Unpacking, bir bireyin küçüklükten yetişkin haline kadar yaşadığı taşınma süreçlerine yardım edip eşyaları düzgün ve doğru şekilde dizdiğimiz tatlı bir yapım. Özellikle kutulardan eşya çıkarmak ölüm gibi olsa da hepsini düzgün şekilde dizdikten sonra gelen o muazzam zevk anlatılamaz.

Belirli seviyeleri geçerken oda çeşitliliğinin artması ve yılların ilerlemesiyle değişen eşyaların dizilim tarzınızı etkilemesi vs. uygun bir şekilde ayarlanmış. Karakterimizin de büyürken ki düzenin hayatında yaptığı gelişmelerden dolayı değişmesi de ayrı hoş detaydı. Müzikler, çizim ve oynayış sırasında olan ince detayların es geçilmeden düzgünce eklenmesine bakıldığı zaman eşya düzenleme kafasında yapılan en iyi oyun denebilir. Tek diyebileceğim eleştiri olarak oyunun 5-6 saat arası oynayış sunmasıydı. Eğer düzen manyağı iseniz ve sürekli oda düzenini değiştirmeyi seviyorsanız Unpacking'i 10 saatten fazla oynayabilirsiniz. 

Gerçek hayatta bu kadar düzenli olmayıp ama bunda adeta eşya dizme manyağına çeviren Unpacking'e zam gelmeden şans vermenizi şiddetle tavsiye ediyorum.

从1997年的儿童房到2018年的双层别墅，八个纸箱，八次搬家，八段被折叠又展开的人生。我们从未见过她的脸，却抚摸过她一生的纹路。

没有台词，一切叙事交给了物品。小猪玩偶从床头到床底，又从柜中重见天日；足球奖杯在男友黑白分明的公寓里，只能委屈地塞进床下；而当两个女孩的连衣裙并肩挂在衣橱，是一种温柔的宣言，爱不是强迫自己融入，而是找到那个连你残缺玩偶和发黄奖状都郑重珍藏的人。  

“真正的收纳，不是把东西放好，而是让每一件旧物，都找到继续被爱的理由。”

Storytelling ambiental, desde a popularização de [i]Dark Souls[/i], tornou-se um método muito utilizado para contar histórias em jogos. Afinal, alimentar jogadores com pedacinhos de um enredo e deixá-los curiosos por mais é uma forma bastante eficaz de conseguir com que seu público escave seu jogo por detalhes. [i]Unpacking[/i] utiliza esta fórmula com maestria ao combiná-la com a leveza típica de jogos aconchegantes para contar sua história.

A jogabilidade consiste em organizar cômodos de diferentes ambientes através dos níveis, porém o que poderia ser apenas uma sequência de cenários avulsos na verdade se trata de uma linha cronológica, acompanhando a vida e jornada de uma protagonista inominada por todos os grandes passos de sua infância até a vida adulta.

É nesta linha do tempo que [i]Unpacking[/i] emprega seu storytelling ambiental, exibindo elementos entre cada um dos diferentes momentos que marcam os níveis do jogo e deixando para quem joga observar e descobrir o que aconteceu na vida da protagonista desde a última vez que a vimos. Isto culmina em uma narrativa de boas surpresas e desenvolvimentos, carregada de uma realidade capaz de fazer a mensagem do jogo ressoar com quem compartilha daquelas experiências.

[i]Unpacking[/i] também conta com uma ótima trilha sonora, acompanhando sua jogatina de acordo com o humor de cada um dos níveis, sem nunca tirar da experiência de ambientação. Os gráficos também são um ponto positivo, compostos por uma arte de pixels muito bem feita, tanto para os cenários quanto para os objetos interativos.

Se o jogo sofre de algum defeito, é apenas de sua duração breve, uma vez que, dependendo do seu senso de organização, os desafios de ordenar os espaços da protagonista não demoram tanto para serem resolvidos. Contudo, para quem busca uma aventura simples e tocante, ou para quem quer se perder em todas as possibilidades organizacionais que ele oferece, [i]Unpacking[/i] oferece um pacote completo.

[b] Target Audience: [/b] [I] Reflective Players, Players who like an Alternate Story, players who like to organize their inventories. [/i]

[b] Summary: [/b]  

Unpacking is a game that's going to be highly hit and miss for a variety of people out there, and the fact is that it's not trying to be anything but what it set out to be: a game where you can unpacking things into a new house. Well, at least at first. A clever use of storytelling makes the game stand out by not dumping exposition and forcing the player to figure out the elements surrounding the game and its items that you are placing into the world. It's able to capture realism with very detailed items from a pixel level where you can recognize that gamecube game case, and the sound design is amazing with the sheer amount of different interactions that you can have. It's a game that's very much designed for you to explore and experiment, and there's an underlying satisifaction that you get even if the game is not entirely grading you 100% of the way. It's relaxing, but not full of pressure.

With that said, those have pointed out the length of the game, and while I don't agree it's not worth a purchase for the content present here, I will say that I did want to see the game's concepts taken to another level. Don't get me wrong, what's here is great, but I could see a community of storytellers absolutely flourishing from a build your own item/house mode, and a scenario constructor. I wanted to see harder decisions like actually considering to have to throw away things, or maybe buy things to put in. The thing is, I think this game is good, and worth your time, but I also think it's very specialized to a subset of people. I think adding some features to expand the world would make it a must buy.

Overall, still a nice game that's worth your time, but be advised it's on Game Pass, if you already have Game Pass.

‎Unpacking is a masterclass in environmental storytelling where the primary antagonist is a poorly shaped cardboard box and your own inability to let go of a high school diploma. 
‎Developer Witch Beam has somehow turned the chore that everyone avoids for six months into a zen-like puzzle game, proving that there is a deep, primal satisfaction in finding the perfect home for a spatula. Hah!
‎X3
‎
‎It’s the only game where you can experience a character's entire emotional arc, from childhood innocence to questionable adult relationships, purely by judging their terrible taste in decorative floor rugs.
‎The gameplay is deceptively simple: you click on a box, pull out a mystery object, and try to fit it into a room that is clearly too small for the protagonist's growing collection of art supplies. It’s a silent narrative told through the medium of "where does this bra go?" and "why do we have so many GameCubes?" You’ll find yourself genuinely rooting for the unseen main character, mostly because you’ve spent twenty minutes trying to figure out if a specific blue plushie belongs on the bed or in the "shame corner" of the closet.
‎(^^)
‎
‎By the time you reach the final level, you’ll have developed a very specific kind of Stockholm Syndrome for organized shelving. Unpacking manages to be both incredibly relaxing and a targeted personal attack on anyone who currently has a "miscellaneous junk drawer." It’s a beautiful, pixel-art reminder that life is just a series of boxes we eventually have to deal with—except in this version, when you finish a room, you get a satisfying gold star instead of a lower back injury and a sense of impending doom.
‎:3

Pequenos detalhes, como um brinquedo de infância que sempre a acompanha ou um prêmio importante que precisa de um lugar de destaque, fazem com que a narrativa se desenrole de maneira natural e emocionalmente impactante.

O visual pixel art é encantador, e a trilha sonora suave cria um clima relaxante e imersivo. Além disso, a mecânica de organização é intuitiva e satisfatória, tornando cada fase uma experiência única. A minha casa favorita, sem dúvida, é aquela com a mesa de RPG e a sala com o cosplay — detalhes que mostram ainda mais a personalidade da protagonista e fazem o espaço parecer realmente vivido e autêntico.

I feel like giving a 'Not Recommended' is too harsh on this game. But I feel like I have to.

This game's premise is everything I love - subtle storytelling (through the houses, photographs and item placement), light puzzles and [i] organising! [/i] I loved the concept that you can't move your roommate's items, but you can move your significant others. I like that certain items evolve over the 20 year period, like the computers, and significant others bring new and different items. I like that you keep items over the 20 years and they show wear, like the plush toys. The art style is beautiful (although sometimes I couldn't identify items due to the vague pixels) and the music was calming, albeit repetitive. I had a lot of fun in the earlier levels, where each level revealed a new room or drastic new items and the lack of storage reflected the character's living situations. And I really did like how you're playing as this unique character and get to go on this journey with them.

Unfortunately, this game just teeters too much on the frustration. 

The puzzle aspect - where items are highlighted red if they're placed in the incorrect position - is just a chore instead of an interesting mechanic (except for one level, where [spoiler] you have to hide a photo of you and your significant other in a cabinet, symbolising the end of your relationship  [/spoiler] ). This puzzle aspect is only revealed after you unpack everything, meaning you might have to re-arrange multiple rooms after you've [i] perfectly [/i] organised everything. All the care I had for the first 95% of the level went out the window when I had to fit these final few items to their "rightful" place. Admittedly you can toggle the puzzle aspect, but it did feel like I was defeating the purpose of the game if I did. I think this mechanic would have been drastically improved if it occurs while you're unpacking. 

Another issue is that boxes in one room (e.g. bathroom) will contain an item from another room that you've already unpacked (e.g. kitchen). This suffers from the same issue above - suddenly you have to reorganise everything, because of a final item that throws a spanner in the works. I appreciate the realism, but when you get to the final level and have [spoiler] TWO FLOORS  [/spoiler] to deal with, it becomes increasingly frustrating to move items to different rooms and then back again. 

Additionally, I felt that there wasn't enough leniency as to where these items can go. In one of the later episodes I placed an item frame next to the television, as my grandmother does the same in real life. Yet this isn't a reasonable enough spot? And why can't the speakers in the final level go on the multi level cabinetry, where there's space? Why does it have to go RIGHT in front of the mirror??? Why can't I  [spoiler] put the baby letter building blocks on the shelves? Does this couple ... not clean up? And I thought it would be really touching to put a copy of the character's book in the baby's room, but I wasn't allowed to do that.  [/spoiler] It's frustrating that the puzzle aspect is so rigid.

The lack of storage is a lot of fun in the earlier levels when it makes sense, but by the time you reach the final level, it feels frustrating that I still can't construct the perfect house, because there isn't enough storage. The character can't buy one more shelf...? My favourite level was definitely the [spoiler] first apartment the character buys  [/spoiler] because there's so much storage!

Another smaller and niche complaint is the repetition of certain items. If I had to see that small red bus [u] one more time... [/u] I do like that the characters have certain memorabilia, but it ends up being an item you throw in the cabinet, far from view.

I was [u] so [/u] close to loving this game. Especially since this is a game from my country. But I ended up just being relieved when the game ended, instead of wanting more. I'm undecided if I can justify the $29AUD price tag for 5 hours of content.

Si ripercorre l'esistenza di una donna nata nel 1984 tramite i traslochi della sua vita; nel corso della storia scopriremo alcune cose su di lei come per esempio che è di origine ebraica, bisessuale, un po' nerd e con una vena artistica... scuola, relazioni, lavoro e così via.
A parte le ormai solite ingerenze moderne ed il chiarissimo indirizzo lgbt etc. il gioco non sarebbe neanche male, piuttosto rilassante e pseudo-romantico/nostalgico... ma ha un paio di difetti:

- Corto, ma solo in relazione al prezzo pieno proposto. Sono circa 3-4 ore di gioco ad andare piano (fare speed-run non è lo scopo di questo gioco, se cercate quello avete sbagliato posto) e quindi 20 euro sono sicuramente tanti. Tuttavia con una key o in offerta si trova facilmente sotto i 10 euro, e allora questo difetto viene meno.

- L'altro difetto sono alcune scelte di gameplay: Sistemandovi nei vari appartamenti che si avvicenderanno negli anni vi verrà fatto obbligo di riporre alcuni oggetti in determinati posti che però non sono molto logici per la nostra mentalità, non per tutti almeno... dovrete quindi tentare di capire o andare a casaccio fino a trovare il posto giusto per ogni oggetto, pena il non poter proseguire. Inoltre spesso gli oggetti sono francamente troppi o insulsi per gli ambienti proposti e questo fa si che a livello terminato la protagonista appaia più come un'accumulatrice seriale che altro. Il tutto potrebbe essere frustrante per chi non appartiene alla stessa cultura di chi ha fatto il gioco.

La mentalità con la quale è strutturata la logica degli arredamenti, infatti, non sembra sud-occidentale o quantomeno sicuramente non latina, visto dove scoprirete che il gioco vuole che mettiate certe cose e come sono arredati i luoghi stessi (tipo l'assenza del bidet, che va ad escludere quindi sicuramente il sud europa... o l'adozione da parte della protagonista di un figlio insieme ad un'altra donna, che restringe ancora di più i papabili paesi in cui può essere ambientata la storia).

In definitiva ho avuto il sospetto che la trama possa essere autobiografica, magari di un'americana/australiana. Per il resto è un passatempo ok a patto di trovarlo sotto i 10 euro. 
Intorno ai 5 sarebbe meglio... l'idea è sicuramente originale (la lore alla netflix un po' meno) ma non è per tutti e comunque è molto breve.

Unpacking is a gem. It's a puzzle/discovery game with gorgeous art and great sound. In Unpacking, you'll unpack the main character's stuff during the moves she makes in her life - from moving into her own room as a child, to going to university, and beyond. My favorite part of the game is how you'll learn bits and pieces about her every time you pull something out of the moving box, and see her grow and change throughout her life, all without ever seeing her on screen. It's a subtle, yet beautiful, way to build a narrative.

The sound design is great. You'll listen to a few different songs (all equally chill) and you can change them by interacting with the music players in the levels. The sounds that trigger every time you pick up and set down an object are well-designed, and never get old.

Also, a random thing I liked: after you complete a level, you can watch a sped-up recording of you unpacking. That might not sound like much, however it is incredibly fun.

This game was gifted to me by a friend, and while it's not my money, I still feel bad for them that they spent $20 on this. We're hoping that this game gets more content and more DLC to make up for that steep price.

Another issue I ran into was not knowing what some objects were and being frustrated that they weren't able to go in the places I put them. One level in particular had me looking for a place to put ONE object for about 15 minutes because it had a very specific place to go that was different from all the other times I placed it.

Please keep up the good work and please add more content to make the price worth it, otherwise I recommend getting this game when it's on sale.

[h1]Finally, my own room![/h1]

[h1]Introduction[/h1]
[b]This review is based on playing on the Steam deck.[/b]
Unpacking is a zen-like puzzle experience about one girl's journey through life, from childhood to adulthood and all the twists and turns between. Set in each of her rooms, apartments and houses throughout her life, it's your job to unpack her story over the years and watch as she evolves with each new chapter. But does the game succeed at unpacking itself from the rest of its kind, or is it destined to gather dust in some forgotten corner?

[table]
[tr]
    [th][b]🟩 Positives[/b][/th]
    [th][b]🟥 Negatives[/b][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]🟩 One of the most heartfelt and expressive non-narrative stories I have ever witnessed in all my years of gaming.

🟩 Simplistic gameplay across ever-growing spaces helps keep the game engaging without becoming burdensome.

🟩 Soft aesthetic tones and gentle, rhythmic music set the stage for a zen-like experience as you unfurl the protagonist's life with each passing chapter.[/td]
    [td]🟥 Quite a short experience despite its relatively steep price point.

🟥 Puzzle gamers might become bored if they are seeking a challenge.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Story[/h1]
The story of Unpacking revolves around a girl named P as she moves from her childhood room to her first apartment and finally to her forever home. But the story is more complex and nuanced than that may seem, as life's filled with moments that help define us as people, and P is no different. As you unpack her life with each new chapter unfolding, you will see items come and go and eventually return. You will see her career develop and her relationships evolve, and in the end, find solace that despite how messy life can get at times, a happy ending awaits us all.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3247498635


[h1]Gameplay Analysis[/h1]
[h3]A tale we all have to tell.[/h3]
The game doesn't deliver many gameplay mechanics, nor do the mechanics evolve much throughout its relatively short five to ten-hour campaign. But there is some calming clarity in this simplicity, where you don't have to feel challenged to be satisfied with the outcome, and you can enjoy the story unfolding without time constraints or counters documenting your errors.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3247498717

The game consists of eight levels of varying size, where you essentially have to unpack boxes and place the items in the correct places based on the type of item they are. There is some moderate freedom in the placement process, and you won't be penalised for placing items in slight variations, although at times, you will have to ensure some items are in the correct rooms or specific places before moving on to the next chapter.

[h1]Audio and Visual[/h1]
Much like the above, because of how the game is designed, there is also not a whole lot to look at. Graphically the game is beautiful and delivers an extremely soothing experience from a visual standpoint, with a clever cartoonish art style that helps carry the unspoken narrative, but just don't expect to be blown away.
With that said, the audio is in a similar boat, not delivering an enormous catalogue of sounds or music to the short experience, it still does an adequate job of backing the storyline without ever distracting from it.

[h1]Deck Performance and Specifications[/h1]
Doesn't require a performance check, the game's low requirements ensure almost anyone can play this title.

[h1]Final Thoughts - Good[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2529084785]Review chart here.[/url]
Unpacking didn't blow me away, it is extremely simple in its design and delivery and doesn't deviate from this in any tangible way throughout its short playtime. Coupled with a rather high price point it's hard to recommend it despite enjoying the experience it provided. I will say that it's a story worth playing through once, but only if you can get it on a steep sale.

Storytelling by finding a place for everything. 

Unpacking is mostly about a unique narrative told through the act of unpacking boxes. The player has to open boxes and move items around to figure out where everything goes. It can be as simple as finding an underwear drawer and throwing all the panties in it. But it also can be anything from finding a good place for a clock radio or a diary. 

The problem is there’s not a lot of puzzle.  When the game is confusing and players can’t figure out what’s wrong with their choice, the game just kind of waits until players figure it out, and that’s just frustrating.  The player sometimes doesn’t even know what an object is, which makes finding a place for it clicking around, rather than storytelling. 

Before someone tells me, I know there’s intentionally no text, but without that text, it often feels like the storytelling can be accidental. I’m avoiding spoilers, but when something has to go under the bed, players of the game will know what I am talking about,  it feels more like a problem with the design of the apartment than a point in the narrative because no direct rule is being explained to the player, instead, it’s where the game will allow you to place something. This isn’t a horrible negative, but it’s something that always bothers me with the praise the game gets for that moment. 

Pick this up if you want a story told uniquely. Not necessarily a unique story, but this delivers an experience unlike anything else. That being said, it is only about 2 hours long, and it’s more of a game to be discussed than a game to challenge players. I’m torn on it but I did enjoy my first playthrough and this time was interesting enough.

I love the concept, the art is great, and the storytelling is excellent, but unless they add more storylines (which seems unlikely at this point), I can't recommend Unpacking.

Прекрасная расслаблялка, в которой нужно расставлять предметы после переезда по своим местам. Очень прикольно что это не просто рандомный набор предметов, а вещи, можно сказать - с историей. Принадлежащие конкретному человеку. Вот наша первая детская комната. Вот первая арендованная квартира с чужими вещами, вот следующая, своя, полностью пустая. По набору "хлама" видно как идет жизнь. Что, например, мы с кем-то съехались. А вот и завели собственных детей. Немножко грустно когда с каждым переездом вещей из самого детства становится все меньше и меньше. На игрушках появляются заплатки.

Реализовано все очень качественно. Поставить что угодно можно почти куда угодно. Разве что на фоне такой свободы, редкие места где что-то разместить все же нельзя - слегка раздражают. Ну и плюс встречаются вещи, которые сразу не разберешь что вообще из себя представляют и где им место. В конце уровня, когда указывают на то, что вообще не на своем месте (совсем нелогичное было пару раз) - начинаешь тупо перебирать. Но это мелочи. Если другие выискивать - непонятно к чему в коробке для условной кухни, могут быть например носки. Т.е. к чему это понятно, реализм. Но немножко с полного чилаута такое сбивает.

Не понравилась - музыка. Уж точно то что звучит - не идеальное сопровождение для игрового процесса и атмосферы. И хотелось бы иметь возможность зумировать картинку. Или иметь промежуточный вариант между теми что предлагаются.

В остальном - прекрасное развлечение.

Mich berührt es immer sehr, wenn Entwickler so viel Liebe zum Detail zeigen. Es gibt so viel kleine Dinge zu sehen und eine Geschichte anhand von Umzügen zu erzählen, das muss man erstmal hinkriegen.
Trotz dessen ganz schön teuer für 4 Stunden.

I love this game so much. 

The game has little to no dialogue (only shows after you've taken a photo of the room you have furnished, and does not talk much about what has happened) the story is told by the furniture, clothes and the house you live in. Every single part of the game is carefully thought out and I appreciate the hard work the team has put into it. 

The art and music was so cute and cozy that you will immediately be immersed. Not to mention the small detail of every object making a different sound depending on where you place it took a lot of work and attention to detail that added a lot to the game. 

I honestly wish there were more stories about different people, because the whole concept of this game makes me feel comfy and relaxes me that you wish there were more.

Unpacking est un jeu que l'on peut qualifier de tranquille, presque méditatif, où l’on déballe des cartons pièce par pièce, mais surtout, souvenir par souvenir.
Sans un mot, il raconte la vie d’une protagoniste à laquelle il sera facile pour chacun de s’identifier, et à travers elle, c’est un peu notre propre histoire qu’on redécouvre.
Unpacking respire la douceur, la sincérité, et la capacité à dire beaucoup avec très peu. Certes, le jeu est court (comptez entre 2 et 5 heures), mais en peu de temps, il nous fait nous sentir bien, nous sentir « chez soi ».
L'émotion transmise est pure, et c'est tout ce qui compte.
What a wonderful life to live! <3 Never give up and hold on... sometimes, you can't see the best version of your life until you put in the effort. Keep trying, and you'll find happiness again! <3

Jogar este jogo foi definitivamente uma experiência única. Por ele possuir de início, um conceito simples de desempacotar caixas e colocar as coisas no lugar, ele pode acabar parecendo meio cansativo e sem graça, porém, a medida com que vc vai jogando, é perceptível a jornada íntima de autoconhecimento que a personagem principal está passando, sendo inevitável não sentir apego e empatia por ela.
E é até estranho que a experiência de organizar a casa no jogo traga esse conforto singular, mas existe algo terapêutico no ato de colocar tudo no lugar certo, transformando ambientes desordenados em espaços que refletem cuidado e harmonia. Enquanto arrumamos a casinha, parece que também estamos colocando nossas próprias mentes em ordem, como se fosse uma pausa tranquila no caos cotidiano.

Queria muito mais jogos assim!
Super recomendo, fez eu me sentir muito bem :3

С огромным удовольствием рекомендую эту игру для прохождения! Да, соглашусь, она недолгая: займет 1-2 вечера, но зато сколько в ней человеческого и душевного... Никогда бы не подумала, что какая-то игра про анпакинг сможет вывести меня на такую чистые эмоции, как печаль, тоска, меланхолия и надежда... В конце пустила слезу, настолько эта игра трогает за душу.. В ней прекрасно все: визуал, сюжет, который вы должны сами додумывать, ну и конечно, музыка... Последняя песня навсегда в сердечке, да и вся игра в целом!
Que jogo fantástico, com uma gameplay extremamente relaxante. Se você como eu, ama organizar coisas, Unpacking é o ideal. Juntamente com as músicas e os pequenos desafios, platinar é uma satisfação.

Unpacking has got to be one of the most lovely games I've played in recent memory. Cute pixel art, nice music, unbelievably complex story told solely through objects? Great stuff man, and some things rattle when you pick em up with your mouse and shake em.

But you already saw my opinion. You saw the "not recommended thing", you saw my play time, you saw the price tag. This is, by no means, a 20 euro game. I'd hardly call it a 10 euro game. Yes, it's well made but the fact they charge so much for it is absolutely SHAMELESS. I finished the entire game and still had time to spare to refund it!! I waited ages for a sale that never came, and I can't help but have my opinion on the game soiled by the asking price.

A shame, really. A very lovely game ruined by greed I'd say.

Meu namorado inicialmente me indicou este jogo, achou que seria minha cara e eu cheguei a experimentá-lo no Gamepass e já naqueles dias, eu havia zerado em pouquíssimo tempo. A capacidade que este joguinho tão simples tem de me tranquilizar e dar boas sensações fazendo algo tão simples - e aparentemente, bobo -  é impressionante, principalmente somada a trilha sonora que só corrobora pra todo esse feeling incrível. O visual é um primor e a história é contada de uma forma sensível e boa parte do tempo, sem dizer uma única palavra. 

A sensação de desempacotar as caixas é quase como se fosse uma criança abrindo aqueles brinquedos misteriosos e confesso que, há certa ansiedade da minha parte em saber o próximo item, o que ele vai dizer sobre a personalidade da protagonista e sobre o momento da vida no qual ela passa exatamente. Se você gosta de jogos calmos, ou até mesmo simplesmente de decorar um ambiente e for uma pessoa sensível o suficiente pra prestar atenção nos mínimos detalhes, ele definitivamente é pra você, mas fique tranquilo: Não é preciso pensar muito pra entender.

O jogo é relativamente curto, por mim existiriam milhares de cenários e eu os jogaria sempre que desse vontade. Estou ansiosa por uma possível sequência. Eu gostei tanto que o meu amor Deyvid, quis me dar de presente aqui pela Steam para que eu sempre tivesse a disponibilidade de jogá-lo quando quisesse e eu farei isso, já peguei todas as conquistas do game! Não posso deixar de mencionar que é um presente lindo, rsrsrs. Por mais jogos fofos e leves como este! ♥

Schade ist, dass man die Gegenstände nicht immer dorthin platzieren kann, wo man möchte. Das verstehe ich nicht so ganz, da man doch selbst der Designer in dem Spiel sein soll. Und schade war, dass in einem Level viele Gegenstände schon festgelegt waren, und ich diese auch gar nicht verschieben konnte. Ansonsten hatte ich aber eine schöne Zeit, und es gibt auch ein paar "Schabernackereien" die man in dem Spiel anstellen kann und dann Errungenschaften für bekommt.

While not usually my genre, I had a really good time with this game. It's cute, it's relaxing, and the environmental storytelling is nice. All that being said, I cannot in any way justify telling anyone else to buy this. It's FAR too short for its price, and even on sale I'm a little annoyed I spent $8 on a game that didn't even last 3 hours. It lasted JUST long enough to avoid being refunded, which I don't feel good about.
I'm sure anyone buying this is already well aware of what they're getting into, and it does what it attempts very well, but this is in no way worth the asking price.

Игра заставила меня задуматься о скоротечности времени и о подлинной ценности моментов жизни. Постепенно погружаясь в небольшой и банальный сюжет бытия главной героини ты невольно позиционируешь себя либо её альтер-эго, либо выступаешь в роли наблюдателя-родителя, в любом случае подсознательно переживая её жизнь на себе. Совершая банальные действия в виде распаковки вещей ты начинаешь подмечать для себя существенные изменения в предметах, в стиле квартир и задумываешься о том, что действительно для тебя в жизни важно, а что стоит изменить и начать отпускать. Игра действительно медитативная, однако навеивает тоску. 
Если говорить о геймплее, то это обычная кликер-головоломка. 
Единственными минусом, который я могла бы выделить красным цветом, является то, что несмотря на метку "расслабляющая игра" на главной странице магазина, здесь не дается полная воля в расстановке вещей. Все они должны находиться на определенных полках, как задумал автор, но.. зачем? Некоторая расстановка вещей (например, диплом университета под кроватью) наоборот раздражает. Я понимаю, что это головоломка, но такое расположение вещей без гайда предугадать практически невозможно... Ещё один минус - мало уровней. Хотелось бы больше историй с разным сюжетом, а здесь всего пара глав, и конец.
Интерфейс в игре потрясающий. Картинка действительно качественная, пиксели только сильнее погружают в атмосферу.
Разработчики щедры на забавные достижения, было приятно их собирать в отдельный альбомчик, ведь они оформлены, как стикеры :) Лично мне это показалось милым и расслабляющим.
В целом, моя оценка этой игре: 9,5/10. Очень хорошая, попробуйте и не пожалеете! Спасибо за внимание <з

游戏的时间从童年到结婚生子，从自己的一间小窝到整个别墅的布局。平淡悠长的人生缩影。

纯粹的点击游戏，如果用手柄的话，会相对减轻右手食指的压力，如果在放上一部电影或者电视剧边玩边看的话，还是比较惬意的。单玩游戏难免会有点单调和烦躁。

流程简单有趣，故事虽然简单，但用搬家时物品的摆放来叙事相当新颖，通过从箱子里拿出一件件物品慢慢拼凑主角的生活又发生了怎样变动的过程充分满足了我的八卦欲望；搬完家后箱子里啥都可能翻出来既真实又给游戏增加了一点点挑战（你怎么知道我真的会用衣服包裹电子产品，快拆我家摄像头）。
不过感觉这个游戏最有难度的地方其实在于当玩家和制作者属于不同文化背景时，可能搞不懂拿在手里的物品是什么，或者相同的物品但有不同的摆放习惯，不过多试几次就能马上试出来（虽然还是不懂箱子里到底拿出来了个啥！）

Unpacking是一个简易的收纳游戏，只需要跟着女主角的成长帮助她整理她孩童时期堆满玩具的房间，青年时期略显窘迫的单间，婚后的双人房，有了孩子后温馨的大家等。随着女主角的长大，她的东西也一直更换着，这些屋子里的物件见证着她的成长和经历，也展现着她多面的性格。从孩童时期起她房间里简易的几根画笔和丢在床脚的足球，到她慢慢购置的更多的画笔 平板 电子绘屏，以及放在家中的第一 第二个足球比赛的奖杯。这些都见证了她的成长，她一直坚持自己的爱好，无论是处于人生中的哪个时期都没有选择放弃。她看过了世界 踏足过许多城市，家里也慢慢摆上了越来越多的纪念品。她收获了爱情，家里多出来枕头 牙刷 毛巾 婴儿床，和合照上越来越多的人。这是她的经历在家中留下的痕迹。除了新物件，她也热衷于自己的老物件，她的玩具娃娃从第一个家到最后一个家一直存在，娃娃从她的玩具变成了她女儿的玩具，正是这些老物件见证了她过去的经历，在老物件和新物件的更替中，她没有忘记过去 也一直在前进。

Bom, ainda não completei tudo (conquistas, digo, a parte dos adesivos, explico mais adiante), mas já zerei o jogo base, então, já dá pra ter uma opinião a respeito.

Em resumo, o nome do jogo já resume as suas atividades, basicamente você terá alguns ambientes no qual teriam sido decorrentes de mudanças (de lar, literalmente) e cabe a você desempacotar as caixas e organizar os itens de acordo. Para não ficar simples demais, os desenvolvedores, inclusive, deixaram alguns itens misturados dentre as caixas (havendo, por exemplo, algum item de cozinha em uma caixa de mudança de um quarto).

Algumas conquistas e objetivos já são decorrentes do seu progresso natural, neste sentido (baseado em você completar cada ambiente, ou seja, organizar todos os itens de todos os locais decorrentes de uma nova mudança). As missões neste aspecto vão se expandindo, fazendo com que as mesmas sejam cada vez mais demoradas para completar.

Contudo, apesar disso, não é um jogo que tomará muito tempo de jogatina. Acredito que a maioria pode concluir o respectivo jogo, ao menos a base dele, em torno de 6 horas (depende de suas habilidades em reconhecer onde devem ficar todos os itens). Em cada missão, depois de desempacotar tudo, se houver, o jogo lhe mostrará com um contorno vermelho, todos os itens que não estão em local adequado (podem estar até mesmo em ambiente errado) e caberá a você vasculhar isso (isso pode lhe tomar um pouco de tempo). Dentre as descobertas mais marcantes, descobri sobre colocar microondas em cima da geladeira e veneno para inseto atrás destes microondas kkk...

Como missão extra, há a coleção de adesivos para completar, alguns são decorrentes de completar as "fases" (digamos assim) simplesmente. Outras, contudo, são decorrentes de fazer determinadas atividades durante a jogatina. Exemplo, montar uma equação na geladeira com os imãs respectivos. Falta eu descobrir os procedimentos para concluir parte destes.

Agora, sobre recomendar o jogo. Acho o preço um pouco alto, pelo que oferece (não é lá um gameplay muito longo e o player não deve querer fazer tudo de uma vez, também). Embora relaxante, é um pouco enjoativo de continuar em uma mesma sessão, jogando por muito tempo. Ao menos, eu achei. Eu acabei pegando com promo de 30% off depois de ter deixado na lista de desejos por um tempo. O jogo é bem tranquilo e bem autodidata, não tem muito segredo para aprendizado de como jogar, é bem simples de entender (e ainda está disponível em PT-BR). Outro ponto positivo é que o jogo é bem leve, rodando tranquilamente em qualquer máquina destinada a jogos (e possivelmente na maioria também com outros fins).
 
Enfim, em resumo seria isso. A ideia achei bastante original e criativa e pelo que vi nos créditos, tem ligação com a avó de uma das pessoas envolvidas no projeto (tem uma dedicatória a respeito, com uma "foto" no final, em arte, como é o jogo todo). Talvez até por isso se dê pra notar um grande capricho e carinho com o modo ao qual foi feito (tendo-se em vista a análise do resultado, tudo tem um visual bastante agradável, inclusive nos detalhes).

No geral, é isso, recomendo o game, tranquilamente. 
Só acho o preço normal um pouco alto tendo-se em vista que é um jogo um pouco curto.

Observação: Uma pequena atualização, coletei dicas dos adesivos pendentes. Por meio deste acabei conquistando o que faltava com menos de 1 hora a mais de jogatina. No meu caso, 8 horas e meia no total.

Unpacking is a cute little game in which you follow the protagonist of the game through different stages of their life starting in their kids bedroom and help them decorate their home through out these times. The game is divided in different chapters, named after the year in which the specific chapter takes place.

The game tells alot of its story visually, you get to know the protagonist through different visual clues which the game is giving you. For example that they like gaming or that they were doing cosplay at some point in their life. Those and many more little details make Unpscking so great in its visual story telling. 

The game does ALOT OF things right but there are a few smaller things that annoyed me personally ~ for example that you can only place some items in dpecific places/areas around the house. Or that even tho there is technically enough room, you can't place a smaller item next to other items. That mostly happened to me with pots or pans. 

But maybe the point that some items can only be in specific areas  around the house or room is also part of the visual narrative of the game, who knows? 

Overall I can wholeheartedly recommend the game to people who like cute, cozy and chill games or just people who want to play something relaxing after a long day. Due to its short playtime you could probably finish it in one sitting if you wanted to, but i'd personally recommend that you take your time with it.

原价竟然70，这游戏完全配不上好评如潮。最大的缺点就是物品只能放在制作组规定的地方，哪怕能自圆其说或者是符合生活习惯的正常摆放方式也过不了，鬼知道剧情设定的[spoiler] 为了凸显搬去和男主住东西放不下自己得的玻璃框大奖章必须放在床底下是为什么，不能收起来或者放在架子上，就非要放那破床底下。和男朋友分手了照片就一定要放在柜子里藏起来....[/spoiler]有很多小东西可能歪果仁一眼就能看出来是什么物品应该放哪，我看不出来。适合m。被控制狂，和什么游戏都吃得下的人玩。唯一优点就是但触发的小成就还算萌。真要玩同类游戏不如去买呓语小镇。
游玩过程里想起许多童年的回忆，例如床上的长条形玩偶，小学的时候看干物妹小埋，也买了一个蓝白色长长的玩偶。摆放的过程配合bgm也非常放松治愈，想起小时候在4399里玩的夏日冰屋，也是在屋里摆放东西。像素的画风和复古的音乐仿佛把我带回童年里了，很沉浸，很喜欢。

I want to recommend this game. It's adorable, cute, relaxing, you get to find yourself in a different way of storytelling by unpacking - but, it is way too expensive for what you get, since it has little to no replay value (items can be placed only in mostly the same areas). In the beginning I thought, since you had three different photo albums available, that you would play through three different people's stories. For that, 20€ would have been justified. But nope, it's just one person and you're done after 4-5 hours. If you want to buy it regardless, only do so on sale.

Ich mag das Spiel - Das Design, die Handhabung und auch die Geschichte hinter den Kartons, die ich in den letzten sechs Stunden nach und nach auspacken durfte. Ich hätte nicht gedacht, aber ich hatte einen wundervollen Einblick in die Geschichte eines Menschen, die sehr simpel erzählt wird. Und es ist überraschend, dass es überzeugend, aber vor allem rührend, ist. Die Musik ist toll und begleitet wundervoll.

Dieses Spiel ist sooo niedlich und entspannend. Es ist schwer zu erklären, warum eigentlich. Es sind die liebevoll gezeichneten Dinge, die angenehme Hintergrundmusik, die Tatsache, dass man alles im eigenen Tempo herumbewegen kann bis es einem gefällt (und mit der Logik des Spiels im Einklang ist. Ab und zu mal war ich anderer Meinung, wo etwas hinpasst, aber das war okay.) und es dabei passende Sounds abgibt. Mit einigen Dingen kann man auch interagieren (sowie natürlich mit Schranktüren und Schubladen, sonst könnte man ja nicht einräumen. Ein nettes Detail ist dabei, dass z.B. Türen dann an die Dinge stoßen, die man versehentlich in den Weg gestellt hat etc.) Ich fand es jedesmal interessant, welche Geschichte die Dinge und die neue Wohnung erzählen von dem Weg, den die Hauptperson geht - Vorlieben, Hobbies, Beruf, Beziehungen. Und wie realistisch leicht chaotisch die Sachen manchmal in den Kartons gelandet waren. 

Dieses Spiel ist wirklich sehr nett gemacht in allen Details. Es ist keine wirklich große Sache, kein Riesenerlebnis oder etwas, das man unbedingt gesehen haben müsste - aber es ist genau das Richtige, um einfach mal runterzukommen, wenn man Ruhe und Gemütlichkeit braucht.

TL;DR : This game is way too short to justify a $20 price-tag, but if you can grab it for $10 or less, you should.
I was really enjoying the game, then I got to the final cinematic and thought to myself, "Wait a second... that was it? Really?! that was all I got for $20?!" It was a nice experience but it was spoiled by the feeling that I just got ripped off. This game should probably be $10 or less. If the devs had plans to add more levels later (which they apparently don't), or if they allowed for the community to create custom levels, it would probably be worth its current asking price (although even if these things were added $15 would still probably be a fairer price). 
Also, I have to say, I think it's a little annoying that the devs teased "big announcements" that just ended up being ads for new merch or just announcing that the game is coming to another platform. It honestly feels like a slap in the face to see these announcements. The only critique I've seen of this game is that there aren't enough levels, yet the devs seem utterly reluctant to add new content. I personally enjoy indie games in large part due to the tendency of indie devs to actually pay attention to what the fans want, sadly it seems as though this is not the case when it comes to Unpacking.

特别特别温柔特别特别温暖特别特别治愈的游戏，代入感很强，就像是认识了一个赛博朋友一样。
通过一个一个房间和她一起经历了她的前半生。
你陪着她慢慢长大，从一个小女孩到上大学再到遇见心爱的人，最后自己买房领养了一个小宝宝。
看着她的生活变得越来越好越来越幸福，喜欢的画画爱好也没有丢掉，从小到大积累的画画本子越来越多，画画的工具也越来越多，最后一关的蓝皮书应该是主角出的绘本吧，把自己的爱好变成了事业。
我觉得最感动的是倒数第二个房间，就是主人公刚和女朋友同居那段日子，你在整理她们房间的时候的感受真的像片尾曲唱的那样“your house plant brightens up the dreary windowsill”，整个房间都有生命力生活气息了。
很喜欢片尾曲，特别治愈。
是我今年通关过最喜欢的游戏。

[h1] Points positifs : [/h1]

- L'histoire simple et émouvante
- Le pixel art magnifique et éloquent
- Bande-sonore discrète et jolie
- La narration environnementale
- Un gameplay minimaliste mais efficace
- Une ambiance toute cosy
- Le plaisir de déballer des cartons de déménagement sans effort
- Un véritable sentiment de satisfaction

[h1] Points négatifs : [/h1]

- Le placement des objets borné (malgré l'ajout d'une option pour un placement libre)
- Durée de vie trop courte (environ 5h00)
- Devient un peu répétitif à la longue
- Un petit manque d'interaction
- Des objets parfois difficiles à identifier

[h1] En conclusion... [/h1]

[i] Unpacking est une expérience zen et satisfaisante, mais il est bien plus qu’un simple jeu au gameplay minimaliste mais ô combien efficace. Sans un mot, sans une image, le titre parvient à raconter l’histoire intime et touchante d’une femme au fil des moments les plus marquants de sa vie. Le titre excelle dans sa narration environnementale et parvient à refléter notre propre vécu et nos propres expériences. On regrettera un manque de rejouabilité et une durée de vie qui sera jugée trop courte pour certains, mais si vous êtes friands d’expériences atypiques et cosy, foncez ! [/i] >> 15/20

[h1]Unpacking — найлегший переїзд у житті[/h1]
Медитативні ігри зазвичай проходять повз мене, особливо коли головна їхня мета — це неспішне проходження, насолода музикою та візуалом без якоїсь чіткої кінцевої мети. Тим паче коли ніхто не перевіряє, як пройдено рівень (ХОЧУ ОЦІНКУ КОЖНОЇ МОЄЇ ДІЇ В ІГРАХ!!!).

Менше з тим, Unpacking — це дійсно мила та цікава гра, яка змогла розповісти історію людини, змушуючи нас просто розпаковувати коробки та розставляти речі в нових помешканнях. Через предмети, які переміщуються з одного місця в інше навіть через багато років, через маленькі деталі та веселі й сумні моменти гра знайомить нас із цікавою, простою, а тому й реальною історією, у яку легко повірити.

Геймплей достатньо простий: у кожній кімнаті нового житла стоять коробки, з яких по черзі дістаємо предмети та розставляємо так, як вважаємо за потрібне. Коли розпакування закінчиться, гра підкаже, які речі лежать не на своїх місцях (як-от чайник у ванній або мікрохвильовка у спальні). Правила не жорсткі, вони радше підказують, куди речі покласти логічніше (у гри навіть є варіант проходження, де всі речі треба розставити неправильно).

Загалом це й усе. Приправлено красивою графікою, приємними звуками (кожен предмет кладеться та шумить як справжній), спокійною музикою та доволі коротким проходженням. Його, звісно, можна розтягнути, якщо довго обирати, як прикрасити кімнати, й переставляти речі з місця на місце. Від себе гру рекомендую на знижці — було цікаво годинки три пограти.

In Unpacking, you relive the memories you have from all the time you moved out in your life. The gameplay is really simple : you get items out of the boxes and place them in the house.

This is not a "puzzle game" at all, what they call "puzzle" is rather the restrictions you have about where you can place items. It's just common sense, like you can't put things on the ground, kitchen items must go in the kitchen etc.
You also have plenty of space so there's no problem on this side either.

I considered dropping the game after the first two houses... but surprisingly I kinda started enjoying the game. The relaxing side is really effective and I thought the achievements to be fun to hunt.

So yeah, as a puzzle game, it's pretty terrible and I unfortunately can't recommend it. But the game isn't bad, it's one of this time you wish Steam had a "mixed feelings" option.

I'm also a bit fed up with misleading games like that.

[h1]休闲的开箱玩法[/h1]

游戏的内容非常简单，就是使用鼠标将箱子中的物品一件一件取出来，并且放在对应的位置，游戏允许玩家尽可能的缩小收纳的位置，但是没有强迫玩家必须要如何收纳，例如衣服尽可能的收纳在衣橱中，但是没有必要让容易皱折的衬衣一定要挂起来，一旦挂衣钩不够了，玩家也可以将衣服折叠起来收纳。内衣内裤可以放置在抽屉里，也可以选择其他的位置放置，玩家要尽可能的让整个房间变得舒适整洁起来，非常适合杀时间的游戏。同时，游戏也是强迫症的福音，游戏的物品收纳其实并不是非常高的自由度，基本上是隐形的方格摆放，每一件物品都有占用的方格数量，而收纳区域也分成长宽高多个方块，这样玩家就比较轻松的可以摆放出整整齐齐的样子，而不必纠结。这样是有好处，但是缺点也是自由度不太够，并且有些区域感觉还可以再放些东西，但是因为方格不够了，所以无法再往上面添加了。

[h1]八个时间节点的年代感十足[/h1]

游戏中的八个关卡，对应着主人公人生中的不同年龄阶段与时代背景，而不同的时间点，玩家收纳的物品也会不尽相同。在最初的1997年的背景中，主人公还是一名学生，收纳的区域也只有自己的房间（因为其他的房间会交给父母收纳吧），而收纳的物品也都是学生性质的，学习用品，书包，玩具等。而随着时间的推进，玩家伴随着主人公的成长，有些物品在每个关卡都会出现，是主人公的爱惜的传家宝了，而有些物品在传下来的过程中还会发生变化，会变多之类的，喻示了主人公的成长。而随着年龄的增长，主人公的成长，家中的收纳就不再仅限于自己的一亩三分地了，从主人公上大学，开始独立一个人生活，就会增加许多房间，厨房，洗手间等的收纳。而每个箱子中的物品，也不仅仅是在该房间中使用，也有可能是其他房间的物品，毕竟搬家打包的时候是有空就塞，并不会按房间划分，这也是符合真实度的一个设定。渐渐的，跟随着主人公的成长，迈入社会，结婚。从前只有一个人的衣服，进而变得越来越多，收纳的难度也随之增加，玩家在玩到后面经常会需要将原有的摆放物品重新摆放，从而腾出更多的空间来收纳整理，经常会遇到没有空间的时候，就需要玩家进行一些调整，而游戏没有对时间有什么限制，玩家只要轻松游戏，都可以轻松通关。

[h1]摆放错误会标红提示[/h1]

游戏虽然给与玩家一定的自由度，但是并非让玩家完全自由，毕竟这是一款收纳游戏，不是让玩家把物品摆一地的。因此，在所有箱子开箱完成之后，游戏会自动判定一些物品是否不在对应的位置，在不合适的地方的物品会用红色的边框标出来，玩家只需要拿起它们重新找到合适的地方摆放，全部完成之后就可以通关了。每一件物品的摆放并不是唯一的，但是有些物品确实存在限制，玩家可能需要寻找一段时间才能找到合适的位置摆放。我在游戏的体验过程中，偶尔会遇到我也不认识的物品，从而不知道它应该放在什么位置，而因为允许的地方可能摆放了其他的物品，造成寻找合适的位置寻找很久，最后发现需要移动一下其他的物品，重新摆放才可以，这个过程还是有些头疼的。要是游戏能给一些物品提示或直接告诉玩家物品的名称可能会更好一些。即便是物品全部摆放正确了，我有很多物品也叫不出名字来，只知道他们应该放在马桶边上，床底下，以及必须要摆放在橱柜上。

[h1]白金成就党的福利[/h1]

游戏的成就算是非常容易获得的了，游戏除了通关成就之外，还有一些组合成就，需要玩家达成某些条件即可解锁，前期的成就都比较简单，后期的成就需要玩家调整一些位置，以及一些操作等，就比较复杂了，建议玩家通关一次之后，查缺补漏，回过头来找一下攻略，看一下哪个关卡的成就还没有获得，这样想要完成全成就就很容易了。我打完了全成就也没有用到4个小时。

[h1]总结[/h1]

游戏是一款非常轻松惬意的禅意游戏，玩家在生活中的浮躁尘嚣可以在游戏中得到精华，玩家在游戏过程中也不要过于急躁，慢慢整理，慢慢收拾。游戏玩一段时间就有一种在玩山神教的感觉，更多的是操作，通关之后还可以反复游玩，每一次都有不一样的体验。这款游戏非常适合女孩子玩，满足收纳的欲望。同时，也希望玩家在现实生活中也可以将自己的物品收纳整洁，给自己营造一个整洁干净的生活环境，心情也会随之愉悦，毕竟脏乱邋遢的房间谁也不会喜欢的，正好可以借着游戏学习一下物品的分类与收纳。游戏我非常推荐，因为好玩，因为它真的可以带给我一天的好心情，这是我们玩游戏的初衷啊。

A cozy neat game.

In Unpacking, you move through the life of a girl who every couple of years has to unpack and reorganize her life. It plays like a Sims game, where you get an isometric view of the rooms and you unpack and tidy all your belongings.

The puzzle component being that you actually have to put the items in their right places. There's a little story going on, with partners moving in and out, and small houses where there's not enough room for everything, so you actually need to think on how to stash some items.

It's a super short game with a lot of attention to detail. There were tons of times that it reminded me of my own house moves, with items like consoles, tons of socks, posters, more kitchenware than needed, etc.

Recommended for chilling out.

reviews.review:
[b] English: [/b]

Unpacking is one of those games that starts quietly and then somehow digs deep into your heart.

You open boxes, arrange items in new apartments, and slowly realize that you aren't just sorting rooms—you are piecing together an entire life, bit by bit.

The genius of it is that the game manages without a single line of dialogue, yet still tells an incredibly rich story.
Every object holds meaning, every new apartment feels like a chapter, and you come to understand the person's story solely through the things they own.

It is quiet, meditative, and surprisingly emotional.
Eventually, you realize that you are no longer just "tidying up," but witnessing goodbyes, changes, and different phases of life.

Verdict:
Unpacking is short, but it stays with you long after you’ve finished—a game about change that never speaks a word.

9/10 — I never thought unpacking boxes could be this emotional.

While its relaxing, great game to play while watching a show on another monitor, I just cant recommend it because of the price. It took me 4 hours to 100% and with a $20 price tag that seems a tad too expensive when you can get other sorting games for much cheaper.
It's a great game, but it's a bit pricey for the amount of content, and there's not much replay value.

[b]It took me a while to beat Unpacking. Not in terms of hours played, but in terms of real-world time from start to finish. I just didn’t get the [i]zen[/i] aspect of this one that others laud so much, as much as I wish I could’ve. I think part of this is due to real world circumstances. However, if I look beyond that I can see how Unpacking is a quality title worth recommending.[/b]

When I got Unpacking on the back of a lot of praise from friends, I thought I would really enjoy it. Although I did buy it somewhat apprehensively because I knew how much disliked this unpacking process in real life, I was still expecting to enjoy it more than I did.

In the past 8 years of my life, I’ve had to move internationally some 4-5 times. Moving and setting up again has become so much of a pain in my life, and filled with a lot of mixed emotions (my most recent move immediately following the tragic death of both my mom and grandmother), that even though I didn’t necessarily want to live where I am living now, I committed to staying here for an extended time just to finally stop the cycle of continually uprooting my life every 2 years.

I think this definitely prevented me from really feeling the [i]zen[/i] part of Unpacking. I had a hard time separating that anxiety and frustration in the game from that which I’ve felt in real life.

However, I had some other frustrations with this game, too.

Unpacking does a phenomenal job effectively communicating what items are with the limited perspective and pixel-art style. It’s a true achievement! However, there are some limitations, too. I struggled to properly identify what some items were on almost every level, and I can imagine this is an even more difficult process for those who didn’t spend some portion of their lives in USA, Australia, Canada, etc.

All in all, I think Unpacking [b]should be praised[/b] for how they dealt with this hurdle more than criticized, which is ultimately why I recommend this title, but I’d be lying if I didn’t say there were a significant number of moments of confusion. This wasn’t the biggest issue, though.

My biggest issue with Unpacking [u]is the lack of freedom[/u], [i]particularly[/i] in the later levels.

I think preventing you from unpacking certain items wherever you want is a major misstep for this game.

For me, I would’ve gained a massive level of enjoyment if I could’ve been sillier or expressed my way of organizing more in this game. For story purposes, I think it’s fine if you’re more limited in the early part of the game, when you’re a child or when you’re in an early-stage relationship or something.

Particularly in the later levels, though, I found it continually frustrating [i]”finishing”[/i] every level and still having a dozen items the game doesn’t like where I unpacked them.

And in many of these cases it wasn’t even a situation of me being intentionally weird or out of place, the game is just overly nitpicky for me. When I look at other reviews, I am astonished at how few others are mentioning this. The one way that I could’ve truly felt relaxed and more creative in this game, was largely prevented.

If the dev goal was to make you feel zen, then I think a more streamlined experience where once you were ready to move on, [i]you could[/i] would’ve been the more appropriate move. I recognize that I’m in the minority here, but, again, I’d be lying if I didn’t say the game made me feel this way.

The brilliant pixel-art, soothing music, and fulfilling story are very nice points, and the screenshotting details are good, so I can’t not recommend this game, but this is unfortunately a [b]barely[/b] recommend for me, as I truly felt frustrated quite a significant portion of this experience and there were so many games I would’ve rather played at any moment it took me well over a year to finish a game that’s only 5 hours in length.

[b]6.5/10[/b]

[h1]Unpacking is a fairly short puzzle game involving sorting out items in a living space.[/h1]


Platform: Steam Deck
Time for completion (w/ 100% achievements): 4.6h


Unpacking is a must play puzzle game for people into cozy gaming for sure, everything works well together: Controls, story and soundtrack. However, I personally don't find it mindblowing or a super charming game, it's just a really solid game. There's not much variation in terms of puzzle aesthetics, you're mostly doing the same thing, moving into a new place and unpacking the items into the interior of the rooms in the correct spot, i.e. soaps into bathrooms, toys into bedrooms.


The story behind the puzzles is actually a very subconscious flair into the puzzles, you don't really get it until the end. At first I was like "Hey! Cute puzzles.." and certain stages, I felt more negative emotions like frustration. That is, INTENTIONAL. After you finish the game then you realize that the difficulty of the puzzles were adjusted to make you feel certain emotions in certain levels, so if you're looking for a simple puzzle game to kill time, this isn't exactly the type of game you'd be expecting to play.


Before getting this game, I'd suggest you to think of this as a story centric puzzle game than simply a puzzle game to adjust your expectations, but apart from that, Unpacking is a really solid game overall. I don't necessarily think the price tag of the game is too high but it's a game I'd be more likely to get on sale than not. I didn't particularly find myself engrossed in the puzzles, just picked it up whenever I remembered I had it installed and killed around 30 minutes per session until I completed it xD


Overall game rating: 6.5/10

除了流程太短以外没什么缺点的游戏。

大概三个小时通关，没有去刻意收集成就，相对来说70块钱感觉可能略贵建议等打折或者看看后续更新。

游戏玩法和叙事方式都很新奇，虽然是个空间管理游戏但是更多的还是能够让你随心所欲布置的玩法，没有什么难度，哪怕你卡关了也会有提示告诉你哪里出了问题可以说非常仁慈。

真要说不满意的地方虽然不算缺点，那就是游戏本身通过一种让玩家察觉家中布置变化和风格来揭示剧情，这是一种非常有趣且新奇的方式，但是游戏后期各种情节上的提示太过于明显以至于让我觉得失去了一些遐想的乐趣和格调。

游戏整体观感非常棒，据说制作组为了让所有物件的摆放交互更加自然所以为这个游戏录制了一万多种不同物品相互碰撞的音效，可以说非常非常用心，配合音乐玩下来相当的享受（虽然我觉得配乐有点迷之忧伤以至于我中间甚至怀疑是不是什么悲剧色彩的结局......)

游戏的像素画画的也非常的用心，一般类似的游戏物件只有同一个贴图的两个角度，而这款游戏则是将大部分物体的正反面全部画了出来（不是全部）。

另外游戏存在一点比较神秘的逻辑问题，比如一般来说下意识里我肯定认为厨房里的切丝器啊电热水壶啊都是摆放在桌台上的，但是这款游戏我目前发现只有你放在柜子里才是正确的...
而游戏中没有见到任何的餐盘摆放架 你只能露着摆放在柜子上，看着有点揪心...

最后一点就是成就相对来说比较少，这种游戏一大重复游玩的乐趣就是收集各种隐藏成就，但是目前感觉大部分成就并没有什么画面上的交互且数量很少，即使我完全没刻意去收集一周目下来我也完成了一大半的成就了。

这游戏让我最大的疑惑就是，这是个啥？那又是个啥？？我很肯定地说，每一关起码都有四件物品让人根本不知道是个什么玩意，然后还必须严格地摆在正确的位置，那就只能瞎凑呗？

比如说第四关，我把一个烤面包机一样的蓝色东西往客厅的音响上一放，居然对了；第六关有个竖着的白色小盒子，看起来像个不明所以的电子产品，但不论是书桌上，架子、柜子、抽屉里都不对。整个游戏的节奏都被这个框架连累了。

干脆点，全部取出来摆好之后，让玩家自己觉得满意了就可以进入一下关得了呗，反正截图也是玩家自己欣赏，条条框框地图个啥。

自诩是个禅意游戏，实际上也没给人多少自由发挥的空间，禅意何在呢？只是因为画风圆润，音乐舒缓吗？ 

除此之外，设计有一处不好，箱子跟无底洞似的，一直取出一直取出，我都不晓得还有几件物品，而且取出的物品也是随机的，不是什么从小到大之类的，在考虑摆放位置的时候，经常因为后续的意外要反复调整，为什么不像俄罗斯方块一样，起码让人知道下一件物品的大小和形状？

本作的立意上，让我想到前阵子玩的[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1290000/_/]冲就完事[/url]，两者都是在做一件单调的事情。本作是把东西从箱子里拿出来，摆到不同的地方；后者是用高压水枪清洗不同的物体。但是这两部作品的发展方向非常迥异，本作想透过时间轴和物品来表达主人公的生活变化，这导致就算是不同的关卡，箱子里翻来覆去掏出来的也都是一样的东西。我玩这个游戏的时候，很放松，但同时也觉得很无聊，因为一点新意都没有。

说起来，比起开箱子，我更喜欢装箱子。以前经常是，早上7点要出门赶飞机了，好！半夜3点半开始收拾行李，然后上了飞机就睡觉，到了地方也不想拆包，就想那么放着，放着，让小精灵们趁我睡着的时候把东西都收拾好。装箱还是蛮有成就感的，整整齐齐，四四方方，但是，经过了托运也好，邮寄也罢，到手后打开一看会发现里面的东西已经混乱一团，虽然没有易碎品，但是看着那惨样，就完全不想动弹了，这也是为什么我喜欢装箱而不是开箱吧

喏，针对这个“不能随意放置物品”的问题，玩完之后我在设置里看到一个选项，叫做“是否允许随处放置物品”。如果勾选了的话，随意地把物品摆放好就算作完成，可以进入下一关了。

我是玩完之后才发现的，为啥嘞？因为它这个设置是在【无障碍功能】的分页菜单里。我打开游戏，设置一下语言，看一下音频里音量有没有开最大，视频里画面选项有没有自动适配，控制我都没去看，无非就是点点点嘛，无障碍功能我更没去看，无非就是色盲选项嘛。好家伙，暗示读不到制作组意图的玩家是智力障碍是吧？没错我是在过度解读，但是制作组把这个选项放在无障碍里是不是有点整蛊。

なんだこの作業…
いくらなんでもそんなことはないだろうと思って買って遊んでみたのだが、PVから想像する見た目まんまの作業ゲームでした。自分の部屋すら片付いていないのに、金を払って他人の部屋を片付けるという謎の娯楽。
唯一かつ最大のポイントは、部屋の様子や荷物の中身から、主人公の人生を想像して楽しむサイレントドラマになっていること。これパズルゲームって書いてあるけどあえて分類するならアドベンチャーゲームやろ。ああ今度の部屋にはルームメイトがいるんだなぁとか、次の引っ越し先に持ってきたこの人形はそうかそのルームメイトからもらったのね、とか、彼氏と同棲するにあたってあのぬいぐるみは置いてきちゃったのか、とか、いい加減ゲームキューブやめて新しいハード買いなよ、とか、そういう感慨をしんみりと味わえます。そしてそれが意外といける。意外どころか全然いける。新しい。
値段なりの内容かというとやはり若干疑問ですが（すぐ終わっちゃうしもっとネタ仕込めるのに…）無駄な時間を過ごしている感じは全くしません。実際かなり楽しみました。下手な映画などよりははるかにいい。絵本のシーンなどはほんと最高。
頭も反射神経も一切使わないので、酒飲みながら遊べるゲームというのも貴重。

Fell in love with the game, only for it to end well before $20 worth of game play. Was very sad. :( Lots of fun trying to find places for everything that looks good and matches what you want to do. It's not a 'everything has one place to go', you can stack things on shelves how you like, and move lots of stuff around the kitchen. Obviously there are limitation to what is considered 'unpacked' and not just laying around.

It even had some solid emotional touches and a reverse course in life that made me grin and chuckle. The biggest issue is that I finished the game in less than 4 hours of active play. Now, I can go back and grab the 2 stickers I haven't gotten yet, basically achievements, and move stuff around to reorganize, but beyond that there's nothing. No more game play, no more levels, no different style of game play or anything else to give more meat to the content.

Would wait for a sale or some updates expanding content before purchasing at current price. Besides that, beautiful game, awesome idea, and good story without there being much of any actual narration or written story.

I love the story the game tells me through the process of me unpacking the main character's belongings. I would suggest going at a slow pace and really think about the belongings of the main character and why they own that item, as that's how you piece the story together.

Personally, the act of unpacking in-game and putting things into order makes me feel calm and relax. It's a lot like cleaning up my room IRL.

Definitely wait for a sale, unless you're in desperate need of calming down. It reminds me of a jigsaw puzzle but with the aesthetics & mechanics turned up to 100. 

If you're one of those people that watches the same TV show over and over to relax, then you might love this game. Coming home from a long day of work with no capacity left for anything but some aesthetic puzzles - combined with the nostalgia and positivity that the game's atmosphere achieves - can be just what you need to breathe. 

This game gives a real hopeful feeling of moving onwards, of keeping memories with you, and reminds you of the potential beauty in change/new beginnings. Can't believe how many hours I've spent on this game.

i was actually really excited for this game but its so frustrating to be bound by rules that arent really based on anything. like i get that you dont put your partners laptop in the study room because thats probably not where they want it, but why the heck does some kitchen utensil have to be in a designated spot and if you put it on the counter its unacceptable and you have to move it to proceed? doesnt make any sense to have this kind of hindrance in a game thats supposed to have you in control of where things go. and its not even just some "common sense" thing, as in "you cant put the plushies on the stove", there are things that HAVE to go in certain drawers and you cant have them on display or vice versa, a lot of stuff like that. it literally wouldnt let me put a potted plant on the floor. i thought id be relaxing going into this but im more tense after playing. just seems weird to me that they chose to make the game so limiting all around. whats the point of letting me unpack if youre gonna tell me its all wrong afterwards? PLUS you cant even put pots pans trays etc inside the oven. thats literally where all that stuff always goes in so many households.

[B]Vorab:[/B] Ich empfehle dieses Spiel [B]nicht[/b] für den Vollpreis & selbst den Sale für 9,99€ sollte man sich bei einer maximalen Spieldauer von 3,5 Stunden inklusive 100% Errungenschaften sehr gut überlegen.
[B]Unpacking[/B] ist genau das, was ihr von diesem Produkt nach dem Anschauen der Trailer erwertet: Ein Karton-Auspacksimulator, bei dem ihr verschiedene Gegenstände in ihre jeweiligen Zimmer & teilweise sogar auf ihre jeweiligen Plätze räumen müsst. Im Review gehe ich auf ein paar Punkte ein.

[H1]Die Handlung...[/H1]
...des Spieles. sofern wir es als diese bezeichnen können, beschränkt sich im wesentlichen auf das Verfolgen des Lebens der Protagonistin, die zwischen 1997-2018 verschiedene Umzüge erlebt. Wir beobachten das Verschwinden & Dazukommen von Gegenständen & müssen uns die dazugehörige Geschichte und/oder Ereignisse selbst zusammenreimen. Ein Voice-Over, Textschnipsel oder anderweitige Erklärungen gibt es nicht.
Leider begleiten wir den Charakter auch gerade mal bis um die 30 Jahre, alles was danach hätte kommen können & womit ich gerechnet habe, passiert leider nicht.

[H1]Die Interaktionen...[/H1]
...mit den Gegenständen sind aber sehr süß. Wir sehen Kühlschrankmagneten? Wieso machen wir daraus nicht eine mathematische Gleichung und erhalten dafür eine Steam-Errungenschaft? Wieso klicken wir nicht ein bisschen auf dem Fernsehr, der Anlage oder den Lampen herum, oder stellen Weingläser auf ihre Untersetzer?
Bis auf wirklich wenige Ausnahmen können wir die Gegenstände innerhalb ihrer Räume frei gestalten & so individuelle Zimmer einrichten.

[H1]Irreführend fand' ich jedoch...[/H1]
...die anderen Reviews, die von 'Spoilern', 'extrem intensiver Geschichte' oder 'selten dagewesener Liebe zum Protagnoisten' sprachen. Sellt euch vor, was in einem gewöhnlichen Durchschnittsleben so passiert. Umzug, Erwachsenwerden, Partnerschaft, Kinder. Das alles passiert. Es gibt nichts zu Spoilern. Wenn ihr erwachsen seid wisst ihr, was in einem Leben passieren kann und wird.
Dennoch ist es ein süßes Spiel, das mir Freude bereitet hat. Doch wie eingangs erwähnt, die 'Empfehlung' ist nur eingeschränkt, der Inhalt ist wirklich wenig, wenn auch mit Liebe gemacht.

成就通关了《Unpacking》，大约4小时。这是一款名副其实的搬家后拆箱子游戏。游戏一共分为八个关卡。在每一个关卡中，女主人公都处在需要收拾屋子的状态之中，基本上是属于乔迁新居，房屋的各个房间里面堆放着好几个箱子。箱子里面有各种各样的物品。玩家需要把这些东西逐个拿出并且安置好。尽管玩家安置的具体状况有一定的自由度，但是不能太离谱。如果吧烤面包机安放到洗手间，把浴巾安放到婴儿房，就会有闪光提示放置的地方不合适。在第一关时，女主应该是和家人住在一起，只有一个上床下桌和简单的陈设，之后她和其他室友合租，恋爱，分手，再次恋爱……到了最后一关，玩家需要整理的已经是一个多达10个房间的别墅。好在每一关都会有一些和之前重复的物品，这意味这女主搬家的时候带着这些东西搬到了新家。有些东西很好收拾，比如袜子、胸罩显然是要放到卧室衣橱或者储藏间的抽屉里，书籍、唱片和笔记本可以竖着码放在卧室或者书房的架子上，高压锅要放在厨房，洗发水要放在浴室。但是也有些东西我不知道该怎么放，比如擀面杖或者不知道是什么的白色机器。毕竟，这款游戏除了每一关通关时的一句描述或者感叹之外，没有任何文字说明，仅凭像素画的表情达意，有时力有未逮。

Unpacking - это невероятно приятная и расслабляющая игра. Геймплей максимально простой: у вас есть разные комнаты и множество коробок в каждой из них. Вам нужно распаковать и разместить по местам одежду, аксессуары, безделушки, открытки, посуду, технику и игрушки. Иногда содержимое коробок может быть перепутано, и вы можете, например, найти тостер в спальне.

Главная фишка игры - это ее атмосфера. Картинка, музыка и медитативный геймплей создают особую атмосферу. Проходя игру и обустраивая комнаты или квартиры год за годом, вы будете больше узнавать о девушке, которая проживает тут. Содержимое коробок многое расскажет вам о ней, начиная с детства и заканчивая работой.

Очень интересно следить за тем, как некоторые любимые игрушки и предметы пережили годы и снова оказались на полке.

Однозначно рекомендую эту игру.

Действительно медитативная игра, т.к. вы в расслабленном состоянии распределяете предметы из коробок по соответствующим комнатам. Как-то особо сильно не пришлось "ломать голову", но было пару очень странных моментов, когда предметы нужно было поместить в неожиданные места, т.е., пожалуй, нелогичные...
В целом я с удовольствием прошёл. Наверное, это отличительная черта игр, которые выпускает Хамбл

ダンボールから荷物を出して、ここだという位置に置く本当にそれだけでした。一応、アイテムを特定の部屋、位置に置くというパズル的なゲーム要素がありましたが、そこに面白さを感じる方は少ないように思います。
 私は自己解釈で部屋の持ち主に思いを馳せる、BGMやSEを楽しむなど、どちらかというとゲームのシステム外での面白さを重視した作品だと思いました。
 優しいイラストと雰囲気がとても魅力的で所謂雰囲気ゲーが好きな方には刺さると思います。反対にそういったゲームに興味がない方にとっては面白味を感じにくいかもしれません。

 部屋の移り変わりや、荷物の変化からその人の人生に思いを馳せるという初めてのシュチュエーションはとても新鮮で楽しい体験でした(´˘`＊)
 ステージを重ねる事に部屋の持ち主に愛着を感じるようになり、最後にはこれからも幸せな人生を歩んでほしいなぁとそんな気持ちになりました。

 さっくと短時間で遊べましたので気になっている方にはぜひ遊んでみてほしいです。

Wenn man mal abschalten will und absolut nichts Anspruchsvolles spielen möchte, ist dieses Spiel genau das Richtige. 
Man packt Kartons aus und sortiert sie in seiner Wohnung ein. Das wars... Aber es hat so entspannende Musik und Sounds, dass es wie ASMR auf einen wirkt. Es beruhigt, senkt den Alltagssstress und ist einfach nur zum abschalten da. 

Den Preis finde ich allerdings extrem überteuert! 20 Euro für so ein Spiel... es ist grafisch ect. auch nicht sonderlich schwer oder anspruchsvoll für Entwickler, wenn man bedenkt, was die heutzutage alles auf die Beine stellen können. Sicher wird auch das Spiel mit über 14.000 Soundeffekten seine Arbeit gekostet haben, dennoch sind 20 euro eine Unverschämtheit für die paar "Level". 5-10 Euro hätte ich okay gefunden, zumal die Entwickler auch keine weiteren Level oder eben Jahre hinzufügen wollen. Nach 8 Umzügen ist mit dem Eigenheim einfach Ende. Schade. Dachboden, Keller oder Garten wären ja vielleicht auch noch schön gewesen einzurichten. 

Ich hätte es niemals gekauft für den Preis. Mir hat es ein Freund geschenkt.

Mein Fazit: Es ist okay. Preis sehr überteuert, Spielspaß auf jeden Fall vorhanden, wenn man eben auf sowas steht. Ich würde dem Spiel 3 von 5 Sternen geben. Es ist eben okay.

I went in blind and wasnt expecting too much going in, just fun to sort and unpack and make a house feel like home.... It was a roller-coaster of emotions, I cried multiple times. It had me happily swaying to the music, crying, my stomach dropping and crying, happily shaking in excitement, bouncing happily and crying, and joyfully sobbing at the end, still a bit teary eyed right now. What an amazingly wonderful story, the ending was a bit abrupt, as in I would have gladly unpacked another dozen or more spaces, but, it also ended so wonderfully that I dont think it would have felt the same if it went on longer, and could easily get pretty sad if it went until, well, until there was no places left to go except into the ground so, I like the happy ending better. 

This, might be game of the year for me, just for, how lovely it was to play, the story was beautiful, the game play was satisfying, the artstyle was pretty, the sound design was amazing, and the representation was some of the best I've ever seen. Thank you for such a wonderful game. <3

Очень красиво, но геймплей все же чуть более однообразный, чем хотелось бы. По идее в этом и должна быть суть - просто расслабленно и медитативно ставишь предметы в разные места, но из-за того, что единственными вариациями являются новые квартиры и вещи, груз всего разнообразия ложится на них. Квартиры достаточно разные (хотя и не скажу что сильно интересные) и свою задачу выполняют, но вот вариаций между распаковываемыми вещами крайне мало, а некоторые предметы либо непонятно, чем являются (из-за чего даже не знаешь, куда их положить), либо (из-за того, что игра частично головоломка) игра часто указывает несколько предметов как положенные неправильно, несмотря на то, что тебе местоположение кажется на 100% логичным - сказывается разница в культурах и привычках. Поначалу это напрягает не так сильно, но когда я в 4-й раз сидел и перекладывал разные предметы туда-сюда, пытаясь выяснить, где же разработчики решили им самое место, понял, что игра меня все же не расслабляет на эти 435 рублей, что за неё просят. Скорее всего возьму позже на какой-нибудь распродаже.

Если раздражают ограничения по расстановке вещей, то они отключаются в настройках. Я это сразу не поняла и сильно сердилась на некоторые странные и нелогичные для меня предпочтения героини, из-за которых приходилось тыкать некоторыми предметами наугад (они не подписаны - иногда просто не понимаешь, что это за предмет).

Так как ты прослеживаешь историю героини, то много вещей повторяются из раза в раз. Довольно интересно расставляться первые несколько комнат, дальше это превращается в "ага, эта ложка лежала в ящике, надо опять её туда закинуть". Уже третий уровень играю, всё примерно одно и то же.

Что-то странное происходит с фоновой музыкой, её постоянно тротлит, это раздражает. Саунд дизайн при этом классный - переносишь гитару, слышишь звук бряцающих струн, переносишь свинку-копилку, слышишь стук монет друг о дружку.

Очень крутой фоторежим, красивые фильтры. В целом графика очень приятная, если нравятся пиксели.

Как итог - классная идея и красивый визуал, но не хватило фантазии в проектировании уровней.

Расслабляющая, милая, незамысловатая игра про, буквально, переезды. Ваша задача - расставлять вещи "на свои места", при этом следуя зову своего внутреннего "я". Разбираем коробки и читаем по содержимому историю жизни героя. 

Минусы: 
- Довольно дорогая. Я брала без скидки и, если честно, пожалела потраченных денег. Дождитесь распродажи!
- Очень короткая, но, наверное, если б было больше уровней - игроки бы "задушились"

Из плюсов: 
- Пройдя очередной уровень вы чувствуете себя умиротворенно - знаете, как-будто прибрались в своей комнате и она "дышит" свежестью
- Я прибалдела с коллекции миленьких курочек :) 
- Красивый арт, который можно неплохо зумировать и поразглядывать детали
- Отсылки на культовые вещи 90-х - 10-х годов
- Звуки взаимодействия с предметами просто услада для ушей! 
- Легко ассоциировать себя с ГГ, так как все распаковываемые предметы мы используем в своей повседневности или наблюдаем у родных: носки, спортивная одежда, шапки, школьный ластик, безделушки с отпуска и т.д. Это приятно.

Купите, если есть потребность в чилле и вы любитель прибраться, а дома уже все переложено по 100 раз. Кратко - игра на 7/10.

Not a terrible game by any means - nice style, fairly satisfying gameplay, nice context-based story in the background. However, it is outrageously priced for the content you get.

I paid full price on my switch years back as I wanted something slow and chill for a break from work, and I remember being genuinely surprised and confused at how little gameplay there was for £16. I really did think I'd missed something.

Picked this up again on sale here, mainly for the achievements and to see if I missed or rushed the game the first time around (as I said, I enjoyed it... but seriously, that much for a couple of hours?)

Sad to say I'm still really unsure why this is still priced so highly. I spent a fiver on sale and still feel a bit ripped off. There's no replay value. Nothing to encourage returning. 非常治愈的一款游戏，适合在玩累了解密烧脑或者激烈对抗后，静下心慢慢品味。
游戏内容很简单，就是打开包装，布置新家，可以选择寻找预设好的位置来布局，也可以按自己的喜好自由摆放家具。游玩过程中，作为玩家的我可以清晰看到主角从小到大的成长，观察她一点点实现理想，找寻真爱。有很多家具自始至终伴随主角身边，我也习惯把它们码放在相似的位置，好似我也透过屏幕，感受到了老物件们默默的守护和无声的鼓励。
游戏很适合不忙的时候一个人慢慢玩，过程中也有些有趣的小彩蛋，时长和体量都适中，本来史低入的时候还觉得这个可玩性匹配这个价格偏贵了些，但玩完觉得本作制作十分精良，花出去的钱还是值得的。
最后也是我最喜欢的一点就是，收拾完之后还可以选择喜爱的倍速观看自己的收拾过程，这个设计真的非常解压舒适了~

Se eu fosse resumir [b][i]Unpacking[/i][/b], seria assim: arrume este quarto da melhor forma possível e simplesmente relaxe. Essa é a proposta do jogo, sem exageros, sem complicações. Simples na aparência, delicado na execução e com uma história sutil, contada por meio de pequenas nuances.

A jogabilidade gira em torno de abrir caixas e organizar um quarto com os objetos que surgem delas. Cada item tem seu lugar, correto ou incorreto, incentivando o jogador a pensar, arrumar, observar e, principalmente, apreciar o processo. A trilha sonora é suave e aconchegante, perfeitamente alinhada ao clima calmo que o jogo transmite, enquanto os gráficos minimalistas completam essa atmosfera serena.

No final, foi um jogo pelo qual eu estava realmente ansioso e fico feliz em dizer que não decepcionou. Espero que mais pessoas tenham a chance de conhecê-lo, pois Unpacking é pequeno em escala, mas enorme em sensibilidade.

📦Переезд — не самое приятное занятие в жизни, но в игровом мире переезд может быть весёлым и расслабляющим. Интересно ли распаковывать множество коробок и расставлять вещи по своим местам вы узнаете в этом обзоре.

🧸В игре нет кат-сцен или чего-то такого — только дата в начале уровня и небольшой текст в конце. Весь сюжет в игре передаётся через предметы и на удивление эта идея работает. Сюжет игры происходит в период с 1997 года до 2018, начнётся всё с детской комнаты, а закончится огромным домом.В игре есть много разных деталей (к примеру наша героиня очень любит консоли Nintendo), но основной сюжет можно уместить в несколько предложений.
Мы будем следить за историей художницы. После школы она поступает в колледж, а после обучения продолжает жить с соседями по комнате. Через пару лет она встретила парня, но отношения не сложились и ей пришлось вернуться в дом родителей. Достаточно быстро она встала на ноги, переехала в свою квартиру и нашла себе «подружку», а в финале они усыновили ребёнка и переехали в большой дом.

👒Как и было сказано выше — всю игру мы будем распаковывать вещи, заполняя ими комнату за комнатой. В игре всего 8 уровней и с каждым разом количество комнат и предметов увеличивается. Казалось бы — мы просто ставим вещи на определённые места, но эта простота затягивает и успокаивает.Кроме распаковки вещей мы можем делать фотографии и просматривать запись нашего прохождения. Также в игре есть достижения — выполнены они в виде стикеров для фоторежима и выполнять их очень интересно. Почти все из них требуют взаимодействий с определёнными предметами, что придаёт живости игре.

🐷Визуальный стиль у игры прекрасный — качественный пиксель-арт в сочетании с яркими цветами задают правильный настрой. Жаль только что после прохождения нельзя выбирать фильтры изображения из фоторежима, они бы сделали игру ещё красивее. В игре кстати присутствует русский язык, но текста в игре мало.

🎼Саундтрек в игре приятный и расслабляющий. Не думаю что какой-то из треков вы запомните, но атмосферность во время игры они предают. В финале играет единственная озвученная песня за всю игру и она достаточно хорошая.

🌂Длительность всего 2-3 часа на прохождение + максимум 1 час на все достижения. За это время игра не успевает надоесть и заканчивается она как раз в нужный момент. Про сложность думаю нет смысла говорить, места для предметов найти очень легко.

🧺Эта игра очередной представитель короткого, но хорошего инди — играть интересно и приятно. По итогам я получила море удовольствия и надеюсь, что будущие игры этой студии также не разочаруют. Советую вам потратить эти два часа жизни и немного расслабиться после тяжёлого рабочего дня.
