[b]"Unpacking" has a simple sole purpose. Unpack your things as you move from house to house. A really unique concept for nowadays action heavy, cinematic game industry. Gorgeous visuals, responsive controls, cheerful music and relaxing atmosphere offer a nice experience. Unfortunately the gameplay doesn't evolve at all as you play, while the story is pretty basic. Also, I'm not sure that I agree with its stereotypical core message which implies that happiness is having a bigger house, more things, more money and a baby.


Manometer: 6/10[/b]


The good
- Unique concept. Among all these games full of action, epic scenes and killing they decided to create a game for something simple, a routine, something that ordinary people do. They make unpacking interesting.
- Gorgeous minimalistic isometric visuals. Nice pixel graphics with great color palette and cool details. They have designed many different objects for you to unpack.
- Responsive, effective controls. Moving, rotating and placing objects happen instantly and accurately without weird snaps. Very satisfying.
- Fluid animations and. It's so pleasant to watch the cardboards disappearing. Also some objects change shape according to the position that you're placing them.
- Cool, calm music.
- Nice audio design. Sounds are simplistic but every object has different sound effect that corresponds to its material and the surface that you're placing it.
- Some extra features like saving videos and gifs after finishing your decoration.
- It has a cheerful atmosphere that may be relaxing for some.

The bad
- It's entertaining enough, but the gameplay doesn't evolve at all as you play. You do the same thing from the start till the end, just in different houses and with more objects.
- It tries to tell a story in an abstract way, but although you understand some major events it's actually pretty basic.
- I'm not sure that I agree with its core meaning. It essentially tells us that happiness is moving in bigger and bigger houses, having babies, making more money and having more and more things. It's too stereotypical.
- It may become a small nightmare, bringing bad memories to people that have moved out a lot during their lives or perfectionists that want everything to a specific place.
- Too small duration, only few houses.

After a respectable playtime of five hours, which in reflection felt like mere moments, I find myself compelled to articulate my assessments of "Unpacking". This artful presentation, more a simulated tableau vivant of modern human existence than a conventional video game, illustrates the quintessence of relocating and starting anew with remarkable eloquence. The subtle nuances by which the silent narrative progresses appear as a metaphor for the impermanent nature of human life. The puzzling gameplay is not just an intellectual pastime, but also a reflection of the individual's existential confrontation with space and matter. In short, "Unpacking" is not merely a game but a philosophical epic in pixels. A must for those seeking the deeper meanings in the mundane.

Sehr schönes und entspannendes Spiel, welches einen hin und wieder auch ein wenig in die eigene Kindheit und frühe Jugend zurück versetzt. 

Sinn ist das Auspacken (wie der Titel bereits beschreibt) und entsprechende Einräumen in die bereits vorhandene Einrichtung. Hier und da wurde es auch knifflig, weil man das eine oder andere vielleicht selbst auch noch nie gesehen hat oder erst einmal überlegen und vielleicht auch probieren muss wo der Gegenstand denn Sinn macht bzw. machen soll.
- Bei mir war es übrigens eine Whiteboard mit Stift welches offensichtlich an den Kühlschrank musste - 
Grundsätzlich hat mich das Spiel gut unterhalten und hat für Entspannung gesorgt. Von daher eine Empfehlung von mir.

Ein-zwei Minuspunkte muss ich jedoch vergeben: 
Derzeit noch 20 Euro sind meines Erachtens noch zu viel für das Spiel. Klar die Entwickler und Co. müssen auch von was leben aber 4 Stunden Spielzeit dafür ist schon wirklich wenig in meinen Augen. Dabei war ich öfter mal Kaffee holen und eine Kleinigkeit zubereiten um es sich in den Schlund zu stecken. Wahrscheinlich liegt die tatsächlich Spielzeit vermutlich bei 3-3,5 Stunden. 
Ein Potential es noch mal zu spielen, sehe ich selbst nicht wirklich. Kleidung kommt in den Schrank, Bücher ins Regal und und der Becher mit den Stiften gehört auf den Schreibtisch. Auf im Realen Leben hat man für sich immer Regeln welche einem Ordnung vermittelt. Daher wir man vielleicht ein Socken-Paar unbewusst tauschen oder das Shirt mal legen statt auf den Bügel hängen, jedoch beliebt es doch irgenwie immer das selbe. 
Der innere Entdecker, der beim ersten Auspacken versucht die Geschichte hinter allem zu verstehen, existiert bei Runde zwei dann ja leider schon nichtmehr.

Unpacking is a very relaxing game about moving into a new home and figuring out how to best place your belongings. It not only encourages you to be creative, but it's also a fun puzzle, since you need to discover how to best use the space in order for everything to fit. The game also doesn't let you complete a level until all items are in places where it makes sense, so you can't just throw a roll of toilet paper on a table and call it a day; you need to organize everything properly, and in some levels it can actually get a bit challenging! It's nothing excruatingly hard, but rather just a fun little challenge to tackle.

The fun puzzle element, the relaxing soundtrack, the cute art style and even some indirect storytelling all work together pretty well to create a very unique and fun experience. It may be a bit short, but I don't think a game like this necessarily needs to be very long. It lasts long enough to stay interesting until the end, never getting stale.

I'm not a fan of games that hold your hand and this was great in that respect - you get to discover the story organically through stuff (literally) and you get a great sense of accomplishment from figuring everything out step by step instead of being flat out told what is happening. 

Unpacking and decorating is also incredibly relaxing, I've already played through the game twice so I could try to arrange objects in a different pattern. I'm an "organised chaos" person and the environment really made me feel at home, trying to cram spices and kitchen gadgets into a too small kitchen. 

The only gripe I have with the game is the fact that it will sometimes decide where you've placed an object is not okay (eg the french press too forward on the counter) which in my opinion takes away from how completely immersed you get while playing. All of a sudden I'm trying to figure out why the tampons can't sit on top of the toilet and getting frustrated because I have to rearrange everything to place them exactly where the game wants. 

Overall though I highly recommend this for a few hours of relaxing and wholesome fun!

[h1] Why you should or should not play Unpacking [/h1]

[b] What is Unpacking? [/b]

Unpacking is a cute eagle view game where you slowly unpack boxes of a character who continues to move throughout their life. You see as years go by, and how their items become older and what they collect throughout the years. 

[b] Quick Pros [/b]

✔ Easy to learn controls
✔ Relaxing gameplay
✔ Strong visual style

[b] Quick Cons [/b]

✘ Limited gameplay variety
✘ Limited content
✘ Can be played in a very short time

[b] Initial Thoughts: [/b]

-"OMG this is too cute, I love the little stuffed animals."
_"Wait it has a story??? Thats so cool!"
-"Thats it? I was hoping there would be another part to the story or a new story..."

[b] Beginner Player Friendly?  [/b]

This game is super beginner player friendly, it has easy controls and from what I know it is on numerous platforms. Even if you are just starting to get into video games, this game is such a good start and so addicting!

[b] Game Play: [/b]

The game play mainly consists of you taking things out of boxes and moving between rooms to do so. You can sort, organise and move things to your liking. Though some things you may not be able to put places if it does not make to much sense to put them there. 

[b] Graphics: [/b]

The graphics are an adorable style that compliment the game play completely. Its just too adorable.

[b] Community: [/b]

The creators of this community is so so sweet and the people who play have also proven to be amazing people. I so far have not found anyone toxic that has played this game.

[b] How long can you play? [/b]

Sadly, there is not to much game play available to the game. I wish they had more story, and more lifes we could live through the game. Though there was only 2.5 hours of content, and then it only took another 2.5 hours to 100% the game. I am very upset that there is no more stories in the game and the developers have stated that they do not intend to add more, hopefully that will change. But for 20 dollars, 5 hours isnt to to bad for play-ability. I just don't know if it was really worth spending my money on. If you are going to get it, get it while its on sale :) (Well, just get every game on sale.)

[b] My Opinion: [/b]

Overall this game is super fun and beautiful with an amazing story. Though I really wish there was more too it, so if you are not someone who likes to replay games, and you need more then 2.5 hours of content I would say that this game is not for you and to continue your search for a different game. Though if you do enjoy playing games more then once and would like a cute organisation game, I would say you should 1000000% get this game as you will enjoy it a lot more then you think.

[b] Overall Review [/b]

★ 7/10 - Fun game with a short story.

If you've watched the video on this store page, then you have seen everything this game has to offer so there should be really no surprises.  It's an interesting way to tell a story, however mundane that story might be.  Through unpacking this character's boxes as she moves from place to place over the years, you glean information about who she is and what she's been through.  Depending on the room you choose to look at when you snap the photo for the album, you'll get a different blurb.  There's things in the video that I didn't see while playing so it's possible (however unlikely) that arranging stuff in different ways might lead to alternate rooms, but I don't think this is the case.  It's probably just some pre-gold stuff that squeaked on by.

In any case, whether or not this game has value to you is based on how you feel about the videos available.  If you look at them and think "That is the dumbest thing I've ever seen," then you're not going to be impressed.  If, on the other hand, you think it'd be fun to do this for a few hours or perhaps you just really like the art (like me), then you'll find something to appreciate here.  It's a little time killer and occasionally you'll find some stuff that doesn't belong and you'll have to figure out where it actually goes (what's with all the dang blankets?!).  Could I have lived without playing it? Sure. Do I regret the time I spent on it? No - I played it while listening in on awful, boring meetings... and also while munching snacks.  If anything, it's a cure for idle hands.

An absolute comfort game for me. No stress. No pressure. Just put your silly little things in their silly little places. I do wish the game had a bit more levels but that's just because I have them all memorized by now. Hoping for any sort of continuation in the future.

A beautiful, heart-warming game. Take your time and unpack, learn about who this person is through her troubles, tribulations, and successes. Take the time to appreciate the zen, and then take time to appreciate your loved ones.

It's a good distracting and time consuming game, I mean that in the best way possible. I played this game for 3 hours straight hours, with breaks of course lol, but it was a good game. I do wish it had more levels though.

I loved Unpacking every bit as much as I thought I would. It's so relaxing, satisfying and beautifully designed, and the story that runs through it all is so sweet and well-realised, I felt quite moved. I have completed it once and started it again and am enjoying it just as much the second time.
This is one of the best and most calming games i've ever played. Just wish they would make a sequel lol.
Super jeu, concept très réussis et graphismes très agréables, gros bémol sur le prix. 20 euros pour seulement 4-6 heures de jeu et uniquement une histoire.
Excelent point and click game... the pixel art is gorgeous and pleasant to look at. Very relaxing and kinda leaves you wanting more since it's pretty short.
Very fun for anyone who likes to organize things in their own household. The story is also amazing, I loved seeing the storyteller grow up through the items you unpack and the rooms you go through.

I love organizing things, the design is absolutely adorable and this game is just so great !!
I would just like more levels because of how much I love it

Unpacking est un petit jeu zen et tranquille. Les détails ainsi que certaines interactions sont plutôt cools. Il existe beaucoup de possibilités de rangement et d'agencement, en fonction de ses propres goûts. Ce qui rend le jeu "personnalisable" car nous pouvons établir un aménagement intérieur proche de notre réalité.

It's a great game, especially the story it tells without actually formally telling you it. Instead of speaking with words and a dialog we get a story by the environment and the things around you. It's really wonderful how you can tell much about someone or something without actually speaking. Great game <3

Very adorable game, it
s nice to make the spaces feel cozy and lived in, if you want. I like how you can see the progression of the person's life and how cluttered but loving their environments become. I wish there was a DLC where you can unpack other people's lives as well. That would be fun and make the $20 price tag more enticing. For only a few hours of game play, I would say it's a smidge expensive but the quality is great.  just wish there was a little bit more content. :)

O jogo vale muito a pena, algumas partes são desafiadoras, teve uma panela que demorei 30 minutos pra achar um lugar pra encaixar ela. Mas, isso é oq faz o jogo se tornar legal, eu já passei por varias mudanças, e de vez em quando acontece de simplesmente não ter lugar na nova casa para colocar as coisas. E aí tu tem que dar um jeito, e é isso. 
Entendo que o preço é um pouco salgado, porém, pra quem conseguir comprar, vale muito a pena!
This game has me losing brain cells and slowly losing hope for adulthood trying to organize a hoarder's house for hours as their hoarding problem gets progressively worse... I highly recommend! :)

I love the flexibility with how/ where you can place things in this game. There is so much detail and extra little bits that i haven't noticed until now as i continue to play threw this game, the music and sound affects are golden, and i'd love to see more games from the creators!

Önce basit bir taşınma/yerleştirme oyunu gibi gelebilir size. Ama aslında hikayesi olan bir oyun. Bitinceye dek aslında bir kaç yıllık yaşam öyküsünün de parçası oluyoruz. Karakterin de aslında hissettiklerini görebiliyoruz. Kafa dağıtmalık aşırı soft bir oyun. Çok beğendim.

Talvez seja minha mania obsessiva de limpeza e organização mas esse jogo foi um verdadeiro calmante pra mim. Eu preciso de mais jogos como este e tão bons quanto. Arte linda, músicas lindas, e ver a vida da personagem pelas coisinhas dela é muito legal, chorei

This is such a lovely little game. I was expecting a neat and satisfying organization puzzle, but this is so much more.  The storytelling and emotional arc of this game is told so well through snapshots of a woman's life. Even though you never meet her, you feel the ups and downs of her life through her belongings. Pulling a familiar item out of a box to find it's aged since the last time you saw it, realizing an item that's followed her though every move isn't around anymore, trying to fit her stuff into a shared apartment, you feel the phases of her life in a way that's surprisingly poignant.
Love it! Beautiful storytelling and wonderful music. A master piece.

Lovely game, ok music, somewhat interesting story but NOT worth the price tag for approx 6 hours of play time. I knew it was short, but I was still shocked when it was over. I would have hoped for more interesting rooms (variety), different items (can I unpack for the roommates and unpack their rooms, too?) and complex unpacking puzzles. I feel like the concept is there, and it's very good, but this falls short.

This game is a masterpiece BUT, it is way too expensive for how short the game is. There are only 8 levels and then the game is over, then you have to just repeat the same rooms again if you wish to play more. The only downfall to this game is that there is not more rooms to be unpacked. Other than that, the game is wonderful. It is relaxing and tells a story through items packed into boxes. I just wish there were more, maybe a futuristic approach, a different family/character with a new story?

This game is a very enjoyable game and it delivered when it came to playing a relaxing game. The negative side is that it is over after 5 hours of game play. For $20 I expected a bit more air time. If you do a sequel I suggest to add new concepts. Maybe after so many years you have to repack selected items, store or have a yard sale. An attic space maybe, but yeah the game needs to be longer for the money. I felt like I just played the prologue/introduction of an early access to Unpacking.

İnanılmaz bir hikaye anlatımına sahip bir oyun. Odasını düzenlediğiniz karakteri oyunda asla tam olarak göremeseniz bile çocukluğundan yetişkinliğine kadar olan evlerindeki eşyalarını düzenliyorsunuz ve bu esnada karakterin hayatının nasıl ilerlediğine şahit oluyorsunuz. Zevkleri hakkında bilgiler öğrenip başarılarını fark ediyorsunuz. Keşke başka karakterlerin de odalarını düzenlediğimiz devam oyunları olsaydı ama sanırım yapımcılar bağımsız olarak çalıştıkları için yorulmuşlar ve bir süre içerik üretmeyeceklermiş

I've never written a review for a game before, but I had to for this one. The gameplay is flawless and the environmental storytelling is phenomenal. Some people have commented it's not worth full-price, but I think it's worth it based on how polished and impactful the game is.

i have no regrets buying this game, this is a longer review so skip to the bottom for the gist if you don't like reading,

for a silly organize-unpacking game, there's an implied story through-out and its pretty cute.
small details like the 'main character' keeping items through-out the years, including childhood ones, is what makes this game just that much special.
every new environment has more to offer and challenges you more on wear to place things in order to align up your room best.

i will admit, there's times i had to look up a guide on a room or two because there was an item i had no idea what to do with and kept implying was in the wrong area, but didn't happen to me often.

i enjoy the 'realistic packing', how some things are disorganized or a box meant for the living room has some bathroom items in it; which allows more of a realistic, human nature on the game to really show this is about someone who's moving around, unpacking if you will.

most people won't read a long review so i expect this to be skimmed lightly, so if so, take these;
-art style is cozy and really suits the atmosphere of the game
-the game play can get boring due to it having the same premise every time but that shouldn't bother someone who enjoys games like these
-the story is subtle and cute, you'd have to pay attention close enough to really understand it but isn't the main focus of the game
-vibrant, engaging, make you lose track of time/good time passer.
-overall, a very worth it purchase for me.

I love this game so much i tend to go back & Play it again when i'm bored 

To Start, This game is perfect for people who love to organize; Its also perfect for people who love to customize!
this game & its sound design is not only relaxing but also very satisfying. Hearing the things you place, it just itches something in my brain in a good way. having 100%ed the game, casually playing it the first time around might be hard to get every achievement  but if you know what you are looking for when achievement hunting, 100%ing the game is easy 

Secondly, I love how each "Chapter" in our book tells a story. Its so heart warming but also sad at times. In the end everything ties together nicely.

In Conclusion, This game is beautifully put together, there's a lot of things that can be up to players choice; giving players a lot of freedom. its fun & cute in unique ways. The Music & Sound design are amazing & really pull you into the game making it feel cozy.
Definitely a game i want to sip hot chocolate & relax too

乱摆加解压，强推，不爱整理东西但是这种看着空白的空间慢慢添置上属于自己的物品的感觉极其舒适
另外暗线主角从小到大结婚生子再邂逅相伴一生的伴侣真的太有生活气息的浪漫了！

Beautiful game that is a masterclass in environmental storytelling. 
Finished it in 5 hours tho, I know there is a little more to do, but I would recommend buying it on sale.

[b]Unpacking[/b] conta a história de uma pessoa evoluindo na vida, construindo gradativamente cada etapa e deixando o jogador fazer parte dessa história. Curto, mas valioso, vale a pena esperar uma promoção e comprar.

Unpacking cria uma sensação de nostalgia ao desempacotar pertences de diferentes períodos da vida. A partir de um quarto infantil até sua vida adulta, você desempacota brinquedos, livros e outras lembranças. Passando para um primeiro apartamento, dormitório universitário e eventual lar, você observá a progressão para a idade adulta com mudanças de estilos e responsabilidades refletidas nos itens.
Com gráficos e jogabilidade minimalistas, o Unpacking é simples, mas profundamente comovente. Desempacotar cada caixa é como abrir uma cápsula do tempo de memórias. A falta de texto ou narração torna a experiência pessoal e reflexiva. Os jogadores podem interpretar a história à sua maneira com base nos objetos e como eles escolhem organizá-los.

If you enjoy decorating houses on The Sims, you'll enjoy Unpacking.  It's offers about 4 hours of play per playthrough, but the replayability-level is really up to you.  If you'd enjoy decorating the same rooms again and again in different ways (I do) or finding wacky places to put things, you'll enjoy this game.  You can also try "DARK STAR MODE", which is where you make sure everything is in the "wrong" spot.  It's harder than you think - when you have massive clutter, it's easy to miss a shoe that you think is wrong but the game says is right!  Anyway, you can make some challenges for yourself or run through it once and be done with it, but I enjoyed the game and find myself coming back to it at least every other month.
很解压的。不过有时候也很烦，搞不懂什么意思。因为有些东西没见过，所以根本不知道放哪里只能随缘或者查攻略。
It's a cute and fun game however it's too short. But it's fun to play and you can always play again and find different ways to unpack

I genuinely enjoyed this game. It's very cute, it gives hints about a heartwearming story without forcing it on the player and the attention to detail is really great. I liked the returning items throughout the game which tell their own little story as you move from level to level. The sound design is also really well done.

Though i would say that almost 20€ is a bit much for the ammount of content you get. You can get through the game within 2 or 3 hours which means it's very short. I wish there was more content in the game but if you get it while it's on sale it's well worth the money 

overall, it's a wellmade, cozy and cute game and i had a lot of fun with it, though i'd recommend getting it when it's on sale

So. Stinking. Cute. And relaxing AF. I just wish it had more levels - I finished it in two sittings, only because my husband made me go to bed the first night. I plan on playing it again regardless, over and over and over if possible. <3 9.5/10 - add more levels and it'd be a 10/10!

it was really fun and a great, cosy way to pass time. the only complaint i have is that it should've been longer and i wanted more content of this style! other than that, its a great game but kind of expensive for such a short game. but nonetheless its an amazing game and i loved it.

i absolutely love the story and art style, however for the price of the game I'll be honest and say that i kinda expected more then one story line, especially since other story games have multiple endings for cheaper. its gorgeous but just hoped for a bit more i guess.
cute little game, super simple to play and finish. getting all of the achievements as well is simple, 7/10 recommend with some music of your choice.

It's a cute game, if occasionally frustrating because you're not sure what the heck the item is, so you find it difficult to place it. For example, there was a white tablet that I had to look up because I didn't realize it was a white board that went on the fridge. But your mileage may vary -- I might just be an idiot.

I'm also not sure it's worth $20, only because I've played a bunch of hidden object games by Five-BN that took me many more hours to solve and only cost $7. And I honestly don't think the writing of this game is really that much better? I feel like it pretends to be poignant but it's really just a simple story. I think my opinion of the game suffered because of all the hype.

TL;DR -- it's a cute game with a simple story hidden among the objects that you put away. You may only play it once, making the $20 price tag a little hard to swallow.

Although the game is short, Unpacking allows you to relax in an environment with no-timer, no challenges, and one task: unpack your boxes. It's a lovely cozy-puzzle game and I appreciate the option to put things anywhere if I disagree with the games rules. I wish it had more content in it but it's nice to come back and unwind with Unpacking.
Cute game but fair warning don't buy at full price, it really easy to finish hence it gets a little boring fast. However the story was very delightful, also I swear some stuff can go other places.

oyunu ilk alırken sıkılırım diye düşünmüştüm ama öyle olmadı sadece eski sevgilimizin fotoğrafını koycağımız yeri yarım saat bulamayıp mouse kırcak dereceye geldim en son youtubedan bakmak aklıma geldi dolabın en köşesine dibe koymamız lazımmış onun harici arkadan müzik açıp sakin sakin oynamalık oyun gayet güzel

Not just "a game where you organize stuff" It tells a whole story about a person throughout their highs and lows: when they're in love, when things don't work out, when the money isn't much, when a family starts being built. It's a journey from a house to a home, and as you start getting attached to the owner of this album, you can't help but feel proud about every little achievement of theirs. The ending gives us a feeling of warmth and fulfilment.

Oddechovka s naprosto roztomilou grafikou s krásnými detaily. Jsou zde přístupné a pěkné achievementy. Hru máte sice za chvíli dohranou a cena se mi zdá kapku přemrštěná ale jestli vás baví jednoduchý a odpočinkový styl her tak doporučuji.

Very relaxing and nice music! Pros for the option that you can put items anywhere. It allows you to unpack everything just how you like it! But think 20 euros for about 3 hour gameplay is a bit too much, but other than that I'd recommend!

I like how chill this game is. it doesn't require a super fancy pants computer to run it. Some of the items can be a bit funky in terms of placements but it is what it is, kinda like when you move house. I like some of the realism and the story to this game. A good one when you're wanting a nice game with good vibes to just relax to.

I've replayed this game about 5 times now. I can't recommend it enough. 
I was initially put off at first by the amount of negative reviews that claim that there is no replay value in the game, so I waited until a sale to buy it. I wish I had bought it at launch because this is one of the best relaxing puzzle games I've ever played.

The story is charming, the game style is cute and functional, the atmosphere is peaceful. For me, it has so much replay value because I love how satisfying it is to clean up and put things away. You can replay and create a completely different arrangement each time. 

If you want to turn off your mind at the end of a stressful day, this is the point and click puzzle game for you.

Finished the whole game in 4 hours, really cute and fun but $23 is a little much for 4 hours of game play. It's not super repayable, may be able to come back to it in a a few months to replay.

All the achievements on steam are hidden too so its not like I could keep playing to try and get the achievements.

lovely game. other than the fact that i love to organize, i admire the concept of using living spaces as a way to tell a story. it's definitely a unique concept to me. + the pixel art is amazing!
i was a bit hasty buying this game as i was late to the hype when it first launched and was excited to see what it was all about. for its price, $20 is definitely not worth about 2-3 hours of gameplay for a majority of people. there isn't exactly much replayability unless you're looking to get all the achievements, do a dark star run, or try organizing in an entirely different way. but i feel a majority of people aren't particularly interested or motivated enough to try at that. obviously, judging from my play time, i'm not part of that majority, and while i enjoyed doing all of these things, i also was partly trying to make it somewhat worth the price i paid for.

SOOOO.. if you want to play this game: like many others have said, buy it when it's on sale. other than that yes yes very nice game smiley face
I've heard or seen this game from vtubers and turns out it's fun and interesting! It's worth buying if you're into creating your own story by organising stuff!
A nice short game, feels like you really get to know some of the stories behind the owners of the items without ever actually interacting with them, very chilled out vibes and a great way to unwind!

This game has all the requirements to be the perfect game. Adorable story that makes me cry, beautiful colors and graphics, adorable animals and objects, delightful music to zone out to, pretty much complete customization, and it's super re-playable. I could go on forever about this masterpiece and i hope to see more from Witch Beam!!

Adorable, mindful, therapeutic. All the joys of unpacking and arranging a home, without the painful packing and moving. A sweet little game, the perfect way to spend a Sunday afternoon, only downside is that I want more! Would love to be able to unpack for another character or two. ^.^

Absolutely love this game. So relaxing and it's fun to see how the items change as time goes on. Like many others I also feel like it was a bit short, but I took around a 3 month break and played through the game again and honestly enjoyed it just as much as I did the first time.

A cute, relaxing little puzzle game that lets you imagine the story line as you go through the levels. A short game, got through it with almost 4 hours of game play. I do wish there was more content to play through, but regardless, I loved it! :) I got Unpacking as a gift

Que jogo relaxante. A única coisa que me incomodou é que a personagem é um pouco acumuladora (guardando coisas de 30 anos atrás) e eu ficava com vontade de jogar um pouco de coisa fora.
O jogo é bem curto, então vale a pena esperar uma promoção.

I just really like the organizing aspect of this, and how accessible it is! I didn't know that you could put things in the "wrong" spot but you can turn that option off. I thought the story was cute and I liked to see what the character brought with them to the next place!

This game is really cute and has a nice story. Only complaint is how ridiculously short it is, I finished it in less than 3 hours. I recommend this game, but definitely buy on sale just because of the short playtime.
The fact that this game is able to tell a story with just some objects in moving boxes and a bit of commentary on the individual finished rooms is really astounding, incredibly enjoyable.
I absolutely adore this game. Words can't even describe how much I love it. My only wish is that it was longer, I wasn't ready for it to be over.

Got it as a present, recomend buying on sale, not enough content for the full price. 

Would recomend to people who love clutter up the room in sims and enjoy some mindless repetative gameplay. Will definetly play again. But also would love a dlc or more levels in general (renovating kids room, moving again, etc)
The art and music of this game is amazing, so is it's beautiful story. It's very cozy and precise for casual playing, it's a 5 out of 5 stars for me <3
A very cozy relaxing game with so many small details throughout your character's life. 100% recommend plsying it if you like the relaxing sorting out type of game

A very cute, relaxing, and enjoyable experience. This game caught me a little bit by surprise. I was expecting a cute home organization game, which is what I got, but I honestly got so much more than just that. This game tells a story through the art and levels that you play through. The combination of relaxing gameplay alongside the story bringing these ideas to my mind caused me to reflect on my own life experiences and everything that I have gone through. It was honestly a wholesome and grounding experience. While the game itself is a bit short for the price for what I want from a game, my own experience during the time I spent playing the game made up it.
highly recommend this game if you love organising and casual, cosy games. although it only took me a few hours to finish the entire game so I wish there were more levels or it was longer in general

游戏整理的过程很治愈，真实的整理令人头大。
游戏流程有点短，3-5小时，对标价格有点贵。
关于部分成就的获得方式：
1.解决难题---97年拿出魔方后不停右键
2.大声播放音乐---04年拿到录音机，右键播放音乐
3.摆个姿势---04年拿到木头小人，多右键几次
4.偶尔啃两口---04年把饼干罐子放到橱柜最上面
5.头戴帽子---07年把鸭舌帽戴到有餐桌房间的人头模特上
6.开始游戏---07年把一个蓝色带把手的盒子放到客厅电视桌下面，右键盒子，电视会开机
7.整齐收纳---10年把所有“他”的内裤放在一个抽屉里（黑白灰和红色的，不带星星条纹和蝴蝶结）
8.冲泡咖啡---10年把和咖啡有关的物品放到厨房吧台上
9.12:00---13年厨房的微波炉，多右键
10.毛绒好友---18年婴儿房的小猪和老虎并排放在一起
11.抽水马桶---每年都冲厕所获得成就

I love this unpacking game it calms you if your are a neat freak and love to organise your home with everything put in its rightful place. you have lot levels to complete and there is no time limit so your heart will always feel full of joy. Also the achievements are easy to obtain.

Muito gostoso de jogar, ele é um tanto linear, mas, dentro de uma lógica, ele deixa você organizar os itens no cenário como quiser. Curtinho, quentinho no coração, a história é muito fofa e é muito recompensante ver ela se desenrolando. No geral é um jogo leve, e que apesar de ser meio repetitivo, é a premissa do jogo: ocupar a cabeça, com coisas simples. Super recomendo.

Super cute, loved seeing the story play out; it was wholesome and relatable. I'm satisfied with the length, but it's not one I feel like I'd play again after the first time. Would definitely love to see more content :)

The game is cute and I did enjoy the overall aesthetic and story progression but (1) it can be tricky to figure out what some of the objects are, (2) because we're always unpacking a bedroom/home, it started to feel super repetitive, and (3) I feel like it's overpriced for the experience I got.

Fairly short game for the price. However, Unpacking is a very relaxing experience. It has a wonderful way of conveying the story through the settings as you get to know the main character via their possessions. It also has a pleasant soundtrack throughout. The in-game items are cute, detailed, and fairly straightforward (except for the jar of honey! It's not a candle like I thought it was: just a heads-up)
8/10, would recommend.
It's a very nice, comfy and chill game. I loved the gameplay and had a lot of fun playing! It's not worth the sale price tho, it lacks a lot in content, unfortunately.

Simple and relaxing with a visual narrative that essentially tells a story of life through things you have, you acquire, you loss, and you learn from others. I was unexpectedly touched when I saw the bag of coffee beans and the poster of the published book later in the game. Subtle yet impactful all the same. Love this game.
this game is very cute and is ALL environmental story-telling. doesnt take very long to play at all but the replayability is definitely there!

I really think that unpacking was a fun and loving game. I would totally play it again, but it was too fast to play and complete. I wanted more adventure and story in the characters life. It was all very well made and I enjoyed making her home...
Mit ganz viel Liebe zum Detail begibt man sich mit diesem Spiel auf eine Zeitreise - auch in die eigene Vergangenheit. So, so schön! Leider ist die Reise überraschend schnell zu Ende.

Bought this during the Christmas sale and It's amazing!   I'm actually surprised that so much information gets conveyed with so little text or dialogue. However, this was a really short game :( I was expecting more levels but this is still a great game to calm down to!

I like how you can turn on and off the setting to allow you to place things anywhere, it let me play the game properly but also then play the game as I would like. I love organising so it's the perfect game for me :D

Eu só acho que talvez seria melhor se a gameplay fosse mais extensa, já que o jogo é caro. Por isso só recomendo compra-lo quando estiver em promoção. Tirando isso eu amei, muito relaxante e com certeza é um jogo que eu compraria de novo.

Way, way too expensive for how short it is and having been available for over a year now. I was only just starting to get a hang of where the game wants me to put certain things and the game was totally over. Excited for more - hopefully we get any extras for free

It's a very chill and cosy game. loved it from before i bought it and just trying it out myself proved it that's such a nice game. the sound of everything is so calming and the storyline is just a nice touch. 100% recommend this game.

Absolutely adored this game! Its so cute and perfect for anyone who loves organising items and/or decorating. The soundtrack is beautiful and the story line as you progress through the game is amazing. Definitely recommend playing if you want a chill game :)

I've said I recommend with the caveat that it has problems. Some problems a game this simple should not have. That being said, we don't have enough games with a Jewish protagonist in them, and this was a lovely addition overall to the small pool that we have, and a lot of people will likely love the gameplay in this. This seems tailor-made for me, since I like organization (especially when it's not my stuff), and it's cute and low stakes. There are also a lot of hidden interactions you can have which are pretty nice, and I like the idea of environmental storytelling used in this rather small world.

That being said, the game frequently froze/crashed, and then crashed Steam. Items would sometimes glitch out of doing what they were supposed to (a towel in particular would not change out from being folded to hanging). I actually wanted to replay this earlier, and after completing one year, the game froze lol I think part of it might be clicking too fast at once or something, or just... transitioning between screens. I don't know. My computer runs more complicated games than this just fine.

Another caveat isn't a bug, but intentional, though not in the way I think it's meant to be: I had a hard time telling just what certain objects were supposed to be, so figuring out where things were supposed to go could be very difficult. It took me two rooms to realize an item was an instrument stand, and I'm still not sure one item is used to dry dishes. There are a number of small items that I truly don't understand the point of, and usually just stuffed them in drawers or closets. Some kind of label feature with like "here's what this is" would be very helpful. In a way, yes, it's immersive to just be like "oh here's this thing I have, we'll put it wherever" when moving into a new place, but this was just frustrating in practice.

Overall, it's a very low stakes, simple game with a surprising level of complexity, and fun for people who like the dopamine of organizing stuff. The art is cute. It has a nice story. I don't know that I'll play it again because I'm tired of it crashing so much.

[i]Unpacking[/i] is an incredibly relaxing puzzle(/simulation?) game with GREAT sound design (*slaps roof of game* this baby can hold so many sound effects). I turned the music off because I like to listen to other things while playing, but I kept the SFX on because it adds to the satisfying experience of opening up the boxes and putting everything where it belongs. The music itself is very nice and reminds me a lot of Stardew Valley, which is one of my favorite games!

I think the only qualm I have with the game is not being able to put something [i]right[/i] where you want it because it's either visually blocked by something (e.g., a cupboard wall or shelf) or just not exactly in a predetermined spot. While it can be annoying, however, it'd probably take a LOT more programming to be able to place everything [i]anywhere[/i], so I try not to let it bother me. [i]Unpacking[/i] is absolutely wonderful otherwise, and I haven't even mentioned the story! You only get dialogue through captions written in your photo album (which are different for each room, by the way!), but the way I developed an emotional connection to the main character is stunning. Like I said, I've played this game quite a few times, but it feels like I'm still realizing new things about our protagonist's life.

Anyway, I'm off to go play [i]Unpacking[/i] for the 20th time - care to join me?

我們所擺放的物品和位置也會延伸到後續的年份，讓整個劇情看似鬆散實則連貫到最後。
當然要嚴格說來，它的劇情還是主要建立在玩家自己腦補，畢竟不是直接給你演出主角的人生。
此外，主角交往的對象算是有小小的暗示與巧思，
很喜歡這樣不刻意操作，卻把細節藏在日常生活之中的設計。
收尾在和伴侶一起彈烏克麗麗，配上BGM非常浪漫。
我個人的好評主要是給這點。

最後是缺點的部分。
1. 衣架掛衣服的判定實在是有夠難抓，氣死。
2. 有時候會搞不清楚物品是什麼而不知道該放哪，要一直試錯，可能會有點煩。
3. 成就藏得比較深，想追求的人可以直接找指南看。
4. 遊戲時長真的短也沒太大的重玩性，在意這點的人建議特價入手。

好玩！！就是切换房间是真的不方便，最后豪华双层大别野直接偷懒随便放放了:D
以及很多东西认不出来！！不过问题不大，准备去看别人的实况直播啦www

一、居然有剧情！有不少小细节，本来以为只是收纳爱好者会很享受的游戏，但很多时候其实没法做到特别有序整齐（东西好多），极简主义者不太能代入。好的方面在于东西多而都比较有特色很有生活感，通关后看着这里那里的用有一种温馨感。
另外，生活用品又能反映出很多细节，在不同房子里unpack也能一瞥主角的生活状态，随着她成长。游玩过程中有意想不到的开展，就是像“嗯？...嗯？好像是？啊，原来是这样”的感觉。
二、作为像素游戏制作很精美，细节多多。比起美学更注重生活。
三、关卡不太但个人感觉内容不少，得收拾好一会儿。我4.6小时可以通关（如果不摆的特别完美也不刷成就）。所以打折56块买到虽然是有点小贵但还可以接收。

总的来说，因为有意想不到的点所以觉很不错的超预期的作品！值得入手！

[b][h1]物载人生，箱窥成长[/h1][/b]

游戏记录了从1997年到2018年主人公多次的搬家拆箱过程。作品细节丰富，怀旧感拉满，场景内物品与年代、角色身份、环境等都十分匹配，且能够放大观看，很适合慢节奏地打发时间。游戏详细记录了主人公人生的不同的阶段：童年、学生时代、打工、恋爱、找到职业、最终与恋人迎来了新的小生命的成长历程，除了部分物品有要求外，自由度较高，可以说有一千个哈姆雷特那味儿了。

[b]游戏时长[/b]：3.5h—4.5h全成就
[b]游戏备注[/b]：漫游戏，细节满满，内容略少，希望能够更长一点


[h2]拆箱、新环境与人生变化[/h2]

搬家的时候，人们总是受到箱子的局限，重新审视自己的生活状态，抛弃掉一部分不必要的东西，轻装简行地搬进新环境。这时候保留下来的东西，就成为了最能体现主人公性格的不同方面了。

每一次新家的场景，往往都伴随着主人公人生重要的节点，也表示状态和处境的变化。从最开始的独立房间的出现明显的儿童玩具和学习用品，到合租房青春靓丽的服装收纳，再到恋爱时衣柜里的打工围裙，到后来回到家里曾经的小房间，却增加了更多绘画用品……

细微之处的见人生，物品一直在随着主人公的成长和经历不断变化。不富裕的学生宿舍里会看到每个人塞得满满的东西，低调奢华的恋人家里成套的碗碟看起来就很贵，随着伴侣一起搬进来的还有明显亚洲风格笼屉……环境的变化也是人生的变化，遇见了不同的人，经历的不同也会带来不同的感触。

不过总是有不变的，就像从小陪在身边的小猪玩偶，不断增加的花花绿绿T恤和游戏卡带，始终在书架上的形体书，持续增加的小鸡家族摆件，还有更新换代的绘画物品……主人公的成长轨迹一目了然，看着她生活得越来越好，甚至玩家会有种吾家有儿初长成的错觉（目移）。


[h2]拉满的游戏细节[/h2]

游戏的场景跨越了前后二十余年的时间，而细节丰富的场景带来的，游戏中最大的麻烦在于——不认识需要摆放的是什么。这也是本作精心制作的最大体验，随着一件件不同物品在场景中的摆放，很多具有年代感的物品一一呈现出来。不论是90后熟悉的拓麻歌子，还是80后熟悉的家用游戏机，再到烘焙爱好者们常用的量勺和老式擀面杖，还有至今仍然流行，但很少被提及的冰箱贴和留言板，文化、年代、性格、爱好上的差异体现得淋漓尽致。

玩家一边一一摆放着符合主人公身份的东西，一边猜测着自己放的这是什么，随之试着理解主人公的生活。就像是为什么有了棉条还要有卫生巾，为什么有止汗露了还要有香水瓶，为什么会有巨大的鱼型的盘子……一些人与人之间的文化不同慢慢呈现了出来。没有绝对正确的答案，不论是主播的呈现，还是评论区个人的截图分享，这是个永远不会被剧透的游戏，因为每个玩家都有符合自己喜好的答案。

千人千面，这游戏最有趣的点就在于细节足够丰富。因为生活和经历的不同，都会出现一点点的偏差，关注点都有所不同，交流也好，疑问也好，这让原本内容有限的单机游戏变得丰富了起来，有话题性，有反应差异，有交流的欲望。


[h2]用心的意识表达[/h2]

游戏被称为第九艺术，主要原因是每一个作品在呈现的时候都会有意识上的引导。而本作，至少做到了客观地呈现。

对于女性用品和衣着的呈现十分自然，猝不及防地从纸箱里拿出bra、内衣和棉条是很正常的，不需要遮掩，也不需要马赛克。展示架上不仅会有女孩子喜欢的可爱系，也会有大量的机甲手办和塑料小人，没有明显性别倾向的人设让游戏过程更加舒服。女孩子有随性的一面，也就有柔美的一面，有爱好小裙子的人，也会有T恤一沓又一沓的时候。当然，只有亚洲人会用笼屉和坚持用电饭煲神马的，还是挺刻板印象的，但确实那个巨大的鱼型盘子也不会在一般家庭里出现的啊喂！

不同的人会有不同的爱好，关注的物品也会有所不同。在主人公遇见伴侣之前，东西大部分以实用为主，装饰品很少，最多也就是一些摆件。而最后两个场景当中，大量绿植的出现直接宣告了另一个热爱生活的人的存在。可以说，一个游戏体现了很多种不同的生活方式，就像第二个合租公寓里那个制衣架子上的水手服，游戏很好地用物品，呈现了每个人生活都不太一样的无限可能。

Honestly this is the most relaxing game I've ever played. It's helped me through the process of losing a relationship, and losing someone I considered an inspiration to a battle with cancer. I love the memories created by this wonderful little game, and I hope to make many more with it.

This game was ridiculously fun and so addicting. I finished it in one sitting. Could not get myself to stop. I already want to play it all over again. Do yourself a favor and buy it already.

The art is so nice, the music is relaxing and cute (reminded me of Stardew Valley), and the subtle storytelling through the player’s objects/environment was done really well. The game doesn’t give any instructions. There are a few limitations to where you can put certain things, but it never felt restrictive. It’s a simple premise that was executed so well. A great example of games making real-life-not-fun-things really, really fun.

I'm going to be honest; I've seen unpacking on here before and was interested in it just because I love droll little simulator type games. I was expecting something just mind numbing but satisfying. I was not expecting feels. I read nothing and watched nothing on it before deciding to purchase it on sale. It was very satisfying and relaxing moving items from one area to the other but I wasn't expecting a well told story and my journey through life to unfold. I discovered so much about 'myself' while playing and I ended up gushing about it to my husband, which I'm sure he was thrilled by. 

In other words, play this game. I'm not sure how much replay value there is, though I am a full achievements junky so I will be going through again, however, I feel it is such a wonderful story and that it is now one of my favorite games.

UPDATE: I went back in to start a new game and realized I didn't have to in order to get all the achievements! I could simply click on the save I did, click on the picture for the date, and I'm right back in, no issues, not needing to unpack everything, just simply go in and find the thing I needed to complete for the achievement. I love when game developers do this!

A short game, in terms of play time. A great story watching someone grow and the journey they take through their lives, unpacking it from a box one item at a time. The art style coupled with the music makes for an incredibly soothing experience.

This game is perfect for anybody who finds organization relaxing, or anybody who simply likes decorating without the stress of having to design a whole space from scratch. The idea is that you unpack little nic-nacs and household items and arrange them in a way that fits the requirements but gives you a little bit of creative freedom in the design process. 

With each level, some items will no longer be packed but will be replaced by new ones which I think is a nice element that tells an unspoken story about the characters growth as people. One can learn what's important to the characters based on the items that get kept with each level. Another detail I appreciate is that some boxes have an item that doesn't belong in the room and you have to find the proper spot for it - a small detail that makes me imagine the characters "accidentally putting items in the wrong boxes while packing". Most of the hidden achievements are simple enough to stumble upon by accident during the playthrough, and add a fun touch to the game when you figure them out. 

If you like chill games, I wouldn't hesitate to give this game a try. It's honestly one of my favorite games and I find myself re-arranging the rooms even though I've already completed all the levels.

I was taken by surprise on how much I cared about her. This game managed to tell a touching story about growing up with minimal words and I loved it.

So, yes, the game play is short, but this game is super re-playable. First off, there's the black star mode, where you have to place everything where it should NOT be, and it's not as easy as it sounds. Then, my first playthrough was a little frantic because I wanted to see all the different places I would move into and I was not as relaxed as I hoped I would be. My next real playthrough (normal mode), I will take the time I want to organise everything the way I like. So, if you think this game is too expensive for the time played, don't worry, you will be coming back to it to relaxed and organise your rooms all over again. 

Happy gaming!

I finished this game in 3 hours, and as far as I know there's no new content coming out. Really not worth the $20. If they added more to the story, or even just let you unpack multiple people's houses, it'd be a lot more fun.

The story is told through the items you unpack, which allows you to play detective over what exactly is/has happened to the character you're following. Come up with your own theories about why your character moves houses, has certain belongings, moves out of certain places, and so forth.

The good:
Enjoyable puzzles that offer (some) creative control over how the rooms look.
Achievements to collect from HOW you decide to unpack/rearrange items.

The bad:
Not much replayability, apart from collecting all achievements.
Music that gets a little bit repetitive, but mostly unnoticable.
The game is TOO short!

Devs, you should add:
More characters to follow
More rooms/houses to unpack
