This game could be one of the best organisation/puzzle games out there. At the start of the game you are a child who has just gotten her own room. You have to neatly store away all of your belongings in all of the nooks and crannies in your brand new room. As you progress through the game, you skip through years of your life, moving from place to place in different parts of your life. This game is very relaxing and easy to play. If you pay close attention to the items you are sorting out in each house you may notice that a certain cup is cracked, or her childhood toy is growing old. The amount of detail in each object, whether it be the noise you make if you shake it, the design, or just the specific places you have to put it show how much the developers cared about this game. My absolute favourite part of this game was watching the chicken collection grow each level teehee.

 Although there are a few downsides also. I have played this game completely twice, once on Xbox and once on pc. On both of my play-through's I found this game very short. The levels only take you around four hours altogether. I think that you should be able to have one or two more lives that you could unpack. The second downside is the price. I don't really think that this game is worth twenty euros. Although it is a good game, as I said previously; it is very short. However this game obviously had a huge amount of effort put into it so the price is not really that big of a deal to me. I just think that people would be more inclined to buy it if it was ten to fifteen euros. 

All in all i would 100% recommend this game. It is cozy, relaxing and entertaining and once again, I adored the chickens. :)

Un jeu casual parfait pour des soirées détentes posé sous votre couette ... et qui refera surgir votre petit côté maniaque et "perfectionniste", avec des musiques assez calmes qui ne peuvent qu'adoucir vos tympans, le gameplay n'étant pas très variés ici on se contentera de vous faire ranger divers objets dans diverses pièces, un gameplay simpliste mais idéal pour vous détendre.

Unpacking au premier abord, peut vous faire penser que c'est juste un jeu zen sans plus, sans histoire ... mais ce n'est pas le cas, et c'est là le point fort du jeu, c'est qu'il y a une histoire, non pas avec des personnages mais avec des objets que l'on range, à travers les nombreux déménagements du personnage ou encore avec des éléments de décor où l'on en tire des conclusions. Cela me fait fort penser au cinéma ... le fait de raconter une histoire avec des images, des plans et des décors sans avoir nécessairement le besoin de dialoguer la scène, sans avoir ce besoin de dire "oui oui blabla il est en train de faire ceci ou cela...", et je trouve ça très malin d'avoir rajouter cette sorte de "storytelling" dans un jeu de rangement qui parait un peu simpliste.

Exemple d'une fois où un détail du jeu m'a fait comprendre une chose triste pour le personnage [spoiler] c'est le niveau où j'ai galéré à ranger une photo, je ne savais pas où la mettre, puis viens le moment où je découvre qu'il ne peut se ranger que dans un placard. Alors pourquoi une photo dans un placard me diriez vous ? Eh bien parce qu'il s'agit d'une photo entre le personnage principal et son ex petit copain, on en déduit donc que la rupture a été assez douloureuse pour elle au point de mettre cette photo au fond d'un placard très ingénieux quand même). Entre ce détail et les autres où l'on en apprends plus sur sa vie comme le fait qu'elle aime dessiner, qu'elle a fait de la collocation ou même qu'elle a reconstruit sa vie avec quelqu'un d'autre, ce jeu en devient très bon tout en restant simpliste et zen.[/spoiler]

Concernant l'accessibilité du jeu, il n'y a pas besoin de grosses configs (tant mieux), mais pour le prix ça c'est autre chose, attendez donc que le jeu soit en promo pour vous jeter dessus et ce sera l'idéal pour vous.

Unpacking》是一款独特的解压游戏，让玩家在一个富有情感共鸣的过程中体验整理物品的乐趣。游戏不仅仅是一种简单的过程，玩家能够通过探索一个人一生中的多个时刻，产生对生活中不同感受的思考。

游戏以其独特的方式呈现了生活中日常的一部分：打开箱子整理。每一个场景都是一个时刻的缩影，而玩家需要根据这些物品的用途和场景来放置它们。通过这个过程，玩家不仅仅是简单地整理物品，而是体验和共同经历了游戏中主人公的每一个人生阶段。

而在游戏的这个过程中，玩家会发现一个重要的主题就是保持自我，尤其是在恋爱关系中。通过整理和摆放物品，我们可以看到主人公的生活轨迹，以及与其他人的关系。在这个过程中，保持自我成为一个重要的挑战。例如，在和男朋友同居一个的房间时，玩家可能会发现这个角色在不同的生活阶段中是如何逐渐丧失自我，为了适应他人而放弃了自己的爱好或者价值观，没有地方拜访的证书，没有主人公可以工作的书房和桌子，绘画用品只能放进柜子。

很高兴能看到游戏后端主人公能够重新回到让自己舒适的空间，做自己喜欢的事情，爱可以伴随牺牲，但不能让我们丧失自我，阻止我们成为更好的人。

[h2]Einleitung[/h2]
Unpacking ist sicherlich kein Spiel, welches voller Action und rasanter Handlung steckt. Ganz im Gegenteil. Mit diesem Spiel lernt man zwei Sachen: 1. Einen Gang runter schalten und entschleunigen und 2., Ordnung in seinem (digitalen) Leben schaffen. Ob es sich lohnt oder für wen dieses Spiel wirklich ist, schauen wir uns in den nächsten Abschnitten an.

[h2]Story[/h2]
Mit dem Spiel unpacking begleiten wir eine Person bzw. ein junges Mädchen von Kindesalter bis zum Ableben. Wir durchlaufen dabei die unterschiedlichsten Stationen ihres Lebens. Diese beginnen bei den Eltern als Kind im Kinderzimmer, gehen über das Teenager-Alter hinaus, das Studiums, die erste Liebe, die erste Trennung, der Versuch das andere Geschlecht durch ein Gleichnamiges zu ersetzen und einfach mit dem Leben klar zukommen. Wir erleben die Protagonistin hierbei in den einzelnen Stationen, indem wir ihr Zimmer bzw. ihre Wohnung bzw. das Haus "einrichten" müssen. Es geht dabei, dass man die Umzugskartons auspackt und die Gegenstände sinnvoll ein- und wegräumt. Wie im echten Leben fängt alles mal klein an und mit der Zeit sammelt sich viel Schrott, ähm... viele Gegenstände bzw. Besitz. Dabei erleben wir das Auspacken, wie in der Realität. Nicht jeder Umzugskarton auf dem drauf steht was drin sein soll, beinhaltet auch dies. So müssen wir die Besitztümer auch den richtigen Räumen zu ordnen. Auf Grundlage der Wohnung bzw. Wohnsituation und der Besitztümer stellen wir fest, in welcher Lebensphase sich unsere Protagonistin gerade befindet.

Mit der Zeit wächst der Umfang, aber auch die Konstante ist mit an Bord. Irgendwann erkennen wir die geliebten Stücke und wissen ganz genau, wohin sie sollen. Aufregend wird es nur in sofern, dass wir uns vielleicht mal unterordnen müssen, wenn wir zu jemanden ziehen oder wir unser Reich mit jemanden anderem teilen wollen. Dann geht das gepuzzle los und es wird teils zum (positiven) Krampf, wohin noch etwas kann und seinen Platz findet.

[h2]Grafik[/h2]
Das Spiel stellt in einer 3-dimensionalen Vogelperspektive die unterschiedlichen Räume da. Leicht in einer Pixel-Darstellung. Es ist nicht an einem reinen Realismus angelehnt (grafisch gesehen!), sondern vertritt eher den spielerischen Charakter. Somit erwartet uns auch nichts an Effekten oder dergleichen. Die Einrichtungsgegenstände können weitestgehend frei platziert werden. Dabei hilft ein Rastermuster, welches die Objekte "einrasten" lässt. Somit erkennen wir, ob wir etwas ablegen, aufstellen, aufhängen, etc. können. Da die Grafik einfach gehalten ist und nicht mit Animationen oder anderen beweglichen Features daherkommt, ist die Auslastung der Grafikkarte gering. Zudem gibt es jedoch eine 4K-Auflösung-Unterstützung, wenn man Besitzer eines 4K-fähigen Gerätes ist.

[h2]Sound und Musik[/h2]
Es spielt sich im Hintergrund eine dezente, leiste Musik ab. Diese wirkt teils beruhigend und kann sogar in Endlosschleife laufen. Die Musik wirkt in keinster Form nervend oder störend und untermalt die jeweiligen Stationen des Lebens.

Soundeffekte sind vorhanden, konzentrieren sich jedoch auf die passiven Elemente. So haben wir Geräusche beim Kartonöffnen, beim Zusammenfalten oder wenn Schränke bzw. Schubladen benutzt werden. Die Objekte selbst, die es zu verstauen gilt, geben keine Geräusche wieder.

Eine Sprachausgabe gibt es nicht. Weder in Englisch oder sonst irgendeiner Sprache.

[h2]Gameplay und Steuerung[/h2]
Das Spiel wird rein mit der Maus oder einem Gaming Controller gespielt. Die Tastatur ist nicht notwendig. Die Steuerung mit der Maus erfolgt problemlos. Da es möglich ist auch heran- bzw. rauszuzoomen, können die Räume gut bedient werden. Wie oben bereits erwähnt hilft das Raster zur Ablage enorm, um die Gegenstände zu platzieren. Einzig in Kombination mit einem in der "Hand" gehaltenen Objekt und der Interaktion mit einem Möbelstück, kann schon mal ungewollt verlaufen. So werden Schränke geschlossen, anstatt das darin befindliche Objekt auszuwählen.

In vielen Fällen ist ein Gaming Controller hilfreicher, als Maus und Tastatur. Allerdings hatte ich nicht das Gefühl, dass man mit einem Controller eine bessere Möglichkeit hat, um das Spiel kontrollierter zu bedienen. Der Stick für die Mauspositionierung über den Controller war mühsamer, als das Schieben einer Maus und das entsprechende Anvisieren. Daher habe ich das Spiel lieber rein mit der Maus gesteuert.

[h2]Maps[/h2]
Maps ist hier etwas irreführend, da es sich ja um die einzelnen Räume handelt. Betrachten wir aber Map als kompletten Wohnraum, den es zu beziehen gilt, lässt sich sagen, dass die Größe und Komplexität dieser je nach Lebensabschnitt ziemlich variiert. Das hat zum Vorteil, dass es Abwechslung für den Spieler darstellt und immer eine kleine Überraschung parat hält, was als nächstes kommt.

[[h2]Bugs/h2]
Kurz und knapp: Keine gefunden, wenn man die "Falschselektierung" mal außer Betracht lässt.

[h2]Spielspaß und Langzeitmotivation[/h2]
Zunächst muss man, wie fast immer, sich erst Gedanken machen, an wen dieses Spiel adressiert wurde. Es ist ein Spiel für Zwischendurch und um entspannt die eine oder andere Minute zu verbringen. Ganz ohne Zeitdruck und Stress. Da die Maps/Lebensabschnitte zu meist immer herausfordernder werden, benötigt es schon etwas Zeit, um alles korrekt zu verstauen. Es bestehen einige Lebensabschnitte und die Sprünge durch die Zeit sind nicht gewaltig. Eher fast immer in kleinen Jahresabschnitten. Bei der Protagonistin geschieht recht viel und sie muss sich erst finden. Daher gibt es viele "Maps" und somit auch viele Räume und entsprechend noch mehr Kartons zum Auspacken.

Wem dies nicht reicht, kann zusätzlich auf Steam Achievement-Jagd gehen. Alle Errungenschaften sind zunächst versteckt und müssen Stück für Stück freigespielt bzw. entdeckt werden. Dabei erhält man nicht alle Errungenschaften nur weil man alle Lebensabschnitte durchläuft. Teils kleine Besonderheiten müssen ausgelöst werden, damit man die entsprechende Errungenschaft seins nennen darf.

[h2]Fazit und Empfehlung[/h2]
Am Anfang hatte ich persönlich keine richtige Lust oder Motivation auf dieses Spiel. Der Gedanke etwas "auszupacken" und wegzuräumen schien mehr absurd. Aber tatsächlich ist es ein Spiel, was vieles über einen selbst sagen kann und auch ggf. den einen oder anderen eigenen Lebensabschnitt widerspiegelt. Ebenfalls ist es ein Spiel, was dazu einlädt mal das Leben im Slow-Motion zu fahren und sich entspannt zurückzulehnen. Keine Hektik, kein Zeitdruck, keine (unnötige) Action. Einfach mal machen und schauen wohin es führt.

Für wen ist das Spiel ? Für Spieler, die mit viel Lust und Laune auch gerne Puzzle machen, ist das Spiel definitiv eine Möglichkeit und eine Empfehlung. Wer allerdings keine Geduld hat und auch nicht immer wieder das Gleiche machen möchte, der wird mit unpacking falsch sein. Es ist eben un-aufregend und das ist schon wieder das Aufregende an diesem Spiel.

Von mir eine Empfehlung, wenn man etwas für Zwischendurch zur Entspannung sucht. Daumen nach oben!

Pourquoi ne pas avoir fait des niveaux supplémentaires ? Le jeu se termine en trois heures, et encore, j'ai pris mon temps. Je suis vraiment déçue et ne m'attendais pas du tout à ça. Short and nice

A quick game about moving... that's it (for the most part)
Putting your belongings where ever you please is really nice.
The game has a little story which gets told with the objects (and living spaces).

Overall A "Let's put the toaster in the bathtub, perfect place for it"/10

Got this as it was on a few people's GOTY lists (2023). I have nothing bad to say about it except its very short, once its done in three hours its done.

I was hoping each of the albums would have a different storyline but that was not the case. The story you do get is nice but there's nothing noteworthy about it. Perhaps for a relaxing zen game this is trying to be that's appropriate, I was just hoping for a little more of a memorable experience.
很有趣，在搬家的过程中一边收拾一边脑补主角经历了什么。和第一位恋人同居的时候，对方明显没有为自己即将搬进他家做任何准备，也意味着这段关系里，也许“我”并没有得到相应的尊重。而第二段恋爱同居的时候，可以发现会多出好几个柜子来存放对方的东西，这是做好了一起生活的准备。而有的东西随着搬家过程中丢了，那个魔方。有的却一直保留，她的画笔。就像通过一次次的搬家大概看到了她的上半生。

确实是好游戏，整理癖狂喜。但是流程实在太短了，三个小时就能玩完，真不值70块好吧。建议等特加入。
还有这游戏中国人玩着可能不太懂，因为好多物品在中国不常用或者根本不用，还有一些让国人费解的放置逻辑（比如药品放在卫生间里）还有几个瓶装的东西光看外观根本不知道放哪里。
但瑕不掩瑜，这游戏还是值得一玩的，顺便啥时候有DLC呀，就这些根本收拾不够！！！

A relaxing and adorably animated game. I love sorting and organizing everything to how I would do it myself. The art is beautiful and the storytelling is subtle yet powerful. I love, love, love this game and recommend it to others if they want a chill game and like satisfying organization!
It's very a very nice game. Unique storytelling and fun gameplay loop

Organization is very relaxing for myself so Unpacking offers a very calming experience. It is a fun game and has beautiful visuals, however I do recommend buying it on sale (I got it at 50%) as I 100%'d the game after about four hours. The only downside is there obviously isn't much replayability to it; another reason to buy it on sale.

honestly this is a super sweet and heartwarming game. if you pay attention to the details of the levels you can see the progress of life of the main character. i recommend this game if you like casual and calming games to kill time :)

Schönes Spiel, das sehr liebevoll gestaltet ist. Die Spielzeit kann man ein bisschen variieren, je nachdem wie lange man einsortiert und umsortiert. Trotzdem finde ich 5 Stunden Spielzeit für 20 Euro ein bisschen wenig und ich habe wirklich langsam gespielt. Ich würde also empfehlen, auf einen Rabatt zu warten. Trotzdem war es für mich das Geld wert, weil man es gut öfter durchspielen kann. Es eignet sich super, um parallel ein Hörbuch oder ähnliches zu hören.

非常温馨游戏，使我尸斑淡化
女主好重感情好热爱生活，旧玩偶和玩具一直留着，每次拿出来我都会想怎么老是你
反观我自己，没有一点恋物癖，无论什么东西说扔就扔

Super cute and cozy game! I had tons of fun playing it and figuring out the puzzle aspect of what goes where (which can be toggled on and off!). I also appreciate all the accessibility settings, I didn't try them out, but I love to see that available for people who need it. My only main and major complaint is that it is such a short game; I finished it in one afternoon. It definitely has a re-playable ability to it, but I feel like it will get boring after doing it once or twice...I would love to see more houses/families/characters to unpack for to help combat this (I looked it up and there is a possibility of a sequel but no mods or additional content :( ).

Recomendo mt esse jogo! além de ter uma arte lindíssima, é muito relaxante e detalhadinho (dá pra vc interagir com vários dos objetos e até desbloquear conquistas com isso). 
A história é mt bonitinha mas infelizmente o jogo é bem curtinho, espero que futuramente possam ter mais fases com outras historinhas!
Jogo fofo :´)

im a sucker for subtle / implicit story telling. also a very calming game where you can just organize things. 

diploma / 10

An absolutely perfect cozy game. It was cute seeing different items in multiple levels and learning about the characters life this way without ever seeing them. Hidden secrets throughout the levels. Would highly recommend if you want a true cozy game with chill music and a bit of a plot.
Es un juego visualmente bonito, es fácil de utilizar y muy tranquilizante. puedes pasar horas jugando y acomodando las cosas de diferentes maneras. muy entretenido.

Como amante de los juegos de orden y organización, me ha encantado. Los sonidos de los objetos, la música envolvente y calmada. La historia, que no es lo más importante, está muy bien explicada sin falta de texto. El pixelart con los colores vivos es maravilloso!

Como única pega posible, con poquitos objetos me pasó que no entendí el lugar en que se ponen aquí, supongo que por haber aprendido de otra forma.

Recomendado!! :D
The art in this game is beautiful. I was sincerely sad when I realized I had finished playing through all of the levels. Its a very peaceful narrative and a great game to relax to.

어떤 사람의 방을 몇 십분 보는 게 그 사람을 오래 아는 사람과 비슷한 수준의 이해도를 가질 수 있다던데 그런 점이 엄청 잘 느껴지는 게임인 듯합니다. 한 사람의 인생을 겨우 이사하는 짐으로 알 수 있단 게 정말 흥미롭고 재밌어요. 속편 꼭 나왔으면 좋겠습니다!

단, 망할 파란색 정사각형 게임기는 없이 내주세요. 게임 큐브가 뭔지 몰라서 망할 기계 버리라고 잔소리를 몇 번을 했는지 모르겠습니다.

i like this game but its only worth it on sale, the game NEEDS more levels but (at least on social media) its been said that they think the story is complete and wont add more but the other levels don't need to follow the same character, they could do it from the mc's partner's life or the mc's child, id love that as dlc (even if i have to pay but anymore than 3 pounds wouldn't feel right)

i really hope they make a squeal that has the ability for fans to make levels, it would immediately fix the lack on content problem and keep the game relevant, maybe even have dlc waves of official levels telling a story! you could have a basic and a more complex level maker with the simple one letting you use already existing levels but maybe add rooms or swap out items and where they can go with a complex level maker where people can make there own stuff (they could use steam work shop if they want to have more custom ones be available but not have to worry about moderation)

this game is good and its well known for a reason i just hope the devs let it thrive as much as it can because i know this can be something even better!!

This game is soo good, im like in love with it. Could you guys pleaseeee make a second game, but like a diffrent story, maybe there kids story or something like that!

Played through the game twice now, and have gotten every achievement. Genuinely one of my FAVORITE games I've personally played through. Great OST, a great story, and overall such an immersive and fun experience. HIGHLY recommend it, and I hope to see a new DLC or even a new game. Bravo!! :D

I looooooved this game. It was so engaging, and I loved the changes in settings and items that reflected where our main character is in their life. The little hints of what's going on are so cute. If you like virtually organizing things this is so worth it...hope they make a new game one day with similar vibes.
muy buen juego y entretenido, me gusta la forma que tiene de contar la historia, lo esperaba más corto y que durara un ratito más me ha encantado

I love this game. It brings a peace as you unpack, showing what kind of person you are and the person you are moving in with. Just wish for more alternatives of other characters since the game ends quickly based on your effectiveness. What remains is getting all the achievements.

Um jogo calmo, gostoso de jogar, que conta uma história sem precisar dizer uma palavra. Organizar as coisas acaba sendo mais envolvente do que parece, e platinar vem naturalmente. Perfeito pra desligar a cabeça e curtir.

Chill way to unwind. I think you will already have a feeling for if you'd enjoy this. It's pretty relaxing, and pretty short (~3h). For me it is worth it when on sale, but the full price is a little high.

This is a super cute and relaxing game (It does go on sale at times but the price really isn't bad for the game is good)
I still need to finish it all but so far I've enjoyed it

If you're into organizing things I definitely recommend it!

A fun and relaxing game centered around unpacking and organizing for someone while they move throughout their life. see what they bring with them and where their life takes them :)

i have played through all the levels at least 3 times. i heavily enjoyed looking at all of the objects and listening to the noises of everything as i was placing them. it put me in a very zen space and i was focused solely on placing items in the "best" spots.

the pixel art and the music are both really well done, as is the sound design. everything feels fleshed out and nothing really feels missing to me (aside from more games like this)

def worth it at full price imo but get it on sale if you can :)
Awesome story telling through game mechanics. It's an excellent cozy game for people who also want closure from a game. It'll make a satisfying afternoon.

This game is incredible, I bought it for 2$, so i don't know if the price is really that good, but the game is soo relaxing. The entire point of the game is to unpack boxs and put all the object in it in a room or in a house, like if you were moving. EVERY object has does a different sound if you place it on EVERY other object, wich make it soo satisfying. And the achievment are really adorable. This game is certainly a 10/10 for me, I wish it was a little bit longer, it's like 4 hour long, but that's just because I want to play more, and not because the game is lacking content.

I love this game and really like the small details that have been put in place into the game! Really need to finish all the chapters but overall I really enjoy the games cute pixel style and gameplay :)

A warm game with touchable details, please cancel the Tidy Whites achievement or revise it to tidy the protagonist's own underwear to unlock (I am quite unhappy with this achievement in a female-friendly game) and I will change my review to positive.

The game is $20, and I completed it in 2 hours. Went back through to see if things changed the 2nd time, but nope. If it's on sale, absolutely worth it if you enjoy organizing things. You can't put them exactly where you want them, but it's close enough to scratch your brain in just the right way if you're into that. 

But at 20 bucks? Really not worth it.

Short game. You can finish it within one or two hours; however, it may take five to eight hours if you are a perfectionist or have OCD traits like me (haha). The game is just about taking out stuff from the boxes and rearranging it to the proper position. Most people told me that they feel relaxed. However, it is just OK for me. Maybe because I have to tidy my room every week and clean the whole house every month. Though, it is a great game to introduce your children to tidying their room. hehe

It's just so relaxing and the actual story is fun to follow and notice the little differences. I wouldn't pay full price for it but when I bought it on sale, I definitely got my money's worth out of it.

The most relaxed I've ever been. This is also the perfect game for me because I love to (and am good at) Organizing things in real life. I love the subtle storytelling that happens through the various items, rooms/houses and scrap book entries. You can figure out the personality of the unseen characters through the small details.

Really nice and relaxing game. Sadly, it doesn't have a lot of repeatability in gameplay, so I'd recommend buying it on sale. It's ~2-3 hours of gameplay for $20 otherwise. Besides that, it's great. Really tells a story without using words. Pretty interesting concept.

I have really enjoyed this game.  The storytelling happens in the tiny details, but it feels so interesting each time I notice a new detail that I overlooked before.  Very clever and even fun to repeat; at least it was for me.  Deciding what gets put away and what takes prominence is a very subtle way for player to make their own mark.  The music for the game is also excellent.  Just the right blend of cozy yet unobtrusive.  The ending theme song makes me cry every time I hear it.  I even bought that song for my own personal collection.  I have played through the game four time.  Even my young son enjoys this game.

I originally played Unpacking on gamepass trial after watching a few of my friends play it. I liked it so much I bought it on Steam so I could keep playing it. 

My only quarrel is that you can only do three saves per game because I want to keep playing it over and over and over again. I guess I could delete one of my saves... but it hasn't come to that yet.
This game is a very fun yet relaxing experience :) I recommend this game to anyone who likes playing Stardew Valley, or any other similar titles/

I have played through this game one time so far, not focusing on the story or getting everything to look pretty, just playing through it at face value. Even playing it in that context was fun and I enjoyed it a lot. It took me about 3 hours to finish the game, I did leave it open while I was doing other things and that's why it says I've played it for 9 hours :P But yeah I enjoyed it. The art style reminded me of Stardew Valley with the pixel style.

My favorite game. The story is so cute, and it's amazing to see your character's life unfold with each new place they unpack into. I love organizing so this game just clicks perfectly with me, and the details in each item are just incredible. 100/10. I've replayed this at least 3 times, buy it.
This game is very calming, unique, and cute! I love the artstyle of the game and the music is just beautiful! 1000/10 recommend this game for those rainy days.. or for any day!! lol

このゲームは、引っ越しの際に必ずやる「荷ほどき」という行為を通じて一人の女性の人生をたどる物語です。
それにしてもこの女性、驚異的なまでに荷造りが下手。何故かキッチンの段ボールからトイレットペーパーが出てくるなどして首を傾げるのも一度や二度ではないでしょう。文化圏の違いでしょうか、たまに日本ではあまり見かけなさそうなナニコレ小物が現れることもあります。
のんびりとしたBGMを聞きながら、これはどこに置くか、これの並びはどうするか、あ、これ持って来たんだ……と考えていると、まるで自分もどこかに引っ越したかのような気持ちになります。リラックスしたいときにはお勧めです。
更に、小物の効果音を含めた細かな作り込みには驚嘆を禁じえません。特にドット絵が好きな人は買って後悔しないと思います。

Even though it seems like a simple and sweet game, it is actually a very meaningful and soul-touching game. The play can tell us about the changes and stages that a person goes through throughout his life, without any verbal expression. That's why I kept visualizing the stages I went through in my own life throughout the game.
      The pixel art of the game is really beautiful. The fine details in the game are also really nice. For example, if there is an object in front of it when closing the doors, it will hit it or some drawers have a retarder etc. This game has a special place for me among Pixel art games.

剛開始以為這是個單純整理房間的遊戲，直到後面的關卡發現有些東西是不能移動的， [strike] 差點強迫症發作玩不下去 [/strike] 。
沒有很明確的故事劇情，但跟著主角一起搬家，可以從一些蛛絲馬跡察覺到主角的成長與變化。
最喜歡的部分是關卡結束時，主角在相簿寫下的註解。每一個場景的文字都會不同，有時間的話就把每一個都看過吧！
整體而言還滿喜歡這種溫馨的風格，遊戲方式也很特別，推薦在特價的時候入手！

[b] Sinopse: [/b] Unpacking é um jogo relaxante, e consiste em desempacotar seus pertences em diferentes etapas da sua vida, conforme ela muda.

[b] O Jogo: [/b] Um bom jogo para relaxar sem se preocupar com a dificuldade, é um jogo para passar o tempo e esquecer os problemas da vida real. É um jogo curto, em menos de 5 horas é possível fazer 100%. Unpacking conta com 8 "fases" da sua vida, nas quais você vai desempacotar seus pertences e descobrir o que aconteceu na sua jornada.

[b] Pontos positivos: [/b]
Relaxante
Jogabilidade fácil
Prende a atenção
Boa trilha sonora

[b] Pontos negativos: [/b]
Jogo curto para o valor cobrado.

[b] Conclusão: [/b] Um ótimo jogo para passar o tempo, um jogo de qualidade e que passa a impressão que foi feito com carinho, mas poderia ser mais barato pelo tempo de jogo.

I got this game 60% off - I wouldn't have payed the full prize for that short amount of gaming time.
Anyway, I still recommend this game for those who want to just relax and shut thoughts out.

I've already finished this in its entirety around three times... it's really short but really nice and relaxing. A good detox for my brain. I love a good organizational game. Collecting achievements are also really fun because of how they appear as stickers in-game. Totally recommend!!!!!

Very relaxing and engaging. The story elements are beautifully subtle and seamlessly diegetic. I enjoyed this a lot.
very peaceful to play, loved figuring out the story on the way for the character. It would be cool to do more stories on different people. Loved this.
Such a satisfying and relaxing game. Can play over and over without ever getting bored. The detail of the story line is incredible. Love this game!

This game is beautiful in every single way, I didn't think a game about unpacking boxes would have such a beautiful story and be able to bring me to tears. 
slight spoiler: The way she carries things from all walks of her life is such an impactful message. Like no matter if they are memories that were good or bad, she still brings them as they are part of her story. Also the fact it took her YEARS to paint the mini is so real haha

Unpacking is one of those chill, relaxing games that will totally put you in comfort as you experience it. Over the course of several time periods, you have to unpack boxes of your possessions as the protagonist lives their life from childhood to adulthood. The gameplay really helps facilitate your creativity in where to put your possessions as you unpack. It can seem a bit overwhelming with the amount of items at first, but the game has a feature where it will not let you place things in improper places, which helps a lot with the quality of life aspect. From there on, you can engage with the relaxing zen you will feel as you move things around and see what looks best to you. 

Unpacking is a great case of "show, don't tell." With the items that you unpack, you get the understanding that it's the life journey of this woman who's the protagonist. It starts off with childhood with childhood-themed things then evolves into adult things to unpack. You get the sense of this woman's accomplishments, struggles, and more just from the items that you unpack and the process of settings things down. An actually strong sense of storytelling with no words at all. Unpacking is a game well worth the price tag and you playing through it. 

9/10
Sehr entspanntes Spiel. Leider etwas kurz, aber es erzählt die Geschichte von uns und wie wir in unserem Leben in verschiedene Räume und Situationen einziehen. Mit einem super schönen Happy End! (:

The moment when it breaks into "masterpiece" territory is when you realize how it's telling a story – not only using the objects, but also the placement rules – with some meaningful comments about the human condition.

If you do not allow your heightened expectations or imagination get the better of you, Unpacking is a fine little puzzle fidget game - something to do while listening to a podcast or online meeting. It won't ask much of your brain, and its anodyne aesthetic and whimsical settings are pleasant, but not engrossing with detail. The problem is that it uses the tiniest amount - the smallest bit - of environmental storytelling and its mechanics to make you wish a more talented writer and artist had gotten the chance to play with this concept. In a world where we already have Gone Home - precious flaws and all - Unpacking feels like a gameplay demo, not a full experience. Its Coming of Age narrative lacks the punch and detail of that Gone Home's hyper-detailed environments provided, even if they strained credulity. Unpacking has the gameplay engagement that Gone Home lacked, but Gone Home has the writing and attention to detail that Unpacking desperately needs.

Puedo decir con seguridad que este juego ofrece una experiencia única y envolvente. Su mecánica principal y distintiva de desempaquetar paquetes y organizar objetos es sorprendentemente satisfactorio. Desde encontrar el lugar perfecto para cada artículo hasta ver cómo la historia se desenvuelve a través de tus acciones, cada momento es una delicia tranquila.

Unpacking es un viaje corto pero profundo que puede disfrutarse en una tarde tranquila. La música acompaña perfectamente esta atmósfera relajante, sumergiéndote aún más en el mundo de la organización doméstica. Además, gráficamente es una delicia para los ojos, con su estilo visual encantador que añade un toque de calidez a cada escena.

Lo más destacado de Unpacking es la forma en que cuenta su historia sin decir una palabra. A medida que desempacas las cajas y colocas los objetos en sus lugares designados, vas descubriendo la vida de la protagonista a lo largo de los años. Es un enfoque sutil pero efectivo que te hace sentir parte de su viaje.

Sin embargo, debo admitir que el precio del juego puede parecer un poco elevado considerando su duración. Aunque la experiencia es sin duda valiosa.

A pesar de este pequeño inconveniente, recomendaría jugar Unpacking a cualquiera que busque una experiencia de juego relajante y emotiva.

This game is like that game on mobile where you can organize rooms with boxes but this has a story and no ads! I do wish this game was longer but it was fun and very addicting when I first started it. Now I only crave for more games like this because of how satisfying everything was.

Jogo totalmente satisfatório de jogar, além de contar uma historia sobre a vida!

O jogo tem um visual incrível, para quem gosta de jogos pixels e quer relaxar um pouco depois de uma partida infernal de TF2, vai gostar bastante.

Recomendo!

Every so often, I play a game that reminds me why I enjoy this medium so much. While this might not have the most high-end Graphics or the most Innovative gameplay, the ability to tell a story simply by unpacking boxes in a new home is something special. I would highly recommend it to anybody who wants to take a quick break and have fun piecing together this character's life story, one box at a time.

8/10 could have more game materiel and a bit pricey for the play time

my first playthrough was 6,6 hours and i only have 50% of the achievements so i would play it again. i would say you should get it on 50% off if you can, the full price is not worth only one story in my opinion. theres just not enough play time for the price. 
i really liked the story and seeing them keeping items and getting new once was really cute. when i read the reviews i was really confused how you could see a story in a game of unpacking moving items but it makes sense when you play it.

This game is so cute. I wish there were more just like this. It's so relaxing, the sound effects are very satisfying and the story line is actually adorable. I really love this game. I can't say I think it's worth $20, but it's very cute.

I've played this game over and over again and I can't really get bored of it! Each time you notice new small things :) Very wholesome, definitely recommend. Wish it'd have more levels though. Highly recommend doing the dark star route where you put everything in the wrong place!
very cute and cozy game 10/10, only downside is thats its really short. Would love to have a lot more levels even if they dont tell a story i just love organising stuff
I love this game! The equality and general relaxation is amazing! The ending is so sweet. I do wish there were more levels and puzzles, but it's an amazing game either way. Thank you <3

I adored this game. From the art style to the sounds to the gameplay. Nothing was missing. 
I loved the story. How it lets you imagine the missing pieces that it doesn't directly tell you. 

The only real complaint I have is that there's not more of it! I really wish there were other levels, or a DLC to play, another story maybe. 
I played it a couple of times, collected all there was to collect and I don't feel like replaying it over and over because I don't want it to feel repetitive and ruin the first experience I had with it. 


It made my brain go quiet for a little and relaxed me, I wish I could forget it and play it for the first time again.

The Good: 
- Subtle story you can follow. It was really nice following the character's development and seeing what they keep/discard as they keep moving each time. 
- Strangely inspiring story that makes you happy :) 
- The soundtrack was also good as it changes between levels, to fit the "vibe/emotions" of that stage in her life. 
- Relaxing and mindless

The Not So Good: 
- Short game without many levels - can be finished in 4-6 hours. You can't do much else once you finish the game either (besides going back and rearranging if you wanted to.) 
- Price. I brought this game on sale, and even then I'd say the price is high for what it is.
I found this game through multiple YouTubers. It's a nice, relaxing little game. And I loved the little story bits the game sprinkled throughout and the credits song was very nice.

흔들리는 소리가 다르다거나 두는 소리가 각각 다른 등 디테일 면에서는 너무나 좋은 게임이지만, 단일 컨텐츠라 볼륨이 작다는 게 아쉬움. dlc나 다른 앨범 선택으로 또다른 캐릭터의 이야기를 들려준다는 등의 볼륨키우기가 필요하다고 생각함. . 너무너무 하고 싶어서 거의 정가줬었던 것같은데 그러기엔 좀 아쉬운 게임인듯. 

*정가주기 아쉬움. 

*디테일이 좋다.

* 볼륨이 더 커야될 것같음.

This game is so sweet and beautifully illustrated. It's short, but I think it is absolutely worth your time and money if you like laid-back and heartwarming games. I love that the "main character" of the game is invisible, and yet you learn so much about her just from unpacking her belongings. The pixel art is gorgeous, so if you love pixel art then this is a must-play!! I thoroughly enjoyed my brief time with Unpacking and would recommend it to anyone else who loves cozy vibes.

I didn't realize how short this game was, I only saw clips of the game from other streamers and it looked fun. I had a good time playing it, I just wish there were more levels. The creativity to place objects in different places made for many variations in gameplay.

A short but very sweet game! There's very tetris-like satisfaction in finding every item it's home, and the subtle narrative you can follow gives the game a nice flow and ties you to the people behind the objects. I like that you can go back in and rearrange after you've completed a level. I think adding a "sandbox" mode where you can pick from all the Main Character's objects and play with them in different levels would be fun, but to be fair my first review when my wife asked me how I liked the game was "I wish there were 8000 more levels"
i didn't expect a story like that to unfold, i thought it was just some sorting game. great execution though, loved it. [spoiler]10/10 stabbed photo onto the cork board[/spoiler]

A fun and relaxing game where you organize different rooms! There is a fun little story line where you can see someone slowly growing up through the different rooms/houses you organize. The background music is super nice and there are some really fun achievements!

If you just love cozy games this is really a game for you!

Joguinho muito bom de se jogar.
Vemos a história de uma personagens sem falas, apenas com ações e coisas que refletem uma uma vida que está evoluindo.
Músicas de fundo memoráveis que assim que escutamos vamos nos lembrar deste jogo. E ver a música final junto com os créditos e de aquecer o coração.
Recomendo, e muito!

I love unpacking I think its a game I will revisit after a while but for twenty dollars and only around ten hours of game play I think it should have more to it I finished the game in a day and I would hope most games would give at least a week of game play but the game is fun and relaxing and its really fun to find all sorts of little hidden things inside of the different houses but if your looking for a game that will entertain you for a long time I would say this game isn't for you.

Para relajar, casual, de ordenar cositas. Sencillo, arte estilo pixel art muy agradable.
Unos cuantos niveles para descontracturar ordenando ítems en los diferentes lugares donde le protagoniste vive.
beautiful artwork, and very nice story. I really enjoyed piecing together the characters through the environmental storytelling (:

This game is really cool. The game play is pretty short though, it took me only 3 hours to finish it (I've let my friends play it as well). If you do get it, I'd say wait for the game to go on sale. I've also gotten all achievements which did not take long at all.

All in all I recommend this game, it's pretty relaxing! :)

很有意思的小游戏，就是对于这个价格来说流程太短了，多来两个故事就好了。
还有就是有些物品根本认不得是什么东西，放哪全靠穷举，拿起的时候能显示物品的名字会更好一点。

Cute and fun game. It was a good game for me to relax to, let my brain go empty while it focused on unpacking and organizing. There is even a little story revealed through each packing event. Game took me 5 hours to complete, and I'll likely try playing again.

A nice, relaxing game to about putting away belongs when moving into new homes.  I do feel a bit like a detective at times, seeing kind of how the characters' belongings change over time, what was kept and what was left behind, and how those changes reflect different moments in their lives.  The original asking price is a bit high, but the game is definitely worth checking out on a sale.

my feelings for this game are kinda mixed, although the game is simply cute and works how you expect it to work, it didn't really give that satisfying vibe i was hoping for. sometimes there were so many things to put away and not enough space to do that nicely. overall i did enjoy it, but it just wasn't as nice as i hoped it to be and i'm not sure if it is worth the money (eventhough i got it in a sale)

I've known about this game since it came out and finally decided to play it. I was in the mood for a relaxing game. It's not at all what I expected. It's more than just decorating rooms, it tells a story. It's a very sweet little indie game with nice music. I did get stumped a couple times as some items have specific places they need to be, but despite that I still loved the game. I would highly recommend this game. I was unsure of how replayable it would be, but I can see myself coming back to this game multiple times.

This game was just what the doctor ordered. ADHD friendly, music was relaxing, colors aesthetically pleasing, it just had enough challenges to unravel. The story line was heartfelt- could have had more chapters.

If you're looking for a "palate cleanse" - like you just finished a heavy, lengthy, or difficult game and want to take a break, then Unpacking is perfect. It takes roughly 1-2 hours to complete the whole thing, but depending on how you, erm, arrange things, your game time may vary.

The game is simple, you have to unpack things and arrange your space.

There's a story (yes!) to, erm, unpack, as you play the game.

It's also fun to watch other people how they arrange things - it will tell a lot about their personality. Try making your partner play this while you watch lol.

This is a short game, so getting it on sale is much better as you might end up playing 2-4 hours if you are also going back for achievements. Cute, relaxing, easy to play, and so easy to run that you could have a total potato and still play!

i remember seeing a clip of this game on social media and really liked it. I was really happy when I was able to get it. I like the organization type games like this. Aside from the organization aspect, it a really nice back story to it and to be able to see the growth and progression through each year is really cool. I always have fun when I play this game and is a nice way for me to wind down and relax.
It's very relaxing with the background music, there's a lot of lore if you look closely at the items you unpack. It's over all a really cute and fun puzzle game.

O jogo é legal e muito lindo, mas é minúsculo :( 
Dava para ter mais jogo, acrescentar mais quartos/cômodos e até mesmo mais famílias com gostos diferentes de estilos para decorar. 
Joguei tudo em 4 horas (jogando bem tranquila, fazendo umas pequenas pausas e sem pressa), depois que acabou joguei mais um pouco tentando mudar a organização das coisas mas acaba que não tem nada para fazer... Enfim, tomara que algum dia acrescentem mais coisas porque eu amei <3

Such a cute little game!

My disappointment was that it was quite short, I did not want it to stop.  The graphics were cute and pixel in style, but added to the charm.

The bulk of this game is easy, relaxing clicking around, perfect for when you want something therapeutic and requiring barely any brainpower.  There are a couple of tricky bits to keep it interesting.

Most of the hidden objectives were obvious when you knew what they were.

Definitely worth a play.

I enjoy organising and the "what goes where" type of puzzle so this game was very relaxing to me.
Ended up going between years to try and figure out how this person's life changed as they moved around.
Objects can be used in different ways sometimes, which is fun to figure out.
Really enjoyed this game.

几个小时就通关了，原本我以为这只是按照自己喜好随意摆放物品的收简单收纳小游戏，后面才发现还要摆放的合理，刚开始我费了不少时间找最后几个放不进去的东西，印象比较深刻的就是在女主和男友同居时最后的奖状我死活也找不到放哪里，还是后来看评论才知道要塞床底下，我很喜欢这里面摆放物品的音效，而且画面很细致，而且真的很细节，女主看起来是一名画家，她的绘画工具从简单的绘图板和彩笔到数位板，后面看起来还画了自己的绘本，她的卫生间常备药品还有一盒治疗脊椎疼的药物。我觉得这个游戏很好玩，适合消遣时间，我还想玩更多的剧情！！
Calming and collecting the stickers is so fun. I love the style and played this for hours, then again. Would recommend as a shining example to support indie games!

Not only does game make the overwhelming task of unpacking less daunting both virtually and in real life, its story is told so minimally yet makes you just as invested as if it were spelled out for you. Yes, it's really short (I hope the devs are interested in making more Unpacking content for this character or a new one some time in the future!) but the price is well worth supporting an indie game by fellow Australians with explicitly (*SPOILERS!*) female and queer (sapphic) representation.

This is such a cute game. I personally have replayed multiple times and although it doesn't change, there are multiple ways to arrange things so it feels replayable to me. Also the story is so subtle but so cute.

Cozy little game with great music, some neat environmental storytelling as you progress through the years and a few cute eastereggs.

Takes about 3 to 4 hours to complete.

Its a cute game. If you like organising, I would reccomend it. It is also very relaxing after a hard work day. But don't get it full price. Wait for a discount, because there is not a lot of hours in this game.
It's a cute and casual game that's good to pass the time. It seemed like a very quick game, however. It's not something I have strong feelings about either way. Overall, I'd recommend it.

The game is super short, there is not enough content for this much of a price. You can finish this game in 1,5h or even less if you are a quick player. Really hoped for more levels tbh. I should have made more research before wasting my money on it.

Its good but VERY short. I love the amazing attention to detail. Nice and relaxing, no timers or anything. Graphics are really nice, I enjoy the style. A game for any age. I would like to see maybe two or three more stories. In just a few short hours I not only finished the story twice but also got all the stickers (achievements) in the game and I'm not some sort of speed runner or completionist. I took my time and still feel like I blew through it. Guess Id rate a 7.5-8/10.

This game is visually incredible and the pixelated style is perfect for the relaxed and cozy vibe. The story isn't super in your face, but it's still surprisingly impactful considering that the gameplay is just placing items. You learn so much about the character, their circumstances, and their relationships. 

HIghly recommend this game for anyone looking for a quick, relaxing, and low commitment game!
Jeu vraiment mimi, mais je penser le finir en un peu plus longtemps quand même.. 3 heures de jeu et vous l'avez terminée acheter le sur Instant Gaming au moins il serra moins chere..

I really enjoyed this far better than unpacking in real life, (*stares at still packed boxes hidden in the corner, and tries to forget they exist yet again until I need something from them*) and without the hassle of the packing itself. Jogo incrível com uma linguagem não-verbal muito expressiva, e um jeito de contar a história de forma totalmente original, além de gameplay muito relaxante. É a terceira vez que jogo isso e nunca consigo me enjoar, amo demais.

A really stupidly cute game about unpacking boxes. Very simple, not difficult mechanically, but I love it to bits.

A surprising amount of story is conveyed throughout the contents of said boxes; stuffed animals are a constant, and a collection of small stuffed chicklets are collected through out the story. A mug that is constantly used for toothbrushes until it is replaced. A DND figure who is unpainted until later. It's also fun to follow both the consistent items and the ones that get added each year.

I won't spoil too much with regards to the story, and I think its really fun to imagine the conversation that are going on between the character that we follow through the story and the people that we are sharing these spaces with.

I highly recommend this game. I'm not totally sure that I would buy at full price, what with the amount of content in the game, but even a small discount would be a prefect opportunity to buy this.

10/10, would be hit in the feels by a red outline again.

I just played this game and it was fun and peaceful playing but the game in my opinion isn't long enough. I would like to see more puzzles and areas. In my opinion this game isn't worth 10$. This is one of the games I come back to over and over and over again. I find myself looking for similar games frequently, just to try to capture the feelings that this game gave me the first ever time i played it. There are so many different ways to set up your characters house that let you create your own story as the protagonist. Did you know you can put the plates in the kitchen drawers? Very fun pixel styled game with chill vibes. There is no time limit with completing this game. So, you can go with your own pace. This game is absolutely adorable. It’s a very cute unpacking game. It’s very relaxing to play again and again. The music is very calming as well. I just wish there was more to it, other than that.
I highly recommend playing it.

I have been playing this game for long enough to know its entertaining, it may not be easy to find the correct places to put items thought its still fun. You get to unpack and decorate a girls house/room throughout her life. It has her move into a guys house, and having a baby. (i know those two events based on just having to unpack)

Honestly one of my favourite games ever. Biggest qualm? Too short. Almost 4 hours it took me to finish the entire game, achievements and all. The story is good, the design is cute, the concept is cool, I love it. I would recommend it to anyone willing to listen but chances are it's good for people who like not too difficult, sweet, and slight story games as it's not too story heavy and you don't have to acknowledge it. Would love for this game to be longer or for there to be more achievements to finish but other than that, I love this game so much.

i feel kinda scammed, only 8 levels, and i completed it in a day. ive heard many people talk about this game so i assumed there would be more to it, maybe more stories than just one, or maybe the story going on until they're old. glad i got it for 50% off and not the full 20$ but i still feel like i wasted my money

建议买cdk，就算打折性价比也不是很划算。

一个整理搬家后房间的游戏，“家”的每次整理都代表着屋主又进入了一个新的人生阶段，小小的房间也见证了屋主每一个温馨愉悦的时刻。通关后在制作名单中也会提到这个游戏另一个背景——[spoiler] 致敬作者的祖母 [/spoiler]。这个作品所带来的精神价值远大于娱乐价值，整理房间的时候真的是一种很放松的过程，当房屋变得整洁的时候心理也会很舒适。当然仅限于偶尔，天天做这种量的家务肯定要疯的（
全成就难度也不高，难点仅有2010年整理内衣内裤的那个成就，攻略大多都说不清，我也是自己挨个放才达成的，其余的成就难度都不高。
缺点也是存在的，开发商是欧洲那边的，所以很多物品的摆放与中国的观念有所不同，有些物品也看不明白到底是什么东西导致不知道该收纳到哪里，这点挺难受的，全整理完之后还要再挨个把错误的重新整理一遍。不过通关一次之后这个限制就消失了。你可以自己随意把东西放到你喜欢的位置，我觉得也蛮合理的，毕竟体会过作者想表达的才能再体会我们自己想要的。

I bought this game when it was on sale for around $11, and found that to be an appropriate price for a game of this length.
It's not very long with a total of I believe only 8 levels, and depending on how quickly you organise things, it can take as little as 1-2 hours. If you are going to buy this, I'd wait for a sale. I don't think it's worth 25 bucks (CAD).

I really enjoy the pixel art style, however, I found it difficult to identify some objects due to this. 
-I couldn't tell the laptop was a laptop while it was closed, which made finding it's spot very difficult.
-I couldn't tell cookie cutters apart from magnets at first.
-I still don't know what one of the electronics is supposed to be.
-Some of the small toys made it nearly impossible to tell they were supposed to be.

I have some nitpicks as well with how the mechanics are presented to you. Click to pick up, right click to rotate, right?
I missed nearly all the achievements due to not knowing you can interact with some of the objects, such as the [spoiler] wooden figure or rubixs cube, flushing the toilets, etc. [/spoiler]
I really wish there was an option to decide whether to stack books/games horizontally or vertically instead of dragging one everywhere until a spot decides that ok, you can stack them upright against it. Maybe.
Some of the "correct" spots are just obscure. In the first level, the backpack couldn't go near the door, on the bed, on a shelf, on the desk, under the desk, or in storage. I had to put it in one specific corner, on the floor. Same with the laundry basket in one of the later stages.
I didn't find it as calming as some others did, and ended up instead getting frustrated many times trying to find enough room for things. I'm sure there's a large demographic of people who found this meticulous and methodical placement calming, but that is not me.

I do find it a very cute game, with a sweet overarching story, but if you've got vision issues or shaky hands, this game will be difficult to navigate. I wish I could give a "sort of" recommendation for this game.

I didn't think I would enjoy so much a game about organizing and unpacking stuff. There are neat details that makes the experience even better. Soundtrack is good, sound effects are good, it's a good game that delivers the very thing the title tells you

Unpacking is an insanely cozy puzzle game, that guides you through the different life stages of your character. Your job is to unpack moving boxes and decorate your characters' space, which ranges from a single room to a whole house.
The game offers an incredibly relaxing atmosphere and together with its cute visuals, it draws you in.  I do love that the story itself is told only through the visuals and the music in the background - which is a genius way to do it, since the player gets to interpret their own feeling into it. The game absolutely nailed the feeling of having just moved and needing to figure out where to put all your stuff.
Sadly, I got to play through the whole story in a single sitting, lasting about 2.5 hours, and I really wish it were longer, especially for the price of 19.99€ it's too short and I definitely recommend purchasing it while it's on sale.

Been waiting for a while to get this game and it did not disappoint! I loved unpacking all the items and wondering what chapter are we in her life. I love how it's a new adventure every single time, and the ending is absolutely beautiful. 5/5 would recommend to play!

Such a cozy and addictive game! I love the pixel art. There's a lot of cute details, like items that keep showing up, and fun hidden achievements. There's also a subtle and interesting story playing out in the background, which invites you to infer things about the main character without ever explicitly stating them. Mechanically, I really like that the game lets you stack things and put stuff where it logically should go. You can put the toothbrush in a cup! That's cool! There are times when it seems like something should fit somewhere and the game won't let you place it, but that's a very minor concern for me. 

The ONLY negative thing I have to say about this game is that it is a little short for the price. I got it on sale which was perfect. I can see myself playing this game again later though. Since there's no one right way to unpack everything, it's not like a puzzle game that's not fun anymore after you know the solution. So I do recommend Unpacking if like me you like organizing, but wish there was some way to do it in a video game instead of cleaning your own house.

Retinal Pleasure or Art: Quite high quality pixel art. Honestly, I liked the design of the items. There is not much to say here. After all, the game's visuals are quite sufficient. The only thing I did not like was the design of the plush toys.

Mechanics: I cannot say much about this. You are basically opening boxes and arranging items neatly.

Atto Finale: In summary, the game is quite short but enjoyable. If you are looking for a pleasant game to spend 2-3 hours on, there is no reason not to play this game.

经历了一段时间一个人的生活，突然有一天我在箱子里发现了其他东西，绿色的植物，新的蒸笼，奇怪的手办模型，还有很多筷子。这下一起生活的是个女孩，想必她也是个恋旧的人吧，即便搬家连玩偶都带来了。终于有人给女主烧饭吃了。可以见得两个人的性格是很和谐的。

在最后两个女生终于有了两个人的屋子，非常大的两层。
玩偶小猪和小老虎在婴儿床上迎接新生命的到来，与开局形成了闭环。

如果你问我什么是幸福，我想这就是幸福。
大家都在追寻的幸福。
在这一刻，想要结婚的念头达到了顶峰。

但又有点悲伤，感觉好远。

One of my very favorite short games. Does what it says on the tin: You'll proceed through various levels, unpacking the protagonist's belongings and finding places for them in whatever room(s) the level entails. There are some rules within the game about where things can go - nothing left on the floor, for example - but within those guidelines, there is plenty of room to arrange as you see fit. Mechanics are simple and intuitive, and there are a handful of fun little interactive surprises throughout.

One of the more remarkable aspects of the game though is its masterful use of storytelling through gameplay. Without any dialogue or interaction, or even ever seeing the protagonist or any characters directly, by the end of the game, you'll feel like you know her - like she's an old friend you grew up with. And unless you're Professor Coldheart, you'll probably have some big feelings by the end of the game, too - I cried. It was just so good.

My only complaint is that I wish there were more. I'd play a dozen sequels, or any similar game with writing half as good. Please buy this game so the developers will make more like it. :D

[h1]Although short, it is a very relaxing and pleasant experience, especially when you need to procrastinate while having some unpacked boxes in your room.[/h1]

Unpacking is a cool little title about... yes, you got it buddy, unpacking boxes. Developed by Witch Beam and published by Humble Bundle, it is a nice, relaxing experience that’s easy to just jump into for half an hour after a long day. 

The game has plot and an interesting way of storytelling. Levels are divided in years in a photo album, which functions as the level select screen. The way you actually familiarize yourself with the character and what goes on in her life is by unpacking and putting her belongings where they, well, belong. You can see for example that she held on to one specific plushie for all these years. 
It's a pretty story, but mostly it serves as a background of the actual gameplay. 

And the gameplay is simple, but gratifying. You get stuff out of the box and find a suitable place for it in the room. You can’t just put stuff in random places though. Certain items must be hidden in a cupboard for example or maybe put on a table. This functions as a sort of a puzzle, as sometimes you have to carry items into different rooms even. The game starts from sorting out a single room, to an actual two-story house. Certain objects can be interacted with like a game console, microwave or the toilet which is always a nice little touch. 

The aesthetics are very nice, and it is always nice to see a reoccurring item during different years of the story as a little surprise - especially how creative and interesting they are. The game is colorful and has a very chill soundtrack that nicely complements the entire vibe. 

Although short, it is a very relaxing and pleasant experience, especially when you have some unpacked boxes in your room, and you want to procrastinate.
My only complaint would be the length of it as I was able to platinum this game in around 3 hours. Supporting custom levels would be cool I think.

I would definitely recommend this game if it were to have less unbelievably broken logic.
Most of the item placements are fine. But there are a couple that the game just wouldn't let you put anywhere seemingly spacious or logical. One of the chapters requires me to put a poster up, and there's literally no space on the main room's wall (nothing can be moved), and the game won't let me put it in other rooms where there's space. It took 5 minutes of frustrating spam clicking for me to finally be graced by the solution - the poster goes underneath the bed! Ha! Genius isn't it?! 
Item footprint is also very misleading. Some shelves have plenty of space, but the small item just won't go. Or it would auto-oriented to a weird angle that you don't want. There's this alarm clock thingy which is the worst offender, as it always wants to face away from the direction of viewing. And no, you can't adjust the orientation. It is locked for some reason, despite the visual shows much room for this thing to fit in however way it wants.
Some items do not have any distinguishing features (like those dozens of bottles) and it is very confusing to me what they are and where they belong. At the end of the day, I resort back to spamming clicks and see where they'd fit, so may have stuffed some hairspray next to bug killer. If every item has a short name that'd help a lot.
If you could stomach all of the above, then this is a relaxing fun game with very stylist touch, and I highly recommend it. Worst case you could spam through all levels.

对于喜欢收纳和整理的玩家来说这是一款好游戏，但是有一些无聊和乏味，在我心中不如“向左一点？”那款游戏，但是游戏的内容无疑是十分温馨的，至少在最后关闭游戏时我的内心是暖呼呼的，这就足够了。
其实从最开始收拾行李的时候会感到麻烦，就像是真实的生活一样，你得先挨个拿出来，找好地方，再走来走去把放错箱子的东西搬去另一个屋子，麻烦。但是玩久了对这些就有自己的心得了，什么东西大概在什么位置一眼就知道，不会再因为找不到正确位置而心烦。隔三差五打开一下收拾一年的行李还是很不错的，拉长游戏的流程，看着年份和行李物品的变化，还有不同的家的样子，短短的游戏的确能让人感觉到沉淀下来的人生的感觉。也许这就是这种游戏该有的节奏。

最后我很感触的两点是：
①有时我搬进了你的家，有时你搬进了我的家，有时我们一起带着我们的行李住进属于我们共同的家。那种感觉真的很幸福。我的意思是彼此奔赴，你的厨具我的餐具乱七八糟的东西融合在一起，努力磨合在一起生活，最终以幸福的年份结局真的很美好。
②有些细节是玩家细心才能感受到的，最后能在结尾的歌曲里也看见一些制作人的小提醒：原来我们和作者在为同样的生活小细节感动，我们在这些不起眼的小音符里共鸣，这真的很美好。对于玩家和作者来说这都是很棒的享受。

[b]Sights & Sounds[/b]
- The art direction is pretty nice. The pixel art rooms feel natural and lived in. I swear it looked one of my friend's kitchens was used as a reference for one of the levels
- Even though I completed this game less than a week ago, I couldn't remember any of the music until I looked it up on YouTube. I guess that means it's fine, but it didn't leave much of an impression

[b]Story & Vibes[/b]
- Unpacking is an interesting exercise in active environmental storytelling. It's interesting to see what possessions follow the main character through her lifetime. The locations you move into and what you unpack gradually reveal more background until you see the whole bittersweet view of the protagonists growth and development despite her never appearing on screen 
- This game can be an emotional experience, particularly for those that have moved around a lot during their lives. Going away to college, getting your first apartment, moving in with a romantic partner, moving away from that partner into a worse living situation, and finally getting your first real place with the love of your live are all emotional and poignant experiences. Unpacking does a good job of evoking the mixed emotions that accompany this major, but quotidian, life event

[b]Playability & Replayability[/b]
- As creative and thoughtful as the approach to the narrative was, the gameplay is a chore (quite literally). You open a box, place the possessions it contains in appropriate parts of the room. This basic gameplay loop is all you'll be doing
- Given that that's the case, I don't foresee a replay. One playthrough to appreciate the storytelling method is really all you'll need

[b]Overall Impressions & Performance[/b]
- I wish there had been just one or two twists on the gameplay loop to make the experience a little more fun. It's not a bad game by any means. It's just a bit tedious. I feel like I could have received half the game for half the price and enjoyed it twice as much
- This feels like a game for people who have settled into their lives. A younger player may still appreciate it, but I do suspect that the older crowd will be able to relate a bit better to the experience
- Ran well on the Steam Deck, but would probably have been easier to play with a mouse

[b]Final Verdict[/b]
- [b]6/10[/b]. Worth a shot if you want a chill playthough. The creative storytelling technique is at least worth checking out; I just wish there was a little more variety given the 5-ish hour run time

[h1]TLDR  8/10 [/h1]
I loved this game, I thought it was amazing and I had so much fun, but I'm left wanting more.  It's too short for the price, even on sale. It takes about 5 hours to finish, maybe more if you spend a long time sorting things. And with the £1/per hour rule the price does not add up. That being said it was an incredibly fun game with amazing story telling. It's really pretty and the soundtrack is lovely to listen to. It's so satisfying to put everything away/ I love the little achievements for putting things where they're not supposed to be, but again I wanted more! There's not even an achievement for getting the "dark star ending", which seems a little odd when they put enough effort into to make two endings. At the end of the day it gave me much dopamine so therefore I am happy. And hey the money goes to a small developer so I can't be too mad. 

[b] Buy if: [/b]
- You really like the concept and don't mind a shorter game.
- You like 100% achievements
- You love a queer little love story and DnD
- It's under £5

[b] Don't buy if: [/b]
- You want to get your money's worth for your time
- Your idea of fun is not putting things neatly away in little drawers

Had to stop halfway through to leave a review. 
The subtle design that forms the story of this game is brilliant. 
It feels much like a good book, despite there being almost no words or exposition. 
As you pull out another now-familiar object or something brand new and either put it in an empty space or work around a new roommates things - you truly get a sense of who this person is and how they are evolving. You have a sense of where they have been and of the new possibilities or pitfalls in their new location.

I personally find each time-period (marked mostly by the change is technology) very nostalgic and the character relatable.
 I love the art style too and the very calming gameplay loop. 

My only complaint is it was a little pricey for the hours-worth and probably a little too short. 
I'm not quite done but I already want a lot more. 
I want to put more things away and I also want to get to know other people via their changing stuff.
I feel like this game could become a (perhaps more affordable) series, and or be reworked to make modding possible because the potential for people to make new stories and their own items is vast.

Anyway great idea and follow through.  I wish I could buy it for a bunch of friends I think would enjoy it. 

TLDR
If it's on sale and you like a well done casual game, it's a no brainer.

Only 3 hours of game play for a $20 game. 

Yes, it's a good game. It was cozy and enjoyable. I liked unpacking the home and discovering the person's story along the way and throughout the years.  However, with only 3 hours of game time, I do not think that the game should be $20 as a regular price. Wait for the game to go on sale, then buy it. 

I did have one issue bug-wise with the game. For some reason, unless I had my AMD adrenaline up and running on the second screen the game would continue to drop FPS and sit at 13-30 fps. I changed multiple settings and tried many things but every time I took down adrenaline the game's FPS would majorly drop from 150 fps to 13-30. Not sure why the game was having those issues but I know that it wasn't my computer. I couldn't find anything about anyone else having these issues, so maybe it is just me lol. 

Overall, it is a good cute, and cozy organizational game. But only buy it on sale. $20 for 3 hours of game play feels like a waste of money to me.

I saw a few youtubers play this game and it looked sort of peaceful, just a relaxing game to boot up where it saves n' you can resume whenever. My little ADHD played this for 4 hours straight upon getting gifted it from a friend, let's just say it was very enjoyable. I love organizing things, fixing and making things look pretty the way I feel it should. It was fun randomly getting achievements as well from just clicking stuff or putting things in certain spots. (I completed it after 7 hours.)

Give it a try if you like organizing things, and I loved the storyline along the way. <3

Amazing game! Loved the satisfaction of placing objects in places that varies from large to small. Would play again when I have the extra 4 hours...I like how this has a story line that gives the game character into your brain because all I could think is 'what...happens...next..?' every new level how it goes from their childhood room to a 2 bedroom house with a baby-on-board. 10/10 love this. PLAY NOW!!!
It is a very nice relaxing game however, there are only 4 levels which makes it kinda disappointing was hoping for more levels other than 4.
A relaxing little puzzle game with an unexpectedly enjoyable story told just through the items you're organizing. The only issue is that it's pretty short, would love for more games to come out.
Adorable game that has kept me company while I'm home sick. The music is lovely and I have enjoyed finding so many little details scattered throughout the levels. This game gives me joy.

Instantly fell in love with the first chapter, very cute and relaxing. From the second chapter forward it gets more challenging and stressful, and very realistically so. Definitely encouraged my minimalist tendencies... Anyway this is beautifully made and very atmospheric, can recommend to puzzle enjoyers but don't expect it to be super relaxing all the way, there is a lot to unpack.

休闲整理游戏，一次性打完可能会有点审美疲劳，更适合多次游玩。
体量不大，流程大概4小时，20左右的价格相对更加适合入手。

:D Overall a great journey
实话说对这个玩法完全没有兴趣ahahaha，但是游戏本身很完整地把自己想要讲的故事给讲了。
看游戏内容就知道做起来非常费力，加油啊，很喜欢你们讲故事的方式。

人の引っ越し手伝ってるみたいで楽しかったです。4時間くらいでクリアかな？
変なところのダンボールから変なものが出てきたり、引っ越し直前って急いで詰め込んでて変なところに入れちゃうよなーという引っ越しあるあるを感じます。最近引っ越し経験した人にとくにおすすめ。
海外ゲームなのでコレ何？というものがあり、正解の置き場所に結構困ります。いろんなところに置いてみて気合いでクリアしましょう！

The first time I played this game I gave up in the first stages, but this time I finally completed the storyline! It's very interesting to know about a person from the things in their house and how they phase through life as time passes. Recommended! Especially now as it's on sale.

Jogo extremamente relaxante, já joguei varias vezes e sempre volto a jogar quando sinto saudades. Poderiam adicionar mais histórias ao jogo. Recomendo para quem gosta de organizar as coisas ou que acha satisfatório ver tudo organizado (da sua maneira)

Esse jogo é simplesmente perfeito. Você não cansa de jogar e o jeito que a história é mostrada e bem sutil, onde cada decoração do jogo conta uma parte da vida da personagem deixando o a história para a interpretação de cada um. E sim eu chorei com o final por que ele é PERFEITO!

I enjoyed the game a lot. Loved the little details that tell a story. I got it from the Humble Bundle and I still would recommend to get it on sale, nothing against the game itself but truly short of a game so I would say $10 or less is worth it.

PS I'll have to say though, this comes from someone that has no idea how much it costs to make a game so... lol

I 100% completed this in one sitting and was moved by the story throughout. With subtle hints of heartbreak and finding oneself I was honestly not expecting to shed a tear as the credits rolled yet here we are. The gameplay was fantastic for my ADHD brain and I loved placing items throughout each level. I want more games like this and hope they have more coming. An incredibly simple way to tell a few story. Bravo. Truly.
This game is so relaxing with its music and overall vibe. It tells a story without any words and is just the best game for a cozy gamer.

Simple concept - you have boxes full of things and you need to unpack them. Simple. But it's not like you can put toaster in bathtub and call it a day. Things that you expect to be in kitchen need to be in kitchen. You can put a cookie jar on the top shelf or diary under the pillow. If you think it can go there, in most cases it can.

The story is told from environment. Each chapter is a diffrent year from someones life, and you can see and guess what happens to them by simple putting their things in rooms.

Es hat mir sehr gut gefallen. 
Das Spiel ist zwar Kurz aber genau so lang wie es sein sollte. 
Man bekommt mehr als nur ein 0815 Puzzlegame, sondern auch ein super Story.  

Ich bin unglaublich überrascht wie gut die Story im Hintergrund sich entwickelt und auch ohne viele Worte für jeden Klar wird. Wie Gegenstände im Alltag kommen und gehen. Wie kleine Dinge die uns wichtig sind bis zum Schluss begleiten. Wie uns Mensch in unsere Art zu leben Prägen. Wie sehr der eigene Lebensraum zum Spiegel der eigen Persönlichkeit wird. Und wie Privat die Einblicke in einen Fremden Zuhause werden könne.

Unpacking is a fun and cozy game that will hit you in the feels. You unpack and arrange a person's belongings throughout several moves and stages of their life. 


Positives:

Intuitive controls
The music, sound effects, and art work are all great
There is a story hidden in the objects and how they change over time
Understanding the story hints at where some objects should be placed
There are extra items you can interact with for hidden achievements
Nostalgic!

Negatives
Too short! Buy it when it goes on sale.

I absolutely love this game. It's very relaxing to put the cute items just so, the music is wonderful, and it is a perfect example of "show, don't tell."

I had originally thought this game would be over after a run-through, with maybe one more run-through to collect achievements, but even after completing all achievements and both the base and dark star modes, I still find myself going back just for the beauty of the art and story. So many small details about character growth, personality, and feelings and the progression of time (in, for example, the aging of items, the adding of items, and when old items are no longer there) are conveyed in mere pixels, making for new discoveries every time, even after the 8-or-so replays that I've done so far. The story gives back more every deeper thought you spare it, and you can spend hours getting lost in the story told by what physical things travel with the protagonist each move. 

There is no rush - no time limit, or even an incentive to go quickly - and the sound design is both pleasant and mood-setting. You can really enjoy looking into details and placing items in the most satisfying order, with a 8-bit-style soundtrack that has lulls between loops that allow you to hear the subtle scene-setting of appliances humming, birds singing, or rain pattering. Items themselves also make noise when you interact with them, and it's very satisfying to hear the thump of a book being set down or a lamp being switched on.

Though there is a "right" way to put items away, there's an option to disable that need, which allows you to leave things exactly where you want them and continue as you please (you just won't get a star of completion for that run). This allows for both those coming to solve the game like a puzzle and those just wishing to set up their perfect scene (or leave a mess) to have fun and enjoy the game.

In summary, I highly recommend experiencing the story of Unpacking for yourself.

When I first heard about Unpacking, it didn't really sound like something I was interested in. You just unpack boxes, and that's it? Indeed, many of the negative reviews here discuss how they find the game boring. Still, I decided to give it a try because I liked the game's aesthetic and I had heard the music was good. As I played Unpacking, I quickly found myself engrossed in the game's world. Admittedly, there isn't much of a story here, really, but as I played more I became more and more excited to discover what was in store with each new box to unpack. Unpacking (the activity, not the game) is an intimate process, and you really get to understand this character's interests and personality through the items that they own. This is especially true as each of the game's levels fast-forwards several years, to the next time that the character has moved into a new home. Certain items will stick around through every single level while others will become lost to time as the character grows up.

Unpacking is a meditative game that wants players to think introspectively about their own experiences with moving and holding onto cherished items. I found the game to be melancholic and thought-provoking, much more than I had expected when I first heard about it. I would reminisce about times in the past when I had to move as my life either improved or worsened, and I thought about the things I chose to take with me through every move, and others that were abandoned somewhere along the way. The story is light, but if you are able to connect with the situations that the main character finds themself in, Unpacking can be deeply impactful.

The game's puzzle elements were more prominent than I expected, also; true, it's no Portal, but I found it fun to figure out how I was ever going to fit all my clothes into a tiny closet, for instance. Players are free to organize as much as they want, and it is rewarding to figure out an ideal setup to put every dish on the same shelf, almost like when you match up the perfect blocks in Tetris. Still, there are a couple of minor issues that I encountered as I played. Sometimes I would place an item in what I thought was a good location, but the game would stop me from progressing because I put the item in "the wrong spot". Unpacking will tell you which item is incorrect, but it doesn't specify why, so it can be occasionally frustrating to figure out why you can't place items where they were. Still, this was never too big of an issue, and if the player wants to there is a setting to turn this feature off so any item can be placed in any location. I enjoyed the challenge more often than it frustrated me so I kept this setting on, but it's nice to know there's options for players wanting a truly zen experience. The other issue worth mentioning is the game's length. It is short, and I really found myself wanting more as I reached the last level. There's worse problems to have, of course, but it is worth noting. I got this game in a humble bundle so it was very cheap, but it is something to be aware of.

Still, I connected with Unpacking in a very deep, intimate way, and I feel that this game will resonate strongly with anyone who feels emotionally connected to the things we own that shape our lives. I'm so happy I gave Unpacking a chance, and it's a game I wish I could play again for the first time.
