Unpacking is a delightful and meditative indie game that takes players on an introspective journey through the seemingly mundane yet profoundly meaningful act of unpacking. Developed by Witch Beam, this minimalist puzzle game transcends traditional gaming boundaries, offering a unique and emotionally resonant experience.

The game's premise is deceptively simple: players are tasked with unpacking boxes and arranging the contents in various rooms throughout different stages of life. What sets Unpacking apart is its masterful execution of storytelling without words. Each item unpacked carries sentimental value, unlocking memories and moments in the protagonist's life. The lack of explicit narrative allows players to project their own stories onto the unfolding scenes, fostering a deeply personal connection.

Visually, Unpacking is a triumph of pixel art and attention to detail. Every object, from childhood toys to office supplies, is meticulously designed, contributing to the overall charm of the game. The environments evolve along with the character, mirroring the stages of life from a childhood bedroom to a bustling city apartment. The transitions are seamless and evocative, creating an emotional tapestry that resonates with players on a visceral level.

The sound design in Unpacking is another standout feature. The subtle, ambient sounds of unpacking and arranging items, coupled with a soothing soundtrack, enhance the game's tranquil atmosphere. The auditory experience complements the visual storytelling, immersing players in a contemplative space that encourages reflection.

Unpacking's puzzles are intuitive and contribute to the narrative flow. As players progress through the game, they uncover new layers of the character's life story, making each unpacking session feel like a discovery of both the physical and emotional aspects of the protagonist's journey. The puzzles strike a balance between accessibility and challenge, ensuring players of all skill levels can enjoy the experience.

One of Unpacking's greatest achievements is its ability to elicit a range of emotions without relying on traditional gaming elements. The game succeeds in capturing the beauty of life's ordinary moments, celebrating the significance of small details often overlooked. Unpacking is not just a game; it's a work of art that invites players to reflect on their own lives and the cherished memories embedded in the everyday objects that surround them.

In conclusion, Unpacking is a masterclass in storytelling through gameplay, proving that a simple premise can yield profound emotional impact. It's a must-play for those seeking a unique and contemplative gaming experience that transcends the boundaries of traditional genres. With its mesmerizing visuals, evocative soundscapes, and poignant storytelling, Unpacking stands as a testament to the artistry that can be achieved in the world of indie gaming. Achievements can be completed within 7 hours of gameplay.

断断续续玩了几周一周目全成就拿下，这个游戏全成就还是很好拿的，流程走完一遍也用不了多久。

首先讲一讲游戏的优点。正如很多玩家讲得那样，游戏没有过多的文字描述，仅仅通过时间线的变化、房间布置与物件的改变，就向我们展示了一位女生的成长经历：从小时候拥挤的卧室开始，到读大学、有了男友、分手搬走、结识新伴侣、有了宝宝，有些物品有了又丢掉，有些东西主角会一直留着：比如粉色的毛绒玩偶小猪、比萨斜塔的小摆件……导致每次进入新关卡的时候我都会迫不及待地去寻找那只毛绒玩具，找到后便会会心一笑地将它摆在床上，小时候的东西能留到现在，也好。

但是，游戏的毛病也是很显眼的。首先囿于画风与年代的限制，有些东西很难分辨出它是什么，应该放在哪里；加之游戏里有些地方箱子开出来的是其他地方的东西，导致很多玩家到最后只能拿着最后几个东西满房间跑着试应该放在哪里；其次游戏里的摆放位置有限，已有的很多东西是挪不了窝的，而且制作组可能是怕玩家把东西一股脑全堆地上，所以供你摆放的位置其实有限，在有限的空间内完成摆放很考验技巧，对于喜欢整齐摆放的玩家带点折磨；

最令我觉得诟病的是，游戏规定有些东西只能放在某些地方——我就一身反骨喜欢把面包机放水槽怎么了？（这好像还是个成就）对于不同人来说有不同的习惯：有些人喜欢枕头下放书，有些人喜欢衣服扔椅子上……有些人说这游戏可以凭喜好自行装饰房间，这不扯淡呢吗，我有一朋友还喜欢厕所放书看呢，这游戏也不能把书放厕所啊。

游戏里的乐子：有个瑜伽垫每次安放的位置都是床底下，这让我想起了好多人家里的瑜伽垫，最终都成了吃灰的玩意，每次到放瑜伽垫的时候我都觉得乐；不知道东西放哪，直接全塞进柜子得了。

写在最后：游戏流程很短短，一周目3-5h左右；白金成就好拿，一周目可拿完；原价70显然不值得，史低可以考虑。

（借用我老妹巴托里·伊丽莎白·瓦伦丁·井上早苗·山吹兰镜的话说：“原价70入手还不如去买现在66的少女理论以及周边呢，不玩少女理论的二刺猿只会度过一个相对失败的人生。”）

Unpacking is not your typical style of game.

Yes, there is gameplay with challenges to overcome and rewards for utilizing the game's systems, but if you sit down and play this game with only the intention to finish it/beat it; you're going to find it disappointing.

Unpacking is two styles of games in one: 
On the one hand, it's a subversive story telling game where you get to experience a persons' life, with it's ups, downs, and surprises, through moving them from place to place over the years.
On the other hand, it's a game where you get to express yourself by organizing a given set of objects in a given environment.

So, if you're the type of person that doesn't derive pleasure from organization, you'll likely blast through this game in a few hours and feel pretty disappointed.  If you enjoy turning a space into something special for yourself, then you have a huge variety of objects and locations to choose from to fulfill your organizational itch.

Unpacking is a very cute and relaxing game. It can have an added bonus of nostalgia for players born in the late 80's and early 90's. From first glance, it might not appear to have a direct story -- you're just opening boxes, removing items, and placing them on shelves or in drawers. However, it is so much deeper than this. As a touchstone, each level is based on a year of the main character's life; after completing a level, the game presents a journal page with a photo of your work and a text entry reflecting that place in time ~ 
[spoiler] having your own room for the first time or enjoying movie night with your new roommates [/spoiler].  
Each level has the items you unpack change-- increasing in number; it's also interesting to notice what is left behind in the previous level-- a stuffed animal, an old monitor, various books. The missing items allude to the character's growth. However, what stays with the character from each "move" to the next grips at nostalgia-- the designers of Unpacking show the wear on things over the years. A small example without much spoiling--- the mousepad is fresh during its first unpacking; the next time, years later, you can see the wear from dragging the mouse across it day after day. I had a double take when I noticed it and realized this game was made with so much love.

Each item has a story-- the main character [spoiler] travels across the globe as she acquires a new souvenir each move. [/spoiler]  [spoiler] She develops from spending time with her roommates -- one of them is an insect enthusiast and has a few pet beetles-- the main character has her own beetle in the next move. [/spoiler] Heck, The main character has had the same plastic spatula each year [spoiler] and her poor, but trusty toothbrush cup is a chipped drinking cup from when she went to college. [/spoiler]. Story is presented in a small 4-wall breaking way as well-- some items need to be in certain places before the level completes, which adds to a narrative [spoiler] when the main character moves back in with her parents, as you hang up her postcards and photos on the corkboard, you might miss that the photo of her boyfriend and her has the tack right over his face (next spoiler explains solution) [/spoiler] [spoiler] You might then need to clear out the small cabinet, rearranging everything you stored in there, to make some room to store this photo in there. I initially thought the game wanted me to place the photo in the trash--- but no, the main character is holding onto the memory, but putting it out of sight. [/spoiler] This feels completely real-- unpacking, having second thoughts about an item (or unpacking a later box and finding something you thought you had misplaced) and then needing further re-arrange things. The books and DVDs always get me-- "There's plenty of room on this shelf... oh, she got some new DVDs and the next novel in that series... maybe the lower shelf will have enough room, but I need to move that thing." 

By the way, despite the low-res styling of the game, there is incredible detail in the books and DVDs, you can make out a few of the designs based on the originals [spoiler] The Eragon Series, Donny Darko, Simpsons Hit and Run, to name a few[/spoiler]. 
One last note on the detailing and concept of "spacial-societal awareness" [spoiler] when the main character moves in with her roommates, the rooms are already filled with objects from their lives. You need to add your items among the mix, but can't move anything of theirs (which makes sense). [/spoiler] [spoiler] Later, when you move in with your boyfriend, the are objects present, but you CAN move them, as the couple is meant to share the space-- and you have to "tidy" some things to ensure your items will fit and have their own spot [/spoiler] I had a wry smile when I encountered these new "game mechanics" and understood how they so cleverly reflect human interaction.

The music cannot be ignored in this review. It is a medley of soothing, yet energetic synth and acoustic. I might have been incredibly lucky, but I'd like to imagine the music also changed as I unpacked specific things. [spoiler] I unpacked the piggy stuffed animal in the roommates' house and the music had a "sad" riff at that moment, as if to usher in a feeling of nostalgia and ennui for the days gone by. [/spoiler] 
Wonderful designwork in every aspect.and outside of the gameplay itself, there is a photo mode that I haven't messed around with too much, but I know there are a lot of possibilities there to show off your unpacking work; and after each level, you can watch or export a quick .gif of your playback from that level-- I've enjoyed re-watching my unpacking, switching to different rooms as I encounter a kitchen item in the bedroom, or moving all the books from one shelf to another, or wondering why I temporarily put an item on the bed before finally moving it into place after everything else was settled. It's a lovely feature.

I've mentioned nostalgia a lot in this review-- I am a sucker for it-- and it paints my opinions of this game. This is both related and unrelated, but I played "Gone Home" for the first time at the beginning of this year, and greatly enjoyed it (you can see my review) despite influence of negative reviews and the misleading game description. Unpacking doesn't have any of these problems, but I get a similar vibe from both-- growing up in the 90's and story-telling from object interaction/design-- even the music feels very familiar between the two (I checked that the composers are different). While Gone Home does have a direct story-- you only get it in-full from interacting with the objects in the home. Unpacking tells a story through its objects as well, but requires a little interpretation beneath the surface, of which there is great depth. I find it very interesting and poignant that I started and ended 2023 with these two titles and can only hope to find future games with as much consideration and love put into them.

Long story short, I highly recommend Unpacking and think its a near-perfect casual "puzzle-lite" game that makes me wish unpacking in real-life was as easy and charming as this game is.

Really enjoyable game the whole way through, each level gives you more room to be creative with your organization and is more fun than the last. Seems like the kind of game I'll be able to come back to in a year and play through again.

Some items can give you a lot of trouble with placing them in the correct spot, it's not very clear where the right place is and they sometimes might not look all that great in the specific place they have to be. Don't really have any other complaints.

Also there's a board game in the game that has the same name as my username, which gave me whiplash like nothing ever has before.

8/10

Really cute n cozy game def recommend.

Absolutely loved organizing everything and unpacking this sweet little story but... 
I just wish there was more!
9/10
Got it in a humble bundle, was a fun and calm few hours but I wouldn't pay full price for it. Still not bad if you get it really cheap and just want to zone out for a bit.

Cute, comfy, short, sweet.

These are the adjectives I'd use for Unpacking. I loved my short time with this game.

Audio:
The sound effects are EXTREMELY satisfying. You can really feel when you place an item down. Every item has a different sound depending on where you place it, and I loved it. The music was also great for setting the atmosphere, the only thing I would say is that there would be periods where the music stopped looping and there was just silence. I think this is fine as the silence is nice once in a while, but I would have preferred the music looped with shorter silence between tracks/loops.

Game-play: You unpack into new rooms and living spaces. It's comfy and satisfying. I was only left wishing I would rotate some items more than I was able to. Other than that it was flawless and again satisfying.

Over all: great game. I started playing because I was stressed and this certainly helped while telling a very nice cute story. Would recommend to anyone looking for a short and sweet game you can get lost in, blink, and it's suddenly over.

Prós:

- não tem tutorial pois é intuitivo, e isso faz a sua experiência ficar ainda melhor.

Contras:
- o jogo tem uma baixíssima duração. Por conta disso, acaba sendo caro. Pois basicamente não há replay e só tem a história de uma família. 
- como não tem tutorial, tem alguns itens que não são daquele cômodo e vc nao pode deixar nele, tem que colocar no cômodo certo e isso acabou me gerando impaciência, pq as vezes eu nem sabia direito qual era a função do item pra definir pra onde ele iria.

Conclusão:
- é legal sim, porém é caro pelas horas de jogo, então vale a pena se for na promoção.

I knew I’d love this game before I ever started playing it. I didn’t read into it much before purchasing, so it was a little different to how I imagined. I wasn’t expecting a cute, moving story to follow along with or that it would cleverly take you along the life journey without you ever having to read anything. You can figure out everything yourself since the controls are so simple, which is a big relief for someone like me who reads constantly for work every day. Despite the story being so short, there’s replay value in having to come back to collect the rest of the stickers/achievements and it feels very complete, though I do wish it had been filled out a little bit more, maybe with a choice of swatches occasionally or story pathways you could take that made the contents of the boxes slightly different (it could even just be from placing something in a specific place or interacting with something that triggered a different path). I also kinda wish there’d be more interactivity options with some of the environments, especially early on when you can’t move other people's things around. Just having the choice to either do the washing up or not or to turn the tap on when you click it would have really added something. The pixel graphics are both beautiful and nostalgic. Back when I was a kid, I used to play this game called I Live At Santa’s House (1997), and playing Unpacking was taking me back to playing that a little. At least this game doesn’t say ‘uh-uh’ whenever you click something you can’t do anything with. I would very much appreciate a sequel or an expansion, and would play every single follow up of this released. A cute, fun, and relaxing game that I would like to find a way to waste more hours of my life on.

Unpacking is a serene and emotionally resonant game that turns the act of unpacking into a captivating narrative journey. With its minimalist art style, calming soundtrack, and puzzle-like organization mechanics, it creates a unique and introspective gaming experience. Unpacking stands out as a masterclass in storytelling through simplicity, leaving a lasting impact by inviting players to reflect on the significance of each unpacked item.

A very relaxing game where each room is exquisitely designed, creating a strong sense of life. Players experience the lifestyle changes of the character throughout the years by organizing rooms from different periods of her life.

I liked this game. I like the pixelated art style, and the retro music added a nice touch. It is very story-driven, and it is amazing that the story can be told and understood with almost no dialogue. However, there are only 8 levels and the game gets a bit repetitive, so it isn't really worth twenty dollars. If the game is one sale for less than ten dollars or so, you should buy it. A sequel would be nice, especially if it had more levels, and if the price was more reasonable you should get it.

This is a heartwarming game of following a life from childhood to adulthood that you learn by unpacking after every move. This game made me feel things. Happiness, sadness, and frustration as to how this person organizes given how different it is from me. The pixel art style shines here, along with the soundtrack, however I can;t say I recommend it at its current price point of $20, not after beating it at ~3.5 hours. I'd say this is worth more than my usual cheap $.50/hr, maybe $1-2/hr, but that is kinda pushing it given the limited replay value. There are multiple save files to allow you to organize differently, but there's only so many ways you can store shirts. I likely won't replay unless content gets added. This is a game I would buy on sale, but I also feel disappointed in saying that. Maybe that's another emotion the game is making me feel.

A very chill and wholesome game, 100% it within 5 hours. Some of the Achievements have very funny names, I love this little game, would recommend it to anyone that mindless wants to be distracted for a while!

I enjoyed this game so much! The details in the art and objects added so much to my experience! I found myself just so immersed in the storyline and I loved all the different achievements you could get. A nicely short and sweet game about unpacking the belongings of your character, learning more about them and their life with each item you put away and arrange in the room. It's heartwarming and made me feel some emotions about growing up and adulthood. Definitely recommend getting this on a sale!

Listen. I've been hearing about how great this game is since forever, it feels like, but knowing it was very short I waited until I could get it for cheap (which turned out to be a very discounted month of humble choice). I do recommend Unpacking, but as a woman pushing 50, I was like "uh, so where's the rest of the game"? Like so much media about women, the story ends way too freakin early. A woman's story doesn't end when she gets preggo, folks. Probably this game is autobiographical and the devs aren't my age yet. I wonder if this game will get a sequel when they figure out life goes on. 

Look, it's cute but i have been wanting to play it and seeing the hype for so long, my expectations were sky high, so I can't say I love Unpacking as much as I wanted and expected to. While I used to love rearranging my possessions and furniture when I was younger, these days I have no energy or motivation to do so and apparently that transfers over into the gaming space. If you're into arranging things just right, you'll probably get an extra hour out of the game than I did. If you're really creative I bet you can have tons of fun trying to put things where they don't belong. And if you're an achievement hunter you'll need a walkthrough or several playthroughs, because I was pretty thorough and only got to 56%. One day I'll come back to this and get all the achievements, probably. But right now I'm just a bit bitter about the incompleteness of this woman's life. I'm glad she's happy right now, but what's next? Where's the empty nest, downsizing and nursing home? I'd take a DLC.

[h1] Life Viewed Through a Box [/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]: 9/10 - 40% (Weight in Final Score)
The gamplay is quite simple. Open new box, empty said box, throw away said box. What makes the game special is the items you pull out of the boxes and how you create the space around you. These items tell a story but not as cut and dry as reading a book. Instead YOU get to create the story through how you portray the environment. You start as a young girl and you get to see her grow and who she becomes. I've never played a game like this and although simple mechanically it was quite enjoyable to play through and just have a nice vibe.

[b]Graphics[/b]: 9/10 - 15%
Honestly the graphics aren't anything innovative or "next-gen". It is a pretty game however and the level of detail in the environment is what tells the story so for that I gave some bonus points

[b]Audio[/b]: 8/10 - 15%
I enjoyed the music throughout the game however there was a one soundtrack that I just didn't enjoy too much. The audio details of the environment are fun too like dropping something on a metal surface vs the counter ect. I will say though I've never had a toilet flush for so long.

[b]Bugs/Playability[/b] 10/10 - 30%
Game had no problems performance wise and no bugs that I encountered either!

[h3]Overall Score: 9.2/10[/h3] 

[h1]Achievements Review:[/h1]

[b]Difficulty[/b]: 10/10 - 40%
I didn't find any of the achievments difficult, there is no "skill" value associated with the achievments. Just sit back and collect baby.

[b]The Grind[/b]: 10/10 - 40%
As above the achievements were easy to obtain only took 4 hours, no achievment took more than a few item movements. I did have to go back to every level to flush a toilet and  that is as far is it gets.

[b]Variety[/b]: 6/10 - 20%
I do wish that the game took advantage of the "hard" mode. While going through the discussions I saw there was a hard mode that you could complete with more strict conditions for placing items in the house but there was no achievement associated with it so I didn't complete it prior to the review. I wish that they added another achievement to show off that you are the "better" unpacker but maybe I'm asking too much lol.

[h3]Achievement Score: 9.2/10[/h3]

I am currently going through my extensive steam library and playing games to 100% completion. I'm doing this to revive my love for gaming instead of mindlessly playing games. I aim to explore everything the game has to offer and all the features a developer implemented into their game.

I like the base idea, ie. telling a story with only unpacking your things when you move to another place. It's very well done, and it's quite unique. I like the pixel graphics as well, however, there were quite some occasion when I just couldn't figure out what is that thing.

What I really didn't like is the execution of gameplay. This game is supposed to be a chill game, putting your things in a nice, OCD-ish order, while enjoying the story. However, placing objects is really restrictive: it seems you can put something there, but you can't, there are certain object you can't move around - which sometimes has a narrative reason (like, your boyfriend said don't touch my things), but sometimes it's just a dirty bowl in your way. Also, the game has a "puzzle" element, where you must guess what is the correct place of each object. You want to put your pills under your pillow? Well, FU, that's not its correct place. It's really frustrating and just makes the game unchill. Fortunatelly, you can turn this behavior off in options, but you'll still struggle sometimes placing the objects, simply because placing things is not working as smooth as should. Another con for me, that toward the end of the game, boxes contains random objects, and you have to "run around" in the house, because the box in the bedroom has random stuff belonging to the toilet. Again, it's frustrating switching from room to room with every single item you unpack. And finally, the game is VERY short, and feels like it ends abruptly. I've finished it in two sittings.
A girl after my own heart. Unpacking is a wonderful and poignant story about growing up packaged in an adorable home decor/ zen puzzle game. 10/10 would recommend

如果有缺点的话，就是流程较短了吧，一周目不到5小时就能通关。不过因为我对这个游戏比较来电，现在已经开始二周目了，我想看看通关结算时，如果处于不同的房间里，女孩的日记上是否会写不同的话。

I absolutely love this game. I enjoyed it so much. Beautiful, relaxing, peaceful and so cute. Love the unboxing sounds and placing item sounds. Such a Satisfying game.

进包后9块钱买的cdk!非常治愈的游戏，我本来觉得不就是理理东西有什么好玩的，但它是真的好玩T T，通过整理包包参与到主角的生活里，游戏各种细节做的很好，玩的过程中持续不断会被惊喜到，很喜欢很喜欢。
缺点：流程太短了！

This game features such a great plot and each level leaves you guessing what the next adventure in your characters life will be next. It's also just a very calming game overall. Sure it's frustrating when you don't have enough space for all your shoes, but it's really helped my anxiety to just sit back and unpack a box of my things and make each environment my new home.
Super adorable game. Easy and fun "puzzles", if you can call them that, which serve as a very simple story driver. It's short, and I would love to play more, but I think it hit the right length.

I saw a lot of criticism about the price for this game when it came out but it is extremely worth it in my opinion. i have replayed this game like 4 times now and loved it each time. Great story that's told kind of subtly but easy to understand if you're following along. I really hope they come out with more of this! got my partner to play this as well and they also loved it.

想玩很久了 但走过一些阶段才能更好的感受

真的很爱搬家 线下搬完线上搬
及时断舍离+少买东西很重要
同居√ 搬到别人家× 自己东西完全没地方放很痛苦 所以一起生活不是进入对方的生活，而是两个人搬到新房子开始新生活
Strangely soothing and addicting. An interesting way to play while putting together or making inferences on the story aspect.

This game is an absolute masterclass in digital storytelling. It's been years since I've experienced a game that weaved together a touching story without any dialogue along the way. I can't recommend this game enough and I will certainly be recommending it to friends, colleagues, and even strangers for years to come.

As someone who went a long while unable to run a lot of bigger games, I became a super big fan of the cozy game genre. They're small, much easier to run, and they're a good stress reliever. I'm a sucker for pixel art/pixel style games, and when I saw that this was also a home decor kind of game, it had me sold. It kind of sucks that there aren't more levels, but I think it's a real fun game. Very cute, very relaxing. The music is nice too!

What can I even say about this game that hasn't been said before? An absolutely amazing and adorable experience and one of the first games in a long time to have made me actually cry because it was over. Seriously if you're on the fence about it for whatever reason. Buy it. Super relaxing to boot.

You follow the life of a woman who moves between different apartments as life goes on. As the name suggests, you're the one tasked with unpacking her stuff! It's a lovely and relaxing game. However, it's a short game and I wish there are more stories of different people to follow. I wonder if there's a sequel where you pack the boxes.

Oyun keyifli ve rahatlatıcı. Bütün kutuları bitirmeden hatalı yerleştirmeleri göstermemesi ve başarımların gizli olması tek kötü yanları. Yıldan yıla aynı eşyaları görünce sanki gerçekten kendi eşyalarımızmış gibi hissettiriyor.

如果现实中整理房间也能那么简单就好了~
房间里的小物件细节非常多 ，可以推断得出房间主人的兴趣喜好，以及房间主人这些年来的成长轨迹等等，存在一定的剧情而不是单纯的收拾房间。可惜流程短了点 ，期待出dlc~

Oyun çok tatlışşşş müzikleri falanda çok hoş,keyifli ama 
koca çizmeyi de yatağın oraya koymayalım be abi bi ayakkabılık yapamadın mı be abla
kırmızı süzgeç bile dışarda kaldı yapıcağınız mutfak dolabını skm
非常喜欢，通过一个一个房间的整理，让过我看到作者一年一年走过的历程，有了一个完满的结局，最后也希望你们的旅程不会结束(●'◡'●)
after playing for 3 hours already, its one of those games that is soothing and rewarding both at the same time, after a busy chaotic day , just let go  and rewind and relax ...

Unpacking erzählt die Geschichte eines jungen Mädchens vom ersten Kinderzimmer bis ins Heim für den Rest des Lebens. Dies geschieht aber nicht durch Worte, sondern der Spieler entdeckt ihre Vorlieben, Hobbies und auch Schicksalsschläge durch das Einräumen ihrer Habseligkeiten in verschiedene Zimmer und Wohnungen.
Dabei lässt das Spiel einem ziemlich freien Lauf, wobei Gegenstände auch "falsch" platziert werden können. Eine Pfanne gehört z.B. nicht ins Schlafzimmer, sondern in die Küche. Erst wenn solche groben Schnitzer beseitigt wurden, lässt sich ein "Level" abschließen.
Unpacking hat eine super niedliche Grafik und eine tolle Hintergrundmusik! Es ist ein sehr gemütliches Spiel für Zwischendurch. Und durch einige Geheimnisse mancher Gegenstände macht auch das Herumprobieren damit echt Spaß!
Für meinen zweiten Durchgang (den ersten hier auf Steam), habe ich knapp 3 Stunden für 100% gebraucht.

Mehr als Gegenstände in Regale zu stellen macht man als Spieler nicht, daher sind die, die groß Action erwarten hier fehl am Platz. Aber wer gemütliche Puzzlespiele mag und es toll findet anhand von Hinweisen sich eine Geschichte auszudenken, kann hier gerne zugreifen!

Não estava esperando esse final, mas só deixou o jogo todo ainda melhor! Incrível poder acompanhar o desenrolar de uma história não só de amor, mas de crescimento enquanto faço o que mais amo que é organizar casas rs... Acho um jogo muito caro, mas sinceramente amo jogar não importa quantas vezes seja! Muito bom mesmo.

OMG, I loved all of the scenery backstory and organization in this game, it calmed me down when i was stressed except, when i was unpacking a hard room like the kitchen, but it is a lovely game and i recommend it

Was a very fun game that can be both complex and relaxing depending on how you look at it. Definitely agree with most reviews about waiting for the game to go on sale, as it doesn’t take long to beat the game, (I was playing at a normal pace and finished the game in 6.8 hrs, I definitely don’t think that it would be worth full price, had I paid as much. However I got it half off, and at that price I think it’s worth it!)

Simulador de mudança com gráficos bonitinhos, trilha sonora igualmente fofa e barulhinhos de toc-toc-toc quando você mexe as coisinhas de lugar. E eu não poderia ter pedido por mais. 

A história não é narrada, não tá escrita em nenhum lugar, não passa nenhum filminho de introdução no começo de cada ano. Ainda sim, você entende perfeitamente a situação na qual a personagem principal tá o tempo inteiro. As emoções passadas enquanto os anos passam, o sentimento de estar crescendo junto com ela, as relações criadas por ela enquanto você não pôde ver, tudo é passado de um jeito tão sútil, e marcante, e tão relaxante. Daí você tá se preocupando com onde diabos botar a panela de pressão, e de repente, chorando por ver a protagonista se mudar de novo e finalmente achar uma casa pra chamar de lar.

Acabaram todas as minhas lágrimas, mas eu me sinto radiante. Recomendo.

Un juego muy personal y muy bonito

Las casas son un reflejo de las personas que viven en ellas. Nunca habia vivido la historia de un personaje haciendo la mudanza del mismo. Sin duda un juego unico

Vine por el llamativo pixel art y me quedé por la exquisita narrativa (y un poco por ese sonido acaricia tímpanos).  

Cómo el espacio, y compartirlo, te oprime o te libera.
Hasta qué punto los objetos que nos rodean, que poseemos o a los que nos apegamos nos aportan identidad, sentimiento de pertenencia, nos ayudan a avanzar o a quedar estancados.  
Cómo unas meras instantáneas de las diferentes mudanzas que acomete nuestro personaje protagonista pueden contar una historia a ese nivel de profundidad.

Si eres millenial te va a gustar el doble que si no lo eres, aunque puede que lo disfrutes igualmente.
Si tienes TOC vas a estar un poco j-o-d-i-d-o, pero la frustración es una mecánica en este juego. 
Si eres detallista, observador o te gusta profundizar serás capaz de ver decenas de detalles que para otros pasarán desapercibidos (aparte de los obvios). 

Es caro para lo que ofrece, pero lo que ofrece es de altísima calidad. 

En definitiva, si estás aquí, espero que sea porque te llamó la atención lo que dije al principio y/o cumples algo de lo antes mencionado, porque entonces vas a vivir una experiencia para guardar en la caja de mudanzas de tu recuerdo.

非常休闲的一个小游戏，玩法就是开箱，收拾。但是从一开始没有意义并且附带有一丝无聊的收拾，变成了推测女主生活的工具，从收拾屋子这一简单的事情来看着女主的成长已经情感经历的变化。游戏换了一个角度交代剧情，给我一个新视角去了解故事全貌，不得不说，还是很有意思的
——来自小黑盒用户孔雀自挂东南枝的评价
OYUN ÇOK KISA. umarım ileride güncelleme alır çünkü inanılmaz chill bi oyun ama birkaç saate bitiyor. yine de oynarken çok eğlendim (bazen kızın zevklerini yargılamadan edemedim😭)

I thought this game would be just a relaxing unpacking experience. However, as we delve into the years and unpack the character's belongings, we witness the significant life changes she undergoes. The game employs subtle storytelling—a short yet beautiful tale.
The game where moving in is as satisfying as finding a lost sock.

Es un gran juego para pasar un rato tranquilo, pero no diría que lo volvería a jugar una y otra vez, ciertamente.
Una vez completado ya te da una satisfacción momentánea, así que dudo que vuelva a comenzarlo.
La música relajante, el orden relativamente adecuado y el poder tener unas horas de diversión hacen que lo recomiende si lo encuentran a buen precio, pero a considerar que no es un juego de más de una vez.
Me encantó. (:

It is short, but cute game. 
Story is told basically by item you unpack and in in the rooms you do so. 

I do recommend buying it on sale when ti is atleast -50% off or get in bundle with other games (like humble bundle monthly)
A very cozy game, a simple little story told without any dialogue or text, simply throug context clues. I've enjoyed my time with it very much.

gerçekten oynarken rahatladığım ve beni içine çeken bir oyun oldu. her bölümde yeni taşındığımız eve eşyalarımızı yerleştirirken karakterin hayat hikayesini de görmüş oluyoruz ve bu çok hoşuma gitti. oyun sadece kutu açıp eşya yerleştirmekten ibaret değil. karakterin başarısız bir ilişkiden sonra ailesinin evine dönmesi ve sonrasında başka biri ile tanışıp bir bebeklerinin olduğunu görmek çok güzeldi. oyun kesinlikle alıp oynanmalı
this game is a delightful lesson in environmental story telling. it has no dialog or anything like that but still i feel like i know the characters really well.

Really sweet game BUT I completed the whole thing in about 4 hours; it's cute and relaxing, but definitely not really that replayable. Not quite worth the cost for how quickly you get through it; I'd definitely wait for a sale tbh.

1) First of all, wholesome game with added elements that you have to dig in. Like in accessibility, there is a option to remove puzzle element, so after finishing it, you can put stuff anywhere. 
2) Music is relaxing with shuffle option. The graphics just say modern retro style and some objects are interactive, so some electronics has working sound and stuff. 
3) But don't just go to the guide section to complete the achievements, first complete the game then you can do anything you want.
4) Overall the game to relax the unboxing moment and do anything, heck even go crazy on this game if you want to.

Tenía muchas ganas de este juego desde que salió porque me pareció un juego súper relajante y cozy. Cumplió totalmente mis expectativas. 

Me gusta mucho su forma de narrativa de “muestra no cuentes” y el cómo te está contando una historia a través de los objetos y las mudanzas de la protagonista, cómo a base de pequeños puzles y detalles descubres más cosas.

La única pega que le pondría es que, por ese precio, me esperaba un juego más largo, ya que solo da al rededor de unas 3 horas de juego. Al precio de rebaja que lo compré si que lo vería más normal, pero eso no quita todo el trabajo y mimo que le han puesto a cada detalle.

¡Recomendado!

so relaxing! the experience of progressing through the main character's life and really getting to know them is incredible. the last couple levels made me emotional! amazing game :)

only complaint I have is that it's not long enough! 

10/10

Um jogo muito bonito e gostoso de jogar. Conta uma história de uma forma muito legal, com vários detalhes interessantes e até objetos que você pode interagir.

Apesar de ter gostado muito do jogo, eu tenho a mesma crítica que muitas pessoas aqui: o preço é salgado para a quantidade de conteúdo. Se não tiver lhe faltando dinheiro, eu recomendo, caso o contrário, recomendo apenas quando estiver em promoção.

This was a super sweet story. I was so pleasantly surprised that this game had such strong narrative. I was expecting a comfy puzzle light experience, and got it along with a story that had me wanting to know what happened next. It also made me think of my own things that have made it along my entire path. The last thing this gave me was a heavy dose of nostalgia for various household things that have come and gone through the years. Very cool game!

Juego corto y para relajar, pero que te hace pensar o replantear muchas cosas si has pasado ya por distintas etapas en tu vida. Muy nostálgico, me recordó a ciertas cosas y la canción del final me llegó a emocionar. Si andas medio sensible por una partida, una separación o algo por el estilo no recomiendo jugarlo. La nostalgia te puede hacer pensar en cosas que tal vez no querías xD.

Jeu assez contemplatif de gestion d'espace et de rangement. Très sympa pour passer le temps, mais très rapidement fini. A mes yeux il ne vaut absolument pas plus de 5€, donc essayez d'avoir une promotion pour y jouer. Jeu terminé en 2.7h de mon côté. L'histoire est intéressante car l'on suit quand même la vie de quelqu'un à travers ses cartons, et c'est assez touchant.
This game is wonderful. Relaxing, (Except for that last object) and you always get a sense of accomplishment when you finish a level. The music is great as well.

although i hate giving a negative review this game just simply isn't worth it full price. luckily, i did buy it on sale when it was $9.99; however, i probably would've refunded it if i paid full price. although it is a very relaxing game it can easily be done quickly (i finished the entire game + all achievements in 2.6 hours). its extremely repetitive and a solid 50% of what you unpack are books or book shaped items (e.g., video games, notebooks etc..). overall, i just had high hopes for this game and i was extremely excited for it and it just wasn't unfortunately wasn't what i thought it would be. but, with that being said, it still does have its positives. the artwork is really pretty and the soundtrack is quite relaxing. i also loved how the achievements incorporated interacting with the items unpacked and it was interesting to see how what the person brought with them over the years as they moved. there is also replay-ability of this game as you can organize what you unpack in different ways; however, i doubt i will ever do that. too many small items that started to fluster me and i don't imagine myself going through that again. in the end, if you are someone who likes relaxed and repetitive organizational games you will love it. if you are someone with somewhat of a short attention span and get bored of repetition it may not be the game for you.

tl;dr: wait for it to go on sale before buying.

jeu très sympathique et qui est très chill et agréable à jouer.
Par contre qui ne vaux vraiment pas 20e pour 3h de gameplay, je vous conseil vivement d'aller sur des sites ou vous pouvez  trouver des clefs du jeu pour 2e ( mon cas ) et qui mon beaucoup plus donné envie de jouer au jeu.

I ended up returning this because I didn't feel like I was absorbed enough for the price and read that there isn't much content, but it's VERY cute and relaxing and if it sounds appealing it's definitely worth trying out.

It's a good game to get on sale only. Gives you roughly 8-10 hours of game play with finding little achievements. I would like to see expansions to different stories maybe some more dark or maybe more light hearted and playful. It deserves the awards and tells a great story. (Bonus for being able to throw the ex boyfriends clothes under the bed and detail to the cramp hot bottle under the pillow tehe)

挺有意思的游戏，很温馨。每个关卡之间多少都有些联系，看到这种小细节、小变化让人很开心。虽然人物没有出场，但主角的形象已经通过一次次整理和相册里的语句建立了起来。
虽然是主角的房间，但玩家自己整理也很有代入感，好像同时也在布置自己的家一样。
不过流程很短，重复玩的可能性不大，打折的时候买比较好。
cute little game. the story progression is adorable and interesting to follow. it is short so i would recommend getting it on sale as i did.

se voce gosta de jogos de flash de arrumar casinhas vai adorar isso aqui, porem tem que entender que o jogo nao e pra vc fazer sua casinha dos sonhos, ele tem uma historia e uma narrativa e quer q vc siga nele.

nao adianta querer colocar coisas onde o jogo nao quer q fique, os items nao tem opcao de customizacao de cor nem nada, oque nao e um problema pois e a pegada do jogo mas e bom pras pessoas que acham que ele e mais sandbox.

seria bem legal um modo sandbox alias.

no geral o jogo e divertido a historia e fofinha na medida do possivel, porem acho que ter uma historia mais complexa e mini-games pra quebrar um pouco a monotonia de fazer as mesmas coisas ajudaria
A short puzzle game about unpacking boxes and moving into new spaces. Very chill and I liked the implied storytelling.
I found it really relaxing to play and it was fun getting each of the achievements. I like the subtle story telling and how the one house that was annoying to do was purposefully that way.

Woo got it on sale for $9.99 50% off and definitely worth it at this price!! Gameplay wise what u would expect but music and details in the item/stuff really convey a nice growing story!! I genuinely even feel excited for the protagonist as she move in in life!!!(LGBTQ BIG WHOLESOME NESS) Personally I recently went through a very sad break up and this game is indeed very curing like a lot of game recommendations say! 9/10 why can't I put socks on the stove?

One of the best and most relaxing games I have ever had the privilege of playing; the story being told subtly through objects in the environment is stellar and genius. It is a beautiful experience that I highly recommend you play. Also gotta love the representation. MORE GAY GAMES PLSSSSSS!!!!!!!!!! >:]]]]

Unpacking ist ein wirklich niedliches Game. Es hat eine simple Grafik und eine einfache Handhabung. Ich denke, man kann sich in dem Spiel weitaus mehr als drei Stunden-4 Stunden verlieren. Es ist sehr entspannend und ein schönes Game für Zwischendurch.

SO RELAXING. I watched some of this on a stream and was sucked in. I love the visuals. Putting everything in its place is so satisfying. I wish there were more rooms beyond the main story, but overall I can see myself playing again.

Got the game during a sale for ten buckaroos, extremely relaxing and enjoyable, as someone with rather eclectic thoughts this amazingly, and helpfully calmed my mind really well. The game is really enjoyable and slowly gathering clues of the protagonists' life as you unpack is quite engaging. However the game is very short, and after playing it for a second time with a combined playtime of bout' five hours I was done playing the game, and tired of it. I definitely will play it again periodically. I'd 100% buy it on sale, and the game is amazing but it's too short to spend the $20 full price.
Game itself I'd rate 4.6/5, it's pricing and length separately gets a 2/5.

J'ai acheté le jeu car j'ai vu un live il y a peu sur celui-ci.
Un jeu très satisfaisant, un jeu de détente sympathique, c'est un jeu relaxant. 
Le but de ce jeu est de déballer des affaires qui se trouvent dans des cartons et de les placer dans différentes pièces de la maison en fonction de leurs utilités. Le jeu est sur plusieurs époques (retrace t-il l'histoire d'une personne ?), donc il y a plusieurs ambiances a travers le temps. 
Cependant un prix aussi haut pour 3h de jeu, cela ne vaut pas le coup.
Je vous recommande d'attendre les "promotions" du jeu pour l'acheter.

Really cute and soothing, it is very comforting and easy to play. It was fun to follow this character through her life by watching all her items develop and relationships develop as well, it feels very wistful. I recommend this game!
I loved this game so much, but I wish there was more levels :( Maybe if they started it in the earlier years it would give more content? Just too good of a game to be so quick.

방을 꾸미는 힐링 게임을 하고 싶으시면 추천 드립니다!
시간 가는지도 모르고 플레이 하면서 나도 이런 방 가지고 싶다...  라는 생각을 하며 꾸몄습니다
내가 두고 싶은 위치가 틀린 부분도 많아서 좀 헤매긴했지만 좋았습니다

Kısa ve tatlı bir oyun. Bi iki oturuşta bitirilebilir. Bazı eşyaların sığmadığı yerlerde sinir oldum onun dışında sıkıntısı yok.
Eşyalar ve evlerin değişimi üzerinden hafiften bir hikaye veriyor bize. Biraz dikkat edince bile anlaşılıyor zaten.
Tek eksisi bir tık daha uzun olmasını beklerdim diyebilirim.

A pretty chill and relaxing game, It took me 3 hours to complete it with all achievements so nothing special. I recommend buying it when it's on sale, because it's definitely not worth the full price.

3h de jeu pour 10€ c'est encore beaucoup trop cher pour ce que c'est, même si la tentative artistique autour du titre est intéressante et adorable. On aurait aimé plus de nouveaux éléments à chaque fois et pas de replacer trop de fois les mêmes, qui ne vieillissent même pas avec le temps pour la plupart. Pour un tel prix on mérite au moins ça quand le jeu est aussi court.
En résumé : Achetez-le quand il sera à 3/5€ mais pas plus.

很治愈人的像素收纳小游戏，通过整理一步步了解主人公的成长历程。

但是流程很短，推荐等打折再入。

I've never actually written a steam review about a game I loved but I had to for this one. Even if it's only a few hours in length total I enjoyed every single second of it. It is so detailed, so moving, so precious for a game that only has a sentence every stage. 10/10 recommend to anyone looking for a calm, heartwarming, homebody adventure.

This game was very beautiful, cute, and I very much enjoyed playing it. I wish it was longer and if it ever gets a sequel I will buy it in a heart beat. I highly recommend this game if you enjoy organizing, cozy games, or something that you can easily jump in and out of.

I beat the game in one sitting however so beware; it may be addicting.
A short story -unpacking- ASMR game that I completed within 3 hours, found achievements, and finished within sessions. Can't wait for more!

8/10，很精致的短流程慢热游戏，各种细节都做得很好，需要耐下心玩，最好一口气玩完。
[spoiler] 整个游戏过程仿佛看着一个可爱活泼的小姑娘长大成人，从朋友身上学习，与爱人分分合合，最后找到合适自己的生活方式安定下来，实在是太可爱太感动的过程 [/spoiler]

Unpacking é um jogo extremamente calmo e otimo para um passa tempo em dias estressantes ou inquietos. A história da protagonista do jogo é silenciosa mas é nós apresentada por apenas inumeras mudanças da vida que ela passa.

Assistimos na pontrona da frente o quão silenciosa e rapida a evolução de um ser humano é, como os interesses pessoais vão surgindo aos poucos e como alguns deles acabam nos guiando para o nosso futuro. A música no final, mesmo sendo simples, me deixou emocionado.

Recomendo demais para aqueles que querem um jogo calmo e gostoso de jogar nas horas vagas <3

This was an adorable game. While it is quite short, I played through once (3 hours) and then played through again immediately afterwards (3 hours), and there were little bits to discover during the second playthrough that really impressed me. It's a great "zen" game. Would recommend.
I have not finished the game yet, but it is so, so, SO good. you think that you are just unpacking rooms, but you are unpacking a persons life. I love this game
que gracinha de jogo o que mais gostei é que dá para ter uma noção da historia da personagem, e que perfeito a cena final delas e o bebê.

Its a nice concept. Reminds me of those free to play pixel puzzle games we all used to play. The price tag is ridiculous tho. Bought it on sale for half off and I would STILL say its a bit much.

PRO: Rilassante, storia delicatissima
CONTRO: Gameplay di nicchia
VOTO: 8+/10

---------------------------------------------------------

Quando ho scoperto Unpacking non pensavo facesse per me e lo credevo un semplice passatempo rilassante. Grazie ad alcune opinioni entusiastiche ho deciso di provarlo, essendo anche incluso sul GamePass. 

Stilisticamente si presenta con una bella pixel art, piuttosto dettagliata e moderna, che si è rivelata convincente anche per chi come me non la apprezza facilmente. 
Le ambientazioni sono molto ben caratterizzate e inoltre si riescono ad adeguare sempre al passare del tempo, risultando credibili. 

Un aspetto che non so bene come giudicare è la colonna sonora, molto bella ma anche piuttosto ripetitiva e con pochissime tracce. Avrei preferito che caratterizzasse di più i vari periodi storici e della vita della protagonista, cosa che accade già di più con le tracce dei dispositivi audio che si possono trovare.

Come gameplay Unpacking è molto semplice e anche piuttosto indefinito in quanto bisogna soltanto arredare le stanze di una casa, con l'unico vincolo che la posizione degli oggetti sia coerente. 

Quel che si fa è a discrezione del giocatore, alla fine si segue il proprio gusto e ci si rilassa senza pensare all'obiettivo. Se si entra nel mood del gioco gli oggetti non si posizionano a caso, come di solito è consentito fare, ma si finisce per mettere in ordine come nella vita vera, con un occhio di riguardo all'estetica e alla funzionalità. Se questo meccanismo non si innesca penso che semplicemente l'opera non sia rivolta a voi. 

Come detto alcuni oggetti vanno posizionati soltanto in determinati posti ma questo viene detto solo quando non è più presente niente negli scatoloni. In questa fase bisogna spesso riorganizzare intere stanze per far quadrare tutti i conti. È possibile inoltre disattivare l'avviso che indica quali sono gli elementi incriminati, cosa che secondo me rischia di rendere l'esperienza troppo difficile e frustrante (non l'ho provata ma a volte alcune regole sono un po' strane). 

Le interazioni possibili sono comunque poche, si possono solo ruotare ed impilare gli oggetti, ma non ho quasi trovato bug (uno piccolissimo solo grafico) e il titolo risulta solido nella sua totalità. 

Nonostante non siano quasi nemmeno presenti testi, la storia è davvero piacevole e importante. 
Il gioco utilizza infatti le ambientazioni per portare avanti un racconto basato sulla narrativa emergente, a tratti simpatica ma che sa essere anche molto empatica e profonda. Nel complesso mi aspettavo il titolo più triste e malinconico, mentre invece sono presenti quasi solo emozioni positive. 

Molto bello che la vita della protagonista sia raccontata solo tramite i traslochi che effettua, imparando a cosa è più affezionata e come cambia nel tempo. Non tutte le ambientazioni sono però facilmente associabili ad un importante passo compiuto, rimanendo un po' poco chiare. 

Si tratta comunque di un prodotto molto breve, che ho completato al 100% in 4 ore e mezza. Alcuni achievements tuttavia, seppur facilissimi da fare, risultano quasi impossibili senza saperne la richiesta e ho dovuto cercarli su internet (sono segreti se non si sono sbloccati). 

In conclusione Unpacking non è un titolo per tutti ma caratterizzato da una cura sorprendente. Può risultare ripetitivo e poco attivo ma bisogna approcciarlo come una sorta di antistress, mettendo per una volta da parte la mentalità da videogiocatore. 

VOTO: 8+/10

---REVIEW ON "Unpacking"---

=Overview=
In the few short hours that I have played this game (spread out over two days), I was taken on a sentimental journey. This game tackled things that I myself have had to go through -- as well as things I hope to achieve: 
sentimentality, family, the concept of "home", and how material items can affect our perceptions of what makes a home.

=WHAT I LIKED=
- The Music: The music was cozy and emotional, reminiscent of composers like Lena Raine and C418.
- The Art Style: The art style helped to cement the cozy feel of the game. In a strange way, it reminded me of Point-and-Click mystery games from the days of Flash.
- The Story: The story, even being unspoken, hit very close to home for me particularly (This may have been influenced by the fact I used my real name for the name of the first album).

=WHAT I DISLIKED=
All in all, there was very little I disliked. Any technical issues I encountered could be attributed to my potato-tier computer. However, there were some items I had trouble recognising until (and even still I'm not sure they were what I thought they were). 

=THINGS I WOULD LIKED TO HAVE SEEN=
Personally, I would liked to have seen a sort of sandbox mode in the game. However, this only comes from my desire to have a home that doesn't look like it should be condemned.

=CONCLUSION=
Normally, games like this tend to make me stress out. But I found this stress to be missing while I played! I found myself actively interpreting the story in a way I haven't since I played "Celeste" and I was humming along to the music as I tried to figure out where to stuff a DS. Overall, "Unpacking" is a phenomenal game and a wonderful experience for those who enjoy organisation, interior design, and nostalgia. 




!!!\\\WARNING: EVERYTHING PAST THIS POINT MAY INCLUDE SPOILERS///!!!


=EXTRA COMMENTS=
Throughout the game, I had this lingering feeling that the main character would turn out to be lesbian. I was pleased to see I was right! This really only made the story resonate with me further, given my own preferences away from the screen. I found the ending incredibly sweet and wholly deserved.

[h1] Overpriced but Relaxing [/h1]

Unpacking is a game that I finally got to play after hearing nothing but praise for it and for the most part, that praise has been warranted. It's a relaxing game where you unpack items as you move into new homes at various places in your life, from moving to college, to moving in with your boyfriend, to moving into a permanent house with your partner, there's a clear story to follow here without any cut scenes or dialogue. Is it anything too interesting or meaningful? Not really, it's very surface level but that's perfectly fine for this game and it adds meaning to doing what you're doing. Figuring out where everything goes is really only interesting the first time you encounter that room, for example the first time you get to unpack a bathroom, or an office, since that's the only time you need to actually figure out where stuff goes, after that it's just doing the same thing you've already done, and gets a bit repetitive, especially the wardrobes! Unpacking 20 pairs of underwear for the 5th time is just boring. Other than that though, the game is pretty solid. The graphics are simple yet effective, and the music is just fine. The biggest issue with this game is the price. It does absolutely nothing to warrant a $20 price tag. The absolute maximum I'd pay for this game is $8 and that's pushing it even I think. Either get this in some sort of bundle or when it's on a big sale, otherwise wait. It's a fun and relaxing way to spend an afternoon but not worth the hefty price tag. 它看似很自由，你可以隨意擺放物品，但實際上限制了範圍，如果在非指定位置放置物品那麽拆開所有箱子后就會提示錯誤。比如白板，我放在了工作室裏，客廳桌子上，甚至臥室中，但都錯誤，於是去看了實況[spoiler] 發現是貼在冰箱上。 [/spoiler]而且因爲像素美術導致有些物品難以辨識，比如藍色不知名墊子，也是幾乎每個房間都放了一遍還不行，去找實況才知道是[spoiler] 放在浴缸裏。 [/spoiler]
因爲這樣整體的體驗解壓中又帶了一絲煩躁，還有某些地方是放不滿的...難受起來了...
關於劇情，通過每次搬家增減的物品、房屋的構造來講述，但也許是因爲我更多的是去“收納”，故事怎樣反倒沒什麽感覺。
游戲的細節不錯，多次出現的物品仔細觀察可以看到磨損痕跡，結束關卡時在不同的房間拍照相簿裏的備注也會不同，還有貼紙很可愛。
綜合來説還算是不錯的，推薦打折時入。

Short and sweet game, where you focus on unpacking different items and search for a fitting space in a relaxing atmosphere. Main focus is lying on the mechanic itself while you can see some story by identifying the new areas.

So I was really excited to play this game for a long long time but overall I just felt that this game was ok. My opinion of it being ok might just be because I was hyped about it for so long and then the game just ended up not meeting the hype. I do really enjoy the concept of this game along with it being a nice little adventure game. I also appreciate the story that went into it. I think that I unfortunately just didn't like it as much.

Unpacking is a very cozy and relaxing game centered around uncovering someone's life story via unpacking their belongings through various life events. It slowly uncovers the main protagonist's journeys in life, and if you pay attention you will find some awesome details that really brings life to this game. Highly recommended if putting things in place is satisfying to you, bonus points for wholesome vibes and a beautiful slice of life story.

Love the game but i think it's not worth full price.
I got little over 3 hours out of it and don't really see any reason to replay only to go through the same rooms/itmes again. If there was a sandbox or endless mode it might be different. But the way it is you are very restricted where to put certain things to complete a level and it would have been nice to have the option of more freedom.

If i had bought this game separately and not gotten it in Humble monthly i don't think i'd have been able to give thumbs up on this.

Recommended, but only if on special.  Hopefully they consider adding more content, or storylines.

The story of a green first aid kit and its female sidekick.

It's a short game at only four hours--and a good portion of that was figuring out the last few achievements. I found it enjoyable though. Obviously, the game is about putting away someone's stuff, but thematically it's about digging through their life. At various points you get to see what got kept and what got left behind. Other reviews call it vague, but I feel it's tantalizing to never interact with the owner but just see their stuff.

The only thing I wish the game had was some way to ID items besides looking at them. Most are obvious, but a few are mysteries that would be solved by reading a label to see what they are. 

Still totally worth a buy whenever the price is worth 2-3 hours of entertainment.

First off, don't buy this game unless it's on sale. I am not convinced that there is enough content in the game to make it worth $20.

That out of the way, the content Unpacking DOES provide is FANTASTIC. It's a relaxing game about unpacking (who knew?) and I'm surprised I haven't played a game with this kind of concept before. It's the small details that sell it for me, like what items have been packed into what boxes, or what recurring items you keep as you move from place to place. I'm particularly impressed with how the game manages to invoke nostalgia, not just for myself thinking back on my own past, but nostalgia for the character you play as: her life, her belongings, and the way it all ties together as the years progress. It's a neat little story that does a great job showing you rather than telling. The music, sound design, and art style all fit the game perfectly.

You can finish the whole game in just a few hours and you probably won't feel a need to play the game twice. But if you're like me, you may end up returning to the game every so often. What can I say? It's a good game for me to de-stress. I suppose there IS merit in the whole "cleaning is therapeutic" thing...

Overall, a solid game worth experiencing, but unless they lower the price or add more content to the base game (what about a hard mode with even MORE things to unpack each level, making it much harder to find space for everything? or a custom room builder where you can place items from all of the different levels? even just one or two bonus levels?), I don't recommend paying full price for this.

Aunque no hay diálogos ni textos, la historia se revela a través de los objetos y cómo estos evolucionan con el tiempo. Es una narración ambiental, ofreciendo pistas sobre relaciones, trabajos y momentos vitales del personaje principal.

Lo recomiendo si te gusta este estilo de juego que puede llegar a ser lento y cuidadoso.

This is such a cute game and very relaxing, too. It's also very heartwarming in a way. Despite the fact that there are no characters to interact with or a clear story to follow, players engage in unpacking boxes. [i] That's it? Unpacking boxes? [/i] Someone uninterested in this kind of game would definitely see it as just that, but after playing through pretty much most of it, I see it as unpacking a life. If you take a look around your room right now, I'm sure you can find things, small or big, that make it distinctive. The same applies to this game. You start off with one room, a bedroom, and it is evident that you are unpacking boxes for a child. From this alone, I'm sure you could assume how the rest of the gameplay follows. Nevertheless, players are able to witness a life unfold before them and evident changes of this life, like moving in with another person. I definitely recommend this game— 8/10, minus two points because it is pretty repetitive, and I don't have the best attention span.

游戏的主要内容，是将搬家箱内的一个个大小物品，分门别类的放到它们应该待的地方，有那么一丝拼图一样的解密味道。

游戏中的“谜题”设置有一些瑕疵。首先是部分物品真的看不出是干什么的，比如中后期出现的一个像红色尺子一样的东西，以及最后的婴儿润肤乳。再者部分认得出来的东西，会因为不同人的现实生活习惯导致无法找到合适的放置位置，比如后期的那个老大个的木头架子为什么必须要放到柜子里？为什么鞋子一定要放在架子上？为什么书包一定要放在地上？

游戏严格来说是有剧情的，整个游戏过程中都没有出现任何的“人”，而是通过“人”的物品，像做人物侧写一样了解ta们的个人性格和生活方式。通过主角的几次搬家/增添陈设，来领会主角的经历，以及她遇见的人。

推荐人群及价格：适合收纳爱好者。原价尚可。

可能涉及剧透的吐槽：[spoiler] 片尾曲最后的画面个人觉得有点画蛇添足，如上所述，游戏中一直处于让玩家进行人物侧写的状态，而最后出现的主角、爱人、孩子反而破坏了游戏构建的朦胧美。 [/spoiler]

This game is exactly as how it's shown, a relaxing and chill game of organizing for someone moving into a new place at different stages in their life. It flows through big life changes and hints, some cute like an item or two from college or an old item from home when they're older. I liked it as a busy adult cause I could just drop it whenever I needed to in order to do errands without worrying. It's sweet and there is a lot of personality, but I don't see much replay in this - I beat the game and so far assume you can just create a new name/file but it goes through the same motions. If you save it you can fastplay watch how you organized the room before which could be fun. Now, I bought the game for $12, when it was 40% off. I would say to definitely wait for a decent sale and not buy it at $20. It's great fun, but it's quite short. I saw other reviewers who finished in less than 5 hours, some may have taken longer, and it took me about 7 hours. Again, it's great fun, but way too short and lack of replay to feel that $20 is fair. TLDR, great fun, but purchase only when on at least 40% sale.

Like many others, my only complaint about this game is that I wish it were a bit longer. I had a lot of feelings while I was playing this game. You don't think that a game where all you're doing is organizing someone's stuff out of boxes is gonna somehow give you feels, but it really does. There are some levels where you can't really find room to place things that you know are important to her, and that's done intentionally to make a point about what's going on in her life right now. You get foreshadowing at the beginning about her cultural identity - and her sexual orientation - that then plays out later as she's finding herself as an adult. She picks up new hobbies and drops others, only for that lost hobby to reappear at the end. And all of this is told through unpacking her stuff and putting it away. It's intensely nostalgic and highly enjoyable, and I really wish we had another protagonist to explore, a "Chapter 2" with a different story to go through.

Whilst the developers have continued to update the game and give us different accessibility and settings to enjoy the game more, there isn't any DLC's and I don't think they will be releasing any, any time soon.

TLDR: Great game for the cosy gamers, but wait til it's a lower price <3

I like that I can place the objects where I want to. It is such a relaxing game to play with the soft music and the sound effects of the objects getting placed down. I have replayed this game so many times I lost count but I recommend this game.

И так, начну с того что игра мне очень понравилась, прошёл ее на одном дыхании, сама игра очень милая и в каком то смысле медитативная, музыка очень красивая а рисовка так вообще отпад! ( я просто тащусь по Пиксельной графике ) разве что мне чутка не хватило контента, если бы выбор книги в начале, был не выбором пользователя, а выбором истории, это было бы прекрасно! а так, игра на Твёрдую Восьмёрочку, и да 20$ это многовато всё же

Unpacking es un juego realmente relajante. Lo disfruto un montón, sobre todo por esa libertad creativa y la forma tan particular de contarte una historia usando únicamente las mudanzas. Vas siguiendo a la protagonista desde que es chiquita hasta su etapa adulta, y es increíble cómo conectás con ella así. 📦✨

Los gráficos me encantan y la originalidad del concepto es total (no por nada surgieron tantos juegos parecidos después). Los sonidos y esos pequeños detalles marcan muchísimo la diferencia. Aunque es un juego corto, dan ganas de jugarlo una y otra vez porque te deja decorar a tu gusto y a tu forma, sin seguir un patrón predeterminado. Hay momentos donde te adaptas a espacios ya establecidos y otros donde tenes habitaciones o casas enteras para arrancar desde cero. 

Es una experiencia que recomiendo.

-ˋˏ✄┈┈┈┈📦🚚

Organização, música calminha com uma pixel art incrivelmente linda, unpacking vale cada centavo e cada hora de jogo. Além disso, as fases ainda contam uma história cativante que faz com o jogador fique totalmente imerso!

my ultimate comfort game. but for the price? its not like super worth it.
story and gameplay wise: 8/10. i really wished they'd put in like A and D for switching rooms instead of clicking so minor inconvenience on that part.

10/10 would recommend if it goes on sale tho

This game is good for student players. But once you start to get to work, this game may not be as fun as it supposed to be. Becuz we are living in a society that a nice house or an apartment in big cities is no more affordable for youth, no mention about a family. It'd be a kind of bitter to play this game when you can't have that sweet home irl.

A game about unpacking a person's belongings as they move into new places during new phases in their life--should be something fairly basic on the surface, but the creators of this game are masters at environmental storytelling. There is a clear story throughout the game as you see which items you keep, which items you stop seeing, and which items of your former roommates' slip into your new homes, along with where items are able to be placed to pass

All my friends and I have strong emotions for the protagonist and some of the people she lives with, and we never see these people aside from some small photos to put up in these homes. But something as little as what we can move to make room for ourselves says so much, and I can't praise the creators of this game enough for the story and emotion they were able to create from just telling us to unpack some boxes
เพลินมากกกก สนุกสุดๆ ขออีก เอาห้องมาอีกกกกกกกกกกกกกกกกกก อยากเล่นอีกกกก ช่วยทำห้องมาเยอะๆ เลยนะคะ Plzzzzz

A very relaxing and cozy game. Very cute and easy to manage. Even though it is very simple there is still a story that you can follow throughout the game. My only complaint is that there's not more places to unpack......

This game is surprisingly relaxing and satisfying to play. The music is soothing and the gameplay is simple and easy to learn. This game is great for people who like organizing things and for people who just want to chill and with a point and click game. Definitely recommend.

The overall gameplay is so relaxing; the storyline, very compelling; and the art, beautiful. I've had this on my wishlist since it came out but was only able to purchase recently. I'm glad I did—I really enjoyed playing it.

It's quite short, though, so I'm hoping for future updates—also considering the price (it's a bit too pricey for me). Maybe a different main character/storyline. (:

I didn't expect a game with no dialogue to make me cry, multiple times, but here we are. The act of tidying was not only soothing, it told me so much about a character I never even met in the game. I wish this had a billion more levels. It will scratch that same itch as Stardew Valley and Growing Up, though the game is much shorter. The amount of polish this has is phenomenal - pay attention to what goes where, what gets kept/discarded, and what noises things make when setting them down on different surfaces. Look at what the protagonist gains, loses, and hides. Just an absolutely brilliant game.

A beautiful game, I always love to play whenever I am sad or just feeling like I need an excellent peaceful game to end the day before bed, it has a lovely calm atmosphere, and the music is simply soothing to listen to. Definitely recommend it for any small indie game gamers who love small soft and cute games

Me encantó el juego, pero me pareció caro para el contenido que tiene.
No quito que esté bien hecho, que me encantó que te contara la historia de alguien en base a mudanzas, pero es un juego que te puedes pasar en una hora si lo juegas sin parar.

Very cosy game, has a wholesome story and gives you the freedom unpack belongings and find a new home for them. Hope it gets updated in the future as you can finish the story in 2/3 hours, would like more content!

I like this game a lot but it seems very short and I wish that they had more updates to add more levels and maybe unpack for different people. In the game you unpack the living space for the same person over many different years and places during their life. I wish they had more people to unpack for that would tell different stories. The game is fun but does not feel the same to replay. I would wait for it to go on sale to purchase because of how short the game is.

Super cute and nostalgic game. The storytelling is very subtle, but still endearing. If you're the kind of gamer that pays attention to and appreciates tiny details, you'll really like this game. Also love that they included the option to watch a recap video of each stage!

Jogo muito fofo, bonito, música extremamente boa e relaxante, mesmo que não tenha muito texto, ao decorrer que jogamos descobrimos mais sobre a personagem que estamos jogando, do que ela gosta e etc, recomendo muito.
its absolutely amazing. its calming and sort of creative and its like you are being walked through a journey of unpacking.

很治愈的游戏画风也很好看，很喜欢这种像素风的收纳游戏
玩起来是很爽贵也值就是我还是嫌流程有点短，要是可以出点dlc就好了

One of the cutest game lore i've played, took a few days to finish but its really cute! Best unpacking game ever
100% would recommend
É um jogo incrivelmente lindo e fofo, bem relaxante, adorei a forma em q conta indiretamente uma história. Vale a pena jogar até o final, a última imagem é MAGNÍFICA!

A sweet puzzle game with an emotional narrative. I originally saw someone playing this on their steam deck whilst I was on a busy London tube ride in rush hour; so glad I finally got round to playing, and will definitely be re-playing, too. 

Short enough for one-sitting and super relaxing

very smoothing and cozy game! good way to wind down. The music is so fitting for every stage of the game...y ux is superb - you gain satisfaction every click where you put the item where you want to put it.

A lovelystory without ever seeing a character. With each step and move of the protagonist, you learn more about the person just by unpacking and putting away their belongings. The details are lovingly incorporated and subtly kept going. Was a lot of fun and satisfied your own obsession with order.

This game has both amazing storytelling through visuals that will leave you attached to the girl you are watching grow up and is calming and satisfying experience! I highly recommend to those who enjoy seeing a mess turn into a home.

Fun game if you want to relax for a bit!  I do wish there were more levels, instead of having to do the same ones multiple times!  Sometimes, it can be irritating to put something where you want it just to have the game tell you you're wrong.  Other than that I would recommend!

i love this game the way everything looks is stunning and it had a really good story line to go along with it. overall is very relaxing to play, especially if you cant think of anything to do i can play this game for hours on end and never get disinterested!!<33

Just as good as everyone said. I *love* that you can watch playback of your unpacking and save a gif of it! Also, the environmental storytelling is easy to get invested in. The gameplay and music are both relaxing. I enjoyed unlocking most of the stickers, but I spent way too long trying to figure out how to "brew" coffee when it turns out that's not actually what that sticker means. Still, great game!
Fun, but not as fun as the ads made it seem. There are some rules that require you to place items in certain places which makes it less fun. But the unpacking and clicking is very calming.

This game is delightful and I love putting things away! I've played this over and over and over again and gotten every achievement and even dark star mode- I wish there was more content in the game, or maybe a way for other people to make levels, but I understand that kind of engine would be hard to do. I still really like the base game, though! Highly recommend if you like low-stress puzzle games :)

Me encantó. Estoy trasitando una licencia por un cuadro ansioso depresivo, y necesitaba toparme con un juego de este estilo para cuando no puedo controlar la ansiedad.
Es relajante, estéticamente hermoso, la música acompaña bien, la interfaz es súper amable y sencilla.
Lo único, me quedé con ganas de algunas habitaciones más, pero la historia tácita que se transita (con el año a año del personaje) tiene su lógica y está bien.
Es un juego que se resuelve en 6hs aprox. Recomiendo muchísimo.

Good game, I would prefer little more content or maybe a smaller price since I 100% the game in less than 4 hours but it's not distracting enough of a flaw for me to consider the game bad. Unpacking is a great game for when you wanna have cozy moment.
This game is so wholesome and warm, you never see the character you're unpacking for but at the end you'll want to reach through your monitor and hug her.  10/10 excellent game

This game has probably THE most incredible story telling of any I have ever played. Every level is subtle and clues you into what happened to the main character. The best part of each level is that you follow a singular person through their entire life, and despite the fact that you can probably put their tooth brush in their sewing table end up with the best ending. There is no hard level achievements, you just play as a person, and enjoy the game as someone who is unpacking their own belongings. It's calming, and it's satisfying. The actual story is just an INSANE bonus.

Unpacking is a beautiful combination of relaxing mechanics, puzzles that are the right level of stretch without feeling like the only way to figure them out is to google the answers, and fantastic storytelling that is effective in its simplicity and relatable on a human level. It's one of those games that you can easily get lost in or play whilst listening to a podcast.
As someone who loves to organize this is a great sim to resemble that. This is a great puzzle game and is a great game to play when need to relax. Highly recommended.
Amazing and so calming. The story behind it to brings a wholesome beam to the game. Planning to play this tons more in the future too!!!

Definitely a good buy on sale, and for how much I paid for it i think i got my money's worth.

But i have to think, if I paid MSRP (20 US dollars at time of writing) would i have felt as happy? and the answer is unfortunately no as of right now. It's a fun puzzle game, it's visually amazing, the story is subtle but intriguing.

But it is WAY too short for how much it costs. Right when you feel yourself start getting into it, the game is over. and there's not really a lot of replay value, other than trying to complete the sticker book.

I really wish i could give this a more positive review because it's clear that the devs poured a lot of care and love into this game, but it just doesn't have a lot to chew on. If you see it on sale, grab it. you'll have fun but don't get too attached to it.
Unexpectedly emotional, calm, relaxing and better than I had imagined, this game is a very original storyteller, and can be played by anyone. Definitely recommend
