I really liked the game and have replayed it a couple times, but I was really hoping the team would be working on expanding the game and maybe add new stories/levels for the price it's being sold for I assumed they were working to add more but that was not the case. Unfortunate, but cool while it lasted
Very cozy and satisfying game for anyone who likes organizing and/or pixel art. There's fun collectables too :)

Super cute game that is very chill, but short. The music is nice and I love the little story it has. There are stickers you can collect for arranging things a certain way. You could play the whole thing in a couple of hours.
absolutely amazing game, stress free and relaxing to play, really good game animation kept simple but beautiful, lovely story line as well would highly recommend.

The game as a whole? AMAZING! Is it worth $20? No. Finished it in a day and wanted more. I wish there were different lives to live through or something a little more than just the one play through. Love the story currently in game, and thought it was beautifully made. However, I typically don't spend that much money unless there's reasons to come back. Sure I can replay the game, but since I've already completed every achievement, there's no other goal for me in game. I recommend waiting for a sale to go up before purchasing. Other than the price, it's an amazing experience and I wish there was more content like this. Another review said there the creators don't intend on adding to the game, but I hope they change their mind.
這是一款嫌家裡整理不夠的遊戲，非常適合整理狂與收納狂，一玩就是欲罷不能。能從整理的過程發現主角是學美術設計的，居然連字型設計的書都有，很酷！

reminded me a of those free games i used to play as a child, a very nostalgic and relaxing experience, totally recommended if you like rearranging items and chill games, i enjoyed every moment of it !! the story told through the mc's belongings was lovely AND the sound design was impeccable <3
For the price of the game, the lack of replayability is disappointing. Other than that, it's cute and a fun way to spend a couple of hours.
I love this game! There's a story told with every item. It may not be long, but I've enjoyed playing it several times. It would be great to have some kind of spinoff or DLC telling different stories.

a unique form of storytelling, using items, scenes and subtle music cues in order to tell the story of the main character's life as she goes from childhood, to college life, and through love and heartbreak.

unpacking is not only great at telling it's story through the belongings of the character, but is also a relaxing experience that allows the players to work at their own pace accompanied by the lovely soundtrack.

this game is great for those who just want a casual and relaxing experience, or for those who want to perfect their organization skills.

作为一个整理控真的太喜欢这个游戏了！从下载游戏开始已经反复玩了4周目还没有厌倦，一有时间就会想玩……感觉同类型的整理游戏真的很少，相比之下无论是画面、剧情还是玩法，这个游戏对我来说都堪称完美。不但满足了强迫症和整理欲，更让我惊喜的是这样的游戏也有着温馨的剧情，细节满满。随着游戏进程，通过一间间屋子的变化和个别物品的收纳方式，让人亲身经历了一个女孩的成长：上学、恋爱、分手、事业有了起色、收获甜蜜与幸福。通关后心里真的非常温暖而且意犹未尽。最后不得不提游戏的音乐和画风都十分治愈，锦上添花！十分期待将来还会有类似的新游戏出现！

내 방은 청소 1도 안하면서 남의 집 청소 하고 있으니까 살짝 현타오긴 함.
근데 너무 재밌고 엔딩크레딧 노래 너무 좋음 가사 미쳣네 나 감동 왕방 받아버렸잔아.....오타쿠 벅차올랏잔아....!
도전과제도 너무 귀엽고(스티커 미쳣음 굿즈 내줘)도트 디자인이 나를 미치게 함. 이 앙큼한 자식들.
다 끝나면 타임랩스 보는 것도 재미요소임 타임랩스 꼭 보세요 ASMR로 써도 됨 소리도 너무 좋음.......
유료 DLC좀 내주라 제발..... 더 줘. 더 줘. 콘텐츠.더.줘.

Hermoso juego me sacó la depresión que sentía por mi ruptura de una relación de tres años, siento que gracias a este juego podré saber bien donde debo acomodar todas las cosas de la casa y que la tostadora no va en la ducha :) muchas gracias por tan maravilloso juego.

un petit jeu vraiment très agréable, on se prend au jeu de ranger au mieux les objets et on se surprend a être heureux de retrouver certains objets au fur et à mesure de la vie de notre protagoniste, on comprend quand il y a des problèmes sans le moindre texte et on partage sa joie quand les choses se règlent.

Will recommend. The idea is brilliant!
I love how there is progress with what the player owns. <3

10/10 Story - Indirectly told but love how it shows the life of the player through the years.
10/10 Visuals - I think this is perfect for the game and its concept. 
10/10 Controls - Easy and some I like how I can interact with some objects.
08/10 Music - Simple and appropriate.

A cute little game that has creative game-play as well as story-telling. Well designed art style makes the experience smooth and comfy. Most of the time I find the experience quite intuitive, there wasn't many things that I never saw in my life and where you are supposed to place them seem just about right. I think the achievements are somewhat tricky and could be used even more towards telling the story. Also I would warn new players to NOT PLAY THIS IN ONE GO, it can potentially drive you crazy. (a little bit is fine, not THIS MUCH at once please) Otherwise a somewhat relaxing game, I won't spend this much effort for my own room LOL.
I really enjoyed the story and how it progressed, such a wholesome game. some of the achievements were silly, but fun to find.
I can't stop crying this was so cute and it felt like I was actually there to experience the moving and the loss and I just, it's so sweet but sad at the same time!

While the game itself is not bad, I am disappointed that I paid £15 for this game as it has very few levels before completion. It is not worth the money at all in my opinion. If you are looking for a game you can play for more than a few hours this is not the game for you.

To be honest I wish there were more games like this! I've replayed three times and I'm most likely going to play it again. So calming and cute! I do wish you could move some of the bigger objects but understandably you can't. It's unpacking and not technically moving in but still just adore this game! I hope to see more games like this in the future and would gladly pay for dlc for more houses or even a new chapter in her life!

힐링겜이라는데 힐링이 되는지는 모르겠고
요리를 한번도 안해본 양반이 게임을 만든건지
주방도구를 저지랄로 많이 살꺼면 
주방도구를 걸어놓을법도 한데 
다 서랍에 쑤셔박아야 된다는게 아쉬웠다
도전과제는 올클리어 후에 5분만 투자해도
숨겨진과제 모든 클리어 가능하니 스트레스 없이 
나중에 몰아서 해도 될듯하다

i would legitimately pay a lot of money for well done expansion packs for this game, it has a lot of replay value, there's an asmr element where i find myself placing coasters and dvd's repeatedly. Sounds have been well thought out. You can stream for friends and argue about where items should go and argue about where you all put things in your real homes. I play this game when I'm sad, i play this game when i'm stressed. It's only got one "bad level" and that's on purpose to make you think. Honestly just power through that level and you'll be rewarded with better levels. 10/10. Would pay for more.

Wow this game is just wow 
the game play, soundtrack, pixel art, achievements, game modes, community, story and ending are literally perfect 10/10 
I had so much fun and the only complaint I have is that it's TO GOOD and I personally felt quite sad when I realized I had nothing more to do

Very cute and cozy. A perfect comfort game for anyone who needs to calm down and just sink into something simple. I love how the story unfolds and how you get to know the characters through out the unpacking process. I have replayed this game more times than what would be socially acceptable but hey i love it so why should i care. XD

Cute puzzle game that feels bittersweet. It feels really calming and satisfying organizing things in a game even though I don't have enough motivation to clean around the house sometimes. Can get a little frustrating if you put a few items in the wrong area. Overall, a great game to relax and chill with for an hour or so at a time.

This game made me realize how much you can get to know a person with the amount of stuff they own. The story is genius. There is no direct dialogue between the characters. We didn't even get to meet them in action. We only see them in pictures and in the diary entries. But the way you unpack items from different years of the protagonist's life shows the whole story. From being a young girl finally having their own room, to moving out of their parent's place, to moving in with their partners, experiencing loss, and finding growth and love, this game is so rich in story and it will pull your heartstrings. I did not expect to cry in this game.

I've had my eye on this game for some time since I love chillaxing puzzle games. However, I couldn't see this game being worth the full price so I waited for a sale. Luckily a great friend gifted it to me on the sale day and I was able to try it out.

Unpacking doesn't flat-out tell you its story, however, you can piece it together by the gameplay. It is obvious that we are following the story of a woman starting from the time she is a little girl. The game does a great job of telling you her story through the items you "unpack" at each stage. I found this way of storytelling really cool and immersive as you see the important phases of her life. When she was a kid, going off to college, moving in with roommates, etc. It's fun and intriguing to see the items that go along through each phase of her life and which ones you don't see anymore.

This game is a puzzle game at its core. Each stage starts you in a room with packing boxes. It's your job to take out all the items in arrange them in the room as best you can. Once you finish unpacking all the boxes, you'll have to go through a final check. Any objects that have a red highlight have to be moved to a particular spot so the level can be completed. For example, toilet paper is not going to go in the living room. In the beginning, you'll only have to unpack a room or two. In later stages, you'll be unpacking a whole house/ apartment. It gets trickier when the space becomes limited.

As far as gripes go, I think I only have one. The game is pretty short and the replay value is low. There are 8 stages and the only reason you'll want to replay this game is to complete the special challenges on each stage. 

Final verdict? If you want a chillaxing puzzle game, pick this up. However, I suggest grabbing it when it goes on sale for about 12 dollars. I don't feel it's worth 20. The music was relaxing, and the story was quite enjoyable, but I once again have to reiterate that it's quite short. Other than that, give it a try and unpack your life. Thanks for reading!

Upon glance of "Unpacking," what immediately captures your attention is its delightful visual presentation that exudes charm and warmth; the game boasts a simplistic yet appealing aesthetic characterized by a cozy color scheme that brings life to every room and gives it a personal touch. The use of a view further enhances the sense of comfort and closeness as players explore various settings meticulously depicted with careful attention to detail. The artistic design adds depth to the storytelling by ensuring that each, in game environment stands out as distinct and memorable. Moving from a kids room brimming with toys to an adults apartment adorned with cherished keepsakes reveals tales held within these spaces themselves.The gameplay feels natural and straightforward with its drag and drop controls for seamless interaction.Yet the true richness lies, in the players choices of item placement; each decision mirrors the characters essence and backstory making way for a sense of attachment and influence. Arranging and beautifying each area brings a sense of fulfillment that reflects the protagonists evolution. Turning the unpacking process into a symbol of personal development and transformation in "Unpacking." The storytelling in the game is understated yet impactful as players unravel the protagonists narrative, across life milestones without any spoken words exchanged. From childhood to adulthood and through stages of her life journey depicted in each level of the game players piece together her story gradually. The way this story is told lets players see how she grows and how the people around her influence her life and identity evolve well.The game touches upon themes such as belonging. The idea of home consistently throughout the gameplay experience.Every item holds its tale that unfolds as players interact with them making them contemplate the role material objects play in shaping our identities.The game delves into the concept of home being a notion that adapts with each new chapter, in life. You feel the mix of emotions that come with relocating and the sentimental value attached to objects that bring back memories of growing up and family moments as time passes by slowly but surely. For people who enjoy games focused on storytelling that encourage contemplation and emotional bonding,"Unpacking'' is a game you shouldn’t miss out playing. It serves as a reminder of the significance of ones home base the tales we hold dear, to us and the recollections that mold our identities. Unpacking boxes or exploring your thoughts and emotions. This game provides a journey that is truly worth experiencing.

To describe this game in one word: relaxing. (Though admittedly I played through the game the first time around like a madman, hardly stopped playing until I completed it.) It took me around 3.5 hours or to complete. With that in mind, I would recommend waiting for a sale--I got it half off and it falls relatively into the "worth it" range, but I don't think it would be at full price. However, despite having finished the game, I am still playing it--I load it up to play a level every now and then when I want a calm, relaxing game to play when I'm either unwinding from work or about to get ready for bed. The soundtrack is also lovely, unobtrusive and I'd even say soothing--it kind of almost induced a feeling of nostalgia for me.

As far as gameplay goes, pretty simple--place items where your average human might put them, rotate them as needed. Much like any real living space, there are limits to space in certain areas--sometimes the difficulty of a level is figuring out "how do I stack these without them taking up ALL the shelf space?", though it's not difficult, in my opinion. It's also very satisfying when you DO get the items where they need to be.

Definitely would recommend this game (as long as you're purchasing on a sale), especially if you like calm, quiet games or if you like organizing.

總評: 四星 ★★★★☆

這款整理房間遊戲真的就只是在整理房間，除了少數物品能夠互動、整理完成可以重播以及拍照裝飾分享之外，遊戲中沒有其他特殊的玩法，就是單純把東西從箱子拿出來，再整齊地放置在各個房間內。但就是這麼一款簡單的遊戲，卻讓我非常喜歡。

遊戲中的整理方式非常直觀，比如鍋碗瓢盆放在廚房；衣物放在衣櫃；書放在書架上。遊戲也能透過設定擺脫主觀式的擺放，做到各種天馬行空的擺設。遊戲中的漸進式關卡年份設計非常具有巧思，讓每一年箱子內的東西都不太一樣，有時候在箱子裡翻到這些東西的時候，甚至會勾起你童年的回憶。此外，也能透過房間內的擺設以及物品推斷房間主人的近況，就如同欣賞一個人的人生一般。

唯一的小缺點是遊戲時長實在是太短了，整個遊戲時長大約 5 小時，當我看到遊戲存檔介面時還以為遊戲會有三大關卡，殊不知只是不同的存檔格。另外就是頻繁地點擊拿起以及點擊放置對於手指也是不小的壓力，但即使如此，還是推薦給喜歡玩放鬆休閒類遊戲的玩家嘗試看看。

Je ne pense pas devoir présenter Unpacking, pas quand tant de youtubers, francophones comme anglophones, l'ont exploré. Je n'apporte donc que mon point de vue de joueuse lambda.

Unpacking est un jeu qui ne paye pas de mine mais dont la force est dans sa narration: on vit plusieurs déménagement et on découvre ainsi comment notre protagoniste, laquelle reste toujours sans visage, évolue et grandit. On la voit enfant avec ses rêves, on la voit grandir, découvrir des passions, garder celles de son enfance, ses goûts, ses problèmes de santé aussi, ses amours, ses peines, ses joies... juste en déballant des cartons. C'est tout bête mais c'est très bien pensé et la manière dont on doit ranger les affaires ajoute parfois un peu plus à cette histoire que l'on suit au fil des cartons que l'on plie. 

Le tout est accompagné d'une bande-son très agréable, sympathique et nous avons même le droit à une chanson originale composée pour le générique de fin qui, si elle n'est pas révolutionnaire, est bien écrite. 

Les graphismes sont aussi colorés et sympathiques.

Unpacking est un jeu sympa, Unpacking est un jeu chill, Unpacking vous offrira environ 3h30 de fun si, comme moi, vous essayez d'avoir tous les succès. Je vous encourage d'ailleurs à essayer de faire des clics droits sur certains objets pour interagir avec eux ;)

Par contre, là où le bas blesse et comme beaucoup d'utilisateurs l'ont souligné, c'est qu'Unpacking est cher pour ce qu'il est. 

Presque 20 euros pour 3h30 quand on finit le jeu à 100%, c'est un peu excessif à mon goût, c'est d'ailleurs pourquoi, malgré mon envie d'y jouer, j'ai sagement attendu une bonne promotion. 

Si vous souhaitez y jouer, je ne pense pas que vous serez déçu mais attendez les soldes steam.

Overall the game is very relaxed and fun to play. The idea of just unpacking boxes after a move and setting up your areas to live in, feels real as it is. Even if you didn't have as many moves that happen in the game it gives a good idea and feel of how and what you may take with you as you grow older and move from just your parents house to a dorm or a apartment for the first time and all the things you leave behind when you first start out on your own to moving in with friends or your first place to call your own.

For the story of it, its well told without words just the areas you are placed to move into. and finding spots to put things you own, from small apartment style places to rooming with others, to even moving in with someone special to you. Its done every nicely without saying any words besides a little snap shot at the end depending on what room you end each level in. 

Art and music in the game is done very nicely. Some would call the art simple but simple can be done nicely and was a wonderful art choice for the game as you don't need really detailed dishes or clothes that you move around with but just the right amount of detail that you can see the usage over time, that can be shown and seen while moving. chips on a special mug or some faded fabric on some items you kept for a long time. With the music its really enjoyable with little hidden things you can find throughout the game, along with a very wonderful ending song that is full of emotion and feeling. 

Overall, like I said at the start, the game is a wonderful and relaxing game to play, something chill that you can play though and try placing items in new areas to bring new ideas.

Unpacking is a peerlessly moving story packaged in the guise of a puzzle game. You play as an unnamed protagonist moving house at various points in her life—dorm room, starter apartment, first live-in partner, and so on—each rendered as an isometric diorama. Your goal, simply, is to remove objects from boxes and put those objects where they’d typically go (toothbrush in the bathroom, silverware in the kitchen). But those items, taken in totality, tell you what’s going on in her life: the new people, and new problems, that fly into and out of her sphere with every passing stage of life.

[b]A Good Match For:[/b] Décor-minded players. Anyone looking for a short, soothing game.

[b]Not A Good Match For:[/b] Anyone who can’t deal with an ambiguous story. Folks seeking brain-meltingly difficult puzzles; Unpacking isn’t really about that.

Unpacking is a visually stunning game that transforms the ordinary task of unpacking into an emotional and nostalgic adventure. Its pixel art style and intuitive gameplay mechanics create a captivating experience. However, the game's brevity, clocking in at around 2 to 3 hours, may leave some players wanting more in relation to its price. Nevertheless, for those seeking a unique and evocative journey, Unpacking offers a brief yet enchanting exploration of memories and personal connections.

While Unpacking may be short, it delivers a poignant and immersive experience that lingers in the mind long after completion. Its ability to evoke emotions through the arrangement of objects is a testament to the game's artistry and storytelling prowess. It invites players to reflect on their own experiences and find meaning in the little moments that shape our lives.

Despite its short length, Unpacking is a game that can be wholeheartedly recommended to anyone with an appreciation for heartfelt storytelling and beautiful aesthetics. Its profound impact transcends its brevity, making it a journey worth embarking upon. Unpacking reminds us that sometimes the most meaningful stories are found in the simplest of tasks, offering a reminder of the power of memories and the significance of the spaces we call home.

I recently found this game, and I must say, it's wonderfully charming and therapeutic. You're given the task of unpacking boxes for the main character, who never actually speaks, save for the little notes she writes on the bottom of the pictures she takes. You must interpret the story for yourself. You can move every item that comes out of the boxes, plus some objects already in your environment, and arrange them pretty much anyway, anywhere you like.

--Pros--

--Story. Very simple, leaving room for interpretation.
--Design. A pixelated environment with little pixelated objects. 
--Details. If you pick up a board game box and shake it, you can hear pieces rattling around inside. You can solve a rubix cube, turn on tvs and radios, flush toilets, and more! 
--Soundtrack. Beautiful and fun.
--Sound effects. Suuuuper satisfying.
--Save. You can exit anytime and pick up right where you left off.

--Cons--

--Replayability. It took me roughly six hours over the course of two-three days to complete this game. Now that I've completed it, I want to keep playing. But all I can do is restart the game. Personally, more characters to unpack for would be awesome, instead of just one. But that would probably take an insane amount of work.
--Placing. For the most part, you can choose where you want everything to go. Some items go in certain locations. For example, a pair of scissors goes in a drawer. Makes sense. But a bottle of air spray took me forever to find a place for, when it could've just gone on an open space on an open shelf. 
--The coffee achievement. Well, I do need to point out that I've never made coffee...

If you enjoy being able to organize your environment, I highly recommend giving this game a try. Cute, fun, and simple. Have a good day ;D

Porem seria perfeito se, em vez de ter saves em cada álbum, ser ou uma história de ponto de vista diferentes ou a continuação com o crescimento ||do filho da protagonista|| ou até outra história sem nenhum envolvimento com a protagonista inicial. O jogo tem 4 horas, pelo menos de duração, e nelas você viverá uma experiência de intimidade com uma personagem que nunca vê e uma história que nunca é contada explicitamente. Levando em conta que houveram várias participações no processo de produção do jogo, eu esperava que ele pelo menos tivesse uma gameplay mais longa(onde se encaixa a ideia dos saves serem na verdade álbums de outras pessoas). Unpacking tem uma gameplay muito confortável e indico para todos, além que existe uma profunda reflexão, que vivemos nossas vidas um passo de cada vez ou abrindo uma caixa de cada vez, vamos passar por dificuldades mas sempre terá alguém do nosso lado, tudo que se passa em nossas vidas serão memórias que precisamos levar como aprendizado, tudo que vc leva contigo se torna uma parte da sua vida para sempre, entretanto, é necessário saber discernir quais coisas vc vai levar. Nesse jogo vc tem como vê coisas novas e vê diferentes pontos de vistas da vida.
Nota: 9.5/10

Very cute and refreshing game! An excellent way to destress after a long day. 

PROS: 
- STORY: For a game without dialogue, there is so much story here. I love how the items that you are unpacking and placing tell so much about the MC. You really feel connected to the MC as you go from each home, with the ending tugging at your heartstrings. 
- MUSIC: This is the sort of game you HAVE to play with sound on. The music is such an integral part of the story telling by setting the emotions for each place. Sometimes, I would just leave my computer on as I listened to the music for a couple minutes before doing the stage. 
- SOUND DESIGN: This sorta connects to the last point but I love the sound design in this game. It adds to the satisfaction of unpacking when the objects sound like they are actually interacting with the environment. For example, placing books on top of the bed or the floor sound like they are actually being placed on those different areas, I also love how the acoustics of the room are also accounted for, as things being placed in a relatively empty bathroom sound more echo-y than a dampened bedroom. 
- ART: Self explanatory. I mean, just LOOK at it. :)))) 

CONS: 
- PRICE: For a $20.00 USD normally, I feel as though it is pricey for the amount of content you are given. However, if you can grab it on sale, it is totally worth your money!! 
- REPEATABILITY: While I have 11 hrs on record, there is technically about 1-2 hrs of gameplay (depending on how particular you are with your organization). I wish there was a way for the levels to be different for a sort of infinite mode as the levels do get repetitive after a while. This is the sort of game you can only play once (plus the achievements if that is your thing).

This game is PERFECT for exploring the "AFTER happily ever after". Ending the way it did felt more like the developers ran out of time or steam, which is not a great feeling to end with.
A bit strange I feel that way when there are 8 stages to unpack? But it just felt like the story reached a happy and exciting point, to cop-out right as the biggest adventure begins feels unfulfilling.

Completing the game (even while taking breaks with it open, and taking my slowest time to unpack) took about 6 hours. I feel the story is a wonderful thing to experience, yet admittedly can be experienced through videos. The gameplay is something else though- something about it is so crisply and cleanly designed. Putting everything in it's proper place- it truly sucks you in to the experience!

This is a casual little time-waster with a nice pixel aesthetic and low-stress premise. You basically follow the unnamed main character through her life from her childhood room to college to adult apartments and finally a home with her partner and child. At each stop, you unpack each box in the home, take out objects, and place them in an appropriate place in the room or elsewhere in the home. Once everything is in its place, you advance to the next level. Simple, right? Boring? Maybe, if you only just play the game to solve the puzzles and don't pay attention to what's going on. The belongings you unpack and the homes you unpack them in give subtle clues about the story of the main character's life over the years, the development of their career, the ups and downs of their love life, etc.

Unpacking is a click-and-drag puzzle game with a strong narrative subtext. The puzzle aspect is extremely understated, as most levels offer plenty of space to unpack into. Where the game really shines is storytelling through exploration of the spaces and the evolution of the protagonist's possessions. The limitations and opportunities of each new room convey a lot of information and the emotional impact is surprisingly high. 

The biggest weakness the game has is its emphasis on extremely specific cultural elements. I can't imagine playing this as a non-American or someone born before 1980 or after 2000. It would also be easy to just play this as a straightforward puzzle game and be confused as to why it is so praised; however, if you do get invested in unpacking, arranging possessions, decorating the spaces, and learning about the protagonist - if you play the game on its own terms - it is an exemplar of interactive storytelling.

As a small unpacking simulation game, I think the game captures the time-consuming and emotional aspects of the unpacking process throughout the various life stages well. Although there is only one story to play through, the items in the moving boxes subtly reveal more about the character's life, from new interests/hobbies to strong emotional attachments. I also admire the pixel graphics, especially when it comes to adding details to the smaller items.

After you finish the story, there is not much to do afterwards. You could reorganize the items differently, or restart a scene [for a different/better replay of the unpacking process]. Since the game could be completed in under a day with no significant post-game content, the full price of $19.99 USD is more costly than expected. I purchased the game when it had a 40% sale.

Overall, I would recommend the game for people interested in a short, casual game and/or enjoy organizing stuff as long as it's purchased at a discount. For achievement hunters, it's very easy to obtain all of the available (25) achievements.

Very cute and cozy game. You get to decorate the room with items you find in boxes. There's a little story that you can understand through all the objects that you'll find missing and the new ones.

I think this game is fun and does definitely help your mind stay busy. However I wish there was more content... It is a lot of money for what you are getting. I did not play this game long and have already completed it. 

If it is ever on sale I think it is worth purchasing.

This game is amazing and I love how you get 3 different save files allowing you to play up to 3 times. You can also use the same save file and just redo some rooms which is a really nice feature. I also like how you can either play where you have to put everything in the right spot, or you can play where you can put anything anywhere. Overall this game is really fun and I would definitely recommend that you buy it. (The only bad part is that it's $20)
cool game, but you should have a mouse to play because thats how you can rotate things and access achievements but even without a mouse the game will still work the same you just cant rotate objects.

It's like watching a tiktok where someone is organizing their groceries, but instead you have full control of where things are getting placed. It is relaxing enough to take your mind off anything that may be clutter up your headspace.

I personally LOVE unpacking in general. I love organizing things and making sure that everything is in it's perfect place.
I wish we could follow the child's journey, though I know that would be a task and a half to make.
Keep up the good work!!!

This is probably my favorite game I've every purchased. I've replayed it about 7 times already and I don't think I could get tired of it. However, developers. Y'all NEED to make DLCs or Mods or an Unpacking 2 because we all NEED MORE LEVELS!!!! We say this out of a place of love, of course. This game is fantastic and absolutely worth the cheap $15. We just want more of it!
I love this game. It's not long, but so relaxing and replayable. Worth the spend if you love organizing or just relaxing games in general.

The things we own serve as storehouses of who we are. This game perfectly encapsulates an individual (rather several individuals lives) from their childhood all the way to the point of her expecting a child with her partner. 

TBH, this game triggered my obsessive-compulsive tendencies but it was worth it. It does not take a long time to complete - the only reason it took me 5 hrs for my first play through was cause I left the house and accidentally left the game running while I was organizing the last room of the last stage. 

That said, it's a fine game. It tells a subtle story as you go through stages of the "protagonist's" life. It's a reminder that the only constant in life is change but that doesn't mean that we have to lose ourselves with that change.

its rally aestetic and personal and as someone with ocd i love the organization of it all! my only issue is ive completed it all 5 times and cant complete it or even play it again after u beat it 5 times

its a great game with a soothing atmosphere. very satisfying to play, however, it's way too short. the game is only about 2-3 hours long so i cant say i recommend it at full price, hence why i refunded it. however, if you have extra money to spare and are looking for a cute and quick game this is probably for you! :)

There is no intro to the game or explanation; it just throws you right into it. There's a story subtly placed into what new place you move into, and nothing is 100% confirmed. It's just about this person living their life and moving into new places. It's so fun and cute.

This game is so cute! It's peaceful and calming, with a simple concept and hidden tasks for achievements. The soundtrack is relaxing and enjoyable! My only issue is that the game isn't longer- I completed it in just over 2.5 hours, with the remaining 0.5 hours spent trying to unlock all of the achievements. For the cost, it would be nice if there were more levels or even DLC expansions. Overall, I would highly recommend this for anyone looking for a cute game about organising and unpacking!

i love ittt, feels satisfying placing and organising the items in the game and so many hidden secrets I'm still finding even after getting all the achievements-which was also fun to do :) I'll definitely keep going back, especially since they're bringing it to mobile phones too!!

Based on the comments, I knew it would be short. However, I was not prepared for it to be THIS short. Sure, the game is really fun, relaxing and quite addictive (at least until you finish all the levels for the first time). But if my friend asked me if they should buy it, I would say "No, it's not worth the money.". And I bought it on a discount, so I think it says a lot. If there would be more achievements, storyline or challenges, like anything that gives the player a real reason to play again, then sure. But like this? I forced myself to play it a few more times so I would not feel like I've wasted my money. It was okay, but I still felt very disappointed. HOWEVER, if you are a person that can enjoy replaying the same game over and over, then the game is definitely for you!! Literally, if they had at least a few more levels, this would have the potential to be one of my fav games. So i guess, you need to think about your preferences and decide if you really want to buy it

гра дуже класна та мила :) 
було цікаво розпаковувати речі головної героїні і додумувати, що ж з нею трапилося. Мені подобається, як автори заклали купу дрібничок, які натякають на те, куди пішов сюжет. Нам не говориться прямо що сталося, лише натякають, тож є місце для фантазії. 

Взагалі гра чудово відволікає, ви забуваєте про все і тільки думаєте куди ж всунути той клятий вазон. А ще ціна приємна! :) Тому рекомендую

This is the sweetest game I've played in a while.

You get to let your imagination run wild over the little clues around the stages, some things change, others stay. Definitely worth a sit down and unpack it all one step at a time.

The storytelling through the levels is unmatched. It can be a little annoying when the game says that something is in the wrong spot, but it's usually easy to figure out where it's supposed to go. The sound design is incredible, each item has it's own sound when you place it. This game is so heartwarming and wonderful. 

The ending made me cry like a baby but in the best way.

100000/10

I love this game. I wish there was a sequel because my only complaint is the fact that it's so short! While we're on the topic, can I PLEASE get a sequel about the woman the main character lives with at the end? I NEED more because I'm so addicted.
This has been my best purchase of any game I have played! It is so chill and cozy that no matter the day Ik I can come and replay it and have the same amount of fun as I did the first time.

I don't play a lot of video games because I'm super bad at them and they stress me out, but this one is very nice :) super relaxing and I can just unwind and de-stress instead of worrying about gameplay

A Great game for such a great price. Compared to other games the price is suitable for this game's content. A DLC Featuring the new born child's life Would be a good idea. I will Play this Heart warming experience again someday, though i did complete this in about a day. Overall Good game.

It was a lot of fun to play through, only downside is that it is quite short you can complete the whole game + all achievements in one sitting. I am hoping they come out with DLC/more albums to complete. [spoiler] Maybe following down the family line? Like you are playing as the person unpacking they eventually have a kid so maybe continue with them?[/spoiler]

Bit on the pricey side for such a short game but I'm not complaining, split it with a friend and still enjoyed it. When I bought it, I wasn't expecting it to unfold a life story, that was a lovely surprise. Very calming but fun to play :)

Just a fun little organizing game with a bit of a story line. Easy to get immersed into the life you are unpacking and the graphics are cuteness overload. Very much looking forward to more content from this game developer.

This is my comfort game. 100%. Anytime I feel upset or stressed or just need to regulate my emotions and escape for even a moment, I turn to this game. I love this game so much. I've gotten my 10-year-old kiddo into this game as well. It seems so simple, yet you do the levels over and over again because it's just that relaxing. It's just that cozy. It's just that comforting. I would love to see the developers make another Unpacking game with more levels. My only complaint is this game isn't long enough. I need more. Thank you so much to the creators of this game and I truly hope they develop a second with more levels and a story as sweet as this one.

I loved this game! So cute. I cried when I saw the credits. The only con is that there is not much content so its kind of expensive for how quick you finish the game. Please add more homes soon please :)

A bit short, but definitely worth it if you liked decorating games as a kid. This one is a bit like a puzzle as well, plus it has a nice narrative for you to follow. I do think the price tage is a bit high for the amount of hours of content, but all in all a good game.

cosy and cute but not much gameplay for 20€
would recommend to get it on sale

Cutesie little game. Surprisingly more frustrating than you might think, but for me personally it's not overwhelmingly so. It amazes me how much this game says without saying anything at all, just like real life :)

super cozy, creative, immersive game! you can get as creative with it as you want, its really up to you. spend as little or as long as you please. it has a fantastic subtle story, as you play you will notice little nods. the achievements are also super cute!

Definitely Yes! I love this game, it's very relaxing for me, everytime I feel stressed I will come back and replay some stages of this game. My real playtime should be 24+ hours or more... I love the atmosphere in the game, the Ambient bgm, the art...
The only minus point of this game is the short-playtime. The price isn't the problem due to the quality of the game, but it would be perfect if there is more stages to play.
It's great how this game can tell a heartwarming story with no text, dialogue, just picking up and placing item while watching someone grow throughout their life.

Super cute and chill game! The story line is adorable and I really enjoyed playing it, my only issue is the fact I personally feel it has very little replay-ability, I'm currently trying to get 100% achievements and am finding myself very bored going through the levels a 3rd time. I cant wait to see if they will ever add more levels with more characters and items!

I bought this game today and I finished it today. The story is super cute, and the gameplay is fun, however, I can't justify the price for how much content there is. Going into it, I didn't know how long the game was and when I saw the three albums I thought they were 3 different stories. I was very disappointed to find out its just one story.

I wish there was more to this game because it's right up my alley, but I'm really upset that I'm already done with the game. It's probably too late for DLC or a content update due to how old the game is now, but I really hope the devs add more in the future.
Super cute! Love the little details of shaking the piggy bank and the sounds of everything. The "story" is very neat too. Highly recommend if you like puzzle games!

Simple game in concept, big on feels, built on curiosity through following the tale of the things that come along with us. 

Be sure to take the snapshots and read the captions in each room before moving on to the next time period (and always stay to the end of credits sequences)
Very cute and fun game but does not have 20 dollars worth of play time. had to go organize my own house afterwards to make up for it.

I finally get to live my Marie Kondo fantasy without actually having to clean my own room.
10/10 would meticulously organize virtual socks again!
amei arrumar a casa dos outros me desestressa mas minha critica e a falta de padrao nas coisas essa maluca comprou uma torradeira vermelha e uma panela VERDE

Unpacking est l'une de ces expériences habiles, qui parvient à dire énormément de choses, avec très peu de texte. J'ai joué et apprécié ces 4 heures de contenu, et j'ai adoré m'attacher autant que notre personnage à ses petites affaires que l'on voit évoluer avec elle dans le temps. Unpacking c'est une oeuvre qui m'a parlé de mon (notre) attachement aux objets, simplement et avec un pixelart des plus élégants.

Je recommande à 100%, merci pour ce joli bijou !

unpacking is genuinely a game fun, it's also EXTREMELY calming, in my opinion. i bought it yesterday and i cannot stop playing it, i really like the calming music and how i can put the items wherever. it makes me feel like i am decorating my own room. 100/10 would recommend.

I absolutely love and adore this cute little game!! It:s a liiiitttlllle pricey for how short it is but I really enjoyed it!! As someone who is about to move to the big city I have a lot of nervousness and worries but playing this has helped me a little in the way that life moves on and I will never be stuck in one place. It:s a little sentimental for me as I realize the character gets rid of stuff and gets new stuff to replace it as I have a fondness for my belongings, but life goes on!!

This is such a sweet and beautiful game. I loved watching the story unfold through the different places we moved and watching us fall in love. The graphics were adorable and each place we lived had such different feels. The music was perfect and the ending was amazing. 10/10 game

Um jogo maravilhoso que te prende na história que é indiretamente apresentada. Super relaxante e rápido de zerar, mas ainda sim muito marcante. Os pequenos detalhes são o que dão um ar tão único para ele, contanto que, até o meu eu desinteressado em completar todas as conquistas teve que se render ao seu charme. Obviamente há algumas coisas que não fizeram tanta razão, (como alguns objetos que no final, ficavam em lugares não tão convencionais) porém, nada discrepante o suficiente para arruinar a minha experiência.

更新：音效改了 好评

能不能把你们的logo音效改一改，大晚上玩真的很吓人，本来是个解压游戏，一开声音压力更大了
LOVE this game. It gives my OCD a nice scratching and I love the repeat of items into the new houses. I think I've played this through 4 times already and I will probably continue.
Very fun and cute with a good storyline even if it doesn't really say whats going on, you kind of somewhat know. I enjoyed it a lot!

I think this was a fun, casual game to unwind with. I think the price is kind of steep for the amount of levels and the complexity of the gameplay - so, I would buy it on sale. I hope they add some DLC for the game.

I enjoy the simplicity of the game, the ambient music, and the ability to just relax and put things away. I like feeling accomplished when I've done each year and completed the game. I don't think it's worth the listed price, I waited until it was on sale to purchase. The reason I don't think it's worth the listed price is because it doesn't take very long to finish the game. I really wish they would add more content and years to the game or have different options available because I feel that so many additional things could be done to make this game go from good and fun to fantastic and amazing. Still good and fun is not so bad :)

I really enjoyed this game as it is very satisfying but also because you can make up your own story for the character. The controls are very easy and this game is very simple, adorable and fun. My only issue with the game is that to go back to get achievements you need to restart the level. But all in all I really enjoyed this game and highly recommend that you get it for yourself.

This game is so peaceful and just calm. I loved it. Such a wonderful storyline in a game without dialogue or interaction beyond just unpacking the spaces. 

(I left the game open overnight... so I probably really spent 3-4 hours on the game.)
this game is so cute and very relaxing!! I thought it might be overwhelming since unpacking irl is generally overwhelming, but it's not at all! very satisfying and wholesome, 10/10 stars :)
Gorgeous gorgeous game, I just wish it was longer. Such a simple and yet emotional journey and very clever story telling. loved it.

I have zero regrets about this one. It was a fantastic and calming experience. I was sorting things out, creating order and finding the most attractive places for things to go.
The only complaint is that sometimes I disagreed with things being allowed/not allowed to be placed in spaces.

cute artstyle, nice tunes, sweet storyline. i'd recommend this game for anyone who loves organizing things, making order out of chaos, aesthetics, and lesbians. i've played through the game twice now and it was interesting to see how differently i unpacked each room on my different save files.
honestly, i want more games similar to this one. it was incredibly relaxing and put in in a sort of meditative state. 5 hours flew by before i'd even realized it!

 also i think if you like asmr you might like this game. no tingles per se, but i get the same sense of calm from this game that i get from listening to/watching asmr vids.
It's very calming and relaxing. If you like ASMR you will like this. There is only one story, though. You can pick the color of your album at the start but they are not different story lines.

Very cute game with some wonderful details and lots of love.
Decorating all the rooms and seeing how the character "grows" with the stuff that's brought along to different places was really fun and i generally enjoyed the relaxing nature of it all.
Later on it does get slightly more puzzle based, certain things having more specific places than in the early levels since there are more rooms and such, but still a great atmosphere and just really cute to play.

It's a short experience, after little over 4 hours playtime i was able to finish the whole game, so 20€ seems like a bit much for it. Getting it on sale is 100% worth it though in my eyes.

it took me multiple a few weeks to finish the game fully, getting all achievements (a few with the help of a guide because i could not imagine what they would want me to collect/click/do) and I think that was what made the experience also as relaxing as it was - I wasn't stressing myself to finish it.

Some of the items in the game are unknown to me personally, that did however not stop me from enjoying trying to place them in the correct rooms/spots.

Overall very nice game, if a bit price-y for the amount of playtime you get out of it.
Solid 8/10
the fact theres no dialogue and its still the most intriguing storytelling of any game ive played in the last 3 years is absolutely astonishing
I personally like this game because it is so relaxing. PS. I like organizing stuff...so, I loveeee this game but too bad it's a short game

this game is so cute! I saw this game being played by a few of my favorite influencers and thought I'd give it a try and I'm very happy I did. great game, very relaxing, and good if you like slow-tempo/chill games! I recommend this to anyone who's considering making the purchase.

I really liked this game but I felt it was too short for the price and it didn't really seem fun to play over and over again. I finished it in 4 hours, and while the story was complete, I could have kept arranging new rooms with new items forever. I also wished that there was a hint or help button for when an item is in the wrong place but you can't figure out what it is or where it needs to go. Otherwise, very cute, simple, and relaxing,

An enjoyable organizational game with a subtle story woven with the items available to unpack. I was hoping each volume might have different stories but they were all the same, just additional opportunities to access the remaining achievements, all of which were simple and easy to unlock. Overall I enjoyed it but I would have preferred different stories/environments per volume and could see this continuing to be enjoyable with additional levels to explore.

Lovely, i feel some kind of control in my fears of moving and advancing through life.

At minimum its a nice and calming and ascetic experience that makes me lust for custom furniture(ie; shelves, dressers, cabinets, etc.).

This is a fun, cozy little game with a surprising amount of storytelling. It's so relaxing, I drifted off at times. It's also as detailed and goal-oriented as you make it (face everything the same way, like-with-like, lump it all together, however you want). If this somehow became a series, I would buy the subsequent games as well.

Ein wirklich sehr entspannendes und sehr schönes Spiel!
Die Grafik und Animationen sind unbeschreiblich niedlich gemacht und die winzige Story dahinter reisst einen irgendwie mit ♥
Das Einzige, was ich ein wenig schade finde ist, das man eben nur diesen einzigen Storyverlauf durchspielen kann 

Ich hoffe aber, dass es vielleicht irgendwann einmal ein kleines Update gibt und man so vielleicht noch einmal eine andere kleine Lebensgeschichte durchlebt - das würde mir persönlich sehr gut gefallen ♥

Ansonsten kann ich dieses traumhaft süße Spiel wirklich nur jedem ans Herz legen der es entspannend findet, Kisten auszupacken und Gegenstände an ihren Platz zu sortieren ♥
I highly recommend this particular experience to individuals who may be dealing with anxiety or have difficulty achieving a state of relaxation.

It was a really fun game with a cute story with it. I didn't even realize how long I was playing until I finished and Steam said I played for 4 hours XD. Nice easy game for me to distract myself on my sick day.

The music is calming and makes for a perfect relaxing game with zero pressure. You have complete freedom in some chapters and in others you have to make room for yourself. I love the story of the game as it goes on. Who knew a game could be so awesome with zero talking! I highly recommend this game to anyone who likes to organize and chill out while doing it.

Plushies are always and forever your best friends <3
Seen this game played by YouTubers before but even then, playing it on my own was an experience for me and I very much enjoyed it along with the story behind each stage throughout the familial's life.

One of the cutest and most relaxing games I've played!! The music is soothing and the story brought a tear to my eye. It's crazy what kind of world you can build just by unpacking boxes, haha. I would definitely recommend this game to anyone willing to put a few hours into it ^^

I absolutely love this game. I play this game still even after I've beaten it multiple times. It's such a nice winding down game if you're having a bad day. And don't even get me started about the story! It's so lovely and as a bisexual woman it makes me feel seen. Like I related to the story SO much and I've never felt that way about a game before. Thank you for this game <3
A chill and cosy game to play. This is so good! I would recommend it for a wholesome and relaxing play through with a heartwarming story.
very cute game, but you don't really get the most playtime out of it (i finished in 4 hours) so i recommend getting it during a sale. adorable, heartwarming game.

One of the best organization, zen games I have ever played. I feel like $20 for its current price is TOO CHEAP. Totally buying this for my OCD friends. Such a niche, adorable, and visually stimulating game with a creative illustrative timeline. 10/10.

This game is very cozy. While there are some restrictions on where items should be to finish off a level it is like the organizing of a new space just with less stress of real life. Will be playing more.

I love love love games where I can organize stuff and Unpacking really gives you that with pleasant pixel art and a beautiful story that you can see unravel as you unpack the protagonists life <3 

I have no complaints other than I wish there was even more for me to play. I would literally eat up a second game just like this again just for the pure satisfaction unpacking and organizing everything gives me.

I definitely recommend this game to everyone <3

Love the fact that a storyline is so easily interpreted without needing any words. An absolute delight and satisfying to play through; for the perfectionist in me wanting to make every place in the game look as 'tidy' as possible. The achievements were also fun and easy to gather. Lovely design and style too, not a single complaint. Great job devs!

Absolutely adored how peaceful and relaxing this game was.
It also made me think about my own relationship and how it SHOULD be compared to how it is: a housewife to a manchild.

Definitely recommend for those of the chill and simple games. OH MY GOD, THE SOUNDTRACK IS AMAZING!!

What a sweet and gentle game with lots of therapy involved! Putting things away never seemed so satisfying until playing this gem. Well developed, well executed in design; I absolutely love all the little items that were made to be unpacked in this game. The story development is also very unique! Would love to see this as a series. Unpacking 2 - lets go!

A very cute and relaxing game! I enjoyed the "story", though I wish there was a bit more depth to it. Maybe some letters, photos or other small details to let us get to know the characters a bit more. Right now, the story is mostly what you make of it (but maybe that's the point?).

I genuinely laughed a few times, especially when the MC moves in with the guy. Waaaay too relatable. I spent a good 30 minutes just reorganizing all of his stuff... Totally worth it though ♡

One thing I didn’t love was the end-of-level blinking. Once you've emptied all the boxes, anything placed “incorrectly” starts flashing red. I get it - it’s helpful if you’re trying to finish quickly, but if you’re like me and want to lay everything out before doing the final touches, the blinking gets rather annoying.

Overall, I had a good time with it. That said, I do agree with many of the other reviews. The game is way too short for the price (20€). Imo, wait until it's on sale before buying it!

Very sweet and simple game, that tells a story without any real dialogue.
More like a puzzle game of sorts. I've played it twice already, so yes, I would recommend it if you want a sweet chill game to play

infelizmente deixei o jogo aberto e fui fazer outras coisas, então não consegui reembolsar por ate 2hrs de jogo
jogo lindo e muito divertido, mas não recomendo por o jogo ser absurdo de curto
pagar 60 reais por uma história que não tem nem graça repetir é sacanagem
tentei jogar outras vezes e fazer alguns amigos jogarem na minha conta pra ver se fazia valer um pouco mais o preço

se tivesse pelo menos alguma atualização com mais histórias

I love this game so much! the music is so soothing, the art style is to die for, and the gameplay is so relaxing. The hidden story as you unpack the boxes is so cool to witness, it's really neat! I think the part I love most are the SOUND EFFECTS. Everything sounds different and it's so satisfying when I pick up a jar of pencils, it makes a fun clinking sound. This game is so relaxing and I recommend it to anyone who wants a chill game to play in your free time!!
Tells a story through the lens of having to unpack into new and different places and what items like the pig plush has stayed the same over the years.

You can rotate and stand books up which is awesome. It's a fun game but definitely not worth $20. It was very short. They could've added several different homes to this. Wish I didn't pay so much for it. But it was fun while it lasted. I would love to see other stories added on. I really hope to see more games like this come out. It was so fun. I've actually played it 2 or 3 times now. Just wish there was more to it
divorce arc!!!!!!! no this is a really nice and relaxing and fun game, love it :] but also good luck figuring out the fridge magnets and stuff lmao

The game works as intended and is relaxing and very casual.

However, cannot recommend it as £15.49 is grossly overpriced for 3-4 hours worth of gameplay.

You can buy a real game for this money.

very relaxing game but can be stressful when something doesn't fit where you want it to go. I find myself super into the character and whats happening in her life. who knew you can learn so much from a person just by unboxing there stuff.

A beautiful story hidden in a puzzle game. Pay attention to the environments, and her life story is all there to see. 

What a great game. 15 out of 10. I cried sad and happy and it was so so so cathartic.

This is a beautiful and well done game. Very cozy and relaxing. I am very impressed with the storytelling even though there is no dialogue. Would love a second story/game I was sad when I completed everything because it meant I was finished. Would love more, it's so cute
Cute and relaxing game. A good story even though i didn't expect there to be any. I would recommend this game to anyone needing a chill and relaxing game to play for a few hours. <3

Love the game, the vibes are everything, and its a wonderful way to relax. My only issue is the price, its not worth the 20$USD for only a few levels, if there was extra levels for after completing the game or like a free play for when you finish the story I definitely would say it was worth the price, but as it is currently wait for the game to go on sale then buy, there is not enough content to be worth the 20 bucks your gonna spend on it.

Even though the game is short, I enjoyed every minute of it. It is a simple and yet comforting game to play. 
A few hours of unpacking and decorating your rooms. I wish they come out with a 2nd or more stories.

i was playing this game and I realized that this was pretty much just me and my partner. Love the representation, even if its really subtle. This is one of the first times I've seen a chronically ill/disabled queer person in any sort of media, and so it was really nice.

This game is slightly repetitive, but is great for a calm night. The music is nice, it's a very aesthetic game and it's quite soothing. I love the whole story, you unpack someone's life, and it show's the journey the characters are. There's room for self expression, within reason. You can really place things anywhere you want, if the game doesn't allow it, it let's you know.

Personally, I find this game to have an equal stress to reward ratio. As the levels go, the more boxes their are, the more to organize. However, the story and knowledge of the person your unpacking for actually make a nice hindsight. And I end most the levels feeling rewarded for the time spent. 

If you enjoy organizing or if you could care less for it, either way, the game is definitely worth playing if you want a fun, time consuming, and rewarding experience.

such a unique and charming game that manages to engage with its gameplay loop while also providing a heartwarming story in the background, rich with details that reward attention, brilliant brilliant game

I was so excited to sink some real hours into this game but was left a little disappointed when it was done. I thought the different photo albums would be different story lines or characters, but unfortunately they are just different save files of the same story. I finished it in about 4 hours and I really enjoyed my time, but for the cost I was expecting a lot more.  I wouldn't pay full price for this game but I do recommend it as a relaxing and interesting time passer.
If you just want a chill time with a little story while you relaxingly unpack and sort your living space, look no further. Cute design and just a good, slow time.  10/10

A very light recommendation. 
Telling a story via unpacking moving boxes is a very original idea, and to that end they did a good job. Certain things are up to interpretation, but there is still a very satisfying ending. 

My issue though is that unpacking boxes is boring in real life, and that issue translates over to the game. 

Would still recommend though. Grab it on sale, put on some music, and chill out.

복잡한 게임을 계속해서 그런지 잠깐 쉼이 되주는 게임을 찾고 싶어졌습니다. 
그래서 스팀 목록을 뒤지다가 방청소 하는 게임이라길래 이거 신선한데 26일에 엔딩을 냈습니다. 

게임 스토리는 크게 중요하지 않고 1997년부터 2018년까지 주인공이 옮겨간 방들을 정리하는 게임입니다. 사실 스토리가 있긴 하나 후반부에 큰 스포일러급이라서
직접 찾아보시는게 좋을거 같습니다.

게임에 처음 진입하게 되면 1997년부터 2018년까지의 방 사진첩이 있는데 한 스테이지를 클리어할때마다 짧막하게 그림일기 식으로 붙여져있는게 특징입니다. 

첫 스테이지는 간단히 원룸에서 시작하지만 다음 챕터와 후반부로 갈수록 1층 2층을 번갈아가면서 정리를 해야 하기 때문에 약간 피곤한 느낌도 듭니다.

아무튼 여기까지 설명을 하도록 하고 장단점을 적어보겠습니다.

장점

힐링 게임
단순히 힐링하는 게임입니다. 잡생각 없이 단 하나의 목적인 방을 정리하는 것이라
화자가 의도하는 바나 숨겨진 물건 그런 것 걱정 없이 적절한 위치에 두면 되는 게임이라 복잡하게 생각하지 않아서 좋았습니다.

거기다가 데드 스페이스라던지 칼리스토 갓오브워 호그와트 이블 위딘 등 폭력적이거나 잔인한 게임들이나 복잡한 게임으로 잠시동안의 버거움을 느끼신 분들에게 쉬어가는 느낌으로 이런 게임 어떨까 싶네요.

성취감
실제로도 청소를 평소에 즐겨하는 사람 제외하고는 귀찮아 하는 경우가 많잖아요?
그래도 막상 심각해서 청소해야 겠다 하고 깨끗해진 새 방을 보면 의외로 기분 좋은 경우가 있듯이 이 게임도 잘 정돈된 방을 보고 있으면 뭔가 기분이 좋아집니다.

적절한 난이도와 브금 옛 감성
적절한 난이도는 이제 이 게임이 단순히 방정리 시뮬레이터라고 착각한 사람들에게 해당되는 말입니다. 단점에서도 이 점을 쓸건데 엄연한 퍼즐게임입니다. 그래서 간혹 정리하는 과정이 잘 나가다가 알 수 없는 잘 안쓰이는 물건이 나왔을때에 어디다 놓아야지 하는 공간지각능력+센스가 들어가기 때문에 마냥 쉬운 게임이 아니라는 점은 좋았습니다.

브금은 게임을 하는데 있어서 큰 거슬림 없이 적절히 녹아들었고 옛감성은 과거부터 현대까지의 레트로함과 트렌디함을 넘나드는 가구들이 나타나면서 추억회상 하는데 좋았던거 같았습니다. 

PC
이 점은 언패킹을 클리어하고 나중에 나무위키 스토리 목록을 들여다보면 주인공의 가구들에 대한 미스터리한 점이 풀리실 겁니다. 요즘 PC가 노골적으로 나와서 작품의 질을 해치는 가운데 이 게임은 캐릭터가 등장하지 않고 약간의 나레이션과 짧은 후일담만 등장하는 걸로 봐서 거부감 없이 할만한 게임인 거 같습니다.

단점

퍼즐 게임
위에서 언급했다싶이 이 게임은 시뮬레이터 게임이 아닙니다. 단순히 방 꾸미는 게임이라고 생각하셨다가 낭패를 볼 수 있는게 물건을 다 배치하면 빨간 띠가 나오면서 다시 가구들을 게임이 원하는 위치에 바꿔야 합니다.

거기다가 아이템 정리를 하다보면 이게 뭐지 하면서 우리나라에서는 안 익숙하다던지 형체를 알아볼 수 없는 물건들이 종종 등장해서 센스가 없으신 분들은 좀 어려우실 수도 있습니다.

회전 각도와 수납
수납은 기본적으로 다 되어 있는데 아쉬운 점을 뽑자면 물건 안에 다른 물건이 못들어 간다는 점입니다. 예를 들어 가방이 나오고 다음에 책이 나왔는데 가방을 열어서 책을 보관할 수 없다는 점과 휴지가 나왔는데 쓰레기통에 못 넣는다던지를 들 수 있습니다.

회전 각도는 수납이 가능할거 같은 공간이 있는데도 왜인지 방향 회전이 되지 않아서
될거 같은데하면서도 안된다는 점이 이해가 안갔습니다.

짧은 플레이타임과 그렇지 못하는 가격
일단 플탐이 길어봤자 7시간 최소 집중하면 4시간 컷입니다. 그런데 가격은 2만원을 넘어가니 저야 할인해서 만원에 샀다만 4시간 치고는 가격이 너무 짠 느낌이 들더라구요.

I could play this game 100 times over.  It is everything you could want from this style of game; colorful art, tone setting music, satisfying game play, and a beautiful story woven into the game play itself.  I never thought a cute, house decorating game could bring me to tears with it's story.  There are so many tiny details, you have to play at least twice to really appreciate the time and love put into this lovely game.  I am onto my fourth play through and still in love - 15/10 would recommend!

This is an adorable game that can occasionally hit you right in the feels.  The story is uniquely told by unpacking the girl (then woman)'s stuff over the course of her lifetime as she moves to each stage of her life. It is amazing what kind of story you can tell just by looking at someone's belongings- and where they ultimately want to keep them.  I really felt for her and was happy that the game had a happy ending.  This has excellent replay value for me as I try different ways to organize her stuff.  It scratches some kind of itch in my brain. lol

reviews.review: Oyun bir evden başka bir eve taşınan eşyaları kolilerden çıkartıp düzenlemek üstüne kurulu. Bu sayede de oyun bize farklı bir hikaye anlatımı sunuyor. Oyunda bir kızın 1997'den 2018'e kadarki macerasını görüyoruz. Kutulardan çıkan eşyaların yıllar içindeki değişimini oyun gerçekten de çok iyi aktarıyor. Hele ki çocukluğumuzdan kalan atsan atılmaz satsan satılmaz eşyaların peşimizden sürüklenip raflara, dolaplara sıkıştırma çilesini güzel yaşatıyor. İndirimde alınmasını öneririm. Benim şansıma oyunun fiyatını karşılayabilecek parlak kart çıktı.

Unpacking é uma obra prima! Apesar do preço salgado em relação ao tempo de gameplay, o jogo é ótimo. Parecendo que é só um jogo de guardar coisas, ele conta uma pequena história de uma mulher ao longo 20 anos, que se muda alguma vezes ao longo de sua vida.

Super chill game, placing things is intuitive and personal. A very good game, absolutely recommend!

Easy, pleasant to look at, casual, has light puzzle elements, overarching narrative is largely told through level design while unpacking on each level. Definitely an interesting and unique story-telling approach, but could make the game seem narratively empty if you overlook the context clues.

$20 price tag is a bit steep for a game that can be 100%-ed in under 4 hours, but that's also the price of movie tickets + concessions for a film with half the run-time as this game, so honestly it's pretty fair. 

Replayability isn't high but also not non-existent. It's a casual game with soft narrative elements, just install it when you're having a casual/chill afternoon and don't want to commit to a longer game. I wouldn't be interested in revisiting this game on a weekly, or even monthly, basis, but I'd be down for a play-through like once a year or so.

More content or DLC would be dope, the visual design and chill vibes are great. Would love to see more rooms (garages, attics, offices), or even garden settings. Pretty much anything I should be cleaning irl haha.

Anyone saying that they blew through Unpacking too quickly did not play this game as it was meant to be played. Unpacking is the very definition of a "cozy game;" you're supposed to settle down with it and take everything in. And there truly is SO much to take in; the developers thoughtfully and lovingly crafted every single element of this game. I got so lost in the environments and the storytelling that by the time I finished, warmed and crying happy tears, 8 hours had gone by without me even realizing it. I just finished my second play-through so I could try the "put items anywhere" mode (so satisfying!) and nab all the fun stickers. :)

This easily became one of my favorite games ever. "A Little to the Left" wishes it was this. Just get it. It's truly wonderful.
Such a cute and relaxing game, warning though it's highly addicting cause I sat down to try the game and ended up finishing the game. It has such nice graphics and a cute storyline.

Really cute game - fun puzzle capacities and a really nice intersection of storytelling and gameplay. This is definitely a game to buy on sale as there's only a few hours worth of gameplay total, which makes it worth it on sale but not really worth it for full price.

The game is beautifully made and the artstyle is so calm and simplistiqe. The game is realy relaxing. The only thing i would change is the amount of levels. I do feel like i payd more then what was in the actual game. The game feels like a demo. I would love it if they expanded the game with more povs of different ppls lives.
But all in all, its a great game.
Though it only took me around an hour before finishing the whole game and unlocking all achivements on steam.

A lovely little game all about unpacking your things after a move. Everything is just perfect from the sound design, to the soundtrack, and the graphics. All in all it took me about 3 and a half hours to get through all of the 5 or so levels although I only completed about half of the achievments.

Very chill and comfy little game.

[b]Cozy game with nice graphics![/b] If you like building in the Sims games, this one is also easy to enjoy.
It has, however, short gameplay, both in the playthrough and achievements. I recommend getting it when it's on sale if you don't want to spend time redecorating the same areas.
生活中不怎么整理东西的我，居然在游戏里整理了五个小时。随着一次次搬家，把物品一件件拿出来摆好，可以发现有些东西一如既往地保存着，有些东西却不想再见到。游戏本身没有剧情，但是也可以从中发现人生的变化轨迹。希望加入提示模块，毕竟有的东西真的不知道是什么应该放在哪。。。

Super fun and relaxing but way too short. I went through the entire game in like three hours. Really hope the devs are planning on adding DLCs or something because as of right now it is severely lacking content.

this really helps me calm my stress and ♥♥♥♥. the game actually has some really awesome lore and its nice to learn about it as you play. I've only played for like 3 hours but its really helped me whenever I've felt neglected. its a nice way to block everything else out and just imagine you're unpacking in your cute new place. the graphics are so cute and so is every feature in the game. all the items and rooms are so adorable and homey. its honestly so adorable it makes me sad. I wish i had the things our character has. As our character grows up its nice to see what stays with them through the years and what they grow out of. Overall its a really well developed game<3.
