O jogo é muito bom e relaxante, super recomendo. Só acho que pelo preço não vale muito a pena, mesmo comprando na promoção ainda estava caro para o tempo de jogo. Se for pra comprar, espera uma promoção, mesmo ainda estando um preço meio meh ainda tá mais em conta que o valor original.

Super chill, cozy, adorable and charming game, lots of love poured in it by devs <3
While I do respect the work put into this game, I don't think the price fits the time it took me to complete the game : without rushing I 100%ed Unpacking in 3.5hrs, so I would strongly advise to wait for a discount to buy the game

เป็นเกมที่เรียบง่าย น่ารักดี ในการแกะของวาง ก็จะทำให้เราสังเกตชีวิตของเจ้าของห้อง ที่เติบโตขึ้น ของบางอย่างยังคงอยู่ไม่ว่าจะผ่านไปกี่ปี รสนิยมแฟร์ชั่น เทคโนโลยีต่างๆ หน้าที่การงาน เปลี่ยนไปตามเวลาแต่ละปี แนะนำให้ซื้อตอนลดราคา เพราะเกมก็ค่อนข้างสั้น แนวเล่นเพลินๆไม่คิดอะไรมาก เหมาะกับคนไม่ค่อยมีเวลาเล่นเกม

This game is relaxing. it's a sweet story and cute graphics. One huge problem...
It's way too short, even if purchased on a discount. They definitely need to add several new stories. Come on team, it's such a simple game you need to add huge content updates.

Super süßes, kleines Spiel mit viel Liebe zum Detail :) die kleine Story am Rande kam für mich unerwartet, aber dadurch ist es noch viel besser ^.^ Für mich bisher einer der absoluten Highlights der Spiele 2023, gerne mehr!

A game that you can play multiple times and never get sick of! The only downside is that there isn't more than one story-line to explore and ''unpack'', other than that you won't regret purchasing this game if you love all things cozy.

Beautiful game.
Cute graphics and I admit I've never been touched so much by a story that is told just by objects and rooms. There are so many good things I want to say about this game, but I just finished it for the first time, and I simply can't find the words...
It was a nice game, decent length, but re-playable. I enjoyed the options to place items in places wherever I wanted.

Cute and wholesome kind of casual game. For those times when you don't want to see bloody crime scenes or learn to pick locks, I guess. 
The only sort of negative thing I could say is its a bit short. Otherwise everything about it is pleasant and well designed, and the player has lots of freedom to make their own choices.
Cute game with very sweet environmental storytelling but very short for the price. Hard to justify buying for 4-5 hours' gameplay unless the sale discount is significant.

A very charming and relaxing game with fun puzzle elements to placement. I love that this game can tell such an emotional and satisfying story only through music, environment, and the contents of someones boxes. makes you think about how much the things we choose to bring with us and keep tell about us as people. all love for this game from me! also you can put the toaster in the bathtub!

Kafa dağıtmak ve işinizin olduğu bir dönemde boş vaktinizi değerlendirmek için çok güzel. Bir yandan bir hikaye de dönüyor arkada, öyle çok detaylı bir şey değil ama eşyalardan birinin yanına mı taşınıyoruz, biri mi bizim yanımıza taşınıyor ya da  tek başımıza bir eve mi geçiyoruz görebiliyoruz, kıyafetlerden yanına taşındığımız kişinin cinsiyetini öğrenebiliyoruz, hobilerini öğrenebiliyoruz, sonraki bölüme geçtiğimizde yeni aldığımız eşyaları görebiliyoruz vb. ve açıkçası bu benim çok hoşuma gitti. Hikayeyi tahmin etmeye çalışmak en çok zevk aldığım şeydi. Keşke karakter yeni oyun alıp durmasa ya bıktım cd yerleştirmekten :') Ve bir de en önemli eşyalardan bizimle her yere gelen domuzcuk.. Sakince kafa dağıtmalık çok güzel bir oyun 10/10 diyebilirim sanırım :3

Unpacking is a cute experience. The stages tell a story and they took me onto a nostalgia trip through my youth and gave me a glimpse of the experience of moving together with someone, among other things.

The gameplay consists of a few hours of relaxing, methodical busywork. It was fun and satisfying in a way similar to the time I've so far spent in PowerWash Simulator, but unlike it I would have liked more to do. 

The game was over before I even got started and in that sense I don't feel like I got my moneys worth, even after the generous -40% sale I grabbed it on.

Regardless, I enjoyed Unpacking immensely and hope the money I spent sponsors more from Witch Beam in the future.
打折入比较好，游戏篇幅太少了，不够玩，剧情也不错，不难，不需要攻略，感觉很解压

Very fun game, but just way too short (especially for the full price at 20€). Would love if there was a free mode and also would like if I could tidy up stuff already in the rooms to make them less messy. I would still definitely recommend it, but maybe wait for a sale.
Very relaxing game. Would have liked to have multiple playthroughs for different characters such as a male MC, an MC with a foster home childhood etc.
A relaxing game that takes you through the life of a child all the way to adulthood. Who knew unpacking someone else's life unpacks certain emotions within you?

Super relaxing and cozy game that has helped me whenever I've felt stressed or on the verge of sensory overload. I just sit down, focus on the game and forget about everything. I honestly wish we had more levels, but I can appreciate the story the levels we got follows. Love this game, couldn't recommend it more if you are in need of something to unwind completely
This is a very mellow game with great atmosphere and music. I do wish there were more "levels" or an additional story, besides that it is a fantastic game.

This a cute game i love how simple the concept is and also touching, from a playing aspect it has minimal to no difficulty something simple and easy to play to pass time! though the price is high i feel like its a good play, taking up maximum 3 hours to complete i feel this is something which could be used in many circumstances game play is a 10/10 and so is everything else! just take caution when buying as the game isn't a 24/7 experience, rather a moment in time game-play.

全実績解除しました！
整理整頓が好きな人にはとにかく性に合うゲームで新鮮。
ただ単に荷解きするだけではなく、主人公の住まいや持ち物の変化で、どのような人生を送っているのか想像できるのがとても楽しかった…！
個人的には、同棲からの流れがリアルでよかった。写真のくだりとかも…
また整理整頓したくなったらプレイすると思う。

This is by far the best game I have ever played in my entire life! the calming soundtrack, the pixel-y look, just everything is so good! I have no complaints about this game. The story of watching this girl grow up going from house to house is so heartwarming. This is a good cozy game that will relax you. 10/10

Beautiful game, perfect for a break from studies or work. The art is great, the sounds satisfying, and the music adorable. 
You may think this game is completely chill at first but, if you're a perfectionist, you may feel frustrated at times when not finding the right spot for things.
However, good story line and game overall. Perfect for cozy gamers.  :)

This game is really calming, a perfect way to calm down. Though there is some limitations, there are not many. There are so many little secrets to uncover, I had to watch a 1 hour video to find them all. Also the art and graphics are absolutely beautiful. I would definitely recommend this game to people who like calming and simple games, people who like to find secrets and people who like story games.
One of my favorite cozy games to play. Very relaxing. The only downside is there's a limited number of maps and no DLC. Would love for more fresh unpacking maps.

Not difficult, but sometimes unclear where something goes. There are objects that I simply cannot fathom because they appear to be something other than I perceive. maybe a cultural difference? Often takes several tries to figure it out. Still, it's enjoyable. 
You start with a small space and work up through larger homes and houses. Sometimes moving items up or down a level or between rooms can be annoying to place, but overall the game is worth the effort.
Kudos for developing a peaceful, non-violent game that can be played by all ages.
One of the most beautiful games i've ever player, this one will stick with me for sure. A Masterclass in narrative design.
Small, quaint slice of life game that'll have you wasting the hours away without even realizing it. Really cute. Visuals were soothing, music was nice and relaxing. Solid 9/10.

absolutely adorable, amazing storytelling through the environment.

I only wish there were more games with the same format, I could sit and unpack boxes for little pixel rooms for hours if I could.

A short, but very sweet little game. It takes you through the stages of life, through moving out and gaining independence, to moving in with roommates, to finding love. The amount of cute details in this game is astounding, the music and the graphics are wonderful, and the achievements are fun and silly. Highly recommend for anyone who just wants a nice, relaxing game to play

Really relaxing, but also anxiety inducing game. 

It's pretty fun if you like organizing stuff (which I do), but can be a bit frustrating when you think you don't have enough space or don't know wth is this item (took me a while to realise roll of paper is actually rolled up poster and that notepad thing for a fridge gave me a lot of grief). 

And it's pretty creative way to tell a story - practically no exposition, just small notes under pictures and items themselves. [spoiler] For example, I liked how when she broke up with her boyfriend, their photo could not be placed where she could see. Or how you realise she's got new girlfriend, cause of new boxes and there're dresses. Or how she collected more chicks (heh) and tourist places figurines as years went on. Or small details, like you can't move your roommates things, but can move your bf things. [/spoiler] I enjoyed discovering story this way.

But for the love of god woman, how, HOW does one shoe ends up in a box of kitchen supplies??
Nevermind, still love the game, 10/10 play to relax.

10/10 lovely relaxing gameplay, a story told by time and objects, amazing sound track, and something you can always come back to and replay.

My only negatives: No DLC, No Updates, No Modding Support
Yes the story of the character, the CREATOR was wrapped up, but there is so much room for more and I crave more. The replay-ability is a amazing though.

The gameplay is amazing, there is no time limit, there is no scoring system. You aren't in a rush to unpack everything and can take this at your own pace. Because of this relaxed gameplay you can see every little object and see a story being told, this isn't just someone growing up, but finding themselves, finding love, and going though loss. The sound track lulls you into a sense of comfort and the sound effects of EVERY LITTLE OBJECT ON DIFFERENT SURFACES is so delightful! I still find little things when I go back and play, and it just adds to the charm. I love this game and will always go back to it.

Expanding on the "downsides" and this in no-way impacts the game play. Like I said earlier, this person's story has come to an end (or is this the start of a new chapter?). It didn't feel as if the story was short, I even shed a little tear at the end, but I wish there was more. I have seen many great indie games like this FLOURISH within the modding community, but that is not possible, and it hurts. I am hoping and praying for DLC in the future. Still, don't let that deter you from reaching the end. Once again this is an amazing game with so much heart and soul laid into all the environments and items.

Relaxing, chill puzzle game with nice graphics and soundtrack.  Many different ways to organize all the spaces, and can be personalized to how you want it or how you think the main character would like it.

I bought the same full price - as much as I love the game, it wasn't worth the price. Even if I replay it for the achievements, it still isn't worth the price. I wish there were multiple stories. Very conflicted as I love the game but feel a little disappointed by how much I spent.

El juego es lindo y relajante, pero no lo recomendaría comprar al precio actual. En la primera vuelta me lo terminé en 3 horas y listo, no había mas nada que hacer. Lo recomiendo si lo encuentran con un buen descuento, pero no paguen el precio entero por esto, no lo vale.

a sweet game where the main character's journey is shown through moving from place to place. the end to this game is not truly an end, but the beginning of her life with her wife and their new baby. if you like cosy games, organising meticulously, reading between the lines to grasp a story and seeing into peoples personal lives, this is a game for you.

I only wish there was more

This game has a cute story that is fun to watch unfold and is so relaxing 
The first time I played it I was surprised at how much I enjoyed it

This game is quite relaxing and enjoyable. From the graphics, to the background music - it's all wonderful. The only downside is that there are few rooms in the game to organize. I believe there are seven in total. Though there are few levels, the game itself makes up for it. You can also earn reward stickers for finding little Easter eggs throughout the levels. Overall, this game was worth the $20.00 I spent on it.

Absolutly love the game. The storyline is very cute and every level i looked forward to finding out what stuff the protagonist has taken with her. Wished there were a few more levels though, since once you have the game done the first time you already know what is going to happen in each level. Beside though again the game is very nice and I love playing it over and over again.

I originally thought this was just going to be a generic, cozy furniture sorting game. I ended up experiencing so much more. This game is a masterclass in environmental storytelling. So many things are able to be conveyed just through the characters' belongings and the way they're able (And sometimes ALLOWED) to fill a space. The joy AND stress of filling out a room are expressed in just the right amounts - I just really can't praise this game enough for what it manages to achieve without a single word of dialogue. I need an "Unpacking 2" immediately.

Loved the style, its so cute and calming and the subtle story-line is beautiful. I finished it in about 2 hours though and don't feel the want to replay it. I wish there were new storly-ines added that you can play through!

A soundless beautiful story unfolded through hundreds of adorable items and stories with each one. The game depicts a story that allows for interpretation and customization. Its comfortable, cute, satisfying and memorable. 10/10 would recommend.
simple and nice unboxing puzzle game. you could understand the story through the game itself. its relaxing and recommended for anyone.
Such a sweet little environmental storytelling game!! I loved seeing the character progression and life changes reflected in their surroundings, very neat concept and well-executed.

This game is a lot of fun, but I really wish there were more scenarios and stories to play through. I really enjoy replaying this game, I just wish there was something new to experience when replaying, or even some kind of "endless" mode like others have suggested. 

Grab it on a good sale- it's a great little story with a very charming art style. I just want more.

love this game. easy fun and chill. My speed for sure. ps i really did not play that many hours i just leave everything on overnight. However my biggest gripe is that the ending is not clearly an ending at all. You just finish the level like every other level and youre like okay next level and its just not there. kinda soured the end for me because of how silly that was. The last chapter is 2018 for those who want to know. but definitely if theres more coming i get that but it seems like a completed game so im not sure.

I got this game for myself when it went on sale a while ago. I was hesitant to play it because I wondered how engrossed I would get (looming thesis means that I should refrain from going too far down the rabbit hole). But I was surprised that most other reviews pointed out that this game is relatively short (someone said maybe 4 hours? It took me about 6-7 for the main game). 
In the end, I really loved this game. I loved how it felt easy to pick back up and put it down again. I enjoyed getting wrapped in the story these levels created, and even got to see a bit of myself in them. I got to cry thinking about my own mortality and how my moves in life have affected myself and the people around me. I got to passionately organize others belongings just how my ADHD likes. In fact I think it does have a fine re-playability if you're like me and love to consider all the ways to organize things, going through many scenarios and applying my own internal logic. 
I highly recommend this game to anyone who likes slow-paced slightly subjective puzzles. You can either play in your mind as if you were the character whose belongings are being unpacked or as a viewer looking from the outside in. All in all, a great game and I look forward to playing it again soon!
It's a fun game, but honestly I expected more stories to be told other than the character portrayed. I wish it had more to it.
It is a very relaxing game, and i have a lot in common with the main character, so it is fun to learn about her little secrets.

I loved the game - so relaxing, fun to learn about this character's life and see their story unfold, from childhood through college, relationships and finally parenthood. It's about a four-hour play if you take your time (I've now played it on PC and Switch and I can't recommend the PC version enough), and all I can say is I wish it was longer! It would be really fun to meet more characters and engage with more levels, but I think the creators did an absolutely incredible job, and I guess all that's left for me to do is play it over again from the top.
가끔 특정 물건이 있어야 하는 위치가 정해져 있어서 약간 납득이 안 될 때도 있는데 그래픽이 아기자기하고 나름의 이야기가 있어서 그냥 편하게 할 수 있는 정리 게임. 약한 LGBT적 요소 있음 주의

Wonderful, addictive, relaxing game. It only took me six hours altogether, so I'm not certain I would have spent twenty dollars on it if I'd known it wasn't very long. Still, a beautiful, imaginative game that the developers should be proud of.  I hope they plan on making a sequel or adding on to this one.

If you need an adorable game to wind down with or just to get out of your head, I would definitely recommend 'unpacking'.
That being said, it does need to be warned that it is a very short game (taking less than 3 hours for my first run through).
I would recommend getting it on sale if you are able to wait.

I did pay full price but still thoroughly enjoyed it for what it was. If you or someone you know is the type that gets stressed out but loves gaming, highly rate this.

Never knew I could get emotionally invested in a story about organising belongings, but here we are. This game is great fun if you like organising/designing spaces, but also tells a story in such a unique way - well worth a play!

Anfangs habe ich keine großen Erwartungen an das Spiel gehabt, da lediglich nur Umzugskartons ausgeräumt werden müssen. Doch bereits nach kurzer Zeit war ich gefesselt an das Game. Für mich Spaß- und Entspannungsfaktor 10 v. 10, auch aus dem Grund das ich ein solch aufgebautes Spiel mit entsprechender Handlung noch nie gespielt bzw. auch noch nie gesehen habe. 

Leider ist die Story etwas kurz geraten so das, das Preis nicht ganz dem Leistungsverhältnis entspricht. Wer jedoch mal ein etwas anderes Spiel spielen möchte dem kann ich es nur empfehlen.
calming and fun, and also lesbians. had the aesthetics and is a quick play. Wish there were more levels but its still good.

This game took me totally by surprise and got me in the feels. The environmental storytelling in this game is absolutely genius. No 'storyline' just different households and rooms that you move in and out of as you progress through your life, unpacking your belongings. You start to recognise and remember items as the game moves on and feel a need to put them pride of place, but in some houses (for example, when you see to move in with a partner) there's limited room and you're forced to put your comfort items under the bed or in a drawer, making you feel a sense of being unwanted and uncomfortable. It's SO clever. It was really enjoyable to play and super relaxing. You can easily finish it in a couple of hours.

Unpacking was actually really good. I liked the story line and fitting everything into the places that needed to be fit into. Only thing is that the game itself is pretty short :( Once you're grown up in the game, it's pretty much done. Overall, I liked it.

Jeu très chill avec une chouette ambiance et des graphismes sympas. Très bien quand on veut juste pas se prendre la tete et déballer des cartons... ou foutre le bordel !

Un peu court cependant, il m'a fallu 10h pour faire toutes les scènes, version normal et version dark star, ainsi que tous les succès.

8/10, j'aimerais beaucoup que d'autres "albums" sortent afin de pouvoir continuer l'aventure !

Lovely game, very relaxing and calming!

The music fits very well and is comforting and the overall game mechanics are nice.
Loved figuring out where to put which item and it really calmed my anxiety at times.

I have nothing bad to say about it, only that maaaybe it should've been longer :D
A story about growing up and living life, told through a simple game of unpacking and organizing items into new and old environments.

Ich finde dieses Spiel echt klasse. Es ist sehr beruhigend und entspannend.
Was ich mir allerdings wünschen würde ist, wenn es noch ein paar Mehr Level gibt, da man dass Spiel recht schnell durch hat. : ) Ich empfehle es auf jedenfalls weiter.

More than what I expected! I have so much to say about this game!

I thought it would be a relaxing puzzle type game, and it is, but you also get pulled into the story of this unseen character. You only know her from the objects she possesses, but you start to feel that you know her well. You see her progress through different stages of life, moving from her childhood bedroom, to her college dorm, and through relationship and career ups and downs. You take notice of the things she keeps, loses, and gains along the way. You see the passage of time in chipped mugs and worn stuffed animals.

I was also surprised by the realism of the game. There are tampons! And roommates' dirty dishes! And a boyfriend's dumb decor that you can't move! The goal is not to create a perfectly tidy space, but to set this character up as well as possible to begin a new phase of life.

The end was surprisingly touching. I am not sure how the replay value will be, but I'm definitely glad I played it through once. I will probably play it through at least one more time to see if I can pick up on any details and hidden achievements I missed the first time.

I did groan a bit every time I pulled a new chicken out of the box. Like girl, stop buying all these chickens. You've got nowhere for me to put them. Buy another pair of pants instead. You have like 2 pairs of pants and 5 stuffed chickens.

Fun, quick story line. Satisfying game. The sound, music, and game play are perfect for relaxing. Also perfect for people who like to click around and organize. Achievements are cute and unique. Story line isn't intense and you'll get clues as to what's going on in the main character's life. 10/10 would recommend.

çok rahatlatıcı ama bazen de çıldırtan bi oyun kızın eşyalarının çirkinliği bazen şok etse de keyifle oynadım. en büyük eksik tek bir kişinin hikayesi olmasıydı başka karakterlerin de evini dizebilseydik çok daha kapsamlı bir oyun olabilirdi.

This game is so relaxing and fun. I loved finding all the achievments and i actually enjoyed playing through this game about three times. I really love the progression of the main character growing up and it makes my queer little heart happy to see the two women sharing an apartment and then getting a house and having a baby together. Easily one of the best part of the game. The post credit scene was so cute!
Super cozy and chill game with little plot to work over but says enough. And this is a win for people who like to organize stuff.

a fun, calm game that shows the stages of growing up and as the name suggests, unpacking your possessions over the years. it has nice details that are easily missed but fun when noticed and it has a good soundtrack as well! the only issue is that there are no new updates and for the steep price, there is not enough content (unless you play the same levels over and over again..)

i managed to 100% this game in 5.3 hrs and i personally think $20 is a little high if ur looking at it from that perspective. HOWEVER, i think theres more to games than just the amount of time you can spend playing them. it was a really unique experience and i think that the game is able to make you "feel something" with no dialogue is really neat. noticing little details and seeing someone grow up simply by unpacking boxes and making everything fit was so nice. i really enjoyed it and you can tell a lot of thought and time went into making the game. for those reasons i think its worth it.
I absolutely adored this game, it has such a sweet story to it. It was a nice game to sit and unwind without having to think too much about what you was doing. Very cosy atmosphere.

i LOVE this game, its relaxing and cute and just a great game overall! its weirdly a very nostalgic game and i love it. i like the art style a lot, very unique. the soundtrack is also really good, makes the experience even more enjoyable! 9/10 for me.
only con is a think its slightly over-priced for its length
It is an overall good game but it's very short on game play for the $20 that you will spend. It needs more levels, would recommend getting on sale.

Unpacking is an incredibly beautiful and relaxing game that I find myself coming back to whenever I need to unwind. The gameplay is so calming and straightforward, and I love how easy it is to just pick up and play. Plus, it's perfect for enjoying with a cup of tea!

One of the things that really sets Unpacking apart is the way it follows the life of a specific person and their journey through different spaces. It's fascinating to see how they grow and the relationships they build along the way. However, I do wish there were more stories to explore and more rooms to unpack - I can never get enough of this game!

Overall, if you're looking for a game to help you unwind and relax, Unpacking is an excellent choice. It's a beautiful, well-crafted experience that's sure to soothe your mind and spirit. Highly recommended!

悠閒的小遊戲, 可以滿足強迫症的慾望把東西擺整齊很舒壓, 故事隨著女主角長大而搬到不同地方, 
從每一章的結語也能明顯感受到不論年齡或是心境的成長
é muito caro pra um jogo tão pequeno e simples, mas tirando isso, é bem divertido e relaxante jogar, além de que é bem bonitinho, pena que o tempo é tão curto:/

I enjoyed this game, but I don't think that it's worth its steep price considering how short it is. I recommend it if it goes on sale for 10$ CAD and below. I paid 15.95$ CAD and I definitely believe that I overpaid for the amount of content I received.

Relaxing, intuitive, simple, pleasant, and a stellar example of environmental storytelling.

That said, the 4-hour playtime seen above is a 100% run that was subsequently artificially extended, because I completed the game BEFORE it finished dropping steam trading cards so I had to idle for a bit. It's decidedly very short, and so I feel it's a bit overpriced, but it's definitely worth getting on sale.

Unpacking is such a cute game to play! It has a great story line, and you get to follow them throughout stages of life! Plus, there's some easter eggs references hidden throughout the game that are HIGHLY worth finding! If this game ever does a sequel, I'm down for it!
This game was very fun and relaxing, definitely recommend to anyone who enjoys organizing or wants a fun cozy game to play.

I liked it, it's really chill and stress relieving, especially when you turn the red items option off. It follows a cute story that is worth figuring out. 
i however believe that it's overpriced for what it is.

At the end of the day, this game accomplishes what it sets out to do. It's just a relaxing puzzle game about placing furniture in choice spots. The environmental story telling was beautiful. Learning more and more about our faceless protagonist by not being able to place objects in certain places hit me in the heart at certain points. The main mechanic of the game gets just a bit tiring near the end. On the last level in particular, I started placing objects in somewhat questionable spots. Having something to spice up the game-play would have helped out tremendously. Maybe having vague suggestions about where some items could go would help prevent the game from being too repetitive. A co-op mode would do wonders for a potential sequel. Having a friend help take on bigger and more complex maps would make for a nice weekend afternoon. Overall, I would recommend this game, but maybe wait for a discount.

Super cute game. I loved watching the character grow up and move through life through the items she has in her various homes. Did a great job of telling a story without words, and I love the customability of where you place things. I actually played through it three separate times, and probably will again in the future.

I've played this game as someone in a very unsettled period in life, and it has a really special place in my heart now. In this game, the slow (somewhat uncomfortable) act of unpacking one's life into an unfamiliar space settles into the heart-warming process of rediscovering oneself through the objects that persist through upheavals and collections that expand. 
In other words - playing this game has helped me become less afraid of moving and all the changes that come with it. 
I would highly recommend it, especially if you like organizing other ppls stuff

O jogo é bastante relaxante e, ao mesmo tempo, desafiador, exigindo que o jogador organize todos os itens em cada cômodo de forma lógica e funcional. O jogador pode mover e girar os itens livremente, o que permite uma grande flexibilidade para criar a disposição desejada.

Os gráficos de Unpacking são simples, mas muito charmosos. O jogo tem um estilo de arte minimalista e cores suaves, ajudando a criar uma atmosfera calma e relaxante. A música e os efeitos sonoros são suaves e agradáveis, tornando a experiência ainda mais envolvente.

Uma das coisas mais notáveis em Unpacking é como o jogo é capaz de contar histórias e explorar temas emocionais através dos itens e objetos que o jogador desembala. A medida que o jogador vai desembalando as caixas e organizando seus pertences, pequenas histórias começam a se formar sobre a vida da personagem e os momentos importantes de sua jornada.

No geral, Unpacking é um jogo incrível que oferece uma experiência relaxante e envolvente de simulação de desembalar. Se você está procurando um jogo que ofereça uma jogabilidade única, uma atmosfera tranquila e uma narrativa emocional, Unpacking é definitivamente um jogo que vale a pena conferir.

The game is very easy to understand and navigate. The duration of the game is also apt for the game of its kind. I'd like to thank the people who worked on this game. Your game helped me with focus a lot and motivated me to clean my room in real life.

Thank you and more power to the team!

《Unpacking》是一款独特而感人的游戏，其主题围绕着家庭、记忆和成长展开。玩家将扮演一位将家具和物品搬到新家中的人物，逐步揭开角色的生活经历和成长历程。

游戏的画面风格简约而精致，每个物品和家具都被精细地设计和制作，让玩家感受到真实的家居生活氛围。每个关卡的场景都有不同的背景故事，玩家需要根据提示将物品摆放在正确的位置，逐渐了解角色的成长历程和心路历程。

游戏的音乐和音效也非常出色，每个物品的放置都会伴随着特定的声音和音乐，让玩家更好地感受到角色的情感和记忆。

虽然游戏看起来很简单，但《Unpacking》背后的故事和意义却十分深刻和动人。它呈现出一种关于回忆和成长的主题，让玩家通过每个物品和家具了解到角色的内心和人生历程。游戏也提供了多个关卡和难度，让玩家可以在游戏中不断探索和发现。

总之，《Unpacking》是一款非常独特和精致的游戏，它的画面、音乐和故事都非常出色。如果你想要探索关于成长和回忆的主题，那么这款游戏绝对值得一试。

近期玩过的最能让我安心和放松的游戏，在电子养胃了许久后终于找到一款风格喜欢的游戏了。30r5h全成就，可能流程会更短些。以相册的方式记录了角色的各个阶段，通过收拾房间来了解觉得的故事。

虽然故事只是只言片语透露不多但是细节不少。感觉是故事从主角的学生时代开始，考上大学后有了正在交往的男友。从通过整理收纳男友的衣服看来两个人感情还算不错，但是当看到把主角的奖项放到床底下的时候就感觉这段感情肯定不长久（可能暗示主角为了男友的放弃或是对方并不支持主角的梦想或工作）。后面主角分手后搬家，无法收拾洗衣机和马桶感觉是搬到了一个公共宿舍。同时分手把合影藏进了柜子里。
再然后主角的身边出现了另一个人。一开始以为是合租室友，后来看着发现是主角的女朋友！！（被突然的百合剧情惊喜）而出现的捣蒜的碗和小笼包案板之类的东西感觉女友可能是冲国人（而且从穿衣风格来看好像身高不高×）最后婴儿房的出现作为结束，完美he。从玩法和剧情上看都很满足，每个成就简单但是有趣！对应的贴纸也很可爱！音效和音乐很棒！算是近期来最喜欢的游戏了。

TLDR: This is a beautiful, relaxing game that manages to tell an engaging story, however, there isn't much replay ability and it is quite short. I would recommend grabbing this game on sale!

SPOILERS AHEAD!

You follow a protagonist throughout their life from their childhood bedroom to their first home and every step in-between. Using household items, clothes, toys, etc., Humble Games manages to tell the story of a lifetime. From moving into a boyfriend's house who doesn't make room for the stuff you're unboxing and having to put the protagonist's degree under the bed, to watching the protagonist's interests grow and change with new items you unbox, this game manages to tell an entire story without any dialogue or direct character interaction. I never thought items in a home could manage to tell a story so well.

On top of the amazing story, the game play is simple, fun, and relaxing. Controls are easy to manage and the achievements aren't too difficult to grab. I also enjoy the soothing instrumental music, and I love that each item has a different sound depending on what it is and where you place it. This game loves the little details, and so do I.

However, there is one drawback. I have played through this game 2 or 3 times and obtained all of the achievements, and yet I haven't even hit 10 hours. This game is unfortunately short. I would have liked to have seen more progression/levels of the protagonist's life or an additional character's story to play through, maybe even one of the partners of the protagonist! I hope to see that in DLC or a second game. In addition, there really is no incentive or reason to replay the game, as the game doesn't really vary playthrough to playthrough unless you put stuff in different places. I do still find myself revisiting it occasionally to relax, but I was ultimately glad I waited for it to go on sale.

Overall, if you're looking for a relaxing, casual gaming experience, I absolutely recommend this game. However, I also recommend waiting for a sale if you aren't in a rush to experience it!

All and all this game is pretty humble and worth checking out if you want something relaxing.

The big question people want to know is if this game is worth the price tag, and the answer is yes. I've seen reviews here overselling/hyping the game like "I laughed, I cried!" and other such cliches. I didn't believe it and waited until the game was on sale enough that I was willing to give it a try. I don't regret spending money on it, because it is true that this game tells you a story across the years of a woman's life, and the homes she moves into. The items she brings with each move, the music, the flavor-text in her photo album depending on which room you take the finishing photo in, it all tells her story. And by the end of it, the beautiful way it plays out did make me misty eyed as I listened to the ending song. Maybe people who still complain just don't find her relatable, but given the items she owned, I honestly found her relatable and felt I could be friends with her. It's a a relaxing and simple game with a surprising amount of work put into the sound design, and I now know it was worth every penny to support the studio that put so much work into this nice little game. <3

"Unpacking" is a unique and relaxing puzzle game that tasks players with unpacking and organizing the belongings of a character over a period of several years. With its charming pixel art graphics, atmospheric music, and engaging gameplay, this game is a must-play for fans of puzzle games.The game's concept is simple, but incredibly addictive. Players are presented with a series of rooms, each containing a variety of boxes and items. The objective is to unpack these boxes and place each item in its proper location within the room.What sets "Unpacking" apart, however, is its attention to detail. Every item has its own unique place in the room, and players must use their problem-solving skills to figure out where each item should go. The game also features a variety of interesting and unique items, from books and knick-knacks to video game consoles and appliances.The game's progression is also well-designed, with players unlocking new rooms and items as they progress through the years. The game also features a relaxing and meditative atmosphere, which makes it a great way to unwind and destress after a long day.There are some downsides to the game, however. The gameplay can be a bit repetitive at times, and some players may find the lack of a story or overarching objective to be a bit underwhelming. Additionally, the game's minimalist aesthetic may not be for everyone.Overall, "Unpacking" is an excellent puzzle game that offers a unique and engaging gameplay experience. Whether you're a fan of relaxing puzzle games or just looking for something different, this game is definitely worth checking out.

Such an interesting way of organizing a narrative. There's close to no actual words in the game, and there doesn't need to be any at all. The story comes across clear as day while presenting all the troubles of an actual move - where should this go, there's not enough room, how did that end up there? You get nostalgic seeing items being unpacked again and again (I particularly enjoyed seeing the DnD mini going from unpainted to painted) and you feel as though you are gleaning an intimate view into somebody's life.

As a final remark, I would just like to express my fondness of seeing the queer aspect of the story. It doesn't take up any space, it isn't an issue or a plot-mechanic. It's just there, effortlessly, and uninteresting - perfect.

Also there may be ways to tell, but there were times I couldn't figure out why something couldn't be stored on the floor. i thought a lot ab Florence, somewhat in a positive way (this is essentially a full release version of my favorite pair of vignettes from that game) but both illustrate a difficulty in constructing these kinds of domestic narratives as the greatest imaginable catharsis just seems to be Having Being Working Class Work Out For U In The End. but its genuinely sweet and kind in a way that did move me almost to tears in the last segment, and that im sure ill Remember even if i did just imply that its insubstantial. but ofc its rly most important as a proof of concept for its unique ludic storytelling, i rly cant not appreciate how thoroughly it uses all of its tools as methods of expression, including the occasionally fiddly invisible rules that determine the roughly Correct position for a thing. while there are elements of player expression, its more about empathizing with a wordless faceless character and in that way it retains the focus that allows its final segment to be such a concentrated (and completely uninsistent!) emotional crescendo. this does kinda illustrate some of my problems with Wholesome games (particularly in grounded realistic settings), as the aversion to conflict can end up a bit status quo-y for my tastes, but as a ludic and emotional exercise i prefer it quite a bit to Florence (which i do like!) and im sure i'll remember it fondly

Les Care-games, ou Wholesome games, sont un style de jeu vidéo où le but est de se détendre, de se créer un petit cocon douillet, un espace calme et paisible, un refuge pour l’esprit/âme. Ces jeux répondent à des logiques portées sur la bienveillance et le bien-être : un gameplay accessible, une esthétique enchanteresse, un but relaxant. Unpacking fait partie de ces jeux, comme Townscaper, Ooblets, Spiritfarer, Animal Crossing, ou encore Stardew Valley. De très bonnes vidéos de Game Next Door et Sofia de Game Spectrum existent si vous voulez creuser le sujet. Pour en revenir à Unpacking, le but du jeu sera de déballer les cartons de notre personnage, à chacun des déménagements de sa vie. On y découvre alors la persistance de certains objets, l’ajout ou la perte d’autres et on s’amuse à déduire la vie de notre protagoniste au travers de ses affaires. On n’est peut-être pas définis entièrement par ce que l’on possède (et heureusement), mais ce que l’on possède dis bien des choses sur nous, et c’est là tout l’intérêt du titre. Regardez autour de vous et imaginez ce qu’un inconnu pourrait déduire de vous en voyant votre façon de vous habillez, le placement de vos meubles, ou encore votre collection de films ou de jeux vidéo. Les objets parlent bien plus qu’on pourrait l’imaginer, même si on ne peut évidemment pas tout déduire ainsi. Pour conclure, un jeu aussi passionnant que relaxant que je vous conseille les yeux fermés ^^

I really enjoyed Unpacking. The simple yet engaging gameplay combined with the wonderfully-told story through each of the levels just makes for a great experience and a game that I’ll doubtlessly be replaying again down the line. There are set goals, and oftentimes you can only place objects in certain parts of the levels, but there’s enough freedom and creativity that I was able to decorate and unpack how I wanted while still being faced with a challenge in how exactly I was going to fit everything into the spots that I wanted them to go. Additionally, the graphics, sound effects, and music are all just absolutely great. In short, I’d really recommend the game to anyone on the fence about it.
好玩~~很疗愈很喜欢，把一个乱糟糟的房间整理干净就是浑身舒畅，唯一可惜的是我希望内容可以更长啊~~~~还有就是玩完后可以告诉我们一些物品到底是什么东西，有些东西我真的看不懂，基本上就是乱猜乱放的

This is a super sweet game with minimal repeatability if you're in it specifically for the story. I had a lot of fun playing it regardless, and I still go back to replay it if I need something that is mindless and relaxing. Gameplay is fun, the story is especially sweet, and overall a good time. I highly recommend it!

This game is nice and relaxing it is good when you need alone time to your self. If you are a organised person this game is most likely for you.In my opinion I like that you can turn off and on if you want the item to glow if you put it in the wrong spot at the of the level/year. I love the story it tells about from turning a kid to an married adult with a kid it shows how fast things can change.

힐링 게임 그 자체, 일기장 처럼 넘어가는 패턴, 시간이 거듭 될 수록 집의 퀄리티 같은 것들이 바뀌면서
주인공의 상황을 알 수 있는 듯한 게임. 진짜 물건 꺼낼 때마다 몇개는 갖다 버려버리고 싶은 것들도 보였다.
이 게임 하고 방정리 다시 하게 됨.
Charming, touching, relaxing game with delightful little details. Very rewarding to play all the way through and watch the story evolve.

Pros:
[list]
    [*] Relaxing, no pressure game
    [*] I like how the story can be inferred, but isn't in your face
    [*] Has a lot of cute details
[/list]

Cons:
[list]
    [*] Felt a bit too short for my liking, but I guess that means the game is good! Wish it had more levels.

    [*] In my opinion, $19.99 seems overpriced for the length of game play.

单从游戏性来讲，这款游戏画风很可爱，玩法也很解压，虽然走的是模拟室内设计的路子，但你只能在现有装潢的基础上添加物品，尽管如此，也足够那些现实生活中从没打扫过房间的强迫症好好爽上几个小时了，除了价格有点贵以外，没有太大的缺点，希望以后能增加更多的内容。
剧情方面，一向延续了西方不搞点ZZZQ就发行不了游戏的老路，这个游戏大概讲的是一个独立自主的取向选择自由的女性从小到大的故事，标准的女主受情伤然后口味改变，最后发展为两个母亲的故事，然后其中添加了些许另无神论者不适的宗教元素，至于这款游戏想传达什么呢？
也许就是异性死路一条，同性康庄大道吧。
很温馨，蛮推荐的，就是属实个别几个东西不知道是啥，纯粹是猜对了放哪的。整体蛮好的，有很多小惊喜，有很多小物件会一直跟着你，不管你怎么搬家。这些回忆都还在，甚至会陪着你的孩子
全成就通关啦 很喜欢这个游戏 很治愈 在现实中自己的房间碰都懒得碰一下 在这个游戏里却能让我沉下心来收拾整理房间 很舒服的游戏 很喜欢 心情不好的时候 累的时候 想放松的时候可以来玩这个游戏 玩完压力什么的都没了
You repeat the same stuff over and over again. It's so boring. I've downloaded this game for the second time to see if there were any improvements after a year and yet still nothing.
It's very soothing and the story is captivating. I cried because I'm going through ♥♥♥♥ and needed to feel control for just a little bit-

Hermoso juego, tranquilizante y agradable para distraerse un rato. A medida que uno avanza en el juego desempacando cada caja, vamos conociendo y descifrando la vida de esta persona, sus logros y altibajos que hacen que sintamos que crecemos con el personaje. 
Solo siento que es muy cortito, siento que pagué por 5 horas de juego. 
De todas formas, lo recomiendo un montón.

Was not worth my money. If you want to play it, wait for a sale. 

playtime through the story around 3 to 4 houers!

pro´s:

Ein Spiel das eine Geschichte durch Umzüge und auspacken erzählt. Deshalb ja auch der Name.
Jedem zu empfehlen, der einfach mal etwas abschalten möchte. Nicht nur sind die Visuals einfach zuckersüß, das Sounddesign und die "plazierbarkeit" der Gegenstände sind einfach satisfying. Zumal die Geschichte, die erzählt wird, einfach schön ist.
It's such a fun and relaxing game to play!! although I do wish it was longer, it's still a lovely game with amazing music and a cute storyline. I'm glad I spent the $20 <33

this game is adorable. i was hesitant to spend $20 on it, especially because i knew it was a rather short game, but i have no regrets. it has very relaxing game play, nice music, and a story to go along with it. it is fairly short, but i've found myself playing it over again because i enjoy it so much. if ur ever feeling stressed this is a great anti-anxiety game :).

Its short but really fun and detailed, the music is calming and helps not stressing while putting stuff away, the game also highlights stuff in red so you know where you accidentally put something wrong

This super cozy game was satisfying to play, but managed to tell a complex story at the same time! The entire game probably used less than 30 words, but each level gives you everything you need to know! Im so sad it was short though because I was having a great time (:
Oyunu Pqueen'den gördüm yayında beraber oynadık sonra ben de aldım gayet eğlendim, defalarca bitirdim. Arkadan chill bi müzik açıp, kafa dağıtmalık eğlenceli bir oyun, tavsiye ederim. :))
我觉得真的很好玩，是一个收纳整理游戏，也是一个讲述了女孩子的一辈子要经历的事情的游戏，从少女到大学，再到工作，找男朋友，分手，找到真爱，结婚，生子。家里的物件能体现出很多小细节，很值得细细品味，比如分手后，在一起时拍的合照不能挂起来，必须放到柜子里，房子越来越大，东西越来越多，甚至连快递盒都是与时俱进的，从小陪伴女生的玩偶继续陪伴她的女儿，很温馨，很治愈，真的推荐大家都去玩。

It's a very comforting game. Cute pixel graphics and chill music. I enjoyed organising random stuff from the boxes and making each living space a home. You learn a little of the people's backgrounds. Reminds me of the times my family and I would spend unpacking when we moved places.

I liked the design and the storyline it was very cute and creative but it was overpriced, theres only 8 levels and the game is 20 dollars. sure theres some badges you can get and you can replay the levels I just expected more for 20 dollars
I absolutely love the storyline and puzzle element of this game. I wish it was a little bit longer though, so I could sink even more time into it.
This game is so relaxing. The music and the tasks are very calming and I have really enjoyed following the life of the characters and all the life changes they go through. It's a lot of fun.

I found it amazing how the creators are able to tell such a clear story without a single word said. The story was really touching and the game play is beyond satisfying. I could play this over and over without getting tired of it! Thank you for creating such a comfy well thought out game.

Its a very fun game but 20 bucks for such a short play through is crazy, id like to see a lot more added to this game since i'm a very on going person. Other then that its a nice game with a simple story.

This was a delightful game to play. I loved being able to unpack and organize, and watch the character's life unfold with the way her stuff is curated. I've played through a couple of times. I really like the earlier levels, organizing the bedrooms to highlight certain toys or art supplies is really refreshing.
I would love to see more games like this in the future, as unpacking someones life created a really compelling story.

This game was a lot of fun to play however, it is definitely not worth the full price of $28.95. I was able to complete the entire base game in 3 hours and 100% it's steam achievements in 5. It is relaxing to play, the art style and story is cute but I don't think you should waste your money on 3 hours of gameplay.
I loved this game, it was the perfect cozy game. The only downside is how short it was. i completed the game in 3 hours and was hoping there would be different story lines.
Absolutely beautiful pixel work, and even a sweet story to go with some calm and soothing game play of unpacking boxes.

Simple, soothing game with an excellent, nuanced story, told solely by items that you unpack and the environments you put those items in.

Thoroughly scratches the organization itch -- as it should, given that that's the entirety of the gameplay. Placement options are very broad and intelligent, though there are a few times I wanted to put an item in a certain room or location, but was not allowed to do so (and have it count towards level completion, anyway).

Very recommended, but only on a sale. It's too short to justify buying at full price.

I've played and replayed this game maybe 5 times now.  I've gotten so fast at unpacking that I can finish the entire game in 1 hour, maybe.  I love it so much.  I'm going through a heavy time in my life and this game allows me to control something and also feel connected to the character I'm unpacking for (the character I'm playing?).  This is such a cute game with such heart and love and it's so pretty.  I love it
Esse jogo é simplesmente incrível! adorei a história, os sons, a jogabilidade e principalmente a estética. Pra quem gosta de organizar as coisas é um passa tempo maravilhoso e relaxante.
Gerçekten inanılmaz bir oyun hayatımda bu kadar sıkıldığım oyun oynarken rahatlamak yerine sinir stres olduğum oyun olmadı. <3 32 pahalı buna hocam...

Me encanta este juego, puedo estar jugando horas sin aburrirme. Maravilloso juego, lo recomiendo totalmente
精致的像素风格，很有质感的音效，很特殊的通过物品来讲故事的方法，特别治愈
really cute storyline, really cute graphics, really cute music, really cute EVERYTHING!! highly recommend <3

This game is super cute, and weirdly addictive. It tells a story with so little words, wonderful.

Edit: I've played this like, 3 times now? Whenever I want to turn my brain off and just organize/pack or personalize a space, I play this game. It lets me think and still have fun engaging with what's in the room, and the soundtrack is relaxing. I know every game has DLC and it's not always great, but I kind of wish the devs would either create another set/version of this, or add some extra rooms/spaces to organize, or add to the story.

I love this game. Even though I think many would agree with me that the game would be even more loveable if it had more content. More stories, more levels you name it. But as long as it does not have more content I believe approximately 3 hours of playtime (to finish it one time) is not worth 20 bugs. So I and probably some others too would recommend to buy it on sale.

This game is very relaxing and fun and it tells a sweet story through the things you unpack throughout the main character's life. This was gifted to me for Christmas and I really enjoyed playing it, but I don't think I would've bought it for myself if I'm being honest. Don't get me wrong, it is very fun and I do recommend playing it, but I just don't think the price is worth it for the amount of content you get from the game. I think if it goes on sale or you just have a lot of extra money to fork over, you should go for it, this game is a good time and a nice, calm experience, but I'm just not sure if it's worth paying full price for.

A unique game. A prime example of ludonarrative synergy. It is a fun 150 minutes. The game is short and the story doesn't really feel like it ends. Get it if you like indie games with innovative gameplay.

7.5/10

Super short game. The unpacking is done according to where the game expects things to go, not where the player thinks they'd be best suited. Not really unpacking as much as "take things and put them in the place we want them." Not so much with the fun of unpacking. I'm really disappointed in the game overall.

It‘s a really cute and relaxing game. I spent three hours playing consecutively without even knowing. Love the tiny bits of details and easter eggs within the game and I feel like I'm growing with the character. My heart is warm and I can feel the love poured into this game by the developers and designers. Great job!

第一次写评论hhh，有点点贵，四个半小时就通关啦！虽然有些时候根本认不出来是什么东西，但是大部分都放对啦~真的很好玩，很少有这种能让人安心下来慢慢玩的游戏qwq！很奇怪的是为什么要把前男友的照片藏起来而不是扔在垃圾桶0.0（不过给照片里的男友头上扎了图钉好真实噢哈哈哈）但是为了通关，很多东西都没有按照自己的心意摆好，现在要去按照自己的审美重新摆一摆咯。剧情里的女孩子的家里出现了花花草草，足球和吉他收起来了，摆的玩具也越来越少，应该就是变成熟和长大了吧hhh~

很温馨的游戏，伴随着舒缓的音乐整理房间，从房屋与物品的改变能看出主角的成长与情感状况，到后面从一个个箱子里翻出前几关就有点物品还会有一种惊喜感。但是本作厨房的收纳空间一直让我觉得不够，联系一下现实倒觉得也合理，我家厨房里的锅子也没地方放：）
最后的结尾曲很感人，房子只是房子，是因为“我们”，它才成为了最美好的家
This game was so good. My friend and I played it on call together and were both blown away by the story and ending. This game is adorable and wholesome, 10/10
It was fun and very satisfying. Cute little story behind it all, but it is not worth the money. Definitely wait for a sale.

Honestly, I thought it will be more "free style" typo of game. I can't really place items where I want them to be, because the game tell me so. Almost every level is the same and it starts to be really boring at this point. I feel quite disappointed..
Maybe in the future I will change my mind, but for now i don't really enjoy doing what they tell me to...
this game is so much fun. i wish there was more to it but its so cute, feels a bit to expensive for a 20 dollar game and its a little short. i love the music, art style, etc. :)

Amazing and very peaceful, albeit short, this game is wonderful from start to finish and easy to 100%, with the only setback being it restricts where you can place certain items, which, on certain occasions, made me wonder what exactly did I do wrong for longer than I'd like to admit. 10/10, would recommend to anyone for a chill playthrough.

Petit jeu au top, très satisfaying MAIS trop cher pour sa durée de vie.. Jeu fini en 3h et en prenant mon temps. Du coup 20€ ça fait un peu mal bien que la qualité soit là.
Cela dit, 3 heures très agréables.

Ce jeu est très sympathique et aide à se détendre. Le fait de mettre de l'ordre est très satisfaisant. 
Cependant, je trouve que le jeu manque de contenu et qu'il ne permet pas beaucoup de temps de jeu. En 4 heures de jeu, j'ai fait le tour du contenu (C'est à dire des missions à accomplir) mis à part les trophées cachés à débloquer.
Il manque selon moi, un mode bac à sable libre voir un mode d'aménagement simple de maisons.
是很不错的一款拆箱子的游戏，题材很新颖，拥有属于你的一个房间或是一套房那么你肯定会用心的装扮以及整理它，刚开始的杂乱无章到最后整理的清清楚楚这莫大的满足感使得我这个还没买房的年轻人有了这么一次憧憬，不久的将来我住进我的新房，我也会用心的去整理它
this is such amazing game 100% recommend i have played for 5 house and have just finished the game i am so sad there is not more too it but an overall 10/10 game worth every penny.

This is such a cute organizational game, with a story to follow along to keep you engaged. I really love environmental storytelling... and this game is exactly that. There's so so many details hidden within the boxes in each move - it was cute seeing what was kept with the main character over the years. :) The music is relaxing, and I loved the sound design... giving so many possessions unique sound effects when moved and placed. It's a really wholesome game with a wonderful story. Unpacking isn't a long game, no, but I would say it's worth the experience. I would love to see more rooms explored of different people and places if there ever is a sequel or DLC!

One of the most heartwarming games I've played. It did indeed make me cry but I loved it so damn much. I could replay this over and over with a smile on my face. Also one of the best soundtracks I have heard in a game.

Cozy little mind numb game.
The story was absolutely wholesome and not something I expected out of an aesthetic unpacking game.
All I gotta say is "GOOD FOR HER."
There was a lot more content than I was expecting and once you get to farther levels it keeps your items where you had previously placed them. Get ready to reorganize 8 times as you unpack.
Will absolutely play again, good for the mentally ill.

I really liked this game! The art is lovely and I think it approaches storytelling in a really unique way that's so intuitive even with so few words. The attention to detail is so intricate, and I think it's really cool how you learn about the main character and their preferences through what they own, what they keep over time, and where they put things. Beautiful story.
really cozy game with nice music, nice grafics and a nice story too!

Unpacking is a short and fun game for anyone looking for any order (or at least virtual order) in their lives. A fantastic game for people who like me, may have some obsessive-compulsive/cleanliness tendencies as it allows players to bring order to the chaos of the character's situation of having to unpack boxes as they move from one stage of their life into the next.

What's beautiful about the game aside from the comforting music, is that there is no pressure to finish or accomplish anything. You can take your sweet time figuring out the proper places for each item: figuring out their correct spot/place in a room, or moving them from one room to the next. It's easy enough to figure out if an item is in the right place as it glows red if it's incorrectly positioned. If you wanted some orderly chaos, you don't even have to put like items in the same place (ex. putting paired socks in different drawers) as long as the general idea of putting them away where clothes belong is fulfilled. Probably the only thing that will bring "pressure" to the game, is completing its achievements.

Another endearing part of the game is that along with correctly placing items, it's as if you're going along on the journey of the character as you see them age, and their environment and their belongings mature. You see which items are added on as they move from one stage to the next, you see which ones get left behind, and you also see which items are with them from start to finish. It's such a joy to see so many familiar items and how they develop (like the old bulky PC and huge stereo that changes into a laptop and tablet, etc) because it feels like my own childhood items. I can't help but assume that the developer is around the same age (or age group) as me because the progression of the story and environment is similar to my own.

I didn't know I could feel so strongly about the life of someone I'd never met or seen, just simply placing every one of their possessions down one item at a time. You don't know what they look like, how they talk, their unique mannerisms or anything of the sort and yet you know them more personally than some ever will. You know what clothes they like to wear, what films they watch, and the stuffed animals they keep at the end of their bed. Games here, dice over there, climbing shoes under this. This is someone's story told to you by the things they choose to bring with them through their life. Some things they might show others and some things they might not. Even though it's you deciding where each item goes, it never feels like you're creating this person, once that picture is hung nicely on the wall it's as if it was always there. You are simply a silent observer, a fly on the wall. This isn't your story but you are granted the pleasure of watching it from beginning to end.

If you're looking for a cozy, chill game to relax to, Unpacking is for you! While the idea of simply sorting stuff from moving boxes may sound boring, it's honestly not. Between the charming graphics, the peaceful music, and the easy action of putting things where they belong, it's a great way to relieve stress. It even has a slight puzzle element; if you didn't put away something or put it in the wrong place, the game will have the outline of the item glow in red to let you know that it still needs a proper place. I highly recommend this game if you need an activity to help you step away from the stressors in your life.

[h1] 優點： [/h1]
從擺放物品的過程中感受到房間主人的生活變化及成長，甚至能在同居人入住時感受到截然不同的兩種風格(即使兩人為同性)，很舒壓的小遊戲。
有些音樂撥放器與燈飾的互動性很好，如果其他物品的互動度也同樣有做到就更好了。
很喜歡『完成後可以看收房間的縮時回顧』的這部分。

[h1] 缺點： [/h1]
然而，與其他玩家的想法相同，[b] 這個遊戲的長度有點過短，非常慢的分次玩還是在4.7小時時玩完了，明明整體構思不錯，但價格即便是折扣後仍然會讓人覺得有點貴 [/b]，或許能稍微改成：

1.主線拉長時間線，從出生到至兩人善終才會有"人生有始有終"的完整感。

2.既然素材重複率高，或許可以參考高壓水槍(PowerWash Simulator)這款遊戲的模式，製作各種不同難度(依照房間尺寸)，並隨機分配各類物品，讓玩家能挑戰更多收拾關卡，而不是主線過完就沒有了(重點是主線短到有種突然結束的感覺)。

雖然是一款正式發售的遊戲，但遊戲長度卻像未成品或先行版，希望未來遊戲能更新成有更多新關卡(非DLC)，彌補主線過短的空虛。
不考慮價格的話我很推薦這款遊戲。

Ce jeu est très reposant et calme et la bande-son est très agréable à écouter. On découvre le personnage principal, ses passions et son entourage à travers ses objets et différents logements et je les trouve, elle et son histoire, très attachantes. Aucun objectif de temps ou d'esthétique, les objets peuvent être disposé selon l'envie, dans leurs pièces respectives. Ces objets sont très mignons et bien pensés et une très grande attention au détail se fait sentir de la part des développeurs.
L'histoire peut être vue en moins d'une dizaine d'heures et les succès s'obtiennent en peu de temps, de manière simple mais réfléchie. Ainsi, pas besoin de trop d'heures pour avoir la sensation d'avoir fini ce jeu. Comme les objets peuvent être disposés au bon vouloir, le joueur peut refaire ce jeu autant de fois qu'il le souhaite tout en obtenant des intérieurs différents à chaque fois.

Pour moi, ce jeu vaut largement son prix: il délivre exactement ce qu'il annonce, il est reposant et mignon, la bande-son est super, beaucoup de détails qui relaient très bien l'histoire du personnage, celui-ci est très attachant et on a la sensation d'avoir fini le jeu en peu de temps de jeu.

Pros:
- A subtle underlying storyline!
- Cute visuals and enjoyable sounds
- LGBT+ friendly
- Neurodivergence friendly
- Super satisfying for someone who likes to organize and reorganize their spaces
** a "place items anywhere" option**

Cons:
- Definitely too expensive for what you get. Get it on sale like I did!
- Some items can't be moved or can't go in certain spaces to continue on 
- Didn't realize you could turn off the "place items anywhere" setting
- No variety on replay

Suggestions: MORE CONTENT!!
- It would be nice to be able to rearrange some of the items that exist before unpacking, such as furniture and art
- upon replay, maybe the order in which items come out of boxes are randomized
- upon replay, different items would be nice (such as different types of clothes or different stuffed animal)
- it'd be fun to have themed game modes: like unpacking a more masculine person's belongings, unpacking someone who moved from one country to another.. IDK, SOMETHING!

This is such a cute game! I would highly recommend it for anyone who enjoys very relaxed game-play.
I'd also say this game is especially Autism/Neurodivergent friendly! Very soft music that you can toggle, nice ASMR-esque noises when grabbing and placing items, and it is centered around organizing (which I love).
The story isn't directly displayed, but is still easy to follow despite that. 
You watch the character grow and change over time, which I absolutely adore and there are even LGBTQ references ranging from subtle to very apparent. 
There are hidden gems throughout the game that make the story that much more sweet, and the achievements are fun and easy to get, even if you do it by accident!
There are two play styles, one being to place everything correctly, and things will be outlined red if they need to be moved, or you can turn on the "place items anywhere" setting, and just put things where you like.

Overall a 10/10, not for everyone, but if this is your style of game you'll love it!

Unpacking is a cute zen game with a sort of implied story about growing up and going through the motions of life and reaching certain milestones. The story is told in a really interesting way, from the possessions you're unpacking and the environment you're unpacking them into, you're able to see into this person's life. It leaves an unusual implication in that our interests, personalities and lives can be boxed up and unpacked. It's a unique way of measuring the milestones we've reached in our own lives.

The game took me about four and a half hours to complete and I do see some replayability in the game. Most of the achievements in the game are progress-based, although a handful are earned by placing or organizing items a certain way. The game played wonderfully on the Steam Deck with no issues.

Overall, I genuinely enjoyed Unpacking. The only thing I'd like to see going forward is more content or replayability. I'd recommend getting the game on sale as personally, I feel $20 is a bit steep for the amount of gameplay offered.

The only thing I didn't like about this game is after you've unpacked everything in a house/room, it'll show you the items that cannot be placed in the spots you put them. I understand the point of this game is that the character is moving in, so everything should be neat and tidy, but sometimes it is very frustrating. As it's a game with very little words, it never tells you why you can't put an item where it is, just that you cannot, and you'll have to go around putting it down randomly to find the place it's allowed to be. It's even worse when you can't figure out what the item is--you can't put jars that look like detergent in the laundry room; they can only be placed in the medicine cabinet despite not looking like it belongs there at all, so you have to rearrange the cabinet to find space for the two huge jars. It can be even more annoying when it's an item you know--a water bottle isn't allowed to sit on the counter in the kitchen. A laptop can't be on a shelf, only on a table (despite already having a PC on the desk).
This was just a minor detail I had an issue with. If the game is on sale and you're looking for a short, relaxing game, I'd recommend.

I'm probably the cleanest, most organized person I know so, naturally, I love this game. My only complaint is that this game is remarkably short; I got about 3 1/2hr out of it, however. I've replayed the entire game about 4 times since then. So far, it hasn't gotten old. I think it's because each time I replay the game, I make new connections between unpacking objects and the girl we are journeying alongside and make new, little discoveries about them. There are so many little details packed into this game that it constantly feels like I'm finding new things.
 I was perfectly happy to pay full-price for this game, however if you're one of those people who only pays a lot for long games, I'd wait for a sale. Otherwise, it was 100% worth the money for the serotonin, chill music, and the amount of personal satisfaction I got out of obsessively organizing a digital house.

I sincerely hope there is a sequel to Unpacking that includes more levels, and more *lives* to journey alongside, because this is one of the best games I've ever played. And, if there were DLCs, I would buy them without hesitation.

A very short game but in those short moments this simple game of unpacking someone's belonging as they go through the various phases of life tells a lot of a in terms of hidden implications. We often knowingly or unknowingly  hold on to our belongings and keepsakes and imbue them with our memories, emotions and nostalgia. Unearthing the meaning behind each offers nuggets of insight into one's life. And this games speaks volumes without dialogue nor narration.

What childhood keepsakes do you bring along in life, how does your likes and dislikes change from child to youth to having your own kid, how one's belonging not having a place to fit into your lover's apartment speaks volume on how important you are to them, how going back home after a heartbreak feels like, rediscovering your passion and making a career about it, that cookie jar your mum used to put her baked goods and which triggers your own passion, the contrast between you and your lover, the simple joys of having your own bedroom and bathroom, your geeky phase with D&D or sailor moon cosplay, plant hobby gone into overdrive, and much more.

In the four hours I spent unpacking some's life and placing it piece by piece, it didn't feel like a chore but an intimate understanding of the person as it is. Wishing there were more of this.

Great story and unique concept!

I bought this game on a whim after seeing many positive posts about it online. I knew that there was some kind of story to this game, but mostly thought it would just be a lighthearted game about unpacking belongings and putting things away. 

I played this game in one full sitting, too captivated to even consider stopping before seeing this through. I shed tears over this game in the best possible way. I became so attached to the character we follow. I was so [i] proud [/i] of her when I saw her get her very first apartment that was all her own. Watching her grow up and find happiness meant more to me than I can possibly say, but I'll say this:

This game irreversibly changed me for the better. It was able to lend me a more hopeful outlook on life that I have been sorely needing. Whenever things get too bleak and my mind travels down that dark road, I'll remember this game and remind myself of all the things I have to look forward to. 

From the bottom of my heart, thank you to everyone on the team who worked so hard to make this game. You have my sincerest, humblest gratitude.
