You can zone out & unpack like tetris in a home setting. 10/10 loved the time I spent playing this game, got a lot of achievements my first go around, about to play a second time and try to get the rest. Should have gotten on my switch as I think this would be great to play while on a long flight to relax.

This is an amazing game. My only problem with it is the mandatory places to put items, although it also makes it feel like a real game and not total sandbox, which is more my style. Short game, but worth it when on sale for over 30% off. It tells a story which is beautiful and even made me tear up once. 10/10

It was fun, though it needs more challenge and more rooms to fill in. I only played it for 9 hrs and it kinda sucks that it just lasted that long. The animation and graphics didn't disappoint me though, its quite cute and splendid even; really love the artwork. The sounds are relaxing so its good. Hoping to play again in the future for more rooms.

Good game, I just wish there was more to it. $20 is a lot for a game with only 8 stages and no real replay-ability outside of going back to get all the achievements. The art and sound design is great. Gameplay is pretty much what you expect with a few minor annoying things that don't make sense (like not being able to stack the little plates on top of the big plates I mean come on). But what this game really needs is more meat on its bones, like more than one character to follow. I feel like this game is the start of something great but stops short of reaching its full potential.

As it is, it's a good puzzle game and a decent way to kill an evening or two, but absolutely not worth $20.

The game has cute estetics and is very chill if only it would be longer or cheaper.. (I bought it while it was -30% and I still think it's not cheap for such short game) still it was a quite nice game

This game made me so happy. It was so much fun figuring out where everything needs to go, and watching your character grow up and see how their life changes. This is such an amazing game, and the background music is awesome. This game was so calming and I would recommend this game to literally anyone.

Such a beautiful game! I feel like it was made for me! I had a lot of fun deciding/figuring out where items went and discovering the character's story. Spending time solving the special achievement puzzles (very clever and pleasantly surprising) was very worth it. While others spent just a few hours on this game, I spent seven :D. If you're into organizing, decorating, pixel art, home/life sims, sweet story lines and/or low-stress games, this one's for you!

变迁乃生活之常态。
一开始进入游戏看见有三本相册的时候，以为会有三个不同的故事。整理完了一本书满怀期待地打开下一本却发现开始了重温，这是最为美中不足的地方了。
游戏的bgm很舒缓，像是在一个闲适的午后，躺在摇椅上享受温度恰好的阳光浴。但是整理这件事本身就很像打扫房间……或许更欢快的会更合适（个人之辞ww）音效方面看了一些访谈，小细节上花了这么大的功夫，确实非常用心！
常态化的人生虽然已经留有足够看客们慨叹的空间，但是更为特殊的人生，或许可以超越长跨度的时间看出生活带给人的影响……
感谢你分享自己的人生！

Очень хорошая игра! Игра сама по себе расслабляет и ты забываешь о проблемах, так этому процессу еще помогает прекрасная музыка. Игра реально хороша по всем параметрам и это говорит любитель шутеров, а не таких игр. Оптимизация, картинка, атмосфера все это немногое чем может порадовать Unpacking! Вообщем по соотношению Цена - качество, эта игра лучшая в своем жанре. И да, спасибо за изи платину в стиме.

Very calm and nice game, hiding a sweet and realistic story behind unpacking boxes into various types of rooms and apartments during different stages of one's life. Lovely music and fun achievements.
A bit short, but definitely worth replaying multiple times.
Can't believe I am recommending a game about cleaning and decorating rooms as a irl hater of cleaning and decorating rooms.
Sequel please!

有轻度强迫症的话，这个游戏玩起来还是蛮舒服的。
通过几次搬家，讲述了一个简单但是幸福的故事……喜欢小游戏的遇到这款游戏打折，不妨试试
I like the concept of this game so much! It's relaxing to play and makes time "fly by" fast. I just wish the game was longer or if the creators could add more rooms to play.

Very thought provoking, and accurately describes with only the use puzzle elements the difficulties of adult life. I could genuinely relate to some of these moments, life is a tough one but it is a great reminder that it is a journey. Enjoy the path taken, and don't focus too much on the ending! 

Want a game that gives you some time to reflect? this ones for you.

This was a gently relaxing game that tells a story through pretty realistic unpacking of belongings. Having moved a number of times, I was nodding along to certain pieces and choices (who doesn't throw random stuff in the wrong room's box when you're rushing last minute?) Very soft and calm, with subtle details added through belongings. Just wish it was a little longer as I enjoyed it so much, I'd love to have a 2nd story/protagonist to unpack.

Unpacking was an extremely lovely game, especially with the replay-ability/save files of the multiple albums. The accessibility settings were nice, as they have a feature to place anything anywhere. I love the subtle hints of a bisexual, female main character and the simple representation. 

The only thing I disliked about the game was the inability to choose the gender aspect, as all of the clothing is feminine. I adored the game otherwise, though. <3

Definitely a great game to relax to and it works great on steam deck. It will take around 3-4hrs to finish going through all the levels. Once a level is finished, it will tell you if any items need to be moved to be in its perfect spot which I didn't mind doing since you end up organizing everything anyway and only a few items end up needing to be moved. The game also has collectible stickers which are tied to the hidden achievements. These were pretty easy to complete so it didn't add any stress to this relaxing game.

I definitely recommend getting this game on sale, though, due to it's short play time.
很温馨的小游戏，两个半小时左右，感觉很适合姐妹们尝试。卡关的时候我是真的很想为主角妹妹挂上她最重视的成就，每一个角落都找过了，真的没有。就好像在这段关系里主角必须要退让，面对不被重视和尊重，希望女性回归家庭的声音，爱情和面包谁更重要这件事确实很适合思考。不过很感动最后妹妹还是找到了自己的爱情。希望大家都可以像妹妹一样坚强，果断，重视自己，把自己放在第一位www。会有真正懂你珍惜你的人来爱你。

I just wish the game was longer than a couple hours. It was cute, special and moving.
If more content gets added, or user generated content is an option it would truly take off.

This game was incredibly relaxing and told a story without words. It is such a cozy game. I hope there are future updates and that there are other games released that are similar! If anyone knows of any similar please let me know!

Relaxing little game that subtly tells a story along the way. As someone that likes to organize stuff this really scratched an itch for me and the story was simple but sweet, I loved all the little details you could pick up on throughout as the years passed and what came out of the boxes changed.

This game is super cute and fun, and has such a sweet and beautiful ending credits scene! My only issue is that I wish it was longer. I managed to play through the whole game within a couple of days, and I probably could've played the entire thing within a few hours. I would love an update or a sequel to this game that featured more levels; more rooms to unpack and organize!
休闲游戏却不自由，我玩偶就放床上书就放桌上了怎么了？？非要把东西都放到看不见的地方才叫收拾吗？那直接还是让它们躺在纸箱子里不更好。当摆完之后那个红色提示出现的时候我知道，这款游戏不适合我。

An amazingly relaxing cozy game :) only downside was that it only took me 6h to play trough, but honestly ill do it again sometime. The story was moving (pun intented) and it was fun doing detective work to figure out how our character grew and how their life progressed.

O jogo pode até estar um pouco acima do preço pela quantidade de ambientes que tem inserido, então se quer jogar espere uma promoção. Dependendo da pessoa pode terminar em pouquíssimo tempo, agora se você é uma pessoa que gosta de arrumar direitinho as coisas, organizar, dá mais tempo. O jogo te proporciona uma experiência bonita da mudança e do envelhecer da personagem, além do que você tem os bônus para descobrir. Eu diria que vale a pena, mas espero muitíssimo que o desenvolvedores coloquem mais ambientes, quem sabe a vida de um novo personagem? Temos 3 livros lá no início, poderiam ter 3 histórias.
This is such a nice, cozy game to relax with. The music is beautiful and the story is very interesting. 10/10 would reccomend.
Cute little game, sound design is the best about the game for me. Art and storytelling are really on point. The gameplay is a bit stressful for me but I still finished it :)
A sweet game with relaxing gameplay and a neat storytelling style. It's also just kind of fun picking and dropping something and hearing the sound play over and over again

Adorable art, a fun little decorating and organizational game with a surprisingly deep story for never explicitly telling you anything. There is a lot of replay-ability even outside of getting all the achievements. Once I finished my initial run through there were so many things I discovered I could do differently, or little games I could add in (like the floor is lava) and I think I will come back again and again and refresh how I've arranged everything.

Very relaxing and enjoyable game to slowly get to unpack objects and find homes for them. I enjoyed the storyline that followed this person in various moves through their life. I do wish there were more packing stories as I did get through the game faster than expected (approx. 5 hours) but for the enjoyment I had for the time I played I would say a worthwhile purchase. :)
Very cute, relaxing puzzle game that made me legitimately tear up in ways I didn't expect, despite its very lightly-worded narrative. Glad I experienced it finally!!

Only about 3 hour game play, but definitely a comfort game. I loved just seeing the person grow up. The person went from (I'm assuming) a preteen, to moved out, to moving in with someone (probably boyfriend/girlfriend/partner), to then moving back home (probably because of a breakup, cue you putting the one photo of the two people into a cabinet to get rid of the memory), to moving back out and being independent, to finally settling in and having a baby. Seriously a good game with amazing meaning behind it. The music is very calming, the asmr from it is wonderful. I got this game one sale for $14, but of a normal price of $20, I don't think it's worth it, but I do highly recommend this game to someone looking for a comforting game.
玩着玩着就催眠了怎么....女主从小就有女汉子特征，结局也不奇怪了。前男友照片还舍不得扔放柜子积灰啊。书和内裤是真的多啊 而且还喜欢鸡，越来越多的鸡；）

[h1] 진짜 최고의 정리게임이에요 [/h1]

[b] 장점 [/b]

노래와 도트배경이 딱 봐도 힐링게임으로 인식하게 되는 게임입니다.

의외로 플레이타임이 길 줄 알았던 게임인데, 적당한편입니다.
한 5시간정도?

[u] 더이상 말할 필요없이 진짜 재밌습니다. [/u]


[b] 단점 [/b]

좀 불편한 부분이 있자면 내가 놓고 싶은 마음대로 물건배치한 채로 진행은 안됩니다.

그건 좀 자유성 없어서 개인적으로 진심 아쉬움.

아 진짜 이 게임 아껴두고 한건데 제가 좋아하던 분이 하시는걸 봐서 그냥 바로 플레이해버렸습니다ㅋㅋ
真的很治愈。每一次的搬家都是一个转折点。太太太喜欢最后的画面了。就是流程有些短。一开始以为3本画册有3个人的故事。

Unpacking is a cozy, relaxing game that tells a sweet narrative solely through unpacking boxes each stage of life (along with little blurbs in your scrap book). I've played this game 3 times over and I've been searching for games similar since I finished this. I'll probably play this a few more times until I forget it's in my Steam library and rediscover it.
I highly recommend this game to anyone who has an hour or two and are looking for something relaxing and fun. From wonderful pixel art to a cute soundtrack, this game is a 10/10 for me

overall a very simple but beautiful game, stuff like this is what im looking for personally. simple organization, no time penalty, with small story details and an insight into whose house you are unpacking. more like, whose life really. we get to sort of.. watch the main character grow up. cute little video game references and artist references littered about. 10/10 i cried

Bardzo przyjemna i relaksująca gra. Wydawałoby się że Unpacking to nic wielkiego - opróżniasz pudła z przedmiotów i meblujesz nowe mieszkanie, a jednak jest w tym tytule to COŚ! Obserwując wnętrza kolejnych mieszkań możemy poznać życiowe etapy, przez które przechodzi bohaterka. Ładna, piksel artowa grafika nadaje rozgrywce dodatkowego smaku. W grze znajdziemy tryb fotograficzny, więc możemy uwiecznić mozolnie dekorowane pomieszczenia. Jedyny minus to długość gry - w moim przypadku 8h. Z jednej strony rozumiem, że tego typu produkcja mogłaby znudzić po dłuższym czasie, a z drugiej mam jakiś taki niedosyt. Warto zagrać! 7/10

I bought this game because it was on sale and I thought it might be fun and satisfying for a few hours, but it is surprisingly touching! The story line sneaks up on you and now I'm looking for certain items, and anticipating what might change in the next move.

It is really my type of game. I like decorating and this game gave me exactly that. When I bought it, I thought there was no plot. You just unpacking everything then go to the next room. But to my suprise, there was a plot! A small one but heart warming one. I wish we have a little more options. It finished too early for me.
作为收纳爱好者很喜欢这款游戏，玩起来非常解压。胆是游戏时长较短，感到很可惜……如果有dlc就好了……

Lovely, short game. The story is unclear but also clear at the same time, giving you permission to be wild with your fantasies. If I said I wasn't atleast a little sad when I saw the first crack in my trusty purple mug, I'd be lying to you. Fantastic game, but a little bit pricey for playtime. I recommend getting it when it's on sale.
Jeu simple et relaxant qui raconte une histoire adorable sans un seul mot. Voyager entre les différents décors est très satisfaisant, je recommande à tous.
非常治愈的游戏，有很多的东西陪伴着房子的主人走过了一年又一年，感觉她很喜欢画画和音乐，爱玩游戏，在收拾的过程中仿佛看到了我自己，有很多的小东西，很开心！
very wholesome subtle story line. Even though it is quite short, it was very enjoyable and relaxing. Def recommend to those who are looking for a more chill game to play.

o jogo é muito fofinho!! é uma experiência bastante aconchegante e individual, porque cada um que jogar vai decorar do seu próprio jeito, então isso é um ponto bem legal. ele tem uma história discreta, mas que dá vontade de acompanhar por causa dos itens que se mantêm ao longo dos anos e por causa das anotações feitas no álbum. a trilha sonora também é super agradável, especialmente para um jogo que quem jogar vai provavelmente ficar um bom tempo pensando em onde colocar os objetos. recomendo ^_^
a cute puzzle game that tells a story but I was disappointed that it took like 3 hours to finish the whole game :( It would be great if they could bring more content

The game itself is really fun and relaxing to play, its fun finding all the stickers and achievements but in all honestly its not worth 20 hours for 3 hours of game play. Yes you can do it over again but that is only fun for so long. I do really hope they will add to this game because it has a lot of potential.

很沉浸的一款遊戲，可以體會到主角各時期的變化，在小細節也做得很好，沒想到會這麼投入在故事內
最愛的功能是回放紀錄，可以回顧自己擺放的過程，超讚的！
I have never been so invested in a character with no dialogue or face for most of a game before. The last 2 maps to me were the most fun :)

This is an adorable game that you can spend hours on if you really wanted to. Personally, I am actually more invested in the story progression than I am in the unpacking part which pretty much is the main part. But, if we are being for real, the game is just really repetitive and quite boring. The story is sweet, but there's only a single story and no way to forexample decorate random rooms. Basically, I wish there was multiple stories and/or the ability to do random rooms. Aside from that though, the art is very cute, and the small details are very cool if you notice them. There is something additive about the game, even though it's hella boring. It's definitely not for everyone, but I'd recommend you give it a try. Play it when you have nothing to do. Here is a review I fully agree with: "Though the mechanics are simple and the campaign can be completed in a handful of hours, Unpacking is a memorable, delightful game that shows that there are still new ways to tell stories in video games out there. You might not think stacking plates and organizing books is compelling, but strangely, it really is."
可玩性还是有的，就是内容比较少，只到2018年，希望能出DLC。从简简单单的收纳整理也能观察到这个房子的主人喜欢看书，是个女孩，从稚嫩到成熟从初恋到分手到结婚，还是蛮有意思的。就是这价格感觉有点点不太值啊
Ame el juego, me encantan los graficos, el modo de juego todo me relaja mucho. No lo quiero completar jsjsjsj
Loved the design and visual graphics! Also, it was very interesting to see how time progressed when staying in the same space, (cabinet doors got more scratches, more decorations on desk, etc.)

it's a cute game, it has a nice story-line and nice graphics. i love the ability to organize however you want but i don't recommend getting it at the full price since you finish it in a few hours. while i understand it follows the creator's life, i would like to see more chapters released for other staff members (maybe) or just in general.

The game is very short, but I absolutely loved every second of it!! it was so cute and it made me so happy to organize all of these tiny things :). I hope in the future the creators add a dlc or something where we can play as different people and organize their homes as well!!!

This game honestly itches my brain in the best way. I just spent multiple hours doing nothing but unpacking all the boxes. And I normally struggle focusing for 10 minutes. I'm going to keep replaying this forever.
It's a nice calming game to play, both to have fun and waste time. Plus you'll spend time making the rooms look how you want them too which fells kind of rewarding in a sense.

I got this game as a birthday present and it has been the best way to chill out after a long day. I just finished going through the levels for the first time and absolutely loved the story elements and progression of the main character's life. 10/10 would recommend
非常好玩，還有dark star mode可以挑戰，玩到手痠，各種細節太有趣了，音效也做得非常棒，希望還能有新作

This game is so addicting and well done, the detail to everything and the puzzle aspects just makes it better. Would love to see more content added to this game, either through updates, a sequel or a DLC. I would recommend to people who want a calming yet slightly challenging experience.

Got this game on sale a while back and I can honestly say it's one of my faves! The story is really good and I enjoy learning about the character over the years. Personally I think it is very replayable, even though the story does not change. It's my go-to game to play whilst listening to podcasts or music as it's very relaxing and not too demanding!

This is a fun game! Great design, beautiful music and a heartwarming story. Unfortunately way too short for the price. If you want to pick it up, wait for a sale (a big one). For this kind of price one should expect twice the content or even more. Im sad it ended so quickly.

This game is incredibly wholesome, subtly inclusive, and heartwarming! The cozy puzzle gameplay combined with signs of the over-arching story and hints and nods to little pieces the narrator picks up along the way make it a joy to play and replayable for a familiar comfort. I always enjoy the small details in this game, and with every replay I discover a new little detail that I missed before! Truly an excellent game, good enough that I bought it on two platforms! :)

An adorable little game with a lot of heart behind it. the atmosphere and sound design are so well done that even though it doesn't take a long time to complete, it still is completely worth the full price. great for those with OCD or who just love cute things.

10/10 would hug stuffed piggy again

It's a beautiful game with an original idea. And I definitely recommend it to anyone!
I loved every minute of it and it really helped me to relax.

The graphics is beautiful & love the gameplay. 
I even watched all the credits at the end & I loved the background song for the credits!

I only have the same disappointment that almost every other reviewer has. The game was overpriced and it only gave 4-5 hours of gameplay time. If they had more levels and stories - then the price would be fine, but this is just too little for too much of money.
特别爱玩，就是不知道有些是什么东西，也找不到该把东西搁哪。主线讲的是一个喜欢运动的女孩的感情及生活。一切故事背景都埋藏在细节中，等你去发现。

this game is so comforting . i downloaded it during my midterm exams , i'm a sophomore CS student , and this game was the best way for me to distress , chill and have a break from everything for a while. the art is so charming , it gives you a feeling of peace and comfort. much love and appreciation to the artist and the developers of this amazing game.

as someone who loves to organize and play cozy games, this is great, but i do wish there were more levels for the price. i've been able to go through the game twice, but there isn't much to replay afterwards. i really like it but i suggest getting it on sale!

I can't say enough good things about this game!! From the relaxing gameplay to the adorable art style, this was such a fun game to play. Beautiful story and it was so fun to watch it unfold throughout the different stages and piece it together through the different items you unpack. Wonderful job to the devs and I can't wait to see what other creations they make!

I received this product for free from fan.

Unpacking was honestly okay.
It is not good or bad, It's okay.

The music and the aim of the game is relaxing, gives out good vibes. However, I do have some issues about it that I will address in the pros and the cons.

Pros:
-Relaxing Vibes
-Hot Water bottle makes sounds when you shake it
-Can beat the game in a few hours

Cons:
-Wish the game would give you more freedom of where to store your images. [Without it telling you that it can't be place here or there]
-Personally do not think that it is the worth the full price with how much gameplay you get in it.

Rating:
6/10
Nice relaxing game, very entertaining for organisation freaks like me :) However, it's too short and I also wonder why there are no other scenarios to play.
very cute and relaxing. perfect for de-stressing after work. there's flexibility in the way you solve the puzzles which is nice, because i am oblivious. overall, highly recommend!

[i]SUCH[/i] a sweet game! Cozy, cute, relaxing, and can be played in an afternoon if you're ambitious (or bored, like I was). The story and discovery is so compelling I didn't want to stop! I'd love if you could play through as different characters, but I also realize that this alone is a huge achievement. I'll probably play through to get the rest of the badges, but it won't be for a while. It's sweet, but a bit confusing and repetitive.

This game is so cute and relaxing, it's definitely one of my favourite games of all time. I really hope they add more levels or even make a new game. I can't get enough. Despite not really having characters the creators have managed to build a whole story about the person you play as simple using items in the game. Absolutely amazing. 100% underrated.

Main downside; too short. .. Otherwise its relaxing.. but also requires one to think and try to find new places for items. .. I hope they make more houses .. (perhaps following someone else? I'd be happy about it at least).

I absolutely loved the game, it's just a fun realazing and sweet game to play.

The only negative for me is that the price is a bit high for what it is (I do believe they reduced the full price but I still think it's a bit high) but other than that I highly recommend getting the game on a sale.

8/10

This was a really relaxing/fun little puzzle game.  I liked how it very cleverly instilled  tiny bit of a story of the main character through the nature of the moves they had been doing throughout.  Only complaint was some items were a little vague, but it was so easy to figure out where to place things this was not a big deal.

Absolutely, positively in love with this game. If you like puzzles, soothing sounds, and relaxing vibes, I highly recommend this game. You can finish the game pretty quickly, but there is a lot of replay potential. One of the coziest!

Super relaxing with chill vibes. There's no score so you don't have to worry about doing thins within a certain amount of time or putting things in the exact right place. You can take your time and organise everything as you want it! I bought this originally on my switch but the controls weren't great, it plays much smoother on PC! I've replayed it over ten times because of how relaxing and fun it is. Every play through i still feel like I'm figuring out new stuff. Some of the items are interactive which is a lot of fun, there are definitely a few more that could be interactive but aren't which sucks. I wish they decided to make DLC or allow mods so people could create more content for this game, the whole thing can be completed in under two hours. The stickers are fun to collect and in some cases made me laugh when I finally figured out how to get it! A good game for kids even. If its on sale, its definitely worth picking up!
I mean it's a really fun relaxing game but for 20 euros it is not worth it. I completed the game in 3 hours... And its not fun to just play the same levels over and over :3

Relajante a la par que estresante. 
¿Eres de los que le busca a todo un lugar? Este es tu juego
¿Tienes ansiedad y necesitas dejar todo en su sitio? a
¿Te gustan los puzzles? jiji
-----------
Algunos niveles son tranquilos, con pocas cajas para quitar, ¿lo últimos? Buena suerte.
Un juego acompañado constantemente de música relajante, en la que iremos descubriendo la vida de la protagonista a medida que vamos avanzando por los años. 
Me ha encantado que haya logros ocultos en cada nivel en función de cómo interactúes con los objetos. Por otro lado, una vez lo acabas, si buscar información en internet de la historia es una maravilla. 
Sin duda una gran recomendación.

absolutely love this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ game. It comforts me every single time i play it. i've gone through each album and slowly collected all the achievements. i never got tired of the story line either, 10/10 from a mentally ill ♥♥♥♥♥.

Unpacking is as wholesome and calming as you can get in a game. The music is definitely worth listening to with or without the game. The ease of the point and click is repetitive without being monotonous. The storyline is cute (albeit predictable) and does not take a lot of effort on the part of the player to enjoy. Is it worth the current cost? Eh, probably not. But I felt I needed a calm this relaxing in my life, and I was right. So, consider it for yourself.

Overall a lovely game.  Although some may not find fun in replaying it I certainly did.  No matter how many times you go over a level it seems you always figure out different ways on how you'd like to organize things.  Sometimes you may feel like color coding every book, other times  you may enjoy putting items in size order, etc.  I just love everything about it.  Would recommend.
fun game getting to know the characters story hopefully there will be another story (new house) to unpack :)

Absolutely ADORE this game. Honestly, the main run through the game is a really good length, and the gameplay felt very balanced. Not too much to distract from the main point, but you still got a feeling of this story. I hope this game gets some DLC or something!

Comforting, low pressure, and sweet. The story is in the details and the gameplay is what you make of it. It's not for everyone due to low replayability and a bite sized runtime, but if you're having a rough day, do yourself a favour and pick this one up.
Love this game. Super cute look and helps me relax at the end of the day! The music even helps me relax in the evenings and afternoons. 100 out of 10 would recommend!
This game is fun and all but why are you organizing a digital room instead of your own? tsk tsk, better stop procrastinating.

Couldn't recomend this game enough, especially to the fellow girls and gays (affectionate) who love stardew valley, animal crossing, minecraft, house flipper, etc. The perfect game to just sink your toes into!

Pros: Everything.
Cons: Much too short. You can complete it within a few hours. Some very enjoyable few hours, but I wish there was more! I'd pay more money for more stories!

super duper fun! I loved how easy it was to understand and interpret the story without really any words and mostly through pictures, locations and items you unpack throughout the game! the ending was so cute too!
I like this game. But not worth $20. I finished this way to fast. Its a great game just not worth the money. $10 at most $5 at least. Still a great game overall. Love the little song at the end.

I love this game so much.
This game is a little pricey, but when it is on sale it should be in your cart ready to go.
The reason I say the above is because you really do only get 3.5 - 4hrs of game-time until you've finished the game.
!!!BUT!!!
I have replayed this game 2 times now to completion, and both times i have found ways to redesign and have fun with it. (except for [i] the place [/i])
While the game is a little pricey, I genuinely think it's worth it in the long run for the warm fuzzies this game gives you, the slight replayability, the music, the art, and the characters you never get to officially meet.

Absolutely gorgeous and stunningly creative game. Very intriguing to follow the story of the character throughout their household items. Fell in love with this game and just wish there was more levels!! I wanna play it again and again. Beautifully done.

A relaxing way to pass the time. Listening to a lovely calming soundtrack whilst unpacking really helped me to relax. Sadly I finished in 3 hours and there's not much replay ability. £15.49 is a steep price for what it is! I got Witcher 3 for £10 and have 100x the hours in that game AND its replayable.  £5-£10 would be appropriate for Unpacking. If you're tempted, wait until a sale.
This is a very pleasant way to pass the time. I appreciate the subtle ways the game tells a full narrative through items alone. Brilliant ^-^

Cute, relaxing game. I liked organizing and trying to make it look good. Played it through in one evening. After enough time I may replay it in the future if I want to relax, but it`s not really replayable besides that.

I had a feeling I was going to love this game and I was absolutely correct-- I wasn't disappointed. It's so relaxing; wholesome and adorable, with great attention to detail and fun little hidden things to uncover. It isn't the longest game ever, but it does what it set out to do, and it does it well.

This is such a cute game!!!! It's so relaxing in an organizational way and tells such a good story, which is surprising since all you're doing is unpacking, but the story is there and I'm not afraid to say I cried at least twice while playing a game about unpacking. I think everyone should play this game and relax and enjoy the ride of the story!
relaxing, cute, entertaining, and has a story line. the story line is perfect because rather than interrupting the gameplay it adds to it. 10/10 :)

A fairly zen experience and can be finished in a single sitting.

You are essentially doing chores though, which you can do in real life.

A very cute game about unpacking boxes and getting a view into the life you're unpacking. It's very well made, the art style is gorgeous and the music pleasnt though perhaps a bit too extremely quiet and calm at points. The only complaint I have is that at 20 dollars or local equivalent, the price is a bit steep for a very short game. There's not much replay value and sadly no additional content has been added.

Short, but good, maybe buy it on sale.
It's a great game and it is very fun, I just wish there was more for what I paid. I would recommend playing this but only getting it when it's on sale, for it feels like there just isn't enough.

This game is perfect for when I'm anxious and need to organize things. The music is soft and calming, the decor is nostalgic, and you get such a sweet little story woven throughout. I love the way that unpacking your things lets you find out who you are - and I especially love the D&D books and mini/dice that stay with you throughout your life! Such a gorgeous, fun, relaxing game.

A very cozy and relaxing game. The story is simple, but great; I love how we learn so much from just belongings. 
I keep coming back to this game when I need a little bit of relaxing. 

I hope they make more in the future, even with a new character or something.

I love this game! I is very relaxing and satisfying to play and I have replayed it already without the puzzle element so I can place anything anywhere and it makes it a whole new relaxing experience. highly recommend if you are looking for something satisfying and relaxing that is organizing or designing. The mechanics and sound effects are amazing an add to the experience as well.

At first i was  hesitant to buy, considering the price of the game, and the type of game it is, but i was pleasantly surprised when i did buy it. If you enjoy to sort things, while being greeted with a cozy soundtrack and graphics, this game will be perfect for you.

Best game ever, I've played it through 20+ times. I love the storyline and the satisfaction of putting the pieces together. Plus it's so exciting to look at the life of a disabled/chronically ill Jewish lesbian like me :)

Jogo bom, relaxante mas não vale o valor cheio. Zerei em menos de 3 horas e apesar de ter gostado, me senti decepcionada e pedi reembolso. Se um dia tiver uma promoção onde custe BEM mais barato, vale a pena pegar. Fora isso...
게임 귀엽다. 집 꾸미는 맛을 기대하고 샀는데 생각보다 물건은 원하는 곳에 못 두는일이 많다. 내가 수건을 화장실에 걸든 거실에 걸든 내 방 침대에 올려두던... 어디에 두던 그건 내 자유 아닌가? 무조건 화장실에 걸어야한다는 점 빼곤 다 좋다.

Unpacking is honestly such a beautiful and heart-warming experience. It's not simply a mindless cosy game (though certainly on my second and third plays I was simply having a nice calm experience), but it genuinely tells it's narrative in a simple (yet deep?) and beautiful way.

As humans we collect things in our life as we go that hold meaning to us and form a part of our individual experience. I fell in love with these characters without hearing them, seeing them really either. And the end? oh boy.

Honestly one of the best games with a subtle and sweet representation of growing up while being LGBTQIA+, it doesn't focus on it but it's just part of the puzzle. So refreshing and made my heart sing when I realised.

I'll always keep coming back to this game. It feels nostalgic, it feels like home, in love <3

It's a cute game ngl. I wish it had more episodes because I finished it in like 2-3 hours. Dark Mode is pretty fun to play with. In times where I don't have anything else to do, I play this game to pass time.

The only complaint I have about the game is that I wished it was longer! I hope there will be part 2, I loved playing this to destress after work so had hoped for it to run a little longer. 

Also, I wish we had the freedom to place items ANYWHERE we wanted, and not be restricted by the game just because the placement of the items do not make sense to the game >.< But all in all, loved the game and graphics. Looking forward to a part 2!

Very satisfying cute game, with a hidden but sweet story. Good music and funny achievments as you go through the levels. I recommend. I am very sad though, that there arent more levels or different stories... XD

Great game. Wish it was longer and followed the main character for more than a little over a decade. Went into it expecting a story of a life, instead it's more of a coming of age story. Still, definitely recommend it. Very cute environmental story telling.

If you're looking for a relaxing game,
without rushing against time, this is a game for you!
Beautiful pixel art, cute music, and you get to chill
by learning about this character's life.
I really wish there were more games like this one,
if you know more, please recommend them!
[b]To summerize: beautiful.[/b]

something about putting your characters life together and watching it change, watching it get better, just has me very emotional.  unpacking the second time in the same apartment nearly made me burst into tears. it's very sweet 10/10

it's cute and satisfying and the environmental storytelling is an awesome idea, but i agree with other reviewers that it is not worth $20 when it took me less than five hours to complete. if you can get it on sale then it is definitely worth a play!

So many mixed feelings. I like this game, but it's over quickly. You can replay, but there's not much room to do things differently, other than maybe place things a little differently. I like that it's a story of one person and you unravel that story as you unpack. It's sweet. But, I would love to have different options, whether they have stories or not. Maybe a minimalist track? I would love that option. An option to donate some items would be cool. Any other additions, something would be nice. It's too short. I'm replaying but am bored with the replay.

Davvero molto bello, sia per il gioco in sé, sia per la storia dietro. 
Unica pecca, dura davvero troppo poco (specialmente rispetto al costo). 
Sarebbe bello avere delle aggiunte :)

A relaxing game where you unpack boxes. But if you put an item in the wrong spot have fun looking for half an hour to figure out where the miss placed item goes, because the game will not give you any hints on where it would go. So many times I would be satisfied with where I put the objects, and 8/10 times I would spend about 20-30 minutes trying to find where the game wants me to put the item. 

I would not recommend this game to anyone that wanted to have a good time.

so fun and relaxing but i do recommend getting the game on sale. you can play it multiple times but its the same all over again. i suggest that when you re-play, play with a friend(s) because they might discover things you never knew! dont have a friend to play with? thats okay! you can re-play by yourself and try and find new things <3 have a great day :)

This game is extremely heartwarming to the core, without realizing I watched a beautiful story unfold before my very eyes and it brought to my KNEES in tears. Very amazing game, 10/10 would recommend.

I thoroughly enjoyed this game. It is a shame that it is so short and as far as I know there are no plans to add to it, because I could spend hours and hours with this game.
It is a really satisfying and relaxing game to play. The story is beautiful, and the amount of details you can learn about a person's life through their belongings is frankly astounding. You almost feel like a little detective, trying to figure out this person's story. 
I loved it. Wish they made more of it.

I know what people may say, this game only has so many levels until you are finished, but I have beaten the game and gotten all the achievements and I still love playing it. You can put things in more that one place in a room. It is cute and very zen. It is one of the games I played the most out of, and still play, when I first downloaded steam. I hope anyone else playing will enjoy it as well. 10/10!

I was unsure if I would buy it but I saw a youtuber play this game and I thought why not? It's a short game, very easy but cute and relaxing. Sometimes the music got annoying playing over and over again, but beside that the soundtacks were perfect for this game. I do not regret buying the game. In fact, I recommend it :)
A very simple game that is able to tell a life story without any dialogue. An excellent way to spend an hour or so with a relaxing game

I gave my wife a running narrative as I played through this game, which is something that neither of us is usually very interested in doing/  I genuinely woke her up to tell her about it because I was so stricken by the subtle, infuriating narrative of the move in with the boyfriend and then the move that came after that.  I'd say more, but I don't want to spoil!

A fun, memorable little game for sure.
对于没有强迫症的玩家来说非常治愈，适合休闲解压。整理需要在游戏本身摆放规则框架下进行，但是自由度还算不错，同时还能跟进主角的人生历程。不太好的是游戏内容过少，如果后期更新其他场景和人物经历就非常不错。
This is a super cute and relaxing game. The game played takes about 4 hours to complete, but you can go back and try to get all of the achievements for replayability.
总的来说还不错，画面可爱，小物件的音效很细节，游戏背后的故事很温馨呢。但是就是摆放的限制有点多，有些东西我不知道是什么。。

This is the best game I've ever played. The DETAILS. The storyline. The symbols and metaphors. The music at the very end that ties the story together. This game will make you feel like you've lived a whole life, through first apartments, breakups, and finally, a happily ever after. 10/10.

<한줄평>
할만한 힐링게임.(3.5/5)

<재미 요소>
박스만 있는 방에 물품을 정리하면서 인테리어 하는 느낌이 듭니다.
물체 각각 놓는 소리가 있고 상호작용이 가능한 것이 드물게 있으며
앞에 물건이 있으면 서랍이 안 열린다던지 휴지나 수건을 걸거나 자석을 붙이거나 하는 등
디테일한 부분에서 현실에서 정리하는 듯한 느낌을 줍니다.
종종 도전과제가 달성되기도 하고 물건을 다 놓은 후 꾸민 과정을 돌려보면서 카타르시스 마저 느낄 수 있습니다.

<서사 요소>
주인공의 방을 정리하면서 그녀의 삶을 예상할 수 있고, 그녀의 성장과정을 보며 자식을 키우는 느낌마저 듭니다.
또한, 배우자의 물품을 주인공과는 대비되게 설정해서
주인공의 삶과 배우자의 삶이 섞이는 느낌이 드는 점은 감명 깊었습니다.

<아쉬웠던 점>
1. 돈에 비해 볼륨이 작습니다.
  마지막 스테이지 할 때에는 꽤 오랜 시간을 먹어서 이러다가 성장한 아이 방도 정리해야하나 싶었는데 
  바로 끝나서 아쉬웠습니다. 하지만, 재미면으로도 정리만 하는 것도 뇌절이었고 서사면에서도 결합했으니 끊어주는게 깔끔하다고 
  생각해서 큰 단점은 아니라고 생각합니다. 
2.주인공이 동성애자입니다..  
  여성용품만 있길래 혹시..했지만.. 레즈커플이 나오는 점은 조금 아쉬웠습니다. 동성애자가 좋냐 나쁘냐 보다는 '성장과 결합' 이라 
  는 작품의 메세지를 해치는 느낌이 들었습니다.
3.저는 한국인 입니다.
  물건을 보면 이게 어디다 쓰는 물건인지 갈피가 안 잡힐 때가 있습니다. 힌트 몇개라도 있었으면 좋지 않았을까 싶습니다.

This game is ADDICTIVE.

Its cute, detailed, and well-made. I just wish there were more of it. There have been many games of this kind, but it seems Unpacking is the only one that got it right. I finished it in under 4 hours. I get that the idea is a short and sweet gameplay, but it honestly left me feeling VERY underwhelmed. Not really worth the 20 bucks.
Good game, can finish it in a day if you're really dedicated, but you can come back whenever and it wouldn't get too old if you play it right :)

I appreciate that the developers clearly prioritized quality over quantity in this game. It feels a little short and left me wanting more, but the attention to detail is striking. The OST, sounds and visuals are very pleasing. The narrative and characterization is subtle and in some cases even conveyed through the gameplay, e.g. the player having to store away the protagonist's diploma when she moves in with her boyfriend because there is no space left on the wall vs. the abundance of space later in the game signal certain conflicts and states of mind in her life. It's a therapeutic game about creating a space where you can relax and be yourself, it definitely left its mark on me, having played this after moving to another country.

It's a nice and chill game, but you're done with the game within 4 hours. There's no real replayability - only one "story", which is told in a great way, tho. It got me sentimental a few times throughout the playthrough. The gameplay is very satisfying, if you're a fan of sorting stuff etc.

Overall 7/10

The amount of story they fit into this game without any literal story-telling is a feat that not a lot of developers can pull off well. The coziness of Unpacking combined with it's ability to get us attached to a main character that we never see, along with getting the player to feel like they're the ones who are organizing their own rooms and kitchens and bathrooms, is something that other developers should take notes on. I genuinely cannot find something wrong with this game. 10/10, would recommend to literally anyone who loves gaming.

Very relaxing and cute! I agree that if you were to sit down and really focus you could finish this game pretty quickly... but if you are the kind of person who likes taking their time and plays little by little then this is perfect for you. The subtle story telling in the environment also has a pretty interesting story that the player follows as it progresses. 
I very much like to take my time with most games I play, so this is no issue for me as I will probably spread it over a few days, but if you know you play through these kind of games quickly, then do be warned that it may not be the experience you are looking for.

I like this game. I love to decorate. However, in my opinion sometimes there are too many items for placing in the rooms. You have to give them all a place, but it in my opinion it can look messy in the rooms. Also, i wished that the items were more varieted. For all rooms you have items that are the same as in the rooms before. Ofcourse there are also new items for every next house you have to decorate.

The best de-stressor. It's so relaxing and enjoyable. Although there are only a few levels, you can replay it multiple times to find new things and just organise things in a different way. I absolutely loved the little bits of story you get just from unpacking.

Chill and cute game. I recommend playing it before you sleep because although the game is interesting, it is very helpful with winding down and just chilling out. The art style is cute and the story along with such a overlooked task proves how much thought was put into this game.

Um jogo muito relaxante e divertido, oferece uma quantidade razoável de quebra-cabeça em sua gameplay. Recomendo caso queira um jogo para se distrair ou esfriar a cabeça, a dificuldade não é frustrante nem de longe.
This game is really relaxing and cute, so if you're just wanting a chill game, this is for you, as well as, the storyline really making it worth finishing.
A wonderful game where you get a glimpse of someone's life by unpacking their belongings, I was very moved and captivated by the story, would love to play a DLC or a sequel!
值得反复回味的一款游戏，每次重玩都会有新的想法和搭配，带给自己一点小惊喜，很棒

PROS:
- Passive and easy gameplay
- Super cute story
- Plenty of achievements to unlock
- Soundtrack is great

CONS:
- Overpriced (It would be worth it for maybe ~$10)
- Fast (could be a PRO if you like easy gameplay)
- Completed in less than 10 hours

OVERALL:
I still recommend this game - if you have $20. The gameplay is sweet and simple, the story is fun to play through, and achievements are easy to acquire. I would NOT recommend this if you prefer slower, richer gameplay. This game is super sweet and I hope we get to see more from Witch Beam.

I really enjoyed this game. It was relaxing with nice graphics, and a subtle story line with lots of little things to notice and learn about the character. I only wish there was more to the game or different characters to unpack.

This game is fantastic! I finished the whole thing in about 5 hours, the controls are super easy to grasp and the concept is really sweet! It was really satisfying to play, and the art style is adorable. I really don't like a majority of video games and they tend to frustrate me as a whole, but this game is awesome and I'm definitely gonna replay it!

5 Hours of zen wholesomeness 

The only downside I can think of for this game is that is went by too fast. That being said, the sheer amount of detail the team has went into is astounding!

80's and 90's kids will find many hidden gems, and all in great pixel-detail. We learn about the owner/s' life stages through the game from their rooms and items, and honestly this is just beautiful. I wish there were more games like it.

Cute game, cute story, cute music. Definitely a relatable feeling packing, moving and unboxing over the many stages of your life. Definitely recommend if you want something to just drink a cup of coffee with and relax.
This is a cute and fun game. It is relaxing with nice background music. Gameplay is quite short, but overall nice.

Honestly, I think the most adorable game I've ever played in my life. 
Not only was it a satisfying little puzzle game that I messed around on when I was bored, but it also had a really subtle but really great little story for your protagonist. Never thought I'd cry about a little game like this, but i did :)
10/10 recommend

Wirklich ein sehr schönes und entspannendes Spiel. Man fühlt sich nicht gestresst und man kann in aller ruhe die Räume einräumen. Auch hat es einen wiederspielwert, da man beim zweiten Durchlauf, ein wenig anders gestalten kann. Wirklich schön gemacht und die Musik ist auch sehr entspannt.

อย่างชิล ฟังเพลงเพลินๆ มีลูกเล่นให้จัดได้เยอะไม่น่าเบื่อ

สรุปเป็นเกมชิลจัดของ ฟังเพลงเพลินๆ  9/10
