打折买好，原价买不推荐。体量小，很好玩。
游玩过程中脑子里全是物品怎么放，完全没注意游戏讲的故事，等通关之后才想起来。（Lily妙

Хорошая но скучноватая игра, подходит для того что бы скоротать время. Маловато комнат и предметов, если сидеть без остановки в игре, то её можно пройти за пару часов. Рекомендую, но только если вам больше нечем заняться.

such a cute and relaxing game. I love that most of the story is told by the items itself and what gets carried through each chapter. I wish there was more parts to it but i'll just hope for updates or a second game to follow this one. maybe following the kid instead.
Loved the story and the graphics. Can start to feel a little repetitive after awhile, but very relaxing and fun.
This is the perfect game for those that have anxiety. It really helps to settle the mind and allows the players to just organize at their own pace.
Insanely addicting for people who love organizing. It is so satisfying and relaxing. Completed it three times. I would absolutely LOVE a sequel or anything similar to the game.

有点意思但不多，整体来讲市面上没有第二个这样的游戏做到这种程度，交互什么的很有趣，比如有东西挡着开不开门关不上门。 但是！我有一些东西根本不知道是什么！放哪全靠蒙就很痛苦！如果能显示这个东西是什么就好了！
整体玩下来我个人是觉得不值得70块的 打折还不错 游戏真的很有趣 但是！70太贵了 并且到后期因为不知道这个是什么那个是什么我非常的烦躁，并且 袜子居然不是全能一对一对对上的，强迫症疯了。好多书，真的好多书和游戏硬盘 真找不着地方塞。
推荐买 但不推荐原价买。
以上。

I enjoyed this, but it definitely feels too short. We follow one woman's journey but I hoped to see multiple journeys as well to follow other people who like different things and experienced different lives. The Album save system was especially misleading in making me think there'd be more content to this. It feels like wasted potential to just end the game here, and it seems the game devs ~maybe~ will make a sequel but certainly not for a while. I don't know why they're so determined to move on from Unpacking when it's got such a solid gameplay setup and there's so many other wonderful kinds of humans we could follow through their moving adventures! It would be really awesome even if there were a community building feature so users could create their own stories for others to explore!

Anyways, ending statement is I reccomend this game but maybe only on sale b/c $20 seems high for a 4 hour game with not a lot of replayability for most people and no new content will be coming to the game.

This is a very adorable and relaxing game. I found myself getting attached to the character that was moving around a lot and it felt like helping a close friend move. The story is very subtle and I love that! Everyone can make it up as they go. 
I haven't gotten every sticker yet so I'll keep playing for some relaxing hours in the future. I think the game is a little expensive for what it is, but I enjoyed it nonetheless. If you have 20 bucks to spare and want to chill out and decorate a 2D room for a bit, this is perfect.

Lovely game! I watched some streamers play it and simply had to get it for myself. The art style is super cute and it was fun seeing all the clues of the main character's living situation. It was cute, relaxing, fun and moving. Would love to see a sequel! I would also love to see a game just like this where you get more control over the items you bring into a space. I'm hooked if it wasn't obvious.
this is a great game, very calm and realxing. great story and storytelling as wel!l
Unpacking was an extremely cute game to play! But it's definitely a one time thing. It gets boring playing the same levels over and over again. The storyline was cute as well.
i love this game, i wish it had an option for a different gender, like amab. i think that would be nice, but otherwise very nice and amazing story line

Very cute and calming.. if you like to organize this game is for you. It's not a very long game (3.5hrs) and is kind of expensive for it's length, but it tells a surprisingly good story for how simple of a premise it has.

I absolutely LOVED this game. I hope they come out with another one like this or at least expand it. Some people have stated that the money is not worth it but I think it is, especially with the amount of detail in the graphics which are absolutely beautiful and the story line is amazing. Its super fun and relaxing 20/10 game.

I got 4.8 hours out of it, but I accomplished exactly what I wanted: To just chill. If you've only got $20 to spend on games, I wouldn't recommend getting this, but if you have a bit of disposable income its well worth it in my eyes. Just know what you're signing up for...

I really liked the game, replayable if you just want to have fun with it, but it's not really worth the money. If it goes on sale, it's wonderful! A great way to relax, but not super story-driven. Achievements are fairly easy, just a lot of trial and error. Overall, good game, like the story, the graphics are amazing and the objects are cute, I would just wait for it to go on sale.
IMO this is a great game to unwind with.  Music is really soothing and love how simplistic it is. My days are pretty hectic so this was nice to come home to.
its fun until you cant place something somewhere and the only good place to put something is in an ugly spot so you take 20 mins repositioning everything to make it look pretty

Such a relaxing game if you love organising. The soundtrack is nice and the sound affects are a good touch. I wish this game had unlimited levels/rooms to decorate because it's easy to finish in one sitting.

I rarely feel moved enough by a game to spend the few moments it takes to write a quick review, but this was something special.  I expected some chilled out gameplay, what I didn't expect was for the game to rifle through my disordered soul and put it back a little neater.  Thank you everyone who had a hand in making this.

Now if you'll excuse me, I have some boxes that haven't been unpacked for years that need my attention.

Great game, very good puzzles, but not a lot of replay value. Once you have the achievements & such there isn't really any reason to play it anymore, I wish there was a sandbox mode or something. 6.5/10

Cute and fun, if you enjoy relaxing games and organizing the same things over and over. If you are buying the game to play through it once, not really worth it. The game can be completed (with full achievements) in roughly 4 hours, or less if you manage to get all the achievements in your first album. All in all it is a good game, just a short experience. So just take your time with it and it's worth it.
Amazing game with amazing storytelling, sounds and ideas. I've replayed this around 15 times now i love it so much! :D

It's a cute game, if you're willing to spend over 15$ on 3 or less hours of fun. It feels great to follow protagonists life, but there is only one of them. The game would be amazing if there were more stories, but it's just not worth it. Don't waste your money.

Price is a little too high for the amount of playtime you'll get out of this. 

For the rest this game is awesome, has a good story and unique and fun gameplay!

Very cute. Very simple. There's a bit of a story you figure out by the progression of levels, but it isn't anything too complicated. Honestly, this is the perfect game for people who just need something to do and have the itch to organize (like me). The music is pretty soundtrack is nothing remarkable, but I still enjoyed it. Would play again. I hope they make an "Unpacking 2"

This is a very charming and heartwarming game! It won't take you too long but the games content Is enough to create an enjoyable experience. Plus the achievements are super fun to figure out! I highly recommend.

Very nice an relaxing game where you as the game is called Unpack for a Nice girl who grows into a woman and You help her with each move she makes and puts the stuff the right places! you also earn stickers for acheivments and i LOVE acheivments 

-Story (7) i think things moved to fast... 
-Visuel (9) very calming 
-Gameplay (6) You cant decide COMPLETLY where things should be wen it comes to the end

all in all a game that is Lovely to play wether your child adult teen or elderly!

Ce jeu est une leçon sur la manière de transmettre une histoire. Au travers d'un gameplay très simple et d'une ambiance "chill" le jeu nous transpose dans son univers.
Je noterais quand même la difficulté de trouver l'utilité de certain objet qui nous donne des fois l'effet "je met ça où", mais cela n'arrive qu'assez rarement.
Je recommande !

This is probably one of my favorite new games that I have played as of recently. The storyline, the art, the music and gameplay is simple and easy to understand. It's such a calming game I find myself replaying and wanting more of after each playthrough. I'm hoping for DLC content for this game if not another game from the developers that is similar in nature to the unpacking gameplay style. 1000/10 would recommend for a nice and calm game to play.

Such a great way to unwind after a super stressful period in my life. I loved when I would figure out that i would manipulate objects outside of just placing them. This game also tended to make my OCD tendencies happy. 10/10 would recommend to anyone trying to escape from their life.

Meiner Meinung nach ist das Spiel sehr entspannend und hilft mir extrem, nach einem stressigen Tag runterzukommen. Die Musik trägt ebenfalls dazu bei, dass man gut entspannen kann und passt sehr gut zum Spiel.

This is a really calming game with a great story-line running under the content which is easy to pickup and figure out. I just keep replaying it over and over. The one thing I would change is adding in more stories to play.

Unpacking is a game I’ve played multiple times first on the Nintendo Switch. I will say the controllers on the Switch is a lot more annoying vs keyboard+mouse on a PC. I eventually succumbed and got it again on PC while on sale to use as my more chillax game on mindless lazy days. 

The music and aesthetics tells a story as you unpack. During gameplay, you’ll get a real feel for what type of character we are unpacking for. You’ll see adorable plushie obsession big and small, to how space is shared when finally living with a significant other. 

While many find that this game is far too short (and I highly agree), it can end up being a very drawn out game for someone like myself who has a perfectionist OCD trait. I spent hours and countless replays of this game on my Switch! What I have noticed soon as I started playing the PC version, is now I play it with less stress and more speed. 

Having played it on the Switch multiple times, I can finally play it like it’s meant to which is just unpacking and getting to the next stage of life while collecting stickers :P

There is no dialogue in the game, just a using your noggin puzzle game of where the hell should I put all this crap in such limited and sometimes restricted living space!
super cute game and i loved it, but would definitely  not recommend unless it was on sale. a little spendy for only 3ish hours, not a whole lot of replay ability.

I finished the game and wasn't a huge fan at all.

The gameplay to me in the end felt more 'boring' and 'tedious' than 'relaxing'. Yes, a big part of the puzzle is trying to make everything fit within the correct room, but It was oftentimes really frustrating because many items felt like they should be able to stack on top of each other more, but you could not stack them. 

This + the game was way too simple and REALLY short for its price too- I mean 15 quid for eight levels...? I wouldn't recommend it even if it was half price tbh.

If you're looking for a chill game to play, I'm sure there's games out there that are cheaper, that have more depth, and higher replayability than Unpacking.
i got this a while ago played around 1/3rd of it and never played any more have no idea why just came back to it it is super fun and calming trying to get all achievements would reccomend

Sweet game but expensive for the price. It's nothing more than a cute simple story that brings you some calm and reflexions while you unpack your things. If you only expect that, you probably will enjoy it. If you expect more, this game is not for you.

I think that this is a very good and relaxing game, but I thinks It's overpriced for being only 3 hours of game play. I hope that the developers will add more rooms to unpack in even if they don't make new story lines.

I loved this game while I was isolating with covid, I completed the game in about 3 hours and it is so fun. The only downside for me is that I found it a little short and would love to keep playing more! The black star challenge was a lot of fun and harder than I thought it would be.

an overall amazing game but am sad that the story is short. the overall sound design and the way you see the character's personality/story unfold through the items they own was an interesting and heartwarming experience. if you see this game on sale then you should totally get it

I adore this game. It's short, yes, but it is so very wonderful. I've  played it 4 or 5 times by now and have had a lot of fun trying to figure out different layouts, different ways to put away things, and how to make things look as clean as  possible. So for me, the game has a lot of replay value, even though the story is the same every time. It also helps with my anxiety and calms me down when I'm about to freak out. A 10/10 for me, absolutely worth it.
非常好玩！这种不需要技术的休闲游戏太棒了！玩了很久还没有通关，会考虑购买材料包，游戏内容细节很多！有小故事

This game is such a therapeutic and simple game, and is definitely both a stress reliever and anxiety remedy. The sounds of moving things around and setting them on surfaces plus the calming music is just so relaxing.

So relaxing! Throughout the game you start to get a feel for the progression of the life that you're following and unpacking! I've played so many times since I downloaded this game and it never gets old! There are so many different ways that you can set things up and put them away! Literally the most calming and relaxing game I've ever played!
This game is really cute and follows the story of someone moving between houses as the get older. The mechanics and graphics are amazing too. Definitely recommend.
Fun, relaxing game. Story is a bit too short for my likings though, compared to what the game costs, I would've expected something longer.

This is a great game to just kind of vibe with. I usually pull it up when I know I'm going to be on the phone for a while with friend as it gives my hands something to do. It's a really intuitive game and is advertised as exactly what you get.

Es increíble que un juego sea tan sencillo en concepto y a la vez te enganche de una forma increíble.
Ver la vida de una persona y su progreso a lo largo de su vida, a través de sus pertenencias. Precioso

看到Calli玩這款看起來很治癒的遊戲 所以買來自己體驗一下
玩完會了解為什麼Calli會玩到哭
這些經歷很日常 特別是像我們就是從事藝術設計行業的
背景上又更代入那個為夢想努力的自己
我也會想像我曾經合租、一起奮鬥的朋友現在如何
一次次的搬家整理中 增加了另一個人的物件 也有拋棄了不少的物件
從遊戲中閱讀了從一個人到找到家的故事 一個簡單而溫暖的遊戲
希望會有續作
Really good game - I'd love more rooms to be added onto the game though as I finished it within 4 hours, and for the price I think it's a little high for less than a days gameplay.
this game quickly became a favorite game. i definitely think this would do well with extra downloadable levels. or even a 2nd version to the game that adds more levels and even possibly more story's.

this game is adorable and it's so relaxing. the levels are also replayable which i like! the little story is interesting. i appreciate this game and i genuinely enjoy playing it. 
the vibes are good <3

i think this game is fun and relaxing. Its fun to organize and make your own rooms. And the more you play the more freedom you have and i enjoy that. Also its fun trying to find all of the achievements.

El juego de por sí no es nada del otro mundo, abres cajas, sacas objetos y colocas objetos. La razón por la que recomiendo este juego es por el trasfondo que tiene, esa mágica capacidad de contarte una historia sobre una persona y como se puede saber de esa persona solo por el hecho de ver que cosas se lleva en su mudanza de casa en casa...

El precio, para las horas de juego es alto, eso es innegable (5 horas he echado y con calma). Pero el como te sientes reflejado, como descubres a esa persona de la forma en la que el juego te lo transmite... no tiene precio.

Si eres un jugador que solo va a terminarse el juego, este no es tu sitio, pero si quieres oir una historia de una forma distinta, compralo, no perderás tu tiempo.

Fun and immersive, every item felt intentional and I definitely put a lot of thought into where everything would go. A little disappointed in how short it was, would love some DLC or future updates to help justify the price!

A sweet, relaxing, and well-designed game with a satisfying element of tidying and some clever storytelling hidden away in there. Not much replayability, and I'd advise getting it while it is on sale, but it is a calming experience and a nice change of pace from other games.

A great relaxing game with a lovely little story and little hidden details to discover. The perfect game for when you just want to sit back relax, and plop items into places you think they fit best. the sounds of the items and boxes being folded up are relaxing and satisfying. I have enjoyed playing thsi game over and over again to find all the hidden stickers, secrets and dark mode, which i found quite the challange.

A really simple game of unpacking a person's life. The pixel art is fantastic and the music is very relaxing. While unpacking, you get a glimpse into this person's life and the subtlety with the way the items change in the various moves (levels) makes for a very enjoyable game.

I love this game. I obsessively played it for 3 days until I finished the main game. It is such an amazing game. The main game is in a storyline format with the unpacking you do telling the story. You unpack the persons life and go through their journey with them as they grow up. The main game is a puzzle and you have to put the items in mostly specified places, some things are meant to go in certain rooms and it will say it's incorrect if you put them somewhere else which is fun. But if that frustrates you, there is an option to turn that off and you can put things wherever you want and still go through the story. I am not sure how replayable the game is but I am having a lot of fun. Would 100% recommend.

Very chill and relaxing game. Keeps an element of puzzle-solving without being too strict with the placement of items. The ability to place items in a variety of places and configurations allows the game to not become boring, even if you replay the levels. Ngl, will probably end up replaying it when I need to just chill or decompress.

If you love organizing, this is the game for you! A creative game that tells the story of someone's life through the times, places, and things we have to unpack. As someone who's had to unpack quite a bit over the years, this one was surprisingly touching. 10/10.

I cried (': I really loved being able to see the narrator develop and grow, especially mentally. Achievements were easy and having the multiple interactive elements was my favorite! Hope they add more to the game soon <3

Giving this a thumbs up for the art, gameplay and storytelling.

However, complaints about the length of the game are not without merit.  It is a *very* short game and I finished it in about 2.5 hours.  For the price (which, to be clear, isn't that high), I'd expect something around the 5-6 hour mark, certainly not something I'd complete in one sitting.  

Still, the game is good and worth playing.

This game is super relaxing and cute. I love the style, and I enjoy how much representation is shown within the characters. I'm playing this for my second run through at the moment, and it's so fun. Highly recommend.
Probably one of my favorite games I've ever played. It is short, but it is so satisfying to play! The story is great and relatable, and subtly told. I'd recommend this game to anyone!

I've noticed a lot of people saying this game is overpriced for the gaming experience, and though I do agree, I still think this game is worth the current price. There are so many secrets and little details that make the game that much better. I really wish this game continues and the developers make more levels and modes.

[u]新しい部屋に物置いてくのって楽しいよね、　を地で行くゲーム[/u]

思ったよりはボリューム少ないかな…？とは思いましたが、
荷物から主人公の今までの歩みが見えてきて「ああ、この本お気に入りなんだな」とか
「今これに夢中なんだな～」とかしんみりしたり応援したくなったりで大変楽しい。
黙々と封開けて片づけていくのが大変良いです。

物の置き方はざっくり決められていて違うところにあるとクリアできない。
置き方とか、片づけ方は個性が出るもので「なんでダメなの…？」とか
なんの道具かわからなくて「そこでいいの！？」と思う部分は多少ありましたが…それも一つの片づけ方だよね、うん。
大変だとは思いますが、物の名前だけでも表示してほしかったです。

Get it on discount. While I think it's a wonderful game, it's only about 4 hours long. There are not custom maps, so that's all you get. While you do get a lot of cute animations and a relaxing experience, it's just very expensive. You could alternatively, for the exact same price, but The Sims 4 and can design your own house with the motherload cheat. If you think, that's an unfair comparison, you could also buy Stardew Valley for 13, Terraria for 10, Valheim for 16 or even tribes of midgard for 20 bucks.
However, what's present here is good. There are no bugs or glitches. There are just so many games, that offer more in an equally relaxing environment.

Nice little game to play mindlessly. You can get all the enjoyment out of moving without the hassle of actually living in the place or owning the things! It was fun to try to piece together the lives of the people whose belongings I was messing with, and the different styles of furnishings based on the time period were quite accurate. I don't know if it's worth 20 bucks for what was essentially 5 hours of gameplay with low replay value, but to each their own I guess.

This game is a very chill way to spend some time gaming. Unlocking all the achievements is a great way to play through the game a  few times. Finding all the messages for the rooms is another fun way to keep playing. Very much recommend this lovely game. I would love to play even more levels with bigger homes.
一开始三本日记我以为是三种不同风格的设施呢，结果都是一样的呀关卡还是太少了建议增加点，这种关卡数建议折扣史低入手打发时间还是蛮棒的

I absolutely LOVED this game! The graphics are amazing, the sound is beautiful, the artwork is SOOO awesome! I can see that a lot of love and work was put into this game, and the story was genuinely so lovely. This game is perfect for people who need an escape for a bit, and want to relax. You might see a bunch of comments that say the game is too expensive, but I think it is worth every penny! You can tell immediately how hard the creators worked to make this game possible, and it is apparent through every level of the game, in every item and pixel. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to just chill after a long day, I promis that you'll love it as much as I did!

I love this game. Everything from the UX to the graphics are really well thought-out and feel solid. The story is subtle, relatable, and unique enough to not feel shallow or hackneyed. I loved every minute of it! 

I was disappointed and a little surprised to find that after only 4-5 hours of game play it was over! Especially since this game doesn't have much replayability. For those who value their games based on playtime alone, I'd wait for a sale. 

I'm choosing to see the price as an investment in the development team. I hope they will use the momentum from this first game to launch more in this series with new stories, spaces, and longer playtimes!
This game has such a cute cozy vibe. I highly recommend this to anyone who is or isn't a serious gamer and is just looking for a cute satisfying video game.
Cute relaxing puzzle unpacking game, tells a cute story, but its very short, and not all rooms are unlocked, i read that theres no future for this game and this is all there is

This is such a fun, lowkey game. It's really fun seeing what comes out of the box and finding the perfect spot for it.  The only downside is..... it's so short! I played for 6 hours and finished all of the levels. Would love to see more years or an Unpacking 2!

A comfy cozy must have! Relaxing music and gameplay that can help you forget about all your worries with fun organizing tasks that unveil a story and a journey that is so quaint and deep. Easily can take as much or as little time with it and still get the full story and enjoyment out of it.

This game was wonderful and calming, I'm embarrassed to say I finished this game in one sitting. And my only gripe with it is that it isn't longer. Or that there aren't more stories to explore. Other than that it is a very entertaining game and I enjoyed it!

Ein sehr schönes Spiel :D! Mir gefallen die ganzen Kleinigkeiten und Details sehr. Ich hatte mir ein längeres Spiel erhofft, also das man mehr Häuser dekorieren kann. Daher sind es mir die fast 25€ die ich zahlen musste nicht ganz wert, trotz allem kann ich es definitiv weiter empfehlen.
最后坐在夕阳下好治愈，果然没有男人可以过得更好~·为什么前男友照片不能扔垃圾桶！！！希望出dlc
i love everything about this game. the sound effects. the story. the graphics. spectacular.

Lovely game. The story was subtle but very open about what was happening, and the game itself was very relaxing. I made my brother play and saw how different we were in organizing things, which helped me understand his brain more. He is now going to force his brother by, and I quote, "Dragging his lazy dead body over here to play this amazing game." It's so beautiful and. I kind of want there to be a D.L.C. where you can put the furniture and move it all around. Even if that never happens it's still an amazing game as is.

First off, I definitely think the cost of the game greatly surpasses the amount of game time I put in before completing it. That's not saying I wouldn't recommend this game, because I absolutely do, but maybe wait until there is a sale or price drop.

The music is very relaxing and the various sound effects are wonderful and create a calm and linear game to relax and zone out with. The pixel-art style fits perfectly with this type of game and makes for a cute and fun style overall. 

However, there were at some points that I could not seem to figure out what some items were, exactly, and that took finishing a level frustrating. I think there's this egg-shaped timer that I couldn't figure out where it went???  I think some brief text overlay, maybe as your cursor goes over an item, just giving its name would be very helpful.  

I think this game is very cute and fun. My replay-motivation is quite low for it, however, but it helped scratch that itch in my brain for organizing. I do wish you could move around the furniture rather than just the small items - it would make each room more unique and flexible for each person. But this game does make my brain go brrr.

it's so much fun! very relaxing, the noises are so so, SO satisfying, and it tells a story without really having to tell anything. it's a beautiful game, the achievements are so fun to try to figure out. there are a bunch of little features that are also fun to find! 10/10 recommend this game to everyone! :)

kinda hurts to spend like £13 on a game i 100% in like 5 hours but woo pixel art
also upon further investigation you can get away with making the home completely unlivable and get praised for it so 10/10 would pay again

This game is so relaxing, the story line makes the game so much more interesting to follow. I think the art design makes for beautiful game play! Definitely a game I'd recommend for people who prefer slower or more relaxed games

Unpacking is a calming game with relaxing music and a very interesting storyline. Since there are very few rules in where you must place the items it gives the player an ability to "customize" the main character (e.g. whether she is left hand or right handed, how she stores her clothes, how organised she is, etc.) The sound effects are incredible and vary depending on where you place an object (e.g. on tiles, carpet, a table, etc.) Definitely one of my newest favourite games to play after a long day :D

It's a cute little game, that shows the story of a life through moving and unpacking, really cute, love the music and the graphics definitely something else and an experience you wouldn't want to miss in my opinion

Super cute game. Really relaxing and its fun to watch the main character grow and develop. Personally would only buy it if its on sale though. Theres not too many levels and its a tad over priced. Still would definitely recommend. 8/10

整理房間遊戲
非常舒壓跟優閒感，整理完也會很有成就感
一間一間也同主角成長跟戀愛的感覺
不過我有性別平等障礙這讓我有點小困擾
但依舊不影響它是款相當優秀的作品
相當推薦購買，慢慢打完會讓妳感到溫馨浪漫跟舒壓

I only recommend this if you're buying it on sale. I love the content of this game, everything is excellent from the art to the music to the fun little easter eggs, along with a story told through the objects the main character has. Which is an excellent example of narrative design. 
However, the biggest downside is that its super short. If you like super short games, this is for you. However, I don't think that an approx 4-5 hour game (including finding all the achievements) is worth $24. If it had several characters to 'unpack' for and going throughout each of their lives, or content that is approx 10+ hrs on average, it'll be more worth the price.
Overall, it's a super cute and zen game, but I would recommend buying it on sale.

I love this game so much. I did want more at the end of the game but not because there was not a decent amount of content. I wanted more because I really enjoyed this. It feels so polished and the sounds and movements are so satisfying. It is a wonderful game and I can see the amount of effort that went into making it .

A really cute relaxing game that really now has me in the mood to redecorate my place, again! It's also really nice how we get to see in a sense the life of our protag and what they're going through just simply by the stuff we get to unpack and the music! The games very incredibly charming, relaxing and fun! :D
This game is very relaxing and enjoyable! The representation is amazing. but I wish there were more levels considering the price

If you like relaxing and you are nerodivergent you would love this game. I feel like people that like animal crossing or the sims would love this game too.  Fun to make up a story about this persons life through their things. Not the most deep game or crazy exciting but that's expected.

A game about unpacking possessions may not sound like it holds a lot of intrigue to most, but Unpacking is by far one of the most interesting games I've played. The storytelling isn't in-your-face, but rather given to you via album captions and the items you remove from your boxes. You experience happiness, heartbreak, nostalgia, new beginnings, coming of age, and many more experiences, all shown through boxes and accompanied by a pleasant and beautiful soundtrack. I didn't expect this game to be as captivating as it was, but I'm incredibly glad I took the plunge. Worth every penny.

Lo compré por que tenía muchas ganas de jugarlo, y ahora que ya estoy a punto de acabar el juego me siento tan satisfecha de haberlo comprado, es un juego muy relajante que puedes jugar cuando estés aburrida, también es desestresante dependiendo de como lo veas, y la historia que contiene es increíble, puedes guiarte a crear una historia en tu cabeza de acuerdo a lo que notes en cada cuarto nuevo, me gustó mucho y sin duda lo recomiendo, es un poco triste que no dure tanto, pero es muy lindo.

I originally played this as an app forever ago.  It was cute and relaxing, though on the small screen not as interesting as it should have been.  So when I saw that I could just buy it on Steam I was up for it and pretty excited!  And this little game blew me away.

Really, I never would have thought I could get so attached to a character you only see from their stuff, but there is so much character in the design of the rooms and of the items you are unpacking.

As you go through the years a lot of things reappear, as you would expect.  But they don't just reappear, they actually have some differences.  The stuffed pig that is so important to the character continues to show up getting a little dingier and have some stitches added.  The chicken and her chicks multiply, which I thought was super cute!  You get a story through scenery and it is a beautiful one.  I found myself smiling all through the last couple of levels as I saw what was happening to our protagonist.

I will admit though, I didn't play with the puzzles on.  Personally, I like it better without because it lets me just put together the house the way I think looks best.

Very cute game. Incredibly relaxing and quite emjoyable to decorate as you unpack for someone over and over. Would love DLCs to unpack more people's lives. Only two problems I found with the game.

1:Very short for the price. Only got ~4 hours out of it.
2: Some items are restricted to certain rooms, and occasionally and item comes out of a box in the wrong room. Not a huge deal, but can be frustrating when you're trying to find out which of only 3 specific spots the game wants a certain item to be in.

I love how nice and relaxing this game is! It is just a fun game to play when bored! I love the decor, and the aesthetic! But I don't think this game is worth 20.00$ You definitely should get the game whenever it's on a sale!

The items and art are cute and the music is pretty relaxing.  It definitely made me feel calm while I was playing. I've completed it twice, once regular and once dark star mode.  It's only 1 person for whom we are moving items, so a possible future enhancement might be to add more people?  I tried to take my time with the game, but my gameplay is still only at 5 hours across both completions so I'm a little disappointed it was over so quickly.  I don't think I'd recommend it as-is.
It is really fun and easy to play i love the lesbian story line and if you need a game the clams you this is the game. There are different modes that really are nice.

This game is about, as the title suggests, unpacking and putting items in their correct locations. It's a really creative way to tell the story of a woman growing up and going through different experiences in her life. It allows you to draw conclusions on your own without being explicitly told which I enjoyed. Excellent game. Highly recommend. 10/10 Soundtrack, visuals, and gameplay loop along with an environmental story with a surprisingly emotional touch. I would suggest turning on the free-play mode for the most fun experience.

Unpacking is a pretty short game (I finished it in 4 or so hours) but it uses its time pretty effectively. It tells the story of the protagonist's life through the act of unpacking the boxes they carry from place to place as they move through different stages of their life. Little easter eggs also give you interesting clues about what kind of life the character is experiencing which I quite enjoyed. The act of unpacking is also very satisfying interestingly enough. I waited until I had finished moving to play this game and I found a visceral satisfaction in the act of unpacking. The art is also pretty and the music is soothing. It is very much a chill game and I recommend it.

However I came to have an issue with it which was not being able to identify certain objects because of how small they are and there is no way of zooming in which would make you end up just putting them somewhere without knowing what they actually are. Would recommend if you are into unpacking and organizing (at a discounted price).

If the price was half that, then I would say it was worth it.  It says I played for 8 hours but I actually just had it running while I was away from the computer making food or watching movies.  I forgot to close it because I was distracted.

If the creators add just a bit more content then the $19.99 price is worth it.  In the end though, I feel like the gameplay was what I expected and was satisfied enough, and the "extra" money I felt that I spent would go to the creators for a good job.

I said I would recommend because of the idea and thoughtfulness of the game itself, not the length of it or the price.  If there was a in between choice I would have chosen that.

But other than that I do think it's overpriced for what it is, the graphics are amazing and the story is pretty nice, but I'd suggest getting it during a sale for what it is.

Amazing game - the only big let down is that there isn't more of it and that it doesn't seem like more is coming - which is aweful since it has a lot of expansion-potential!!!
If you like organizing, this is the game for YOU <3!!!
Very cute and very relaxing, with a bit of a storyline to follow through context clues. A nice game to play to unwind.

整體而言，遊戲的畫風跟音樂很優秀，遊玩方式讓人很放鬆，隨著每次搬家進入新的空間，都可以從開箱出來的物品感受到成長和變化。
但部分物品的擺放有一定的限制，無法自由決定位置，[spoiler]某時期的新家有使用過的髒碗盤被隨意亂放，玩家不可移動或是清洗[/spoiler]，這真的讓我血壓飆升 D：

知人から紹介されギフトしてもらったゲーム。一つ一つに物語があり、成長し、また新しい子どもに受け継ぐ。

This game overall is good- you have near complete control over where you place things, it's cute and relaxing, and you are very likely to just get lost in it. 
However, the game does come with a few flaws. 
1) I really wish you could move boxes. Sometimes they are just perfectly in the way of something and it really sucks. 
2) The game play is way too short in regards to the pricing. It takes only around three hours to complete the game. Considering the really short game time, it just wasn't worth 20$, which is why I'm happy I got it on sale. 
3) There is just not enough levels. It really sucks because this is a good game that I can see a lot of people enjoying, but there is so little game play that it's just a little pointless. Also, the Devs have said there is currently no plans to add anything to the game, which means that none of these problems will be fixed. 

So overall, it's a really nice and relaxing game, but I'd recommend only getting it when it hits sale so you don't feel let down.

This game is very casual and would be nice to play after coming home from a busy day out. An absolute delight and something I'll go back to multiple times (and have already). I would love to see new storylines from this creator if they choose to make them!

I love the story a lot. This game is super relaxing and chill! I love every nostalgic touch. As someone who has moved just as many times as the character in the game, there's nothing more satisfying than putting all of your things where they go and making your house a home <3

Really chill and nice game. You wouldn't guess how subtle you can tell a (not revolutionary but) nice story. Relaxing and remarkable audio.

This game got me back onto Steam. Love the art of storytelling without any narrations involved. It's nice to see how the character grew and watch the key moments of her life unfolded through the album.

This is the cutest and sweetest game I've ever played! It tells a story while you get to watch the mc grow and grow, gaining new items, watching items from early levels get older or change! I think everyone should play this game to be honest! The best 20 bucks I've ever spent!
I love this game it's so calming and relaxing to play after a long day. The sounds are also so pleasing and vary between items. I recommend highly!!!!

Such a sweet and emotional game that captures the changing of life perfectly. Definitely worth it even if a bit short and the secrets are too cute to find all of them. 10/10 would replay over and over. Super relaxing and helps OCD

评分8.4/10
理由
扣分项
1、最后一关要收拾的地方太多，大概需要150分钟左右。并不够解压。
2、许多地方不能满足强迫症（例如刚刚能放下某些东西的地方、例如书柜、游戏光碟、瓶瓶罐罐、内衣袜子衣服之类的不够配对）我知道这是写实的做法，但是我觉得可以根据游戏性质来满足玩家的爽点，与此同时并不会出戏。
3、有小问题BUG（例如房间户型有问题、构造有问题、比例有问题）东西的放置不够自在、不够自然、不够合理（个别的，大多数还是合理的）
4、有时候音乐停了的时候感觉很怪不太好。
加分项
1、东西拿起来晃动有声音、户型图虽然不够合理，但和房间布局是对应的。
2、游戏手感、非线性动画、做的可以直接给满分。无可挑剔。
3、像素作画可以说是足够生动形象了，几乎所有东西都可以辨认

总结：并不一定能完美的降压和休闲。但总体制作很棒，有些小问题。适合没有强迫症的休闲玩家。

One thing that did bother me throughout the game was the puzzle element mechanic of the game telling me things needed to go in a *very* specific spot to complete the puzzle for that room. Objects like lamps that I thought were okay on one side table needed to go on another side table to finish the room, though I suppose it's down to personal preference in the end! Just shows the difference in how people like their rooms, which I can appreciate. There is an option to turn this off in the menu, and I'll probably do another playthrough where I turn it off to put things where *I* want them to go, though I did want to complete at least one playthrough with it on out of respect for it being part of the core experience.
Long story short: really enjoyed the game, art and music were it's strong points, turn off puzzle elements in the menu if you want things to go where *you* want them, and probably get this on sale unless you want to support the devs.

I'll be completely honest, I didn't have high hopes for this game. I got it on sale, figured that it would mostly be a decorating simulator to burn a few hours on, and cracked into it.

Genuinely, this is one of my new favorite games. I'm talking with Stardew Valley and Skyrim. I would buy DLC or sequels to this game in a heartbeat. On the surface, it is very basic. You're a young woman moving from place to place, and you unpack your items in each of your homes. BUT, this game is incredible when it comes to environmental story telling. It doesn't have blocks of text to spoon-feed the story to you, it barely has any text at all, but you get a deep understanding of the main character nonetheless. Through nothing more than objects in boxes- which are surprisingly accurate to how I pack when I move -they manage to paint a full story and life for the character. You get to see her grow and mature and succeed in life, through nothing more than what she brings along with her. I've gotten every achievement, I've replayed it multiple times, and I'm about to go play it again. It's very detailed, visually impressive for a pixel game, and far more in depth than I ever expected. Bravo, Witch Beam!

Unpacking is a slow, lazy, kind of game. A gentle puzzler which tasks you with emptying your packing boxes upon moving into a new home. Each home has a set of rooms, from a couple in the beginning to quite a lot at the end, containing boxes. Your task is to work through each item in turn, placing them where they should go until the box is empty and you move onto the next. Once you've done this for every room you can skip to the next level.  At the basic level it's that simple.  

Obviously with it being a puzzle game there is some logic to be applied. Should the toaster go in the cupboard? Do DVDs live under the bed? But on the whole it's gently. At the end of placing items, the game marks up incorrect ones with a red border so you can instantly tell what's in the wrong place. Then it's just trial and error until everything goes where it should. 

If that's are there was to this though then it wouldn't be the success it is. No, it's the subtle storytelling that goes along with it that makes this special. Each home completed comes with a little tale from the protagonist that clues you into where they are at that time of their life. It can become quite touching, and when you see little items crop up again and again or indeed disappear forever it can be affecting, which is a big achievement for a relatively small puzzle game. It looks charming too, lovely pastel shades and well defined, recognisable objects. The soundtrack is spot on as well, it sits in the background but has enough about it to add charm rather than be blandly irritating.

Bonus marks for it running really well and adapting very well to the Steam Deck. You can move objects with the thumbstick and shift room to room with the shoulder buttons. I had a very nice time playing it on there.

When I saw the tag "story rich," I expected a lot more story than there really was, but there is more to it than I gathered from the trailer. You're following one person throughout several stages of their life, and seeing familiar possessions stay or be replaced, in a way that's deeply relatable. The "story" is just what you surmise about the character and their relationships based on the rooms and items, nothing particularly surprising or revelatory. I had to look up where you're allowed to put some items, and that was a little annoying, but overall it is a pretty satisfying and warm experience.

However, I don't know if the amount of content will be worth your 20 bucks. If you're not flush with cash, it can wait.

So, I'll say that this is a very good and very fun game where you get the joy of organizing a house without having to do any of the actual work. It has puzzle elements where you need to try to fit everything into the right place, which can get difficult depending on how much space you have at any given time, but still gives you room to organize the room in the way that you like. There is also an option to turn off the puzzle elements, letting you place items wherever you see fit. Beyond that, the game is strongly focused on environmental story-telling as you slowly work your way through this persons life, watching them acquire more items and hobbies as you move them from location to location and sometimes in with other people. There is no random items, as each object tells you something both about your mover and the people they will be living with, giving you an idea of where things will go and how the mover is doing.

That said, this game is very short as you are only following one person's life and thus I can't say it's completely worth the price to play. This is, arguably, the only thing that makes unpacking a difficult suggestion as I feel if it wasn't for this I would be recommending it more heavily. It's a fun game, but it's also a short game and replay ability is hit or miss. 

I'm kinda hoping the developer will consider adding onto it, by perhaps including other stories that we could follow, as I think Unpacking has a lot of untapped potential to explore peoples lives through moving them from place to place. That said, if not, I recommend getting this on sale, it's worth checking out even if it's a short and sweet game

Many of my friends played this game before me, and many couldn't recommend it enough. I was expecting a nice and chill experience, very relaxed, which is exactly what I got. I wasn't expecting it would hit me this hard.

This game is about unpacking, of course. There's a lot of opening cardboard boxes and placing items around. But there's something else. At some point, somewhere during pre-production, the developers probably realised that unpacking cardboard boxes is a metaphor for change. And so this game is about change; it's about trying things out, making mistakes, going back and finding your place in the world. It's about this and more; a lot of things that I personally read into it, and a lot more that I'm sure other people will find.

The part I love the most about this game is how familiar it quickly becomes. You forget the items that you leave behind, and you grow attached to the few things that you carry with you as you progress in the main character's life. I loved the little chicks; I loved the big piggy. So when some of those items get repurposed for something greater, you feel warmth flowing through your whole body. And when you see some of those again, it still feels like home - but in a different way.

Some games and works of entertainment you have the chance to experience at exactly the right time in your life. To The Moon was the first one for me; NieR: Automata was the second.

I think Unpacking may be a strong third.

This game can be played in a short amount of time (5 hours) or breaks can be taken in between unpacking scenarios. Unpacking is a very straightforward game where you unpack boxes into rooms in different houses, at different stages of a young woman's life. Despite the simple premise, this is a more complicated game than it seems at first glance. Aside from sometimes needing to work out how to fit a lot of items into a small area, the items aren't always unpacked into the room they're intended for, which adds an element of slightly humorous realism to the game. (Haven't we all found something in a box in one room that was meant for another room, while unpacking at some point in our lives?) 

The positives: There's no dialogue or narrative, instead, the charming story is woven through the items you unpack; however if you listen to the song that plays over the end credits, you get a slightly deeper look into the character whose life you've just been unpacking. The graphics are simple but pleasant to spend time looking at with a mostly pastel palette and no harsh neons or colours that would make your eyes beg for mercy after 5 minutes. The music is lovely and helps to set a very relaxed and calming tone for the game. There's something remarkably soothing about unpacking boxes with such music in the background and the challenge of finding where to put everything is enough to keep interest in the task without making it feel rushed at all. There's no timer and nothing needs to be done as fast as possible; the player is free to take as much (or as little) time as they wish. That said, it's also not a long game, so you're not likely to get bored before you finish it. Finally, there are 25 Steam achievements to gain. Over half of them come from completing the different levels and you can collect the rest in the first play-through as well, if you use one of the Steam Achievement Guides so you know what you need to do for some of them as they range from easy to 'I have to do WHAT?'.

The negatives: 'It's not a long game' is also a negative here. Even taking your time, the game likely won't stretch to 6 hours for a single play-through. I completed it twice in 8.4 hours and noticed the second time was shorter than the first as I already knew where everything would fit and which rooms certain items needed to be moved to. Another negative is that the normal price is what I usually consider slightly high for so short a game, however in this case the quality of the game (especially the music) makes it a fair price; some players will consider it money well spent, while others may prefer to wait until the game is on sale. I bought this game on sale at 20% off and feel I got my money's worth out of it. 

Mixed: The last aspect of the game I want to mention here is the game's Steam Achievements; as I said earlier, there are 25 and most of them are very easy to earn. However it should be noted that neither the player's Personal Achievements page (where all the achievement names are hidden until they're unlocked) nor the Global Achievements page (lists the achievements by name but has no information on what they're for) is very helpful in working out what the player needs to do to earn them. If you hate looking up achievement guides for games, you will need to spend a lot more time on this game to work them all out, as some of them are... Well let's just say that 'obscure' is an understatement for at least 2 of them. There is absolutely no shame in looking up an achievement guide for this game. If I'd thought of it before starting the game, I would have looked one up first. As it was, I needed a second play-through to earn all of the achievements. It won't be seen as a negative aspect of the game for many players, however.

All in all, I recommend this game for anyone looking to while away a few hours doing something relaxing and quiet with no timers or pressure. You're most likely to enjoy this game if you also like making order out of chaos. You may not enjoy the game as much if you like completing achievements in games without the use of an achievement guide, however.

Unpacking is a quaint and relaxing game that gives you a sense of satisfaction as you nest in various homes throughout your character's life. If you enjoy the feeling you get when you unpack in a new place or even on a vacation, you should give this game a try. Additionally, there are some hidden features that I didn't notice on my first playthrough, such as using the camera, flushing toilets, setting clock times, and turning electronics on/ off. Unlocking achievements yields you fun stickers that you can use to decorate your album or photos that you take in-game.

My only complaint is that the game is so short. I played through the whole game and got 13/25 achievements in 3.8 hours, and I just now went back to get the remaining achievements for an even 4 hours. Replay-ability isn't strong, and even for the sale price of $15, I was expecting a bit more. I think there's a lot of room for expansion-- different home layouts, getting a pet so you have to unpack a kennel/ pet toys and food bowls, maybe future levels where the baby grows up and takes over the album to show their homes, taking precious memorabilia with them like the stuffed pig or toy bus. I'm hoping the devs add some DLC like this in the future. That being said, I thoroughly enjoyed the nesting feeling while listening to the soundtrack as I played this game. Great concept, fun to play, easy to listen to. I would recommend it to anyone of any age looking for a relaxing game to play.

自分の人生に必要な持ち物とはなんだろう。
ゲームを終えた後に、部屋を見回して今まで大切に持っているものや手放せないものを考えさせられた。

ゲームそのものは至ってシンプル、1997年の子ども時代から始まる一人の荷解きをパズル感覚で行っていくもの。ドット絵が細かく、物によって置いたときの音が異なる。重いもの、軽いもの、金属や陶器…実際に整理整頓をしていたら聞こえる音がする。そういう細かさがゲーム性に対して飽きを感じさせない。
また特定のものは定位置があるけれど、必ずしもすべてがそうとは限らない。衣類の並べ方や小物の配置、本やノートの順序などこだわりだしたらいくらでも止まらない。そういう部分も楽しいゲームだった。
この荷物の持ち主の人生は一体どんなものだろう。彼女の成長に合わせて進んでいくうちに見えてくるもの、感じられるものがたくさんあった。生活用品は趣味、仕事、その他多種多様に人生を表すのだ。

If you're looking for a long, involved game with multiple facets and a kickass story then this definitely isn't the game for you. This game is very simple, and easily completed in about 4 hours, but that honestly just adds to its overall charm and appeal.

Unpacking is essentially that; each level you're in a little room, or a series of little rooms in an apartment or house, and each room has a couple of boxes filled with items you need to unpack and find a home for out of the many surfaces and cupboards across the level. It's strangely cathartic, especially if - like me - you feel like you're losing control of your life and are unable to sort anything out there, being able to do it in a video games seems to help restore some form of order. But I digress.

The levels are beautifully designed, the music is very calming, and there's just something calming and stress-free about this entire game (even when faced with items that just. refuse. to. go. in. the. bookcase.). It may be short, but it's definitely a game you can play again and again just to regain that feeling of order and calm. I would highly recommend!

Unpacking is self-explanatory. You unpack your belongings when you move into a new home. It is a short game that tells the life story of a young woman from 1997 to 2018.

As your unpack each level, you begin to find out more about this woman you play as, her age, her occupation, her relationships, her hobbies, etc. This method of storytelling is unique to its own as there are barely any words throughout the entire game. Her belongings are all that is needed. Is it impactful? No, I do not think so, but it is certainly interesting. I unfortunately do not find myself extremely attached to the main character, but I do like the process of learning how she grew up to become the person she is now in the final year where she moves to her forever home with her partner.

As with each review I do, I try to also give credits to the art and music. This game itself is a beautiful piece of pixel-art work, with soothing music in the back as you unpack all things. It is a sweet, cozy game.

Do I recommend this game? Definitely pick it up on sale. Unpacking is not a long game; it is mostly a decoration-sim plus a little puzzle-solving, like how you should fit everything the woman has brought with her when she moves in to another person's apartment or a dorm room. So if you feel like taking a break from intense MOBAs or FPS games, this is a great option for you.

Unpacking is, if nothing else, a masterclass in title design. The title contains pretty much everything you'll be doing: unpacking, unpacking, and grumbling to yourself because oh my GOD JUST FIT IN THE STUPID CUPBOARD ALREADY.

Deep breaths. Deep breaths. I'm fine.

Unpacking is, quite simply, a game about systematically unpacking a character's belongings and finding room for them as the character moves house. The story jumps forward through various key moments in the protagonist's life, with most of the challenge coming from having to fill larger and larger spaces until you're trekking around two-story suburban terraces looking for the one sodding place to put the towels. In terms of accomplishing this rather simple goal, Unpacking absolutely nails it. The controls are intuitive, the soundtrack is relaxing, and the soft pastel pixel art is just delightful to look at. The core gameplay loop does get a bit repetitive, but I was motivated to keep playing just to see what was going to come out of the boxes next.

Another thing I loved about the game was its approach to storytelling. There's no cutscenes, exposition or even spoken dialogue; the story is conveyed entirely through subtle background details and context clues. It's remarkable how much you can learn about this person's life from the things they continually bring with them when they move, to the places where you can store certain items, to the things they write in their photo album about each room. It's a marvellous job by the developers that shows real creativity and restraint, and it drew me in waaay more than I was expecting. 

However there is one big complaint to be raised about Unpacking that pretty much everyone can relate to; the length. It's a nice game to chill out and relax with, but you'd better savour that while it lasts because it really is very short. My run took 3.5 hours, and a good chunk of that was me alt-tabbed out and choosing which podcast to listen to. The game initially greets you with three albums, which I took to be three distinct stories centred on different characters. What the game neglects to tell you is that these are merely save files, and there's no difference between the three albums besides the colour of the cover and what stupid name you choose to give the protagonist. 

Compounding this issue is the fact that, due to the repetitiveness of the core gameplay loop and the lack of additional stories, the game has almost no replay value. This is one of the few times where I think procedural generation might actually improve a game. If nothing else, some kind of procedural bonus mode would add SOME reason to go back to this game after you've finished it. Without it, you may as well uninstall the game once you're done with all eight levels, because I can guarantee you won't want to go back and replay it. 

So, do I recommend this game? Well, while it is in dire need of some new content (especially for the asking price, which is very steep for a mere 3 hours), Unpacking's uniquely absorbing blend of relaxing gameplay and subtle background storytelling is absolutely something you must experience for yourself. However, if you're tight for cash and looking for a game that can keep you going for a while, you're probably better off elsewhere.
