정리하는 느낌이 아니라 그냥 욱여넣는 게임임입니다
플탐은 4시간이지만 게임하다가 끄적끄적 하려고 산 건데 씅질만남......
이 가격 주고 산 걸 후회하는 중.. 플탐때문에 환불도 못하고 진짜 최악..

This was one of those games that I just hyperfocused on for 4 hours until I beat it. I'm not sure its worth full price, but it is a fun game. It is a bit short. The gist of it is you're literally just unpacking boxes every time this person moves, and putting things where you think they should go. Things don't have to be EXACTLY in the correct area, but after you've unboxed every box any items that are placed in a wrong place will 'blink'. The achievement list was also easy, nothing overly complicated, but this was a game you can just get lost in with the unpacking and sorting. I wish I could get that same hyperfocus and unpack all my boxes in real life from my move 9 months ago, but here we are.

A game with a wonderful--and surprisingly strong--story, which is told subtly, but not plainly.
I would not believe a game in which you unpack boxes could be so lovely and unforgettable. 10/10

Great game, very relaxing. The only thing I didn't like was how short it was for $20. It took me probably an hour and a half to get through it. I love it though and have gone back to it; I just wish they would add more levels to it.

Love this game a lot! Having now played through it twice and gotten all of the stickers.

I will say I wish there was a little more content in the game either with another character's life or a continuation of the same story already in game.

It it very relaxing and a good game for people wanting to organize things.  I laughed. I cried. It was an emotional journey that you get to go on through the main character's life.

Unpacking is a unique game that uses relaxing puzzle-solving and environmental storytelling to show a person's life through objects. I absolutely adored this game, and have since recommended it to my partner and friends. Though it can be completed in anywhere between three and five hours, I thought the story was well fleshed out and I found immense joy in returning to it to complete all the creative little achievements in each level.

I love this game. whenever I want a calming (sometimes can be stressful) game. I do believe for $20 it is a bit pricey, and I'd wish they would add to it, but I think overall it is worth it! I have replayed it multiple times and is one of my favs!

Super cute game, not 100% sure if its worth the $20 I spent on it but it is a good game nonetheless. The replay-ability is decent cause you can put the art and everything in different spots but that's about it. There is also a "secret" mode you can play in but I don't wanna spoil it lol you can finish the whole game in less than 5 hours. it doesn't have any written story but it does have A LOT of context clues that make it absolutely adorable and at some times really sad. that being said I did have fun playing it and I have played it through almost three times now, super nice if you need a relaxing game that has no time limit or stress.

This is such a great game if not for it's potential. Very casual and relaxing. You pick up on a little back-story by the items you unpack. I have to say that this game is ,however, very short. I feel like for $19.99 it should have a few stories to "unpack". Quite expensive for so little content. I would recommend by game play and it's great potential. But it lacking otherwise. Perhaps they should create expansion packs for cheap. You know, since the game isn't worth the price as it is.

As a very sentimental person, especially regarding moving homes and organizing my spaces. This silly little game brought me such comfort and happiness. I like the thought that everyone who plays will move stuff around in subtle different ways. It's also a very beautiful game with a lot of fun details. I loved it very much :)

This game is really and truly beautiful. I love the controls, they are SO easy and you would never get upset because you don't understand them. The fact that the game tells a story without really telling the story is one of the most creative game concepts I've ever heard of. This game truly made me cry because the main character finding herself and blossoming into a proud woman is one of the most inspiring things I've ever experienced in a game and I really, really love this game. I recommend this to anyone on the planet.

Loved the game very much and the bonus ending was very lovely, its so much fun, I highly recommend this game to who doesn't have it and wishes to have it in the future. I finished this game in 1 day. Theres about 3 books, I think it might have saving progress or other, I havent really checked out yet but I still recommend this quite a lot!! 11/10

This game is fun and relaxing it has beautiful music and a rich underlying story that you cant help but put yourself in the shoes of the person who owns the belongings. I would agree with similar comments about the price of the game being a bit high for the short 3.4 hours i spent to complete the story line. However the game truly is very immersive and i'm not sorry I paid $20 for this.

I think this game is really cute and I always come back to it when I'm bored. However, it only takes 3-4 hours to finish if you're taking your time and there is no replay value.  I'd love it if there were more stages added to make the game worth its money, though I'm sure they aren't going to add any more. I'd recommend it if you're ok spending $20 for a few hours of game play, but I wouldn't recommend otherwise.

Absolutely loved it!
 It's a wonderfully cute, short and enjoyable game that i think everyone should sit through!

the story follows a woman through her formative years from childhood to adulthood and there's a surprising amount of emotion and story put into old belongings in cardboard boxes.

10/10 would unpack again

very relaxing but i dont think it has enough content for the $20 i spent. i also liked the hints of representation as well (at least i think it was). definitely recommend getting the game if its on sale.

This is a very good game and I highly recommend it.
Yes, it's $20 and only three hours, but you pay more than that to see a 2 hour movie. Idk why people are expecting every game to give them tens or hundreds of hrs of content. 

I only have a few comments:
- music on some levels can get a little repetitive.
- 90% of the unpacking is great, the last 10% can be kind of confusing as sometimes you literally just don't know either what an object is, or why your placements are being flagged as wrong. This messes with the pacing of the game and makes the end of every level kind of drag on. 
- moving tons of tiny items gets kind of annoying. if there were a way to select multiple items to move them around, that would fix this. However, i guess it would disrupt the flow of the game if you could play it less methodically so there's that.

Definitiv eine schöne, entspannte und kreative Spieleidee. Hab es in einem Stück durch gespielt. 

Einziges Manko: 20,-€ für 4 Stunden Spielspaß.

짧은 순간에 삶이 어떻게 자라나고 완성되어가는지를 담은 게임입니다. 처음에는 깨끗하고 상처 하나 없던 분홍돼지 인형이 차츰 낡고 헤지지만, 깁고 새 천을 덧대어 가듯. 게임 속 짐의 주인도 시간에 따라 자신의 삶을 완성시켜갑니다. 조그마했던 공간에 몇 안되던 물건을 채워넣다 차츰 더 넓고 멀끔한 집에 새 물건을 채워넣어가는 과정을 따라가보면 주인공의 삶이 어떠한가도 유추하는 재미도 있어요.
삶의 굴곡을 드라마틱하지는 않아도 담고 있는 것 같고 공간에 물건을 나름대로 배치하며 이상한 편안함도 느낄 수 있었어요. 짧은 플레이타임이지만 재밌었습니다.
摆放过程解压，纠正摆放结果增压；不认识摆放的东西增压，最后的音乐和画面解压。时隔很久决定改为不推荐，无法从摆放过程以及观察他人生活中得到乐趣的玩家可以不用尝试了。

It's a very calm game and is wonderful in order to both pass the time and take a break from any other chaos going around. It keeps me entertained and engaged with its hint of a puzzle aspect. I know that some people talk about a short gameplay, but even just the first run-through lasted me almost 5 hours and I plan a playing it a lot more; I feel like there is a lot of replay ability.

Edit: It's actually given me motivation/inspiration for organizing my own home/room haha

Extremely fun and relaxing. Also I love how its a story of show but not spelling it out for the payer. As you unpack, you find items and little details here and there of what the character you're unpacking for is going through at the moment as well as their interests. Apparently you can learn a lot about someone just by their stuff and rooms without ever meeting them face to face and this games proves its effective in showing that kind of story telling works. I recommend it!
非常解压，设计者也很用心，从细节体现剧情和人物关系，就是体量有点儿小，要是能再多几章就好了。

Es un juego precioso y relajante. Me encanta que descubras la historia del personaje mientras ves cómo cambia su casa. Me lo pasé muy rápido y pensaba que habría más historias, pero sólo es una :( así que si lo compráis disfrutadlo mucho e id lento.

I enjoyed this game a lot! My only wish is that it were longer; I finished in about five hours, which isn't much for a $20 game. Hopefully they release more content? But still, it was a pleasurable gaming experience. I am the sort who watches "satisfying" videos and enjoys when things fit perfectly into other things, and this game really played on that. 

More than that though, this is really a story game, and a very interesting way to tell a story at that. You never meet the character whose things you are unpacking, but you follow her throughout her life and understand all sorts of things about her just from her belongings. Watch your character grow and change! Draw inferences from tiny details! I don't want to spoil anything, but when I realized that my character had achieved something she had been working toward for a while, I got genuinely excited. I felt sincerely connected to her even though I never actually saw her. It's well crafted and interesting.

I thought I was going to be playing a simple relaxing game where I'm just moving from house to house unpacking boxes, but this game surprised me. You follow the life of a character from childhood through to adulthood and I can't express how delighted I was with the story telling dynamics. It was so subtle but so clever. The controls are simple and easy. Graphics and animation are fun. Just an all around good game.

The whole idea of telling a story through different moves & using each one as a state of the main character's life is such an original and charming idea.
The game itself is very relaxing and fun, it can also be finished pretty quickly, but maybe too quickly? It would be nice to maybe see more storyline in the future & follow new characters. The dark star mode is fun, but doesn't bring much more content.

In the end, if you're looking for a quick game to get your mind off things, would 100% recommend.

Very cute, very relaxing. 

The game has a cute background story and is perfect for a rainy day. I could have played for hours and hours. Sadly the game is rather short. The graphic design is adorable and makes it possible to play this game on weak hardware as well.

Got it as a gift, otherwise I would have probably never played, because it's quite pricey. 
I'd recommend to buy it on sale.

Honestly adored this game, definitely cosy vibes, even the soundtrack to the whole game puts you in the zone to play this peaceful game. Got easily lost away and played for 5 hours without realising. Of course not for everybody, but for someone like me who proffers the slower and simpler games most of the time, it's perfect!

Unpacking is a very calm game and while it is quite "do it yourself" it has enough of a story line to keep you interested. Along with that, the option to be able to place items in this unpacking game wherever you want, which can be toggled on and off, makes it able to played multiply times without feeling too repetitive. I also love the surprises and different ways you can play it. For example when you finish decorating one of the many houses or apartments and you take your final picture of one of the rooms you get a different caption in the album for whichever room you take a photo of, which is fun to play around with. Another example is how you can play the game just to collect all of the different little stickers and emojis to decorate those pictures which you get depending on how you decorate your house, for example, you get a little math related sticker if when you are putting the fridge magnets on, you make a equation out of the 1, +, 2, =, and 3. This game seems very simple and like I mentioned before, calming, at first but at a deeper glance you can truly see how much effort and thought the creators have put into every single aspect of this game.

I love this game, it is so relaxing even tho you would think it would be stressfull when it tells you that you did something wrong and you need to find a new spot fo rit but at the end of the day its a very nice and relaxing game. I wish we had more levles though :')

Loved the game, but wish there were more years you could play. This is also a short 2 hour game at the least and wish it were longer. If you want to play multiple times then i would get it but if you don't like playing games and the same levels over and over again i wouldn't get it.
Amazing, the game has very subtle storytelling and its just really relaxing. put on a podcast and just play it, youll finish it in around 4-5 hours but its time well spent

Unpacking is a pretty short puzzle game about...well, unpacking. The only story you have is the one you make in your head through the items you find in your character's boxes. As you go from a kid, to a teenager at university, to a young adult moving in with roommates, to moving in with your significant other, to moving back home, to getting back on your feet again, to building a new family, the experience is yours to make. Your only goal in this game is to put these little pieces of your life where you think they'd best fit.

It's a fairly short game, and for 20 bucks, I was hoping it'd be a lot longer or have different levels, or at least a modding community where people can make their own levels and homes for others to unpack in, but it is what it is. I wish I had gotten it while it was on sale, honestly, because 20 bucks seems pretty steep for just 8 levels and not a lot else. Maybe I'm missing something, I don't know. But if you're looking for a good puzzle game with relaxing music and a steady pace, this is for you.
Such a relaxing zen game to play to destress and pass the time! Recommend to anyone who likes zen games and the story line is great with so many stickers/secrets to unlock

Very chill game, it's fun and relaxing. If you're having a bad day and just wanna take your mind off things, this is the game for you. Although I must admit that it's a very short game, and it's pretty expensive for what you get in return. Regardless, it's a good game. I use it for de-stressing^^

Wonderful little game which is unbelievably satisfying! Should definitely have more content though, it only has about 3 hours or playtime of which you can then redo all the levels but it gets a big mundane (because obviously its the exact same thing) I would definitely recommend getting it if it goes on sale. Cute graphics and the attention to the different noises when you pick things up and also when you move them about really hits all the good spots in my brain (except the shower mat thing the noise of those bubbles is hell to me for some reason).

I find organization relaxing, so this was a perfect game. I strangely became attached to items and was sad to see changes in items or was happy to see the return of a previously missing objects. To see your character transition through each phase in life through each move was strangely melancholic and nostalgic. I remembered my own moving experiences and all those important moments in my life connected to those memories. The cute little achievements found in each move are a delightful motivation. The song at the end credits is wonderful and was a sweet bow, tying together a lovely game. If you like organization and nostalgia, this is the perfect game.

A great game to play when you want to unwind and relax. The story line is adorable and as you follow it you grow more fond of the game! I would say that for the cost of the game compared to how long you get out of the first run through is something you should debate on. Took me 3 hours and cost me $30 NZD.

I did enjoy this Game a lot and had fun discovering the Story of the person you are unpacking for. Seeing what they go through in their life, discovering the Character and seeing these items that appear in every House and growing familiar with them.
The sound design is incredible from the music to the sound of putting things down it's just so so perfect, the artstyle is wonderful and it just looks amazing.

That said, I think the 20Euro price tag is a bit much. I 100% the Game in 3.5 hours and there is nothing after. I am not sure about replayability since I had the most fun with discovering the Characters life and I already know everything now.
I would still recommend getting the Game, but only if it's 50% off. ~3 hours of gameplay for 20Euro is just not worth it, imo.

it's fun and relaxing. the only annoying part is where some items may be in the wrong place and you can't move on until its in it right place. it's annoying because sometimes you have no idea what the item is or you have your own idea of where the item should be but the game keeps telling indicating that your in the wrong place and gives no clues on where the player should put it. however, other than that its a really fun games which also imagination to run surprisingly

This game is great. If you enjoy puzzles and sorting things then this is a great, cozy game for you. The story is also incredibly wholesome and it was a treat to experience showing-not-telling in the true sense of the word.

I followed Wren Briar's work on this while it was in development and I'm just incredibly impressed with what the team has created. I thoroughly enjoyed this game. I hope to see more from Witch Beam in the future.

If you're looking for some chill games, but you also like good stories and puzzles, Unpacking might be for you. I just keep on playing and playing, and the next thing I know, it's already been 3 hours. I definitely had fun playing this and I would come back again for other levels (?).

Fantastic, lovely and smart!

It's one of those rare scenarios that I had a hunch I would love it when first heard about the game play, and it turns out far better than expected. All you need is to wait for a right mood, then relax and enjoy.

To repeat that "the empathy is overflowed" will be an understatement and cliche, but it is what it is.

One downside is that my very unrealistic desire for a cintiq is reignited though :(  sad

saw a lot of reviews with the same take, I really enjoy this game to the point where I replayed it, the story is subtle, its in the music and a collection of context clues and I adore it for that! the gameplay is very enjoyable and satisfying for someone like me who likes organising things. It gives you a decent amount of freedom while also making sure that your placements align with the story (as well as common sense hehe.)

but definitely wait for it to get on sale as it isn't nearly long enough to be worth the full price

This game has been in my wishlist ever since this came out, but I never bought it. It was only until last week, when I had encountered a similar (knock off) game from Google Play, which I had to pay to remove the ads for and still was not satisfied with the overall experience that I had realized that, here's Unpacking on Steam, cheaper and better a hundred times than the knock off. So I bought Unpacking (finally) full price (I didn't wait for any sale to get it).

Unpacking is a simple, zen-like, organizing game. The graphics are beautiful. I've always adored pixel and isometric art so this one, like I said, had caught my eye from the start. The music and SFX are also good and fits in the game overall. There are also some interactions with some elements in the game, other than organizing stuff. Even though this is such a short game, there is also a heartwarming story.

Anyway, learn from me, don't buy knock offs. Just buy the original games. Devs worked hard for these types of innovations in the game industry so it would really pay off to buy from them.

This game is very relaxing and I enjoyed it. However, there isn't enough content for the $20 price tag it has; I finished the game in less than 4 hours. I was hoping each album was a different person's life we were unpacking, not it's not, it's just the one woman. Really hoping they add more levels, I want to keep unpacking more new stuff!

This game is a delightful study in environmental storytelling. Masterfully told, masterfully displayed and overall just one of the most enjoyable little games I've ever played. It's short but worth every penny paid for it.

Great game, a very cozy time but not worth 20€. 
Buy it, but wait for a sale I'd say. 

It has very little content. 
Hope for something more in the future but right now it took me less than 3 hours to play the whole game.

I loved the story of the game, and would love to see it continue, maybe follow the family into the next generation, or someone new entirely.

One of the most relaxing games I've played, no time constraints or anything stressfull, nice music and cozy atmosphere.
Love this game! I hope they expand someday by adding new character's lives or continuing this one until old age. I really enjoyed playing this (:

This game was very cute, relaxing, and had a very heartfelt story without throwing the story right in your face. There are 3 books in the menu, which are basically your save points. However, they're all the same story. I wish the other 2 books were someone else's story, with more rooms and more things to unpack. Like many others I believe the game isn't worth it's price tag for how little you get. I hope they add more stories in the future with more to unpack, but for now, it's not worth it. Did I enjoy myself? Yes. Was it relaxing? Yes. Did I finish the game in a few hours? Also yes.
Pretty quick play through. Once on the final level the unpacking is almost as frustrating as doing it IRL as boxes and items are unloaded into the incorrect room.
遊戲過程十分療癒，畫面美術也很好看，只可惜有些物品不確定是什麼，如果能加上說明或許會有更好的遊戲體驗

very relaxing puzzle game, i loved that it told a story and how the items aged. i had the game on my wishlist and bought it during a sale. however i was pretty bummed it only took about 3-4 hours to complete the entire game. they really should release a free dlc with more characters / or alternate life paths to make the game feel less cheap.

i wasn't expecting a story, but man... i am invested. just thinking of the events in her life to make her unpack and move a lot.  love the attention to detail on items. So good and simple and cute with lovely [and proper] pixel art.
everything in its right place, for the kid architect in all of us.
this game could have infinite levels/sequels and i would spend an embarrassing amount of money to play every single one. it's so relaxing & intimate it is really the perfect game.

Though this is a "one time play" kind of game, it brings me loads of comfort rearranging old things I organized. When I first downloaded it, I was a mess. Nothing was in the right place, and I was really just freaking out and I put stuff half-hazardly and gave up. Coming back to it is like redecorating your room. Putting things in new places, redecorating, and following along a story of a girl living her best life. I don't want to give any spoilers, but the ending made be shed a tear. If you are looking to get this game, I strongly recommend it for people with OCD or Anxiety. Have fun!

Really like this game. It's very relaxing to play, the music is so cozy, the game play is simple yet satisfying. 
I really hope there's a sequel for this game!

this game is very sweet and has a lot of creative freedom with where you're placing everything, making each person's choices their own within the same guideline; however, i would absolutely recommend buying this on sale. it is a very short game for the price, but the story is cute and the game is enjoyable.

this game is gorgeous and heartwarming in every way. it has it's emotional ups and downs and a story that tells itself through nothing but images and implications, in the best way i could possibly say that. however, there is one thing i don't particularly like about the game that many people share the same opinion of.

that's right, the price! i don't think it's worth 20$. it's definitely a beautiful game, but, eh.

This is a very relaxing game that tells the story of a woman's life only through her living situation, you can see her becoming independent from her parents, through love, heartbreak, then love again. It is a beautiful game that tells a beautiful story, if you need a game to help calm you down, I highly recommend this game.
玩了兩遍了 好喜歡這個遊戲 要是能有多幾關玩或者開工作坊就好了 找遍全網也沒找到類似的遊戲
The gameplay is really fun and relaxing, but man it genuinely made me so emotional ;;!! just hit close to home for me and i really got invested in the story that i feel i was really well conveyed
게임 자체는 플레이타임 너무 짧다 대충대충 하면 한두시간 만에 할수도 있을듯 강박증 처럼 완벽하게 정리하고 싶은 사람한테는 잘맞는 게임인데 다른 주인공 스토리도 만들어주면 좋겠음 ..

A truly lovely, lovely game. Excellent pixel art everywhere, attention to detail at every step and and no stress to be found except your own inner perfectionism to get every room as final as you want it to be. The best thing of all, however, is how even the tiniest object in this game plays a part in its overall story. Not all packed things will make sense to everybody, sure, but the hint system makes up for it in my opinion.

I'd give it a double thumbs up if I could, but one will have to suffice says Steam. Highly recommend for anybody who likes environmental storytelling, spatial puzzles or simply needs to escape their own living space for a little while.

First and foremost, I would love to see updates to this game. More rooms to unpack, more of the character to discover, more of her story!

On one hand, I really like how understated the story and evolution of the character is. You can fill in the blanks, and if you pay close enough attention make your own connections. On the other, I think I'd like a "canon" for the character, because there are lots of things I'm curious about after finishing the game and I really want to know!

Gameplay is relaxing, but sometimes frustrating when you are trying to get things to fit just right in limited space. Unfortunately, even with the addition of new game modes it has a limited amount of replayability. It's the kind of game that provides nostalgia though, the kind you can revisit again after awhile and enjoy.
An interesting game about unpacking your stuff into different scenarios. Be aware that this game has a story that is not so obvious at first and you should look after it.

Really fun and relaxing. 
Can get through it quite quickly though if you're looking for a longer game with more bang for your buck. :)

Ich finde das Game unglaublich süß und liebevoll gestaltet und mit viel Liebe zum Detail. Eigentlich spiele ich Games in der Art eher selten, aber Unpacking hat mich direkt überzeugt und ich musste unbedingt weiterspielen!^^ Ich kann es nur weiterempfehlen, denn es macht Spaß und man kann dabei auch abschalten und entspannen. Ich habe das Game schon durch und hoffe, dass in Zukunft vielleicht noch weitere Storys hinzugefügt werden, denn das Game hat auf jeden Fall Potenzial.

If you are okay with spending $20 for about 2-3 hours of game-play, Unpacking is for you. Despite being short and simple, I really enjoyed this game. There's something so relaxing about moving around objects and finding the perfect space for them, I always felt a rush a joy after completing a room/level. It was honestly a bunch needed break after playing so many games with hard to achieve goals. I enjoyed story as well as the gay  representation, I felt I could really connect to the PC. I was so happy to see them leave the toxic relationship and find new love and start a family. I did also really like the time-lapse mechanic. It was very enjoyable to watch everything I had just done, but fast.
   The only issues I have with the game are the price-to-playtime ratio and relay value. Sure, It's a good game to revisit maybe once a month, look back at how I organized things and maybe even try again, but It's not something one would do forever. And the price, well, it's just too high in my opinion. Games like Stardew Valley have much more playtime at a cheaper price, and I just feel like this game is more a $15 game than a $20 game. 
   Overall this game a 7.5/10, and if you're looking for a quick play that isn't too hard on your brain, I heavily recommend, but maybe wait until it goes o sale.

The game itself is very cute, perfect for a relaxing time. However, there's no content. Maybe they will release more in the future (hopefully soon), but as of right now, it's a game you should buy only when on sale.
Es estéticamente muy bonito, pero es muy corto y sale mucha plata .Realmente no se justifica. En 3 horas lo termine de jugar completo. No lo vale.

This is literally the best game ever I could play it forever but my computer overheats after 30 minutes of playing anyways lol if they were ever to update this game and add more "levels" it'd be absolutely fantastic! Definitely recommend this game, very relaxing and cute

Storytelling was 100%, made me shed tears. 

i also love re-watching the replays of the levels and see my horrid organizing skills go ham while putting everything on the floor.

Short answer, yes it's worth your time but it's kinda short game. (I completed it in 3,5 hours but you can do it faster)

The alignments may be off by some pixels from where you want to place it, and some items cannot be placed in certain parts of the room. Parts where an item could/should go cannot be accessed because it's not "visible" (i.e. cupboard wall partially hiding space) and I got frustrated trying to place the cups, etc in an arrangement that I wanted. [h3]Impressive from both an artistic and technical perspective, and with a subtle heartwarming story to boot. 
Unpacking is a wonderful game that's right up your ally if you love indies that act as a kind of playable short story/novella.[/h3]

[hr][/hr]

It may not seem like there is a plot present at first just off of the promotional material, at least I didn't think there would be much of one myself. Though once I got in and experienced what it was- I have to say- the story was lovely. I've never truly realized how much insight you can gain from observing a character's possessions over time. Unpacking does an incredible job with giving you just enough information to be hooked and instantly understand when something occurred over a period of time. But not too much information so that it doesn't leave any room for your mind to wander. Often times throughout the game I would ask myself how I thought something went down while simultaneously sorting clothes in a closest or stacking kitchen shelves. Getting lost in thought while just simply playing the game. When they say this is a zen puzzler; they mean it. 
I also loved how many of the items had little secrets. There are even a ton of items that follow the main character's entire life, these items have very cute details that evolve alongside the main character. Opening up the moving boxes and seeing old and new items is literally a lore dump for that level. 

Of course the pixel art is beautiful all throughout and the music is also very fitting for the tone of each level. But frankly that's unsurprising considering that you've ever seen even a tiny bit of the game. What I was surprised to find out about however was how versatile the placement of objects are and all the extra features the compliment the relaxing atmosphere of the game. The way the grid was implemented in conjunction with the level design was very well done, there's a ton of possibilities and unique ways to solve the rooms. While solving where these items are allowed to go isn't hard, which it's not supposed to be. It was still rewarding mainly just because of seeing the insane visual improvement going from barren-lifeless rooms to something that resembles a real home. Watching the replays once I finished some of the later [i](admittedly daunting)[/i] levels was also very satisfying. 

After playing; I believe that the game is fully worth the 20$ price. Though initially it personally took a small sale for me to finally take that extra step to buy and play this. This review is being written just after I 100% the game, so my time log is what you can expect. This is just beating all the levels and along the way doing some extra cute interactions/puzzles to get achievements and stickers for use in the game's photo mode. You can go back and replay and even [spoiler]reorganize items in the levels without puzzle constraints[/spoiler] once you've beaten it, though I didn't mess around with it that much at the time of this review.

[hr][/hr]

Unpacking is the definition of short and sweet. The game is easily completed within a short amount of time but manages to tell quite the heart warming story within that time. We don't get to interact with any characters in the narrative but we get to know them in probably the most intimate way, by organising their things in their rooms. We get to see the main character's life through her belongs as she moves from place to place, we learn about her and her situations through these items and it shows that you don't need an intricate concept to tell a good story. The game play is very relaxing, as someone who finds decorating quite enjoyable it is really satisfying seeing the final result. The price tag on the game may seem a little much for such a short game but you must consider the time and effort that went into it as well as the fact this is a game that can be played countless times, I still haven't earned all the stickers.

Adorable and interesting puzzle game where you open moving boxes and put items where they belong. It’s short and sweet. Just pointing and clicking, sending things to the right cupboard or drawer; organizing and tidying up a lifelong collection of memorabilia.

The main draw here for me is how it weaves a narrative through a seemingly uneventful game. There are no characters or dialogue. There’s no action. No exposition or storytelling in the traditional sense. Just boxes with [i]stuff[/i]. Stuff you infer meaning from; that eventually describes a person -- their interests, hobbies, and preferences. Each item you pick up is like a brush stroke, painting a clearer and clearer picture.

Who knew you could tell so much about someone just by looking through their personal belongings?

Recommended, if you want to chill out with some clever narrative design, and an all-around feel-good game.

Unpacking is an exceptional storytelling game that takes the phrase "show, don't tell" to the nth degree. 

You are never explicitly told anything about the life of the character you play as, and are instead left to infer everything for yourself as you perform the titular activity of unpacking boxes in various stages of your character's life; represented by the different houses/apartments they've moved to throughout the years, stylised in in delightfully intricate and stunningly beautiful pixel art. You learn not just surface-level details about the character you're playing as (hygiene products showing your character is female, art supplies and gaming consoles suggesting hobbies, etc.) but also events that unfold throughout the years. Photos once heartfully displayed become shoved into the back of drawers, a degree once proudly hung gets shoved under a bed; moments like these paint such a vivid narrative picture without ever presenting you with a written or verbal story beat, instead using the ingeniously rudimentary core gameplay mechanic of "yes, this object can be placed there" and "no, that object cannot" to guide you in drawing your own conclusions on the significance that each box of unpacked mementos has. 

While listed as a puzzle game, I find Unpacking to not exactly meet that label, but I'm glad for it because getting frustrated by puzzles would ultimately just detract from how rich and involved the story unfolding before you can be enjoyed. Maybe that's just me though and there are people that are legitimately puzzled and stumped by the task of where in a house a bottle of shampoo should be placed.

Unpacking is relaxing, engaging, and deeply moving. Through the process of unpacking objects, organising them, and arranging the errata of everyday living, you slowly uncover the story of a young woman coming of age in Brisbane, Australia. By the end of the game I felt like I knew her intimately and was close friends with this person I had never seen or heard, just by examining the objects that follow her through multiple moves. I delighted in all the little moments that emerged throughout each move: discovering the protagonist had taken up the ukelele, finding her posthumous portrait of her pet stag beetle, watching her rough sketches evolve into a successful picture book, finding new souvenirs of her travels. It's also a game deeply rooted in Brisbane, from the VJ boards of her childhood home, to the boyfriend's apartment in Kangaroo Point overlooking the Storey Bridge, to the one-bed woolshed conversion in Newstead; so many little architectural and cultural touches root this game squarely in my own home town. Unpacking is a joy to play.

A short game but quite sweet. Some of the levels lacked adequate storage space, making the organising a bit stressful as I could not set things as I wanted them. But I guess that’s true to life.
A very nice relaxing game with amazing sound design. You learn the story of the main character through her belongings as well as her flatmates.
Quick, fun and relaxing game, would wait for a sale though, $20 does feel like a lot when you only get a couple hours of playing time.
虽然摆放的地方还是会有限制，偶尔也会有不知道是什么的东西，不过总体来说，游戏很温馨。不知道会不会有下一个？

this is not worth it's full price, in any way. Buy it when it's at least 50% off, if not more

this game is a beautiful experience to have, but the pleasure of the gameplay was ruined at the end when I realized I had played the entire thing in 4 hours, with a break for dinner in the middle... I left some time go by, and went back to play it again, and it took even less time the second time, since I didn't have to try and understand what some things were and I was faster with the map... 
Also, I read somewhere that the developers said that they wouldn't be adding any extra content or stories, or allow the community to make stuff in the workshop, and that really pissed me off, considering the replayability (or lack thereof) with this game...
This game is so cute I love it. The story is sad and happy but also relatable. It also very chill and a great game to wind down/relax to.

I really liked playing this game, it was cute and relaxing and I really enjoyed the underlying story. I've spend a lot of time on each room so I didn't really notice how short it was, but I do wish there was more

I watched a YouTube play-through of this game (By Seri!PixelBiologist) and just knew I had to buy and play it. I had high expectations for the game, and after playing through it once, my expectations were more than met. There were so many cute little things you notice as you go through the story, the twists and turns-- everything was absolutely amazing. I completed the game in just two days because of how excited I was to play it! The hidden achievements are so cute, and I love that it doesn't list out what they are or how to get them so you have to find them yourself! I will definitely play through the game again in the future. The credits at the end of the game even made me cry! It's not hard to make me cry, but this game deserves sentimental and surreal tears from everyone that plays it! 

I hope you make an Unpacking 2 or Unpacking Continued in the future! Perhaps for the future life stages. I won't say too much so that I don't spoil the game for anyone who reads this review, but I know I along with many others would love more to play using this storyline and these characters. <3

It's a fun, cute, very short game and it said something to my OCD that caused me to love it.  I do love it, but I really meant it when I said it was extremely short and for $20 I really wish I had waited until it was on sale.  I did play it multiple times though and enjoyed doing so.  Although it would be nice if other story lines were added to make it have more content.

This game was super fun and had my attention the whole time, I loved organizing everything in all the rooms, and I loved the fact that we basically made our own interpretation of the gals life in the story. Would I pay $20 for this game again no. $15? maybe, it's a little expensive for only lasting a few hours and then it being done, but it was a good game and worth it at the end of the day.

Honestly, its a very heartwarming game, you get to know this person as you well literally unpack their life from home to home, you see the bad and the good. If I had one problem with this game its that it was rather short. I'd Say pick this game up on sale if you want to kill a few hours.
Great game but it does get pretty repetitive, I really wish there was more levels and stories other than just the one. Either way still a great game and I recommend

Schade das es nicht länger geht (ca. 8h) mit allen Errungenschaften und gemütlich gespielt :( es ist so ein schönes Spiel. Ich finde es für knapp 20 Euro leider zu kurz. Trotzdem empfehle ich es, weil es mega liebevoll gestaltet ist und mega Spaß gemacht hat <3

This game is so relaxing and satisfying! I loved getting to go room to room and find places to put all of the characters' things. The storyline is super cute and subtle enough that you can imagine some of your own details based off the items in the boxes while also giving enough to enjoy as it appears. I hope that the game gets expanded to include more years and moves eventually because it is definitely addicting!

Replayability is also pretty good in my opinion as there are near infinite ways to organize the items. Overall amazing game albeit a little bit short (ap.6hrs) although playing it more times through can remedy that!

Comfy lil game to unwind with, quite short but worth the experience. 
About 4-5 hours to 100%.

Only real dislike was that items have "correct" positions and it forces you to place them where it wants them to go, and not necessarily where you think they should go. A bit jarring and detracts from the immersion since it's like being told your personal room isn't designed "properly".
很喜欢这种家里大大小小的东西收拾整齐的感觉，很治愈。在每次搬家整理的时候跟着小线索推理出的剧情也很棒。结局十分的对我口味，本来是当成模拟类游戏买的，打通了时候竟然也可以归类到我的另一个分类，意外之喜了。

Unpacking is a good cozy game that has a pretty awesome subtle storytelling method as you play through the game. Well worth the buy. You will likely only get an two or so hours of game play out of Unpacking, but I'd still highly suggest it if you just want a cute break.

its a great game, honestly. i had loads of fun playing it and it kept me entertained for 4 hours which most games fail to do. is it worth 20 dollars?? i dunno, but it is a good game so if its on sale or you want a nice relaxing game then yes 100% get it

Absolutely loved playing this game. Very relaxing and satisfying! The level of story telling packed within the short span of the game is impressive.

However, the length of gameplay is the main problem. It is too short considering the price. It is replayable but only to a certain extent before it gets repetitive. 
Hopefully more content will be added in the future but until then i'd say not worth the $$.
I loved this game! It was very fun and the story-telling was great. Though, I'm disappointed that it was so short, especially that it cost me nearly CAD$30

Bien plus qu'un jeu de rangement, c'est notre histoire qui est compté et que l'on déballe au fur et à mesure des déménagement.
Aucun texte, juste des bribes de souvenirs ici et là. A nous de nous faire notre propre récit. 
C'est extrêmement satisfaisant de pouvoir poser les choses où on le souhaite. A chaque fin d'aménagement, on peut choisir de voir une vidéo en accéléré ou un GIF pour se remémorer tous nos gestes... 

La DA est magnifique, les couleurs sont douces et suivent leurs temps. On reconnaît bien les différentes générations qui sont traversées.
Un jeu chill qui fait plaisir, je ne peux que vous le conseiller!
The game was entertaining but i feel i wouldn't recommend buying this game on full price as its got very short content for a almost $30 game!

This game is very satisfiying!
If you really into cleaning house mode, this game definetly for you!
its like a puzzle game where u need to figure out how to sort things and put them away. 10/10

I love this game. It's very relaxing and fun. I understand how some people don't see the replay value, but I replay it all the time to help me relax. I have 26 hours on record. I would love to see more levels. Maybe different people with different stories you could follow. That is my only problem with this game, is that I want more of it.

This is a great game. It's a cute and relaxing simulation-type game. The only downfall is how short the game itself is for the price you end up paying for it. To finish the game, it took me around 3 to 4 hours tops, excluding extra time to go through and get achievements. The game would be much better if there were other stories you could play through and unpack.
Overall I did thoroughly enjoy the game, and I adore the concept of going through and unpacking their things into new homes.

It's a cute game, relaxing, bit of a story in the background. But it's pricey for what it is and how long it was stuck in dev. Unfortunately they gave away half the game in the demo alone, so we were expecting more for it's price. Hope they can rectify this soon, the concept is great, but as is right now can only recommend it as a "Maybe"

Really loved the game, finished in the span of 3 hours, give or take. Too short for the price it is. 

Great relaxing game, frustrating when things light up red when they aren't in the right spot, but its just because sometimes i don't know what things are, hopefully in a further update every time you pick something up it tells you what the item is. 

But all in all hope more is released soon.
Its fun but I don't see a point in spending so much on a game that doesn't have any plans for expansion, get it on sale, it is worth the sale prices!!
Super short game but it's cute and fun. Would recommend as it's story telling is done in a fun style that will take you on a trip.

Very nice game. The story telling is very subtle and it's an easy game to just zen out on. I would say it's too short for the 20 dollar price tag but not by that much. Hopefully they add more content to enjoy.
Exceptionally cute game that is relaxing and makes you think about how your life merged and changed over the years, where you lived and who you shared it with. Awesome game!

Its such a sweet game, I love the story and the progression throughout the years. Its a very cleaver game with how it told the quite emotional story, I felt touched and close with the character as we went through their formative years, I felt with them during their journey. This game is really special, I cried once I realised one of the big changes (so beautiful, I also felt represented beautifully), and also at the end. This game is just simply beautiful, through and through , from the story and the art style- I absolutely adore the aesthetic <3 The replay value is great too. I know some people have complained about the price and the fact the story is quite short, I personally finished it in a night. however, I#m so glad I decided to bite the bullet and buy it (it was full price) and I haven#t regretted it. I adored it during the first play through and learning the story and the character, going on this journey with them, but I love the actual game play and mechanics, I find myself wanting to play it again and again. I find myself playing it towards nighttime or when I'm having a bout of insomnia or my anxiety is high as the game is so relaxing and peaceful. I truly love what the Devs and their team did with the game and I personally would love to see more games like this from them ! Would love an expansion that continues on the story progress of this particular character and I cant wait to see what other characters the Devs create <3

Such an amazing game!!! The graphics are one point and the story line is beautiful. I love how peaceful the game is and how you are allowed to customise the way you want the house to look. Honestly, so upset when i finished it in a couple hours i just wished it was a little longer. I will DEFINITELY DEFINITELY play this game again!!! I also love the games from Humble Games they are amazing and at a reasonable price. I think a way that they could create more story development for this game is going into the future where there child has grown up and now they go through the stages up to the point they retire or even making a second story line but this time from the girlfriends or ex-boyfriends perspectives.

I loved this game. Even though it was short I played it through many times just cause it was so relaxing and addictive. I would love maybe more chapters that follow after chapter eight then transition to connected characters or even the ability to pick an album of a different character to follow their eight-chapter story. I would buy that so quickly.

I adore this game 100%. Its fairly short so about $20 is a teensy steep BUT considering the atmosphere of the game and how you can organize everything its very much worth it. There's more than just organizing things too. It tells a story through unpacking and sorting the things you see. Some things you can tell the narrator was attached to and others not so much.

The aesthetics of the game were wonderful and the sounds were very ASMR-esk so it was very relaxing. <3 
9.9/10


[spoiler] When she moved into the boyfriend's place and had to put her diploma under the bed?? That was super annoying LMAO! Like, I hate this guy and i dont know him. xD  [/spoiler]

This game is a thesis in environmental storytelling. The gameplay itself is therapeutic somehow. I keep coming back to this game even after completing it, just so I can rearrange things differently again and again.

This is such a cute and relaxing game. I love following the story of this character's life - it's so heartwarming! And the gameplay is not stressful and soothes my need to organize things. Love this game.
This game is good for anyone that has slight OCD or really like to keep things organized. The style is cute and very detailed for a pixel game.

so cute and simple, very relaxing. i wish there was more game content and i hope that there are more levels coming soon! nevertheless, a lovely game and one i was excited to play since before it came out
cute cute

I love this little puzzle game.
It's yet another example of how games can do storytelling like no other medium.
Easy and intuitive controls
And the music is really good also.
Unpacking is so much fun! I love the subtle story telling with each move and the details that the creators put into the game. If you are looking for something relaxing, this is the game for you.

UGHH!!! I love this game so much. It fits me too perfectly for me to not love it. Apparently this is a game that's usually finished in 4 hours... but I took 13? LOL, I just had a lot of fun with it.. don't judge me. One of my favorite parts of it is watching the playback of your placements afterwards and seeing how indecisive I am. It's hilarous. Definitely a 10/10 game and absolutely one of my new favorites.

Just a super chill, short little lovely game. Loved the mood and picking where to put stuff. Super fun to play with the wife - we couldn't agree where to put stuff lol.

It has a great subtle storytelling. Play it!

Honestly the most chilled and relaxing game - at your own pace. It's very fun and interesting to see into the life of the character you are playing! As you unpack, you'll notice a lot of things about our main character and how she's grown, the person she has become, her likes, dislikes, as well as the relationships around her. There are different modes of packing from 1997 (when the main character is a child) up to 2018, when she's grown up! 

Honestly, the plot twist towards the end was very cute! It represents a lot of people in the community, and it was just a heartwarming ending. I enjoyed the end credit scene, as well as the song playing in the background, It's really nostalgic! 

I loved this game very much! I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a short, cute and smooth relaxing game-play with amazing graphics and concepts!

its a really calming and great expiriance, i do wish there was more content tho, this game would benefit off of a forge (from halo) style game mode were you can make a room with anything you want and being able to make your own items for the forge mode, its still a great game.

This is a calming and fun game with a surprisingly rich story, what with it being a game with almost no dialog or narration. The character made me happy in how she grew from beginning to end, and it was kinda fun to see exactly what I changed in my own arrangement style in my second playthrough when compared to the messiness of my first one. All in all it's a cute and fun game, though I do wish there was more than one story. I think it is well worth the cost. :)

Nice and relaxing game, but I wish it was longer and had more content. The concept of the game is great but unfortunately it is easily done within a very short amount of time as there is only one "storyline". I recommend it if you are willing to pay 20 bucks for 2-4hours of gameplay (depending on your speed) before you're done with it.

Other than that it is a very nice game, and it is great for just casual gameplay if you want to play something calm and relaxin :)
es ist ein super spiel um zu entspannen und runter zu kommen. Leider für den Preis viel zu schnell durch gespielt. Mir würden neue Level gefallen

This game is one of the best I've played in a while. A simple game, but it has a lot of story to it, without any speech. 
I loved this game from start to finish, especially because there are so many unique options to decorating each level. At times it was slightly frustrating certain objects were not allowed where I had them, only one seemed to have any real meaning to it, but it turned out alright. My only downside with this game, like many others have discussed, is how short it is, and the price. It doesn't meet up to a $20 label of content. I'm hoping, both for the value sake and for my own want for more levels, that more are added in the future. Overall, a very cute game, just probably should buy on sale.

I loved the game, as a casual player it´s wonderful. It´s really interesting all the thought and detail that went into it, all the bits of information that you can gather from the characters without even seen them is great. The music works beautifully with the way game. Visually, well I personally love pixel art and this piece really hits the mark everything is so wonderfully drawn and colorized. 
I have to agree with most comments that the price is a bit on the high end considering how short the game is. You can replay it, which is nice, but not much is going to change since really it´s reorganizing, so I would have loved at least a few extra levels or a cheaper price.
But still 10/10 would recommend, I spent a lovely 4 hours and couldn´t go to bed until I finished it.
I loved it very much, it made me feel really happy and fuzzy seeing the main character finding someone they love and who loves them equally as much.
Such a nice relaxing game while you are running on 0 sleeep. Love it. I found the replying to be super funny cuz why am i struggling with a pair of shoe ?

Very satisfying and surprisingly emotional for such a simple concept. Made me reflect on so many life changes I've gone through. The sprite work has a very nostalgic PC CD-ROM educational game quality to it as well. I wish there was more of it!
This is a vary relaxing game. You also get to grow up with your charter. It can be repetativ after you play it once through. Even givin that I would 100% recommend this game.

Games like this proof that stories can be told in a multitude of ways. It doesn't always have to be so prominent. It's the type of game is kind of slow burn you gradually learn things rather than narrative being shut down your throat breakneck speed just for the sake of plot device. And the music is really cool like as soon as I realise that the entire soundtrack was on Spotify I was like oh my God yes! I hope they make more games like this because this was really fun. You would think that unpacking would be an arduous task but sometimes it's really interesting to see where people would put different things because everybody has a different place for pretty much everything despite when you've unpacked all the items on the phone to arrange them exactly where you want them and there are technically "right" places for certain things to go. It was still really fun and I will do it again if we were given a different story with a different person as well. The developers clearly had a very specific vision and took great care to make sure that it was executed exactly. I really look forward to more games being given the amount of attention and love and care for which beam give to this one
Für jeden Sortierfreak wie mich ein echter Spass! Tolles kleines Spiel. Die Graphik ist absolut süss und sehr asiatisch angehaucht. Eine Fortführung würde ich ebenfalls spielen.

i really liked the desighn! t was rlly cute! :D but one thing that i disliked is that when im done with all the boxes some stuff are in the wrong places.
but,im not saying u should get rid of it though.
either way its a fun game!
totaly recommend this game!!

I still wish for the price more content was available. I bought this a while ago, and after some playtime I was able to get all achievements and complete all the houses. I've played through again twice and while it's really fun, I was holding out for an update possibly with a new story, or continuing the life story of the child of the two women in game. $20 for what can be done in 2-4 hours unfortunately to me is pretty unacceptable when some people are the type to complete a game and not pick it up again. For the amount of content in it, it feels much more like it should be around $10. Lol. 

It seems like that's probably not happening at this point, which is extremely unfortunate as after a few times, to me personally the replayability keeps going down. Amazing story, amazing art, surprise gay ending that I loved... but I just want more :(
This is a very cute game that mainly focuses on organization. There's a story that you can follow along with as you play the game as well, which I thought was very cute.

So I loved this game, it was cute and I had watching a lot of people play it and it was very fun. HOWEVER, the game was too short. I hope in the future they add more game play. More different types of people, show the phases of different types of people. In my honest opinion, it is not worth the $20 I paid. Even if you are just throwing money away, don't throw your money away to a game like this with only one short story line. I am not going to lie, this took my 5 hours but that was also me talking over and taking it slow with my stream. I really really hope they add more content to this. That would definitely make this game worth it if they did. 

TLDR; Don't spend $20 on this game, buy when its on sale or you will regret it.
This game is  nice and relaxing. The sound effects and everything combined together make it a comfortable and memorable game.

While the price for the game is a bit much for the amount of content is has I do NOT regret buying this game :)
Its simple and sweet and is great for those who love organizing and need a bit of time to relax.

I was actually really excited for this game, but as soon as I got into it I was let down. The game itself is unfulfilling, and considering how simple it is the fact that you have to put certain items in a certain spot was really annoying. The story itself is uncompelling and way to short. Dear Reader and Devs,
                I never deem my time worthy of leaving a review for anything, let alone a game. Unpacking is not a game; it is an experience. The subtle underlying story, allowing the player to put the pieces of their lives together in more ways than one, it is absolutely, beautifully magnificent. You never finish Unpacking, Unpacking finishes you.

                        Thank you.

This game manages to really encapsulate what it feels like to unpack when moving to a new home. From the staple things we keep, the things we discard, and fitting her things into spaces with others - the game really captures nostalgia well. Each move tells a story without the need to spell it out.

This game is extremely soothing to play, and the subtlety of the story emerging really brings up emotions, especially as someone has moved several times in different situations. It's both nostalgic and hopeful, and that really makes it a beautiful game to play.
I have never played such a beautiful game. The way the items came out of the boxes made me shed a tear.

Love the game! Initially, it seemed I would get bored quickly. Then, the zen nature took over and I couldn't stop playing. I was pretty disappointed, given the price, that there was less than 5 hours of game play. Lack of levels is my ONLY complaint.

This game is so calming and relaxing. I kinda wish there was more to it or like different people for the 3 different colored books though cause you can finish the game in a day if you trully wanted to.

This was a really sweet game.  My favorite part is how the stuffed pig keeps changing as life adapts, starting brand new, getting a little damaged and put back together, and finally new again for the next chapter in their life.  I really, really enjoyed playing this.  Got a little teary eyed, not gonna lie.

i cannot believe that i love this game!
the game pretty much related to our own life story.. the phase where we were just a kid, grew up and being away from home.. being in love etc~
you really can see how much it tells story through a "picture"
so if you love easy game to kill some time with chill music definitely purchase this game!
but i would say that this game will be more interesting for woman since this tells story about woman's life lol

anywaaay i hope they have more game like this in the future <3

I really liked the story aspect of the game. One of my favorite streamers recently played the game on stream and it made me really want to buy it! I absolutely love the game and the idea of it. I would like to see some different stories being told through it though as it only has the one.

I very much enjoyed this game for what it is.  A relaxing game, with a bit of story line, and you just unpack and put things away.  As the game progresses you have ample opportunity to move items around, and make your own space.  And, before completion, the game prompts you for items in the wrong area.

The graphic design is amazingly done.  Harmonious color pallets and some amazing attention to detail in the pieces you move around as well as the static backgrounds. The music is wonderful, and really helps with the complete immersion of putting things away all neat and tidy.  As items carry through and age you get this amazing connection to them.

That being said, I feel the cost of it isn't quite right.  (Though, with the level of work put in it's not far off.)  The game is comforting and relaxing, but very short. [h1]TL;DR[/h1]
Entspanntes und grafisch extrem knuffiges Puzzle-Point'n'Click mit einem Hauch von Story. Für den Vollpreis mit drei bis vier Stunden Spielzeit pro Durchlauf schon recht kurz, für Freunde des Genres [b]im Sale ein Pflichtkauf[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Genre[/h1]
Pixelart-Point-And-Click / Entspanntes Puzzle

[h1]Entwickler[/h1]
Witch Beam (2021)

[h1]Story[/h1]
Wir packen in acht verschiedenen Jahren (1997, 2004, 2007, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2015 und 2018) nach dem Umzug unser Hab und Gut aus und müssen alles in unserer Wohnung an den rechten Platz bringen.
Wir sind in diesem Spiel scheinbar eine Künstlerin, denn in den frühen Jahren haben wir schon Kreidestifte und Malkästen, später wird daraus ein Computer mit Zeichentableau. Dass wir eine Frau sind, schließe ich mal ganz verwegen daraus, dass wir [spoiler]in den späteren Jahren einige BHs auspacken und in die Kleiderschränke zu verstauen haben.[/spoiler]
Unsere Wohnung wächst mit der Zeit, sind wir anfangs alleine, haben wir im Laufe der "Geschichte" noch andere Personen, mit denen wir zusammen ziehen.
Wir bekommen eine lockere Hintergrundgeschichte, die wir uns anhand der ausgepackten Dinge selber ausmalen können. Vor allem lebt das Spiel von seiner friedlichen Atmosphäre und dem schönen Pixelart-Stil, dazu gibt es noch einen schönen [b]Soundtrack[/b], der auf Wunsch auch extern vom Spiel bei Steam kaufbar ist.

Sind alle Gegenstände aus den Umzugskartons ausgepackt - Obacht: [u]vereinzelt[/u] kommt es mal vor, dass ein Teil (wohl aus Paltzgründen so verpackt?!) in einen anderen Raum gehört, was aber auch schon das "Maximum an Stress" in diesem Spiel ist -, gilt es noch, sie an einen "passenden Platz" im neuen Heim zu bringen.
Beim Grafikstil kam ich schon einige Male ins Grübeln, was genau ich da jetzt zu verstauen haben sollte (es gibt eine integrierte Zoomfunktion im Spiel). Aber mit ein wenig Probieren und Dingeverschieben kriegt man das immer recht schnell und frustarm hin! Zumal dankbarerweise alle "nicht legitim verstauten" Dinge deutlich markiert werden.
Ist am Ende alles ordnungsgemäß zugeteilt, blinkt ein nicht zu übersehender, animierter Stern auf, der uns ins nächste Umzugsjahr bringt.

[h1]Umfang[/h1]
Für einen kompletten Durchlauf des Spiels wird man so drei bis maximal vier Stunden brauchen. Aber man kann auch nach einem fertigen Durchspielen immer mal wieder reinsehen und ein paar Kisten und Kartons auspacken.

[h1]Wertung[/h1]
[list]
[*] Atmosphäre ★★★★★ 10/10
[*] Grafik ★★★★★ 10/10
[*] Sound ★★★★★ 10/10
[*] Umfang ★★★☆☆ 6/10
[*] Gesamt ★★★★★ 9/10
[/list]

[h1]Fazit[/h1]
Das Spiel ist einfach wundervoll gemacht und entspannend. Und: wem der [b]Vollpreis[/b] einfach zuviel ist, dem rate ich: ab mit dem Spiel auf die eigene [b]Wunschliste[/b] und dann beim (nicht gerade selten stattfindenden!) [b]Steam-Sale[/b] einfach günstiger mitnehmen!

This game nails the odd achievement of making unpacking (normally a stressful activity) somehow enjoyable. It hits a strangely satisfying chord that takes you by surprise, much like Stardew Valley does as it gets you hyped up about planting turnips. This is partly due to the laid back soundtrack, which is aided by the quaint pixelated graphic style.

This relaxing nature makes the first few levels a euphoric experience, but things do start to go stale in the second half. This happens for two reasons. First, the characters collect so much stuff throughout the game that by the final levels, your only concern is how to fit it all in the house, which leaves little room for you to think about how to make it look nice. Not very relaxing. Second, the game will critique your item placement at the end of each level, and require you to tweak your layout when something doesn't make sense. At first this is no problem, but as the game progresses, its logic makes less and less sense. Why must this laptop be placed on the dining room table, instead of the office desk? Why must the baby's toy be placed near the crib, instead of the center of the room? Why can the yoga mat be placed under the bed, but not the suitcase? The game never explains itself, which can be frustrating.

With all that said, even though I doubt I will ever play through it again, I'm glad I experienced it at least once. If you get a chance and it's on sale, I think you will be, too.

For the price, im really hopeful that in the future there might be new stories available for us to "unpack", but for now, buy this game knowing that it will only give you a few hours of pure enjoyment.

It's only March and this might just be my favorite game of the whole year. If you enjoy relaxing, chill games like Stardew Valley, House Flipper, and Slime Rancher, then you should give Unpacking a try.

It's exactly what the title suggests: a game where you unpack things and put them away. You follow a girl through her life as she moves to new homes, removing her belongings from boxes and decorating her living space. You learn a lot about what kind of person she is and what her life is like, just from the objects she carries from place to place. 

PROS
-one of the most calming games I've ever played
-the music is lovely; you'd think the loop would get repetitive, but it changes just enough that it never does
-tons of little hidden secrets, I'm still finding more after 24+ hours of play
-tells a subtle story that is open to the imagination
-serious 90's nostalgia
-simple point-and-click gameplay that's easy to learn and easy to use with accessibility devices
-old-school gamers will recognize some artwork on the girl's game cassettes and DVDs; a nice little touch
-very polished; it's clear the developers spent time and care on this game to make it as smooth as possible
-the programming is really well-done; you can place an item in one spot in one year and it'll be in that same spot when you revisit the area years later. I've known many games that try to do this and wind up glitchy because they can't anticipate every possibility of where the gamer will want to place items; no such issues with Unpacking

CONS
-it's too short
Literally that's the only thing I don't like. You can beat the entire game in 6 hours if you take your time. I got all the achievements within 14 hours of gameplay. But it's so enjoyable and relaxing that I have played the entire game, start to finish, four times already. I would happily buy any DLC that comes out for this game (maybe following the girl's sister, or just unpacking the life of a different character).

My tips for new players:
1. Right-click EVERYTHING. Right-click usually just lets you rotate an object, but for many objects it also does something special, like turning on stereos or lamps, changing an action figure's pose, etc. Experiment with EVERYTHING. This is how you get a lot of the achievements, but it's also just crazy fun to see what clever little surprises the devs have put in.
2. When finishing a year, you can change what picture is put into the photo album by switching rooms before you continue on to the next year. This lets you read what the character has to say about this time of her life and it offers a lot of insight into the story.

Happy Unpacking!

This game hit very close to home for me, bringing me to tears at least twice. Unpacking tells the story of a young artist, from childhood to present. Every level you help her find places for her belongings after moving into a new place. Each object has a tiny insight into who she is as a person and hints to what is happening in her life at that moment. And not every moment is a good one. This game does not shy away from the idea of heartbreak and the idea of having to start over from scratch. But as you play the game more, you realize just how unbreakable the human spirit is even in the face of hardship and the power of optimism. I want to personally say to the developers; thank you for making this little game. It's helped me come to terms with several things that I regret; and now I'm looking forward to the next time I see my things in boxes all along the floor. <3

One minor thing I'd like to see would be custom stories! I'm not sure if it's feasible as this game is pretty customized towards the main character, but it would be a very interesting idea to allow players to create their own custom levels in order to tell their stories. I found this game quite therapeutic, in the same vein as I find PowerWash Simulator! This is simply a suggestion, however!

A game where you unpack boxes and arrange them around a house. And despite that, I spent a lot of time just making sure things were in the right place because of context.

There is a puzzle aspect as certain things go in certain places but the main point of it is that you learn more about the person who owns these things and how their life is going simply based on the items they own. There’s a lot to love as you figure out the life situation, career, and partners of a person yourself without the game having to spell it out. The attention to detail like having the later stages pack vitamins and back ache stuff to indicate age was really good. There’s even specific things like [spoiler]your diploma not fitting anywhere on the walls of a partner’s apartment so you stow it under the bed away from sight or the cramped nature of you fitting into that apartment hinting at reasons for the break up in the next scene. It’s never explicitly mentioned but you can infer it from the location, the order, and the items you have[/spoiler]. From a simple mechanic of unpacking, you can give context and make the player feel for a character they’ve never met which is pretty nice.

It’s not perfect IMO as the story is both short and long. You don’t move that often so it makes sense that there aren’t too many levels but the story is, while sweet, simple. Also, the last level was just a bit too tedious with so much stuff to move. This might have been the point as you feel for a person moving in all that stuff but it still felt a bit too much.

There’s another game called Florence which had a similar mechanic but didn’t focus on it. I think the thing both games recognize is that the stuff you have and how it fits into a physical space with another person can show you their relationship. While Florence’s story is better IMO despite the very chicle ending, I think this game has a better focus on melding the narrative with a simple mechanic and delivering a believable story.

Unpacking was absolutely delightful. Clever art. Clever design. Clever music. Touching concept in ways you would not expect. The minimalism of the UI puts the emphasis entirely on UX, and that's been wonderfully rewarding for those willing to exert a little intuition. 

Admittedly, not much for replayability from a purely progression perspective (e.g. there's only one Life that you follow and each chapter begins the same). However, it's eminently replayable from the perspective of a game that lets you unplug and simply embrace the nuance of a fictional character's experiences. In that respect, replaying Unpacking is not unlike tucking into a favorite book you've read before; you know what's going to happen, but you find comfort in familiar, impactful story regardless.
