休日の暇つぶしとして買いましたが、クリアした後はこのゲームを買ってよかったなと思いました。これくらいの完成度と満足度だったら、もう少し値段が高くても買うと思います。
　（深夜なので日本語がところどころおかしいですが許してください）

I absolutely adore this game. It was so cool to see the little details through the years and to piece together the story of the character's life. Also, the music was nice to listen to while I unpacked. I highly recommend this game!!

画风温馨可爱，原以为是单纯的摆放，但随着流程进展，房间/住宅的变化以及各种细节仿佛伴随屋主人走过一生，像是屋主人从童年保留到成年的玩具手办和小物件，一生热爱的绘画与游戏，因生活不得不搁置在衣柜底的荣耀证书等也会令人感慨，将人生百态浓缩在简洁的娃娃屋游戏方式里的叙事方式让人很容易接受和代入，如果未来能够加入更多主人翁以及不同风格和爱好的房间一定能进一步提升游戏的耐玩度
游戏定位为禅意游戏这一点我无法苟同，游戏系统强制【特定类型的物品必须放置在某些地方】有些破坏游戏本身的自由度和代入感（娃娃不能放在地上姑且可以理解，但游戏机不能放在床上这点有些那啥了），加上可能是东西方居民生活习惯的不同，以及个别因为体积小难以辨认的物体（比如卫生巾、药品和化妆品等），需要反复尝试才能找到“正确”的摆放位置，在寻找的过程中很容易破坏治愈感和所谓的禅意，让本该解压的游戏过程变得焦躁，如果能有一些提示性的细节会让游玩体验变得更舒适

The most wholesome, beautiful and relaxing game I've ever played! Adorable graphics, wonderful story, little 'easter eggs' in every home, and the way the items change as the years pass just draws you into the game. 1000% recommend!

I loved the game. Thought it was adorable and relaxing. I loved the unique storytelling. However, even though I loved it, it leaves too much to wish for. I felt that for the price, it isn't worth it. I would suggest waiting for either a deal to go on it, or for the price to drop to below $10. I wish that there was regular updates such as additional chapters, or for new stories. I feel that $10 is a good price for this game at the condition that it's being sold. (The price is my only real complaint about this game). I would give it a 4/5 at the time of it's release.
This is a fun and relaxing game. I loved to just play it empty brain. The music is beautiful and the story is very cute. I would recommend. :)
เกมน่ารักมาก ภาพดีมาก เพลงก็ดีมากกก เล่นแล้วรู้สึกคิดถึงบ้านขึ้นมาเลยล่ะค่ะ ส่วนเนื้อเรื่องบวกไปเลย 100 คะแนนเต็ม!! เรียกได้ว่าเนื้อเรื่องน่ารักสุด ๆ ควรค่าแก่การซื้อมาติดไว้เป็นมงคลแก่สตีมจริง ๆ ค่ะ
This game tells a story in the most unique way possible. I fell in love with this game, the gameplay is relaxing and satisfying, but the most compelling part is the story behind the boxes.

This game really helped me during a bad depressive episode. The game play was so simple that I could sit there and just kind of get lost in unpacking and sorting. It was incredibly methodical and really gave my brain what it needed for me to feel a tiny bit better. Definitely not a cure but a great help.

Gameplay i would rate an 8/10 the reason i wouldnt recommend it is because for £15+ you get about 5 hours of play time it only has about 8 levels and would be very good if it was longer or if they had it so you could follow different peoples moving stories for the length of the game i personally think that this game should be £5 maximum i understand making a game is hard and costs money but this game is about £3 per hour of play time since its £15 and lasts around 5 hours I really enjoyed the game but it was too short and quick to complete even if it took about 8-10 hours i still dont think it would be worth it since you can get games like stardew valley, house flipper, dungreed and even the sims 4 for around the same price and gives much more play time and enjoyment
Lovely little gayme! It's pretty short, but the environmental storytelling is incredible and the romance caught me entirely by surprise. 10/10 would unpack again
I really love the relaxing feeling this game gave me, but at the same time I was solving a very in depth puzzle! Very fun and captivating.

It's an amazing game, super cozy and a great game to play either you have nothing to do, or just want a calming game to play.

I love this game, and I'm hoping for more houses / apartments to decorate and orginaze <3

i'm going to say this right off the bat - this game is far too short for how fun it is!! there is a high replay-ability to it since you can organize things differently (to a certain extent) each time you play. however, i think it is much needed to have additional character story lines to play through with their own unique spaces and placements in time. 

this game hits a lot of very specific niches!! there is a fun customization with goals and achievments similar to games like the sims (building mode), animal crossing (either happy homes or the decorating aspect of the games) while there is also an interesting and engaging story line being told in a way that feels at home with visual novels (or games akin to gone home, where exploration of the surroundings and finding objects adds more to the overall story). and it's all wrapped up in a very fun and stylistic pixel art, accompanied by cute and soothing music. 

i highly rec this game, just be warned you'll be left wanting more!!
Really chill game, fun to organize stuff! I should probably do the same thing in real life. But its really fun go get it!!!!
This is a super charming game, nothing bad to say about it except it's too short. Wish it went from childhood to elderly rather than stopping when it did.
通过整理房间了解到主人的生活，很有意思！系统会提示放的位置，不用绞尽脑汁去想，很有趣！
很好玩！本收纳控非常喜欢！就是有的东西不知道是什么也不知道该放哪才对要到处试有点烦... [spoiler] 另外最后女主是和同性伴侣在一起了吗  真好 [/spoiler]

although the game is really cool and great to just go brain dead and play, one of the biggest problems with is just the fact that there is almost no replay ability and i wish there was some like endless mode where it just gave you random rooms and and a bunch of items or something.

sometimes the game also just gets really annoying by highlighting object that it deems to be in the wrong spot.

6-7 out of 10

Such a cute game with a lovely story. The shock of pulling some of the things out of the boxes really got to me. The entire sentiment of "Let's unpack our life." has I think genuinely changed my worldview on a few things. I even knew one of the bigger "twists" leading into this game, and it still had me crying. Thank you for such a touching game.

Bon jeux, mais frustrant, car on ne peut pas décider pleinement d'où on veut mettre nos objets. Un peu cher pour le contenue, une mise à jour qui rajoute une histoire serait la bienvenue. Je recommande tout de même, car très relaxant et c'est un bon jeu pour ceux qui aiment ranger des trucs. Il y a des secrets à découvrir, si vous voulez les chercher le temps de jeux peut être un peu plus long.
Very relaxing and enjoyable game. I love organizing and this satisfied my need to organize. I wish there were more levels or rooms/maps. I hope to see more updates in the future!

This game is one of the most calming things I have ever experienced. I fully recommend it if you need something you can get involved in, without any pvp or fighting. It has a nice, light story line that makes you wonder what is happening. Also the art is all amazingly cozy. 10/10

I didn't enjoy playing this game. The items that you unpack have no names, and you can't really tell, what some of the items are. So you just have to place them randomly and hope that it's the right place.

Also the game tells you which item has been set wrong. Which kinda kills the idea of a puzzle. I mean it's like a tutorial, without an actual campaign. 

I didnt really play fast, but after 3 hours gameplay you are done.

I don't see why anyone should buy this game, when all you can do is creativly set up an appartment. But you can already do that in The Sims, and that game has the same price.

TLDR: Nice, Relaxing but short. Best get it on sale.

It's got a relatively short playtime but it's relaxing, the graphics are nice. 
There is a bit of a story, but you can piece it together yourself.
I don't think it has much replayability unless you're going to try get all the achievements.

Really enjoyed this sweet game. The story-telling was clever and overall was a very relaxing game to play. Loved the art style as well as how easy it was to get immersed in the game. Would recommend playing!
好温馨好有趣的游戏啊，理东西本就是很解压的一件事情，能从物品里感觉到主人公的喜好和生活的轨迹，看到那些从小到大被留在身边的东西觉得很治愈！
amazingly done game, i love how the story unfolds through the stuff you unpack. great pacing, great music and the sounds!! made me cry because it is so relatable to me as well. love it!!

Despite what most reviewers say, I think this game was the correct length. Very sweet story told with these subtle visual tid-bits and changes of items between locations.

Assuredly a game any person would enjoy and should play, 100% reccomend.

This is one of the best LoFi games I have played.. The soundtrack is amazing, the gameplay is easy and relaxing.  I enjoyed it Completely.  I hope they make more of these games or extend this game.  I would love to play thru another persons lives or continue with the family I played with.  The only issue I have is the length of the game, I played for 6  hours and I took my time exploring and unpacking and placing the objects.  There is not much replayability as the rooms/Items are not random.  But I do not in anyway regret purchasing it.   If you are looking for a "break from the world game" this is a winner!!!!!

The art was fantastic. It was so cute and the calming music helped me not to get frustrated when I couldn't find out where to put something. If it were under different categories, I would describe it as an aesthetic, meditative puzzle game. It's also fun to follow the story line after you complete each house. The ONLY possible downside I can think of is that what feels like twenty minutes is actually an hour of play time, so if you want to play, make sure you save some time before getting sucked in. For me, it  was definitely worth the $20, regardless of how short it takes to complete.

Unpacking has 1 Pro and 1 Con:

Pro: Relaxing Game
Con: OCD Nightmare

This game has brought the worst side of me, I never knew it existed and has developed strongly within me, OCD. I'm descently clean to how I live but this game drove me mad! Aside of that! The game is really relaxing and feng shui'ing the belongings in the environment got me so organized in the most insane way! Even to the smallest little details! In addition, what caught my attention was the "Unpacking" storytelling in every stage and it's really nice.

I now have OCD after finishing the game BUT I had fun playing it!

https://youtu.be/QXb7lLjCoGo

It's a super cute game, and it honestly helps a lot when your brain is flat, smooth and needs something cute for decompressing. It IS a little short, but I've replayed it a few times for achievement hunting and 'cause I could move things around and decorate each room differently each time.
Petit jeu très sympa, se joue en 2-3 heures, détend sans prise de tête et parvient à raconter une jolie petite histoire au milieu de tous ces déballages de cartons.
very relaxing. nice setting options. nice progression. nice graphics, very cute. is it worth £15? eh
Lighthearted fun puzzle game! There's so much personality in the journey & each location your character moves to. it got a little "too real" trying to stuff all the stuff into the limited space lol

I really liked this game - loved the retro music / feel; concept is great; like the little subtle things about the storyline throughout.  However, I only got about 3 hrs of gameplay out of it - and I wanted way more...  So as long as you're ok with the very short length of the game - you'll enjoy it.

Overall it's a pretty enjoyable game. I like the puzzle aspect where you can only place items in certain areas. I also like that you can turn that off for a more therapeutic experience. The art is very good and the music is nice too. I like the little details, like how the stuffed pig gets a hole that is later repaired.  Like most other reviewers are saying, it's too short. I wish there was at least one other person's story we could go through. It took me about 3-4 hrs the first time I played it. I would recommend buying it on sale.

Unpacking é um ótimo jogo, é por meio do desempacotamento da mudança que a gente vai sabendo da história, as fases da vida da personagem e eles capricharam bem nos detalhes, realmente um amor.
Comprei ele na promoção por R$47,99, mas, é um valor muito alto para uma narrativa tão curta. Um conselho que eu dou é aguardar uma promoção de no mínimo 30%.
A brilliantly cute little narrative journey through unpacking your(character's) life!  If you pay attention to what makes it in the next move, you have some really sweet little easter eggs,

Lovely little game. I've played through multiple times at this point. At first, I was drawn to the mystery of finding out who the protagonist was through unpacking their items. The progression from their childhood room to their final home was a lovely story to follow. At this point, since I've played through more than few times, this game has become my go-to de-stress/anti-anxiety tool. Amazing game. Could not recommend more.

overall lovely game, but i feel like there isnt enough content there. The story was very sweet and the gameplay was very relaxing, but the price vs the amount of gameplay you get doesnt seem like an appropriate ratio. This would be fine if there was a story and a freeplay mode, but only being able to play for a few hours and not having really any more content was a bit disappointing.

Gameplay gets a 9/10 - not a 10/10 just because i found it a little difficult to tell what some of the items were and how they needed to be in a particular area, like the blankets.

Overall, a 7/10 - just not enough content in this game, but i loved it nonetheless

really adorable game, it tells a simple but sweet story throughout all of the levels. only thing i wish was that it had more houses to decorate! this game definately is NOT for everyone. but if youre the type of person to spend countless hours decorating a house in the sims, this game is for you
Absolutely loved playing this game.  My only complaint is I wish they would release more levels!  Maybe a second storyline?  I want more!
This game is fun and feels like I'm moving to a new house. Its relaxing when I'm stressed and I would totally recommend this game.

Such a soothing and fun little game. The unpacking and sorting aspect has some sort of difficulty to it and through it you start to learn about a character you've never even seen, learning their story and watching the progression of their life through their possession and homes throughout the years. Its a beautiful and heartwarming story, almost nostalgic when you move in to your first student apartment and the way that your favourite childhood toys seem to follow with you, becoming more worn and distressed through the years, showing their use and the love this character has for where she came from and the things that have always brought her joy. A very peaceful experience, couldn't recommend it more.

[h1] ちょっと一息つきたい時にオススメ [/h1]
目まぐるしいRTSやFPSで疲れた人に、おすすめしたい作品。
1日1ステージのペースとかで遊ぶのが、個人的に性に合っていた気がします。

ゲームを遊ぶと、何とはなしに整理整頓が出来る気がして、部屋が散らかっている人へもオススメです(笑)
Yes. Yes, play it. It's so sweet. Very relaxing, and a joy to follow along the environmental storytelling. Such a joy.

The game was short, but very calming. The colors are stunning and there were only a couple times where I was confused on where an item was meant to go. Eventually you figure out where it is meant to go and you can move on to the next level. The story is absolutely adorable and I liked that they had a chicken with an army of chicks. It was so cute. The fact that they made an effort to keep some old things like shirts from previous homes and that there were times where the things were upgraded. It is a sweet game and it took me three hours to complete. It is one of those games that will suck your time away from you.

Uma graça de jogo. Dá pra terminar e platinar de uma só vez, tem só 8 níveis que não são muito complexos. A proposta é um jogo relaxante, que permite que o jogador vá conhecendo a personagem principal através dos objetos que são desempacotados. É muito interessante e permite uma reflexão legal sobre como podemos levar nossas experiências encaixotadas por diferentes fases da vida. Definitivamente recomendo e jogaria de novo, pois a arte é linda!
It is very comfy and fun. I really enjoyed the underlying story as well. Made me really happy! I think this was definitely worth the purchase. The art style and music are wonderful! 11/10
Lovely music, art direction, and story. I really enjoyed seeing all the items as they game out of the boxes and the fun puzzles to get the achievements. A great game for a cozy weekend afternoon.

Beautiful story telling without saying a word.The soundtrack is calming and the art of putting things in the right place is very relaxing. Without giving spoilers I will say I was irritated at the moving into a place where there was obviously no room for a certain belonging of the character and very happy at the next move. This is such a unique way of telling a story without seeing what the character looks like or any dialogue at all! 10/10 excellent game.
It's an adorable game with really cute art and music. I cried a few times towards the end like a little b*tch. 10/10.

Krásná grafika, velice relaxující hra. Většinově jde všechno poskládat tak, jak sami chcete a ještě to vypadá elegantně. Hudba též není špatná. Je mi líto, že tvůrci neudělají pokračování, protože by to mohlo být ještě zajímavější. Stejný způsob hry, ale jiný příběh.
Absolutely beautiful and satisfying. Played it through many times. It could use some additional storylines, though.

Also 4,5 Stunden Spielzeit für 19,99 EUR ist mir zu wenig. Ich hoffe da kommt noch was, ansonsten finde ich es sehr überteuert und kann jedem nur raten es im Sale zu kaufen.
Die Geschichte ist eigentlich keine. Eher findet man bei jedem Umzug heraus wie sich das Leben der Spielfigur so entwickelt.
Ganz nett und zeigt das man auch ohne viele Worte eine kleine Lebensgeschichte erzählen kann.
Einige Gegenständen lassen sich über die rechte Maustaste aktivieren. Computer, Spielekonsole, Radio etc.
Das Spiel endet leider genauso schnell wie es begonnen hat. Keine Einführungsstory und kein erzähltes Happy End.
Schade, denn ich denke hier hätte man wesentlich mehr draus machen können. Denn so ein Leben spielt sich ja nicht nur zu Hause ab. Stichwort: Gartenhaus nebst Geräteschuppen einrichten, verschiedene Berufe wo die Arbeitsplätze oder Büroräume eingeräumt werden, Freunden beim Umzug helfen, der Lebenpartner eröffnet eine Bar etc.
Aber mehr Inhalt hätte wohl eine Grundstrory benötigt. Vielleicht gibt es dann ja mal ein großes DLC. Würde mich freuen!

5 hours just flew by. The subtle details tell a story through the moves, from the wear and tear on items that have been used over the years to the progression of the main charactor that goes from childhood to college years, different relationships to family. Very cute, great game.

I love this game so much! Definitly a must have for puzzle lovers and story lovers alike! You get to essentially create your own story along the way which is such an awesome feature. Absolutely love <3

The game may be short when comparing it to other games but i feel that every moment i spent on it was valueable to me which makes the price alright in my eyes. 
Unpacking someones belonings tells the story of what they like and where they have been, i didnt really think that i could see a story being told with that method. I was stuck to the game from start to finish and didnt want to let go of it until i knew where she would end up.

I finished this game in a matter of hours. It's simple and heartfelt but also challenging at times.

If you're looking for a cute, relaxing way to pass time I would highly recommend. Please make more games like this, Humble! <3
It's a really relaxing and interesting game. There's not a lot of levels to complete but it's still really fun. You can complete the game within a few hours though.

This game is absolutely adorable, and the ending including an LGBTQ+ relationship is the cherry on top! I like to turn off puzzle mode and spend time organizing the rooms however I want, but puzzle mode is still very fun

really cute game to relax and just sort things, mostly to ignore the own mess in the background of your room but, it helps getting on different thoughts! i just love the representation in a game with no dialoge it's just so heartwarming.

If you like organizing rooms that aren't your own, this game is a must-play. I thoroughly enjoyed every bit, and the silent story made me incredibly happy.

I bought this game on sale because I heard it was short. I played about 6 hours total, so you determine yourself  if unpacking boxes for full price is worth it or not.

this game is super relaxing. i love organizing things irl and sometimes i'm too burnt out to put my energy into games like league or valorant so this helps me calm down. super comfy game, i just wish more content was available!

The game is enjoyable, relaxing and has an awesome soundtrack. The story was well done and you could take your own meaning from different items having to be put in certain locations. It was a really interesting way to tell a story, you didn't need text boxes to explain what was happening. The visual story was really well done. I just wished there was more too it, I got 6.5 hours played, it would be lovely to see DLC added with new story lines or a continuation of the current story.
This game is so awesome to play and it's very chilled so I recommend everyone getting this (if they don't want to) but this is really an awesome game

It's a cute game, although it's unfortunate the whole thing can be played through in about three hours, and my time may even be a bit longer as I was battling a cat for control of my keybaord during part of that.
The art style is cute, the story is cute, the gameplay is great and the hidden achievements are fun! I just wish there was more.

This is such a fantastic, sweet and short game. I wish it were longer but I understand why it cannot be. I've watched enough people play it that I decided to buy it yesterday. I plan to play this again. This was also the first time I have rolled credits on any game. I love this so much! Keep making great games like this!! ::big hugs::
I love this game! So relaxing and the soundtrack is great. Definitely recommend for anyone who just wants to unwind. The story os also adorable and so wholesome. Just wish it was longer!

The game has such a wonderful story, and you almost feel what the character is going through with the music choice, and you can see how far you've come and what has been lost/repaired by what objects you bring into each stage. Every time I unpack the piggy plush I feel elated to see them again, no matter how dirty or torn they have become, and it makes seeing them patched so much more sweet. This game makes you feel like a person, a wonderful, perfect person. Who is almost completely ordinary and yet so special because you've lived your whole life with them. You become lifelong friends with them, being with them every step of the way. I could unpack and repackage in this game forever.

I love how simple this game is and how you get to choose how challenging you want to make it. There is a story line to follow and I really felt for the character. We never meet them but it feels like we learn so much with every box we go through. The art is lovely and it gave me such a nostalgic feeling throughout every level. There was a moment in the game where I tried to make the items fit but there simply wasn't space. It was actually eye opening to see that when you are with someone, you don't try to make room for yourself because they should be willing to open up room so you feel welcomed. When you play the game, you'll know what room I'm talking about. Lovely game, def recommend.

This is a really great game, with a very relaxing vibe to it. You get the opportunity to organize exactly how you want, and the game gives a lot of freedom to organize and be creative!
I really enjoyed the story, and how it was also illustrated through little details hidden in the chapters. :)

The only critic I would have to make is that the game is quite short, and you get through the chapters fast. But it's really understandable as it already took a lot of time to develop the game. I hope they will someday release a sequel to it !

it show us how the main character life , how her life changes form time to time..
i feel relate to this game, because i moving a lot and fight for better life from time to time and moving a lot...
Thumbs up for the developer... so creative...

I didn't do too much research into this game before buying it and i didn't realize there would be storyline and i absolutely loved it. The storyline was beautiful and so fun to uncover and the soundtrack is amazing. I played through in about 3.5 hours.
I won't stop playing even after I finished it. There's many creative ways of organizing things. Especially when you disable the puzzle function. I'm just gonna throw everything on the floor now.

its a good game, the only thing is that if you place an item wrong and dont know where it needs to go you might take a while to find where it needs to be, but its still a very good game would recomend

Unpacking is one of those games that pulled me in, where I was able to completely immerse myself and relate to in a deeper level. Every stage of life in the game had something relatable to my own life, and I think that's something that enjoyed very much. I can't say that the game was perfect, as there were some items that I couldn't be placed anywhere other than an specific room and that was annoying. Trying to create the "perfect room" wasn't possible with that disadvantage but overall the game was exceptional. Another criticism that I have for the game is its price point. I truly believe that $20 USD is a very high price for a game like this. Its very short, you could play it all under 8 hours and very easy to achieve 100% completion. I have played many games at lower price points that had a lot more available content and took me days to complete.
Overall, yes, I recommend this game to anyone wanting to play a "cozy game" but I suggest you wait for it to go on sale to get your money's worth.

I finished the game in 108 minutes the first time. I thought I was taking my time and learning the story, but honestly it went by very quickly. I played it through a second time and in about 2 more hours I was able to get all the achievements. I've never gotten every achievement in any game so that was actually super exciting to see and they are not difficult. I had a super fun time and I see myself coming back to play this all the way through multiple times. $20 for a game that I've "finished" in 3ish hours seems like a lot, but personally I see a lot of replay value and its soooo relaxing and fun I would say if you have the money this is worth it. The story is really cute and I'm sure there is tons I've missed and I can't wait to find out when I play it again. 

If you want hours of new and different game play out of a game I would not advise getting the game since it is only one story line and as fun as it is maybe wait until it goes on sale to give it a try. I think it's on xbox game pass, so if you have that give it a try on there first for sure. If you have the $20 and love the game even after playing it I would say go for it and purchase the game to show the developers some support.

I loved this game. The idea might be simple, but it was so well executed. I loved watching my character grow up even though they are fake. It gradually got harder so I am glad it did not go straight too hard, but it just got harder. I had a very fun time with this game and I think others will too. 9.5/10 just because it was not the most perfect game in the world, but it was amazing and I hope others will enjoy too.
the game is really good, not really a type of "relaxing" but more puzzlish, its a pretty short game theres only 5-6 levels but time consuming!

An amazing, relaxing game that doesn't require much effort. I also very much liked the storyline that happened as you go along the levels. The representation in the game was also nice. It made the game feel more personable and made it stand out from other games with the same concept, that don't have much of a storyline or relatable characters. Only critique is I wish that it was longer or there was maybe different storylines we could follow as well, such as a different group of characters or a continuation of the game with the kid.

To all those who say it is too short: don't just place, *contemplate*! Think about every item's origin! 
Why it is there?
Where did it come from?
What does it mean?
When it does or does not show up in the next area, imagine why that is! Develop a narrative in your head!
Yes this is a very relaxing game, but at the same time it can be a bit of a detective game!
For instance: The beetle in the plastic cage you unbox early on. [spoiler] did you notice when you did not unbox it later on? did you notice the beetle with the halo picture? Develop the narrative in your head, infer or imagine what led to that outcome! [/spoiler]
Another example: When you are unboxing the residence that is very obviously occupied by a guy. [spoiler] Did you tidy up the underwear drawers? What did that mean? How about the lack of space? Where did your diploma end up? Did that affect the rest of the game, where you're obviously unpacking only women's things? [/spoiler]
Well enough with the spoilers, but suffice it to say this game is a relaxing zen game but at the same time it can be like reading a novel without reading. It is up to you, the player, to infer what is going on as you unpack each item. Why is that item here? Why isn't another item there instead? What is this item? Where does it go? Why doesn't it go where you think it should?
Don't forget to take pictures!

Without giving too much away in the game, you're unpacking their life possessions, each of their items you can gleam the kind of person they are, gradually building up their character, on their profession, their hobbies, who their life partner is.

Its also developed by an independent australian game studio published by humble games.

I also think it's worth noting that this game will not be the same if you watch someone else play/ have the entire game spoiled for you.

That being said, before this came out I was so hyped for it and it went beyond my expectations. It's incredible they managed to tell such a beautiful story by making you just unpack someone's things. I found my self nostalgic for the things in the childhood bedroom, upset with where I was having to put things in a certain house they lived in; knowing it was done on purpose. I was so excited in one of the next homes, anticipating what I knew was coming next. I rooted for this random fictional character I never saw or really truly knew much about.
I can't stress enough how well this game was made. I felt the love and passion put into it. It goes far beyond the "oh that's probably relaxing and satisfying" (which of course it is).

Loved everything except for how short it is. I finished it in 5 hours (including all sticker challenges). The overall story is really heartwarming and the style of play, satisfying. There were tiny details throughout that made the game feel real and very relatable. Wish you could save a photo of every room in the album instead of having to choose one. The stickers were a great detail and the type of thing I would want more of.
This is an amazing game. Its very relaxing with the music and game play combined. This isn't a hard game but i don't think that's a bad thing.

I really enjoyed the concept of this game and how open-ended it could be. I would play it in between other games as it was a good way to cool down or de-stress. I was quite sad that the game only lasted me about a day before finishing it. I really hope the devs come out with an update soon with new stories or chapters of different people/characters. That would really make it worth its money!

If you're considering buying this, it definitely is a fun game but I suggest to get it if it goes on sale!

The game is fun but you should definitely get this when its on sale if you plan on buying it, the base game has only 4 hours worth of content and honestly i don't think thats worth £15 when i can buy other games cheaper and have like 60 hours at least

在收拾房间的过程中每一个物件都见证了主角的成长历程：逐渐磨损的粉色牙刷杯，越来越多的画笔套装，开始上色的灰色手办，一直陪伴的毛绒玩具，[spoiler] 因为局促的同居空间而不得不憋屈放在床底的奖状 [/spoiler]……总之强迫症一本满足！为数不多的全成就游戏之一。要是收拾家里有鼠标点点点这么简单就好了（悲。

就是肥肠贵，建议等打骨折了再买……在此永远感谢来自Kagami的礼物！
开心了在游戏里整理东西是我最爱干的事儿，心满意足了。虽然画风不是我的菜，觉得也还挺好的。有些物品画得不知道是什么，我更想在通关后玩家可以选择让物品自由摆放，有些东西可以放到别的地方我觉得也很合理😂😂

Very sweet Game adorable heart warming story line. I do wish that there was ether a prequel or more levels considering the price. I spent a long time playing though and its fun to collect the stickers

This is definitely one of the coziest games I've ever played. The only downside is the length of it, it is too small!!! Would definitely play more games like this and would love this game to evolve into more chapters.
The story is nice, and you get to see and live a life through the things a person own and what they carry and leave behind.

This game will make you feel nostalgic for a life that was never yours. You will feel like you know the character you're unpacking for on a more intimate level than you originally though possible. I went into this game expecting an unpacking simulator and was rewarded with a phenomenal story told in the most unique way. What an incredible idea. Can't wait to play again to find more achievements.

This game was surprisingly entertaining considering it's simplicity. I love this for winding down in the evenings. I echo other complaints that it is hard to justify the price for the playtime, however, its definitely replayable.

Pure relaxation all the way. My 7 year old daughter also loves to chill playing this, and the music is lovely. I would love more games like this, and recommend it wholeheartedly. I have replaced my usual Mahjong time for this game!

um jogo simplesmente incrível, super relaxante e diverte por horas.. além de ser um jogo ótimo para passar o tempo, tem uma história muito linda (confesso que até choreiKKJ). minha única critica é o preço, talvez um preço regional seja algo que os devs devam pensar.

I absolutely love this game and the story it tells. The sfx and gameplay are chefkiss. HOWEVER. As much as I like game length for the purpose of the story, I wish the game was longer or offered more rooms because the gameplay tickles my brain in a way that makes me just want more. lol yes the gameplay is too good.

It's a very clever game - and rather zen-like as you play.  I enjoyed attempting to unpack each room and finding room for each item.  My only issue with the game is that some of the objects were not clear in "what" they were, so that made knowing the appropriate room and/or surface/container for them a bit difficult at times.  But overall, I thought the game was great - wonderful graphics, unique game play and even offers a more intense version by timing, achievements. etc.

it's so much fun and so satisfying to get everything unpacked and organized. it's a relatively short game (able to play through in ~3 hours), but it's a great game. it's very relaxing, and i've already filled all three albums, and will most likely fill them all a second time.

I have played this game three time from start to finish and I'm STILL finding new little details each time that are not only fun to look at, but that pertain to the story. The attention to every little detail is incredible, I can't even begin to imagine how much thought went into the artwork and planning for this game. Every heartbreak and triumph in our main character's life makes me misty-eyed and I never get sick of it. This is definitely one of my favorites (if not THE favorite) games to play when I just want to relax. The music certainly helps with that! I can't recommend this game enough for gamers that like cozy games, relaxing games, and story games. It's perfect and I can't help but hope that we'll get a sequel or maybe a similar game visiting someone else's life story.
Very chill and fun vibes. Some of the things in the game were so uncanny for things I had during the years it says. Sweet, subtle story but mostly some satisfying organizing.

its a chill game that I can play while procrastinating lol, but finding where an item has to go near the end can be super random, like why did the earbuds go into the kitchen hahahaha but super cute game .

This game is fun, i wish there was more playability and more "unpacking" stories to do. It is easy, puzzle and something to do when you need a relaxing game. I recommend it only because it was so cute - I hope more comes to it in the future but until then i'll just move then around lol
its so great and fun, i do agree it is short, but its a story of someones life from childhood to having a family. maybe more stories and more families? def needs more for the 20$ price tag

Super cute and easy game to get sucked into. Not only is it super satisfying to do, there's also the storyline going on in the background which is a really beautiful one that had me in tears in the end.

love this relaxing game. the story was surprisingly engaging - i became so invested in the progress and how it was shown through moving alone. such an amazing way of storytelling. also a quick play, only took me 4 hours to finish. overall - love!!

This game was so beautiful, and I became so invested in the story. The graphics are stunning, and the calming soundtrack makes it easy to zone out and enjoy. I cannot recommend this game enough! If it has been sitting on your wishlist, it is so worth playing.

Ein schönes Spiel, um zu entspannen. Dinge auspacken, aufräumen, umstellen, einfach herrlich simpel und beruhigend. Auch die Geschichte, die innerhalb des Spiels erzählt wird, ist ein schönes Detail.
Leider ist der Preis für die Länge an Spielzeit sehr hoch.

This is a super relaxing game. You really understand the Protagonist's journey. It's like looking into someone's life. The subtle narrative points were my favorite. I enjoyed it so much the first playthrough that I started a new one just to get any achievements I had missed and to try different ways of organizing the rooms.

Adorable, contained story. Great for those searching for something calm and world-building. Uncover the story of one individual's life by unpacking their belongings every time they move. Absolutely lovely.

Very fun game, relaxing music with cute visuals. Really cool that it has a storyline that it basically follows. Only complaint would be that there's only the one story. Wish there were more rooms/houses to unbox and gameplay since it definitely too short a game otherwise. Overall quite a good game. Definitely worth a try. Not sure if worth the exact price considering how quick you could get through this but that's just me.

Very chill and relaxed puzzle game about sorting out the rooms of people through their various stages of life. No time limit with relaxing music to let you unwind and organize knickknacks and clutter.

Got this game when a sale was going on, I ended up playing this with a friend who was going through their own playthrough at the same time, Needless to say we were having a good time.
The game itself isn't very long but i personally don't have a problem with that.

A fun little puzzle game about (funnily enough) unpacking objects from boxes.
Great to relax with if you want to have a bit of a chilled out gaming session.
The art style is beautiful.
I enjoyed playing the game but I completed it in 3hrs so it seemed quite expensive for what it is. Hopefully they add more to it in the future that can justify the amount spent.

Entspannend, nette Musik, einfach zum Abschalten. Das Spiel ist einfach nur angenehm und wenn man sich mal nicht stressen möchte. Einfach klicken und platzieren. Es macht einfach Spaß und die Geschichte, die das Spiel ohne viele Worte erzählt, ist gut.
Lovely game, would recommend, but it could do with more end game content that you can play with once you've done the story mode. Beautiful art <3
Very cozy and satisfying game, especially if you enjoy simple mechanics. The story line is cute. I would recommend buying when it's on sale as the length of game-play is pretty short.

I really enjoyed my time with this game, they really did a good job with what they set out to do. It is definitely worth a playthrough, especially if you catch the game on a sale. It was very relaxing for a sunday afternoon type game.

Also, some items could use maybe a description or something to push you in the right direction? Most are clear/self explanatory, but I didn't realize the wooden "X" thing was a dish rack for the longest time and had to just place it anywhere lol
its really fun and quite wholesome, like the title unpacking/moving into a new room or house at diferrent stages in your life, as a whole 10/10 recommend

The only thing that I would say is for it to be made longer- maybe make extra scenarios for when the kid grows up and stuff just because I feel like it went very quickly. I was able to finish it after playing for 4.5 hours over a course of two days and because I liked it so much I would just really like for them to have made it longer. Other than that, it was a very good game, would recommend!

although its short, it really is worth the money, i see a lot of people complain about it but homies....people gotta start somewhere to be able to make games, so dont be too harsh on the price, if you didnt like it that much then maybe you shouldve just waited for it to on sale or smth,...?  imo Witch did an amazing job, and i cant wait to see what else they make <3
Loved playing this game! it was so relaxing. I wish there were more stages though. Maybe you could create another story line as I would love to unpack more rooms and objects

If you like Decorating then this game is perfect. I haven't played long enough to know if it's a different scenario each time but from what I played it seems to be the same sim

If there was more to the game list say doing a small quiz in the beginning to kinda determine what sort of life you would be unpacking then it would for sure be worth the price; it just needs a bit more work to it and some more creative outputs then I would 100% say buy this game for it's normal price.

rating: 7/10

I thought i would e getting much more out of this for the price. I believe it only took me like 2.5 hrs to play it the first time (i've played it fully twice). I'd say that if you want to play this game, get it when it's on sale. It is not worth $20 AT ALL. It's cute and relaxing but there should've been way more.

Brilliant game overall but wish there was more stories you could complete, especially with the price of the game as i finished this in under 2 hours, larger variety of houses and maybe even houses in the future?
everything about this game is incredible. I think the price is a tiny bit much, get it on sale if possible but I will still say its worth it if you have the money.,

Super cool, super little content and way too expensive!

This game has a really cute story told through unpacking the characters home, I do wish that in the future theres more stories to unlock or something but either way its a well made calming game

delightful little story. it manages to pack so much into the simple process of unpacking boxes. so much is said with so few words. the graphics are very pleasing to the eye, and the ending gives a much needed sense of catharsis.

There is not enough of this game... If you ever made a dlc, adding a second story (i.e. the woman's daughter), I would buy it in a heartbeat...  love this game and wish there was more of it to enjoy. So relaxing.

I genuinely hope that we get some DLC for this game one day! I would love to at least get a 2nd story from the perspective of a boy as well! It is so cathartic - if you love organizing and have a lil pinch of OCD then you will love Unpacking <3 I already had it on Switch but I had to get it on Steam for the adorable achievements you can earn.

In this relaxing game, you follow a character you discover only through unpacking her stuff in a new home, through several phases of her life. In childhood, with roommates, with a significant other... You think about what the most convenient places for an item is, you discover new objects, new hobbies of the character, new people in her life, maybe a secret... It's very satisfying and wholesome. The graphic design is very cute, sound design is awesome. Loved it <3

Ein sehr schönes Spiel! Entspannen, Runterkommen und dabei eine junge Frau im Fortschritt ihres Lebens begleiten ohne viel zu erfahren und doch alles mitzubekommen. Kleine Details wie das Kuscheltier, dass sie seit der Kindheit bis ins Erwachsensein begleitet, machen das Spiel zu etwas besonderem.
Such a soothing, cosy and nice game to sit and just relax to the music. Too bad there wont be any DLC's for this game with other peoples lives.

At first, I was unhappy with the duration of the game as I thought I would never play it again. To my surprise, I caught myself thinking about it in a time of uneasiness pretty soon. The aesthetics, music, and possibilities this game has to offer are impeccable. A solid choice for those who can appreciate a digital way of de-stressing.

A short but wholesome experience that I highly recommend. I got so immersed in the life of the character that I was so happy when I noticed that I was unpacking things that showed the character made progress in life and succeeded in their goals. I'm also the type of person who likes to organize their stuff so everything is in its place, so I really enjoyed organizing everything here.

Очень классная игра, чтобы расслабиться после тяжёлого дня. Вам точно понравится, если вы любите убираться и раскладывать вещи. Приятная и довольно детальная пиксельная графика и ненавязчивый  саундтрек. Лично мне понравились звуки предметов вроде стука о дерево, когда ставишь что-то на стол. Отдельного внимания заслуживают отсылки. У меня был какой-то щенячий восторг, когда я увидела коробки с любимыми настолками, названия которых заменены синонимами. Похожая штука с дисками с фильмами и играми.

Геймплей предлагает два режима: стандартный с элементом головоломки, где некоторые предметы должны быть размещены в определённых местах, и свободный, где предметы можно размещать там, где захочется. Есть несколько скрытых достижений, которые можно легко получить, если вы достаточно любопытны. При желании, игру можно пройти очень быстро, но можно и залипнуть подольше, расставляя чашечки и сортируя одежду по цвету.

Очень понравилось, однозначно советую

This game was gifted to me, and I'm so glad I had the opportunity to try it! I was very hesitant to try it given the price tag, but it's downright cute & cozy and totally worth it. 

You follow the story of your character's life by unpacking her items as she moves from home to home over the years. Really simple in concept, but each level contains so much detail and the love that went into this game's design is palpable. Every item that can be interacted with has a unique sound that changes depending on whichever surface it's set on. It just tickles my brain! The best part of this game has got to be the playback feature that unlocks once you complete a level. 

It's not mentioned in the Store description, but Unpacking's design is done in a manner that helps to make gameplay highly accessible (mobility/vision/hearing/cognitition). To keep this review brief, I won't list them here - you can read more about these Accessibility Features directly on their website. 

Totally recommended!

I love this game. I've beaten it 3 times now. Its relaxing yet challenging enough to make you think each time you play it. Its cute and fun to play. I do have some comments/suggestions. 
1. It would be super cool if each album was a different person moving/unpacking. A different life/perspective.
2. I need more story. I need to know why the unpacker moved in with him. Why they moved out. Why they need a cane. Did they move in with friends? Did they get married? I NEED MORE.
Aside from that I definitely recommend this game.

Absolutely loved it. It's a short casual puzzle-ish game where you unpack things and put them into new homes which consists of 1 to several rooms. I do hope there will be an extension to this game since it has a lot of potential.

Неплохая расслабляющая игра, с приятным музыкальным сопровождением и незамысловатым сюжетом. Отлично подходит для того, чтобы психологически отдохнуть после сложного рабочего дня, Единственный минус - очень короткая. Всего одна история и проходится она очень быстро.

Super calming and fun, very short but it is worth it. It tells a story with no characters allowing you to imagine the life of the character you're playing. I found myself actually being shocked with many things like milestones with the main character that are hidden in the items you unpack.

總時長約2~4個多小時建議是等特價時在入手
it's a cute and fun game but ends too soon for the price ($20USD). If there was a few more chapters this would be a great game at a great price. Worth grabbing if on sale.

It's super chill. There's a minor puzzle element. There's gorgeous graphics. The sound effects are amazing. The music is calming. The little hidden elements are so much fun to find and figure out. It is awe-inspiring how well you learn about your playable character and the people she lives with without ever meeting them and having virtually no dialogue. The detailed storytelling is fantastic.
Very zen, incredibly fun. I really liked following the storyline as the main character progressed through the years. Can't wait to play it again!
很輕鬆的小游戲，但是我覺得只有這個程度的可游玩内容確實太貴了。如果真的要玩，真的建議等減價的時候再買。

The game is very cute but i think it's too expensive for the lenght of the game.
Wouldn't buy again unless i knew there was much more to play.

Concept génial, réalisation bien faites. Musique vraiment top. Cependant 20 euros pour un jeu qui dure à peine 3h c'est du vol un peu quand même. Je l'avais acheté pour ma fille, il a duré même pas une journée....Dommage, il aurait fallu aller au bout du concept.
Super Cute! this game was a lot of fun, and it doesn't take a lot of time to play, I got through it in about 4 hours. Would definitely recommend.

great art, great design, great concept! 
one can argue that the game is short but if you really take your time to go through the chapters you will notice the little things and decipher the plot. (great plot btw)
and for that, i deemed it worth the price on sale! 

it's the little details that makes the story great.

This game is incredible. Absolute 10/10.

This is one of the most beautiful, short-but-sweet games I've ever played. If you love organizing, collecting, and soothing jams, I'd definitely give this a try.

The story format is refreshingly unique — you learn about the main character by unpacking their things as they grow up and move through life. You get to be a kid, go to college, experience break-ups, first apartments, and more. You get to watch their career flourish, and can feel sad, proud, and experience joy as you find places to fit the things that make them, them. 

The game also felt more gender-inclusive than most to me, and was really soothing to open up at the end of the work day. I was pretty bummed when I finished it, but I'm so happy that I played, and would happily play again (or play another).

I love the graphics and sprites. This is a game that proves that you don't always need to show the characters to tell a story. It's hard to find other games like this. However, some might get tired of it easily as it can get repetitive and, once you finish it, there's only so much more you can play. I'd love to see another game like this or even a continuation of it, but I think it's perfect as is.

내 집은 못치워도 남의 집 치우고 싶은 분께 추천.
물론 정리정돈 좋아하는 사람들에겐 재밌을만한 게임 임
청소 다 끝내면 뿌듯하기도 한데, 가끔씩 이 물건이 왜 오답이라는 건지 의문이 들긴 하는 경우도 있음

Incredibly relaxing as promised, but the subtle storyline was an unexpected treat that makes this game truly special. There is a puzzle to find the right place for every belonging, but an additional puzzle you find yourself in is to piece together the protagonist's life story in each stage. My only qualm is that I tried to really take my time and it still only took me 6 hours to complete. Some different game modes and challenges would really help the replayability!

I was skeptical about buying the game at 20$ (annoyingly I was just a few days late for the sale), but I got it because it was near the top of the relaxing tag and looked super cute! I should've looked into it more. I figured that at that price, with how simple the game looked, it must have a long playtime, maybe even a random level generator. And when you launch the game and start playing it presents you with three books, I was naive enough to think that each book was for a different character, so you would have a few levels as one character, finish their story, and move on to the next. It made sense to me because it would represent lots of different reasons for the unpacking, every U-Haul truck has a story right? But no, obviously they are just different save slots for the same character, I couldn't tell you why, as I don't see much replay-ability after the 3-4 hour game. 

My advice? You have 2 options:
1. Buy the game at a heavy discount (or full price if you just don't care), enjoy it for however long it takes (It's still a great game!), get the achievements for that game completion ratio then put it down after about 4-5 hours of playtime and eventually you will see the need to come back to it once you can't remember the details, or maybe you're one who can just replay the same stuff mindlessly and that's enough for you.

2. This is a wildcard and I have no idea if it would work. Buy the game for whatever price, set a timer for an hour 50 minutes upon launching, speedrun that ♥♥♥♥ as fast as you can. Quit when the timer goes off and get a refund, steam policy should refund you if you have less than 2 hours playtime.

I think that second one would be funny. Anyway I have still given this a thumbs up, price aside, the game is absolutely worth the time. It's just sad because it has [u]such potential[/u] and yet they don't seem to plan on adding any more content. Were it like I said and there were one or two more characters from different walks of life, with different paths, I think it would be worth $20 easily. Oh well.

Whether you love organizing, or you had a rough day and just need some time to decompress, this is the game for you. At first I thought I wouldn't like it, just trying to organize where all of these items in your room/house go, but I wound up loving it! Initially I played it on GamePass, so I decided to get it on Steam too to see how it was playing with a mouse vs my controller (ps: definitely recommend playing this on Steam over Xbox, but try it on GP if you're on the fence about this). I was a little saddened that I beat the game so quickly, but it was a nice relaxing journey!

The game is very soothing and peaceful.  A friend said the game sounds like work, but to me it sounded like fun.  This game satisfied organizing tendencies as well as allowing some creative freedom on how to arrange each room.  The story is pretty subtle but I was cheering for MC throughout.  I hope there'll be more stories/rooms to unpack later :)

Nice game. At first it was a bit frustrating but then when u get into it and listens to the music in the background and do it in your own pace.. it's kinda' soothing! And i really love to watch the ''replays'' after you are done. (:

Game is alright. There isn't much that much to it and you can get 100% achievement completion in about 4 hours. I'd recommend if you're ok with the time length. 
Overall it's a very aesthetically pleasing game but your freedom is limited.

I just wish there was more, whether more people's stories or more choices in what they're like. Even choosing which plush toy they keep or what colour their toothbrush is would add a bit extra content to this.
I particularly think a story about a military kid would work really well in this format.

This is a very chilled out and relaxing little game to play. I did enjoy it a lot and thought it was very wholesome, following the characters journey. However, I was a little bit shocked at how quick the game was. Once you have completed the main story, I would have liked some extra levels in the other albums, maybe perhaps following a different character and their story. I was a little bit sad you just replay the same rooms over once the story has ended. However, despite this I still recommend the game, as it is very cute and imaginative.

Nice game with fun achievements but I wish the game had more content in it. 
I finished the game the first time in 4 hours. I loved the story, great journey to follow. 
I loved the fact that you could turn on a mode where you could place stuff anywhere you wanted to, and loved the sound details.

This was literally the sweetest, cutest game I've ever played. It held my attention for like a solid 3 hours. If you really like interior designing and organizing stuff, this is for sure your game. Absolutely adorable. 10/10, wish I could experience it for the first time again.

I really liked this game. I completed it in several sittings, and it was novel and well-made, with an interesting story that resonated with me. I've also moved a lot in my life, and had to fit it my stuff with others' stuff - finally having my own space after that was very freeing to me. The ending made me a little tear-eyed, and I am very happy about that.
Yes, the game is a little short, but I didn't mind its length or the price (I bought it for about 15 Euro). It conveyed the message well, evoked emotions, and was a very interesting experience. 

I hope to see more games in this format in the future.

Jeu très bien mais beaucoup trop court, 20€ pour le finir en 3h c'est abusé, c'est pile assez pour pas pouvoir se faire rembourser. Je recommande de l'acheter seulement en réduction. En espérant qu'il y ait des mise à jours gratuites. 
PS: le son bug (augmente à des moments inopinés, c'était chiant)
I love this game, it made me very happy and relaxed to play and i was sad when it was over but its a very cute game that I recommend for anyone who likes cute, relaxing games to pass the time

Это очень приятная игра, рассказывающая о взрослении, отношениях и разных жизненных этапах героини в повествовании-распаковке и комментариях фотоальбома. 

Визуальное и звуковое оформление потрясающее, много культурных отсылок. 

!!! Если вы тоже не любите захламленные поверхности и всевозможное сентиментальное коллекционирование, будет очень гореть задница, когда придется расставлять очередные сто фигурок на полках или игра не даст спрятать кухонные мелочи в ящики.

Cute little game not much to say you unpack stuff, has a fun story line you can kinda piece together throughout and the sped up video of you placing everything sounds very relaxing. Its a good game but i'll probably never replay it, still worth it if you have 20 bucks to spare and enjoy clicking noises.

I love this game but its way to expensive for having very little levels I was quite disappointed. If I would have known how little levels they have for the price I wouldn't have bought it. Which is my fault I should have done more research. But it is very fun they just need to add more levels before its worth the price.

A very fun and calming game, my only complaint would be that just as I'm getting into the swing of it, it's over. Would love to see more content and levels, I loved the little hidden story and had a lot of fun unpacking, please add more levels!
This a really relaxing game, you have the option to place items anywhere. It is really easy to earn all the achievements and the game is very heartfelt.

I love this game, It has a very good and wholesome story to it and I love the way it's portrayed. But It's not worth 20$, There's not enough story to it, but I'd say that's the only problem to it. /10

It is a very chill game if you want to just relax and vibe to some lighthearted guitar music and organize rooms. One thing is that there are too few levels and you can finish the game pretty quickky, I hope they add others houses or tooms
Very calming and cute! Beautiful pixel graphics. If the creator decides to make a dlc or other unpacking story lines, I'm all for it!!!

Loved this game, yes it was short so I would LOVE more updates but that doesn't take away from the fact this game was so well made and well thought out. I got emotionally attached to the toy chicken and chicks so enough is said on that hahaha
Soothing game that's great for unwinding. After unboxing all the boxes, you feel connected to the person. Looking forward to a sequel.

A fun, quirky puzzle game with a soothing soundtrack and pleasing to the eye art style and as you sort through the various boxes at each stage of a persons life from childhood to adulthood and the changes that come with it.

i love this game so much! it has such a cute story line and you can easily play it many times. it took me over 5 hours to fullt complete the game as i spent time laying out the clothes neat, laying out bookshelves in rainbow order etc. each time you take and save a pic of a room, it has a diff caption so its fun playing around with that ! theres three save slots so you can decorate differently each time or even allow friends to play! the achievements are really sweet and there are many items to interact with! if you visit a save after a while, things change in the house as if people have 'lived' in it !! overall, a lot of thought was put into the game and it is definitly worth the price if you take your time to organise each aspect of the game, rather than just putting things in places for the sake of it hahah! Ein sehr tolles Spiel. Ich würde mich aber z.B. über DLC's freuen.

The game is also relaxing, and having said that, its a bit disappointing that, unless you just want achievements, or to experience the story again, there's not really any replay ability. I'd say if you enjoy these types of games, go for it, but be warned you won't get much more than a few hours of gameplay, so if you're looking for something to keep your attention for longer, this may not be for you.

Unpacking is a very chill game with good soundtrack. You follow the journey of a unamed woman throught her life by the proxy of her unpacking. Sweet and sometimes sad, the storytelling by the objets is amazing.

i bought this on sale and personally wouldn't pay 20€ for such a short game, but otherwise i would highly recommend this game!!!

主角玩儿着玩儿着弯了，饮食习惯从salt & pepper变成酱油蒸包子……以为主角是服装设计师最后成了一个儿童漫画作家……整体非常解压……谁能告诉我最后那个洗面奶到底放哪儿？

The mechanics are smooth and controls are super simple and nothing is complicated in the slightest. However I did feel overwhelmed whenever more and more boxes started appearing, but thats a personal thing lol.  I felt the character to be relatable and the story line made me emotional at times. She has me worried with all the back pain medication shes taking, but again its those little details that makes this wonderful. For the price I do have my fingers crossed there will be some kind of second level released whether its just another level to unpack into or another characters life to play out because im itching for more content, but I'm not saying the game isn't worth it, I'm just broke lmao. Anyways lovely game. Easy 9/10 for me.
Really great game which tells the story of somebodys life but you do finish it quickly. would highly reccomend.

Un trasloco, un cambiamento, un nuovo inizio. Disfare gli scatoloni e pescarvi da dentro gli oggetti di una vita, alcuni comuni, immediati; altri particolari, strani. Scoprire un intera esistenza attraverso gli oggetti di cui ci circondiamo; quelli che decidiamo di lasciarci dietro, e quelli che nonostante tutto non dimentichiamo mai. Ogni nuova stanza è una nuova fase della vita e rappresenta una tela bianca; un occasione rara di schiarirsi le idee e riflettere su quali cose sono davvero importanti per noi.

Unpacking si presenta con un idea tanto semplice quanto ben realizzata; disporre gli effetti personali di una persona che non conosceremo mai, ma che con l'avanzare del gioco sentiremo sempre più vicina a noi. Siamo noi, ma è anche LEI. I suoi oggetti, le sue stanze; ma noi giochiamo un ruolo importante nel decidere che cosa è più importante per lei; se la musica o i videogiochi, se ama certi vestiti oppure altri.

Un gioco che potremo definire "zen". Non c'è punteggio, non c'è una scelta migliore di un altra. Solo il piacere di riuscire a mettere ordine, di trovare ad ogni cosa il proprio posto - il posto giusto secondo noi - ed infine raggiungere un equilibrio tra le forze in gioco e le dinamiche di una vita.

Tutto questo lo viviamo con una stupenda direzione artistica, capace di trasmettere tanto con poco. E con la preziosa libertà che raramente ci impedirà di disporre gli oggetti come potremo fare noi stessi nella vita reale, concedendosi talvolta anche qualche stravaganza.

Unpacking non è per tutti, e forse colpirà più coloro che hanno già avuto modo di apprezzare i cambiamenti della vita. Se concederai loro la possibilità, le circa 5 ore di gioco che offre ti assorbiranno totalmente, facendoti purtroppo sperare che il gioco possa non terminare così in fretta quanto temi.
Da questo punto di vista è davvero un peccato che il gioco non offra almeno una seconda storia una volta terminata la prima, o che non esistano DLC che possano compensare questa assenza. In cuor mio spero possa un giorno arrivare un seguito di questa piccola perla.

PRO:
+ Gameplay interessante e ben realizzato. Divertente e rilassante.
+ Cura per i piccoli dettagli

CONTRO:
- Limitata rigiocabilità
- Una sola storia disponibile

VOTO: 8.5

I'm a sucker for calming, scenic, somewhat emotional games so it's difficult for my opinion to not be a biased one but I have to be realistic about this game despite how sentimental it makes me.
This game is lovely, from aesthetics to how therapeutic the gameplay is. The storyline is wonderfully subtle and emotional in a way that isn't trying too hard and feels very organic. This is a very loveable game for the right audience <3

In terms of constructive criticism it would've been nice to have access to a new set of rooms to unpack and a new narrative once finished with the main one. I was anticipating the new journey I'd get to play through now that the first one was over and I was left feeling unsatisfied. This development would obviously be difficult and require a lot of attention to detail but I think it would be worthwhile and something I'd like to see added in the future update.

As for the story I've just played through though, it truly was a fantastic experience. I'm looking forward to what the developer has to offer in the future, be that an update to this game or new games entirely.
Realistically, Unpacking isn't for everyone. If you're looking for something intense, some sort of challenging puzzle game or a complex narrative this may not be for you. The main motivation here truly seems to be aesthetics, relaxation and a subtle emotional bond towards our character.

Overall I'd give the game a 7/10, but if we're given more stories to play through in the future I could see it being up to a 9/10 personally. 
TL;DR: don't play this if you're looking for excitement or difficulty, play it if you like pretty things or are somewhat mentally ill

Very calm and relaxing game, just a good vibe.

That being said, I feel like it's too expensive for what you get. More content (such as more levels/houses to unpack and decorate) would really help get rid of that feeling.

Amazing visuals and gameplay. The story was subtle but so awesome to watch unfold. Absolutely loved seeing the MC go through all of her biggest life stages while just unpacking her life ever few years. Would recommend this to absolutely anyone.

very fun game. a little short i finished the game in a little over 2 hours. i hope they add new levels soon. you follow the story of a girl who moves from house to hous as she grows up. ypou help her unpack her things. very challenging good game

i really liked everything about this game. the art, the wordless story telling, the music, the charm, etc. even though 20 dollars is pretty high, the devs really deserve it. if you dont think youll like it, wait until a sale, but please do support the developers if this interests you.

Расслабляющая, милая, незамысловатая игра про, буквально, переезды. Ваша задача - расставлять вещи "на свои места", при этом следуя зову своего внутреннего "я". Разбираем коробки и читаем по содержимому историю жизни героя.
Absolutely delightful in every way. Incredibly relaxing, satisfying, and a surprisingly well-crafted story (yes - story!).    I love this game!

Played the game to completion in 4hrs and I loved every minute of it. It's fascinating how without ever meeting this person, I got to see a small fraction of their life, their joy and sadness. I can't wait to see what this team will come up with next.

I love this game! You have a certain amount of freedom in how you arrange and place items, except for the key items, so it's a personalized experience. Game play is relaxed, play at your own pace. This is a unique little gem. Can we have more like this please?
Lovely game and super fun/cute and great graphics. But I really don't think that the game was worth $20 for the amount of game play there was.

A fun and relaxing game, but waaaaaaay too short for how much it costs. Definitely needs DLC or free updates with additional levels/characters you play through. You'll beat it in about three or so hours.

Depending on how fast you unpack, the play time will differ. I highly recommend this game.
I wish there were more story lines depending on which book you choose in the beginning, honestly, But over this was a very fun game to play! Only a few hours long so it was a good time killer!

I really love this game! I adore the unpacking and moving things around, the controls and snapping is very satisfying. I really hope there will be more scenarios/stories though! I just want more to discover and unpack because I love this enviroment so much and I want to live here forever, but I'm already about to bore of the one story. Excited to see more from the studio!
