This is a sweet puzzle game that tells the story of one person's life. It's really fun to unpack items traveling the the person throughout. My only wish is that it would be a little bit longer of a game.

A really lovely game. Didn't expect to need a box of tissues to unpack boxes, but it's very quietly moving (pun intended). I knew it was a short game so I really took my time and it took me about 8hrs. Many people say 4h but I would recommend slowing down and just trying a bunch of configurations for things, it's fun and satisfying. It was well worth the price for me, personally.

My only complaint is that it's too short. I got this as a gift and it was on sale, but even so, the price seems a little high for a game I finished in 5 hours. That being said, I understand this was an indie developer and I have to be more lenient. It's more important to me that the staff is paid.

The only other gripe I have is personal. I wish there was a gender option. I'd love to see another one of these with a male or gender-neutral character.

I'd also like the option to put certain photos in the garbage :D

Really cute and short game. I enjoyed going through the characters life as they grew up. You get to see their life through the items you unpack, and it was fun to recognize the items from earlier parts as the time passes. While it was very short, I still feel like it was worth the money. The game shares a lot of emotions without telling you outright what was going on. If you're looking for a nice chill game, this is a good one.
一次性的全成就通关了，游戏如你们所见在3-4小时左右，游戏过程可能过于的佛系，但真的十分优秀，建议分段游玩。在游戏进行时不断猜测剧情也很开放，总之就是值得打折入手，不要像我一样脑袋一热全款买了，，
Fue super entretenido si bien fue más corto de lo que esperaba. Pero definitivamente si buscas algo para relajarte y aliviar tensiones, este es el juego para ti!

Cute game, but very very short. Get it on sale! The only reason it even took me close to 4 hours to finish was because I didn't recognize what a few of the objects were and struggled to place them "correctly".

"We unpack your life"
很轻松很解压的小游戏，慢慢收拾到最后通关很难没有成就感吧！！没有很明显的剧情线，但确实能从细枝末节看出每段人生的故事。和男性前任同居的时候因为没有地方放只能放在床下的奖状最后终于在主人公和另一个女孩的家里挂起来啦，最后ed两个落日下相对微笑而坐的背影好美好美TT喜欢！

唯美，清新，美式，简约。
可以放轻松来慢慢摆搭和布置
就是一点，还是加上物品名称提示吧，很多东西真的看不出来是啥

So simple yet so well designed. The story was really well written and I loved that you could follow along at your own pace. Game design was beautiful and the game itself was very easy to pick up and play immediately. Would highly recommend to friends <3

I liked the game, it is a relaxing game to play I wish there was more to it. More levels or story's  or something like that. I did have problems with my screens when I was playing but I don't know if it was because of my PC or the game.

Simple, wholesome, relaxing, and sweet. I didn't expect to get emotionally attached to a character I never even meet; the narrative is skilfully laid out in the items you unpack one by one. A beautiful game.
A nice, relaxing game with a story. I loved that there is a lot to do even for a 'shorter' game. Interested to replay it later just to relax a bit.

This game has to be in my top three favourite games, just for how amazing it's put together. It tells a story with no words, only unpacking. I really enjoyed it, and highly recommend it to anyone with a couple hours of free time
非常适合我这种整理狂魔，玩起来很解压。看到女主小时候的玩偶一直陪伴到长大真的太治愈了。
收纳党必玩！而且很有趣的是看其他up主玩会发现大家的收纳习惯都很不一样，这个游戏的自由度还是很高的（可以去设置里把放置限制关掉哦）
Great simple puzzle game. Felt very relaxed and soothed the entire time, great lgbtq+ repersentation as well, 10/10 loved this game and would play again!

整理自己房间都没这么起劲过

BGM和画面没得说，一直在渲染气氛，游戏里的细节很多，叙事和流程也很流畅且完整。
小姑娘爱好挺多，同居之后光是电子游戏居然就高达一柜子，震撼了，不愧是天天搬家的有钱人。

此外我建议整理到最后两三个的时候可以提示一下这是什么东西或者放在哪里，竹架子我想穿了也没想到他是个放碗盘的架子。

Such a feel good game, very satisfying to play at the end of the day when it's time to chill and unwind. A few small challenges thrown in here and there to get you thinking, and help understand new events in the timeline.

I bought the game and experienced the story of personal items after seeing someone put all the spices behind the plates in their play through. Sound design and small details really made it an incredibly special game to play despite knowing the end results!

Worth an experience!

I really enjoyed this game. The sounds were very satisfying, and the pixel art was SO cute. It was fun to unravel the characters' story from context clues and the little blurbs in the scrapbook. I love the representation, too.

My only issue with this game is the same as I've seen a few others say- it is a very short game for $20. Less of an issue for me because I purchased it on sale, but still kind of a problem nonetheless. The format could easily be used to tell a lot more peoples' stories and add in a lot more levels, as well as some of the pixel art being reused (no need to draw a ton of different toothbrushes) and I feel like the creator is really missing out on something good by not adding more. Other than that I'd recommend playing it!
Perfect game! I normally hate unpacking when I move in real life and I was surprised that i enjoyed the process so much. I hope to see a sequel or some DLC in the future!

A very cute and calm game. I definitely don't consider it to be $20 worth, more like $10. There is so much left to be yearning for by completion of the game. For a game that took me about 4 hours to complete, that's not a lot of game play for a $20 game. 
Overall, I would wait to purchase this when there's a sale. I got the game on sale for $15, but even that is still a little too much for this game. It has a cute story, but I was expecting more from other people's game clips I've seen.

Loved playing, that is true. The music was good, it was relaxing, I had fun organizing everything. 
However, a few hours into the game I realized I finished it. It was just that... was quite disapointing. 
Very nice to play but buy it when in sale, otherwise it doesn't pay off.
100% loved this game, it was so satisfying and relaxing however i only got 2.7 hours of game play for the price. overall still a good game!!
This game is very therapeutic to play and definitely has helped to calm me down during stressful times. 100% recommend to those who need something calm to play

This game is absolutely adorable. It's calming and relaxing to just unpack things and put them where they belong. Though I have some personal qualms about where things deserve to go.... it's a fun game nonetheless. I would highly recommend for anyone who just wants to take a minute and relax with a chill atmosphere and simple gameplay.

This game has been so nice to play as a college student who after a long day just wants to sit and mindlessly play something before bed. It's casual, comforting, and offer just enough of a story to keep you invested! It has made me so relaxed.

as a current art student in their final semester of college trying to figure out what i will do with my life and what will happen, this game was really cathartic for me. almost every level made me cry (in a good way!!) and it was really nice to be able to see queer people like me being able to have a normal, safe, and fulfilling life. i just hope one day i can be as happy as these two :) i loved this game and i know ill keep coming back to it and play it over and over :)

Absolutely love the way the story was presented, very unique narrative delivery. It's a bit short, you can easily do the thing in 2 hours, so maybe wait for a sale. The game itself is very worth playing. Major kudos to the devs for such a unique little gem of a game.

Really loved this game, it was very relaxing and fun. You can understand the history of every house with everything you unpack. Got me a little emotional at the end. I would love to see more added to it.

I bought it because it seemed like a cute game to play and it exceeded my expectations !! The storytelling through environment is honeslty amazing, didnt expect that !!
[spoiler]loved the soft lesbian vibe at the end[/spoiler]

The good: I absolutely loved this game. I couldn't put it down. It is so relaxing and amazing and it's super interesting to see how they can tell a story without a single word.

The bad: it's crazy short. This game is absolutely worth 5$ or so for the length and total game play. But nowhere near worth the non-sale asking price.

That said, I would absolutely buy DLC to expand the game or give another story line to follow, if it became available.

Unpacking acompanha a vida de uma personagem desde sua infância até sua vida adulta. Conforme ela vai crescendo, ela passa por diversas mudanças de casa. Você é responsável por arrumar seus pertences a cada mudança. Com isso, você acompanha diferentes fases de sua vida. É um jogo que parece bobo, mas cativa. E é extremamente relaxante, pois quem não gosta de deixar a casa toda arrumada? Gostei muito! Pena que é curto.

Bought this during Lunar New Year Sale, it's quite expensive compare with the game content but I'll still recommend you to purchase and support the team, the story is quite touching and all the graphics bring me back to 90's. Wish developer could increase more levels, providing some updates in the future!

This game is perfect for unwinding after a busy day. It's very satisfying, with a cute story and great music. The graphics are cute as well and it plays smoothly.
 The only issue is it is a very short game. The price point does not match the game length by any means which was rather disappointing. It took me less than 4 hours to beat the initial play through. The replay value is okay at best.
It's worth it to buy it at a sale price.

I didnt think i was going to like this game, I was hesitant buying it but bought it on sale and thought why not - honestly I ended up loving it and I cant explain why. Its so satisfying and enjoyable!
I really hope they create more content/rooms/characters to unpack because I want to keep playing and coming back to this game <3

Lovely story with relaxing audio. Takes about 2-4 hours to complete (8 levels) but after that you can try to get all the achievements etc. Not really worth the full price (20€) so wait for a sale and buy then. But would recommend this game.

I like the fact that there's an actual character and story, and it's not just your typical puzzle where you have to put things in place. We get to know their story, personality, traits, and hobbies just by seeing the things they posses while we do the unpacking. We follow along throughout the main character's journey in life for each level. The music too, it sets the tone perfectly in every stage.

My only wish though is that it was longer, have more levels, or have some sort of replayability. By the time I hit credits I was like "wait that's it?", I wanted more. 

I hope that if we get an update in the future we can play as a different character, or maybe randomized levels of some kind.

The short time I had with it was fun and relaxing. - 8/10

У игры, на мой взгляд, есть 2 главные проблемы:
1) Идентификация предмета. Не всегда понятно, что за предмет перед тобой. Я потратил добрых 30 минут, чтобы понять, что квадратное разноцветное месиво - это коврик для мышки. Отсюда, кстати, вытекает и вторая проблема.
2) Привязка и логика расположения предметов. Вот например, хотите вы заставить всю квартиру так, как посчитаете нужным - но не выйдет. Предметы зачастую могут быть не только привязаны к определенной комнате, но еще и к определенному месту. 
Да, это накладывает ограничения на медитативный геймплей, поскольку в такие моменты становится безразлично на то, как ты обставил комнату - главное, найти, куда деть тот мигающим красным предмет, чтобы перейти к дальнейшим событиям.
А так - игра хорошая. Ящички открываются, можно спустить воду в унитазе, можно включать освещение и компьютер.
Ну а в конце ждет песенка.
Very short- finished in three hours. Other than that it is very relaxing and calming and serves as a great game to soothe any stress. Wish there was a more distinct plot line- 7/10
太好玩了。本像素爱好者看到这种画风直接心化掉。细节很满，故事也很治愈，通关画面一出来非常感动（讨厌的男人不仅不让我挂奖状而且袜子内裤乱放）。唯一就是流程有点短，完全没有玩够。要是能出dlc或是开启创意工坊就更好了。

Relaxing game with a great little story. Actually had me tear up. I am hopeful that they might make an Unpacking 2 with perhaps some combinable objects and more secret achievements. That was my favorite part.
So fun and relaxing, you could easily play this game for hours without realizing it. Its so fun interpreting the story of the characters life as you unpack their things.

Fantastic game and the story made me cry. I wish I could play it again and experience it all over again.

I literally bought the game and hyper-focused on it so hard that I played the whole game through without even realizing how much time had passed. Well worth the money.

This is a great game. Had an absolutely wonderful time playing it. HOWEVER, I would say wait for this game to go on sale. It's a very short game and I really feel like 20 bucks is a little steep. If you can get it on sale for like 15 bucks I fell like it's a much more reasonable purchase. Otherwise, a beautiful game. It's great gameplay over a heartwarming story.

This game is absolutely wonderful. It's the first in a very long time to make me feel so intensely to the point of crying. I can't recommend this more, from every up and down in MC's live to the incredible implied storytelling, I couldn't get enough of it. I finished the game and got each achievement in less than 5 hours, and it made me crave even more. I'd love for something like this with more characters, each with a different story that you can only gather through unpacking their lives through each stage and new place.
还不错，喜欢像素风，就流程稍微短了点。如果能有其他更多风格的房间的话感觉会更好玩ww

Unpacking is a great game and the story is one that resonated with me. It's relaxing enough to play when you're in the mood to game but you just want something that isn't too mentally straining. The only issue I have is that the length of the game is pretty short and with no DLC on the horizon once you've played it once you've pretty much done. There are achievements if you're into that, but otherwise it is a game you may only play through once and complete. I think it's a shame there won't be more added, because the game is not only beautiful and relaxing, but it's actually a fun concept. I hope the devs reconsider and come up with something else or a sandbox option which means you can continue unpacking rooms at random.

It's a simple game with a simple story, but it's enjoyable throughout.

Great way to procrastinate unpacking my meatspace house that I just moved into, lol.
This game is super cute. It tells an entire story with just a few words. I rushed through it a bit towards the end so I can't wait to play through it a second time.

This game is absolutely amazing! Its amazing that you can replay it over and over, and it never gets boring. I also love that it tells a story. If your bored and have some money to spend, i would absolutely recommend it. 
10/10
Игра очень увлекательная, расслабляет. Звуки и расстановка предметов просто прекрасна, даже сюжет есть. Жаль играется очень быстро, чуть больше 4-х часов. Но внимания и денег точно стоит

Although it is a bit expensive for the length of gameplay, I believe this game is 100% worth it. The satisfaction of unpacking and decorating how you like, all while slowly realizing the larger story of the unknown mc's life, is beautiful. There are also plenty of fun achievements that invite repeat playthroughs if you want to stay in this world while waiting for any updates, dlc, or even new games of the same nature.

The game is really fun and relaxing! At least for me it is!
I was expecting other stories on the other books, but it seams that's not hte case so in the end you don't get to know a new person to unpack they stuff
while a very short game,  its very cute! VERY calming. Would be fun if there was a few more scenarios to unpack. If its on a sale pick it up.

The game was lovely, relaxing, music is amazing and I loved the pixel art.
The issue is the length, I think it's too short for its price. 
If you want to try out this game, I'd recommend only getting it for a cheaper price.
Really cute and fun game! I played it all the way through in one sitting, but there is so much meaning in all of the stages of our characters life
很不错的创意，除了有的时候需要猜“这tm是什么东西”以外，通过“物”来体现“人”的不同选择，不同时期，不同的人生阶段，十分巧妙。

This game is so calming and adorable. It really speaks to the kind of gamer I am -- which doesn't exactly align with most games -- and was so good I finished it in a day! I highly recommend this game to anyone who enjoys organization and soft vibes. 10/10! <3
This game is great. Not only is it very non-stressful, it incorporates storytelling in a way that is almost choose your own adventure.
有点小贵，但是很细节。Demo的时候就觉得很解压，确实解压。不过有些东西没认出来是什么，就从家具里真的能看出人经历的事和发生的变化。遗憾的是流程太短啦，原本以为三个颜色的相册是有三个故事，没想到只是三个存档555

Got the game at 20% off after eyeing it since launch.

Absolutely gorgeous visuals paired with lovely music and a nice story. Chill and relaxing game with around 4-5 hours of playtime.

Price is abit steep but the game was so satisfying and I had fun! Would recommend! :)
每到一个新的房子看到一堆新的箱子的时候会有点烦，但收拾东西的过程和把东西都收拾好之后看着整洁的房间时都很开心

I love love love this game so much, I love the stylisation of it, the story, the atmosphere change in every section. This is a truly amazing game. (SPOILERS AFTER THIS POINT)

The only thing I wish for (yes I'm aware this is a small dev team) for more story(s) or content, like an update that continues the store in the child's eyes or something like that, it's just a $20-$30 game for 2-4 hours content is a little dissappointing.

But other than that, this is a great game, %100 recommend

Definitely game worth playing with adorable story. It is short but worth playing again to find new things. I will definitely be playing again and on the look out for possible future games by this creator.

Satisfying game play and wonderful story telling without hardly any dialogue needed. I highly recommend to anyone, especially those like me that are going to be deal with the stresses of moving in the near future and needed a positive opposition to all the negativity. Hoping for DLC.

Probably the best game I have played in a bit. I love single player games and I love games that have a great storyline, twists and fantastic music. This puts it all together, paired with some amazing and intuitive controls and graphics... I'm just speechless. Best money I've spent in 2022 and I already know that nothing will come close to it. Thank you for this masterpiece.

Considering it only took me a good few hours to fully complete this game, disregarding the fact I went into a second save to get remaining achievements I missed after post end, I do think it has potential in being something more. Which the only main problem I have is the price of the game that has lack of levels. Like I said it has it's potential, but I do think there should've been more to it if that makes sense. It has a good soundtrack though and the theme given off in each level is set pretty good. The music kind of adds to the story as you figure out who this person is and what situation their in at different points. Anyway, despite the odd price and small amount of content, I still will recommend this to a friend that like short puzzle games that have a similar theme to this one. :)

I played this in a Discord stream with a good friend of mine. During the last level, we pulled [spoiler]the stuffed pig and tiger[/spoiler] out of the box in [spoiler]the baby's room[/spoiler] and started crying on the spot. Please play this game, and pay attention to everything you unpack- the narrative behind this game is truly beautiful.

A calm and relaxing game about decorating various homes to your heart's content and making you feel nice and good, and then the game scolds you for putting spoons in the bathroom and that things that make you feel nice and good aren't always right.

Personally, I absolutely love this game and have replayed it over and over on Xbox when I had the game pass, as well as on Steam now.

Do I think it's worth the price? Not necessarily. You finish it within a few hours.
Replayable? Yes, but it sometimes can become repetitive.

On seperate note, I enjoyed the Xbox version more. It had more items than the PC version does, which Imo is a missed oppertunity.

This game is very short and sweet (maybe 4 hours of main gameplay at most) but it's the perfect game if you're looking for something casual, relaxing, and that doesn't require a time of commitment. I could see myself replaying this when I need downtime without being overly concerned about perfectionism and challenging mechanics.

Very nice and relaxing game with a good story. ♥
Would 10/10 recommend if you are looking for a simple game that also helps you relax!

Very relaxing game but it quickly starts becoming repetitive. I don't really like that certain objects have to be in certain rooms in certain locations, like this is my apartment why can't I put my toaster under my bed? Feels like no freedom but a bit of wiggle room at the same time. There also needs to be an option to save your progress, I felt like I had to finish the entire level before leaving because I didn't want to lose my progress. I love the music! It's very similar to Stardew Valley and brings back really good memories. I really liked how smooth the UI was and how easily placing objects was, this was very satisfying when something fix perfectly. I also really liked the tiny objects, like the eyelash curler and the soy sauce, I was literally like "Awwwww" the entire time. But overall this game starts to feel like I am working so I can only play for 30 minutes at a time.

이삿짐 정리하는 퍼즐게임임. 가끔 무슨 아이템인지도 모르겠고, 대체 어디에 놓아야할지 모를 땐 정말 답답함.
그래도 전체적으로는 무난하게 할만했음. 도트 그래픽도 아주 만족. 
난 이삿짐 정리하는 부분만 보고 구매한거라 포장이사 타이쿤 겜인줄 알았는데.... 짧은 스토리 게임이었다...
이런 버전으로 포장이사 타이쿤 누가 만들어줬으면 좋겠다. 멍떄리면서 열심히 즐길 자신 있는데.... 

게임은 신선하긴 하지만, 스토리는 걍 없다고 보면 되고 컨텐츠도 너무 없어서 친구들한테 추천은 안함. 
신선한 인디게임 해보고 싶은 사람들한테만 추천함.

I enjoyed the story told throughout the game. I did not expect to see so much plot in a puzzle game, and was pleasantly surprised. The graphics and style add a unique charm to the game, which adds to the experience overall. Would definitely recommend.

While fun and cute, it is incredibly short, taking not even a few hours to complete, even with going back to get all the achievements. $20 feels unreasonable for the amount of content and replayability, especially since there's no plans to add any additional content or modes.

This game while very short is super cute! I thoroughly enjoyed searching for the hidden achievements some are super neat while others are adorable. I highly recommend if you want a cute and relaxing game.

overpriced, but it offers 3+ hours of gameplay and a subtle story line apart of the obvious one. Its a solid game for organizing and listening to music to, but I wouldn't buy the game unless its on sale i think 10-15$ is a fair price but 20 is a stretch.20$ would be fair if you would play this game more than once, which i cant see myself doing but I can definitely see some people playing it 2-3 times.
Chill game to play in the background or in between games or even just to relax after a long day at work. I love the photo mode feature and the way the game doesn't hold your hand too much.
A surprisingly gripping experience that manages to tell an emotionally engaging story with its mechanics in an unconventional way. Interesting and worth a look.

希望推出新的关卡，游戏真的很细节，操作和音效都很舒适，故事也很棒。
玩完还有一种意犹未尽的感觉，太棒了，还想玩更多
아 힐링되긴하는데 손목 좀 아픔 ㅜ 마우스잡고 계속 클릭해야해서,,, 그래도 진짜 가끔 머리 복잡할때? 힐링하고 싶을 떄 한 번 씩 하면 기분 좋아질듯 ㅜㅜ 짱이에요

Very short, but very nice, very cute. An amazing game about seeing the evolution of one's life through the things they carry with them from home to home. Whether that be a childhood toy, pictures, or medical supplies, each thing in their home tells a little story about the person who lives there. Not only do the individual items tell a story but the placing also tells the insecurities and hopes. Whether proudly displaying an important achievement or hiding pictures of a time you wish to forget, every part of a person's home adds to their story. This game accomplishes a calm and refreshing breath of air as we learn about our MC and unpack their lives at various points.

Unpacking is for folks who enjoy arranging things, interior design, and organization (aka if you love the home making parts of animal crossing). It is for the people who clean up a mess and say ~ ahhhhh ~ and not "my god I am so glad that is over". If you enjoy a fresh stack of towels, or all your glasses put away in the cupboard after washing them, this is for you. 
But it is ALSO for those who enjoy a little bit of mystery; a little bit of investigation and detective work. You can ask yourself "where would I put this?" but you can also ask "where would THEY put this?" Where you would put something is not necessarily where this person would. There is a lot of freedom to put things away where you think they fit best, but you will find some things DO have a specific spot.

Because of my age, this game was SUPER nostalgic and I could relate to the main character a lot. The pixel graphics and soundtrack stir up all sorts of dreamy feelings of the past. So much love went into the design of every little thing you take out of these boxes. I loved figuring out which books, dvds, and videogames were which based on their pixel designs. Very clever nods to geek culture and staples of growing up in the 80s and 90s. The sound design is just *chef's kiss*. Please pick up every single item and place it on every surface in the room before you figure out where to put it for good. Just do it. Seriously.

I was so impressed with the subtle story telling. In so many ways, we are defined by our things. What we choose to keep, what we leave behind, and an assortment of things we gather along the way. Personally, I have moved 12 times in my adult life, so this is very relatable. You will chuckle when you take [that item] out of a box again for the 5th time over a decade later, realizing this is a precious thing to this person. It's really touching. 

I honestly was not expecting the [spoiler]queer[/spoiler] twist in this game. A true tear-jerker that drives the point home that everything DOES have it's right place, but things take time.

All in all a very relaxing game that is great to play after a long chaotic day at work. I don't agree that this game is too short for the price. I really don't understand what people mean by this or how they equate value. Money and time are contructs and I happily spent both of them on this game.

The only complaint I have on Unpacking is that it ends too fast. This is not to say the game is rushed - you are encouraged to be deliberate and relaxed in your game play, taking in its rich story indirectly as you help a woman move into new spaces at key moments in her life. This also is not a reflection on any aspect of it - graphics are clear enough to determine what most objects are, music is fitting for each environment, and sound design is top-notch with every object sounding as it should being placed on every surface. Its length is just a consequence of the subject matter and the nature of indie games.

I highly recommend this, even at full price, as long as you are okay with that short length going in. This is a five-star meal that should be savored.

This game honestly brought tears to my eyes. It was beautiful and it really gave you a connection to the person you played. Despite only unpacking her boxes within new stages of her life you could tell her sorrows, her joys, you could see and feel how she felt. She was a writer, an artist, a wife and a mother, and you could tell all that purely by taking things out of boxes for her!
I cried a little when it ended. Even within the hour or so it took me to initially complete I was there with her for her whole life. We got to see her grow, mature, make her own mistakes, and then regroup. There was so much detail put into the game and it was amazing.

I was expecting a laid back puzzle game and that's what I got... but I got so much more. Yes, you can enjoy this is just several unrelated, relaxing puzzles that scratch a particular itch if you think there's a place for everything and everything should be in its place. I've played through twice and found different, more fulfilling ways to unpack the second time, but the great accomplishment of this game is it also tells a story without explicitly telling you anything. You're following the life of a girl as she grows up and moves from her parents' home to her dorm to her first apartment and so on. It's not hidden but if you pay a bit of attention you can see her progress and setbacks in her personal and professional life. And the musical theme at the end was a pleasantly emotional coda. Fun on a purely mechanical level and a surprisingly touching story waiting to be discovered.

Love this game! My husband & I just bought our first home, so I was playing this game to prep for that move & unwind. Lovely game, I do wish it had more levels, though.

I loved this game. It was fun, relaxing and the graphics were wonderful. The reoccurring items such as the [spoiler]purple mug[/spoiler] or your stuffed animals were a nice touch to the game. [spoiler]Of course, I'm also a sucker for a queer relationship from any source of media and it was nice to play through the game and learn more about their lives.[/spoiler] The different boxes, utensils and trinkets also made the characters feel 3-dimensional and detailed, without is ever having to meet them. The sounds design is also brilliant like how you can turn on radios or game consoles. Gameplay wise, the puzzle element was wonderful and unique and I enjoyed how there was a place items anywhere option for the players that just wanted to design an aesthetically pleasing house, without having to worry about what going where. This is definitely one of my favourite games of all time and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing puzzle indie game with a good storyline and a dash of queerness. 

10/10

This game.... is great.  And it's not because of the gameplay, because that charm wears off fast in my opinion.  This game does a really solid job of telling a story without even directly telling you what's going on.  This is achieved by seeing where the setting is, or where objects are being placed.  There's an obvious overarching story that occurs, but the little details about certain items is what really adds depth to the story, especially when you find out that you have to place a certain object under the bed.  Certain objects can be interacted with, and the things that happen with them really connected with me.  For example, when you turn on the computer from the 2000's, it take quite a while to turn on, just like computers did at the time, and then when you turn on the computer during the last two chapters of the game, it gets to the desktop screen almost instantly, because of the introduction of SSDs.  Also, another great example is when you turn on the obvious GameCube console, it recreated the sound of the booting console so accurately that it gave me a feeling of nostalgia.  Unfortunately not all objects can't be interacted with, especially ones which are just begging for it (i.e. the Newton's Cradle) and it would've been great if many more objects provided this action, making the moving process a whole lot more meaningful.  

All in all, the gameplay itself was excellent at first, but eventually became a chore because you have to move the same certain items over and over, but this is more than made up for by excellent storytelling which requires you to put the puzzle pieces together yourself.  The interaction with certain items does a great job of replicating experiences during those time periods.  An excellent game to play for nostalgia's sake.

Unpacking is a game about just that. You play as an unnamed character who, like many of us will across our lifetimes, moves into various spaces and must unpack and fit all of their belongings into said space. It's a meditative experience, especially for those who enjoy organizing, decorating, and designing locations without the physical labor (or rent prices). In that way, Unpacking is almost most similar to an Animal Crossing life simulator, with a smaller structure and a narrative throughline in levels rather than complete freedom. No matter what compels you to play this game, it's worth it. The omission of text and voice entirely is a smart move, allowing the player to relate to the oddities and little moments stored within the things we keep with us. What the protagonist chooses to move to their next residence or not is extremely relatable and fascinating, and while not groundbreaking on a writing level, Witch Beam sets a new standard for delivering narrative beats through player discovery and subtle moments. On top of the chill gameplay, Unpacking delivers a truly gorgeous pixel-based art style and a soothing soundtrack filled with synth sounds and guitar riffs. Hidden music tracks remain period-accurate and every detail the game has with its individual props shows not only a technical mastery, but an understanding of humanity that is astoundingly grounded. Unpacking is a phenomenal experience, and I loved my time with it. I cannot wait to see what these developers try next.

I do have one other nitpick- This game does something I absolutely hate with the save files. You select a save slot and name the save file. Then, it brings the save slot (a scrapbook) into the game's story. Which I don't appreciate. I don't want the book of the MC's life to be labeled with my name, I am not the MC in any way. She's a character you learn about throughout the game, with a full personality and identity. Tell me upfront that I'm naming the character, not just my save file, and I'll name her something other than my name.

The level with the MC moving into a boyfriend's home really had a constricting feeling, most of all, this level was by far the most expressive one. Giving the ability to move the other person's stuff (which the roommate level didn't have) but still leaving no real room for MC's belongings, like her possessions were merely tolerated rather than welcomed (and again, the level of moving in with a roommate actually felt more like merging space). Well done. All the levels were great, but this one did a lot of heavy lifting. I was relieved to see the MC break up and move back home.

Lovely game but 4 hours of game play for 20 Euros is definitely too high. I really enjoyed the game in itself but I felt like it was lacking a bit of variety and certainly more content. Slightly disappointed after I was super excited to play it. I hope more content will follow., nevertheless.

I really enjoyed this game, it was so relaxing. 
The story it tells as you go unpacking, the different stages in life.. its just a great game.
Only thing is i wish there was more unpacking to do. This game you can complete in one sitting. 
Loved it tho, will definitely play it again :)

the game is very short, i finished it in 3 hours and still took my time playing, it only has one story line so you cant really replay it with out getting at least a bit bored, that being said the art and music is beautiful, the subtle lgbt rep is so nice and it is altogether a cute game, price is a bit steep for what it is so i suggest buying it on sale

Oisin mielelläni antanut täälle pelille peukun, mutta tähän hintaan peli on liian kallis. Vaikka peli on kaunis, rentouttava ja kaikin puolin hyvä siinä on pelattavaa vain muutamaksi tunniksi. Tämä peli on peliaikaan nähden alennuksessakin liian kallis.

I am hesitant to recommend this game -- don't get me wrong, it's a beautiful game. It tells the story of someone through moving from house to house, and it's super cute and cozy! Very calm, relaxing game; that being said, the price is just too much. I imagine that if you get all the stickers (the achievements), seeing as I already have more than half, there would be around 5 hours or less potential, tops. unless you move through very slowly or anything. 

If you catch this game on sale, especially if it's a good sale, grab it. It's a super cute game that can really calm you down and relax you. That being said it's more worth 5-10 dollars in my eyes, which is a whopping 75%-50% off! 

All that being said I absolutely adored this game and there is loads of praise to be said about it.

A relaxing game with a sound design that is borderline ASMR. Feels a bit too quick though, I hope the developers can expand on this quirky concept in the future, as obviously the fans are clamoring for some more.
Delightfully chill game.  The story and music are lovely.  I loved every minute of this game and was sad there weren't more levels.

포장된 박스를 열고 물건들을 정리하는게 전부인 게임!
풀프라이스론 조금 아쉽지만 할인할 떄 질러보면 괜찮은 듯함.

이 게임을 할 시간에 생활감 넘치는 내 방이나 치우는 게 더 생산성 있을 것 같지만 
이상하게 게임속 정리는 즐겁기만 하다.
소품 하나하나가 고유의 소리를 가지고 있고, 어떤 물건을 어디에 놓느냐에 따라 다른 소리가 난다.
나같은 디테일 변태가 환장할 요소라 의미없이 물건을 여기저기 놓아보는 재미가 쏘굿.

전체적인 스토리 라인은 분명히 존재하지만 따로 텍스트로 나오는게 아니라서
시간이 흐름에 따라 변하는 소지품들, 물건들의 올바른위치(?)등으로 유추해 볼 수 밖에 없는데
묘한 뭉클함을 주는 요소들이 꽤 있었다.


(스포주의)

이 게임을 구매할지말지 망설이게 했던.. 타 플레이어들의 부정적인 평가 중 하나는 
한 인물의 짐만 정리하는 것이라서 지루하다. 돈아깝다는 것이었는데 
(이사를 갈 때 새 물건만 나오는 게 아니라, 과거 물건들이 생활감만 추가된 상태로 계속 나온다.)

나는 오히려 그 부분이 소소한 감동요소라고 생각했다.
어린 한 아이가 학생이 되었다가 독립을하고, 이별과 만남을 지나 가정을 꾸리며 노년을 맞이하는 동안
어린 시절의 물건들이 지금의 나를 만들어 왔다는 메세지가 억지로 느껴지진 않았기 떄문이다.
"물건정리하는 쾌감을 느끼고 싶어!" 가 주된 구매목적이었다면, 분명 부정적일 수 있는 부분이지만..
정리 + 스토리 유추 를 주된 목적으로 했던 나는 굉장히 좋았다.
(플레이 전, 부정적인 리뷰들을 많이봐서 기대치가 낮아 가능했던 일일지도...모른다)

소소한 낙서의 종이와 크레파스들은 갈수록 전문적인 미술도구로 변화하고
타블렛으로 까지 발전하지만, 어린시절 그린 그림들은 여전히 방 한쪽에 보관되어있다.
한 두 권에서 시작한 그림연습장은 어느새... 책장 한 칸을 다 차지할정도로 많아지고 상패도 늘어난다.

어린시절 그렸던 낙서공책을 지금까지 소장하고 있는 나로서는 영 눈물나는 부분인 것이다 흑ㄹ흑흑...
"제발버려!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!" 라는 플레이어들의 평가를
현실 속 친구(혹은 가족)들에게 자주 들어왔던 나로서는...그렇다
주인공에게 공감과 연대감을 가질 수밖에,,,

그 물건들은,, 못 버려,, 그건 그 시간을 살았던 나 자신이란 말이다!!

이상... 부정적인 리뷰가 많아서 남겨보는 긍정적 리뷰였다.
+그치만, 확실히 볼륨대비 가격이 비싸게 책정된 것 같긴 하다. 디테일에 대한 연마비용이라고 생각은 하지만서도..
여튼, 또 구매할 의사 10000000% 있으니, DLC나 후속작... 내줬으면 좋겠다.

가보자고.

Игра в целом очень приятная. Есть моменты, когда начинает раздражать. Хорошая задумка. Из минусов - очень короткая. За 2-3 часа пройдете все и даже соберете все достижения. По большой скидке, рублей по 150 советую взять

If you have time to spare this game can fill few hours.
It has cool art style, good music, and wholesome story to go with it.
I can I highly recommend this one.

The story telling on this game is VERY good, small details can say everything and the soundtrack fits perfectly with every level
Worth saying that various parts almost made me cry cuz I related a little bit too much with the protagonist, and that ending was beautiful
I got it on sale but it's worth the full price even so, the whole library of sounds for the objects in each surface is a huge level of detail and the art is so well made, props to the devs
Relaxing game, with a surprisingly fun gameplay mechanic. Was fun to piece together the characters life from the clues you get when unpacking and observing the homes.

+ Very relaxing
+ You get to know the Narrator's story through the items you unpack. A very different way to tell about person and their life
+ Beautiful music
+ Awesome graphics and artwork
+ Cool hidden achievements, it's been fun to find them
+ Looking at the replays and gif exports is almost as satisfying as playing

- Short playtime. For this amount of money 4 hours of game time or 8 levels is very short. I'd hope for multiple different people and times
- Music, as beautiful as it is, gets repetitive
- Can't stack some items that I would stack if I was unpacking in real life (eg. can't put a plushie on top of a file box)
- Can't clean the dirty dishes in the roommate-level!
- The multiplying chickens are pain in the butt to arrange.

This is the best game I've played in years, and I don't put that lightly. Few games make me emotional and this one does that. Yes, this game is very short but well worth the price. It is thoughtful, nostalgic, heartfelt, and artistic.  Through each stage you learn about the person who you are unpacking for and deeply connecting with them with the decisions you make on where to place items. This game makes you think about your own life and the things you choose to keep and where you choose to place those things. It actually makes you FEEL as it would feel moving to these places in these situations. I found myself with greater empathy about people I share space with and their things as I played. It's hard to describe any more without spoiling things or playing the game yourself. 

I highly recommend this game - for anyone - regardless of their experience with games or what games they like to play. Get comfy, turn off everything else and immerse yourself in this beautiful work of art. 

If the creator or creators are reading this, I really want to give you a big hug after playing this. I needed this game in my life. <3

Very entertaining and great time killer. The subtle story is beautiful and a perfect touch. Only thing about it is it is not quite worth what it's selling for. Definitely buy it only when it's on sale, I got it for 17$ and finished the game in under 6 hours, do with that information what you will. Overall a very cute game and cool achievements.

I really enjoyed this game even thought I finished in 4 hours. And it brought back some nostalgia with the magnets on the fridge. It definitely had a 90's vibe. I'd love to see a DLC or a brand new game maybe with an 80's theme or a fantasy one. Idk how they would do it but I hope to play more games like this in the future.

100% wonderful! when i bought this, ill be honest i wasnt expecting to like it so very much. but i cant wait to play it again and again. i have a feeling this game will be a long term fave of mine, especially for those times when i just wanna chill but also creative. 
i didnt expect to get attached to the person we are unpacking for, but i did. the ending made me cry, i just love everything about this game.
i had fun streaming it to my friends and us giggling over funny places to store things. cant wait for my next play through where i try to get all the stickers!

Loved this!
I went in very skeptical.
Not sure why it was so relaxing/therapeutic, but it was.
And addicting too - time flew, and I was up past midnight both play sessions. (facepalm)
Now I just wish the game was longer!  I don't regret 6 hours of gameplay for the price, I just want more of this odd form of fun/satisfaction!  If more Unpacking content is released, I'll certainly buy it.

Highly recommended!

First and foremost, I absolutely loved this game. The story is so compelling and I loved seeing the progression of it unfold around me. There was a certain nostalgia in seeing items time and again when unpacking each new place, as well as a sadness about the things that stopped making an appearance. It was truly a fantastic game and I look forward to replaying it.

That being said: it's definitely very short. It took me a little over three hours to play it through and I definitely wasn't rushing. I know the devs have no plans on continuing the story, but I would love to see new stories from the world of Unpacking. We could meet various characters and learn their stories through the things they carry with them. I think that would keep the story fresh while also giving players more of this beautiful world. The game truly filled me with a lot of emotion and it really goes to show just how talented the creators are. I hope that they choose to revisit and add to this world. I know I would play it, and judging from the reviews, a lot of other people would too.

Very enjoyable little game with many heartfelt moments. Though it is very short in its playtime, id still say that it is worth the buy. Had a good time all together! I only wish that it was longer or that there was more content coming. Should be more in the 5-10 dollar range imo, but the quality as wonderful. beautiful graphics and super immersive story line. If you like cozy games, this is one to add to your collection! :)

I loved every minute of this game. It's truly a touching game and it's very captivating and calming. 
Saying that I bawled throughout would be an understatement. It's portrayed in such a touching way. 
Truly makes you think about life and hardships and also success. 

Now. Having said that, the game does have one major flaw. 
It's only roughly 3 hours of in game playtime. And that's it. 
I was under the impression that the 3 "Books" would at least provide different stories, but they are just the saves. 
Realistically, t's the most expensive game I've ever bought in terms of the gameplay you get per hour. 
It wouldn't be *that* hard to add in more stories from the resources that are already there and that's why I would highly reccommend that you get this game ONLY when it's on sale.

Such a cute game. I love how the story unfolds through context clues, like items becoming more broken, and dull. Old toys we bring with us the entire time getting dirty then patched up. it was so relaxing finding a place for every little object. The art is wonderful and the music is top tier cozy.

If you're debating on getting this game, GET IT!! It's adorable!! I love how there's a story line, even without words. It's adorable, and such a cute way to pass the time! It took me around 3 hours to complete the game. I highly recommend :)

This game is AMAZING.  Perfect for someone who loves organizing and decorating stuff (like the Sims or House Flipper) without having to manage any people or money.  It's so relaxing along with the music.  The story is amazing and emotional just from what we unpack from our character's life.  I wish there was more!

Pretty chill game. If you are looking for a way to distract yourself for a while and follow a story; I recommend playing this game. I do think the game is a bit pricey for the length of it but still a nice play.

This game is probably the most relaxing game you could play. It was really fun to be able to learn about the character just by the contents of their boxes. I think I will end up replaying this game over and over, which is unusual for me.
beautiful art style, i loved the lore and didnt expect to tear up after watching the credits. i got the happy ending i wished for. big thanks to the devs. ♥
The game was super good but expensive for 3 hours playtime, i hope more rooms come in future as its such a nice game but makes it a bit of a shame

Muito bom o jogo n zerei ainda mas estou adorando jogo muito bem feito vale o preco dele muito bom para passar o tempo recomendo muito comprar o jogo e perfeito e muito relaxante mas apenas recomendo se vc tem paciencia

Really relaxing game to play, with a great soundtrack! The story of the main character being told through the belongings they bring from move to move was a really good idea, and it had a really nice ending and the music in the credits was a nice was to end the game!

Such a great cozy game. The story line is pretty deep and as you play, it makes you think about whoever's stuff you are unpacking and what they were going through. Got slight motion sickness when I was flashing from room to room, but I didn't care too much.

It is honestly a really good game! But it only has 4-3 hours of game play. I got it fro about $16. So about $5.50 per hour of gameplay, which is a decent rate, but i expected more gameplay for something i payed for. It was super fun, but you cant sqeeze more levels out of it. Maybe if the developers put more levels, it would be better.

When I bought the game I was actually just looking for something to do on the side, to keep my hands busy. I went in thinking that it was just about unpacking... Well, I mean, it is about unpacking but you also follow along with the life of the main character (who's things you are meticulously putting away) and the different places they move to, piecing together the story together one carefully placed trinket at a time. I became totally engrossed and in the end it wound up not being something I just did on the side. I actually played through the whole thing in one sitting. There was a lot of care put into this game, and it shows. Unpacking is one of those games where I wish I could experience it fresh again from the beginning.

(Also it's a wholesome piece of wlw media <3)

For the most part it is a very soothing game. The only time i got frustrated was when i could'nt figure out where one item was supposed to go and spent 10 minutes trying to figure it out. 8/10 good game

A simple premise for a game with a heartwarming story. Playing this game helps me calm down so much and the story of it brings tears to my eyes. I recommend this for anyone who enjoys decorating and repetitive tasks. There is plenty of replay value especially if you didn't get all the stickers the first time around.
A wonderfully comfy game with a surprisingly touching storyline. Highly recommend even just to spend a few hours relaxing with.

Schönes, kleines Spiel wo man sich einfach mal zeit nehmen kann.
Zwar ist das Spiel etwas Kurz, das gleicht sich aber mit der schönen Geschichte, sowie der erstaunlich detaillierten details pro Gegenstand wieder aus

This game was surprisingly emotional, and very therapeutic. I found that moving into new places is a clever and moving way to tell this life story. The only thing that bothered me was how short the game was - I wish there were more levels :) I'd give it a 4/5

A delightful and heartwarming game. I enjoyed every moment of it. It was incredibly satisfying unpacking this person's belongings and getting to know them—and also seeing how they changed through the years. Now that it's over I'll miss them. I wish it had lasted longer. :)

This is an adorable little game that was really cute and emotional to get through. however, I was expecting more than 1 story line or packing experience due to the multiple album choices.. it would be cute if different story lines happen or gender selections could be made eventually? and for it's price and the time it takes to get through, a little pricey.. hopefully the Devs do more with it :)

作為有整理癖好的人非常喜歡，有能力購入就立即購入了。
個人認為音效做得很細節，一些不能看出來的物品都依賴不同的音效來判斷。
喜歡把成就在游戲中以貼紙來表現的這一點，也很喜歡結束關卡後的快速播放，聽著敲擊音效回顧思路很有趣。

還有很多喜歡的地方，但覺得還是自己去體會比較好，希望大家都能來玩玩看。
(最好帶著舒展的心去玩，愿您能獲得一些時光的安寧。)
Satisfied my itch to bring order into the chaos and create a nice and tidy space. The graphics are very cute and pretty. I just wish the game was a bit longer.
This game has no dialogue or even characters and yet it is one of the most emotionally resonant games I've ever played. I almost cried three times while playing. Highly recommend.

I bought the game on sale for $16 yesterday. Although I was worried about the reported short gameplay experience, I finished the game in 6 hours. Do I wish it was longer? Of course! I would love another story or DLC to experience again. But I expected it to be much shorter than it was and was pleasantly  surprised by it! It's a chill game and I plan on replaying it today with the option to place items anywhere I want this time!

Very relaxing cute little game, also has a story to it which I wasn't expecting. I like the graphics and the mechanics of just picking things up and putting them wherever you want. I wish the game would allow you to keep anything anywhere but I guess it makes sense why they don't
I absolutely LOVED this game! It was so satisfying to unpack the boxes and put everything away. I loved the subtle story. I hope there's another game like this soon! It was so much fun!!

I was delightfully surprised by this game! 

I was a little hesitant about it when I first saw it, mainly based on the price and a few reviews. It seemed the game would be rather short, which it is... BUT it's worth it honestly! It's such a relaxing and charming little game. The graphics are beautifully nostalgic. When I first booted up the game, I felt like a little kid again back in the 90s playing some of my first PC games with the cartoon-ish art style, and clicking on a book to type my name in.

If you're looking for a casual game to just get lost in, then you'll definitely enjoy this game! Don't let the price tag or any reviews steer you away. Play and decide for yourself!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sn5mfl32ccw
Yes its short but its a full fledged game, interesting story telling and a fun game mechanic, if your into sorting and organizing things your gonna have fun.

I kinda got emotionally invested, even if it was only for 2.9 hours of gameplay. I would have wanted the story to continue for at least 2 more levels, but it was pretty good anyway. As I think, you already saw, lots of reviews are about the price, but it's not like you are obligated to play the game.

author.personaname: Mandy Menus von und zu Menü

reviews.review:
Ein sehr süßes und liebevoll gestaltetes Spiel.
Man entspannt sich, regt sich hier und da auf und erfreut sich an allen möglichen Details.

Ich habe die wenigen Stunden Spielzeit vollends genossen und wünsche mir sehnlichst ein Add-On oder Update oder was auch immer...irgendwas, um mehr zu haben, als 2 schöne Nachmittage (ansonsten wären die 20 Euro wirklich sehr happig).

Fun and relaxing.  Music is soothing.  There's a sweet story line and lots of references to IRL things.  The playback once you finish the game is hypnotic.  Only downside is the length of the game for the price.  Got it on a small sale and still thought that was a bit pricey for the amount of content.  However, I think the developers did a great job with what was given.  If you want something to just chill out to, this is perfect.

Unpacking is a gorgeous game in both story and style. The story was told in a brilliant fashion that I haven't really experienced before. The art is very pretty. Overall the game-play is relaxing and so is the soundtrack. Though short, Unpacking is sweet and full of so many little details that are so easy to appreciate. I really recommend it to anyone who likes games like Assemble with Care as this is very reminiscent of that.

可愛到心花怒放的遊戲體驗。現實在家都沒有自己的房間，玩了這個遊戲大大滿足我想要有自己空間的夢想和慾望。在開箱擺放主角物品的過程中，還能觀察到很多細節去推敲出劇情的走向。美術超棒不多說，每件物品都有屬於自己的音效，放在不同材質的表面音效也會有變化、櫃子沒關好拉門還會卡住關不起來，實在是感受到製作團隊滿滿的用心😍。可惜遊戲時間不長，大約三小時內可以結束。希望有更多支線或是新的劇情更新。但還是很推😭❤️從空空的房間，到滿滿雜物充滿自己收納特色的家，很有成就感之外，也超級療癒👍 👍❤️

i cried its so good i highly recommend like over and over again i cant with till their are more story lines to play the amount of detail is amazing for example she has the mouse pad that shows when she first moves out then when the next part its the same mouse pad but worn out and you can see its been used

Super fun and addicting!! I've played it 3 times in the past 4 days!!! It's so fun and despite not ever seeing the characters, the plot that goes with it is so adorable and amazing! I 100% recommend it
画风很可爱，有很多细节可以挖掘。房间主人挺恋旧的哈，有些东西十多年也没换过。整体而言流程实在太短了，希望后续能加些关卡，可以搞个新的故事线什么的。

I am someone who notoriously hates moving and packing/unpacking. This was the most relaxed and happiest I have been helping someone move. A lovely game that successfully tells its story without a single word (or even seeing our character). Short and sweet, definitely recommended for anyone needing a little break from life.

Short but utterly beautiful game. I'm a naturally sentimental person, so watching the character's personality grow with time, keep mementos from their past, and carry on through good and bad was very touching to me, and doing it all without dialogue is a feat. With one moment, I was so emotionally effected I had to pause to recollect myself. I completely adore this game.
Super fun, great story even without dialogue or character designs! Unfortunately pretty short but overall a wonderful, relaxing game.

Pairings: French-press coffee, old stickers, retro games, a review of your DeviantArt favorites from ten years ago.

Use a text for college classes studying thing theory or sense of place.

Sweet, delightful, and relaxing!  Satisfying, naturalistic sound design and a soothing 8-bit soundtrack, plus super-intuitive mouse-only controls make this a pleasing game for experienced gamers and newbies alike.  Great naturalistic representation, too.

Unpacking is a game that will give you feelings, tell a story, and generally let you just vibe, while saying very little at all. You feel the protagonist's struggles and triumphs, while having very little idea who they truly are, giving you alot of room to create your own narrative. This might just be the best story driven relaxation game I've played.

The game is short but for reasons I can't explain, this little game has fixed my heart a bit.
There really is a healing vibe through the boxes we unpacked, each object placed is satisfactory.

relatively short game (clocked in 5hrs total w/ 100% completion) but has replayability and a very relaxing vibe if that's the sort of thing you're into :) 

possibly not worth the price for some and may be better off waiting for it to go on sale if this is the case (which is what i did after seeing people mention how many hours of gameplay there was)

This was such a cute and heartwarming little game. It was fun to play, and it spoke volumes without saying a word at all. Only took about 3 hours to finish a playthrough, sadly, I wish there was more because it was such a wonderful experience.

It's a very fun and relaxing a game, the only downside is that you can't really place things anywhere you want unless you configure it in the settings. The ending was surprisingly heartwarming. Would definitely recommend!

Beautiful environmental story telling. Really relaxing and zen putting things away.
It is a short game, maybe 3/4 hours if you take your time and I'm not sure it has too much re-playability.

So relaxing and nice, but quite short! The first playthrogh takes about 4h, but you can always spend more time on it by doing it again and trying to get all the achievments. But I'd buy it only on sale, unless you reeeeally love the artstyle. But I'm glad i bought it, just wishing for more albums <3

I was looking for a calm game with vibes, like A short hike, and after finally buying this it was not actually even that calming, as some parts got tricky and the whole story was short. 

But, I did not refund as either way I got into it for over 2 hours, for the story got cute, and there's still the last house to furnish, so not bad. The Tetris-like refilling of boxes and shelves actually made it even better. And I hope I will want to play it again, trying to find the achievements, or just some change~

Cute little puzzle game about moving your life around over the years and the changes that come with it, cute graphics, lovely music.

A fun, short, time passer, worth playing (especially if you get it on sale).

its a relaxing, albeit a short, game. had an enjoyable time with unpacking the rooms and enjoyed the story too.
a little sad that its this short, but thats just life sometimes.
Adorable, therapeutic game for anyone with OCD tendencies. Cute story unfolds as you unpack boxes at various stages through life. Bit pricey for a game that takes about 2 hours to finish though

I enjoyed playing this game, finished it in just a couple of hoours. Had fun reading thru other people's perspective on each level. The downside is the price is a bit high for a game you can finish right away.

I really like it. Hopefully They add some DLC or something in the future. Maybe another story line for someone else? I love these relaxing cozy games. Definitely not worth $20 so get it on sale. If there was more content then it would be worth the price.

Cool game, it told a story with no words, I didn't expect that. Pixel art is life.

I was unpacking my soul LOL so many things the character unpacked, that I also own and regularly move. It was relatable and I was proud as heck to see every move she got new copics or better art supplies. :') Then I was sad when she went through the evident breakup and moved back home, with somber music in the background. I might've cried a little for the (again relatable) pain of that. I do wish there was a little replay-ability since there's two other albums but I don't plan on repacking the same girl's life anytime soon.

All in all, I do recommend it, I adored the wordless storytelling, the pixel art, and was tickled pink to unpack all those art supplies I too have. LGTBQ people will love the heck out of this for sure...
I enjoyed this for it's puzzle and story aspect. There is barely any dialogue but it's a surprisingly thoughtful experience as you consider what the main character is going through.

I have played a variety of video games, and have enjoyed a lot of them, but this is the first game that had me playing non-stop. The story was adorable, the touches of nostalgia were perfect, and the game itself was extremely satisfying. My only complaint is that there is not more to unpack! Thank you for making such an awesome game.
This game is really cute! I actually love organizing and decorating so this seemed like the perfect game, especially with it's aesthetic and calm vibes. Definitely recommend.

More of a interactive story than a game but its a GREAT story, and you really start to feel like you are glimpsing into somebody's life.

Won't lie, i cried at the end of it.

Aslında biraz kısa sürüyor gibi geldi, dün başladım bugün bitti ama keyifli vakit geçirdim. Oyun tekrar tekrar oynanabilir, farklı yerleştirme kombinasyonları denenebilir. Ortalamanın üstünde bir deneyimdi diyebilirim, insanı rahatlatan kolay bir oynanış şekli var.

There's a different sound effect for putting your item on the floor, the toilet, the glass table, the wooden table, the bed, etc. 
Now that is [b]PEAK[/b] gaming.

Also shoutout to the little references and gimmick items in the game, makes it feel a bit more 'real' :)

A fun, little game to play around with. Did find it frustrating at times, but that's 'cause I'm a perfectionist & I've come to realise in later terms that I think I was meant to get frustrated at those parts. It made me connect more to the story and taught me to appreciate it more.
Highly recommended if you're just looking for a game to play on a Sunday morning while you drink your tea/coffee!

nice，比较惬意。
也注意到了人与人之间的习惯差别，有些东西见都没见过，桌垫当地毯之类的行为也屡见不鲜，我说怎么地毯还能合体成大地毯。
短小精悍，在耐心刚刚下降时通关了，可以说把握的死死的。
有回放功能，快速过一遍挺爽。
像素差点意思，光照效果有点拉，像素艺术的上限一点也不低，假如把室内场景做的再好看一点就完美了

i really enjoyed this game a lot, and i'd recommend it to anyone else who is into the sims, power washing simulator, etc. I loved the pixel art graphics and everything was adorable. I am upset with the lack of hours this game has. at this point i've beaten the game, and even though i bought it on sale, $15 still feels a bit much to me for the lack of hours. i think this could be easily solved with some free dlc adding another persons story to unpack, but you are only given one and theres only so many ways to unpack the same stuff. i really loved this game so much but i wouldn't recommend at full price. half price would probably be the best to get your moneys worth, though i really enjoyed it so i don't regret paying almost full price.

A calm, zen game with a lovely story told very simply through unpacking boxes. It was a bit short, but so cute!

Un jeu calme et très zen dont l'histoire est racontée tout simplement au travers les déménagements. Un peu court mais tellement adorable!

Despite short playtime for a pricey game, It was very heartwarming. A mellow story put into moving and scenery, this game deserves more credit than given. People complain about short playtime for a game that expensive. In the game's defense Imagine how much effort was put into all the pixels of the game. Or the song writing at the end. Every bit of this game is beautiful.
아기자기하고 집정리를 하는 맛이 있다. 분위기도 귀여워서 최고이지만 새로운 인물로 분량이 추가되거나 DLC라도 내줬으면 좋겠다.

I'm in love with this game, unpacking the boxes and getting to put everything away neatly and I love the story. Definitely recommend this game to anyone who loves a cute, wholesome story and also loves sort of puzzle-like games. It's not a very long game but I honestly love going back and redoing it over and over just for the fun of it. Also, the cute stuffed animals are amazing and really debating getting a bunch of small stuffed animals now.

There's something so familiar about the little things that follow our character from place to place. I adore this. 

As an adult who moved every 2-3 years of my childhood, this game said a lot. Reminded me of many, many years, new places, and tons of boxes to be broken down.

This game is well worth the cost! My little storytelling mind enjoys fitting the pieces of the story together through the objects I interact with. The game never tells you outright what is happening which I absolutely love! I'm three hours in and there is still more for me to discover!!

I would totally recommend this game to anyone and I mean anyone, because this game is just heartwarming and lovely. The game is just not about unpacking stuff, you are literally unpacking a story as you play and it is just amazing. The story is just lovely and sweet.

Le jeu est très relaxant, l'histoire est assez mignonne et comme c'est un jeu de rangement, chaque partie est différente du moment que l'on range  les choses d'une autre façon ! 
Après, si vous êtes du genre à vouloir un jeu à longue durée, ce n'est pas le cas de ce jeu : une fois toutes les pièces rangées, tout les stickers récoltés, il n'y a rien d'autre à faire...
Il faudrait peut être ajouter des histoires, créer des nouvelles personnes selon l'album qu'on choisit pour avoir un panel de choix encore plus grand, ça serait génial ^^

The story telling in this game is really great. It isn't a typical straight-forward story. You have to connect the pieces of a person's story (life) by what you are unpacking and decorating the house. You only get a one sentence "explanation" of what that moment in this person's life is. A slice of their life. Another piece of the story. The music gives subtle hints about the situation unfolding by setting the mood. Overall, it is a very visually pleasing game. I haven't finished the game but it definitely makes me want to keep playing to find out more about this person's story.
Cosy and relaxing game but feel like having more stories would work well as it is quite a short game and can be finished within a few hours

kinda mad i bought it like 2 days before it went on sale lol but i think it was worth it at full price ! i would still love to see more content added to it in the future but i got a good 4 hours of playtime with just the og levels, and i expect to get quite a few more while playing without forced placement

i think this game is really good and i really didn't think the story would be as good as it truly was it was so fun to go through each of the rooms as the character grows up and has a family, it's really fun that there are limitless places to put things where you wouldn't even think of putting things.

A very relaxing yet addictive game. It tells a heartbreaking and heartwarming story through the use of images alone. The art style can go from cute, warm and soft to stark, dreary and sad t he next. The music that comes with it is beautiful and tugs at your heart. combined the music, colouring and imagery really paints the picture well.

It can replayed many times and the stickers (achievements) you collect only encourage you to replay again and again to find them, sometimes in the most surprising and funny ways. I highly recommend this game to anyone who loves in depth story and puzzle solving, for anyone who doesn't want a stressful game and just wants to relax for a few hours.
I finished all of the game and i love it. it really calms me down when im like rly stressed out or something so this is rly a nice game. def gon play again to try and get all the stickers hehehehe.
This game is super adorable. I sat down and played the full game in one go. It's a little spendy, but definitely an adorable game!

I'm a huge fan of 'unusual' puzzle games, and this was right up my alley from the start. I was excited to see what was new or different in each stage, and it was so fun seeing little bits of earlier stages work themselves into the later ones. Plus I was just goofing around at certain points and ended up getting an achievement from it. I always appreciate games encouraging nonsense.

The story itself was shorter than I expected, but very sweet. I found myself getting attached to certain details and 'characters' throughout, and the ending was nice, but a little abrupt. I'd love to see later updates with more added to the story, or maybe additional characters/stories could be added later? As the game stands now I can definitely see myself continuing to replay to pick up the stickers/achievements I missed, and just to enjoy the chill vibes.

If you're like me and have actual legit OCD that's soothed by organizing, this is basically free therapy. (Except it's not please go to an actual therapist if you feel you would benefit from that kind of thing.) Highly recommend.

This is such a cozy game! I played it in between classes and school work when I needed to calm down. I really enjoyed the art style and music; additionally, I'm an early 2000s kid so seeing old technology or video game systems I grew up with was very fun. Overall, 10/10, simple game but very enjoyable for something relaxing!

so fun and calming. highly reccomend to anyone and all ages. the detail in this game is crazy. I also loved figuring out things about the character and what they like. for example, the little figurines that they get when everytime they go on trips and bring them to every apartment/house they live in is such a cute idea.
I really enjoyed playing and recommend to anyone who wants that chill and relaxing vibe. I love the style of the game and how you can be creative in each room.

very chill vibes! I love that you follow the same persons life throughout.
The game can stop you from putting items in certain places, but you can turn this off in Accessibility settings (this does effect the "story"/puzzle aspect, but if you just wanna chill and unpack turn it off)

This game was so peaceful to play. The underlying story line aspect was a great way to keep the player interested throughout. My only complaint is for a game that costs as much as Unpacking does there is only about 3 hours of play time. I do hope in the future the creators will make more stories and levels to lengthen the game and give more variety.
Absolutely loved this game! It's amazing how much story could get told just by seeing what a character owns, I adored watching this character grow and build a home!

Amo este juego es muy relajante pero realmente corto. Y si por cada álbum te da la opción de elegir otra historia? Serian otras habitaciones y mucha variedad porque sino llega a ser aburrido. Podrían hacer tipo de unos gemelos o algo así eso valdría el precio que tiene el juego. Un saludo.

This game is a lot of fun and is a nice chill game, but I don't think it's worth the price. For $20 bucks I would hope it would be a bit longer of a game. I finished the game after 3 hours with all achievements. But overall fun.

Pacing is great, music is relaxing, achievements are fun! I couldn't wait for it to be on sale before buying it (bought it full price) and while I'm not sure if it's completely worth doing that, it's definitely a fun game and I don't mind supporting the developers by doing so.
10/10 will be coming back to this game to fill in another album!
I liked this game. It was very satisfying. Wish there were more lives to unpack in this game. It is definitely not worth the price. Finished it in a couple hours.

First thing to say is, that this game is really good & super relaxing to play BUT it's extremely short and the price is absolutely not worth the length of the game! 

If you like, short relaxing games I would definitely recommend, but would wait for it to come up in a sale, it's worth £10 at best...unless the devs add to it (which they've said on Twitter they have no plan to).
I truly love this game, but only wish that there was DLC that was an expansion or different albums with different layout environments. I'll replay this a million times until then lol.

It is a relatively short game but it is also a very clever and sweet game. In the 10 hours I have on this game at the time of writing this, I have fully completed the game twice, got all achievements, and even got halfway through a third play through with no illegally placed items to make it how I'd want it. The story is very sweet and takes you through the different stages of life, and I love how the hints of what is happening are purely based on clues you get by what you unpack, where you move, and who you move in with. Overall, I would 100% recommend it to friends that love a short, sweet, charming, and re-playable puzzle games.
its a fun game that is cozy and calming, some stages can be somewhat frustrating but for reasons that would resonate with the character

I love this game but there isnt much content. I feel like the game could have been longer. its nice its relaxing but i feel like more needs to be added to the game.

changed to recomended because of how often i replay it

I really love this game. The graphics are perfect, the music is really nice, and it's very relaxing. The story is quite nice too, and I really like how they tell it without dialogue - feels much more personal. Like others have said, it is quite short - personally, I don't mind that, but I can see how it could be a drawback for others. 

I hope we get more games like this!

Talented, brilliant, incredible, amazing, show stopping, spectacular, never the same, totally unique, completely not ever been done before, unafraid to reference or not reference, put it in a blender, ♥♥♥♥ on it, vomit on it, eat it, give birth to it.

I was absolutely not prepared for it to end, my heart is in pieces, I need a 2nd game asap.

I absolutely loved this game more than I thought I would. It's such a cozy and relaxing game and I loved the storyline. It was the simple details from room to room that really pulled this game altogether. You uncover so much of the main character's personality and interests through their items and the game does an excellent job of portraying the different aspects of life that most of us go through as we grow up. I totally recommend this game for anyone still on the fence about playing it.

Honestly, even though it is overpriced, it is still a very fun game! I can see myself playing this again and again without boredom. Also, the fact that they added different album lines depending on which room you saved the stage in is a nice touch!
It's a good game and is remarkable in the fact it can tell a story without words. However it is very very short. I just wish there were more levels to unpack!
Eins der besten Spiele, die ich je gespielt habe. Unglaublich süß gestaltet und die Story ist auch unglaublich. 10 von 10 Sternen.

This game is honestly so emotional. The first time I played it I cried twice, and then teared up again the second time round. For saying it's a 'puzzle game' it is so moving. I don't get how but it is. Learning more about the character and sort of seeing through their perspective is just amazing. I love the graphics, I'm not sure why but it's just so cute in a way? I definitely recommend for people who love a good teary moment when playing a game. :)

It needs more. It needs MOOOOOOORE!! Otherwise the price is a bit hefty. It's a quick and relaxing game to play while listening to a podcast or something. But buy it on sale...! I'm gonna need more apartments to decorate!

It's a really cute design, a well thought mechanic, I really recommend this game!
Maybe 20$ is a little bit much but if the game ever gets a second story and/or any additional content it would be well worth it!

its such a cute game! its helped a lot with my anxiety! the amount of inclusion that this game has is also really amazing, we need more games like this one that represents many groups of people as being a normal part of society. Would definitely have a look if you're intrigued, it's worth it!
The negative thing is theres no different stories...when I finish a book, the next one should be a whole different enviorment, with different scenes, etc

This game is relaxation and a puzzle mind game all in one. The two factors of the game just flow so well together. Its a puzzle game that gets your mind working but without having to look up Youtube tutorials. the game's soundtrack is just so peaceful and it gives me a very welcoming feeling. One thing about this game that you might want to think about is.. i only had to play for a few hours before completing it. and i personally don't mind it too much. I enjoyed myself while playing. But it is a shorter game than most, and i wish there was a little more content to play. But overall i give this game a 9 out of 10! I recommend buying this game if your feeling stressed.

I felt a little bored at the beginning, but as I continued to play, I found it more and more interesting (one main reason is that I didn't know about the hidden achievement at the beginning). It's a relaxing and fun game, not expensive, and it won't cost you much time. If you want to have a rest in a short time period, I'd recommend it. (Trying not to look at solutions online, and exploring more by yourself might make your game voyage more enjoyable!)

I saw someone react to the LGBT representation of the game and had to get it - I wasn't disappointed! I can see myself replaying this a few times because of how calming it is and also how relatable. I really hope the developers recognise how much the representation contained in the game means to people like me - the fact that the couple are represented in such a casual way is so refreshing to see. Fingers crossed that they plan on coming out with more! I'd love to see all kinds of couples, friendships, singles and more! The subtle storytelling through the game is fantastic, especially in the first apartment we move into - how some of our own items, like the graphics tablet and art supplies, have to be put aside - and when we need to move back into our childhood home. Just wonderful and realistic! Thank you, devs, and know what I and a lot of others would love to see more of this game!

if you enjoy a somewhat puzzle experience i would recommend  this for you, the graphics are pretty and while the game is short spanning around 2-3 hours, you'll enjoy unpacking items and placing them into your home, a 10/10 game
