This game is incredibly relaxing while managing to remain interesting enough to tug at the heartstrings. Following the main character's journey through heartbreak and troubles to finally finding her peace and building a family is a beautiful experience.

I really like this game, I had played through the demo a couple time and have played through the full version after I bought it 3 times. It's a very cute game and very relaxing. As someone who is far from a neat or organized person in real life there is something very soothing about neatly organizing the life of the person in the game. I do find in frustrating that some items just can't go in certain spots even if in real life they could. I do find the feelings I got from certain levels interesting. The roommates level annoyed me the first time as I didn't like the fact I just kinda had to shove my stuff in with other people's. All I could think is this is how I lose out on a bunch of my household items (while I wasn't wrong) that had nothing on moving in with the boyfriend. That level just feels so icky, your diploma is stuck having to go under the bed, anytime I had to move any of his things to fit mine I just felt like I was intruding in his perfectly manicured, modern, bachelor pad.  The later levels when you have to make space for someone else feel so much nicer, it feels good to do what others didn't do for you in the earlier levels and have areas cleared out and filled with the other person's things, and finding the right spots to blend our items together vs. well this will only really fit here so I guess I'll have to put it with their stuff.

I do think the price is a little high for the amount of content. I wish there were more levels, I also slightly wish there was some way to change it up more on the items you unpack and go with you from level to level. If I shoved certain items in the cupboard as a kid I probably don't care for having those items with me in college and so on and so forth. I honestly would love for this game to get a sequel with the players maybe getting some further options on deciding what items go with you to the next level, and maybe different level branches on who you live with and such, if would be a lot more complex but I think if would add some more flavor. I'd also love little stats at the end of X% kept all the plushies on the bed ever level or whatever.

Overall I love this game for what it is, but if you don't want a game that can be played through in one sitting for the price, I'd hold off and/or wait for a sale.

It's a beautiful game really.

[h1]Recommended for the cozy gamers![/h1]

It's definitely a quick game that you can burn in no time, given my time of 5 hours. However, if you're the type who likes storytelling games and displayed in a different manner, I find this to be up your alley. The game is heavily reliant on inferring about the events that happens between moving into each room. So phases through life, relationships, school, and being on your own. You'll find it here.

There's nothing intensive about the game and there will be items you're not certain belongs where, but it's the beauty of organization. Albeit not the way we would in real life. A lot of repeated items will appear and if you zoom in you can kinda make out some Easter eggs of gaming consoles and book covers. These can help you decipher what bundles up with what. Most items are unpacked in the correct place to begin with, to some exceptions in other places. But the game doesn't expand rooms immediately, so take your time!

Again I recommend it if you're a cozy kinda gamer. It's my first run and I'll probably return just to 100% the discoverable items.

Amazing game, so touching comforting and what a peaceful journey. Only wish there are more story line or game path to play.

Dit spel is ontzettend leuk, het is altijd een verrasing wat er uit de doos komt :) zeker een aanrader! er is maar een ding wat ik echt heel jammer vind, en dat is dat je hem heel erg snel hebt uitgespeeld. was binnen 5 uurtjes al klaar met alle levels.

One of the best ASMR like games out there. Pleasant story, it's nice to see the evolution of the character through the years and how life change, new relationships, new goals and milestones.

A lot of easter eggs and little interactions you can do in the game, from Zelda Game Cube games to Donnie Darko DVD, at first glance seems a very simple and straightforward games, and it's, but with you look closer, you can found a lot of good stuff hidden in there.

PS: nice to see she never gave up the little mug that after becomes a toothbrush holder and the chicken the gets a new children every year

Chillout game with a really calming and nostalgia-inducing soundtrack.
At 20$ maybe not the "best bang for the buck" in case of playtime though.

Also very interesting to watch other people on twitch/yt play this to harshly judge their interior design decisions. 
Which is what I mostly did, as you can see by my playtime. :<

Played it for free on Xbox Gamepass and found it so heartwarming and beautiful that I purchased it on steam for another playthrough. A wholesome game that subtly takes you through the protagonist's story. Definitely recommend playing it!

This is such a charming game. It hit particularly close to home, as someone whose life and interests mirror the main character's- there were definitely things I could relate to, both funny and bittersweet. I received the game as a gift, and looking at the price now it does seem short for the value. I wish there were more content, perhaps following different characters through the changes in their lives. But overall I enjoyed it and hope to see more.

Unpacking is a cute lil game that I love to play whenever I wanna relax and organize stuff. It gives me that satisfaction when everything is put away neatly almost the way I want it to be. It gives you lots of options to place items and it also tells you a story without actually telling you.
I really enjoyed going through this game and going through the life of the person your un-packing for. It's amazing how much of a story you can get out of such a simple concept.
A fun, calming game that has the player follow a story line of life and heartbreak and all life has to offer.

A chill game about moving house and unpacking stuff as you progress through the MC's life. It helps to pat close attention to the small details and sounds to put everything where it should go. I really appreciated the little things in this game :D

This game tells a very simple story through the gameplay of unpacking boxes as you move into a new living space. It starts out with minimal boxes and small rooms until you are unpacking an entire household, getting frustrated that the towels were packed with the shoes for some reason. Super fun and quick, great soundtrack and has a super interesting story if you pay attention to details as you unpack. Totally recommend, support the creators
I loved this game. It has a subtle way of telling a story through unpacking a womans stuff. It was cute and the music was pleasant. Wish there was a few more levels but overall amazing.

I really enjoyed this game! It was both engaging and relaxing. I have also attached a lot to the main character's story. The sad part is that it was quite short. I wish there will be added more levels or new stories.

Jogo muito bom, trilha sonora bem gostosinha e criação totalmente criativa, nos dá a liberdade de arrumarmos as coisas exatamente do jeito que quisermos. A arte do jogo é muito bonita e bem feita. Apresenta alguns bugs, mas nada que seja tão terrível na gameplay, tive que reiniciar algumas vezes, mas entendo que é um jogo recém lançado. A história é simples e bonita. Gostaria apenas que o jogo fosse mais longo, pois eu realmente amei passar o tempo jogando ele. Espero que futuramente saia alguma expansão incluindo talvez mais um "mapa" ou uma outra história. Parabéns aos desenvolvedores e eu recomendo bastante esse jogo. <3

Nice, low pressure relaxing game. Attractive pixel art style, and relaxing music. It is a mobile game, but works well enough on a desktop.
My only complaints are: 
Sometimes it I can't identify what the object is. Some things have to go in certain places, but if you can't tell what it is, you are left guessing.
Although finding virtual places for virtual items is fun, I have plenty of real things that I should be finding places for.
游戏很温馨，休闲娱乐很不错。美中不足的是流程太短定价过高，速度快的人完全可以在退款时限前玩通关。不建议在不打折的情况下购买。

At first, this is just a little put-stuff-where-you-want chill out game. Soon, you realise you're going through a story, learning about the character and what she's like, seeing what happens to her and what she achieves. There are ups and downs in an emotional story, and you feel like you know her. It isn't her whole life, don't worry; you won't be unpacking into the old people's home. I played through, looked at the sticker/badges and thought, I have to play through again and see what I missed.
很治愈的一款游戏~里面的彩蛋也很有意思哦，就是游戏体量有点少，推荐打折入手👍期待官方推出dlc啊！

This game is extremely relaxing to play and I do love the small story that unfolds through the years. However, I really can't justify $30AUD for 3 hours of gameplay. I'm really hoping for more to be added.

really adorable game. queer friendly, inclusive characters, disabled characters. cute heart warming story too (no explicit story, but easy to pick up from context clues) 

really frustrating at a few parts for how picky it can be sometimes but overall great game
잔잔하고 힐링으론 좋아요!! 물건들을 다 놓고나면 틀린위치에 놓인것들은 빨간색 테두리로 알려주는데 그게뭔지 잘 몰라서 좀 헤멨고 나중에 업데이트할때 스토리도 같이해줬으면 좋겠어요! 왠지 모르게 좀 짧다고 느껴진다랄까?

Neat little puzzle solving, indie developed game. While I agree with a lot of people that the levels feel really short, strongly suggest replaying them all and trying different ways to solve each chapter. Right clicking on certain objects may reveal some cool little details and easter eggs! 

If you're looking for a game to just play and relax on, this is a great title to do so. Wren, the creative art director, and her team put sooo much love into this project, they're active in their Discord and love interacting with their community too- just a great indie team that I hope to see more titles with stories like this.

Its a bit pricy for the play time but its very effective to relax a bit, I loved guessing what happened in each stage to the person that lived there and it was heartwarming to see them grow and build a family. I liked the little secret you can do, it add some charm to it. I would say there is not a huge replay value because lot of the stuff you place have to be on a specific place so you can't decorate as you would like to. Overall I had a good time playing this game but I would recommend you buy it on sale, I bought it full price only because I was impatient.

Très bon jeu, le game design est ultra beau, l'histoire est vraiment cool, la musique n'est pas relou. Les placements manquent un peu de possibilités mais dans l'ensemble il y a tellement de trucs à placer qu'on en oublie l'objet d'avant.

Jogo muito bonito e carismático, que funciona como uma caixinha de pequenas surpresas.
A mecânica é bem simples, um quebra-cabeças de alocação, que vai ficando mais complexo com o decorrer das fases.
Mas aí vem o grande ponto alto do jogo: desempacotar e alocar os objetos faz a gente conhecer a personagem cada vez mais. De repente, começamos a nos identificar com uma personagem que não tá em cena, e isso faz o jogo ser uma experiência ainda mais bonita.
É um jogo curto, e por isso vale jogar sem pressa e prestar atenção nos detalhes escondidos. Isso vai fazer toda a diferença.
I honestly didn't expect to cry playing this game. I thought it was just a cute unpacking game but it's so much more. It has an amazing story and beautiful soundtrack. Highly Recommend

This game is absolutely amazing. I love the story element to it and how you see certain items recurring over time and how you can see the effects of time on them. I think the puzzle element is really engaging although at times it can be a little confusing so i'm very happy that you can opt to play without it. The artwork is incredible and I would definitely recommend this to anyone who enjoys cozy games.

This game was very sweet and I loved every minute of it, I wish there was more levels honestly! Very enjoyable and if you love organizing things (ADHD moment) then you'll probably enjoy this a lot too!

Unpacking is an adorable game that shows the progression of someone's life through their belongings. Though this game is short it's a lovely experience to find room for all the things someone collects as they grow older.

Very interesting game, i hope they add more in the future. I enjoy how there is no exact set way you have to decorate. I loved trying to figure out the hidden achievements and laughed at the toaster in the tub one.

Literally my only minus for this game is that, yes, it's short -- about 4 hours from beginning to end. But it's beautiful, relaxing, fun, and tells a great little story purely through environmental clues. I loved every second and will be replaying it again and again. Scratches that dollhouse-like "arranging furniture" itch (think Animal Crossing, The Sims, etc). Highly recommend.
5 * would recommend. It's not a game that takes very long but it's a game where you sit down relax and simply put things in their rightful place.

I absolutely loved every minute of this game. There's so much to it when you really pay attention - so many little details and parts of things that make it such a beautiful experience. Watching MC grow into herself and her life is such a wonderful experience, kinda like helping your kid unpack her life over the years. There's moments of it that made me feel such joy, and I didn't expect it from a game with absolutely no dialogue and only single sentences from the MC.

I do wish there were more to it, or even more storylines to follow. I hope at some point there's another one with more to it, as it was pretty short for the price. Overall, I really enjoyed it and ended up playing it twice back to back because I just wanted to see anything I could have missed in the details of the characters you only ever get a glimpse of.

Molto bello e rilassante. 
Corto come gameplay ma molto soddisfacente. La storia è davvero carina.. consiglio davvero tanto

I really like this game, however at some points I was not able to determine what belonged where. It mostly calmed my anxiety but at points, I felt overwhelmed by the amount of stuff/number of boxes. But overall, I have played this game a lot and I like the feature that you have 3 different logs that you can save.

I will keep replaying this. It's definitely a game I've always wanted and lives up to the expectations I had. The art style is so charming and there is a narrative that I didn't expect for this kind of game!
Super cute C:
温馨又放松，非常治愈。不知道为什么，刚开始玩就有种百合的预感。收拾物品的时候可以观察出主人公的工作，喜欢看恐怖小说、玩游戏等爱好，有很多细节可以探索。

Super Spiel zum entspannen und netter Pixelgrafik.
Lediglich der Preis von 20 Euro sind für den Inhalt der geboten wird zu viel!
Für das Spiel selbst und alle Erfolge habe ich knapp 4 Stunden gebraucht.
Ich hoffe da wird noch Inhalt nachgereicht.
A lovely game, the gameplay is very relaxing and the hidden story behind it is very touching and relatable for many of us. Definitely worth the play <3

Im absolutely in love with this game .... Ive played it threw twice already. Its so fun . The mechanics of the game are so easy and relaxing. Theres so talking at all (which some times i like ) great music. If you like slime rancher with the feeling and aesthetics youll love this game. Its very chill and you could play it for hours with a podcast in the background. 

You know that feeling when you move into new place and that wonder of where your gonna put all your stuff in the new place? thats this game ,the whole game. You dont know what coming out of the boxes though but thats fun its like opening presents and putting them in your new home. You can get pretty meticulous this game. If you have ocd and are trying to over come it I would not play this game at all. It could maybe trigger it maybe for some people cause your organizing things in house type setting. Just a word of caution for those who need it. 

Great game, love the way they tell the life of the person your playing and how they navigate life in a new home, fantastic music 10/10
It's not a hard game, but enjoyable and the graphics and sounds make it very satisfy to unpack. Great relaxing game.

A relaxing game about moving and unpacking with beautifully drawn pixel art.
There are barely any words throughout this game but all these objects subtly tells you the stories of their owner.
Content wise its a bit short, but there are hidden details here and there that you will only find if you stop and smell the roses.
This game is a joy to play the music and sound effects are so soothing. I am an organizer through and through and I am obsessed. I played it through twice cause I could not get enough.

This game is very relaxing if you enjoy putting things in order. It's a very zen game. The soundtrack is great, but it's fun to play with lofi homework girl in the background too. I really like how the story unfolds slowly over time about who this person is. I also enjoy how you can see their personality and interests change over time depending on who they live with, and what aspects of their relationships they keep from each place they live. The achievements are hidden and not always easy to figure out - I needed to look up one of them via steam community guide - but it was such a cute little game for the price I got a lot of game play out of it and would recommend this to people that like: indie games, organisation, meditation/mindfulness, relaxing cozy gaming, and achievement hunters!
Relaxing and cute, I only wish that it was longer. I love the little story that you go through with each move, would highly recommend getting it when it's on sale.

I loved this game so much I played it twice back to back, really taking my time to organize stuff and get all the cute achievements. It really is subtle and sweet, and I love how it tells you things about the main character's life without actually spelling any of them out. It's a game of gentle discovery and it is perfect.
Oyun sadece bir şeyler yerleştirmek üzerine ama gerçekten çok keyifli ve sesler muhteşem her bir eşyanın sesi ayrı ayrı konulduğu yere göre değişiyor gerçekten çok tatlı bir oyun herkese öneririm. <3

A very nice and relaxing game.
It's got some puzzle elements to it, but it largely feels like a sandbox where you can unpack and organise the rooms however you like. Some items need to go into specific places, but they all make sense just by doing what you would do in the real world, so nothing feels like it's unfair or too cryptic.
So, overall, I really enjoyed the game. Fun, relaxing, a good game to play in some downtime.

Muitas horas de diversão garantidas. Eu achava que seria fácil, mas conforme tu vai avançando na história, vai ficando mais difícil de organizar os objetos. Essa última fase que joguei, dava raiva de ver o quanto a pessoa "desorganizava" as coisas dela. Aí tirava as coisas da caixa e não tinha onde colocar. Tive que rearrumar a casa toda praticamente. Ah, e super relaxante, nenhum estresse (esse que eu citei não conta :P )

This is so fun and relaxing, I bought it today and have played nearly 5 hours of it already, only stopped because my butt hurts from sitting at my desk too long. But I can't stop thinking about it, and where I'll continue when I play next time! As someone who wants to move into their first apartment more anything but can't at the moment, Unpacking makes me feel like it's my own home and I am living my dream. It's also fun to make up a story with all the clues around the game to what the protagonist is like. Lovely game!
A very cute, relaxing game! I know the price might be too much for some, but definetely consider buying this, if you find it on sale, at some point!
Achei que teria mais tempo de jogo (devido ao preço), é extremamente curto. Fora isso, é um ótimo jogo pra só ficar de boa relaxando e arrumando as coisas :)

After having played through this game once, it felt really nice and cozy, both to play through and just look at the different rooms and houses. I'm not sure I could really play it again though, since I don't think it changes after completion and I'd probably put items in the same or similar spots

It's such a lovely little game, it's perfect in every way. You get a sense of the story as you unpack each house, how your person matures and their life moves on. The art style is adorable and you get cute little achievements for doing things. Couldn't recommend this enough, especially if you're looking for a nice calm game to relax to.

除了一些认不出来的物品和一些摆放刁钻的东西会增压
其他的都很解压——
一口气打完了，很棒的游戏啊，从搬家的物品来慢慢感受这个人物的故事，真的很有意思，音乐也很好听。

Great game to relax and play.  Art style and story are fantastic - really hope they add some additional stories as the game goes up in age.  Would easily recommend when full price as you can see the love and care that went into making this game.

Didn't think you could pack a story into a game about unpacking, but I was proved wrong with the context clues given at each different level. Really heartfelt game with a really relaxing gameplay. This game does a great job letting you choose how you want to decorate your rooms while also giving you a puzzle to figure out how to fit things in places.

A cool and simple little game about unpacking your stuff.
It has a story about a girl/woman growing up and it´s very subtle told in the background by the stuff you unpack and where you unpack it.
The music is servicable, nothing to special but not annoying, at least in my opinion. You get a song at the end but, it´s not my kind of music. Still respect the devs for putting it in there.
Sometimes it´s a bit finicky on where you place specific items, wich annoyed me a bit, but it feels like it´s part of the game, as if you actually move.
Like some people already said it´s a bit on the short end. I got trough it in ~3.4 hours (at least steam tells me), but that´s the best kind of critiscism if you just want more. 
I would love to see some updates, like storys from different Charakters, with different Places they move to.
There are also some secrets, like solving a rubik´s cube or discovering an old, childhood poster. That´s pretty neat.

If you really want this game, I would recommend waiting for a sale.

Even after only a short while playing the game, I find the "creating order" gameplay that lets me think about the stories behind the objects I'm placing very calming even when I'm rearranging things multiple times.

The most soothing part might be the way emptied boxes disappear into thin air, though; I wish my last move had worked that way....
A very lovely and relaxing game. The ending was unexpected and made me cry happy tears. If I could go back in time and experience this game for the first time again, I would.
It was a very nice and satisfying game to play! It was very cute. I saw a video for it a few months ago and bought it on day of release. Was worth the wait!

If you have a spare $20 to spare, then I highly recommend this game. The art style is so cute, the music is adorable and it is just such a cute game that tells a story in a different way than the norm.
It is a short game, you'll probably play through it within a few hours (it took me 3.4hrs) but it is super relaxing and I will probably play through it again!

It is on the pricier side compared to the contents but I think what a lot of people are forgetting is that this IS an indie game. It wasn't made by a huge business corporation, it was made by a small team of developers and artists. And imo as an artist, it is so so worth the price of a mere $20. 

(Also, as a small side-note, as an South-East Asian, I absolutely loved the incorporation of household Asian cooking supplies like the fish sauce! It absolutely made my day to see it in a game, it wasn't something I knew I needed or wanted until now. So thank you!!)

เป็นเกมที่เล่นเพลินๆ ตอนแรกคิดว่าเป็นเกมที่ unpack ของ แต่งห้องเฉยๆ แต่พอเล่นไปเรื่อยๆ ตัวเกมจะสื่อถึงเรื่องราวที่ลึกซื้งขึ้น ซึ่งเรื่องราวเหล่านี้จะแฝงไปกับของทุกชิ้นที่เรา unpack ด่านแต่ละด่านที่เปลี่ยนแปลงไปตามกาลเวลาของเรื่องราว เล่นจบแล้วรู้สึกอิ่มเอมในความรู้สึกมาก เกมสะท้อนเรื่องราวของคนๆหนึ่งที่เดินทางผ่านช่วงเวลาต่างๆ เล่นไปก็ทำให้นึกถึงช่วงเวลาของเราเองเหมือนกัน ทำให้นึกถึงเวลาเก่าๆ

I'd been anticipating this game all year, checking damn-near daily on twitter for updates or more screenshots after having the chance to play the demo, I knew this game was going to be something special. My beloved dog, Lily, who'd been with me for 16 years and going strong, had a surgery scheduled the day before Unpacking was set to release, a surgery meant to extend and ease her life. This seemed like a ideal situation, I could pull my laptop up next to her and hang out as she recovered.

Unfortunately, the surgery proved too much, and Lily drew her last breath in my arms while I lay helpless. It's uncertain the exact cause of death, but the surgery was set to prolong her life. It instilled hopes and dreams and in an instant I watched them do limp, then stiff. Never to be.

I didn't get the chance to play Unpacking the second it released as I had intended to do for so long. I didn't have much drive to do anything but mourn and weep. I finally got the chance to play the game, while unpacking the contents of these cute cardboard boxes I also began unpacking my own memories. Each objects in-game reminding me of a real-life parallel, with many reminding me of my precious Lily. It was cathartic, it was an experience filled with joy and sorrow. I remembered things I'd entirely forgotten, and was able to forget about the one thing I desperately wanted to.

Unpacking is a fantastic game, a beautiful story, a humble package laced with nostalgia and discovery. I wish I could play through it again for the first time, it's a shame I beat the thing (aside from all the stickers) in about 6 hours, and while I don't think I'm ready to go through everything that'll come with playing through this game for me again yet, I look forward to the day I revisit these cute cardboard boxes and stuffed chickies (and that one knife)

This is such a wonderfully cozy game. It is so relaxing, and fun to decorate the things you are unpacking. The graphics are done so well, and you can usually tell what the item is that you are putting away. There were only a few things that I didn't know what they were, but at least I found the right room with them. :) Sure, it is a little bit short, but the cozy feel, chill music, and wonderful story that is told are all worth it.

I absolutely LOVED this game. So beautiful, relaxing, NOSTALGIC, and kind of emotional tbh.

I completed this game in like 3 hours :( please add more to this game please!!

I really liked playing this game, perhaps so much that I got through it within a day. I really wish there would have been more content. Other than it being a short play, Unpacking is a simple yet fun game you can easily get into.
A calm and relaxing game where you unpack boxes one item at a time. Journey through the years as you move from various houses and change life partners.

I really love the story element of the game, however I would recommend switching off the placing guides in settings. If there's one thing I could change I would have made each color book a different persons moving story if that makes any sense. Waiting for a free update with more people to help unpack!

The game is great.

The story line is super relaxing, can you believe organising would be so much fun?
However; I finished the game in 3,3hrs. The price is a bit steep for the content it offers.

This game is relaxing in every way except that I feel like there should be more freedom where to place things, e.g. there are certain towels that HAVE to be placed in a certain room or you can not pass the level. Or I can not place my plates on the floor where they belong. In all seriousness I also appreciated the detail of the baby chick buttcrack on the plushies. I also was sort of surpised there is/was not much of a story line, but I like the game none the less.
I really enjoyed playing this game. It was super relaxing but I finished it in 3 hours. For the price, I wish there were more levels to complete. I hope they add more to the game later.

I thoroughly enjoyed playing Unpacking! It was over pretty quickly for me, though I'm still trying to get some of the last achievement bits.  I'm excited to see what new content and stories are in the future!

First I wanna to say that this game is the most meditative game i've ever played! 
I want to reccomend this game to everybody who tires of everything: work, study, your problems etc...
This game telling a story from little girl to adult who  moves to different places of living, depends of her age and status in life, including her personal life. 
Aspecially I want to noticed a great music background in gameplay and sound of all things while unpacking.

Приятная игра, с приятным всем.Если вы перфекционист - вы будете играть в нее вечно. Насчет расслабления в игре можно поспорить, тк, если у вас включено установка предметов на места, то не все предметы ясны (либо я особенная). Сюжет простой, но интересный, интерьер крутой и притягательный, пройти всю игру в спокойном режиме можно за 3-5ч. Остается приятное послевкусие. Похожих не нашла, так что уникальная. Unpacking was an unexpected surprise. It is a fun and relaxing casual game. It's fun to hunt all the achievements in this game. I would definitely purchase more games like this from the publisher.
Exquisite attention to detail. So satisfying to play. The voyeuristic thrill of looking through someone's belongings plus the gratification of organizing items in a pleasing way.

Been following this game over the past year, and so so glad it's finally out! Love the story and honestly it's just so fun to unpack and decorate when it's not your own stuff. lol

Quick game. Finished in one sitting, but it's so worth replaying. <3

Un lindo juego relajante con lindos gráficos para frikis del orden  jajaja.
Es agradable como se va revelando la historia de vida de alguien a través de los objetos y los cambios en los espacios.
Really relaxing game play with an interesting story. I really enjoy finding the achievements for additional game play as story was short but of good quality.
Unpacking is a very relaxing puzzle game that manages to tell a life story without any dialogues, just with the puzzles.

I loved this game but wished there was a little more! I'm not sure how replayable it's going to be after the second run through and for the price I just wish there was more. I hope to see updates and more content in the future.

I'm torn about this. On one hand, the game is very short, and has very low replayability value. Certainly not worth the price. On the other hand, towards the end it feels more like work than playing a game.
If there's a sale where you can get this for 10$ or less, sure, go for it. The beginning of the game  is very nice, and you feel like uncovering a story through the objects that you're putting into place. As the game progresses, the story gets more muddled, and the game feels like a chore. I'd say I had 3-4 hours of fun with this, and played the rest just to be done with it. I thought it would be a relaxing game, and there is some of that there, but it's not quite a relaxing game, and it's sometimes even annoying with the arbitrary rules on where things can and cannot be placed.
It's very good and interesting and fun but its quite expensive for the small amount of content, the storyline is very nice and wholesome.

This is a prime example of a good "casual" game for me. Chill primary gameplay loop with the challenge mainly being self-imposed.

If you love arranging things or have an irrational hate of misaligned stuff in other games this may either be a game you love or grow to hate. 

My only gripe could be that after completion I would have hoped for 1 or 2 more levels but in its current shape it still be worth the full price if you need to chill for a couple of evenings.

This story hit a bit too close to home. You might think this is just a little puzzle/relaxing game, but this is the definition of visual storytelling. And I love it. However... it was eerily close to how my life's gone so far. It's not an especially long game, but I've played through it three times and it just feels good to play.
Petit puzzle game très facile mais avec une histoire prenante et touchante. Un bon jeu chill pour jouer un petit moment avant d'aller dormir.

Unpacking is a game that tells its story through small details revealed over time, and it provides an experience that is both intimate and relatable while still keeping a chill vibe. It was exciting to uncover more about our protagonist by going through each item, putting it in its home in each location, and seeing what changed along our journey. 

This is also a game that I would definitely take your time with, making sure to look at the little details. The structure of the game already lends itself to forcing you to slow down a bit, and I think that's genius. I found myself both really feeling for the protagonist and looking at similarities throughout my own life, and I really enjoy things that make me feel introspective in that way.

I would definitely recommend this game, though, [i]I would wait till the game is on sale[/i]. The number of levels and the fact that there isn't anything different after completion makes the $20 feel too high. It wouldn't be an issue if additional side levels after you finish the main story or just another story of a similar length were available, but the experience is roughly 4 - 6 hours in length currently. It's not a terrible price, and I wouldn't say you would have wasted your money if you decided to pick it up at full price. Still, considering the hours of content other games offer at similar price ranges, it feels like just a bit more content would have made $20 more justifiable.

4.999/5 stars!!

Make no mistake, this IS a perfect game! I came in with meager expectations and was blown away by the simplicity, quality, sounds, and storytelling. There's an ASMR component with the sound bytes and the perfection in setting something down. Finding things in unexpected places, struggling with space, and there's never enough clothes hangers! I laughed a few times with some unexpected finds and on one level found myself spending a half hour trying to hunt down a missing item in a pair when it wasn't an objective. The moment where you question "Why can't I move this? Oh, because it's not mine; they said no." was a perfect moment.

I felt for the protagonist and their journey through life, and I loved learning about them and their relationships through stuff.  I loved the feeling of time passing as you work all day to unpack. 

I rated this game -0.001 stars for these drawbacks: 

(1) Music starts to get a bit repetitive by the end
(2) Didn't like how the photo albums on the start screen are save slots, I wanted them to be new stories
(3) Wanted a chance to play a male-protagonist story, and a gender-fluid/non-binary story
(4) Wanted to see more material possessions from relationship drama - wanted those antacids to come after moving back into my own place. Some clues into why there were canes, now. 
(5) Wanted to interact more with the world, wanted to open the sliding glass doors and windows and let some air in, brew coffee, open the refridgerator, open the microwave, strum the guitar, and desperately wanted to clean up a certain person's sink-mess
(6) 5-6 hours of gameplay (I took my time) is a lot to charge for the full-price of this game
(7) I expected more levels on the core gameplay story - moving into a bigger house or re-arranging the current one for more children/twins/triplets. Building an add-on for adopted children. Building a dog house and a tree-house for the kids. Finishing a basement and moving the leftover construction materials into the wastebin. Moving into a smaller place when the kids have gone to college. Moving into a retirement villa. 
(8) In the college dorm story, wanted to unstick glue from the desk, peel off old stickers, lube up a squeaky chair, toss someone else's candy wrappers into the wastebasket. 
(9) In some places the isometric view prevents you from putting things where it looks like they should fit and I wanted to change my view to a different angle briefly

Please make more expansion packs!

This game will probably seem boring -- even pointless -- to some because it is literally unpacking stuff and putting the items into the correct spots in the correct rooms. No action, no horror, no drama, no dialogue, no....real story. 

However, for someone like me who suffers from OCD and absolutely LOVES to organize things, and as someone who also has problems with anxiety, this game is so relaxing and fun. It's sort of like a puzzle game since you don't always know where to fit everything and where certain things need to go. You have to experiment a little bit and see what works. It's not a difficult puzzle game but it's entertaining and easy-going. No time limit, so you can take as much time as you like.

There isn't a very detailed story but if you pay attention, you do get little but important details about the protagonist who is presumed to be female. You follow her from childhood to adulthood as a mother, and the decor and the size of the homes increases as the years pass (and as she makes more and more money at her job). You can get a general sense of what she does for a living, and while it's all very cute and sweet, I don't see anything wrong with a light-hearted story. Not everything has to be angst-ridden or dramatic.

The graphics are very charming, very colorful, and the rooms all look great. There are plenty of items to work with, including the reoccurring Mr Pigs (the plush pig who is in every "level"), Beetle Bard (a pet beetle the protagonist has for a little while), and the ever-growing chicken army. It was fun to see a new baby chick plush pop up in each level.

And for the record, no, the plush pig has no name nor does the beetle. I just game them names for fun.

The game lasts for quite a while, so it won't be a 1-2 hour experience. It could take several hours and time flies by as you continue to progress. 

The only flaw I can find with this game is that the music loops, but before it restarts, there's a long silence. It's kind of awkward and it made me wonder at first if the music for each "level" only lasts so long before ending completely. But, no, it loops with that weird silence between each interval. 

Overall, I love this game and I would definitely play a sequel. This game really calmed me down, which is saying something because I have been stressed out to the max lately.

While this game seems like a simple puzzle game at first, it surprised me just how much of an indie/hipster aesthetic it has, akin to [i]Gone Home[/i], [i]Oxenfree[/i], or [i]Life is Strange[/i]. If you watch the preview videos, you might get that sense from the indie, acoustic folk soundtrack, but the game also conveys that aesthetic via the items you unpack, giving clues as to who the main character is. In <2 hours, you learn that you're playing: a woman (evidenced by underwear and certain hygiene products), a nerd (d20s and video game consoles abound), an artist (a drawing tablet and art supplies), and a music aficionado (various guitars and a record player).

The modern pixel art style for the graphics looks great; it's very clean and satisfying to look at. The one drawback is that the small scale of some of the items makes it difficult to tell what exactly they are, which leads to a bit of trial-and-error regarding the last few things to unpack.

How the game increases difficulty is different than I expected: The number of rooms to unpack varies wildly from level-to-level (1 -> 3 -> 5 -> 4, and so on), but where the level complexity increases is that some items are pre-unpacked but movable, meaning you may need to rearrange things already on shelves to make room for everything. But that increased complexity pays off in the surprisingly well-refined and sophisticated playback system once a level is complete, which keeps track of every single thing you placed and where you placed it, [i]every time[/i] you placed it, in order. I have no idea how they track that many interactions.

There is also a photo gallery mode that lets you take pictures of rooms and apply stickers you've earned to them, but in the little bit that I've played so far, I've had no interest or seen any need to use it - it comes off as a bit of a novelty.

I've not played enough to know if the game is worth $20 (other reviews point to "no," citing the game's length), but even if the game itself is short, the replay value of finding certain secret Achievements may mitigate it somewhat. Overall, it seems like a fun and relaxing puzzler; would recommend.

**Spoilers**

This is a story of a young woman's life as she grows up, moves out, makes friends, makes art, and makes a family - all told through material things. There is no dialogue, just one sentence in a scrapbook per period of her life. We piece together what her life is like by examining her possessions -- it's an exercise in anthropology. What things does she like to do? What is she doing for work? Where did she travel this year? Why did she hold on to this or that item throughout her life, while discarding others? Why did she hide her diploma under her bed - what dark thing happened? What discouraged her so badly?

As an elder millennial, which seems to be about the age of the protagonist, I've moved many times. I've moved in with a partner, broken up, moved out. I've lived in poverty as a young adult, when the economy crashed and my college degree didn't get me anywhere. I fell in love again, this time for good, and bought a new home. Every time I've unpacked, I've felt that new hope, that fresh beginning. (Even though I *hate* moving!) 

I saw myself in this woman - and my heart jumped when I saw she had become a published illustrator, something I've always dreamed of being. When I saw that she and her wife had a baby - that's when my tears started flowing, even though I myself don't want children.

"Unpacking" tells so much with so little. The old adage for storytelling is, "show, don't tell." And this game is the definition of that.

[b]Плюсы:[/b]

[b]Минуса:[/b]

It's certainly something unique that's never been done before. It's also extremely well made and obviously very personal. There's a lot of love put into this game. Apparently there's 14.000 sounds of things being picked up and placed on different materials.

The game is a masterclass in interactive storytelling. With almost no text at all, the game leads you through an emotional personal story told only through objects that you unpack and place on their appropriate places. And everything is obvious at all times with no need in saying anything. It's perfect.

However, the novelty wears off quite quickly. When I played the demo, there were a couple of smaller rooms which you had to unpack. I fell in love with that instantly and I couldn't wait for the full version which I bought day one. Once I got to bigger and bigger spaces, for me, the "never-ending" unpacking of things became a bit anxiety inducing which is probably the exact opposite of what the game is trying to be.

There's a lot of talk about the game's longevity vs. price. This is not a game made for rushing. The way the game's presented, it's obvious that it wants you to take your time. No need to just put things where they are accepted by the game's rules and call it quits. Try out different placements until you yourself are satisfied with it. There is some replay value to be found here, mostly by trying again and placing objects differently. That's how I played through the demo a couple of times at least.

In the end, while I liked the demo more than the full game I still wholeheartedly recommend it.

this game not only had the cutest graphics, most relaxing sound effects, and heartwarming story, but it also was able to tell the story without any dialogue or showing any of the characters, which is really cool. (it also made me cry at the end which is a good thing)

Literally the cutest game, but it also makes you think and feel sentimental. I really wish it was longer, and I hope that we somehow get more levels. I'd love to see the children grow up and move out too, and helping them unpack.

its really soothing and calming. i kinda wish that more of the items would change, or maybe rooms or locations would change during every playthrough. but an adorable game none the less, and there are so many little things that make the game feel so much more full. 10/10 would reccomend

Lovely game. Didn't expect to cry about a game whose primary mechanic is unpacking boxes, but I did. Great indirect storytelling, The detail in the number of sounds they included in this game is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ and I'm thriving. Can't wait to play it again.

Highly recommend this game to anyone who just wants to play something relaxing with some very soothing music.
I played this game for hours and still want to play more, the game it self is beautifully designed and so easy to get wrapped into. The music and the game itself work so well together that it is one of the many games I would play on end just to listen to the music and just relax and vibe to.
Unpacking is a little jewel: quality, originality, authenticity, poetry, it's all there. A very sweet experience perfect to relax on a weekend.

This game is very good, but the game duration is quite short, so compared to the price, it is a bit expensive. At the same time, the replay value is not much. But the story is good, the transmission value is good, the music at the end of the game sounds great

I bought the game on a whim (don't we all) and I am so happy I did. This is a literal unpacking simulator. You open boxes and unpack someone's life into their new room/apartment/house. Once you are done placing all of the items in a space (or spaces), the game tells you what is out of place by placing a flashing red/white ring around the object. You then have to find the right surface/room for the object. On to the details:

[h2]Pros:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
1. Gameplay -- The game has simple controls; click on a box to open it. Click on it again to pick up an item. Find a spot to place the item. Once an object is placed, you click on the box you opened to grab another item. There is controller support, but I used a mouse and feel this would be the best choice for those who have the dexterity.

2. Easy of Play -- The game is very easy to play. Progress is auto saved, so no need to get to a point and then save. This is really helpful if your an adult who has [b]adulting[/b] to do while you play or if you are non-neurotypical and just need to do something for a couple of minutes to stim.

3. Achievements -- Most you get from just doing some unpacking. Others you get by doing stuff in the environment. Try everything and you will find them.

[h2]Cons:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
1. Music -- It's okay, but it's generic and it's a never ending loop. If you have auditory processing issues, it might be a bit much. Luckily, you can turn it down.

2. Colors -- [b]The game is bright.[/b] Like really bright, so it may not be for people who are sensitive to bright colors. Then again, it could be my monitor.

3. Length -- The game is [i]short[/i]. I beat it in 4 hours and that was not playing it straight through, so for a dedicated player, it would probably be a couple of hours at most. Good if you just want to get through something. Bad if your looking for depth of gameplay.

Last thoughts -- I recommend Unpacking for a player who is looking for a game that doesn't require heavy engagement or investment in a story.
I initially thought this was just a mindless packing game - but I find myself growing to care for the character as time passes. Impressive and amazing how much we can infer from the things we own.

This game was mad cute, super relaxing, and entirely wholesome. The price point, however, is much too steep for the length of the game, I finished it in about 3 hours and I was taking my time. I'll go through again just to get some achievements, but was hoping for just a little but more.

I love this game. The graphic style is adoreable and the storytelling gives the game a certain depth.
Within 5 hours I played it through and couldn't avoid collecting all the stickers. I'm not usually a trophy hunter, but I wanted to enjoy the gameplay a little longer.

And that's where I see the game's biggest problem. It was played through way too quickly (for the price). The main character's story is incomplete. What about the stage in life when they get old? In which they see their children grow up?

This phase of life would also offer the opportunity to continue with the children's story as a "continuation of the game". Maybe they are twins and one of them has a very good life, the other a not very good life. Life is never a pony farm and I am still missing something: depth. Take us into the most beautiful and ugliest emotions that life has to offer. Don't stop here.

(Sorry for my bad English, it's not my native language.)

A relaxing game that both satisfies and intrigues.  Reading the contextual clues to follow the subject's life through it's ups and downs was was really interesting.  It's a very short game, and some may not want to pay full price for a game that you can casually complete in 4-5 hours, but I enjoyed the experience.

I definitely love this game. The art style is super cute and being able to organize someone's life is relaxing. It's also fun to slowly figure out the story behind this person as you dig through their belongings. I wish the story was longer.
This game was very soothing and brought me relaxation as I found a place for each item. I loved trying to figure out the story of the person's life who I was unpacking.

A fun and calm game. I really enjoyed it. Though, I do agree that it was a bit short for the amount of money paid for it. Hopefully more will be added to it in the future.

A very lovely game, with a simple premise but truly exceptional environmental storytelling hiding behind it. Even if it didn't have a story worth crying over, the gameplay is truly charming, with how much attention was paid to the detail of all the things you get to unpack. The wait for this game to be released was completely worth it. Fully recommend.

É um jogo super relaxante com uma história sútil e bem contada nos detalhes do jogo.

cute graphics, cool sounds and background music, great story!
idk but this is very calming..
Really calming and chill, scratches that itch that ive always had about house decorating and organising things that gives me pure serotonin.
Very fun and calming, loved seeing how the character "developed" over time, kind of sad that there are not more levels but you  have three albums and can re due each album as many times as you want!

An exceptional experiment in environmental storytelling, discovered with each freshly opened box. The ultimate experience in zen gaming. I only wished it was longer, even though it told the story it wanted to tell.

I really enjoyed the game and loved seeing the woman's life through her items. Seeing her life fold and unfold was very unique. I do wish there were multiple person's lives. I thought there would be more than one story as there is three colored albums used for saves.

Though overall I enjoyed it plenty and loved the experience and hope for more.

Game was fun overall and cute, but $20 is a lot for three hour game play at most. Some people are saying they didn't like how you couldn't unpack freely, but there is an option in the settings for that

What a wonderful way to spend almost 6 hours!

First off, I am pretty picky about my own cozy games; I want them to be engaging and fun without the stress of worrying about timers or moving at someone else's pace. The cool thing about 'unpacking' is that you choose everything! Besides some small stipulations of where certain items /have/ to go (like a knife in the drawer rather than on the counter), its all your own choice! Everything is up to you and you never have to worry about the pressure of an outside force, you choose your own way to unpack.

With the surprising story and a great, simple mechanic, this game is for sure on my top list of recommended cozy games! 10/10

The game play is around 4 hours in total and I do not feel like that is worth the price. I suggest you get it on sale. It is a good game for what it is, but it does not give you as much freedom as it advertises.
I very much enjoy this game, theres not that much game play and i finished the whole game in about 4 hours. However I have already started to replay it because of how much i enjoy it

I hope that there would be an option to name the item, sort of like a hint system, to help those players.

The idea of being able to tell the story through possessions alone is very relatable. Unfortunately the play time is a bit short and there's not much replayability at the moment. I hope to see more stories with all sorts of characters in the future!

This is one of those games that you need to have in your library no matter what.
too short unfortunately, but i'm eager to see if the developers are adding more contents to the game!

I LOVE IT!! <3

Initial review: if a game costs €20 i expect 20 hours of game play, honesty very upset to find myself finished the game after 4 hours. content is amazing, but the amount of game price

New Review: amazing comfort game, despite the initial play through taking 4 hours ive played it over and over again and it is a game i will come back to in years to come.

i really like these type of games. i hope more games like this come out soon. it's really nice and relaxing and put your mind out of things after a long week. only issue i have is some items are hard to distinguish with each other and the controller support is quite hard to control. anyhow, this game is great!

The sound design is incredible too, with the different materials being put down on several surfaces, or even toys rattling, etc. Everyone NEEDS to see this through to the end, it's a perfect bow for this perfect game! The creators obviously put a ton of effort into this, and I really hope they know it paid off incredibly well!

This game is extremely relaxing. It gives exactly the catharsis of organizing your living space without the real world stuff peaking on in. Also it has one of my favorite things to see in a game; environmental story telling. You go through the emotional highs and lows of ex-datemates who won't recognize your accomplishments, chaotic lovable nerdy roomates, the nostalgia of returning to your childhood home; all without ever being told who this person is or what they're like. I chunked 3 hours into it without even thinking about it. If I hadn't checked the clock I feel like I'd have been at it all night. There's always that joy of discovering what every new scene will unveil about our protagonist, how their life is going, and what they're up to. It's truly addicting. One, its very short, and 20 dollars seems a lot for a 4 hour game (Its probably shorter for most people, I was messing around and taking it slow) And two, the game is also picky where some items go. Ex. books not only standing up but being able to slide them between books already on the shelf, shirts folding themselves or unfolding when you place it up on a hanger, ect.  It's very chill, very fun.  I love it.  My friends love it.  It's just a great game.  Was excited to finally be able to get the full game after having played the demo months back.

I just wanted to add how much I love this game and have been using it to help me relax before bed at night.  I've moved a LOT in my life so I quickly identified with watching this person's life unfold.  It's theraputic putting things in their proper places and experimenting with new way of having everything look, even if sometimes myself and the game don't agree.  And I know I could turn off the puzzle element, and I might just do that for my next play through.  

My first part of this review was after less than an hour with the full game, some friends and I had done the demo together, and now having more than a dozen hours added to that, I really am so happy I bought this.

I know some might look at the price and think it's too much for a short game.  And I get that.  To me, the game has so much replay value I'm just really happy I purchased it as soon as it launched.  If you're on the fence, maybe wait a bit if the price is too high just, keep it wishlisted.  It's worth it.

Another quick note on the price.  Yes, you're just unpacking things, but you're also being told a story through the items you're unpacking and the places the person lives.  I don't know, maybe it's because I like games I can organize and customize but going through this person's life a few rooms at a time was exciting.  I liked playing through it over and over to try different locations, have different focuses for some of the rooms since some things, especially in the later levels, can actually go in many different spots and in different rooms.

Again, if you think it'd be too short and you don't think you'd play it more than once, then yes, wait for a sale.  I am just saying I'm happy with getting it when I did.

What I thought was going to be the zen time dump I was looking for turned out to be so much more. Unpacking is relaxing and quenches a thirst for organization while subtly telling a story of a girl just tying to get by in this world. It took no time to finish, but I'll be Unpacking this story for some time still.

Hopefully there will be more added in the future, Id love to see a game like this wherein there is a randomised unpacking generator or something so you can just unpack and organise rooms in a more unlimited fashion. As much as learning about this particular person and their life was enjoyable I think a game where unpacking for random people is the main focus could be just as fun. I would recommend this to people for the experience but ultimately I am still left with that sad feeling of wanting more!

Serious contender for my GOTY 2021. Игра интересная и оригинальная, но очень короткая и одноразовая.

Through gorgeous art and throwbacks to childhood through various items, this game delivers a wonderful experience to anyone who wants to play it. Watching the main character go through so much through the years is incredibly relatable through realistic struggles. They give you so much detail about the characters life through what kinds of dishes they own, what photos they have in the house, what hobbies their interested in, etc. I would 10/10 recommend this game to anyone looking for a relaxing game to enjoy and explore in an apartment sized world.

The graphics are cute, the music is relaxing and not invasive, the story line is vague enough and yet it draws you in and keeps you asking what is next?  I have been so inspired by this game that I am currently working on some fan art and even a story based on the story that I have in my heart from playing this amazingly wonderful game. It's an adorable, chill casual game. It's very relaxing but like what many others said, it is not worth the price currently. It's pretty short, hopefully the devs will add more levels or different modes. 

I disliked the fact that the furniture has a set place to go. You can't put it anywhere else. Kinda irritating.

Recommend to get when it goes on sale.

It really gives the same feeling of chaotically unpacking all of your things, I especially love the moving in with a boyfriend then then it not working out and they move back in with the parents. that was such a pure situation that's actually so common. its nice to see things that maybe arn't so happy portrayed. I would love to be able to put more things inside of stuff, like when you move into the final house I wanted to put some of the towels in the laundry basket but its okay, I think more interactive elements like that would make it more fun. I had a blast I hope we can get more stories added to this as DLC because I would love unpacking more houses (:

I find this game really enjoyable and relaxing. I do agree it is way too expensive for the amount of levels we got. I do hope we get some new stories/levels to play through or even just one off levels.
Its a short game but the story is so fun to discover through the game play. It controls like a dream and the art style is adorable. Worth your money :)

The story telling is incredibly clever, I have enjoyed many discussions with friends playing the game making observations in little details in the story, "omg! did you notice this item that came up after x year?!" The graphics are beautiful, the music is fantastic. 

Do I wish the game to be longer maybe with more stages? Absolutely. Because the experience is so good I want more of it. I do feel the game is perfect the way it is. It is a little on the pricey side yes, but for the experience I got from it I think it is worth every penny. 

This part is personal and sentimental:
I am so happy this will be amongst one of the last games I would have the pleasure to play through in my life. It also allow me to look back into my own life as reflect on my own life experience. And I very much enjoyed it. Thank you for the fantastic game.

This game is great. Throw on a podcast and play away. It really gives you comfy vibes. Is it worth $20? To me yeah, to the average person probably not most. I'm hoping they plan to add more content, but who knows. I had a nice time 100%ing the game in ~9 hours. I did end up going through it twice because I didn't realize that you could go back in your game to do achievements, but I realized about half way through on my second play through that you can go back through your album and choose the level. 

Get if you're feeling stressed, it'll help.

Really cute, wholesome and sweet (with a surprising subtle storytelling that I thought was heartwarming) game. It's really satisfying, with really nice graphics and simple, straightforward gameplay. It's a good time killer.

However, it's really short and to be honest, even though it's indie and I'm happy to support a small indie game (which was obviously crafted with a whole lot of love), I can't say with honesty that the 20€ value is worth it. It's a bit too pricey for only 1 scenario of... 7? 8? levels. I wish there was one or two more people we could play as, or rather, unpack for. For what we got at that price, I think the game is way too short. I'd recommend waiting for a sale to get this game.

In all a solid 7/10 from me. I enjoyed my time with this game but will probably forget about it soon. Hopefully there's some DLC or something of the sort coming soon! I would love to play it some more.

First of all I would absolutely recommend this game for the storytelling alone, I loved taking the time to discover the mc and the other characters by just looking at the objects i was moving and unpacking.
Also the game is very cozy and calm and the storyline is very sweet. The play time is a bit short, i was quite surprised when the credits popped up but the ending is really heartwarming and I ended up a bit teary eyed (also thank you so much for the sapphic representation).
Over all, loved it.

Absolutely love this game, it was deeper than I thought it would be and actually had a story. As a graphic designer myself this game was a little thought provoking and it was fun to imagine what my own little home office would look like one day. This game also sent me down memory lane, these weren't my things but they got me nostalgic like even though I didn't own a gamecube growing up it was exciting to unpack the main character's gamecube place it near a TV and have it light up to a game intro screen.  My only complaint might be the price? I finished the game just under 6 hours and got most of the achievements on my own during my first play through I understand its hard to make games and everyone's got bills to pay so maybe wait for a sale if the price is too steep but definitely pick up this game when you get the chance :)
I'd also like to note that this is one of the few games I went out of my way to get every achievement. They're simple and fun achievements that come with in game stickers you can use in camera mode.
難得有整理東西的遊戲，雖然劇情很短，但是拆箱的過程很療癒，可以把東西收進抽屜裡、盤子跟碗可以疊放以及某些物品可以互動...很棒的小品遊戲

I personally love this game, but I have to say sometimes I place everything but ONE item.. And that ONE ITEM doesnt go ANYWHERE I put it so I spend like 30 minutes trying to find a place in the house to put it. But other than that 10/10 would recommend for most people, oh and also the music is really nice and calming.

처음에는 평가를 둘러보면서 가격에 대한 말이 나오는 것을 보고 구매를 매우 고민했다.
하지만 단언컨대 내가 했던 캐주얼 게임류 중에서 가장 후회하지 않는 게임이다.
(나는 토카월드라는 잼민이 게임이 단순히 귀엽고 인테리어 가능해서 10만원 가까이 지른 사람이라는 점을 참고해주길 바란다.)

일단 도트 그래픽에 인테리어도 가능하고 캐주얼 게임류에다가 브금도 좋은 게임은 정말 오랜만이다.
아기자기한 소품들에 들어있는 디테일들 (예를 들자면 장수풍뎅이 사육장을 집어들면 삐익!하는 소리가 난다거나 저금통을 집어들고 흔들면 짤랑짤랑 소리가 난다거나 )은 게임을 하는 중간중간에 퍼뜩 떠올라 소소한 재미를 주는 부분 중 하나이다.

2만500원에 3시간 정도의 플레이타임이라면 개인적으로는 괜찮은 가성비라고 생각한다.
그리고 본인이 캐주얼 게임 처돌이다! 하는 사람이라면 설정에서 아무데나 물건을 놓을 수 있게 하는 설정을 활성화 시킨 뒤 원하는 대로 배치하고 꾸미고 사진찍는 (이쁜 필터 많음..) 사골 우려먹는 플레이도 가능하다.
레트로 처돌이라면 사진은 꼭 찍어보자!!!

풍부한 스토리 태그가 붙어있지만 사실 스토리를 서술해주지는 않는다.
우리가 이 게임의 주인공의 짐을 보며 이 사람의 삶을 유추하는 재미가 쏠쏠하다.
[spoiler]마지막 연출에서 내가 지금까지 직접 꾸며온 집을 시간의 흐름에 맞게 보여주며 앨범을 마무리 하는 연출이 어떻게 보면 뻔하지만 브금+아련한 도트 그래픽 빨로 눈가가 빨개지는 것을 느낄 수 있다.[/spoiler]
임팩트가 있는 스토리는 아니지만 오히려 그 덕에 평범한 한 사람의 일생을 내가 지켜보는 것 같아서 신기한 기분이 든다.

나는 이 게임의 브금이 매우 마음에 들었다. 웅장하거나 세련된 비트의 브금은 아니지만, 이 게임에 맞게 아기자기한 느낌의 가상악기들과 도트게임 하면 생각나는 그 느낌의 브금들이 잔잔하게 나와 함께하는 느낌이 정말로 새 집에서 라디오를 듣는 느낌이 들어서 좋았다. 전체적으로 분위기가 아련하다.

간략하게 하자면 플레이어가 한 사람의 전담 이삿짐센터가 되어주는 게임이다. 그런데 이제 평생을 함께하는...
캐주얼 류의 게임과 픽셀 그래픽을 정말 좋아하는 나같은 사람에게는 천국이지만, 그렇지 않은 사람에게는 돈이 아깝다고  느껴질 수도 있을만한 게임이다.(그런데 개인적으로는 정말 추천....세일할때 많이 사주세요)
모션도 괜찮고, 그래픽도 아기자기하고, 브금도 괜찮은 게임이다. 완전 레트로 감성.
난 이 게임을 하면서 이 게임 집에서 살고싶다는 생각을 수백번 했다. 진짜로 살면 정리는 개뿔 개판칠거면서....

Simple but brilliant game. Enjoyable and really beatiful consept. I was suprised about the story part but it really fit perfectly to the game. If you enjoy puzzle and decorating games you need to get this.

Медитативная, несложная игра-головоломка. за всё время встретил только два момента, когда из-за пикселей непонятно куда положить предмет. Я играл в неё во время лекций, помогает отключить мозг и слушать (для тех, кому это подходит.

很治愈的搬家游戏啊！收拾房间，眼看着物件越来越多，收拾整理的时间越来越长了。
从一个人独居，到两个人，到婴儿床。
从小小的房间，动漫海报，到小跃层，盆栽。不觉间，很多变化。
自由度也比较高，不紧不慢的话，大概五六个小时的游戏时长就可以通关。

beautiful game, yes it has a semi short story, however you have the choice to replay it and change the way you set things up, so you can replay it. The story was honestly really adorable and real, this game has helped me calm my anxieties and distract myself, which is honestly really hard to get with some games, however this game just consumed me and my attention.

despite the initial scare of the price, i'd say it's totally worth it. :) took me around four hours to complete the game, which in the end, i did take my time. hopefully, there will be more added to it in the future, or even dlc. i'd love to play more of this game, i just don't know if i'll continuously enjoy playing the same levels. although, it's a good way to pass time. basically a puzzle and organization in one.
Super cute and relaxing game!! The story line is sweet too. It is quite short though which was the only disappointing thing. Hoping they add more to it

My housemate just moved out, so I've been spreading out into the space and going through my possessions to see what I want where, and with that comes back a lot of memories that each thing carries with it.

This game really moved me. If you are trying to just complete it as quickly as possible then you are doing yourself a disservice. Take your time. Pretend you are this person and think about what each object means in the context of their life. I don't want to give anything away, but some of the story points are just amazingly subtle and skillfully done, and sometimes heartbreaking.

Simple and cute puzzle-type game where the story is told through the items and level environments. Loved how small details such as where items are allowed to be placed (and what rooms need unpacking) are used to communicate major events

This is my favourite game I have ever played. It is amazing how rich and engrossing a story it tells just through unpacking. I became very invested in the main character and watching her life unfold through objects. The gameplay was also very soothing and satisfying. I'm someone who spends most of my time when playing Sims setting up houses, and when I was a kid I'd do the same thing when playing dolls. If you also enjoy setting up little homes, you will enjoy this game. The game is also very beautiful to look at and listen to. There are sound effects for each object you unpack, which adds a wonderful richness to the experience. The vibrant pastel shades are so charming and nostalgic and relaxing. I enjoyed every minute of playing this game and would love to see a sequel some day!

I have a specific type of brain wiring that makes me really, really love unpacking and decorating things, and being able to do it while only using the physical power of my mouse is nothing short of amazing. I only wish there were more levels or storylines - but that might not be the case for everyone, especially if you like a lot of action or hate trying to fit things nicely.

The art is adorable, the music is calming, and best of all, there's a story going on. You see a lot of stuff like books, awards, and gaming systems repeat themselves over time. Sometimes the main character gets more stuff, sometimes she upgrades, sometimes she gets rid of what she doesn't need anymore. Where you can and cannot place things (or what you can/cannot move that's already there) has a lot of implications as well, mostly regarding her freedom.

(Also, mild spoiler for my fellow LGBTQ+ friends: [spoiler]one of us! one of us! one of us![/spoiler])

Overall: I loved this game, and if you like unpacking stuff from boxes, you will too.

Really cute, fun, relaxing game. I played it for stress relief and truly enjoyed myself. I am a little disappointed with how short it was, but hopefully there will be future content added to the game.

I absolutely loved Unpacking! The art, the music, the sound design/Foley...everything relaxed and immersed me. If only real unpacking was this easy! I played one level a day until playing two on the last day. Absolutely worth the price, especially if you take your time to savor and enjoy it instead of blazing through in one sitting.
Exactly the game I needed after a long work week. So lovely and meditative. Loved the story as well. The only downside to it is that I want to rearrange my whole apartment now haha

I recommend Unpacking to people who like a chill game with no time pressure. The way you get to know the person and their life is rather unique and done with a lot of love. The artwork is so lovely as well as the music. 

I never ever had so much fun unpacking heaps of boxes! Really enjoyed it. Very well done!! 
Worth every penny!.

There is always the stress of chaos when one moves: the uncertainty, the worry. 

What Unpacking does right is contextual story telling. You follow along moving things, from plushies to soap, and the thoughts of "Man I had one of these" or "Oh jeez girl you've got those?" are natural. I suppose it helps that I had a good chunk of these items as I've aged too. People bond over stuff. 
I suppose it doesn't help that I'm currently moving as I played this, and had an existential crisis because this hit too close to home. 

Great game, worth the mid-life reflection.

Nothing I can tell you about this game will do it proper justice. Without spoilers, it sounds like an annoying task simulator. With spoilers, it's spoiled. You know how explaining to somebody what Katamari Damacy is, they look at you like you've described the worst sounding game in the world, and then after they've played Katamari Damacy for 10 minutes they're just in love with it? That's what Unpacking is like.

I see a lot of negative reviews talking about how the playtime wasn't worth the price, and I mean...I guess if you came into it expecting a game about unpacking houses, and went "This is a game where the thing that happened was I unpacked houses" then sure, I can understand feeling like it was pricey for the duration of the content.

But if all you got out of this was "I unpacked some houses" then you've fundamentally missed the point of this game. Obviously not going to spell it out here, but this game made me feel feelings, and I cried at the end, so like...if you "finished" and think there were no underlying messages or content to discern by the actual processes you were doing, I'm really sorry that you've missed a uniquely wonderful creation here.

I received Unpacking from the team at Dare Drop as part of a promotion.

Unpacking is a cozy little game about unpacking the life of a person as they go through the various stages of their life. College, living with roommates, their first "serious" relationship. As someone who has moved many times in my life the game brought a sense of nostalgia to me as I unpacked the pieces of this person's life and slowly began to learn more about their story. I was touched by the almost-hidden story unfolding before me.

As far as gameplay goes, Unpacking is very intuitive with very few limits on where you can and cant place things.
The sound design is awesome, with furniture pieces making different noises based on where you place them. Ceramic coffee cups on tile, folded clothes on top of each other, magnets on a fridge, etc. I found myself spending time just trying to hear all the different noises I could make. The soundtrack is beautiful as well, and I'll definitely be listening to it apart from the game while cleaning or doing other household tasks.

There's a bit of a puzzle aspect to the placement of items, which gives the game a bit of intrigue past just the story that unfolds (unpacks?) over time. Unlocking all the stickers was really fun!

This game took me about 6 hours to complete, but I was doing challenges on stream with Dare Drop so the average person could probably finish it in closer to 4 or 5 hours.

TLDR;
If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, Unpacking is for you! Sit back, unpack some boxes, and enjoy the ride.

Personally, I love the game. IRL I like to organize rooms, find the right place for things in rooms and it has that zen quality I like. ((and of course I love organizing other peoples things!)) I also loved finding the stuff that character still carried with them throughout their life and its such a relaxing and chill game that I love!

One thing that I have a problem with is the fact that I feel like I got cheated in a way. There are three albums to choose from so I assumed when I clicked the first one that there would be two other stories...So I played through the first one thinking that I would be able to play through other peoples lives...however, it was the same story again! To be honest, I was really disappointed but I have hope there will be more content to drop! I really love the concept! But I would wait until there were more stories to play before buying it at this price. 

But I have no regrets!

abdorable!

I never expected to feel so strongly about unpacking, and the implied story, as I did playing this game. 

Unpacking is a game about exactly the thing described by its title. You're in charge of unpacking the belongings of a woman, following her life over some 20 years. Unpacking is all about the semiotics, the signs of a life being lived. Quickly you'll begin to piece together the events unfolding in the form of various utensils, clothes, and other knick knacks. 
This game is not long, roughly 4 hours for most people depending on how much you're into the decorating element of the game, but it's honestly just long enough. See it as an alternative to going to the cinema.

Note selon moi : 7/10

Points forts : 
- Graphisme et musique très chill 
- Jeu sans aucune prise de tête et sans réel difficulté
- Des petits succès sympa à obtenir
- Possibilité de prendre en photo les pieces (fonction très peu exploré)
- Petit lore sympa

Points faibles : 
-Une seule histoire dispo avec peu de chapitre (voir si maj à prévoir pour rajouter des histoires) 
-Petite rigidité du jeu si l'option du placement libre n'est pas activée 
-Trop cher (le vrai gros point négatif) 

Est-ce que j'y rejouerai sans maj, probablement pas mais est-ce que c'est un mauvais jeu : non. 

Donc je le recommande mais uniquement si solde (max 10 euros selon moi)

This game was very fun and relaxing for me - I ended up playing through it straight in about 3.5 hours on the first go, and I plan on trying again to find the fun/funny places to place things (I can't wait to try the free-style mode too, where objects can go just about anywhere). I really enjoyed following this person's journey in life, from childhood to adulthood, and discovering the small details that told me about that journey. The changes to objects that survive different moves are great, and it also hit the nostalgia bit for me just right with older objects/architectural styles like the evolving hand held gaming sets. And while I don't agree with all the choices this character (that I'm unpacking for) makes, it doesn't mean that the story and game play aren't good. I thought they were all great. I really loved how the story unfolds through this small organizational game. It was amazing to experience. 

There isn't a time limit, so you can take your time playing through. There is also a video record of how you unpacked each level - at least watch one because it's very fun to rewatch your own actions (imo). The accessibility looks good, although I did not take advantage of it so I'm not the best person to review that.

This game manages to tell a surprising story only by the very simple, zen-like action of unpacking as the mostly unseen character moves from home to home. It conveys a lot of depth only through the things that travel with her, what she decides to keep, what she takes out again after it having been cast aside for awhile, or even where there's not enough room for her so she struggles to fit the few small boxes she brings with to try and make it more homey. It's cute, it's sweet, it's simple, it's short, and it's a wonderful example of show, don't tell, because everything you learn about the character (including hobbies, relationships, education, profession, failures, and accomplishments) is done entirely through what comes out of the boxes.
