Unpacking is a wonderfully soothing puzzle game in which you unpack a story moving box by moving box. These boxes and the rooms they fill are full of an amazing amount of pop cultural references hidden away for nerds of all varieties. It features a wide array of beautiful pixel art and a relaxing soundtrack. 10/10 would recommend playing. 

Extra plus points:
No saving required, it picks up where you left off. 
The sound output changes with your default system settings without having to restart the game, which was surprisingly pleasant for me.
Super cute game and super fun, a bit short tho. The graphics are great, I really like the style. And the gameplay is super addicting and relaxing. I'm hoping to see more content in the future!

Very relaxing. Just unpack the boxes for each room.  Some items that are in a box may not go in the room it's in.  It is pretty straight forward where items go. Arrange items how you like them as long you put them in the correct area/room. Upon emptying the last box you'll know if it's in the correct area/room. If not twill outline until placed in the correct area/room.  Also, the rooms that need things complete will outline in red until all items are correctly placed.  So you cannot fail.  Once completed the gold star will appear.  There are achievements...many are hidden. Part of the fun is discovering the achievements. There is a story told through pictures taken of the rooms once the gold star is pressed.  It puts a picture in the photo album and writing appears under it. Each the rooms associated with that year has it own little part of the story, so to get them all will require multiple plays.

I really really love this game. It's so adorable and fun to get to know the character and their story. I understand that many people may find the price too high and I would agree that it contains less gameplay than that money may be worth to you. 
Would highly recommend trying to get the achievements tho. Many people say they have no mativation to do so, but it just adds so many cute little details and probably another hour of playtime at least (depending on how creative you are).
I would also replay this game in a few months time without feeling burnt out on it. So I cannot agree on this game being unreplayable. 
If you think this sounds like you might have fun with it I'd give it a shot :)
Petit jeu très tranquille, dommage que les albums soient tous les mêmes. Une fois les mécaniques comprises, ça va très vite, alors il faut prendre son temps :)

Unpacking is an absolute delight; you can tell just how much care has gone into crafting it. From the huge range of sound effects that echo around the various houses and flats as you unpack and place items around, to the gorgeous art design, to the clever intersection of puzzle and environmental storytelling (of COURSE you can't move someone else's stuff when the central character moves in with a roommate and you have to fit everything you own around them- it's not your stuff to move!).
I've been waiting for this game to be released ever since it was first announced, and for me, it has absolutely delivered. I can definitely see myself going back to different levels to redesign the layouts of rooms I'm not 100% happy with just to unwind playing a simple, relaxing game.

The only downside I would say is occasionally the game doesn't like where I would put certain objects, but you can remedy this in the settings anyway!

This game sounded cute, but I wasn't sure how long it would hold my interest for. It's actually so, so much better than I expected. I don't even know how to explain it. The story telling is done so well. There's hardly any text in the game, but as you unpack things, you see what you've kept with you and what things are showing signs of wear and tear, and where you unpack things into shows who you are currently living with... I don't want to post any spoilers, so I won't go into details. The music also really adds to the story, giving you a sense of where you are in your life. It IS a very zen game, slightly puzzle-y, but it's so much more than that. I really love this game.

This game is a masterpiece. The subtlety of the storytelling is incredible in its power -- despite the fact that the only mechanic is unpacking someone's belongings, by the end of the (admittedly short, but perfectly timed) game you genuinely feel a connection to their lives.

At the beginning of a few of the move-ins (levels), I had "oh heck yeah! way to go!" moments, which was surprising but felt deeply good. In the final level, one box contains evidence that the protaganist finally achieved one of her aspirations and it was deeply touching. I was genuinely proud of her.

A very cute, relaxing game of decorating a house and following a person throughout their life. I hope there is expansions/DLC's in the future because I would play this forever. It's a nice break from all the other games and its very adorable. Well worth the $20!! You can tell a lot of love was put into this <3

Lovely experience filled with wonderful and creative moments where mechanics meets storytelling.
If you like short, innovative experiences this is certainly a worthy one :)

I really enjoyed this game, it was short and sweet and I look forward to playing it again and having a bit more of a play with things. Though it may be short I do see potential for replaying it a bit differently each time. Thank you to the devs, this was an absolute joy to play 💖

Really sweet game. Appreciate the queerness (: Lots of attention to detail, like the pile of accumulated misc cables that have a basket. It felt like an Australian game; turns out it was made in Queensland! 
Though I was genuinely angry (for just a moment or two) I couldn't stack a pot into a frypan. Or, put something flat like the tin of pencils on top of the computer tower under the desk. Might just be me though. 

It's quite a short game, and I've seen a few gripes about that. Just wait til it's on sale if you can't deal with this.

I've been waiting for unpacking to come out since an early post with an animated gif of some items being unpacked. I expected some kind of disconnected puzzle game and instead received a beautiful little story with chill, mostly-relaxing gameplay. Bought the game at full price and I feel it's well worth it.

I'm in awe of the art and sound, and how well they tell a story and invoke emotional responses. I'm struggling a bit to explain more without spoiling the story, so I'll just double down on the game being really well done and well worth it. It _is_ fairly short, so I do feel like I want _more_ game, but in the sense of "I enjoyed this please may I have some more" rather than being displeased about cost to gameplay.

If I had to list any complaints it would be that spiral-bound notebooks are the enemy of humanity and should probably be fired into the sun.

I loved Unpacking so much - yes, it's short, but it packs a punch (especially for a game without dialogue). I was genuinely moved by the subtlety and tenderness of the storytelling - and loved the Story Bridge cameo!

Unpacking is very relaxing and satisfying. The soundtrack is perfect for the underlying story and really beautiful in general. This game got me so trapped in it, that I ended up playing for 4 hours straight. I would've played more if I started earlier. I love how you can organize and make things your own style like when you actually moving, but without the stresses of moving. 12/10 would recommend.

What a beautiful ride of a game. The simple premise followed by game play that satisfies my OCD was such a treat. Following the journey of our character as they progressed through life was also emotional for me and caused me to look back on my own journey. Amazing masterpiece of a small and simple game :D
It was so fun and relaxing. The design are so cute and I love the process of opening things. Overall, I would recommend this game to play.

Played through, took me about 3hrs,and I have to say, it was worth it. $20 isn't really that steep I've paid more for much less. The music is good, I have to say my favorite bit is the "thunk" sounds everything makes when you set things down. They've captured the sounds perfectly.  If you watch and listen carefully there's tons of little subtleties to invoke emotions. The game has left me wanting more.

This game is so calming and fun. My only suggestion would be that there be a sandbox mode, where you can summon items or delete them, to make your truly perfect abode.

I say this only because the storyline of this game is very smooth and calm, and kept me interested, but I want to try and decorate these rooms to the fullest extent of my ability!! There's so much potential.

Simple gameplay with one of the most emotional stories I've experienced, and all without dialogue. A character's life story shown through unpacking at the different moving points in their lives.
Giving this game a thumbs up seems like less than it deserves.

Excellent narrative driven casual/puzzle(?) ludic experience. I was a little disappointed by the length only because it was so well done and beautiful that I wanted more! Watching the character's belongings shift and change (or stay the same) through time and space was endearing and heartbreaking and heartwarming all over again, with barely a word said.

I feel like with a few tweaks (and probably a lot more assets created) this could be changed into a more open-ended experience for a lot more replayability, perhaps after the main story is done? I would definitely be interested in more levels and items!

unpacking is a cute little puzzle game that is relaxing and really great if you love organizing (which i really, really do). it's not a very long game but definitely has replay value to get all the stickers and achievements, if that's something you're in to.

but what really blew me away was the subtle storytelling of the game. when you start the game, there are objects that keep showing up as you continue on throughout the levels. sometimes these are collections that get added to, or items that start to show wear and tear over the years. it's the little touches that really tell the story, and i get a pretty clear picture of what's going on even without many words in the game.

i could write forever about some of my favorite moments but i think it would be best if anyone interested in this game just play it. look for all the little details, and let yourself sink into the story of the main character. it's a wonderfully sweet experience that i really encourage everyone to play!

quick edit: to those saying $20 is too expensive, game development can be really difficult and this game is polished. the art and music are incredible, the story is almost completely visual which is a difficult thing to do, and i encountered no issues during my play through. imo, it's worth the $20 because the game is so well-done.
Nice simple game to relax and play. Kinda short though as I finished it at the time of this review. Might want to consider waiting for sale.

just fully completed this game and i loved it through and through. i've been waiting for it to come out for a few months and it was honestly so worth the wait. the game is pretty short but that honestly isn't a bad thing! the music is great, the art is great, everything about this game was so so cute. 10/10 :)

Was absolutely  thrilled for this game but its actually really kinda disappointing. bought for 20 dollars which isn't cheap and only had about 3 hours of game play, plus you cant actually put anything where you want it, if the game doesn't like where you put something it'll make you move it which is stressful when you spend a while on making a room exactly how you want it then having the game tell you, you have to move like 10 things somewhere else, then you gotta redo everything to find new spots for that stuff. looking forward to more content with this game because it was still good but kinda disappointing.

Really love this game so far. Super cute art and very chill just organizing everything and trying to make it all fit. I'm about halfway through at 3 hours I think but it's very neat the things you can learn about the person just from their belongings as the game goes.

Very relaxing game to play and is full of a lot of cute items. I love the small element of story telling throughout the game with the way some items get worn over time etc. I was quite emotional by the end, I only wish the game was a little longer or if there was to be more years added in a future update.
Tout simplement formidable ! Une histoire belle et douce qu'on a hâte de découvrir boîte par boîte !

This.. was such an amazing game.. I had to mute my stream at the end because I was even crying in sheer joy for the little tiny story! Even though there was no story so to speak.. I felt there was! Unpacking the possessions through the different stages of life... last one was the BEST! I was super invested in the baby room! 

TEN OUT OF TEN! LOVED IT!
Beautiful game. A sweet and subtle story, but the main draw is the very relaxing atmospheric gameplay. I do hope that more levels will be released in the future because I want more!

It might be short, but I really liked the story it told just by introducing new items. Game feels very polished.
Takes ~2-3 hours to 'complete'. Would've been fun with some sort of 'sandbox mode/editor' for more replay value.

IMO I got my moneys worth however.

This game is beautiful. 
You will need a box of tissues, I couldn't stop crying after I finished the game and certain points made me sit back and sob. 
The level of detail in everything and the way the story subtly tells you everything you need to know has just got me in awe of this game.
Set yourself aside a night to play this game, it will make you feel something <3

honestly the most fun, relaxing experience i've had playing a game in awhile. i've been waiting for this game to come out since like last year and it has been well worth the wait! absolutely in love with it.

Unpacking is the perfect game for a type of relaxation that still keeps your mind stimulated. 

I enjoy the puzzle aspect very much! The story that goes on in the background is a nice touch. There is so much detail and attention put into not only that, but also to the items you unpack. One of my favourite things about this game is that you can turn the puzzle aspect off completely, which I think is awesome for someone like myself who beat the game a couple times, but still wanted to experiment and, in a way, design more unique rooms with complete free will.

I want to make it clear that I very much enjoyed this game. It's relaxing and satisfying organizing the rooms. You piece together the story of the characters life through each level and I love that. That being said, it's just one character and the game is over in about 3 hours. I would not recommend this game at full price. I originally rated this as not recommended due to the shortness of it, but my four year old is in love with it and I feel I've gotten my moneys worth from her having fun with it.
It's a chill game with some puzzle-solving and some free choice. It leaves lots of room to imagine your own story, if you want to.

very cute but super short. Some might say its a bit steep but I think its an ok price though I just wish there was more. maybe an update or dlc that could continue with the family or a new set of characters. The gameplay is surprisingly fun as it scratches the tidy things up part of your brain and I really enjoyed watching this persons life unpack so to say and the ambiguity is a very nice change from other games. Enjoyed it but I just wish I could enjoy it for longer

Loved it, found it a nice and relaxing time. I see some others complaining about the price, but personally I found it fair. 3-4 hours of enjoyable and thoughtful content is well worth it.

This is not a game made to be rushed through. When unpacking, make it pleasant for yourself but think through what and where you are unpacking, and what this implies about the life of the person in question. Who are they? Who are they living with? What do they like? In some sense it reminds me of the "For sale: baby shoes, never worn." where what is implied by what's there is much greater than what's actually written/appearing.

It's a neat and original way of telling a story. Full score and a recommendation from me.

Absolutely Loved this Game! It was really cool piecing together the main characters life and seeing how they grew as a person. Great visuals, great music, great game play. Only problem is that it was WAY to short. I'd still highly recommend playing this game but, maybe wait until it goes on sale. It's only about 5-6hrs of game play. 
Developers: let us know if you'll being updating the game with more stories because this an GREAT GAME <3
Love the game and the puzzle like content, however, my only complaint is that it seems rather short for the price.  I really hope they add additional content in the future.

Little disappointed that I finished this game in less than 4 hours, but enjoyed every second of it. Also wanting to go back and play it for an another round, because all the possibilities how one can organize items(!!!).

I knew I would like this game just from seeing the trailer, and I was right. All the little details make it so charming and the sound design is very well done. Also almost teared up at one point, it really hits home on the phases of life you move through and the adjustments you make for others in your home. Do wish it was longer, though!

Unpacking is a very chill and pleasant game to play. I like how this game manages to passively tell a story through the environment of this game. I just enjoyed every minute of this game. There weren't any bugs or glitches that i could tell. It does require you to use your mind while you play, you have to figure out how to fit things in each room, things are sometimes not where they should and you have to figure out where it actually goes. Things are interact able in this game as well, a lot of little gems in this game. The game does let you know when something is out of place which is very nice. I highly recommend this game, its wonderful. My mother also bought this game and she is just as obsessed with it as I am.

This game is so lovely! The art is delightful. I really enjoyed both the soothing sorting/organising mechanic, and following the various threads, like the person's career, relationships, the nostalgic items like the toy pig and chickens, and increasing signs of ageing over time, and becoming more practical. So many elements of this game made me smile. I finished it in a little more than five hours (though not the achievements) and I intend to start it all over again because I like the process of finding a place for everything so much, and I'd like to see how differently I can do it while still following the rules. I love that there's no score and no timer, and I love how many items in the game I recognised from my own life. (Tamagotchi! Nintendo Wii! D20!) Adorable. Love it.

Casual fun game about unpacking. It's not really a "puzzle" game, per say, because it's not hard and not meant to be. There were a couple items that I thought the game's choice of placement seemed arbitrary, since I don't keep those items in my own home where the game wanted them placed. But once you unpack all the boxes, the game highlights those items and you can keep moving them around (and other items too, if you find it fun to rearrange things)

This game is very fun if you like simple simulators and chore style games. On top of that the storytelling through unpacking is masterful. I really liked the way the different spaces had a hugely different feeling and the way the character's possessions were used to tell the story.

A really fun, cute little game. I enjoyed the different places you could put things, the art style, the story. BUT, there is no way enough game play for the price, it's far too short. If more content was added, it would definitely have top marks.

A really quite relaxing and simple puzzle game that combines the satisfying sense of putting things in their proper place and the implications of what we keep and where we keep it to tell a beautiful story.  How do the things we place around us reflect ourselves?  How does the way they complement what is already there reflect how we relate to others?  Quiet ruminations given while playing a quiet game.  It's a short, lovely experience I recommend highly.  Plus, many of the hidden achievements have pretty silly or heartwarming triggers that are a joy to discover.

Love the game design, the atmosphere and the whole concept at its base. I really love this type of games but this is so perfect to relax my organisation sense! I'd like to see more interaction with the objects (e.g. fridge) but overall the game was really well made, enjoyable and with an amazing variety of stuff! 
The most beautiful thing is the storytelling in the background for the whole game, simply wonderful! 10/10!

The art and story draw you in so quickly, and I've already played through it twice. The little details make the game all the more captivating, and I recommend it if you like cozy organization games. It would be cool to see some DLCs with extra content, or more stories from other perspectives. :)

This game is incredibly cute and relaxing.  So much is told despite the fact that there are no words, no voiceovers, no nothing.  You learn about the adorable life of the main characters thru her many moves to many places, and get to know her stuff.  You know when she's in a bad place, when she's in a good one, what her career arc and her personal life is like.  No spoilers here; you'll have to play for yourself to see her story!
On top of the actual plot, the artstyle is soothing, the soundtrack is perfect, and the gameplay is easy, requiring no tutorials; you just jump in and start playing!

I loved the storytelling of this game. In each location just noticing what you still have, what you left behind, what locations you have to place things, etc. It also allows the ability for you to create the story yourself. How did we get here? What is this person like? How did we meet? etc. Beautifully done. 11/10

A great cute game, about unpacking household items and putting them away.  Game is short (about 3-4 hours) with not a lot of replay value.  I bought it as it was advertised as a relaxing, sensory friendly game.

DEVELOPER, if you want to make this game more sensory friendly:

1. Please outline items that are in the wrong place or that still need to be put away.  Right now, they have an outline that flashes and makes noise until you get it right.  I know you can change the color of the outline, but the flashing and noise is really distracting.

2. When a level is complete, the star appears in the bottom right.  It flashes, rotates and makes noise - it continues to makes noise and flash until you want to leave the level. It is even more annoying if you are just tidying your placements up.  Pick up an item, star disappears, put it down, star appears, flashes and makes noise.  After tidying up several items, it gets annoying really fast.
I can't tell you how many times I replayed the demo and how long I've waited for this wonderful game. I teared up at the credits and fell more in love. I'll be playing this over and over.

Unpacking is a game about... unpacking, and that's about it

It's not a game for everyone. but I really liked this game. The game is filled with tiny details that make everything stand out, even though there's no actual characters or dialog. One part that particularly stood out to me was the Chicken Family running "gag". I put gag in quotes because its not really a gag as much as something that progresses throughout the story. Basically at some point in the game you get these chicken and chick plushies and they're pretty cute, and naturally I put them next to eachother. But the thing is, with every new chapter after that more and more chicks start being added to the family and it really makes it feel as though, even though they're not real, they're real to you. But those chickens are no where near the Chad energy that is "The Pig". This dude is the real MVP, as he's (to my knowledge) the only object that sticks with you the whole game. Even tho it's literally a plush pig toy in a video game, I felt as if this guy was my best friend since forever. And that's the true beauty of this game, even though it's very little in style, it makes you feel things and because of that it's good and I could just ramble on and on about it.

If I had to list cons, I'd have to address the elephant in the room, the game is very short. While all those things I mentioned above are great, you don't get to experience it for long because it's over pretty dang soon. But the thing is, I think the reason most people say that is because they don't realize you're not supposed to play the game in a straight line. It's the sort of game where you make a little bit of progress, stop, and then come back later and repeat.

So yeah, if you got $20 to spend and are just looking to vibe out and chill, buy the game, and you probably won't regret it.
A wholesome, relaxing and surprisingly emotional at times: Unpacking is a lovingly crafted indie game, very much worth supporting. I'm glad I bought it and I will be spending much more time with it.

Loved this game. Beautiful and really touching story, loved all the attention to detail. Can get a little tiring with so much clicking- but the story unfolds with each item that comes out from the boxes. Short and sweet. Simply a beautiful game.

Красивая, стильная и расслабляющая игра, в которой проиграть нельзя, но, как ни странно, можно найти цельный трогательный и жизненный сюжет. В год, совпавший со своим первым переездом, очень ее ждал и не разочаровался, терапевтический эффект на месте. Единственный существенный недостаток — сразу после окончания хочется еще чего-нибудь распаковать и разложить, но история в игре всего одна.

我不太些评价，但是这个游戏确实太赞了
只有4到5小时时长但没秒都是照顾自己房间的舒爽，强迫症福音

Short and sweet with a surprisingly deep and engaging story told through the items the main character keeps and leaves behind in her life.
Despite only being 4-5 hours long, I absolutely recommend this game at full price.

(J'ai reçu une clé gratuitement pour ce jeu mais je n'ai pas été payé pour l'essayer.)

Ne tenez surtout pas compte des critiques qui disent "gneuh gneuh j'ai tout fait en 3 h" : installez-vous avec un bon plaid, un bon thé chaud, et prenez le temps. Chaque objet a son histoire et sa raison d'être, ou de ne pas être.

Le jeu est une perle rare. La narration, extrêmement originale, se fait uniquement à travers les objets – on pense aux Choses (1965) de George Perec. Le travail sur ces objets (notamment leur évolution à travers le temps, par petites touches, petits détails) est vraiment très minutieux, de même que le sound design (plus de 14 000 fichiers sonores qui s'adaptent à toutes les combinaisons d'objets et de surfaces). On emménage et on aménage. Et puis, au détour d'un objet pour lequel on ne trouve pas de place, ou d'un objet qui n'est pas forcément à sa place, on se prend des émotions en pleine poire. Si vous aimez déballer des cartons et surtout des feelings, ce jeu est fait pour vous.

跟男友同居的时候，房子很大，但我却只能找一些还空着的缝隙把我的“格格不入”的东西放进去。我的大学毕业证书无论如何都找不到一面墙挂在上面，只能胡乱的塞进柜子的角落里然后合上柜门。
后来有了跟她的家。我总算可以把我的证书，我的创作，我的一切一切都摆上台面，我值得。
Amazingly relax and satisfying. I'm impressed with the story telling. I loved the gameplay. If you are perfectionnist go for it.

I played this first at Pax a few years ago and was completely hooked as soon as i tried it! This game is super relaxing, touching and at times pretty emotional as you move through stages (and homes) through the characters life. 
A lot of the gameplay hits pretty close to home as I think most of us have experienced moving house at least a few times, and the act of unpacking/rediscovering things from your childhood, trying to make room for your sentimental items as you grow older and your priorities change, and how to make yourself feel at home in a share house are reflected beautifully in this game.
This is a point and click style game, with beautiful visuals, a soothing acoustic sound track and a really nice sound and feel to picking items up, opening cupboards, doors and placing them. Unpacking is a fairly short game you could complete in one 3-4 hour session, but I recommend taking your time and getting to know the items and the person you are living through, and have fun with the interior decorating as much as possible!

It's way of story telling is truly marvelous, its subtle and yet tells a emotional story, both happy, sad, and "oh my gosh my heart is melting". Despite the fact we don't get to read anything about the main character, so much of their personality shines thru their belongings and the environment they are in. It's also just enough to leave open room for interpretation.
Ever since playing the Demo i knew it was gonna be good but wow it absolutely surprised me at some points.
And of course its art is gorgeous, so many hidden details, the sound design is unbelivable, it can be both a fun relaxed puzzle game, or a memory trip, or sparks various discussions.
I had the most wonderful time with this game.

Its fun and beautifull. But that price for 3 hour game? Maybe not worth it.

Eli nätti peli ja hauska, erilainen. Mutta tuolla hinnalla 3 tuntia pelattavaa? Ei ole sen arvoista.

Super nice and super chill game.
I am going to recommend this game and give it a thumbs up because I hope there will more in the future of it ! I really enjoyed the game thou it was too short. Everything was amazing, the sorting things and arranging them , the music , the guessing of the story behind unpacking each time and figuring out how to get all stickers (yeah I still need some hehe).
Alot of other reviewers have already said it , price & short game time = bah. But as stated, I will support this absolutely amazing game, so more people can experience it and hope for more content to come, extra unpacking /DLC type what ever. Yes please :)

Amazing. The storytelling is done almost entirely through gameplay. It's very meditative and satisfying. It's about 5 hours of gameplay, which some might not like for the price, but I found that to be the prefect length.
I loved everything about the game and would recommend, however I am super bummed about how short the game is. Took me about 3 hours to finish it, doesn't really feel like its worth 20$.
This is such a sweet and charming game. I could play this for hours, just learning about people through the items they think of as important. This is a real display of showing more than telling.
So good! A relaxing and peaceful game, with a beautiful subtle story line to go along with solid game play. Well worth your time!

I was not expecting such a lovely and intimate story. This truly was a wonderful experience and made me reflect on the past. When I started the game I had no idea how invested I would become in these characters you never see. I felt too much in the 3 hours it took for me to finish the game. I let my mind run wild with the small hints and clues given to us with each new stage, and really enjoyed it. This game is a true gem.

Truly a lovely little bit of serotonin. The story is wonderful and I found myself in a character I never even meet. It's a quick finish and I would hope the developers would add more in the future if possible. If not, a wonderful little stand alone story and a relaxing 3 1/2 hours to zen out and unpack some homes.

I liked it, nice and chill game to kill some time. If you like organizing things/ monotonous tasks  you'll like this game too. As many others have said $20 is sort of steep for about 6 hours of play. Granted there is some replay-ability and there is nothing else out there like it. I'd say pull the trigger if you are on the fence. The art style and the quality of the game is good, you are also helping out a small studio.

Muy lindo y relajante.
Me encantan la música y cómo se va descubriendo qué pasa en la vida de la persona a través de los objetos que tiene.
This game is really fun and I had an amazing time playing! My only critique would be how pricey it is ($25 CAD) for only 4-5 hours of gameplay. But otherwise fantastic game!!

Absolutely loved this game. So chill and relaxing. You're not just unpacking objects - it's someone's life story. I love that.

I wish the plushies were available to buy. Hint hint.

This is a game that I was eagerly waiting for and snapped up the moment it was released. It was fun but I didn't expect it to be so short. For a while I had hopes that there would be some kind of DLC or added play features, but the creators have since stated that this isn't likely. Sucks a little but at least we have a finished game! I enjoyed my time unpacking everything. The music and art is lovely, and the story as you follow this budding artist through their life is just really sweet. There are so many little touches and I still haven't unlocked all of the achievements - so I will be replaying it once in a while to try and find more little secrets. 

All in all, short but sweet! <3

this game is so relaxing and far longer than I thought! 2 hours and i'm still on the first book. It's also not just simple and boring, there are cute little achievments you can get and you have to place certain things correct to move on. Amazing game, it's so worth it.

This game is perfect for people who love to organize things. I loved that it told a story without narration. By simply unpacking belongings throughout time in different places, you learn more and more about yourself. Not too long, simple controls; Would definitely recommend!

Loved this game! Such a great way to tell a story and the attention to detail is so charming!

Don't buy if you prefer a game with a challenge or skill level because this is not the game for you. This is a very charming story told in a very unique format with lovely art. I would highly recommend if that sounds up your alley.
Absolutely adore this game. It can be a little annoying though on the rules for what objects go where, a laptop on the top of a sideboard is not okay, but on the dining table is???

Very cute game! I love the story behind it all and neatly packing everything away, getting to decide how it should be arranged (even the toilet paper!) was great. I do agree with everyone else that it IS a bit pricey for how short the game is, but it's almost worth it because of everything else. It'd be nice if there were more stories! Different lives to go through and help unpack!
Jogo terapêutico, principalmente para quem gosta de organizar coisa. Nada mais gratificante que arrumar o quarto e os livros em ordem de tamanho. Viciante.
I loved watching the story unfold through subtext rather than dialog. I highly recommend it for anyone that likes cosy games. I wish there were more stories though :)
A fun little game going through the life of an artist. Weirdly relatable in some ways. I love the options for storing books. I wish there was more!

Its an amazing game fun to watch, play, and chill after a long time doing homework or after school! I recommend for organizers who don't like to in irl for their own stuff or just organizers! I also say its a game for everyone! 10/10 recommend!

Absolutely beautiful piece of environmental storytelling as you see storylines unfold over years simply via personal possessions. The pixel art and soundtrack are equally beautiful.

The puzzle aspect is not very challenging (but I don't think it's supposed to be) which lends to a very relaxed experience. The correct/incorrect locations for objects is pretty intuitive and open. For example, you can put books on a bookshelf, but how to organize them is totally up to you.

This will forevermore be my relaxation game. It wormed its way into my heart so easily, and once I started playing, I couldn't stop (played the demo three times)... My only complaint is I want so much more. Though I do think the replay value is high. There's an infinite number of combinations for item placement, try something new every time. <3

[h1] A moving game about moving. [/h1]

By the end of the game I felt like I knew the main character without ever having met her! She had some ups and downs but seeing some of her achievements being unpacked made me feel a connection.

It's not the longest game in the world, but it's relaxing and cute, and you can get into the story if you want to, or just treat it like Tetris with t-shirts. I really enjoyed the little details like recognising the games consoles, books, and Blu rays as I was putting them away (like in the last level I noticed [spoiler] our couple had a copy of What to Expect when you're Expecting [/spoiler]. Also it's just really satisfying to watch the cardboard boxes go *poof* when they are empty.
This had a great story and was very enjoyable! The diversity of items surprised me in a great way and the art wonderful. You could easily spot the easter eggs on the books and discs. xD

It is rather short, but it might become a bit longer if you try to get all the achievements.
Overall, it was well worth my time. It tells a nice story through unpacking all the boxes, finding new stuff, lightly figuring out what happens to the person whos stuff we are unpacking.

Just an incredible adventure! Unique gameplay, nice music and design. An interesting story told without words. Incredible. Absolutely warmed my heart. And there is a accessibility setting! I will definitely replay it to take a closer look at the details.

What a wonderful, relaxing experience!
I've been looking forward to this game for a while now and it didn't disappoint. The gameplay is calming, satisfying and relaxing to play, and the music compliments it perfectly. The pixel artstyle is wonderful as well, with some very intricate details in the items.

The underlying story is very sweet as well, and the things you pull out of the boxes give hints at the life of who you play as, as wel as reoccurring items they take with them through their life.

All in all, highly recommended if you need something chill to play!

The only small downside I've noticed is that some items can be hard to discern if you're unfamiliar with them, albeit for cultural reasons or simply not recognizing it immediately. It gets hard to determine the fight place, and I found myself struggling with these instances once or twice before accidentally getting it right or suddenly recognizing the item. And some places for items are sometimes arguable as well, for the same reasons

That's a very small downside to an otherwise great game though

A really nice, chill and relaxing game! The sounds when you place things are very pleasing and the game/music itself are super aesthetically pleasing. Good price for content <3 Can't wait to see if there will be any DLC

A very fun game! I do suggest adding a setting for when you hover over an item it would tell you what it is because some of the things are hard to tell what they are but other than that it’s an amazing game and I would totally recommend this to others

Really great game. Relaxing, fun and tells a story in a great way. 
I will say the game is relatively short. While I still enjoy it it would have been nice to have more content.

I really wished there was more "levels"/ Scenarios. It's a very nice chill game that can help you keep distracted. It's one of those games where you only need to use your mouse which is nice.

Great chill game not very long.

I love the different feeling you get in each home and the stages of this person's life. I do wish it, as a puzzle, was a little bit more challenging but I understand that can take away the coziness in a game. I went through one run in 5 hours without getting all of the achievements, 5 hours of entertainment for $20 is a fantastic deal. Games take a very long time to make and I think we're at a point where we as consumers understand that longer =/= better.

not a very long game, finished in a few hours, but I recommend as it was great fun! I enjoyed the soundtrack, I got myself immersed in the story I was unravelling as I unpacked the boxes. the ending was very sweet I think!

I love this kind of game! Not difficult, great for when I want to just relax but still do something. Unpacking is chill and sweet, with a bit of melancholy thrown in. Extra marks for having a native Linux version.

The pixel graphics are colorful and detailed, and I love how the items react to what you do with them and the environment. The music was pleasant, soothing and non-intrusive. It was amazing how the story of this person's life unfolded without their presence, or any words from them beyond a sentence or two at the end of each level. Getting everything put away in the right place in sometimes close quarters does pose a gentle challenge, especially if you want the end result to look nice.

I do have a few small nitpicks. The rules on what can and can't stack don't always make sense, which is especially frustrating in kitchen scenes. The puzzle element is not strong beyond exercising your tetromino skills; just insisting an item can go on this shelf but not that one, or on one side of something but not the other, or has to be specifically in one particular spot in one particular room when the item's functionality doesn't indicate that, does not a puzzle make. It'd also be nice if there were an inspect button or something, for some of the less-identifiable objects.

Be aware it's fairly short. I beat it in about 3 hours, with maybe another hour left if I were to go back and finish all the achievements.

Overall I would recommend.

A short, sweet game told through the rooms and boxes of stuff of a faceless protagonist as (ostensibly) she grows up, moves out, and moves on. There is very little explicit storytelling, but each set of rooms tells a lot through the objects both present and waiting to be unpacked.

As much is told by the possessions that are carried across sets as are the ones that disappear. It's not like the story is very deep and rich -- in fact, it's quite straightforward -- but having you, the player, make decisions on what to put where allows you to inhabit the persona of the unseen protagonist. Some changes across stages with regards to the acceptability of where to put certain items reveals the changes in the character's circumstances.

Mechanically, it's very simple, relying on "common sense" as to what goes where in the house, but there's a decent amount of freedom within those limitations. The one complaint is that sometimes it's hard to tell exactly what something is (is it a bath towel or a kitchen towel? Could this possibly be a fridge magnet?), but I wouldn't go as far as to call it frustrating.

All in all, a relaxing and yet touching reflection on our possessions and the stories they can tell. If you've got a few hours to spare, I highly recommend it.

This game is full of little details to discover, amazing sound design, a story told through belongings, and plenty of satisfying moments.
Recommend to everyone, and those who love organisation especially.

This is a completely different game - and that's a good thing.

The design of this game is absolutely fantastic. The game has a story, but it's never told to you. Hence the story is in two parts - the items you are unpacking and the narrative you yourself create around the person(s) who own them. Every play through of this game will be unique to the person who does it, and even then, you can still find different ways to interpret what happens within each house. If you look to Twitter you can already see different people having very different experiences of the game. In many ways, this game feels like a landmark in narrative.

Is it worth the price? Yes. Absolutely. It may be a little premium, but the quality in the game is reflected in the price.

You'll find my review is similar to a fair few others you've seen but this game is absolutely stunning but at the price of $30 AUD it just isn't worth it for the minimal amount of content. Hopefully more is added in the future but for the time being I would not recommend buying it for it's price and it's current amount of content.

EDIT - since leaving this review i've replayed this game a lot. So i guess it did end up being worth the price ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

As a work-a-holic person who never seems to get enough rest, this game offers some order and relaxation to my days. Nothing beats the near-ASMR-soundeffects of this game after a day in a noisy work environment.

At least now, right after the game's release, there's plenty enough of content for the price (took me about 12 hours of focused gaming). After organizing all the available rooms and apartments, you can always go back and reorganize them from your photo album. For a completionist, there's also some cute easter eggs to find accompanied by achievements alike.

All in all, Unpacking makes every source of everyday stress seem insignificant. What is important is unpacking your moving boxes after big life changes, as you learn more about yourself on your organizing journey.

Cute, relaxing, charming, chill and satisfying game with amazing art style and subtle but clear storytelling. 

In this game, you follow along the life of a young girl through her self discovery. You begin in a child's room, the very child you are following the story of. You learn that she enjoys and has a talent for art, has a soft spot for cuddly toys and develops a passion for gaming and movies. Along the way she has a relationship with a man which leads to a break up. After the breakup she moves back in with her parents before moving out once again, the chapter after the one where you move into your new apartment you find that you are not unpacking your own items, but rather the girlfriend of the girl you play as. Their steady relationship leads them to move into a bigger home, where they are able to their raise their new baby.  

My most favourite part of this game was the time lapses of at the end of each chapter as they were extremely satisfying to watch. My least being the parts where I struggled to find the right spot for certain items I could have sworn belonged or can belong where I placed them. 

Overall, is this game worth it? Although I immensely enjoyed the game, I do not feel $30 is worth such a short game. It has a sense of incompletion and leaves behind a want for more. Would be nice if the developers included some type of 'side mission' sort of thing where you get to play a chapter of random people and discover what they might be like. Different personalities, different people, different cultures. At the moment I suggest maybe waiting for a sale/discount if you wish to get the game, and I'm looking forward to hopefully seeing some updates and expansions as well.

7/10

This game.. is beautiful. If you're looking for a long game, then this isn't the game for you. Its short, and when I say short I finished it in about 3hrs while spending a lot of time fiddling with placements so it looked perfect. Worth it? I think so. The story is beautiful, it doesn't tell you whats going on but you can understand it from the items you get out of each box. I got attached to the character quite quick, falling in love with their story and on one part getting a little excited when I worked out what was happening. No spoilers but I did get quite happy for them a few times and sometimes cried both happy and sad. Felt like I understood what the character was going through. 

Would I recommend it though.. A solid yes, BUT also a maybe. Its short, like really short but to be honest, I don't mind that. I've been waiting for this game for what feels like forever and it didn't disappoint me in the slightest. Don't go into a game like this expecting a 60+ hr story with deep rich lore and detailed backgrounds of everyone you encounter. Did I want more? Heck yes, its so calm and relaxed and I want to go more into the story, learn more about the character and just keep chilling to the peaceful soundtrack. Sometimes I like a break from the mainstream games of today, and this is one of those games I can say will do that. 

So really, yes I would recommend it if you don't mind short stories with no real explanation to whats going on. This isn't going to be a game for everyone, but I think if you're here reading this now, it might be worth a try.

This is a really good game that tells a story of someone's life through the items and the rooms you can unpack in. There's a lot of story you can get even just from items that carry over between levels (or more accurately, items you keep as you move).

I fell in love with this game when I played the demo ages ago and eagerly waited for the full release. 
Seeing how a person's life changes via unpacking their belongings, seeing what has made the transition from one place to another is a delight (for me it was seeing which stuffed animals were kept as time went on). I legitimately teared up when I came across one particular room in the last level, surprised at how invested I got into a character you don't see. 
If you just want a nice, casual game to play whenever you have time, get this.

It's a zen game about pulling bits and pieces out and putting them away- all the good parts of moving, in my opinion. A charming story about love, loss and moving on is quietly given to us without intruding on the puzzle and generally, it's a wonderful play if you've got some hours to kill. While the story lacks replayability the mechanics absolutely do and you'll probably learn or spot something new on another playthrough.

10/10, adorable zen game that does a brilliant job at telling a story without ever showing you a single character and with very minimal narration. I can't wait to hunt down all the stickers I didn't get in my first playthrough! This was an utter delight to experience.

love how the story slowly unfolds before your eyes and if you dont pick up on small clues, you dont get the full story behind it. on top of relaxing game play, it honestly is a perfect game and the only complaint i have is i wish it was longer or had different stories to choose from

I definitely recommend the game for how cozy and zen it is. You can also pick up on subtle things that you unpack from the boxes about the background story of the game which I really like. The only negative I could say about it is that it's extremely short in length for being a $20 game. It took me about 2 1/2 hours to complete the story.

This is a very fun and relaxing puzzle game. The story is adorable, as is the art style. My only complaint is that it is quite expensive for all the time you get out of it. I took my time and still finished in about 4 hours.

I love this game! watching the story come together was so charming and nice!! i do wish it was a little longer, because i was able to finish each level fairly fast, even when i wasn't trying too. Overall its very cute, and you should give it a try!

If you want a calm, relaxing game with little expectations, this is the one. While the story is only a few hours....it's the type of game you can go back and replay and it won't look exactly the same. Thoroughly enjoyed it and I'm excited for my next play-through.
