I received this game as a gift from a friend. I love the game. The art-style is great and the music is very calming. The gameplay and the story are good and give a true cozy vibe to me. My only nitpick is that the game is pretty short and I think that 20 euro's is way too expensive, in my opinion. Regardless, if you have the money or you get it from on sale it does not disappoint.

As someone who pays way too much attention to details in real life, I loved that this game uses little details to tell a story and leaves so much space for interpretation. It's very fast to finish and every minute is worthy

I really like the game, it's relaxing and mind numbing. The way that you literally unpack someone's life is a great way to portray the story. However, as someone who has replayed the game 4 times now, it does get a bit boring over time. I'm not sure what the future of this game holds, but would love to see a dlc or update with a new story for a new character (whether it be completely new or even a friend/ family member of the current character's). Doing so would allow for more representation in the game in regards to culture, gender and sexual orientation. It would also prevent the game from becoming boring and repetitive. Regardless, this is just my opinion and I still love the game.
It's a cute, relaxing game for anyone looking to unwind. The art style is cute, the colours are nice, and the story line is a nice touch to an overall fantastic game.

i bought this game today and literally fell in love with it instantly ! i dont mind it being short, the decipherable narrative and calming nature makes up for it. the only thing i would change would be to add different sotries maybe so you have a wider variety. other than that, its so well done. thank you !

This game is magical, I've often times now opened this game up to relax and take a break. The music is calming, you can hear the nature outside, and the sounds of the objects you move around is incredibly nice for my ears. Maybe I'm just neurodivergent, but the sounds tickle my brain and therefore this game is such an enjoyable expirence. I've replayed it many times, and will keep doing so. Not only that, but I always love me a good pixelated art style like this one, it's a beautiful world. And the passive story is lovely to see, it took me a while to notice there even was a story in the first place, I was so focused on where my books and plushies were gonna go.

Fun to do while you have spare time and like organizing, but can be irksome to people with OCD like myself, especially when you want to move the unmovable furniture. Other wise, I could spend hours on this game. The music is nice, not annoying or obnoxious, but lively. Over all, I'd give it an 9/10.
I wouldn't pay the full £15 for it, I got it during the new year sale at 50% off, however it was a very cute game with a good story and fun game mechanics. I would definitely play again!
Very charming and enjoyable game! It's a pity that it's only for 3 hours of gameplay. I'm looking forward to some expansions or the next part with impatience! <3

If you love cosy, calming games that are narrative-driven and like organising, this is the game for you!

I got this at 50% off and think it's totally worth it. I loved waiting to unpack the final box to see whether i had everything in the right place and also just organise how I want. I think it was a cute way of telling a story of someone's life and also made me realise how much crap I have that I should really donate because STUFF. EVERYWHERE.

If you like relaxing, organising, pixel aesthetics this is 100% worth it.

I hate how there's a "correct" spot for everything, I think it should purely be about organising things in whatever way you want. Luckily there's an option to fix that, but there's still the issue of the finish button being a massive and annoying effect, which is also basically flashing since it toggles whenever you pick something up. I can't really recommend it since I opened it to relax but just found myself annoyed by these things.

Point and click shtick gets old quite quickly, even at under 3 hours it's a chore to finish. Sometimes you can get stuck while not being sure where which item should go, for example a kitchen towel should go on a specific place in the kitchen which can leave you confused about what's the logic behind the placement of items. It was the complete opposite of relaxing for me, it is not fun to play and can leave you frustrated many times, which is the exact opposite thing you want in these kind of games; I had to complete it over 4 sessions because of how boring it can get quite quickly. Pixel art is quite good, the music is fine. It was quite a letdown, considering the interest I had in this and the good reviews. Also, asking 20 eur for under 3 hours is criminal; do not buy at full price.

Amazing story behind all the *unpacking*. And I agree, the person who packed these boxes probably lost their GPS. But it kind of makes sense, you know? Have you ever finished packing the whole house and then whoops, there's a few random items left that has nowhere to go? Just shove it wherever haha!

Definitely one of my favourite games and it's actually a problem. Let me tell you why: I NEED MORE!!!!!! It is a really short game (even though I have over 10 hours xD). 

Unpacking is the most aesthetically pleasing game in my collection, there's just nothing else like it. Who's with me?
作为像素爱好者我很喜欢这部作品的美术风格，玩法很有意思，剧情蛮有成长性。但是.......太短咯！希望以后有更多关卡，感觉没有玩够

游戏是好游戏，很适合静下心来慢慢玩，但不适合想一口气玩爽的，毕竟……找了半天也找不到这个东西该放在哪里的感觉会令人哽住。我觉得这是一款自由了，但是没完全自由的游戏，对于平时就喜欢杂乱摆放的人来说，有痛点也有爽点，快乐整体较多，隐藏的成就忽然弹出来会有种眼前一亮的感觉！
总流程比较短，打折的时候推荐购入！
it is a short game 3/4 hours but you will play it multiply times to unlock all the achievements.  I am enjoying it, but i do wish it was longer had some different/ alternative endings.

Dont buy unless its on a mega sale. 20€ for 3hrs of gameplay is completely UNACCEPTABLE.
Its a shame since its a well made and very cozy game. Someone should make more gameplay.

Only one story but lots of potential to expand.

As other reviews stated, this is a pretty short game and the three save files go through the same person's life. I hope in the future they add additional stories because it is really fun and sweet but there isn't a lot to do. If I hadn't bought this on sale I'd be upset at the price I paid as I completed this in 3 hours. I was rushing because I was excited but even then it doesn't have a ton of replayability.

Completed it under 3 hours, yet I gotta admit, it's a really nice game. It made me tidy up "my" room better than my irl one, so that's a plus. Bit overpriced for the amount of things you can do, but other than that, I'd do it again.

【设置→无障碍→随意摆放→消除游戏对物品区域的限制，不习惯欧美收纳的朋友一定要打开！】

9元购入CDkey，对于收纳爱好者来说简直是必玩佳作，关卡慢慢玩或者重复玩都很有意思，原价购入反而不太推荐。
有些东西太小了也没有说明真的看不出是什么该放哪......其他的还行，故事性不太强。拿来打发时间还是可以的。性价比不是很高，打折买来玩玩还行

One of the most unique and endearing games I've played. I highly recommend it. It's a tiny light puzzle, but mainly just relaxing and enjoyable.

However, wishlist and wait for a sale. The content, while amazing, is very short and (imo) not worth the full $20 price tag.

The game is a really cute puzzle where you get to unpack stuff and arrange them in the places they belong. A very well made casual and relaxing puzzle that everyone must try. Definitely recommended by me !!!

ilk oynadığımda düzen takıntımı giderdim şöyle bi rahatladım. aylar sonra oyunla ilgili birkaç şey okudum yine oynadım ama bu sefer kızın hayatına dikkat ettim, mal sevgilisinin evinde eşyalarına yer olmaması, ev arkadaşlarının arasına sıkışmaya çalışması, ilerde kendi kitabını çıkartması, ev arkadaşlarından etkilenip sonradan onların eşyalarına benzer şeyler alması, sonlarda bir kız arkadaşı olması, eski sevgilisinin bazı eşyalarını yanına almış olması...beni mutlu eden ve oynamaya devam ettiren böyle detaylar vardı. karakteri az buçuk tanıyıp eşya dizmekten, düzenlemekten hoşlanıyorsanız oynayın derim

Oyunla alakalı bir sorun yok, sorun bende olabilir. Görev bilinciyle oynanacak bir oyun değil, bütün kutuları hızlı hızlı açıp tamamlayınca oyundan bir şey anlaşılmıyormuş ama benim de oturup şunlar şurda dursun, bu düz dursun diye uğraşacak sabrrım yok. Podcast dinlerken bir şeylerle uğraşıyım diye indirdim oyunu, iki buçuk saate bitti. Değmedi benim gözümde. Düzenden ayrı bir keyif alan insanlardansanız sizi sarabilir.

i finished this very quickly which was at an enjoyable rate for me, and then once i finished i realised it was done nothing more. its an expensive game considering there is not a lot too it. it would be an amazing game if it had more :(
its a cute cozy game. This game had me stress free with in the first two room i did, watching the story unravel before your eyes its adorable plus the ending was so cute

this is the cutest and most peaceful game ever. if u want to calm down or get back into playing games again, anything at all, this is the game. theres so much emotion behind every room. u get to know them as if u are them and they are u. its just such a mental reset i love it so much, wish there were more levels.

Such a fun simple game that really gets you invested in the main characters life, I played for hours on end and once I finished I didn't think I would want to replay, but I do! (The game makes it easy to do so:) Overall if you thinking about getting the game, then do it.

Very comforting, I feel like I'm gathering a story of the "character" you get to play. Some parts actually broke my heart and made me sad, because I knew what had happened in their life. I've been in their shoes at some parts also, I don't wanna spoil anything.I haven't finished it yet and only on level 5(?) and am really loving it so far. Highly recommend for puzzle lovers and people who love organizing.

很新颖的叙述方式，通过一个人的住所以及家具看出他的人生镜框，和被相册串起的人生轨迹

由于玩家对于美的追求，所以游戏过程中会很自然很放松地专注在整理和收纳上，可以说是有利的解压放空道具

家具和贴纸细节上的设计也都很可爱

“她真的很爱看书”
整體來說還算不錯，是個久久可以拿出來療癒一下的遊戲，這個遊戲給人的感覺就是雖然自己的房間亂得要命，但變成遊戲的話就會開始構思，東西該擺哪裡，該放哪裡，但全部玩完會覺得有點空虛。

neurodivergent brain likeeee :3
would be more fun with more story levels tho. I wanna play it forever but I'm scared I'll get bored :(
Short but cute. Highly suggest if you like organizing. It's fun to learn about the main character through their belongings, and see their progression through life.

I liked the concept of this game, but what annoyed me the most was that after a while you get way too much stuff, and you can't even place it wherever you want to. You can turn it off and place things literally anywhere, but my places looked crammed with stuff no matter what mode I played on. I was also very surprised by the abrupt ending, as I thought it would be a bit longer than 2 hours. 

Unfortunately this game caused me more annoyance than anything else. I really enjoyed the art, but that doesn't justify the rest.
This game is not good enough for the money you pay. You finish it very fast and it is not so interesting. The levels are not at all well made and are very similar. For me it was a waste of money.

It is a very relaxing game with lots of nice details and touches but unfortunately I can't recommend it at its current price point. I know "quality over quantity" and all that but I don't think any game that can be completed (at a leisurely pace) in an hour is worth $20.

I thought that this game was fun! I thought that it was entertaining and after two levels i got the hang of it. However, the problem isn't in the game. It's in the price. i paid $20 for a story i have to make up in my head and guess things about. And only like 5 or 6 levels. It's fun and relaxing but I wouldn't recommend it exactly for this reason.

if i could marry this game i would only thing keeping me sane thru ap exams. its highly assscible and match practically anyones play style im only on the 4th or so level and id say the difficulty increases with each one as far as i can tell

I love this game. It was beautiful and emotional. The way it tells the story and how you can see the protagonist grown up is lovely. The plushies are definitly a highlight. I wish there was more content so I could keep playing it for a couple more hours. For me this game is a 10/10!

This game is alright. I loved playing it while I did but that wasn't a very long time. I finished the entire game in one day; 5 hours to be exact. It is not worth the price. $20 is way too expensive for such a small amount of content with such low replay value. Considering the game developers have no interest in adding any other content to the game in future, I would not get it again. Waited a long time, decently disappointed.

I think it is disappointing that it is such a short game, it was fun while it lasted but it's too expensive for what it is, in my opinion.
It would be better if there were different scenarios and more houses.
esse jogo nunca enjoa porque cada vez que eu começo de novo, organizo os cômodos de uma forma completamente diferente e que sempre me deixa satisfeita. a estética do jogo é muito satisfatória. amo!

玩法簡單又很治癒的小品，如果之後會再更新更多內容，有更多後續關卡和故事就好了！
有點意猶未盡的感覺 XD 但是遊玩起來很愉快！

This game was made as an outlet for my OCD sorting tendencies.

It's a really easy-going sorting game with a story happening in the background as well as some really gorgeous pixel art. The implications of the story can be deduced through the items being put down and where you can put them. Simple concept, addicting to me in a tetris type way, I hope the devs make more rooms to sort I love it.

Please give us more ... This was the most satisfying game I've played in many many years. I can't get enough of it - I wish you guys would make DLCs and add another story line and more rooms... <3

Completely worth it, I usually play games only once and then get fed up with them, but I've played this probably a few times again and again as this game is completely unique and I can't find the same anywhere else. People with OCD would love it for sure.

Try it, play under 2h of it, if you don't like it, return it - but I have no doubt you will love it, and it can't hurt to give it a try !

It's a fun and relaxing game with a cool method to telling a story.
art style is cool.
I don't understand why there's 3 save files available when you can only really play it once and then the story is finished. but then again the game isn't about living your story, you're just creepily peering into this lady's life.

Final verdict, worth buying when on a 20% discount.

9/10 

It's a nice and short chill game with a good story. And you can see the history or the story thru the room or the things you are unpacking. 

The -1 for me is sometimes things don't fit to "my" liking. It triggers my OCness haha
Unpacking is very fun and relaxing. It also is very satisfying too. You will probably love this game if you get it! That's why I suggest getting it.

I do really like this game, I like that they give you the option to be able to place things anywhere instead of having to find the specific place for the item too. However, I recommend buying it on a sale instead. There wasn't as many levels as I was expecting and I hope one day that more levels (or a possible DLC) will be added to the game.

This is a really neat game. I played it twice, first time I play it normally, second time I tried to get all the achievements. I really enjoy the attention to details this game has, like when you place different objects on different surfaces, it makes a different sound, and also how the pig plushie changes from new to old as the game progresses. I don't think I will play this game again though, but if they are ever releasing Unpacking 2 with different rooms, I would definitely be interested to check it out.
安静的bgm，隐藏在时间里的小细节，游戏虽然没有太多的文字，却让玩家在摆放家具的期间感受到主角人生的推进（而且每次收拾完都好解压！）

It's a cute quick little game.
I'm not sure it's worth the price, but it is cute and was a satisfying way to spend 4 and a half hours.

The unpacking isn't as zen as I would like (especially finding places for those laundry baskets at the end). There isn't really a story, but more like an interesting look at how much you can learn about people from what they own, and what they keep with them over time.

嗯……好玩是好玩的，过程很治愈很有意思。
但是流程很短，我摸着玩了大概4小时吧，就完事了，相对这个价格来说确实是比较失望。开头看着有三本相册可以选，还以为是有三个不同的故事，结果发现就是一样的，大概是让你可以有不同的摆放吧。
东西摆放的位置是有规定的，有东西没放到位的话不给继续。但是有些东西实在看不出来是个啥，我还去查了攻略……只有通关之后才开放自由摆放功能，但是选择别的相册发现是一样的，实在是没有心力再来一遍了……
게임 자체는 아기자기하고 재밌지만 할인하지 않을 때 살 만큼 가치 있는지는 흠스럽다. 한 사람의 시점에서만 계속 플레이 할 수 있어서 2~3시간이면 엔딩을 보고 물건에 대한 설명도 부족하고 위치 선정도 깐깐한 편. 무엇보다 볼륨이 너무 작다. 다른 방으로 배리에이션을 더 줬어야 한다...

解压小游戏，收纳强迫症福音。
缺点就是内容太少，5个小时游戏时间，定价太高。
希望可以更新更多关卡。
喜欢这个像素风的解压小游戏~按照年份收拾房间，从房间看女主人公的成长，中间遇到了什么样的人，又经历了怎样的变故。我比较感叹的一点是，女主人公很珍惜自己的物品，有很多东西从第一幕到最后一幕都可以看到，小猪也一直陪伴着她。最后令我震惊的是！最后和一个女孩在一起了！怪不得！！！还领养了一个孩子！！！哇 哭了！！！！

픽셀그래픽 게임에 환장하는 사람으로서 이 게임을 보자마자 사야겠다고 생각해서 고민없이 구매했습니다 정리하고 꾸미는걸 좋아하는편이라 게임할때 너무너무 힐링하면서 플레이했어요 하지만 너무 짧아서 아쉬워요 ㅠㅠㅠ 공간을 더 넓게 다양하게 정리하고싶어요 번외로 책상 정리나 사물함 정리같은 미니게임처럼 나와도 좋을거같아요 이런 멋진 그래픽을 더 보고싶어요 !! 
픽셀과 정리를 사랑하는 사람이면 이게임 왜 고민하세요 ? 바로 사야됩니다
Very relaxing game. Short, but can be done again and again. They do a great job of telling a story of somebodies life through simle choices of items. Lovely

This game is really cute. It's very chill and soothing, especially if you enjoy sorting and bringing order to things! There are no time limits and only the suggestion of a story. It's fun to see which items the person takes with them with each move.

this game has been on my wishlist for a while and i finally decided to get it and AHHHH im so glad i did!!! super relaxing and a nice stroy attached to it that you delve into when you're unpacking everything ;,) AND IT WAS GAY LIKE HELLO!!!! AHHHH i loved it.
only complaint (which isnt even a complaint) i have is that i lowkey got annoyed whenever id be unpacking a room and something for another room would be in there; dont ask WHY it annoyed me but it did, but i can look past it bc i had oh so much fun playing this :3

Someone else said this game doesn't have replay value, and they're wrong. I've finished this game twice in three days and I would happily play it repeatedly. It's such a soothing game to be able to organize everything. I just wish I could reorganize the one where she's with roommates, but it makes perfect sense that you can't. I also wish the stickers were per file, not per game. But like I love this game so much

优秀的创意，解压的游戏内容，清新的画风，契合的音乐和音效，还有无数小细节，值得一玩。
有些东西直到通关也不知道是什么，比如放在厨房的那个许多木头棍交叉的东西；贴了小猫贴纸的蓝色长方体，是笔记本电脑吗？卧室的红色长方体也是笔记本电脑？挂在冰箱上的镜子我以为是新买的手绘板，试了半天才知道是镜子；树袋熊冰箱贴在立起来之前我以为是u盘……
老母鸡一家的玩偶在哪里买？
整理癖对此很满意。P.S.早在我找不到地方挂奖状之前，打开他衣柜看到一堆乱扔的内裤那一瞬间，我就决定要跟这个男人分手啦！

I loved this game, but way too short! I beat it n 5 hours LOL. More levels and selecting different people would be great! Good for my OCD though. I guess it will sit in my library until I need it in check LOL
I like that there is no timer, multiple solutions to each room, soundtrack is chill, the story is what you make it. Very relaxing to play and my 3 year old enjoyed it too!
one of the most peaceful and fun games i have ever played it also amde me emotional with the story. I loved it, i wish it was much longer, finished too fast <3 :(

This game is great but if it had more levels or there were multiple people with different hobbies that u could play/unpack as that would be great and it would definitely be worth the 20 bucks but it is pretty good
Very good game. It is oddly satisfying to play but it is way to short for 20 Euros! I hope there will be more levels soon or community levels or something...

There is no way for me to give this game enough praise. This game is my absolute favorite game of all time! I loved the story-line and the emotions conveyed through just unpacking boxes. I hope beyond hope that they will make another with a different story because I love this game so much. I will buy every unpacking game by this dev if they make more! It has BLOWN my mind and is in my heart. Thank you Witch Beam for this amazing game!

I would definitely recommend this game for people who want something super relaxing and calming. I have played it several times while listening to podcasts and it's super chill. I love the unpacking and organizing aspect of the game. 

The only thing I would say is a con about the game is the fact that the game is only roughly 3 hours long and, yet, costs $20. I don't feel like the price tag matches the amount of content provided. I would love to remain hopeful that there will be, like, a DLC of more content but, based on some light research, the chances of that happening is rather low. Other than that, this is a fabulous game so I recommend waiting for it to go on sale (unless you're ok with paying the original price tag).

很治愈的一款游戏了。
每件物品拿出和摆放，每个环境的变迁，都可以体会到游戏中那个主角生活和心态的变迁。
直到最后一件屋子布置好，bgm唱完的出现的画面，才知道游戏中很多小细节的透露出的结局。
重复的1+2=3终于在结局里获得了答案，就像最后的歌唱的那样吧，每次来到一个新的地方，打开包装厚重的行李，也是在unpack一段新的人生。


（把东西都丢给你收拾，只留一点空间给你，还让你把奖状放床底下的臭男人给我guna）

遊戲玩法很單純，就是擺放物品到適合的位子，然後透過道具及場景的變化，

讓你大概推敲出遊戲的劇情想表達的內容是什麼，

遊玩過程算是很輕鬆的，過關後是覺得遊戲本質是不錯的，

但可惜的就是關卡有點短，如果用價錢來看的話，會覺得有些偏高，

入手的玩家要先知道遊戲的主要玩法跟關卡不多這為前提，如果可以接受那就好好享受這款吧。
This is a very cute game. Very addictive and fun! I never thought I was one for organizing puzzle games but here I am! This game is so fun, and there is so much to it.

The way that just unpacking boxes so clearly tells the story of someone's life was really surprising and very well done. In particular the difference between 2010 and 2015 really got to me (in a good way for 2015). The music is lovely and it was fun finding stuff in total random boxes, very familiar having moved house not that long ago!

The game is so relaxing, it's a really good game especially if you have anxiety. The soundtrack is lovely and the story line... it's something different. The ending honestly made me tear up, it was so sweet and perfectly built. This is one of my favorite games and I highly recommend it! Thank you to the creator(s) of this game for all your work <3!
It's a well made game, but it was super boring to me. Although the game is only 3-4 hours long, felt like a slog to get through. Would not recommend.
Its a great puzzle Game! Lets ya organize however you wish (of course with some limitations) but still, its amazing! 10/10
Even tho I liked the game its way to overpriced, you only play it once and then its the same over and over again. If they added more levels it will be completely worth the money.

Once you complete the game and think about it a little, you realise that "Unpacking" is more than just moving items out of boxes and placing them around your rooms, but its about literally unpacking your life and memories. The story is told through a very unique way and was very emotionally investing and it times very relatable. Absolutely worth picking up and hope to see more like this. Good job and support indie developers!

Wonderful little game. Although the fact that the character you're playing as pisses me off by packing a kettle with their clothes I still love it. Definitely recommend this little experience. The game doesn't go for as long as I thought it would but it was a lovely few hours (i left the game running in the background so that's why it probably says 26 hours.

Moving is often stressful, but the actual unpacking when you are finally done moving all furniture and boxes  is the one fun part and this game makes a game out of it, and what a game it turned out to be. A masterpiece in storytelling from the mechanics and the environment alone, since there is no dialogue or text other than a few short lines every time you finish a level. But it still manages to tell a full story. From the various objects you unpack and find a space for you can get a pretty good idea about the unnamed and unseen protagonists life and all the ups and downs that come with it. You do have to put things together yourself but it's a sweet and moving story when you finally put down the final object in the last level. 

I tend to ignore the price when deciding to recommend a game (especially indie games) or not since "cost per hour" is subjective, I'm perfectly fine if a indie game is a few hours long. But for those who care, I will say it's not a especially long game. 3-4 hours perhaps.

A heartwarming game. You should definitely pay close attention to details, otherwise you will miss a large part of the depth of this game. Unfortunately, I found the game to come to a very abrupt end. I would have liked the expansion of the game to include even more locations/ages of the main character, not only because of the increased playing time, but also because of the symbolism.
This game is an absolute delight to play. Its so fun to discover things about the characters from unpacking and putting away their things. Such a cute story and a very interesting way to tell it

Very cute and chill game with moderate replay ability. It is super short, which is not a problem, but a thing to consider. I beat it in 5 hours, part of which was me running around doing real life stuff while the game was running. My only actual complaint is certain items are deemed to go in certain places. While I understand wanting restrictions to complete a level it did irk me a fair bit with some items. Thankfully, as far as where items can be placed debate goes, the game will let you rotate the TP to be on the right way or the wrong way. Happy Unpacking!

Really cute and relaxing game. May not be a long game but it's still fun regardless. There's so many cute details hidden in this game also that I love, This very much is a game I can see myself replaying at some point also.
very cute game, it's just as the title says all you do is unpack. i loved creating my own story line for the character based off how the scenary and objects started to change around them.

I just couldn't get into it. A lot of the 8 hours of game play recorded was because I'd run to grab a snack and forgot I even had the game up. It seems far too short with not enough to do. Having the option for multiple side quests or options in the story-line would be nice for those who wish for re-playability. I'm a fan of the $1.00 per hour rule and this game fell immensely short of that. So to me, it wasn't worth the $20.00 I paid for it.
So incredibly delightful. The subtle storytelling is fantastic, and the art is very cute. The ending left me feeling all warm and fuzzy. highly recommend for an fun and relaxing game

Over all a good game and nothing wrong but i paid a bit over 200 sek or 20 dollars and you finish it in 2-3 hours and thats it, it needs mor eupdates and more "rooms" or levels and maybe a infinety mode. im really dissapointed and i cant return the game and i just feel tricked, a waste of money in my opinion.

I loved this game and really wish it was longer- or included separate characters to play as maybe? With different puzzles and accessories rather than reusing the same items in each and every puzzle. As much as I loved seeing the purple mug get chipped overtime and turned into a bathroom sink-mug, I definitely would have liked to see a bigger variety in items as well as stories maybe? It ended way too quickly!!
Not overall interesting, storage room runs out and the clutter just looks messy. Have to place objects in certain room to complete :/ Waste of money

This game is amazing. The storytelling is impeccable, even without there being dialogue to follow. It's soothing, sweet, and surprisingly emotional. I cried of happiness at a certain point and smiled through tears at the end. Yes, I am a wimp, but it was amazing to see the representation in the game. The storytelling was somewhat subtle, but not difficult to find. I really felt like I was unpacking myself after certain events, all aided by the music and environment. Just a brilliant game. I can't wait to try and complete all of the achievements!

Если Вы поклонник или вам просто нравится играть в Симс, то эта игра вам зайдёт. Очень успокаивающая игра, просто кайфуешь и раскладываешь всё по полочкам, в буквальном смысле. 
Милая графика, ненавязчивая музыка и закос под 8 бит - это прикольно.
В данный продукт можно порубиться, когда нервничаешь или спокоен как удав. Ты контролируешь здесь маленький кусок повседневности. 
В общем и целом игра классная!
It's really relaxing, like you're unpacking in real life. Music is good, the SFX is good. The replay is recommended for extra satisfaction. 100% recommend.

I have so many positive things to say about Unpacking. Its such a fun, relaxing, cozy game. I honestly feel with this game I can play it over and over and not be tired of it. Its one game that if you just want to unwind or just relax this is the perfect game. It also helps the music is very relaxing as well. I had fun seeing what new items were added each year you progressed. Honestly fell in love with the little chicken family and how much they grew at the end. I told my friends and viewers on stream that I wanted to own them lol They were that adorable. Honestly if you are on the fence about this game just get it. Its honestly one of the best games i have played and I cried like a baby at the end. It was so beautiful. I hope they make another because I will buy it and play it over and over.

this game made me weepy multiple times over and i cannot stress how relaxing, adorable, and intriguing it is to watch this person grow up and progress through relationships and roommates. the music is wonderful, the graphics are adorable, and watching somebody grow and progress through their items and unpacking into their various stages of life was...a lot more emotional than I really had figured it would be. i loved it. the achievements being stickers and rewarding you for playing around in the space is such a nice touch! added a cherry on top :)

i recc this to anybody who has a few hours to kill and wants a nice relaxing game to play through and have fun with

Beautiful game that has such a unique form of story telling. So much growth, love, and learning is conveyed in such a simple way. Absolutely in love with this game and I desperately hope the game is expanded or sequels are released that tell the stories of more characters. 10/10 I wish I could make everyone play this game.

Absolutely fantastic game that I thought was solely about unpacking stuff, but left me crying at the end. The visual storytelling was one of a kind, and I loved how you could tell in advance how things would develop from 
the interior design alone. An absolute masterpiece, that didn't need a single line nor character to let the player enjoy the whole story.
It was cute and enjoyable - but tooooooooo short for he $20 price. If you want to try it wait until it is severely discounted maybe like $5.

游戏流程太短太短了，虽然是个非常治愈又好玩的游戏，但是只有8个关卡，打通以后也没有更新，70块钱略贵了，希望后续更新。
The game flow is toooooooooo SHORT! We want more boxes to unpack!

装扮公主屋小游戏全面升级版。
本想打开看看就去睡，明天再玩。结果直接玩通了，手麻了，好疼。

This game was such a heart warming experience and I can't lie, it was fully worth the money I spent on it. If you like to decorate this game is just for you, and even better it has a cute story to follow all along the way. I can't explain why I feel like crying when I play this game, but it's such a good experience to sit down and spend a few hours on. 

 The art is so lovely, the small references to other games is fun to find, and watching this character we never really see go through their life journey is just so beautiful. A lot of complaints I noticed so far was length, but there's only so many places a character can move to. And as long as you don't rush through levels there's enough play time to satisfy you (100% buy this on sale!) I hope in the future we get a dlc or update for another story to play through, as I'd buy/play it in a heart-beat.

Was a pleasant relaxing game, LOVELY story behind it as well which I did not expect. The chickens....♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ Everything. Pixelated chill vibe game play. I hope they add a few more cute stories to play through.

I really fell in love with this game! And  I really loved the story!
But I wish it were longer, within a few hours I completed the game :(
Maybe dlc's with more stories to follow?

This game has an amazing potential. Potential for new stories, new environments, new things to unpack and new mysteries to discover.

But the creators decided not to do that. And don't get me wrong, that's okay - but this makes the game not worth its price. It gives you a few hours of gameplay and leaves you with the void, because now you know that you just NEED more stuff to unpack, and doing all the same all over again just doesn't make as much sense. 

This game gave me - I'm not exaggerating - the most fun and chill at the same time, but then it just left me with sadge and bad feelings that it won't be continued. Shame on you, Witch Beam and Humble Games.
20 bucks for a short game like this isnt worth it, very fun and relaxing dont get me wrong. Just I finished the entire game in about 3-4 hours.
It was a cute game. But the price is far too high. Only one storyine and only about 3 hours playtime. Don't buy this until you have the money to spend.

It's simple and fun. Though I do like to put somethings in other places but I like how it will tell you about the story through the objects. I would have definitely liked more stories than just the one...but I'll take it for now and just simply enjoy the game.

Unpacking is a great game. As an Australian, I love all of the little details that you'd typically only see in this country (I loved the New Zealand tributes too!). The ambience and music bring the game to life and it's truly a really good game.
I got emotional at the end. This is a fantastic game, very chill, almost like meditation. But tells an absolutely beautiful story. 10/10 love it.

Sweet and short, i really enjoyed the story telling medium this game uses and the pixel graphics. However, I am very anxious and could only play for short bursts because APPARENTLY unpacking stresses me out. Still worth it!

I did not expect that a game of unpacking and putting away things can make me feel so accomplished and emotional. The gameplay was simple, straightforward. But the little sprinkles of lore and story that you discover through the MC's things added depth to the game: a story of getting older, going through life's downs, and growing out of it to find fulfillment and love.  This game is amazing and I can't wait to find games similar to this.
The game is very fun and relaxing, the game is quite short but it's still good to try and find the achievements and use the free placement mode :)

Quite a unique and interesting experience. I was expecting something more puzzly but it ended up being more of a story told without words. Was confused at certain times by the occasional seemingly arbitrary rules about where something is supposed to go. With certain items it is part of the story but with others it seemed a bit random. But at any rate, it had me laughing out loud at times and overall a pleasure.

I really liked this game... I really enjoy organizing, so I loved unpacking everything and organizing it around the houses. The only thing I didn't like about this game was how short it was. I paid $20 for a game that I finished in 3 day. Considering how short the game was, I think it should be a lot cheaper. For $20, I would expect a much longer game, that doesn't take me 3 days to complete. Otherwise, the game was great, and I loved it!
Very relaxing and easy to understand, with a lovely subtle storyline. My only qualm is I wish there was more content for the price point.

玩得让人想起来每次搬家有多上头。。。而且话说为什么她搬家这么多次
另外。。那几条祖传内裤还有袜子 能不能扔。。多少年了亲姐姐怎么到哪都带着呢？
为什么袜子会莫名其妙少一只捏。。
祖传电脑跟我一样呗，不用了也不扔找个角落一塞。。

Nettes, allerdings ziemlich kurzweiliges, Umzugs-Game.
Es geht darum Kartons auszupacken und die jeweiligen Räume (Küche, Bad, Schlafzimmer usw.) nett einzuräumen. Nebenbei erzählt das Game die Lebensgeschichte (offensichtlich) einer Frau. Also im Grunde wirkt das wie ein ganz normaler Umzug, in den jeweiligen Räumen stehen Kisten, diese packt man aus, wobei man nicht weis was man rausholt. Das Game macht einem recht einfach, da die Gegenstände meist zu den Räumlichkeiten passen. Manchmal muß man jedoch auch Sachen in ein anderes Zimmer schleppen.

Im Badezimmer räumt man üblicherweise diverse weibliche Hygieneartikel, Shampoos, Handtücher und eben alles was ins Bad gehört. Es gibt Küchenutensilien, jede Menge Bücher, DVDs, Blu-Rays und ja Klamotten, Knödelheber, Buchsen und Schuhe. Eben alles was man so im wahren Leben anhäuft und wenns soweit ist dann mit sich schleppt.

Es gibt einige Achievements, die meisten bekommt man automatisch, die anderen sind auch kinderleicht zu ergattern.
Zugegeben für die aktuell (2021-12-23) ~20€ finde ich das Spiel etwas zu wenig, mit gerade mal 8 Level ist man relativ fix durch und einen Wiederspielwert hat das Game eigentlich auch keinen.
Auf der anderen Seite muß man sagen; ja es ist mal etwas anderes. Die Grafik paßt auch recht gut ins Schema, witzig ist (man spielt von 1997 - 2018) das sich die Musik mit den Jahren ändert. Während 1997 noch Techno Mucke tätert, spielt 2018 eben jene Mucke aus dieser Zeit. Ok keine lizensierte Musik, Gebabbel a la Sims aber mit einschlägig erkennbarer Melodie.

Fazit: Man sollte nicht allzu großes erwarten, dennoch hat man einige Stunden Spaß daran der guten die Bude(n) einzuräumen und obwohl ich den Preis doch eindeutig zu hoch finde, würde ich das Game dennoch empfehlen!

Great game, super fun & relaxing, but incredibly short. I played through it SLOWLY in 5 hours. Really hope there is more expansions and free dlcs added. Not worth the price for being so short, still liked it though.

Fantastic game. Relaxing and fun, with some amazing music. The only downside is the overall price. I managed to finish the game within 5 hours and I personally don't think the price should be that high for 5 hours of in game content.
强迫症一本满足，把所有物品归类以后那种解压的感觉特别爽。不过美中不足的就是有些物品从表面而言看不出来属于什么物品该放在哪里，还是希望能有一些提示的。

The sound design alone makes this game worth the $20 price tag. It was incredibly relaxing and I was absolutely blindsided by how well they let the environments tell you a story, without ever speaking the words.

六个小时玩了两遍，所有成就到手。
虽然70块确有些不值，但是游戏风格还非常值得入手的，如果能打个折就很棒了。
画风可爱，音乐放松，充分满足了云收纳的内心快乐，希望可以有更多故事环节，有没有类似游戏各位大佬也推荐推荐。

A beautiful little game from start to finish. I am loving these games about the beauty of life like Unpacking, Hot Pot for One, and Before Your Eyes. The story is wildly excellent considering they can only tell it through moving items through a space. I found myself feeling frustrated, happy, melancholic, and nostalgic all within a few hours. Using personal objects to convey all of this was just beautifully done, and really felt like a progression of the environmental storytelling of Gone Home. Just lovely from start to finish.
Очень милая и расслабляющая игра, было интересно знакомиться с историей не из текста или диалогов с НПС, а по вещам, которые достаешь из коробок. Один минус - игра очень короткая, хочется ещё и ещё.

A very relaxing game, albeit a short one. would like to see more gameplay added in the future, with different storylines [spoiler] (an athlete, author, engineer, a doctor, lawyer, etc) [/spoiler] maybe? or [spoiler] maybe different house layouts? [/spoiler] anyways, it is a very good game. :)

Great game for people who love to organize. The game play is very mindless as you place items around the room but slowly you see a story evolve after each unpacking. With less than 50 words, the game takes you through the ups and downs of this girls life and gives you the chance to grow with her.
Loved the story telling. The part where she moved into her boyfriends home really touched me, they did a great job and showing us that he didnt make room for her.

this game is able to tell a story by having you unpack the possessions for each move.
absolutely fantastic

i adore this game. i never write reviews but i wanted to for this game. i've been waiting for it for a long time, and it was really worth the wait. the music completes the atmosphere, and the graphics are adorable. the fact that you get to decide where to put different items gives you free rein to do what you want. you can turn off the part where it tells you at the end where stuff should go, so you really can have complete choice. i love this game and would recommend it to anyone who likes puzzles, or just relaxing games that help you unwind.

First off this game is short, i played in in about 3 1/2 hours and paid $20, which i am perfectly fine with. i am fine paying that because you can buy a movie for $20 and only get 2 hours of entertainment so it works out :) the games design is simple and beautiful and the music is lovely, i certainly recommend for a quick chill game.

I love this game, however, it is way, way too short, especially for the price. That is the only disappointing thing about it.  If they update and add more to it, it will be perfect. I hope they do add to it... I really enjoyed it while it lasted.

Das Spiel gefällt mir richtig gut und macht Spaß, aber muss mich den anderen leider anschließen, für 20 Euro viel zu wenig Inhalt. War gerade so im Spiel drin und dann war es auch schon vorbei. 2,5 Stunden finde ich sehr wenig dafür das es 20 Euro kostet.

Bei Unpacking verfolgt man die zahlreichen Umzüge der namenlosen Protagonistin. In der Kindheit beginnend sammeln sich auf der Reise ihres Lebens viele Gegenstände an, die Auskünfte über dieses geben und mit jedem Umzug diesem mehr Tiefe verleihen. Das Spiel bietet einen wunderschönen Pixel-Art-Stil, flüssige Animationen, Liebe zum Detail und sehr beruhigenden Soundtrack. Der größte Schwachpunkt Unpacking's ist sein Preis. Für 20€ werden lediglich 3-4 Stunden Spielzeit geboten. Nach diesen ist es einem offen die restlichen Achievements zu jagen, doch darauf kann man sich im Sinne Spielspaß und -länge auch nicht verlassen. Jeder Wohnort bietet eigene Musik, doch läuft diese aus und beginnt nach kurzen Pausen von neuem, was nach einigen Wiederholungen nerven kann. Sobald Unpacking keine weiteren Inhalte bekommt oder im Rabatt angeboten wird ist es leider nicht zu empfehlen.

Lovely Game, very relaxing ! You can be a bit creative with where and how you place things and the "hidden" story is really cute.
Some of the picking up and down sounds do sound cut off but that is the only thing that i noticed.
Overall 10/10, my favourit item is the Rainbow in the last Level because it has Pan Pride Colors.
Just a bit sad that you can complete it in only a few Hours, Would love to see more !

Very happy with this game. It's very relaxing and fun and I love the story it tells within the levels. It seems like a real one of a kind game. My only criticism is how short the game is for the price of it. It would be really nice if it had more levels to unpack with different stories rather than just one persons story. Fingers crossed it has an update or even DLC with more content. I've already beat the game twice and started a third game but I can see myself getting tired of these levels pretty quick as it's the same story every time and you can only move things around so much...

Overall I would give the game an 8/10 because it is pretty much exactly what I was expecting minus replayability.

P.S. I've seen some people complain about not being able to place items wherever they want, there is an option in the settings that allows you to place items anywhere

Original et agréable, "Unpacking" vous fera vivre les emménagements d'une jeune fille, grandissant un-peu plus à chaque nouvelles étapes de la vie. 
Très intimiste, on devine le parcours de notre personnage en triant l'ensemble de ses affaires. Certains objet suivront notre personnages tout au long de sa vie, appuyant alors leur importance pour elle. 
Du cahier de dessin, aux serviettes hygiéniques, en passant par des manettes de Gamecube : tout doit trouver sa place !
L'aspect PUZZLE GAME du jeu prend tout son sens lors des derniers niveaux, ou les objets s'emboîtent afin de former un véritable foyer chaleureux. 
L'immersion est renforcée autant par les graphismes détaillés, que via l'aspect sonore du titre. L'OST est de qualité, et les bruitages des objets sont variés et très satisfaisant. 

Ce jeu est un "MINI"-rafraîchissement.
"MINI" justement... LE vrai point négatif du titre est en effet son prix. 10 ou 12€ auraient été justifiés, mais 20 € : pas dans l'état actuel.

Grace à sa méthode de narration, "Unpacking" à du potentiel. De nouveaux personnages/histoires avec pourquoi pas des thématiques plus adultes auraient été salutaires(maladie/séparation/dépressions/etc...). 
Si suivi et MAJ il y a, je vous conseille ce titre. Sinon, attendez une promo, ou une inclusion dans un catalogue de jeu en ligne (bonjour GamePass)

An incredibly charming game with cute graphics, a meditative pace, and effective and compelling environmental storytelling.  The amount you can learn about the characters' lives just based on what they take with them when they move pushes me to continue unpacking more houses to find out what happens to them, as they go through school, love, injury, and well, just life.

Recommended if you like story-based games or if you ever enjoyed putting together a house in The Sims.

Just an outrageously charming game. Loved every second of it. A tight little experience that knows exactly what story it wants to tell, and tells it beautifully.

This game tells its story through its mechanics, and through only its mechanics, astoundingly well. The evolution of the objects that come with you move to move (or don't come with you) and the way they age and change, does a phenomenal job of telling the story of this character. And the decorating is so fun and relaxing. I don't want to talk about how long I spent shuffling books and games into just the right order, or fussing over the exact placement of a particular fridge magnet - but I had a ton of fun doing so.

Spoilers for mechanical / narrative things follow, so stop reading here if you don't want that!

The changes in what you are and aren't allowed to move, and where you are and aren't allowed to place things between different levels floored me with how simply and effectively it communicated the natural rhythms of living with other people. The little frictions of moving in together, and what access you do or do not have to their things, and what space you do or do not make for each other, is so tenderly communicated through the simple act of placing things in the right/wrong spots. The emotional changes that happen between levels 3 and 7 are so clever, and communicated a fantastic narrative arc that made for a wonderful emotional catharsis in the game's final, joyous level.

I was so touched by so many "real" little details throughout. Standing in the minimalist kitchen wondering where to put my little purple mug. Their shampoo is too tall for the bottom shelf, so they get the top one. Somehow they have five pairs of leggings when only four will fit in the drawer. The way interests and hobbies come along for the ride - like coffee and beetles and music. It was lovely finding personal ways to keep things centered and expressed, and it made me think a lot about my own real life space. A really meditative experience, and a really touching and tender one. Cheers to the development team.

Ich habe das Spiel gekauft, um mich ein wenig abzulenken (und zu entspannen) und seinen Job hat es auf jeden Fall erfüllt.

Spieldauer & Inhalt: 
Die Spieldauer beträgt 3-4 Stunden, was angemessen für ein Indiespiel ist, allerdings für den Preis doch recht wenig ist. Wünschenswert wären Zusatzinhalte, die evtl. mehr Räume und Häuser ermöglicht. Doch was man bereits geboten bekommt, reicht für den Anfang vollkommen aus. Die Geschichte ist einfach erzählt und man lernt doch recht viel vom Charakter kennen. Es wird viel auf Detail geachtet. Also würde ich hier 8/10 geben. 

Musik:
Die Musik ist an sich wirklich entspannend, nur leider setzt sie des öfteren aus. Man kann zwar den Gegenständen dadurch besser zuhören, aber die Stille ist dennoch nicht immer angenehm. Gut finde ich aber, dass es auch in den Geräuschen von den Gegenständen kleine Details gibt; wie dass Rasseln der Tabletten wenn man sie schüttelt. Deswegen gebe ich hier 5/10. 

Grafik & Design: 
Ich habe bewusst nach einem Low-Grafik Spiel gesucht, weswegen mir das Spiel schnell ins Auge sprang. Das Spiel ist daher gut für Pc/Laptop, die keine High-End-Grafikkarte haben. Es ist einfach gehalten, aber trotzdem haben viele Gegenstände gute Details, die einem nicht sofort auffallen. Keine Bugs oder weitere Fehler. Gute 9/10. 

Preis:
19,99€. Ich finde es etwas teuer für die Dauer. Es ist mir bewusst, dass hier viel Liebe im Detail gesetzt wurde, allerdings ist der Inhalt und somit die Spieldauer ein bisschen zu wenig für den Preis. Da das Spiel aber erst raus kam, bin ich gespannt, ob noch weiteren Zusatzinhalte erscheinen. 

Würde ich es empfehlen? Ja, aber auch nur für die, die nicht sehr auf das Geld achten, sondern einfach mal 3-4 ruhige Stunden haben wollen, ohne Stress. Und für die, welche altbekannte Gefühle vom Auspacken wieder erleben wollen.

This game is one of the most beautiful and touching puzzle games I have ever played in my life. It's exactly what I was looking for: a game about organizing and puzzles. However, what I was not expecting was the heartfelt journey of the protagonist implied through the different levels. Each level feels like a real part of this person's life - like it could be anyone's life! Seeing the growth and change was so heartwarming, and the ending was absolutely beautiful. I loved the subtlety of the game, and the LGBTQ+ representation. This game clearly was made with a lot of love, and I felt that in every little detail. While this is a shorter game, it is definitely worth your time! I would recommend this to anyone, not just those who like puzzles. 

Additionally, commenting on the mechanics, I like the casual difficulty of the puzzles and the system of using the cursor to move objects around. The accessibility options are great, too! The art was lovely, and I felt like the player could tell where each item was supposed to go based on its design. The music was charming, but not too intrusive to the experience. 

This game is so worth the price, and I would love to see more playing it!

Игра явно создана девушкой для женской аудитории, но играть мне в неё все равно было интересно, скорее даже расслабленно. Эта игра не требует от тебя каких-то усилий или знаний (хотя со знаниями я бы поспорил, но об этом позже), ты просто расставляешь вещи и предметы так, как тебе нравится, чтобы получить эстетическое удовольствие от того, как ты все это расставил (естественно с соблюдением логики, например, в конце тебе скажут, что настольную лампу на пол не стоит ставить, нельзя носки с трусами разбросать по комнате:( и тому подобное).
Есть конечно одно примечание: это то, что мы "как бы" играем за женского персонажа => все вещи женские, но лично для меня, да и для большинства, я думаю, это будет не так важно, наоборот, внесет какого-то интереса, типо: "Как бы я обустроил свой дом, будь я девушкой". Но всё-таки мужскую сюжетную линию тоже хотелось бы увидеть.
Примечание: В игре есть капля повесточки, но людям не обращающие внимание на сюжет, могут даже её и не заметить.

[b] Перейдём к плюсам и минусам [/b]

[i] Плюсы: [/i]
+ Успокаивающий и расслабленный геймплей. 
 То что надо, после череды поражений в кске, доте или танках. 
+ Игра - песочница с большим количеством вариантов того, как ты хочешь что то расположить. 
 Можешь эти платья повесить в шкаф, а блузки и футболки сложить в тумбочку, или наоборот, как тебе по душе. Можешь на этой полке поставить высокие тонкие книжки и посередине между ними для красоты поставить миниатюрную эйфелеву башню. А на нижней полки картриджи от консоли. Все в твоих руках. 
+ Присутствует сюжет! 
 Для меня было удивительно, что в этой игре есть, хоть прямолинейный и предсказуемый, но сюжет! То есть тебе не только интересно расставлять предметы по комнатам по своему вкусу, но и интересно наблюдать за историей героини. 
+ Внимание к деталям. 
 Я был удивлен, что тут есть внимание к таким деталям, как изнашивание предметов с годами. К примеру: в самом начале у нас есть плюшевая свинка (которую героиня будет таскать с собой всю свою жизнь). В 2005 году она ещё красивая и яркая. Через 5 лет она уже выцветшая и не такая яркая. Ещё через 5 лет на ней видны уже потёртости и отверстия, из которых вылезает вата. Также и со стаканчиком для зубной щётки, который со временем трескается и т.д.
+ Хорошая музыка.
 Я бы её отнёс к + со спокойным геймплейм, если бы она не была так хороша. Обычно я в играх без особого сюжета, по типу, Евро трак симулятора или Кар механик симулятора включаю свою музыку, но не в этой игре. Во-первых она хорошо написана и отлично подходит для расслабленной игры. Во-вторых она совпадает с настроением героини и сюжетом происходящем на фоне, что погружает в атмосферу игры.

[i] Минусы: [/i]

- Очень короткая игра.
Я эту игру со своим темпом прошёл за 7 часов. И это крайне мало. Хотелось бы увидеть больше сюжетных линий и персонажей с разной историей. 
Например: 
 История про героя выросшего в среднестатистической семье, который со временем стал обычным работягой, который каждый день ходил в офис. Но в его жизни что-то происходит, и он становиться богатым миллионером. И вот мы уже не обустраиваем какую-то однушку, а целый особняк.
 Или какую-то грустную историю, где герой игры вырастает в бедной, неблагополучной семье, и все его комнаты будут нас погружать в его нелегкую жизнь.
 Также хотелось бы увидеть интерьер других народов и наций. Так и представляю потрепанный диван, за которым на стене весит персидский ковёр, где то в красном уголке стоит икона бабушки, а под телевизором "Фотон" приставка Денди, а на балконе советские санки, велосипед и батины удочки:) 
- Отсутствие мастерской стим.
Да, я это отношу к минусам, так как поддержка мастерской в этой игре, как раз таки исправила проблему с небольшой историей и открыло бы огромные возможности для комьюнити этой игры.
- Как я и говорил в самом начале, нужно понимать, что куда ставить или класть, но как ты можешь знать куда это поставить, если ты не знаешь что это?!
 Например: Уже ближе к концу, у нас появляется партнёр, у которого есть свои сувениры, связанные с его национальностью. И вопрос, КАК Я ДОЛЖЕН ПОНЯТЬ КУДА СТАВИТЬ ПРЕДМЕТ, КОТОРЫЙ ПОХОЖ НА СРЕДНЕВЕКОВЫЕ ДЕРЕВЯННЫЕ КОЛЬЯ ДЛЯ ОБОРОНЫ СТЕН ЗАМКА, ЕСЛИ ОНИ НЕ СТАВЯТСЯ НА ПОЛКУ?! Куда я их только не тыкал, единственное место куда они подошли, это место на холодильнике. 
 Если бы были описания этих предметов или хотя бы подсказки в конце игры, куда это ставить, было бы намного лучше.

[b] Итоговая оценка: [/b]

Отношение плюсов и минусов 5:3 => Положительный отзыв. Рекомендую покупать, если вас такой геймплей расслабляет, но он короткий из-за одной кампании.

[h1]FR/EN Unpacking[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3580220706
[h3]---FR---[/h3]
Unpacking est un jeu simple, on est là pour ouvrir des cartons et ranger des objets du quotidien. On suit une femme dans ses déménagements successifs au fil de sa vie. On passe ainsi de la chambre d'adolescente à la maison de femme mariée avec enfant en passant par les logements transitoires menant de l'un à l'autre. 

A chaque nouveau logement on range les affaires et on suit sa vie en déballant les objets qui sont autant de souvenirs du temps qui passe. En quelques phrases le jeu nous rappelle la vie qui évolue, celle que l'on a ou que l'on aurait pu avoir avec des choix différents. 
[h3]---EN---[/h3]
Unpacking is a simple game where you open boxes and organize everyday objects. You follow a woman through her successive moves throughout her life. You go from her teenage bedroom to a married woman's house with a child, passing through the temporary accommodations in between.

With each new home, you unpack your belongings and follow her life by unpacking objects that are like memories of time passing. In just a few sentences, the game reminds us of life's evolution, the life we ​​have or the life we ​​could have had with different choices.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3580220789
[h3]---FR---[/h3]
La musique invite à la relaxation et à la contemplation des graphismes en 2D qui sont très réussis. Le jeu propose au joueur d'explorer les niveaux avec des succès cachés qu'il faudra découvrir en effectuant certaines interactions. 

Au final le jeu m'a touché par sa simplicité et les émotions qu'il véhicule avec un concept simple. Tous le monde ne verra pas la même chose ne fonction de son vécu personnel. Pour moi il s'agit d'un beau petit jeu qui se boucle en quelques heures dans une ambiance relaxante.
[h3]---EN---[/h3]
The music invites relaxation and contemplation of the very well-done 2D graphics. The game encourages players to explore levels with hidden achievements that must be discovered by performing certain interactions.

Ultimately, the game touched me with its simplicity and the emotions it conveys through a simple concept. Everyone will see things differently depending on their personal experiences. For me, it's a nice little game that can be completed in a few hours in a relaxing atmosphere.

Unpacking is technically not a [i]bad[/i] product - I mean you only have to look at the acclaim it's received since release. There are definitely things I can find to admire about it, but when it comes down to giving my experience of it as a game a thumbs up or thumbs down? Honestly, I was kind of glad to see the end of it.

The positive reception to the game is something that baffles me because in all honesty, I just don't think it's a very good GAME. A cosy experience, sure. Relatable and heartwarming life stories. But maybe my brain just isn't wired to enjoy something like this, because the "puzzle" element began to wear very thin for me.

There are quite a few elements of moon logic here where figuring out where something is supposed to go just doesn't feel logical or lead to any kind of brain-teasing investigation... just a frustrated trip to Google to figure out where things should be (the 2010 framed degree being the worst culprit - I don't care what "clever" explanation there's supposed to be for it, it wasn't fun to try and figure out).

I can at least give credit where credit is due for the artistic vision of the game. The pixel art is pretty incredible, with so much variety and reactivity to items that I can only IMAGINE how large the asset library for this game would be... it's also very technically well made from the perspective of actually placing things, it all feels very well crafted from an interactive standpoint. I admit it is at least [i]somewhat[/i] satisfying to plonk things around a house.

Sometimes the art style does surface some issues too though; I spent a good period of an earlier stage trying to figure out what I was supposed to be doing with some white drawing tablet-looking thing, which I eventually gave up on and Googled and discovered it was supposed to be some kind of fridge whiteboard? There were a few items where it wasn't immediately obvious what they were because it was obfuscated by the resolution of the pixel art - I finished the game honestly not being 100% sure what some items were.

Which kind of leads me to the point where I got bored of the game. Eventually I started just emptying boxes onto any surface available, like a table or desk, just to get the items out in the open so I could clear the boxes away and start putting items in their rightful spots. But the game just kind of started ACCEPTING this horrible mess I was leaving everywhere as successfully "unpacking" - so I figured why waste time putting things away properly? Eventually I just stopped caring where things went, just as long as the red error outline was gone.

The soundtrack does do an acceptable job of setting the tone for each era, but honestly it's pretty bland and forgettable beyond that. The audio and sound effects are at least good though, and add to the tactile-feeling experience of moving objects around.

I feel kind of bad leaving a bad review, as I was pretty on the fence, but I would just not honestly recommend this to anyone. Which is a shame, because my expectations were so high.

I have a pile of boxes sitting in my garage from my last move, and I had refused to touch them for a number of months now under the pretense of both 'ill get to it, eventually' and 'I might move soon anyways, so why bother'. I don't like unpacking. I find it to be an often overwhelming and stressful experience; there is some joy in pulling open a box and seeing what I have tucked away in there, but there is more often dread. The process of pulling all your ♥♥♥♥ out of boxes forces you to look at all the things you own and the kind of life that you've tried to build, and more-so that the act of pulling a possession out of storage forces you to reconcile both the person that you were when you acquired that possession and how you treated it before, how you might now, and the difference between those states. 

But there is a deep joy and freedom that can come from that experience. Every new object, every new placement, is a new chance to define your home and by proximity yourself. The best homes, in my experience, are their occupants and reflect them. Hence why mine is an gentle wreck with a great deal of things I love, and the only complete thing being the half-complete projects on every surface. 

I found this game painful. And joyful. Sometimes monotonous. The rewind after finishing a full house and seeing a sped up recreation of it might be one of the most singularly satisfying experiences I've had in a video-game. I don't know if this game will be worth it for you, but it was for me. I'm gonna go clean under my bed now.

引っ越し荷物の荷ほどきを通じて主人公の人生を想像し追体験する整頓ゲーム。
なにかに急かされるでもなく、落ち着いた曲を聞きながら黙々と荷物整理。
ゲームコンセプトは素晴らしい。まったりと時間を潰すのに適している。

全８ステージで単純に割れば１ステージあたり２５０円ほど（部屋数で割ればもっと安い）。お世辞にもゲーム性に富んだゲームではないので、高いと思うか安いと思うかは意見が分かれそう。遊びたい人は物足りなさを感じるだろうし、癒されたい人はまあまあ満足できるのでは。

文化圏の違いで馴染みのないアイテムが多く、また情報量の少ないドット絵のせいで分類に迷うことが多々ある。
アイテム名表示のON／OFFがあればよかった。

ステージクリアに必要な条件に「アイテムを適切な場所に置く」というものがある。不適切な場所に置いたアイテムが赤く強調されて教えてくれるのだが、実績達成のために「間違ってはいるけど一度そこに置く」状況が発生するので、実績解除を目指す人は注意されたし。

🏡喜歡程度：⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐​
​
分享一款很有禪意與談及人生的遊戲「unpacking」​
遊戲方式很簡單，全程不會有劇情與對話。​
大體是是一個女生(主角)從小到大各階段搬家，​
玩家要協助他將包裹一一打開 ，將東西整理回位置上。​
而這樣的遊戲方式僅僅是表面，​
稍微想一下你可以從這些物品，拼出一個完整故事。​
每個人會搬家都有一些理由，​
因為升學、因為伴侶、因為理想...等。​
​
大部分人擁有第一個房間時，大都小小舊舊，​
但裡面充斥著所有自己喜歡的物品，​
那種滿足安逸的感受，​
是我們從外頭歸來最溫暖的歸屬。​
我們在房間裡或許吃飯睡覺，​
或許胡思亂想開心又流淚，​
在房間裡作夢與實踐夢想，​
這些情緒和事蹟全都附著在物品上，​
讓我們產生依戀感，漸漸心靈開始依賴它們。​
有一天我們經歷一個階段又一個階段，​
會成長也會改變，​
我們會拋下那些物品跟著時間的步伐往前走，​
頭也不回地往前走。​
​
到頭來，那些從以前到現在所保留的物品，​
是真正重要的，是不可或缺的，​
這輩子我們都會需要他的，最重要的東西。​
​
就像遊戲中主角一樣，他有個豬寶寶娃娃，​
他從全新的樣子到破洞綻開白色的棉花，​
因此小豬身上縫縫補補的，​
主角從小帶著他到每個房間，​
每個家，每個人生階段。​
當然不是所有物品都這樣幸運，​
有些是主角曾經把玩珍視的，​
但過個幾年我們整理房間時，​
發現那些物品不見了........​
就好比有些事物我們曾經執著，​
固執地不放手緊緊抓住，​
可終究我們與它們緣分仍盡，​
它們從手中消失，滾落至床腳深處，​
甚至消失在我們人生中。​
​
​
🏡列幾個遊戲中我覺得特別有故事的物品：(有捏劇情)​
​
-主角從小喜歡踢足球也很喜歡畫圖，​
得過大大小小的獎，​
其中一塊獎牌本來在其他房間都擺在顯眼的牆上，​
不過在一次搬家估計是搬到主角男友家，​
獎牌在這個家我找不到地方放，​
找了很久只有床底下可以安置。​
是不是就代表著人生中那些輝煌的經歷，​
我們曾經得意的成就，​
也會落到在他人亦或自己無法再重視的時候，​
是眼前的愛情勝過自己的成就？​
或戀愛中的人啊也迷失了本來的自己？​
不管是因為什麼原因，​
都是自己選擇的，​
我們總是會忘記自己曾經多麼優秀過，不是嗎？​
​
-主角從男友家搬回到自己家，​
有一張看起來是一對男女親密的照片，​
把它放在照片圖畫牆上系統會跳錯誤，​
只有將他放在櫃子深處系統才會給過，​
這是不是就是指那些對我們刻骨銘心又痛苦的回憶，​
是多麼令人不願面對卻又不忍割捨？​
如果有天主角能將那張照片消失在自己的生活中，​
那才是真正的放下了，​
他已經有勇氣準備好面對未來的日子。​
​
後來的幾次搬家可以透過物品類型發現，​
主角有了一個女性同居者，​
兩人關係親密，而主角也出了自己的系列繪圖本。​
那個還年幼愛畫圖的孩子，​
如今和喜歡的人同住在一個美麗溫馨的家，​
還共同養育了一個孩子。​
一起同居的女孩跟主角一樣，​
喜愛玩各種遊戲喜愛生活，​
是兩個能接受彼此興趣和成就的伴侶。​
​
房子終究是個家的殼，​
住在裡面的人才成了真正的家，​
他們參與進對方的人生。​
遊戲到這裡就結束了，或許.....​
這次是他們最後一次搬家。​
​
人生最終的適得其所，​
不過是找到了個滿意的房子，​
遇到了想一起生活的人。​

Unpacking is a sweet puzzle game that lets you move at your own pace to unpack furniture into various rooms. I had a fun time finding a place for everything, and organizing things however I wanted to. The game is pretty lenient about where you can place things while still having logical requirements for where things should go. The stickers, which are the achievements, were often silly and cute. I wasn't expecting this game to have a story, but I was blown away by how expertly it was told. Even if it was a bit short, I really loved this game, and I'd love to play more like it. I'd recommend it for anyone who likes puzzles and wants a laid-back gaming experience.

[h3][u]Stručné hodnocení[/u][/h3]
☐ Doporučuji
☑ [b]Titul mě neoslovil[/b]
☐ V současném stavu nemohu doporučit

[h3][u]Šplechty[/u][/h3]
Na jednu stranu nechci negativně hodnotit produkt, jehož naprosto zjevně nejsem cílová skupina, na tu druhou však cítím potřebu upozornit kohokoli, kdo by se jako já mohl fundamentálně mýlit v porozumění tomu, co si plánuje koupit, a zároveň vytvořit malou protiváhu k jinak veskrze pozitivním recenzím, neboť jejich aktuální rozložení zde na Steamu nepovažuji za reprezentativní.

Hra v upoutávkách nepředstírá, že je něčím, čím není, ovšem zároveň vyvolává dojem, že jde o něco více, než o pouhé repetitivní vykládání předmětů z krabic při stěhování do stále nových domovů. Nemám nic proti tomu, když je hráči ponechán prostor pro dotvoření příběhu, právě naopak, ovšem když zaplatím 19,99€ a dostane se mi za to narativní ekvivalent párku v rohlíku s neocenitelnou příležitostí domyslet si kečup, hořčici, karamelizovanou cibulku či relish zcela po svém, nemohu se zbavit dojmu, že jsem si pořídil kočku v pytli. Největším problémem je, že jakékoli rozhodnutí – rozumějte položení předmětu na zvolené místo – má nulový význam, neboť příběh se vždy odehraje naprosto identicky, a solidní potenciál je tak kompletně promarněn. Navíc je hráč nucen dokola vykládat stejné předměty, včetně neustále se zvětšující hromady knih a blue-ray disků, jejichž umisťování mi pravděpodobně zabralo více než dvacet minut. Když k tomu připočteme "zábavný twist" spočívající v tom, že protagonistka i přes opakované stěhování zcela zjevně nedokáže rozeznat, co patří do které krabice, neboť stále dokola balí pánvičky k toaletním potřebám či tiskárnu mezi nádobí a důsledně se brání, aby stejné předměty umisťovala k sobě, pročež je třeba neustále přerovnávat již uklizené věci, stává se celý zážitek s postupem hrou stále více frustrujícím. Možnost foto-režimu, v němž jsou k dispozici různé filtry, samolepky a podobné senzačnosti, jsem nevyužil, čímž jsem se okradl o minimálně patnáct minut senzační zábavy, a skončil tak po ulovení všech achievementů na dvou a půl hodinách strávených v nenaplněném očekávání, že teď už se konečně něco stane.

Samostatnou kapitolkou jsou pak ideologické momentky, mezi než patří například to, že když se protagonistka přestěhuje k partnerovi, musí mu přeskládat spodní prádlo do jednoho šuplíku, neboť očividně není tohoto náročného úkonu schopen, nebo že v jeho bytě není prostor na její vysokoškolský diplom, ovšem – a teď asi [b]SPOILER ALERT[/b] – když se nakonec rozhodne založit si rodinu s jinou ženou, místa mají dostatek. S trochou odstupu je však možné, že to spíše než o hře vypovídá něco o mně ... o mně přesyceném neustále se opakující duhově-pastelovou formulí, která spíše než na smysl a hratelnost cílí na to, aby byla dobově poplatná.

急ぎ過ぎてはいけません。

例えば荷物の一つが「なんだろ？この荷物わ・・」となってメチャメチャ試行錯誤を求められる場合がままあります。
曰く「こんなの何処に置いても同じじゃん！」とか「いや、引き出しの一段目と二段目なんて差がないじゃん！なんで二段目固定で置かないとだめなのさ！！」「殺虫剤がなんで大きい方の棚に固定で置かないとだめなのかっ！！」
・・などと心を乱されますが、これらの怒りは抑えないといけません。

[b]則ち其処許(そこもと)に求められるのは「禅」の心なのです。[/b] 
無心になり置ける場所をひたすら探し続ける・・心が鍛えられます。

ステージ（＝新しい引っ越し先）が進むにつれ、正体不明の荷物の置き場所は、貴殿の心の中に必ずやインプットされております ⇒ 「ああ、この謎物体の置き場所は決まって机の上だ」「これはクローゼットの中に配置のやつ」といふ風に。

[spoiler]そして貴殿はさらに学びを得ます⇒「をいっ！最初から配置済のアイテムも能動的に動かせるのかよっ！！」と。[/spoiler]

このゲイムは禅の心だけではなく貴殿の学習能力も「そこはかとなく」求めてくる・・そういうゲイムなのです。

Every October, I subject myself to a constant onslaught of horror: I only read horror books, I only watch horror movies, and I only play horror games. While that may seem like overkill, it pretty much slakes my need for horror for the entire year afterward.

But, even for a freak like me, a palate cleanser is due once November comes. So, after this past Halloween, I decided to settle in for something [b]extremely[/b] cozy. And I couldn’t have picked a better game to come down from my horror high if I tried.

[i]Unpacking[/i] is exactly as the title suggests: you unpack boxes as some unseen protagonist moves from home to home throughout their life. There are no timers and no real challenges (unless you’re going for the extremely-easy-to-get 100% completion). It’s the very definition of chill… even when deciphering what objects are and where they belong proves to be more difficult than it should be.

My favorite part of the game must be the story, though. It’s told exclusively through environmental storytelling. This is usually a negative for me, but all of the cues are easy to pick up, even to an unobservant schmuck like myself. I went along for the ride alongside the protagonist, feeling every high and low point along the way.

If I have something to gripe about, it will have to be the game’s length. This game is very short (it can easily be finished in one sitting) but that didn’t keep me from feeling like it overstayed its welcome. The levels get progressively longer as the game goes on and, by the last couple of levels, I was audibly saying “okay, okay, I get it” to myself. It makes sense in that, as we live our lives, the number of things we carry only increases. But I think that if the developers had found a clever way to do the opposite, it could have been just as impactful. You know, the fleeting nature of life, the years really fly by, and all that ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.

I think that’s all there is for me to say about this one. If it sounds like your cup of tea, you should give it a try. The asking price is pretty steep for what it is, though, so I would recommend waiting for it to be in a bundle or on sale before buying it.

Почитав отзывы, решила, что стоит самой рассказать о "Анпакинге", потому что я вижу эту игру будто с другой стороны.

Игру сложно назвать медитативной, потому что [u]3х часов тупо мало[/u]. 435 рублей....эээээ....

[u]Замечания[/u]:
Проблем с расстановкой предметов нет никаких, о чём пишут люди в отзывах. Все предметы имеют крайне логичное местонахождение. [i]Возможно у меня имеется такой скилл, после многочисленных переездов, hehe.[/i] Только два предмета я лично не признала - пачка новых губок для мытья (спутала с пачкой таблеток) и подставка для благовония (спутала с термометром настенным).
Самые сложные уровни - это общага и переезд к парню. В общаге всё валяется невпопад и тяжело вклинить свои предметы в этот хаос. А у парней из-за "изобилия" вещей естественно есть такие места как: вся полка только для ОДНОГО шампуня и целый огромный ящик для ОДНОЙ ПАРЫ трусов. Всё это решаемо, если передвигать предметы ранее находившиеся в комнате.

Очень надоедает выкладывать одни и те же предметы уже в пятый раз. Из-за чего появляется чувство повторения и начинаешь пересиливать себя. Слава [i][вставить своё][/i], это длиться всего лишь 3 часа.
[quote=Ваас Монтенегро, Far Cry 3]Безумие — это точное повторение одного и того же действия раз за разом в надежде на изменение.[/quote]
Да, прослеживается взросление персонажа, да, и в реальной жизни с многими предметами мы не расстаемся долгие годы, но... и одновременно мало предметов развития персонажа, нет изменений предпочтений и появления новых интересов.
Спойлер: [spoiler] В начале видно, что она любит рисовать, потом это перерастает в рисунки хрюшки, появляются атрибуты современного художника, зарисовки хрюшек, а на последнем левеле это книги с хрюшками. Но как любила видеоигры, так и таскает одни и те же диски и картриджи из одного дома в другой. И книги. И ложки/вилки/кастрюли/кофемолку/etc. Неужели наша реальность такая же? Неужели мы приобретаем интересы в детстве и тянем их всю жизнь за собой с минимальными изменениями и дополнениями? Стоит задуматься... [/spoiler]
Игра типа такая "ээээй, будь тем кто ты есть! Это так современно и круто!". Это без слов и диалогов белыми нитками в игре.
Современная повестОчка имеется, в ногу так сказать...
П.С. Было бы интересно видеть фишечки, что какие-то предметы теряются или разбиваются при переезде. Слышать/видеть реакцию персонажа на события.

跟朋友同時間一起開始玩
大概約3小時多可以全破，但朋友玩得比較快
約2.2小時就破關了

這款遊戲是一種視覺收納和實用擺設互相掙扎牴觸的遊戲
若你要快速過關，不考慮合理性和實用性，其實只要把東西亂放
或是全部擺在抽屜、衣櫃裡面看不到亂塞就好
但是若以這是自己的家裡來布置的話，就會考慮各種合理性
會思考和花上的時間就比較多

看一些人評價遊戲用時間過少價格太貴所以給不好評
但是這遊戲的美術物件數量非常多
每一個物件都是像素物件還要畫各種方向
以及跟場景物建堆疊後的狀態，其實要花非常多時間製作外
遊戲的程式碼控制和測試時間應該也少不了

就這樣我認為這是一款價格合理的遊戲
況且這遊戲的敘事手法是以物件和環境來訴說
最後拍照的結論也會因為你拍照當前的環境有不同的敘事說明
還有許多隱藏小成就，也做得很細心
從遊戲內容可以感受到製作組滿滿的誠意


因此我給予非常好評

很舒壓的遊戲～用搬家整理家來訴說故事～4.7小時全成就～

優點：
在不同場景處按過關時，相冊會有不同的形容，看得出作者的用心～
有些成就要取得還真意想不到，咖啡和廁所這兩個最後還是要看攻略才解到～大概兩小時就完成故事，然後又花了兩小時才解開其他成就，剩這兩個，最後不停試了半個小時都解不開，受不了去看攻略～這兩個解法真的有點難猜到耶～作者的創意滿分！！
可以把遊玩過程製作gif，看起來滿療癒的～
BGM很舒服～玩完後本來想買原聲帶，可是......價錢定價太太太貴了，都快比得上遊戲主體的價錢了～可惜～

缺點：
遊戲太短了～太概用兩小時就能完成故事，而且重玩性不高～
沒物件的名稱，有兩件東西到最後都不知是什麼東西～希望之後更新可以在選取物件後提示該物件是什麼～
圖標沒提示，如重放、拍照等等，裡面的圖案都沒提示，有點不清不楚～

感想：
看得出作者的用心和創意～遊戲整理起來很輕鬆舒壓，玩完我都想來整理一下我家，可是一想到在現實上整理家的麻煩，還是算了～XD 然後遊戲時長太短跟重玩性不高，感覺HK$89有點貴，不過整體來說還是一個很不錯的遊戲～ 希望之後能玩到小孩出生後的故事～
